instruction: Mikataba ya ushauri (consultancy agreements) inahitaji stamp duty Tanzania?
output: Baadhi ya mikataba ya huduma (service agreements) inaweza kuwa na wajibu wa stamp duty chini ya Stamp Duty Act Tanzania kulingana na maudhui na thamani ya mkataba. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa aina maalum za mikataba inayohusika na kiwango cha stamp duty kinachofaa. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kiwango cha PAYE cha asilimia 25 kinatumika kwa mapato kati ya Shilingi 700,001 na 1,000,000 kwa mwezi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kanda ya asilimia 25 inaanza kwa Shilingi 760,001 — si Shilingi 700,001. Kanda ya asilimia 20 inaisha kwa Shilingi 760,000 (si 700,000). Kanda kamili za PAYE za kila mwezi ni: 0% (hadi 270k), 8% (270k–520k), 20% (520k–760k), 25% (760k–1M), 30% (zaidi ya 1M). Shilingi 700,001 iko bado katika kanda ya asilimia 20.
question_en: The 25% PAYE band applies to income between TZS 700,001 and 1,000,000 per month — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The 25% band starts at TZS 760,001 — not TZS 700,001. The 20% band ends at TZS 760,000 (not 700,000). The full monthly PAYE bands are: 0% (up to 270k), 8% (270k–520k), 20% (520k–760k), 25% (760k–1M), 30% (above 1M). TZS 700,001 is still within the 20% band.

question_sw: Tathmini ya TRA ya miaka 5 iliyopita inaweza kupingwa — je, kuna kikomo cha muda?
answer_sw: TRA ina muda wa miaka 5 kuwasilisha tathmini (limitation period) kwa makosa ya kawaida ya kodi. Hata hivyo, kwa udanganyifu au kutopiga kodi kwa makusudi, hakuna kikomo cha muda. Tathmini iliyotolewa ndani ya miaka 5 inaweza kupingwa ndani ya siku 30 za kuipokea.
question_en: Can a TRA assessment for 5 years ago be disputed — is there a time limit?
answer_en: TRA has a 5-year limitation period to issue assessments for normal tax errors. However for fraud or willful non-declaration there is no time limit. An assessment issued within the 5-year period can be disputed within 30 days of receiving it.

question_sw: Niliuza bidhaa kwa shirika la serikali na wamenikatia kodi — ni kiwango gani cha VAT withholding kwenye bidhaa?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha VAT withholding kwenye bidhaa ni asilimia 3, kuanzia 1 Julai 2025. Mnunuzi anayehitimu ni: (a) Wizara ya Fedha, (b) taasisi ya serikali inayorudisha mapato yake yenyewe, au (c) mtu aliosajiliwa aliyeteuliwa na Kamishna Mkuu. Hii inamaanisha mnunuzi hukata asilimia 3 kutoka malipo yako na kuipeleka TRA moja kwa moja. Kiasi hiki si VAT yote — bado unaweza kudai VAT ya pembejeo dhidi ya VAT ya matokeo. Thibitisha na TRA kwa maelezo kamili.
question_en: I sold goods to a government entity and they withheld tax — what is the VAT withholding rate on goods?
answer_en: Under Finance Act 2025, the VAT withholding rate on goods is 3%, effective 1 July 2025. A qualifying buyer means: (a) Ministry of Finance, (b) a government entity that retains its own collected revenue, or (c) a CG-appointed registered person. This means the qualifying buyer deducts 3% from your payment and remits it directly to TRA. This is not the full VAT — you can still claim input VAT credits against your output VAT. Confirm with TRA for full details.

question_sw: Kizingiti cha SDL ni wafanyakazi 10 au ni kulingana na mapato ya biashara?
answer_sw: Kizingiti cha SDL ni IDADI ya wafanyakazi — si mapato ya biashara. Hata biashara ndogo yenye mapato kidogo inalipa SDL ikiwa ina wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Na biashara kubwa yenye wafanyakazi 9 tu hailazimishwi kulipa SDL.
question_en: Is the SDL threshold 10 employees or based on business revenue?
answer_en: The SDL threshold is based on NUMBER OF EMPLOYEES — not business revenue. Even a small business with low revenue pays SDL if it has 10 or more employees. And a large business with only 9 employees is not required to pay SDL.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: Kampuni yangu ya uchimbaji madini Tanzania — kodi na ushuru wote unaohusiana na uchimbaji ni upi?
output: Royalties za madini zinasimamiwa na Sheria ya Madini Tanzania na zinategemea aina ya madini yanayochimbwa. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Kodi ya kampuni za uchimbaji madini inajumuisha royalty, kodi ya mapato ya kampuni, na ushuru mwingine maalum wa sekta ya madini — inahitaji utaalamu maalum wa kina. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu, Wizara ya Madini, au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: PAYE tofauti na kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) ni nini?
answer_sw: PAYE inahusu mapato ya ajira tu — mwajiri anakata na kulipa kila mwezi. Kodi ya zuio inahusu malipo mengine kama vile gawio (dividends), riba, ada za ushauri, na pango — wakala mwingine (mtu anayetoa malipo) anakata na kulipa. Viwango na tarehe za malipo zinatofautiana. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the difference between PAYE and withholding tax in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE relates only to employment income — the employer deducts and remits monthly. Withholding tax covers other payments such as dividends, interest, consultancy fees, and rent — the paying party deducts and remits. Rates and deadlines differ. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri anasema SDL ni 'Sikuwa Leave Disability' — ni kweli?
answer_sw: Uongo kabisa. SDL haina uhusiano wowote na likizo (leave) au ulemavu (disability). SDL ni Skills Development Levy — ushuru wa fedha ambao mwajiri (si mwajiriwa) analipa TRA kila mwezi. Inahesabiwa kama asilimia ya jumla ya mishahara.
question_en: My employer says SDL is 'Sick Leave Disability' — is that true?
answer_en: Completely false. SDL has no connection to leave or disability. SDL is Skills Development Levy — a monetary levy that the employer (not the employee) pays to TRA every month. It is calculated as a percentage of total gross payroll.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Naomba uthibitisho: kiwango cha juu cha VAT Tanzania ni asilimia 18 na cha chini ni asilimia 5?
answer_sw: Hapana sahihi. Tanzania haina muundo wa 'juu' na 'chini' wa viwango vya VAT. Kuna kiwango kimoja cha kawaida: asilimia 18. Bidhaa/huduma zingine ni zero-rated (asilimia 0) na nyingine zimesamehewa kabisa (exempt). Kiwango cha asilimia 5 hakipo. Muundo ni: exempt (hakuna VAT), zero-rated (asilimia 0), standard (asilimia 18).
question_en: Please confirm: is the highest VAT rate in Tanzania 18% and the lowest 5%?
answer_en: Not correct. Tanzania does not have a 'high' and 'low' VAT rate structure. There is one standard rate: 18%. Some goods/services are zero-rated (0%) and others are fully exempt. A 5% rate does not exist. The structure is: exempt (no VAT), zero-rated (0%), standard (18%).

question_sw: Gari la kampuni linalotumika na mfanyakazi kwa matumizi ya kibinafsi — PAYE inatumika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Manufaa ya gari la kampuni yanayotumiwa kwa matumizi ya kibinafsi (personal use of company car) yanachukuliwa kama mapato yanayolazimika PAYE. TRA ina njia ya kuhesabu thamani ya manufaa haya. Matumizi ya gari kwa ajili ya biashara tu hayajumuishwi.
question_en: Company car used by an employee for personal use — does PAYE apply?
answer_en: Yes. The benefit of a company car used for personal use is treated as taxable employment income. TRA has a prescribed method for valuing this benefit. Use strictly for business purposes is not included.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

instruction: Tofauti kati ya OSHA na WCF ni nini? Zote mbili zinasimamia ajali — zinahusiana vipi?
output: Tofauti kati ya OSHA, WCF, na NSSF: OSHA = kuzuia ajali na usalama mahali pa kazi (prevention/regulation). WCF = kulipa fidia baada ya ajali ya kazi (compensation). NSSF = pensheni na usalama wa jamii wa muda mrefu (pension/social security). Mahusiano yao: OSHA inajaribu KUZUIA ajali isitokee. WCF inalipia fidia BAADA YA ajali kutokea. Mfano: mfanyakazi anaanguka na kuumia → OSHA inakagua kama mahali pa kazi kilikuwa salama, WCF inalipa fidia kwa mfanyakazi aliyeumia.

question_sw: NSSF inaweza kulipa mfanyakazi aliyefikia umri wa miaka 55 bila kujali aina ya kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Miaka 55 ni umri wa kustaafu mapema kwa wafanyakazi wa sekta ya MADINI na kazi kali zinazohitajika chini ya NSSF Act. Kwa wafanyakazi wa kawaida wa sekta nyingine, umri wa kawaida wa pensheni ya NSSF ni miaka 60. Pia, ili kupata pensheni kamili ya NSSF, mfanyakazi anahitaji angalau miezi 180 (miaka 15) ya michango. Mfanyakazi wa ofisi anayeacha kazi akiwa na umri wa 55 hawezi kudai pensheni ya NSSF kiotomatiki.
question_en: Can NSSF pay a worker who has reached age 55 regardless of their type of work in Tanzania?
answer_en: Age 55 is the early retirement age for workers in the MINING sector and hazardous occupations specified under the NSSF Act. For ordinary workers in other sectors, the normal NSSF pension age is 60. Also, to receive a full NSSF pension, a worker needs at least 180 months (15 years) of contributions. An office worker who leaves work at age 55 cannot automatically claim NSSF pension.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

instruction: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kupeleka VAT iliyokatwa TRA ni lini?
output: Withholding agent lazima apeleke VAT iliyokatwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata mwezi wa manunuzi. Kwa mfano, ikiwa ulinunua mwezi Januari, malipo ya withheld VAT yanatakiwa ifikapo tarehe 20 Februari. Tarehe 20 pia ni tarehe ya kuwasilisha VAT return — wajibu hizi mbili zinafanana kwa tarehe.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: Bima ya maisha (life insurance) inatozwa insurance premium levy tofauti na bima za jumla (general insurance)?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Utofauti kati ya ushuru wa bima ya maisha na bima za jumla unashughulikiwa na TIRA na inahitaji utaalamu maalum wa sekta ya bima. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TIRA kupitia tira.go.tz.

question_sw: Kampuni ndogo isiyolipa kodi kwa wakati inapata adhabu ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Adhabu za kuchelewa kwa Tanzania zinategemea aina ya kodi: PAYE: asilimia 2.5 kwa mwezi wa kiasi kilichochelewa. VAT: asilimia 2 kwa mwezi + faini ya mara moja ya asilimia 25. NSSF: asilimia 5 kwa mwezi. SDL: adhabu kama PAYE. Adhabu hizi zinaendelea kujilimbikiza kila mwezi hadi kiasi kimelipwa. Kutofungua faili kabisa kunaweza kusababisha ukaguzi wa TRA na tathmini za kodi.
question_en: What penalties does a small company face for late tax payment in Tanzania?
answer_en: Late payment penalties in Tanzania depend on the tax type: PAYE: 2.5% per month of the overdue amount. VAT: 2% per month plus a one-time 25% penalty. NSSF: 5% per month. SDL: penalties similar to PAYE. These penalties compound every month until the amount is paid. Failing to file at all can trigger a TRA audit and tax assessments.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or Tax Administration Act update

question_sw: Mauzo ya nje ya nchi (exports) yanastahili VAT ya asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Mauzo ya nje ya nchi (exports) ya bidhaa na huduma yanastahili VAT ya asilimia sifuri (zero-rated) ikiwa na uthibitisho wa kufilisi bidhaa nje ya Tanzania Bara. VAT ya sifuri inaruhusu msajiliwa kudai mkopo wa pembejeo (input tax credit). Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What VAT rate applies to exports of goods and services from Tanzania?
answer_en: Exports of goods and services are zero-rated (0% VAT) provided there is proof of consumption/supply outside Tanzania Mainland. Zero-rating allows the registered person to claim input tax credit. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: GN 605A imeinua mshahara wa chini lakini mfanyakazi wangu alikuwa tayari anapata zaidi — SDL yake itabadilika?
output: SDL inakokotolewa kwa MSHAHARA HALISI UNAOLIPWA — si mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A. Kama mfanyakazi wako tayari alikuwa anapata zaidi ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A — mshahara wake haubadiliki kwa sababu ya GN 605A peke yake. SDL yake itabaki kulingana na mshahara wake halisi. Kwa mfanyakazi ambaye alipata mshahara sawa na au chini ya kizingiti cha GN 605A — mshahara wake lazima uinuliwe, na kwa hivyo SDL base itaongezeka. Kwa muhtasari: GN 605A inainua sakafu ya mshahara — wafanyakazi walio juu ya sakafu hawabadiliki kwa GN 605A peke yake. Thibitisha na GN 605A na TRA.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya mpya inatazamia mapato ya TZS 300M kwa mwaka wa kwanza — ninaweza kusajili VAT mapema (voluntary registration)?
output: Ndiyo — TRA inaruhusu usajili wa hiari wa VAT (voluntary registration) hata kabla ya kufika kizingiti. Faida za usajili wa mapema: (1) Unaweza kudai input VAT kwa manunuzi yako ya awali (vifaa, vifaa vya biashara); (2) Wateja wako wa VAT wanaweza kudai input VAT — inakufanya mvutia zaidi kwa makampuni makubwa; (3) Unapata TRA VRN (VAT Registration Number) mapema. Hasara ndogo: unaanza wajibu wa kuwasilisha VAT return kila mwezi. Kwa biashara inayotazamia mapato makubwa, usajili wa mapema unashauriwa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Gari la abiria linaloingizwa Tanzania — ushuru wake ni asilimia ngapi ya thamani?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ushuru wa magari yanayoingizwa Tanzania (vehicle import duty) unahusisha asilimia nyingi tofauti zinazotegemea aina ya gari, umri wake, na thamani yake — hii ni mada ya Customs and Excise ambayo iko nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, na ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara. Wasiliana na TRA Forodha na Ushuru kupitia tra.go.tz kwa jibu sahihi.

instruction: Polisi wamesema mgeni atapewa 'faini ndogo ya kiutawala' badala ya kufikishwa mahakamani — hii inawezekana?
output: Hapana — GN 487A si sheria ya faini ya kiutawala inayoweza kutatuliwa nje ya mahakama. Hii ni kosa la jinai linalohitaji: (1) ukamataji au tuhuma rasmi; (2) kesi mahakamani; (3) hukumu ya korti — faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6; (4) kufutwa kwa visa na Idara ya Uhamiaji. Kama polisi wanapendekeza 'faini ndogo' bila mahakama, hii si mchakato halali. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu yuko likizoni ya ugonjwa kwa miezi miwili bado analipwa mshahara. Je, ninalipia NSSF wakati huu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — wajibu wa NSSF unaendelea wakati wa likizo ya ugonjwa inayolipwa. Mwajiri analipa asilimia 10 na mfanyakazi analipa asilimia 10 ya mshahara wote unaolipwa wakati wa kipindi cha ugonjwa. Kama mfanyakazi yuko likizoni bila malipo (unpaid leave) hakuna mshahara kwa hiyo hakuna msingi wa NSSF. Lakini ukwa unamlipa mshahara wa sehemu au kamili wakati wa ugonjwa, NSSF inahesabiwa kwenye kiasi kinachopwa na inalipwa ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa malipo.
question_en: My employee has been on sick leave for two months but is still receiving salary. Do I pay NSSF during this period?
answer_en: Yes — NSSF obligations continue during paid sick leave. The employer pays 10% and the employee pays 10% of all wages paid during the sick leave period. If the employee is on unpaid leave there is no wage and therefore no NSSF base. But if you pay partial or full salary during illness, NSSF is calculated on the amount actually paid and must be remitted within one month after the salary payment month.
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act amendment changing contribution rules

question_sw: Kampuni inahitaji vibali ngapi vya kazi kwa wageni?
answer_sw: Serikali inaweka kikwazo cha idadi ya vibali vya Darasa B kwa kila kampuni kulingana na idadi ya wafanyakazi wa Tanzania. Uwiano unaotakiwa kwa kawaida ni wageni wasizidi asilimia fulani ya wafanyakazi wote. Idara ya Uhamiaji ndio yenye mamlaka ya kuamua na kampuni inapaswa kuwasiliana nao moja kwa moja kwa mwongozo wa hali ya sasa.
question_en: How many work permits can a company get for foreign employees?
answer_en: The government imposes a quota on Class B permits per company based on the number of Tanzanian employees. The required ratio generally means foreigners cannot exceed a certain percentage of total staff. The Immigration Department has authority to decide and companies should contact them directly for current quota guidance.
next_review_trigger: Immigration Act or quota regulation change

question_sw: Mgeni anayeomba kuhamia Tanzania anaweza kufungua duka — amri ya GN 487A inasemaje?
answer_sw: GN 487A inamzuia mgeni yeyote asiye raia wa Tanzania kufungua duka la rejareja au biashara nyingine yoyote katika makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa — bila kujali kama ana kibali cha makazi au la, au kama ameomba uhalisi wa kudumu au la. Hali ya uhamiaji (immigraiton status) haibadilishi uhalali wa kumiliki biashara katika sekta hizi. Duka la rejareja ni miongoni mwa shughuli zilizozuiliwa wazi. Mtu huyu anapaswa kupata ushauri wa kisheria kabla ya kufanya maamuzi ya biashara nchini Tanzania.
question_en: A foreigner applying to move to Tanzania wants to open a shop — what does GN 487A say?
answer_en: GN 487A prohibits any non-Tanzanian citizen from opening a retail shop or any other business in the 15 prohibited categories — regardless of whether they have a residence permit, have applied for permanent residency, or are in any immigration status. Immigration status does not change the legality of owning a business in these sectors. A retail shop is explicitly among the prohibited activities. This person should get legal advice before making any business decisions in Tanzania.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Ndani ya muda gani hati lazima ipigwe stempu baada ya kutiwa saini?
answer_sw: Hati zote zinazohitaji kodi ya stempu zilizotiwa saini Tanzania lazima zipigwe stempu ndani ya siku 30 (thelathini) baada ya kutiwa saini. Kama hati imetiwa saini nje ya Tanzania lakini inahusiana na mali au jambo linalofanywa Tanzania, nayo lazima ipigwe stempu ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kuingia Tanzania. Wakati wa kupeleka hati kwa Afisa wa Stempu kwa tathmini (adjudication), siku hizo hazihesabiwi kwenye siku 30.
answer_en: All instruments requiring stamp duty that are signed in Tanzania must be stamped within 30 (thirty) days of signing. If an instrument is signed outside Tanzania but relates to property or a matter performed in Tanzania, it must also be stamped within 30 days of entering Tanzania. The time period during which the instrument is lodged with the Stamp Duty Officer for adjudication is excluded from the 30-day period.
question_en: Within what period must a document be stamped after it is signed?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — 30-day rule

question_sw: Mshahara wa TZS 270,001 (shilingi moja zaidi ya kizingiti) — mfanyakazi analipa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — mshahara wa TZS 270,001 unaathiriwa na bendi ya pili ya PAYE. Lakini: kodi inazingatiwa kwenye sehemu inayopita kizingiti cha TZS 270,000 tu — si mshahara wote. TZS 1 × 8% = TZS 0.08 Kwa vitendo kiasi hiki ni kidogo sana — PAYE inayozalishwa kwa kiwango hiki cha mapato ni ndogo mno. Kumbuka: hakuna punguzo la kibinafsi tofauti la TZS 26,000 kwa mwezi katika mfumo wa PAYE Tanzania..
question_en: Salary of TZS 270,001 (one shilling above the threshold) — does the employee pay PAYE?
answer_en: Yes — a salary of TZS 270,001 is affected by the second PAYE band. But: tax applies to the portion exceeding the TZS 270,000 threshold only — not the full salary. TZS 1 × 8% = TZS 0.08. This is effectively zero in any practical sense — the total PAYE generated at this income level is negligible. Note: there is no separate TZS 26,000 monthly personal relief deduction in Tanzania's PAYE system. In practice: an employee will not pay PAYE until their salary reaches the level where PAYE bands generate PAYE exceeding TZS 26,000.

instruction: Mwanagenzi (agent) wa bima analipwa commission — je, commission inakatwa VAT?
output: Commission ya wakala wa bima ni mapato ya huduma — kwa hivyo inaweza kukatwa VAT kama wakala amefika kizingiti cha VAT au amesajiliwa VAT. Ikiwa wakala wa bima ni mwanachama wa taaluma inayolazimishwa na TRA — inawezekana kusajili VAT hata bila kufika kizingiti cha TZS 200M. VAT kwa commission ya bima: ikiwa amesajiliwa VAT, anatoza 18% VAT kwa commission yake. Mteja anayehitimu anaweza kudai input VAT. Ikiwa bado hajafika kizingiti na si katika taaluma inayolazimishwa — bado halazimiki. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na TIRA (tira.go.tz).

question_sw: Je, GN 487A inalenga mataifa fulani ya kigeni — kama Wachina au Wasomali peke yake?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A inatumika kwa raia WOTE wa kigeni bila kujali nchi wanayotoka. Inajumuisha raia wa China, Somalia, Kenya, Uganda, India, Ulaya, na kila nchi nyingine. Kigezo pekee ni kuwa si raia wa Tanzania — utaifa wenyewe haufanyi tofauti.
question_en: Does GN 487A target specific foreign nationalities — like Chinese or Somalis only?
answer_en: No. GN 487A applies to ALL non-citizens regardless of their country of origin. This includes citizens of China, Somalia, Kenya, Uganda, India, Europe, and every other country. The only criterion is not being a Tanzanian citizen — nationality itself makes no difference.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: VAT inaathiri nani — mwuzaji au mnunuzi?
output: Kimsingi VAT ni mzigo wa MNUNUZI (consumer) — analipa VAT juu ya bei ya bidhaa au huduma. Hata hivyo, mwuzaji aliyesajiliwa VAT ndiye MKUSANYAJI (collector) wa VAT kwa niaba ya TRA: Mwuzaji anakusanya VAT (18%) kutoka mnunuzi, anazidisha na input VAT (VAT alipolipa kwa manunuzi yake), na analipa NET VAT kwa TRA. Kwa hivyo: mwuzaji ni wakala wa ukusanyaji wa kodi kwa TRA — pesa si yake. Mnunuzi analipa VAT lakini kama ni biashara aliyosajiliwa VAT, anaweza kudai input VAT credit. Mlipaji wa mwisho wa VAT ni MTUMIAJI WA MWISHO (final consumer) asiyesajiliwa VAT. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi wa nyumbani (domestic worker) ana kiwango cha mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wafanyakazi wa nyumbani wamejumuishwa katika GN 605A na wana kiwango cha mshahara wa chini. Hawastahili kulipwa chini ya kiwango kilichowekwa kwa ajili yao kuanzia Januari 2026. Angalia jedwali la GN 605A kwa kiwango maalum cha sekta hii.
question_en: Do domestic workers have a minimum wage under GN 605A?
answer_en: Yes. Domestic workers are included in GN 605A and have a minimum wage floor. They must not be paid below the rate set for their category from January 2026. Check the GN 605A schedule for the specific domestic worker rate.

instruction: Wafanyakazi wangu wanafanya kazi usiku — OSHA ina mahitaji maalum?
output: Ndiyo. Kazi ya usiku ina mahitaji ya ziada ya usalama — taa ya kutosha, usalama wa mahali pake, na kuhakikisha wafanyakazi wana njia salama za kutoka. OSHA inazingatia mazingira ya kazi usiku wakati wa ukaguzi. Fanya tathmini ya hatari maalum kwa kazi ya usiku na weka hatua za usalama zinazofaa. Thibitisha mahitaji kamili na OSHA (osha.go.tz).
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: Kiwango cha SDL ni asilimia ngapi na WCF ni asilimia ngapi — na zinalipwa wapi?
output:
Viwango na mahali pa kulipa:

SDL: asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya fedha — inalipwa TRA.
WCF: asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya fedha — inalipwa Mamlaka ya WCF (si TRA).

Zote mbili ni za mwajiri peke yake — hazikuatwi mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Kumbuka: kulipa WCF kwa TRA badala ya Mamlaka ya WCF hakukuridhisha wajibu wako wa WCF. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na Mamlaka ya WCF.

instruction: Je, Tanzania ina ushuru wa carbon au ushuru wa mazingira?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ushuru wa mazingira (environmental levy, carbon tax) na mfumo wake wa kisheria Tanzania ni mada tofauti kabisa nje ya wigo wangu wa VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na Wizara ya Mazingira, TRA, au mshauri wa mazingira aliyehitimu kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Baada ya TRAB, hatua inayofuata ya rufaa ya kodi ni ipi?
answer_sw: Baada ya uamuzi wa TRAB, rufaa inayofuata ni kwa TRAT (Tax Revenue Appeals Tribunal). Kutoka TRAT, rufaa ya mwisho ni kwa Mahakama ya Rufaa ya Tanzania (Court of Appeal). Kila hatua inahitaji muda na kugharimu gharama za kisheria kubwa zaidi.
question_en: After TRAB what is the next step in a tax appeal?
answer_en: After a TRAB decision the next appeal is to the TRAT (Tax Revenue Appeals Tribunal). From TRAT the final appeal is to Tanzania's Court of Appeal. Each step requires time and increasingly significant legal costs.

question_sw: Sheria ya OSHA inasema nini kuhusu usalama wa moto (fire safety)?
answer_sw: Waajiri wanalazimika kuhakikisha: vizima moto (fire extinguishers) vipo na vimekaguliwa, njia za kutoka kwa dharura (emergency exits) ziko wazi na zina alama, mafunzo ya dharura yanatolewa kwa wafanyakazi, na mpango wa uokoaji (evacuation plan) upo.
question_en: What does the OSHA Act say about fire safety?
answer_en: Employers must ensure: fire extinguishers are present and inspected, emergency exits are clear and marked, evacuation drills are provided to employees, and an evacuation plan is in place.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: VAT Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
output: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Kiwango kinachotumika zaidi ni 18% (standard rate). Kwa bidhaa na huduma zinazouzwa nje ya Tanzania: 0% (zero-rated, unastahili rejareja ya VAT). Chanzo: TRA (tra.go.tz) na Finance Act 2025.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ipo EPZ (Export Processing Zone) — je, ina msamaha wa VAT?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Msamaha na faida za kodi kwa kampuni katika EPZ (Export Processing Zone) au SEZ (Special Economic Zone) Tanzania zinasimamiwa na EPZA (Export Processing Zones Authority) na zina masharti maalum nje ya wigo wangu wa VAT ya biashara ya kawaida. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT ya biashara ya kawaida, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Wasiliana na EPZA (epza.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi wa uwekezaji kwa jibu sahihi.

instruction: Excise duty kwa bia na pombe Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Excise duty kwa pombe, bia, na bidhaa nyingine zenye ushuru maalum (excisable goods) ni mada ya Customs and Excise nje ya wigo wangu wa VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia compliance ya biashara ya kawaida Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na TRA Idara ya Forodha na Ushuru kupitia tra.go.tz au mshauri wa ushuru wa bidhaa maalum.

question_sw: Je, kampuni inaweza kumrudisha nyumbani mfanyakazi wake wa kigeni bila ya kumwarifu Idara ya Uhamiaji?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ikiwa mfanyakazi wa kigeni anaondoka Tanzania (kwa hiari au kufutwa kazi), mwajiri ana wajibu wa kumwarifu Idara ya Uhamiaji. Kushindwa kumwarifu kunaweza kusababisha matatizo ya siku zijazo kwa kampuni katika maombi mengine ya vibali na inaweza kuathiri rekodi ya uzingatiaji wa uhamiaji wa kampuni.
question_en: Can a company repatriate a foreign worker without notifying the Immigration Department?
answer_en: No. When a foreign worker leaves Tanzania (whether voluntarily or through dismissal), the employer has an obligation to notify the Immigration Department. Failure to notify can cause complications for future permit applications and may affect the company's immigration compliance record.

instruction: NSSF hailipi kwa wakati — mkurugenzi wa kampuni anaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi?
output: Ndiyo — TRA na NSSF zote zina uwezo wa kufuatilia wakurugenzi na maafisa wa kampuni kibinafsi kwa madeni yanayotokana na makosa ya makusudi. Kwa NSSF: kama kampuni inakusanya michango ya NSSF ya wafanyakazi (10% ya mshahara wa kila mfanyakazi) lakini haitumi NSSF — hii ni fedha ya wafanyakazi iliyoibwa. Wakurugenzi wanaohusika wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi kwa: (1) Madeni ya NSSF yote + faini ya 5%/mwezi + riba; (2) Mashtaka ya jinai ya kughafiliana na haki za wafanyakazi. Wasiliana na NSSF mapema kabla ya hali kuwa mbaya. Thibitisha na nssf.or.tz.

question_sw: Biashara yangu inafanya mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) tu — ninaweza kudai input VAT yote?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kama biashara inafanya MAUZO YA ZERO-RATED TU (si mauzo ya exempt), unaweza kudai input VAT yote. Zero-rated si sawa na exempt — zero-rated inamaanisha kiwango cha 0% lakini bado ni 'taxable supply', hivyo input VAT inaweza kudaiwa. Exempt inamaanisha nje ya mfumo wa VAT kabisa, na input VAT isiyoweza kudaiwa.
question_en: My business makes only zero-rated (export) sales — can I claim all input VAT?
answer_en: Yes. If your business makes ONLY ZERO-RATED SALES (not exempt sales), you can claim all input VAT. Zero-rated is not the same as exempt — zero-rated means a 0% rate but is still a 'taxable supply', so input VAT can be claimed. Exempt means completely outside the VAT system, and input VAT cannot be claimed.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Biashara ya B2C ya malipo ya kidijitali ina VAT ya asilimia ngapi kuanzia Septemba 2025?
answer_sw: Shughuli za B2C za malipo ya kidijitali (e-payment) zinalipwa VAT ya asilimia 16 kuanzia tarehe 1 Septemba 2025. Kanuni za utekelezaji zingali zinasubiriwa kutoka kwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA. Thibitisha hali ya sasa na TRA.
question_en: What VAT rate applies to B2C digital payment transactions from September 2025?
answer_en: B2C e-payment transactions are subject to 16% VAT from 1 September 2025. Implementation rules are pending a notice from the TRA Commissioner General. Confirm the current status with TRA.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya jumla (wholesale) — inahitaji kutoa risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala wa biashara-kwa-biashara (B2B)?
output: Ndiyo. Biashara yote — B2C (biashara kwa mtumiaji wa mwisho) na B2B (biashara kwa biashara) — zinazofuata kizingiti cha EFD (TZS 11M+ au zilizosajiliwa VAT) lazima zitoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala. Muamala wa B2B hausamehewi. Kila muamala lazima uingie kwenye mfumo wa EFD na risiti itolewe.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Mwajiri anayolipa mfanyakazi posho za chakula na usafiri anahitaji kujumuisha posho hizi katika msingi wa NSSF Tanzania?
answer_sw: Msingi wa michango ya NSSF Tanzania unategemea 'mshahara wa jumla' (gross wage). Posho za chakula na usafiri zinazolipwa kwa kawaida na mara kwa mara kama sehemu ya mfuko wa mishahara ZINAWEZA kujumuishwa kwenye msingi wa NSSF kulingana na jinsi zinavyofafanuliwa. Posho za hiari au zisizo za kawaida zinaweza kuepuka NSSF. Angalia NSSF na mwanasheria wa ajira kwa hali yako mahususi ya posho za mfanyakazi.
question_en: An employer paying food and transport allowances — must these be included in the NSSF base in Tanzania?
answer_en: The NSSF contribution base in Tanzania depends on 'gross wage'. Food and transport allowances paid regularly and consistently as part of the remuneration package MAY be included in the NSSF base depending on how they are defined. Discretionary or irregular allowances may escape NSSF. Check NSSF and an employment lawyer for your specific allowance situation.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act or gross wage definition update

instruction: Hoteli yangu inatoa huduma za mkutano (conference) — je, huduma hizo zinakata VAT?
output: Ndiyo — huduma za mkutano (conference services) kama ukodishaji wa chumba cha mkutano, teknolojia ya mkutano, chakula cha mkutano, na kadhalika ni huduma zinazoweza kuwa na VAT. Kama hoteli imesajiliwa VAT, inatoza 18% VAT kwa huduma zote za mkutano. Wateja wa kampuni wanaoweza kudai input VAT wanapenda kupata tax invoice (risiti ya EFD na VAT) — kwa hivyo toa tax invoice sahihi. Kama mteja ni qualifying buyer — anaweza kukata withholding ya 6% ya VAT. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kuhusu VAT kwa huduma maalum za hoteli yako.

instruction: Photocopy shop au duka la kuchapisha nyaraka inayomilikiwa na mgeni — je, GN 487A inazuia?
output: Ndiyo — uchapishaji na unanakili (printing na photocopying) ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A (tarehe 28 Julai 2025). Hii inajumuisha maduka ya kuchapisha nyaraka, kufanya nakala, na huduma za printing kwa ujumla. Mgeni anayemiliki au kuendesha duka la photocopy anakabiliwa na: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Mgeni mwenye ruhusa ya ukaazi wa kudumu (permanent residence permit) — ana haki ya kufanya rejareja?
answer_sw: Hapana — ruhusa ya ukaazi wa kudumu (permanent residence) inakuruhusu kuishi Tanzania kwa muda mrefu lakini haikubadilishi hadhi yako ya 'mgeni' kwa madhumuni ya GN 487A. GN 487A inaangalia URAIA wa Tanzania — si hali ya ukaazi. Mgeni mwenye ukaazi wa kudumu bado anakabiliwa na vikwazo vya GN 487A kwa biashara. Njia pekee ya kubadilisha hadhi hii ni kupata uraia wa Tanzania rasmi.
question_en: A non-citizen with a permanent residence permit — do they have the right to conduct retail trade?
answer_en: No — a permanent residence permit allows you to live in Tanzania long-term but does not change your 'non-citizen' status for GN 487A purposes. GN 487A looks at Tanzanian CITIZENSHIP — not residency status. A non-citizen with permanent residence still faces GN 487A restrictions on business. The only way to change this status is to obtain Tanzanian citizenship formally.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A or citizenship law

instruction: Mradi wa ujenzi wenye wafanyakazi 25 — safety officer anahitajika?
output: Afisa usalama (safety officer) anahitajika: Sekta ya jumla: wafanyakazi 50 au zaidi. Sekta ya ujenzi: wafanyakazi 20 au zaidi. Kwa sekta ya ujenzi, kizingiti ni wafanyakazi 20+. Mradi wako wa wafanyakazi 25 (ujenzi): Ndio, safety officer anahitajika. Sekta ya ujenzi ina hatari za juu zaidi → kizingiti cha chini zaidi (20 badala ya 50). Safety officer wa ujenzi anahitaji mafunzo maalum ya usalama wa ujenzi.

question_sw: Mwajiri anawasilisha fomu ya P10 tarehe ngapi kila mwezi?
answer_sw: Fomu ya P10 (malipo ya kila mwezi ya PAYE) inawasilishwa ifikapo tarehe 7 ya kila mwezi unaofuata kipindi cha malipo. Kwa mfano, PAYE ya Januari inawasilishwa ifikapo tarehe 7 Februari. Kuchelewa kunaleta adhabu ya asilimia 2.5 kwa kila mwezi wa ucheleweshaji.
question_en: By what date does an employer submit the P10 form each month?
answer_en: The P10 form (monthly PAYE remittance) is submitted by the 7th of each month following the pay period. For example, January PAYE is submitted by 7 February. Late submission attracts a 2.5% penalty for each month of delay.

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inaweza kubadilisha jina lake — mchakato ni gani?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni inaweza kubadilisha jina lake kwa: (1) kupita azimio la mkutano maalum wa wanahisa (special resolution), (2) kuwasilisha ombi la mabadiliko ya jina kwa BRELA pamoja na ada, (3) kupata Cheti kipya cha Uanzishwaji chenye jina jipya, na (4) kusasisha nyaraka zote, akaunti za benki, na hati za kisheria.
question_en: Can a Tanzania company change its name — what is the process?
answer_en: Yes. A company can change its name by: (1) passing a special resolution at a special general meeting of shareholders, (2) submitting a name change application to BRELA with the fee, (3) receiving a new Certificate of Incorporation with the new name, and (4) updating all documents, bank accounts, and legal instruments.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Ninaendesha biashara ya ushauri wa IT (IT consulting) — si fani iliyodhibitiwa. Je, lazima nisajili VAT?
answer_sw: Kwa IT consultant asiye na leseni ya fani iliyodhibitiwa, kizingiti cha kawaida cha TZS 200M kwa miezi 12 kinatumika. Huhitajiki kusajili VAT mpaka mauzo yako yafike kizingiti hiki. Hata hivyo: kama una leseni ya uhandisi wa programu (software engineering) kutoka ERB au leseni nyingine ya kitaalamu, kanuni ya fani zinazodhibitiwa inaweza kutumika. Thibitisha hali yako maalum na TRA.
question_en: I run an IT consulting business — it is not a regulated profession. Must I register for VAT?
answer_en: For an IT consultant without a regulated professional licence, the standard threshold of TZS 200M per 12 months applies. You are not required to register for VAT until your sales reach this threshold. However: if you hold a software engineering licence from ERB or another professional licence, the regulated profession rule may apply. Confirm your specific situation with TRA.

question_sw: EFD ni nini na inatumika kwa nini Tanzania?
answer_sw: EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) ni mashine ya kielelezo cha fedha iliyoidhinishwa na TRA inayorekodia kila muamala wa mauzo moja kwa moja na kupeleka taarifa kwa TRA moja kwa moja. Inatumika kuhakikisha kwamba: (1) kila mauzo yanafuatiliwa kwa madhumuni ya VAT na kodi ya mapato, (2) risiti za EFD zinaotolewa kwa wateja, (3) TRA inapata data ya mauzo moja kwa moja bila kutegemea ripoti za mkono tu. EFD inabadilisha risiti za kawaida za mkono.
question_en: What is an EFD and what is it used for in Tanzania?
answer_en: An EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) is a TRA-approved fiscal recording machine that records every sales transaction directly and transmits data to TRA automatically. It is used to ensure: (1) every sale is tracked for VAT and income tax purposes, (2) EFD receipts are issued to customers, (3) TRA receives sales data directly without relying only on manual reports. EFDs replace ordinary handwritten receipts.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD mandate or technology update

question_sw: Mimi ni wakala wa zuio la VAT. Ninaweza kupunguza VAT niliyoizuia kutoka kwa wasambazaji dhidi ya VAT ninayodaiwa mimi mwenyewe?
answer_sw: Hapana. VAT ya zuio unayoizuia kutoka kwa msambazaji wako hailipwi kama mkopo dhidi ya deni lako la VAT. Wewe kama wakala wa zuio unalipa kiasi hicho moja kwa moja TRA kwa niaba ya msambazaji. Msambazaji wako ndiye anayeidai kama mkopo wa VAT (input VAT) kwenye return yake. Lazima utoe hati ya zuio la VAT kwa msambazaji siku ambayo VAT inastahili kulipwa — si tarehe ya 20.
question_en: I am a designated VAT withholding agent. Can I offset the VAT I withheld from suppliers against my own VAT liability?
answer_en: No. The VAT you withhold from your suppliers cannot be offset against your own output VAT liability. As the withholding agent you remit the withheld amount directly to TRA on behalf of your supplier. Your supplier claims it as input VAT on their own return. You must issue the VAT withholding certificate to your supplier on the day the VAT becomes payable — not on the 20th.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing VAT withholding rules

question_sw: GN 487A ina orodha ya biashara ngapi zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni — na ni zipi kuu?
answer_sw: GN 487A inapiga marufuku makundi 15 ya biashara kwa wageni. Miongoni mwa biashara zilizotajwa: (1) biashara ya rejareja, (2) biashara ya jumla, (3) uhamisho wa pesa za simu (mobile money agent), (4) ukarabati wa simu za mkononi, (5) salon ya nywele na biashara ya uzuri, (6) uchimbaji madini wa kiwango kidogo, (7) huduma za posta na usafirishaji wa vifurushi ndani ya nchi, (8) uongozaji wa watalii ndani ya nchi, (9) uanzishaji na uendeshaji wa redio na televisheni, (10) uendeshaji wa makumbusho au maduka ya vinyago, (11) udalali au wakala wa biashara na mali isiyohamika, (12) huduma za usafishaji forodha na usafirishaji, (13) ununuzi wa mazao shambani, (14) umiliki au uendeshaji wa mashine za kamari isipokuwa ndani ya kasino, (15) umiliki na uendeshaji wa viwanda vidogo na vidogo sana. Kumbuka: kinyozi iko chini ya Kategoria 4 (salon business). Orodha kamili rasmi inapatikana kwenye TanzLII au Idara ya Uhamiaji., (9) huduma za usafi wa nyumba, na makundi 6 mengine. Thibitisha orodha kamili na Idara ya Uhamiaji au TanzLII.
question_en: How many business categories does GN 487A prohibit for non-citizens — and what are the main ones?
answer_en: GN 487A prohibits 15 categories of business for non-citizens. Among the listed businesses: (1) retail trade, (2) wholesale trade, (3) mobile money transfer services, (4) mobile phone repair, (5) hair salons and beauty business, (6) small-scale mining, (7) postal activities and parcel delivery, (8) tour guiding within the country, (9) establishment and operation of radio and television, (10) operation of museums or curio shops, (11) brokerage or agency in businesses and real estate, (12) clearing and forwarding services, (13) on-farm crop purchasing operations, (14) ownership or operation of gambling machines except in casino premises, (15) ownership and operation of micro and small industries. Note: barbershops fall under Category 4 (salon business). The complete official list is available at TanzLII or the Immigration Department., (9) domestic cleaning services, and 6 other categories. Verify the complete list with the Immigration Department or TanzLII.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A prohibited category list

question_sw: Ada za shule za watoto wa mfanyakazi mgeni zinazolipwa na mwajiri — PAYE inahusika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ada za shule za watoto wanaolipwa na mwajiri (school fees paid by employer) zinachukuliwa kama manufaa ya kazi yanayolazimika PAYE. Inajumlishwa kwenye mapato ya ajira ya mfanyakazi mgeni. Hii ni faida inayolipwa kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi — hivyo inajumuishwa kwa PAYE.
question_en: School fees for a foreign employee's children paid by the employer — is PAYE involved?
answer_en: Yes. School fees for children paid by the employer are treated as taxable employment benefits. They are added to the foreign employee's employment income for PAYE. This is a benefit paid on behalf of the employee — so it is included for PAYE.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kuwasilisha fomu gani TRA mwishoni mwa mwaka wa mapato kwa kila mfanyakazi?
answer_sw: Mwajiri lazima aandae na kuwasilisha Fomu P9 kwa kila mfanyakazi ifikapo tarehe 31 Machi ya mwaka unaofuata mwaka wa mapato. Fomu P9 inaonyesha jumla ya mshahara wa mwaka, PAYE iliyokatwa, na mchango wa NSSF. Nakala moja inatolewa kwa mfanyakazi na moja inawasilishwa TRA. Kuchelewa kuwasilisha fomu P9 kunasababisha adhabu.
answer_en: An employer must prepare and submit Form P9 for each employee by 31 March of the year following the tax year. Form P9 shows the total annual salary, PAYE deducted, and NSSF contributions. One copy is given to the employee and one is filed with TRA. Late submission of Form P9 attracts penalties.
question_en: What form must an employer submit to TRA at the end of the tax year for each employee?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — P9 Annual Employer Return

question_sw: Mwajiri anahitaji nini kwa mfanyakazi mgeni mpya — hatua za PAYE?
answer_sw: Hatua za PAYE kwa mfanyakazi mgeni mpya: (1) Omba TIN (Tax Identification Number) kwa mfanyakazi ikiwa hana; (2) Jiandikishe TRA kama mwajiri ukiwa bado hujafanya hivyo; (3) Anza kukata PAYE kuanzia mshahara wa kwanza; (4) Wasilisha PAYE return ya kila mwezi ifikapo tarehe 7; (5) Toa P9 form mwishoni mwa mwaka wa kodi (kabla ya 31 Machi).
question_en: What does an employer need for a new foreign employee — PAYE steps?
answer_en: PAYE steps for a new foreign employee: (1) Apply for a TIN (Tax Identification Number) for the employee if they don't have one; (2) Register with TRA as an employer if not already done; (3) Start deducting PAYE from the first salary payment; (4) File monthly PAYE returns by the 7th; (5) Issue a P9 form at the end of the tax year (before 31 March).
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

instruction: SDL rate ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kiwango cha SDL ni 3.5% ya jumla ya mishahara yote. Hakuna kiwango kingine — si 5%, si 4%, si 3%. Ni 3.5% peke yake. Chanzo: Finance Act na kanuni za TRA.

question_sw: Niliuza nyumba yangu kwa faida ya TZS 30M — je, kuna kodi ya mtaji?
answer_sw: Mauzo ya mali isiyohamishika (real property) na kodi inayohusiana yanazidi mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Mauzo ya nyumba yanaweza kuathiriwa na sheria ya Mapato ya Watu Binafsi — hali inategemea nyumba hiyo ilitumika kwa nini (makazi ya msingi au uwekezaji), muda wa umiliki, na mambo mengine. Wasiliana na mhesabu wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA moja kwa moja.
question_en: I sold my house at a profit of TZS 30M — is there a capital gains tax?
answer_en: Property sales and related taxation are beyond my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. House sale tax may be affected by the Personal Income Tax Act — the situation depends on how the property was used (primary residence or investment), ownership period, and other factors. Contact a qualified tax accountant or TRA directly.

instruction: Hoteli ya nyota 5 — mshahara wa chini kwa wafanyakazi ni ngapi kulingana na GN605A?
output: Kulingana na GN605A, viwango vilivyothibitishwa kwa sekta ya hoteli ni: hoteli za nyota 5 na nyota 4: TZS 375,000 kwa mwezi; baa na mikahawa ya hoteli: TZS 195,000 kwa mwezi. Viwango hivi vilianza Januari 2026. Kama una wasiwasi kuhusu subsekta maalum ya hoteli yako, thibitisha na GN605A yenyewe kupitia tanzlii.org.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: WHT inaweza kulipwa kwa nguzo ya bidhaa (in-kind) badala ya pesa — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. WHT ni ushuru wa pesa taslimu na lazima ulipwe TRA kwa pesa — si kwa bidhaa au huduma. Hata kama malipo ya asili yaliyotoza WHT yalikuwa ya bidhaa (in-kind), WHT lazima ihesabiwe kwa thamani ya bidhaa na kulipwa TRA kwa pesa.
question_en: WHT can be paid in kind (goods instead of cash) instead of money — is this true?
answer_en: No. WHT is a cash tax and must be paid to TRA in money — not in goods or services. Even if the original payment that triggered WHT was in kind, WHT must be calculated at the market value of the goods and paid to TRA in cash.

question_sw: WHT kwa gawio kwa wakazi na wasio wakazi ni asilimia 15 — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. WHT kwa gawio ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi NA kwa wasio wakazi — si asilimia 15. Kiwango cha asilimia 15 kinatumika kwa aina nyingine za malipo kama royalties na ada za mkurugenzi (wakazi). Gawio daima inatoza asilimia 10 bila kujali wakazi au la.
question_en: WHT on dividends for residents and non-residents is 15% — is this correct?
answer_en: No. WHT on dividends is 10% for both residents AND non-residents — not 15%. The 15% rate applies to other payment types such as royalties and resident director fees. Dividends always attract 10% regardless of resident status.

instruction: Je, mwananchi anayeishi Uganda anaweza kununua ardhi Tanzania — kuna kodi gani?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ununuzi wa ardhi na mali isiyohamika na raia wa kigeni Tanzania unahusisha Sheria ya Ardhi, kanuni za uwekezaji wa kigeni, na taratibu za uthamini wa kodi — hii ni mada ngumu ya kisheria nje ya wigo wangu wa compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Wasiliana na mshauri wa ardhi na uwekezaji aliyehitimu kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Mshahara wa TZS 1,200,000 — PAYE halisi ni ngapi?
answer_sw: Mahesabu ya PAYE ya mshahara mahususi yako nje ya mipaka yangu. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Tumia kikokotoo cha TRA IDRAS (taidras.tra.go.tz) kwa jibu sahihi. Ninaweza kukuambia kwamba mshahara wa TZS 1.2M unaathiriwa na bendi nyingi za PAYE lakini punguzo la kibinafsi la TZS 26,000/mwezi litapunguza kiasi. Mhesabu wa kodi au kikokotoo cha TRA IDRAS ndiyo chanzo sahihi.
question_en: Salary of TZS 1,200,000 — what is the exact PAYE?
answer_en: Calculating PAYE for a specific salary is outside my coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Use the TRA IDRAS calculator (taidras.tra.go.tz) for an accurate answer. I can tell you that a TZS 1.2M salary is affected by multiple PAYE bands but the personal relief of TZS 26,000/month will reduce the amount. A tax accountant or the TRA IDRAS calculator is the accurate source.

instruction: Niliuza ardhi yangu Tanzania na kupata faida — lazima nilipe kodi ya mapato ya mtaji (capital gains tax)? Kiasi gani?
output: Faida inayotokana na uuzaji wa mali kama ardhi, hisa, au majengo inaweza kuwa taxable chini ya Income Tax Act Tanzania. Hesabu halisi inategemea thamani ya ununuzi (cost base), thamani ya uuzaji, na hali yako kama mkazi au asiye mkazi. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Kodi ya mapato ya mtaji (capital gains tax) kwa mauzo ya ardhi inashughulikiwa chini ya Income Tax Act — ni mada tofauti inayohitaji utaalamu maalum wa kodi ya mapato. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: NGO hazihitaji kulipa mshahara wa chini kwa sababu si biashara ya faida — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana, si kweli. NGO ni waajiri kama waajiri wengine na lazima wafuate GN 605A. Hali ya faida au isiyo ya faida ya shirika haibadilishi wajibu wa kulipa mshahara wa chini. Kila mwajiri Tanzania — iwe kampuni ya faida au NGO — analazimika kulipa.
question_en: NGOs don't need to pay minimum wage because they are not for-profit — is this true?
answer_en: No, this is false. NGOs are employers like any other and must comply with GN 605A. The profit or non-profit status of an organisation does not change the obligation to pay minimum wage. Every employer in Tanzania — profit or NGO — must comply.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa simu (casual worker) anayefanya kazi siku 10 tu kwa mwezi analipa PAYE vipi?
answer_sw: Wafanyakazi wa simu (casual workers) wanaolipwa kwa siku au wiki wanakabiliwa na PAYE kwa njia sawa na wafanyakazi wa kawaida — yaani jumla ya malipo yao ya mwezi inahesabiwa na kisha PAYE inakokotolewa. Ikiwa mfanyakazi anapata TZS 15,000 kwa siku × 10 siku = TZS 150,000/mwezi, hii iko chini ya kiwango cha PAYE (hata kabla ya punguzo la kibinafsi), kwa hiyo PAYE = TZS 0. Mwajiri bado anahitajika kuweka rekodi za malipo ya wafanyakazi wa simu kwa madhumuni ya ukaguzi.
answer_en: Casual workers paid per day or week are subject to PAYE in the same way as regular employees — their total monthly payments are calculated and then PAYE is computed. If a casual worker earns TZS 15,000 per day × 10 days = TZS 150,000/month, this is below the PAYE threshold (even before personal relief), so PAYE = TZS 0. The employer is still required to keep records of casual worker payments for audit purposes.
question_en: A casual worker works only 10 days per month — how do they pay PAYE?

question_sw: Kampuni inataka kufuta usajili wake (deregistration) rasmi. Mchakato wa BRELA ni upi?
answer_sw: Kufuta usajili wa kampuni kwa hiari (voluntary dissolution) kunahitaji: kupitisha azimio maalum la wanahisa (75%+), kuteuwa msimamizi wa likwidesheni (liquidator), kulipa madeni yote ya kampuni na kukusanya madai, kuwasilisha taarifa za mwisho za uhasibu, na kuomba kufutwa kwa jina kutoka BRELA. Mahakama inaweza pia kuagiza kufutwa kwa lazima. Utaratibu huu unaweza kuchukua miezi kadhaa. Kabla ya kufuta, hakikisha TRA, NSSF, na mashirika mengine yote yamesafirishwa na madeni yalipwa.
answer_en: Voluntary company deregistration requires: passing a special resolution by shareholders (75%+), appointing a liquidator, paying all company debts and collecting receivables, submitting final accounting statements, and applying for name removal from BRELA. A court may also order compulsory winding up. This process may take several months. Before deregistration, ensure TRA, NSSF, and all other agencies are settled and all debts are paid.
question_en: A company wants to formally deregister (dissolution). What is the BRELA process?

instruction: Je, mchango wa NSSF unaweza kukatwa kutoka pensheni au malipo mengine ya mwisho wa ajira?
output: Hapana — mchango wa NSSF hautolipiwa pensheni au malipo ya mwisho (end of service benefits). Mchango wa NSSF unakokotolewa kutoka mshahara wa kawaida (gross wages) tu. Malipo ya mwisho wa ajira kama vile gratuity, severance pay, au malipo ya likizo yanajumuishwa au hayajumuishwi kulingana na sheria ya kazi na mkataba — thibitisha hali maalum na mshauri wa HR au Ofisi ya Kazi.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kusimamisha michango ya NSSF kwa miezi 3 bila adhabu ikiwa ana tatizo la mtiririko wa pesa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. NSSF haiku na utaratibu rasmi wa 'kusimamisha michango' bila adhabu. Michango ya NSSF lazima iwasilishwe ifikapo tarehe 10 ya kila mwezi bila kujali matatizo ya mtiririko wa pesa. Kuchelewa kunasababisha adhabu ya asilimia 5 kwa mwezi. Mwajiri mwenye matatizo ya kweli ya fedha anaweza kuwasiliana na NSSF kuomba mpango wa malipo wa awamu — lakini hii si kusimamisha na bado riba inajilimbikiza.
question_en: Can an employer suspend NSSF contributions for 3 months without penalty if they have a cash flow problem in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. NSSF does not have a formal 'suspend contributions' procedure without penalty. NSSF contributions must be submitted by the 10th of each month regardless of cash flow problems. Late payment attracts a 5% penalty per month. An employer with genuine financial difficulties can contact NSSF to request an instalment payment plan — but this is not a suspension and interest still accrues.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anapata mshahara wa TZS 520,000 hasa — anaingia kwenye kundi gani la PAYE?
answer_sw: Mshahara wa TZS 520,000 uko kwenye mwisho wa kundi la pili (8%). Mahesabu: Kundi 1 (0–270,000): TZS 0. Kundi 2 (270,001–520,000): 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000. Jumla = TZS 20,000. Punguzo la kibinafsi = TZS 26,000. PAYE inayolipwa = TZS 0 (kwa sababu TZS 20,000 < TZS 26,000). Ikiwa mshahara utaongezeka hadi TZS 521,000, sehemu ya TZS 1,000 itatozwa kwa 20% = TZS 200 ya ziada. Hata hivyo punguzo bado linafunika, kwa hiyo PAYE itabaki TZS 0 mpaka mshahara ufikie karibu TZS 595,000.
answer_en: A salary of exactly TZS 520,000 is at the top of the second band (8%). Calculation: Band 1 (0–270,000): TZS 0. Band 2 (270,001–520,000): 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000. Total = TZS 20,000. Personal relief = TZS 26,000. PAYE payable = TZS 0 (because TZS 20,000 < TZS 26,000). If salary increases to TZS 521,000, the additional TZS 1,000 is taxed at 20% = TZS 200 extra. However, the relief still covers it, so PAYE remains TZS 0 until salary reaches approximately TZS 595,000.
question_en: An employee earns exactly TZS 520,000 — which PAYE band do they fall in?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — band boundary ITA Cap.332

question_sw: Kampuni inampa mfanyakazi posho ya nyumba ya TZS 300,000 kila mwezi. Je, posho hiyo inatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Posho ya nyumba (housing allowance) inajumuishwa kwenye mapato ya ajira yanayotozwa PAYE bila kujali kama inaitwa 'posho' au 'mshahara'. TZS 300,000 ya posho ya nyumba inaongezwa kwenye mshahara wa msingi kabla ya kuhesabu PAYE ya mwezi. Tofauti pekee ni ikiwa kampuni inadhihirisha nyumba yake wenyewe (company accommodation) — hapo thamani ya manufaa inakadiriwa tofauti.
answer_en: Yes. Housing allowance is included in taxable employment income subject to PAYE regardless of whether it is called an 'allowance' or 'salary'. The TZS 300,000 housing allowance is added to the basic salary before calculating monthly PAYE. The only difference is where the company provides its own accommodation (company accommodation) — in that case the value of the benefit is assessed differently.
question_en: A company pays an employee a housing allowance of TZS 300,000 per month. Is that allowance subject to PAYE?

instruction: Ninataka kujua bei ya dhahabu kwenye soko la dunia leo — ni ngapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu. Bei za dhahabu na bidhaa za kimataifa zinabadilika kila wakati na zinahitaji chanzo cha habari za wakati halisi (real-time) — hii si taarifa ninayoweza kutoa. Kwa bei za sasa za dhahabu, angalia tovuti za masoko ya kimataifa au mabenki yanayofanya biashara ya dhahabu.

Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio (dividends) kwa kampuni zilizoorodheshwa DSE ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio kwa kampuni zilizoorodheshwa kwenye Soko la Hisa la Dar es Salaam (DSE) ni asilimia 5 — kwa wakazi na wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on dividends from DSE-listed companies?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on dividends from Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange (DSE) listed companies is 5% — for both residents and non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kodi ya makisio (presumptive tax) ni nini na biashara gani zinaistahili?
answer_sw: Kodi ya makisio ni mfumo wa kodi uliorahisishwa kwa biashara ndogo ambazo hazihitajiki kutunza vitabu kamili vya uhasibu. Biashara zinazostahili ni zile zenye mapato ya mwaka kati ya TZS 4,000,000 na TZS 100,000,000. Kodi inalipwa kulingana na jedwali la kiwango kilichowekwa awali kulingana na aina ya biashara na eneo — si kwa faida halisi. Biashara zenye mapato zaidi ya TZS 100,000,000 lazima zitumie mfumo wa kawaida wa uhasibu na kodi ya mapato ya kampuni.
answer_en: Presumptive tax is a simplified tax regime for small businesses that are not required to maintain full accounting records. Eligible businesses are those with annual turnover between TZS 4,000,000 and TZS 100,000,000. Tax is paid according to a predetermined rate schedule based on business type and location — not on actual profit. Businesses with turnover above TZS 100,000,000 must use the normal accounting system and corporate income tax.
question_en: What is presumptive tax and which businesses qualify for it?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — presumptive tax regime

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kukatia mwajiriwa wake kodi ya PAYE na haitoi risiti — mwajiriwa hana haki ya kudai ushahidi wa makato — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana kabisa. Mwajiriwa ana haki ya kupokea ushahidi wa makato ya PAYE — kawaida kwa njia ya slip ya mshahara (payslip) au nyaraka za mwisho wa mwaka. Mwajiriwa anaweza kutumia kumbukumbu hizi kuthibitisha malipo ya kodi yake na kudai marejesho (tax refund) ikiwa atalipishwa kodi zaidi ya kiasi kinachohitajika. Kushindwa kutoa ushahidi wa makato ni ukiukwaji wa wajibu wa mwajiri.
question_en: A company can deduct PAYE from an employee and give no receipt — the employee has no right to claim evidence of deductions — is this true?
answer_en: Absolutely not. An employee has the right to receive evidence of PAYE deductions — normally via a payslip or end-of-year documents. The employee can use these records to prove their tax payments and claim a refund if overtaxed. Failing to provide deduction evidence is a breach of employer obligations.
