instruction: GN 487A na PAYE — je, mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A bado analazimishwa kulipa PAYE?
output: Ndiyo — hata biashara inayokiuka GN 487A bado ina wajibu wa kodi. Ukiukwaji wa GN 487A ni kosa la biashara/uhamiaji — hauathiri wajibu wa kodi wa TRA. TRA inaweza kuhitaji: (1) Malipo ya PAYE, VAT, SDL, na kodi nyingine zilizokusanywa wakati biashara ilikuwa ikifanya kazi (hata kama ilikuwa haramu); (2) TRA haitoi msamaha wa kodi kwa sababu biashara ilikuwa haramu. Mgeni anayefungwa kwa GN 487A bado anaweza kukabiliwa na madeni ya kodi ya TRA pamoja na adhabu ya GN 487A. Kwa hivyo mgeni ana tatizo mbili tofauti: GN 487A na kodi za TRA. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na TRA.

question_sw: Kanda ya PAYE ya asilimia 20 inaanza kwa mshahara wa Shilingi 500,001 kwa mwezi — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kanda ya asilimia 20 inaanza kwa mshahara wa Shilingi 520,001 kwa mwezi — si Shilingi 500,001. Kanda kamili ni: 0% (hadi 270,000), 8% (270,001–520,000), 20% (520,001–760,000), 25% (760,001–1,000,000), 30% (zaidi ya 1,000,000). Namba ya Shilingi 500,001 si sahihi.
question_en: The 20% PAYE band starts at TZS 500,001 per month — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The 20% band starts at TZS 520,001 per month — not TZS 500,001. The full bands are: 0% (up to 270,000), 8% (270,001–520,000), 20% (520,001–760,000), 25% (760,001–1,000,000), 30% (above 1,000,000). The figure of TZS 500,001 is incorrect.

question_sw: Kiwango cha VAT nchini Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT nchini Tanzania ni asilimia 18, kulingana na TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority). Kama biashara yako inauza bidhaa au kutoa huduma zinazolipwa VAT, lazima uongeze asilimia 18 juu ya bei ya mauzo yako na ukusanye kodi hiyo kwa niaba ya serikali. Kumbuka: Kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025, kiwango cha VAT kwa malipo ya kidijitali ya B2C ni asilimia 16, lakini bado linasubiri tangazo rasmi la Kamishna Mkuu. Thibitisha na TRA kwa sababu kiwango cha VAT kinaweza kubadilika baada ya Finance Act ya kila mwaka.
question_en: What is the VAT rate in Tanzania?
answer_en: The standard VAT rate in Tanzania is 18%, as set by the Tanzania Revenue Authority (TRA). If your business sells goods or provides services subject to VAT, you must add 18% on top of your sale price and collect that tax on behalf of the government. Note: From 1 September 2025, the B2C digital payment VAT rate is 16%, pending CG implementation notice. Confirm with TRA for the latest information.

question_sw: BRELA na halmashauri (LGA) — leseni kutoka kwa wapi?
answer_sw: Kuna leseni mbili tofauti zinazohitajika. BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency): inasajili KAMPUNI au BIASHARA kwa kitaifa — unasajili jina, wamiliki, muundo wa kisheria. LGA (Halmashauri ya Wilaya): inatoa LESENI ya biashara ya kufanya shughuli katika eneo husika. BRELA inatoa usajili wa kitaifa; halmashauri inatoa leseni ya eneo. Zote mbili zinahitajika.
question_en: BRELA and local council (LGA) — which one issues a business licence?
answer_en: Two different registrations are required. BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency): registers the COMPANY or BUSINESS at national level — you register the name, owners, legal structure. LGA (District Council): issues the BUSINESS LICENCE to operate in a specific area. BRELA provides national registration; the council provides area-specific licensing. Both are required.

question_sw: Kama mwajiri amewasilisha NSSF kwa miaka 10 bila kukosea — ana haki ya kupata 'clean record' inayothibitishwa na NSSF?
answer_sw: NSSF Tanzania inaweza kutoa taarifa ya uzingatiaji (compliance statement) au cheti cha ukaguzi wa malipo kinachoonyesha historia ya malipo ya mwajiri. Hati hii inaweza kuhitajika kwa: kuthibitishwa na TRA wakati wa ukaguzi, maombi ya mikopo ya benki, zabuni za serikali, au ukaguzi wa washirika wa biashara. Angalia NSSF kwa jinsi ya kupata taarifa hii rasmi.
question_en: If an employer has remitted NSSF for 10 years without error — do they have a right to a 'clean record' certificate from NSSF?
answer_en: NSSF Tanzania can issue a compliance statement or payment audit certificate showing an employer's payment history. This document may be required for: verification by TRA during audits, bank loan applications, government tenders, or business partner due diligence. Check NSSF for how to obtain this formal statement.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Tikiti ya ndege ya kwenda nchi ya asili — ni manufaa yanayolazimika PAYE?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, tikiti za ndege zinazolipwa na mwajiri kwa ajili ya likizo ya mfanyakazi au safari za kibinafsi zinachukuliwa kama manufaa yanayolazimika PAYE. Hata hivyo, tikiti za safari za biashara (business travel) hazijumuishwi. Thibitisha hali ya tikiti maalum na mshauri wa kodi ili kuepuka kosa.
question_en: A return flight ticket to home country — is it a taxable employment benefit?
answer_en: Generally, flight tickets paid by the employer for an employee's vacation or personal travel are treated as taxable employment benefits. However, business travel tickets are not included. Verify the status of specific tickets with a tax advisor to avoid errors.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: NSSF kwa wafanyakazi wa nusu muda inawasilishwa kwa pamoja na wa muda wote au tofauti?
answer_sw: NSSF inawasilishwa pamoja kwa wafanyakazi wote — wa muda wote, nusu muda, na wa muda mfupi — kwenye orodha moja ya malipo (NSSF contribution schedule). Kila mfanyakazi anaonekana tofauti na namba yake ya NSSF, lakini malipo yote yanapelekwa pamoja kwenye NSSF. Kiwango ni 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla kwa kila mfanyakazi. Tarehe: ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara.
question_en: Is NSSF for part-time workers submitted together with full-time workers or separately?
answer_en: NSSF is submitted together for all employees — full-time, part-time, and casual workers — on one contribution schedule. Each employee appears separately with their NSSF number, but all payments go together to NSSF. Rate: 20% of gross wage per employee. Deadline: within one month after the salary month.

question_sw: Je, ninalipa riba kama TRA imechelewa kutoa refund yangu?
answer_sw: Sheria inaelekeza TRA ikusudie kulipa riba ikiwa imechelewa kusindika refund baada ya kipindi kilichoruhusiwa. Hata hivyo, utekelezaji halisi wa kipengele hiki unategemea kanuni maalum. Thibitisha haki zako za riba na TRA au mwanasheria wa kodi kama umechelewa kwa muda mrefu.
question_en: Do I earn interest if TRA is late in paying my refund?
answer_en: The law directs TRA to intend to pay interest if it is late in processing a refund beyond the allowed period. However, practical enforcement of this provision depends on specific regulations. Verify your interest rights with TRA or a tax lawyer if you have experienced a significant delay.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Kodi ya mapato kwenye faida ya uuzaji wa ardhi (capital gain) Tanzania ni asilimia 30 ya faida yote — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Ushuru wa mapato kutoka mauzo ya ardhi au mali za mtaji Tanzania unaweza kutofautiana. Kwa ujumla, faida ya mtaji (capital gain) kutoka uuzaji wa ardhi ya biashara inalipishwa kodi kama sehemu ya mapato ya kawaida ya biashara kwa asilimia 30 kwa kampuni. Kwa watu binafsi, kiwango kinaweza kutofautiana kulingana na aina ya mali na muda wa umiliki. Pia tofauti na withholding tax ya asilimia 10 kwenye uuzaji wa ardhi kwa mtu asiye mkazi.
question_en: Income tax on capital gains from land sales in Tanzania is 30% of all profit — is this correct?
answer_en: Not exactly. Tax on income from land or capital asset sales in Tanzania varies. Generally, capital gain from sale of business land is taxed as ordinary business income at 30% for companies. For individuals, the rate can vary depending on the type of asset and period of ownership. Also distinguish from the 10% withholding tax on land sales by a non-resident.

question_sw: Mwanasheria anayeandaa hati ya mauzo ya ardhi ana wajibu wowote wa ushuru wa stempu — au ni wajibu wa mnunuzi tu?
answer_sw: Mwanasheria anayeandaa hati ya mauzo ana jukumu la kisheria la kumwarifu mteja kuhusu wajibu wa ushuru wa stempu na kuhakikisha hati inasimama kisheria. Hata hivyo, WAJIBU WA MWISHO wa kulipa ushuru wa stempu unabaki kwa mnunuzi (au pande zote mbili kama zilikubaliana). Mwanasheria asiye mzuri anayekosa kueleza ushuru wa stempu anaweza kuadhibiwa kitaalamu.
question_en: Does a lawyer preparing a land sale instrument have any stamp duty obligation — or is it only the buyer's responsibility?
answer_en: A lawyer preparing a sale instrument has a professional duty to advise their client about stamp duty obligations and ensure the document stands legally. However, the FINAL OBLIGATION to pay stamp duty remains with the buyer (or both parties as agreed). A negligent lawyer who fails to explain stamp duty may face professional sanctions.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or professional code update

instruction: NSSF, WCF, na SDL — tofauti yao ni nini kwa kifupi?
output:
NSSF (National Social Security Fund): 10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi | wafanyakazi wote | nssf.or.tz. Kusudi: pensheni na usalama wa jamii. 
WCF (Workers' Compensation Fund): 0.5% mwajiri | waajiri WOTE (hata mfanyakazi 1) | portal.wcf.go.tz. Kusudi: fidia ya ajali za kazi. 
SDL (Skills Development Levy): 3.5% mwajiri | waajiri wenye 10+ wafanyakazi | TRA. Kusudi: mafunzo ya nguvu kazi Tanzania.

instruction: GN 487A ina mkakati wa grace period kwa wageni waliokuwa na biashara kabla ya Julai 2025?
output: GN 487A ina masharti ya mpito: wageni waliokuwa na leseni halali tarehe 28 Julai 2025 katika shughuli zilizokatazwa waliruhusiwa kuendelea mpaka leseni zao ziishe. Baada ya leseni kuisha, upya (renewal) haukuruhusiwa na leseni mpya haikuweza kutolewa. Sheria ilianza mara moja tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Kampeni ya utekelezaji ilianza 11 Septemba 2025 — lakini hiyo ilikuwa utekelezaji wa kwanza, si grace period rasmi. Wageni waliokuwa na biashara katika orodha ya 15 tangu 28 Julai 2025 wamekuwa wakikosea sheria — bila kujali kulikuwa na kampeni au la. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Gari la kampuni linalotumiwa na mfanyakazi — thamani yake inahusika kwenye SDL?
output:
Hapana — gari la kampuni linalotumiwa na mfanyakazi ni faida isiyokuwa ya fedha (non-cash benefit) na HAIJUMUISHWI kwenye SDL base. SDL inakokotolewa kwa malipo ya FEDHA TU. Muhtasari wa SDL base:
INAJUMUISHA (fedha): mshahara wa msingi, posho za fedha, bonasi za fedha.
HAIJUMUISHI (non-cash): nyumba ya kampuni, gari la kampuni, bima, chakula cha kampuni.
Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: EAC free trade area na STR — ni nini tofauti?
answer_sw: EAC Free Trade Area (FTA): inafuta ushuru wa forodha kati ya nchi wanachama kwa bidhaa zinazotimiza masharti ya asili (rules of origin) — mfumo wa kimataifa wa biashara. EAC/COMESA STR (Simplified Trade Regime): mfumo maalum kwa wafanyabiashara WADOGO (threshold USD 2,000, bidhaa ~370) zinazokusudia kupunguza urasimu wa forodha kwa biashara ndogo. FTA ni kwa biashara yoyote; STR ni kwa biashara ndogo maalum.
question_en: EAC free trade area and STR — what is the difference?
answer_en: EAC Free Trade Area (FTA): eliminates customs duties between member states for goods meeting rules of origin — a general international trade framework. EAC/COMESA STR (Simplified Trade Regime): a special scheme for SMALL traders (USD 2,000 threshold, ~370 goods) designed to reduce customs bureaucracy for small trade. FTA is for any business; STR is specifically for small traders.

question_sw: Improvement notice na prohibition notice kutoka OSHA ni tofauti vipi?
answer_sw: Improvement notice (notisi ya uboreshaji): OSHA inakupa muda maalum kurekebisha tatizo. Prohibition notice (amri ya kuzuia): shughuli lazima zisimame MARA MOJA kwa sababu kuna hatari ya haraka ya kifo au majeraha makubwa. Prohibition ni hatua kali zaidi inayohitaji kusimamisha kazi bila kucheleweshwa.
question_en: How do an improvement notice and a prohibition notice from OSHA differ?
answer_en: Improvement notice: OSHA gives you a set time to fix a problem. Prohibition notice: operations must stop IMMEDIATELY because there is imminent risk of death or serious injury. A prohibition is the more serious step requiring an instant work stoppage with no delay.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya tathmini (assessment) na ukaguzi (audit) ya TRA ni nini?
answer_sw: Ukaguzi (audit) ni mchakato wa TRA wa kuchunguza rekodi za kodi za mlipaji kodi. Tathmini (assessment) ni uamuzi rasmi wa TRA unaosema kiasi cha kodi kinachostahili. Ukaguzi unaweza kusababisha tathmini ikiwa makosa yatapatikana. Tathmini ndiyo hati rasmi ambayo inaweza kupingwa ndani ya siku 30.
question_en: What is the difference between a TRA assessment and an audit?
answer_en: An audit is TRA's process of examining a taxpayer's tax records. An assessment is TRA's formal decision stating the amount of tax owed. An audit can lead to an assessment if errors are found. An assessment is the formal document that can be objected to within 30 days.

question_sw: Mshahara wa chini kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa ni Shilingi ngapi?
answer_sw: Kwa sekta ya madini na nishati ya kimataifa, mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni karibu Shilingi 765,900 kwa mwezi — hii ndiyo kiwango cha juu zaidi katika agizo lote. Kiwango hiki kilianza kutumika Januari 2026.
question_en: What is the minimum wage for the international mining sector?
answer_en: For the international mining and energy sector the GN 605A minimum wage is approximately TZS 765,900 per month — the highest floor in the entire order, effective January 2026.

question_sw: NSSF inacheswa vipi kwa mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi). Kwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 358,322: mfanyakazi analipa TZS 35,832; mwajiri analipa TZS 35,832 pia. Jumlisha: mchango wote wa NSSF ni TZS 71,664 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How is NSSF calculated on the GN 605A average minimum wage?
answer_en: NSSF is calculated at 20% of gross wage (10% employer + 10% employee). On the TZS 358,322 average minimum wage: employee pays TZS 35,832; employer pays TZS 35,832. Total NSSF contribution: TZS 71,664 per month. Confirm with NSSF.
next_review_trigger: New wage order or NSSF Act amendment

question_sw: Ikiwa TRAB imeniamua vibaya, hii ni uamuzi wa mwisho kabisa — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Uamuzi wa TRAB unaweza kupingwa kwa rufaa mbele ya TRAT (Tax Revenue Appeals Tribunal). Kutoka TRAT, rufaa ya mwisho ipo mbele ya Mahakama ya Rufaa (Court of Appeal). Kila hatua inahitaji sababu za kisheria za kutosha na gharama za ziada za kisheria.
question_en: If TRAB decides against me this is the absolute final decision — is this true?
answer_en: No. A TRAB decision can be challenged by appeal before the TRAT (Tax Revenue Appeals Tribunal). From TRAT the final appeal lies before the Court of Appeal. Each step requires sufficient legal grounds and additional legal costs.

question_sw: Ninaweza kusajili jina la biashara (business name) bila kuunda kampuni?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Unaweza kusajili jina la biashara (sole proprietorship au partnership) bila kuunda kampuni ya kikomo cha dhima (limited company). Usajili wa jina la biashara unaruhusu kufanya biashara chini ya jina linalotambuliwa kisheria bila gharama za kuanzisha kampuni kamili.
question_en: Can I register a business name without incorporating a company?
answer_en: Yes. You can register a business name (sole proprietorship or partnership) without incorporating a limited liability company. Business name registration allows trading under a legally recognised name without the cost of full company incorporation.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Huduma za wingu (cloud storage/computing) — kodi gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Huduma za wingu (cloud storage, cloud computing) zinachukuliwa kama huduma zinazokabiliwa na VAT Tanzania na possibly withholding tax. Kwa watoa wa ndani: VAT 18% + EFD. Kwa watoa wa nje ya nchi: withholding tax 6% inaweza kutumika kwa mlipaji wa Tanzania. Thibitisha muundo wako mahususi na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: Cloud services (cloud storage/computing) — what taxes apply in Tanzania?
answer_en: Cloud services are treated as services subject to Tanzania VAT and possibly withholding tax. For domestic providers: 18% VAT + EFD. For foreign-based providers: 6% withholding tax may apply for the Tanzanian payer. Confirm your specific structure with a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: Je, biashara yangu yoyote lazima isajiliwe Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara yoyote inayofanya shughuli nchini Tanzania kwa mujibu wa sheria inahitajika kusajiliwa. Usajilishaji unategemea aina ya biashara: jina la biashara peke yako (sole trader/business name) — BRELA; kampuni yenye ukomo (limited company) — BRELA chini ya Companies Act; ushirikiano (partnership) — BRELA. Biashara isiyosajiliwa inakabiliwa na hatari za kisheria ikiwemo faini na kufungwa. Thibitisha mahitaji yako na BRELA kwenye brela.go.tz.
question_en: Does any business I run in Tanzania need to be registered?
answer_en: Yes. Any business conducting activities in Tanzania is legally required to be registered. The registration route depends on your business type: sole trader / business name — BRELA; limited liability company — BRELA under the Companies Act; partnership — BRELA. An unregistered business faces legal risks including fines and closure. Confirm your requirements with BRELA at brela.go.tz.
next_review_trigger: When Business Names Registration or Companies Act is amended

question_sw: Je, biashara ya ujenzi inahitaji OSHA? Hatua gani maalum za usalama zinahitajika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ujenzi ni sekta yenye hatari kubwa na inahitaji usajili wa OSHA. Hatua maalum zinajumuisha: matunzio ya scaffolding, ulinzi wa mahandaki, PPE kwa wafanyakazi wote, mafunzo ya usalama, na afisa wa usalama mahali pa kazi. OSHA inafanya ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara kwa maeneo ya ujenzi.
question_en: Does a construction business need OSHA? What specific safety measures are required?
answer_en: Yes. Construction is a high-risk sector and requires OSHA registration. Specific measures include: proper scaffolding, trench protection, PPE for all workers, safety training, and a site safety officer. OSHA conducts frequent inspections of construction sites.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: GN 605A inashughulikia sekta ngapi?
answer_sw: GN 605A inashughulikia sekta 16 na sekta ndogo 46 za sekta ya faragha Tanzania Bara. Kila sekta ina kiwango chake cha mshahara wa chini kulingana na mazingira ya kazi. Thibitisha sekta yako na MLYWF.
question_en: How many sectors does GN 605A cover?
answer_en: GN 605A covers 16 sectors and 46 sub-sectors of the private sector in Tanzania Mainland. Each sector has its own minimum wage level based on working conditions. Confirm your sector with MLYWF.

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kulipa kodi zangu za TRA kwa Bitcoin?
answer_sw: Hapana. TRA haipokei malipo kwa Bitcoin au sarafu zingine za kidijitali hadi Juni 2026. Malipo ya kodi ya TRA yanakubaliwa kwa: akaunti ya benki (TISS), simu za mkononi (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa), au duka la benki/TRA. Kwa maswali ya jinsi ya kulipa kodi za TRA, tembelea tra.go.tz au ofisi yoyote ya TRA.
question_en: Can I pay my TRA taxes using Bitcoin?
answer_en: No. TRA does not accept Bitcoin or other digital currencies as payment as of June 2026. TRA tax payments are accepted via: bank account (TISS), mobile money (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa), or bank/TRA branch. For information on how to pay TRA taxes, visit tra.go.tz or any TRA office.

question_sw: WCF ni nini na inatofautiana vipi na SDL?
answer_sw: WCF ni Workers Compensation Fund — mfuko wa fidia kwa wafanyakazi waliojeruhiwa kazini. Tofauti kuu na SDL: SDL (asilimia 3.5) → inalipwa TRA, inafadhili mafunzo ya ujuzi. WCF (asilimia 0.5) → inalipwa Mamlaka ya WCF, inafadhili fidia ya majeruhi wa kazi. Zote mbili zinalipwa na mwajiri, na hazikatolewa kwa mfanyakazi. WCF inahusu waajiri wenye wafanyakazi — thibitisha kiwango na mahitaji na WCF.
question_en: What is WCF and how does it differ from SDL?
answer_en: WCF is the Workers Compensation Fund — a fund that compensates workers injured at work. Key difference from SDL: SDL (3.5%) → paid to TRA, funds skills training. WCF (0.5%) → paid to the WCF Authority, funds workplace injury compensation. Both are paid by the employer and are not deducted from the employee's salary. WCF applies to employers with employees — confirm the rate and requirements with WCF.

instruction: Takwimu rasmi ya ongezeko la wastani la mishahara ya chini chini ya GN 605A ni asilimia 33.4 — kwa nini si 33.5?
output: Asilimia 33.4 ni takwimu rasmi iliyotolewa na PKF Eastern Africa kulingana na wastani wa viwango vyote vya GN 605A kwa sekta zote 16. Hii ni takwimu ya wastani uliopimwa kwa sekta zote — si hesabu ya moja kwa moja kati ya wastani wa zamani na mpya tu. Tumia 33.4% kama takwimu rasmi — si 33.5%. Mshahara wa wastani ulipanda kutoka TZS 275,060 hadi TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

instruction: EFD na VAT — zinahusiana vipi? Mtu asiye na VAT bado anahitaji EFD?
output: EFD inahitajika kulingana na kizingiti cha mauzo kilichowekwa na TRA — thibitisha kizingiti cha sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz). VAT registered businesses ZOTE lazima zitumie EFD bila kujali kiasi cha mauzo. Mahusiano: EFD inaweza kuhitajika KABLA ya usajili wa VAT (kuanzia TZS 11M). VAT registered → EFD ni lazima bila shaka yoyote. Si VAT registered + mauzo TZS 11M+ → EFD bado inaweza kuhitajika kwa amri ya TRA. Usijitegemee kwamba kutokuwa na VAT kunamaanisha huhitaji EFD.

question_sw: Je, siku nisiyofanya biashara bado ninahitaji Z-report?
answer_sw: Kama EFD iko hai (powered on) na ulikuwa umefungua na kufunga biashara hiyo siku — hata hakukuwa na muamala — Z-report bado inashauriwa kutolewa. Hata hivyo, ikiwa biashara ilifungwa kabisa (EFD ilizimwa) na hakukuwa na biashara yoyote, Z-report ya siku ile inaweza kuwa haina taarifa za muamala. Wasiliana na muuzaji wa EFD wako kwa mwongozo wa jinsi ya kushughulikia siku za biashara iliyofungwa.
question_en: On a day when I do no business, do I still need a Z-report?
answer_en: If the EFD is powered on and you technically opened and closed business that day — even with no transactions — a Z-report is still advisable to generate. However, if the business was fully closed (EFD powered off) with no transactions at all, the Z-report for that day may have no transaction data. Consult your EFD supplier for guidance on handling days when business is fully closed.

question_sw: PAYE inarudishwa TRA kwa njia gani?
answer_sw: PAYE inarudishwa kupitia mfumo wa IDRAS (TRA Taxpayer Portal) mtandaoni. Mwajiri anaingiza return ya mwezi na kisha kulipa kupitia GePG au benki iliyoidhinishwa. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is PAYE remitted to TRA?
answer_en: PAYE is remitted through the IDRAS (TRA Taxpayer Portal) online system. The employer files a monthly return and pays through GePG or an approved bank. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kuna viwango VIWILI vya usajili wa VAT Tanzania — taja vyote viwili kwa usahihi.
answer_sw: Viwango VYA LAZIMA vya usajili wa VAT Tanzania ni viwili: (1) Kizingiti cha MIEZI 12: mauzo yanayozidi TZS 200,000,000 katika kipindi chochote cha miezi 12 mfululizo; (2) Kizingiti cha MIEZI 6: mauzo yanayozidi TZS 100,000,000 katika kipindi chochote cha miezi 6 mfululizo. Kama kizingiti KIMOJA tu kati ya hivi viwili kimezidiwa, usajili wa VAT ni wa lazima mara moja — huhitajiki kuzidi vyote viwili.
question_en: There are TWO VAT registration thresholds in Tanzania — state both accurately.
answer_en: Tanzania's TWO mandatory VAT registration thresholds are: (1) 12-MONTH threshold: sales exceeding TZS 200,000,000 in any consecutive 12-month period; (2) 6-MONTH threshold: sales exceeding TZS 100,000,000 in any consecutive 6-month period. If EITHER ONE of these thresholds is exceeded, VAT registration is immediately mandatory — you do not need to exceed both.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing VAT registration thresholds

question_sw: Ruzuku ya mafunzo (training allowance) haipigwi kodi ya PAYE kamwe — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Si kweli kwa ujumla. Ruzuku ya mafunzo inayolipwa moja kwa moja kwa mfanyakazi kama pesa inaweza kutoza PAYE ikiwa ni mapato ya ajira yanayopita kizingiti. Ruzuku ya mafunzo inayolipwa moja kwa moja kwa taasisi ya mafunzo (si kwa mfanyakazi) kwa kawaida haijumuishwi. Mazingira yanategemea jinsi ruzuku inavyolipwa.
question_en: Training allowances are never subject to PAYE — is this correct?
answer_en: Not as a general rule. A training allowance paid directly to the employee as cash can be subject to PAYE if it constitutes taxable employment income. Training fees paid directly to a training institution (not to the employee) are generally excluded. The treatment depends on how the allowance is structured.

instruction: Nimeuza duka langu — ni tofauti gani kati ya capital gains tax na kodi ya kawaida ya biashara (business income tax)?
output: Kwa ujumla, mapato ya biashara ya kawaida yanatozwa kodi tofauti na faida ya uuzaji wa mali (capital gains) — tofauti inategemea aina ya mali na jinsi ilivyotumiwa katika biashara. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa tofauti ya kisheria na jinsi ya kuripoti kwa TRA katika hali yako maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: PAYE ni nini Tanzania?
answer_sw: PAYE (Pay As You Earn) ni kodi ya mapato inayokatwa na mwajiri kutoka kwa mishahara ya wafanyakazi kila mwezi, kisha kulipwa TRA. Mwajiri ni wakala wa makusanyo — analipa kodi kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE (Pay As You Earn) is income tax withheld by an employer from employees' monthly wages and remitted to TRA. The employer is the collection agent — paying tax on behalf of the employee. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa huduma ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa usambazaji wa huduma na wakala wa zuio (qualifying buyer) ni asilimia 6, kulingana na Kifungu cha 5(5) cha Sheria ya VAT. Hii ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the VAT withholding rate on services in Tanzania?
answer_en: The VAT withholding obligation on supply of services by the Withholding Agent under Section 5(5) of the VAT Act is 6%, effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Biashara ndogo (SME) yenye mauzo chini ya Shilingi 100M lazima ipigie WHT?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wajibu wa WHT hauhusiani na ukubwa wa biashara au mauzo. Kampuni yoyote inayofanya malipo yanayotoza WHT — iwe kubwa au ndogo — inalazimika kukata na kulipa WHT. SME zenye mauzo madogo bado zina wajibu wa WHT kwenye malipo kama royalties, gawio, na ada za ushauri.
question_en: Does a small business (SME) with sales below TZS 100M have to withhold WHT?
answer_en: Yes. The WHT obligation is not linked to business size or turnover. Any company making payments subject to WHT — large or small — must deduct and remit WHT. SMEs with low turnover still have WHT obligations on payments such as royalties, dividends, and consulting fees.

question_sw: NSSF inacheswa vipi kwa mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi). Kwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 358,322: mfanyakazi analipa TZS 35,832; mwajiri analipa TZS 35,832 pia. Jumlisha: mchango wote wa NSSF ni TZS 71,664 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How is NSSF calculated on the GN 605A average minimum wage?
answer_en: NSSF is calculated at 20% of gross wage (10% employer + 10% employee). On the TZS 358,322 average minimum wage: employee pays TZS 35,832; employer pays TZS 35,832. Total NSSF contribution: TZS 71,664 per month. Confirm with NSSF.
next_review_trigger: New wage order or NSSF Act amendment

instruction: Kampuni yangu inashiriki gharama za utafiti na maendeleo na kampuni mama yake — cost sharing arrangement inaweza kupingwa na TRA vipi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Cost sharing arrangements kati ya kampuni washirika zinashughulikiwa chini ya kanuni za transfer pricing za TRA — kila mkataba lazima uonyeshe mgawanyo wa faida unaofanana na mchango wa kila upande. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi wa kigeni ana haki za kazi sawa na Watanzania chini ya ELRA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania kwa kibali halisi cha kazi ana haki za kimsingi za kazi chini ya Sheria ya Ajira na Mahusiano ya Kazini (ELRA) — ikiwa ni pamoja na haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A, likizo ya mwaka, ulinzi dhidi ya kufutwa kazi bila sababu, na nyinginezo. Uraia wake haunyimi haki za kimsingi za kazi.
question_en: Does a foreign worker have the same employment rights as Tanzanians under ELRA?
answer_en: Yes. A foreign worker lawfully employed in Tanzania with a valid work permit has basic employment rights under the Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA) — including the right to GN 605A minimum wage, annual leave, protection from unfair dismissal, and others. Their foreign nationality does not strip them of basic employment rights.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu Zanzibar inasajiliwa na TRA au ZRA?
answer_sw: Kampuni ya Zanzibar inasajiliwa na Zanzibar Revenue Authority (ZRA) kwa masuala ya kodi za Zanzibar — si TRA ya Mainland. Kwa usajili wa biashara, unaweza kuhitaji BRELA Tanzania na/au Registrar of Companies wa Zanzibar kulingana na aina ya biashara. Ninashughulikia mfumo wa TRA wa Tanzania Bara tu. Kwa Zanzibar, wasiliana na ZRA moja kwa moja.
question_en: Should my Zanzibar company register with TRA or ZRA?
answer_en: A Zanzibar company registers with the Zanzibar Revenue Authority (ZRA) for Zanzibar tax matters — not Mainland TRA. For business registration, you may need BRELA Tanzania and/or the Zanzibar Registrar of Companies depending on business type. I only handle the TRA Mainland Tanzania system. For Zanzibar, contact ZRA directly.

question_sw: Je, OSHA na NSSF ni tofauti?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, ni tofauti kabisa. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inashughulikia USALAMA mahali pa kazi — ukaguzi, viwango vya usalama, na usajili wa mahali pa kazi. NSSF (National Social Security Fund) inashughulikia BIMA YA JAMII — pensheni, matibabu, na manufaa ya kijamii. Zote mbili zinahitaji kufuata na mwajiri.
question_en: Are OSHA and NSSF different?
answer_en: Yes, they are entirely different. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) deals with workplace SAFETY — inspections, safety standards, and workplace registration. NSSF (National Social Security Fund) deals with SOCIAL SECURITY — pension, medical, and social benefits. Both require employer compliance.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Je, biashara inaweza kufanya VAT return ya robo mwaka badala ya kila mwezi?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida, Tanzania inahitaji VAT return ya kila MWEZI. Baadhi ya nchi zinaruhusu quarter filing kwa biashara ndogo — lakini hii si utaratibu wa kawaida wa Tanzania. Thibitisha na TRA kama kuna mpango wa quarterly filing unaohusiana na hali yako.
question_en: Can a business file a quarterly VAT return instead of monthly?
answer_en: Generally, Tanzania requires MONTHLY VAT returns. Some countries allow quarterly filing for small businesses — but this is not Tanzania's standard procedure. Verify with TRA whether there is any quarterly filing arrangement applicable to your situation.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Gharama yote ya mwajiri kwa mfanyakazi mmoja mwenye mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kwa mshahara wa chini wa wastani wa TZS 358,322/mwezi: NSSF ya mwajiri TZS 35,832 (10%); SDL TZS 12,541 (3.5%); WCF TZS 1,792 (0.5%). Jumla ya gharama ya ziada kwa mwajiri: TZS 50,165. Gharama yote ya mwajiri: TZS 358,322 + TZS 50,165 = TZS 408,487/mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA na NSSF.
question_en: What is the total employer cost for one employee at the GN 605A average minimum wage?
answer_en: On TZS 358,322/month minimum wage: employer NSSF TZS 35,832 (10%); SDL TZS 12,541 (3.5%); WCF TZS 1,792 (0.5%). Total employer add-on cost: TZS 50,165. Full employer cost: TZS 358,322 + TZS 50,165 = TZS 408,487/month. Confirm with TRA and NSSF.
next_review_trigger: New wage order or statutory rate change

question_sw: Kampuni mpya ya Tanzania haihitaji kulipa kodi ya mapato kwa miaka mitatu ya kwanza ya biashara — je, hii ni sera ya serikali?
answer_sw: Hapana. Hakuna msamaha wa jumla wa kodi ya kampuni kwa miaka mitatu kwa kampuni mpya. Kampuni zote za Tanzania zinaanza kulipa kodi ya kampuni mara zinapoanza kufanya faida. Msamaha wa kodi mahususi unaweza kutolewa kwa sekta fulani (kama uwekezaji wa TIC), lakini hauitumiki kwa biashara zote mpya kwa ujumla.
question_en: A new Tanzania company does not need to pay income tax for the first three years — is this government policy?
answer_en: No. There is no general three-year corporate tax exemption for new companies. All Tanzania companies begin paying corporate tax as soon as they make a profit. Specific tax exemptions may be granted for certain sectors (such as TIC investments), but these do not apply to all new businesses generally.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or TIC incentive update

question_sw: Mwajiri ana wajibu gani wa kutoa payslip kwa mfanyakazi?
answer_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kutoa payslip (kadi ya mshahara) kwa kila mfanyakazi kila mwezi. Payslip inapaswa kuonyesha: mshahara wa msingi, posho zote, makato ya PAYE, makato ya NSSF, makato mengine, na mshahara halisi wa kulipwa. Kutotoa payslip ni ukiukwaji wa Sheria ya Ajira na Mahusiano ya Kazini (ELRA).
question_en: What is an employer's obligation to provide a payslip to an employee?
answer_en: An employer must issue a payslip to every employee every month. The payslip must show: basic salary, all allowances, PAYE deducted, NSSF deducted, other deductions, and net salary paid. Failure to provide a payslip is a violation of the Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA).

question_sw: GN 487A ilitangazwa lini na ilianza kutumika lini?
answer_sw: GN 487A ilitangazwa tarehe 28 Julai 2025 na ilianza kutumika mara moja siku hiyo hiyo. Idara ya Uhamiaji ilifanya operesheni ya utekelezaji kati ya tarehe 11 Septemba 2025 na 8 Oktoba 2025. Amri hii ni ya mwaka 2025 — si 2023 wala 2024. Jina kamili: Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025.
question_en: When was GN 487A gazetted and when did it take effect?
answer_en: GN 487A was gazetted on 28 July 2025 and took effect immediately on the same day. The Immigration Department conducted an enforcement operation between 11 September 2025 and 8 October 2025. This order is from 2025 — not 2023 or 2024. Full name: Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Kiwango cha chini kabisa cha mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni TZS ngapi?
output:
Kiwango cha chini kabisa cha mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni karibu TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi — kwa baadhi ya sekta za jumla. Muhtasari wa anuwai ya GN 605A:

KIWANGO CHA CHINI KABISA: karibu TZS 175,000 (baadhi ya sekta za jumla)
WASTANI: TZS 358,322 (sekta zote 16)
KIWANGO CHA JUU KABISA: karibu TZS 765,900 (madini ya kimataifa na nishati)

Usichukue wastani kama kiwango cha chini kabisa au cha juu kabisa. Thibitisha kiwango cha sekta yako na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

question_sw: SDL ya kampuni yenye wafanyakazi 15 na mishahara jumla TZS 10M kwa mwezi ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: SDL = 3.5% × TZS 10,000,000 = TZS 350,000 kwa mwezi. Inalipwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Idadi ya wafanyakazi (15) inathibitisha SDL inahitajika (≥10), lakini kiwango kinahesabiwa kwa jumla ya mishahara, si kwa kichwa cha mtu.
question_en: SDL for a company with 15 employees and total payroll of TZS 10M per month is how much?
answer_en: SDL = 3.5% × TZS 10,000,000 = TZS 350,000 per month. It is paid to TRA by the 7th of the following month. The headcount (15) confirms SDL is required (≥10), but the amount is calculated on total payroll, not per person.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Mwajiri aliniambia SDL ni kodi ya "disability leave" ya muda mfupi. Je, hiyo ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hiyo si sahihi. SDL ni Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — kodi ya serikali inayolipwa na waajiri kwa ajili ya kukuza mafunzo ya kitaaluma. Haihusiani kabisa na likizo ya ulemavu. Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara. Hulipwa na mwajiri peke yake — hakatiwi kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi.
question_en: My employer told me SDL is a "short-term disability leave" levy. Is that correct?
answer_en: That is incorrect. SDL is the Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — a government levy paid by employers to fund vocational training. It has nothing to do with disability leave. Rate: 3.5% of gross payroll. Paid by the employer only — not deducted from the employee's wages.

instruction: Ninaajiri wafanyakazi wa kilimo shambani — OSHA inawashughulikia?
output: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inatumika kwa MAENEO YOTE ya kazi Tanzania — bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Tofauti kati ya OSHA, WCF, na NSSF: OSHA = kuzuia ajali na usalama mahali pa kazi (prevention/regulation). WCF = kulipa fidia baada ya ajali ya kazi (compensation). NSSF = pensheni na usalama wa jamii wa muda mrefu (pension/social security). Wafanyakazi wa kilimo (shamba, bustani, misitu) wanashughulikiwa na OSHA. Hatari za kilimo zinazoshughulikiwa na OSHA: viuatilifu (pesticides), jua kali, vifaa vya kilimo, nyoka, na hali ngumu za mazingira. WCF pia inashughulikia wafanyakazi wa kilimo kwa fidia za ajali. Sajili maeneo yako ya kilimo na OSHA na WCF.

question_sw: Mshahara wa chini hutolewa kwa masaa au kwa mwezi?
answer_sw: GN 605A inatoa viwango kwa mwezi. Tanzania haina kiwango cha kisheria cha mshahara kwa saa kwa msingi. Kwa wafanyakazi wa muda, kiwango cha kila saa kinahesabiwa kwa kugawanya mshahara wa mwezi na masaa ya kawaida ya kazi (mara nyingi saa 208 kwa mwezi).
question_en: Is the minimum wage set per hour or per month?
answer_en: GN 605A sets rates per month. Tanzania has no statutory hourly minimum wage as a base. For part-time workers the hourly equivalent is calculated by dividing the monthly minimum by standard working hours (typically 208 hours per month).

question_sw: Kodi ya awali (provisional tax) ni nini na kampuni inalipaje?
answer_sw: Kodi ya awali ni malipo ya mapema ya kodi ya mapato yanayofanywa wakati wa mwaka wa fedha kabla return ya mwisho haijafungwa. Kampuni inalipa kwa awamu nne: awamu ya kwanza ifikapo mwisho wa mwezi wa 3 wa mwaka wa fedha, ya pili ifikapo mwisho wa mwezi wa 6, ya tatu ifikapo mwisho wa mwezi wa 9, na ya nne ifikapo mwisho wa mwezi wa 12. Kila awamu ni sawa na robo ya kodi inayokadiriwa ya mwaka. Tofauti kati ya kodi ya awali iliyolipwa na kodi halisi ya mwaka inalipwa au kurudishwa wakati return ya mwisho inawasilishwa.
answer_en: Provisional tax is an advance payment of income tax made during the financial year before the final return is filed. A company pays in four instalments: first instalment by the end of month 3 of the financial year, second by end of month 6, third by end of month 9, and fourth by end of month 12. Each instalment equals approximately one quarter of the estimated annual tax. The difference between provisional tax paid and the actual annual tax is settled or refunded when the final return is filed.
question_en: What is provisional tax and how does a company pay it?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — provisional tax instalments

question_sw: Mama ntilie anayeuza chakula kila siku mjini — anahitaji kusajili biashara?
answer_sw: Ndio, kwa kawaida. Hata mchuuzi wa chakula cha mitaani (mama ntilie) anafaa kusajili biashara yake na halmashauri ya mtaa/wilaya na kupata leseni ya biashara. Usajili wa TIN pia unashauriwa kama una mapato ya mara kwa mara. Kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200M/mwaka) kwa kawaida hakifiki kwa mama ntilie mdogo. NSSF haihitajiki kama huna wafanyakazi waliohiriwa.
question_en: A mama ntilie who sells food daily in town — does she need to register a business?
answer_en: Generally yes. Even a street food vendor (mama ntilie) should register their business with the local council/district and obtain a business licence. TIN registration is also advisable if you have regular income. The VAT threshold (TZS 200M/year) typically does not apply to a small mama ntilie. NSSF is not required if you have no hired employees.

question_sw: Malipo ya mwisho ya kazi (gratuity/terminal benefits) yanastahili PAYE?
answer_sw: Malipo ya mwisho wa kazi kama vile malipo ya likizo yasiyotumika, mafao ya kujitenga (gratuity), na malipo ya fidia yanaweza kustahili PAYE kulingana na sheria ya kodi. Sehemu fulani inaweza kuwa huru — thibitisha hesabu halisi na TRA kabla ya kulipa.
question_en: Are terminal benefits and gratuity subject to PAYE?
answer_en: Terminal payments such as unused leave pay-out, gratuity, and severance may be subject to PAYE depending on the tax rules. Certain portions may be exempt — confirm the exact calculation with TRA before payment.

instruction: TRA inajuaje kama ninatoa risiti za EFD au la — jinsi gani wanakagua?
output: TRA ina mbinu nyingi za kukagua utiifu wa EFD: (1) Ukaguzi wa moja kwa moja (physical inspection) wa duka — wakaguzi wanakuja bila taarifa; (2) Secret shoppers — wanunuzi wa siri wanaojifanya wateja wa kawaida kujaribu kama risiti inatoka; (3) Data ya EFD — EFD zote zinazotumia TIMS (Tax Invoice Management System) zinatuma data TRA moja kwa moja kwa wakati halisi; (4) Malalamiko ya wateja — mteja yeyote anaweza ripoti biashara isiyotoa risiti; (5) Kulinganisha rekodi za M-Pesa/benki na rekodi za EFD. Kosa moja la ukaguzi wa siri linaweza kusababisha ukaguzi mkubwa wa nyuma. Thibitisha na TRA.

question_sw: Cheti cha WHT (WHT certificate) kinatumika kwa nini?
answer_sw: Cheti cha WHT kinathibitisha kwamba mwajiri alilipa WHT kwa niaba ya mpokeaji. Mpokeaji anaweza kutumia cheti hiki kama mkopo wa kodi dhidi ya kodi yake ya mwisho ya mwaka (tax credit). Kampuni inayowasilisha taarifa ya kodi ya kampuni inaweza kupunguza kodi yake kwa kiasi cha WHT iliyokatwa na kuonyeshwa kwenye cheti.
question_en: What is a WHT certificate used for?
answer_en: A WHT certificate confirms that the payer remitted WHT on behalf of the recipient. The recipient can use this certificate as a tax credit against their final annual tax liability. A company filing a corporate income tax return can reduce its tax liability by the WHT amount shown on the certificate.

instruction: Kwa nini mwajiri hawezi kutumia viwango vya mshahara wa 2022 tena?
output: Kwa sababu amri ya 2022 ilifutwa kikamilifu na GN605A. Kuanzia Januari 1, 2026, viwango vya 2022 havina nguvu ya kisheria — ni kana kwamba havijaandikwa. GN605A ndiyo mamlaka pekee inayohusika na viwango vya mshahara wa chini ya sekta binafsi Tanzania. Wafanyakazi wana haki ya kudai malipo yaliyobaki (backpay) tangu Januari 2026 kama walilipwa kwa viwango vya amri iliyofutwa.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. instruction: Serikali inaniambia nitoe invoice bila VAT ili kuepuka withholding — hii ni halali?
output: Hapana, hii si halali kama umesajiliwa VAT. Kama biashara yako imesajiliwa VAT, lazima utoe invoice yenye VAT ya 18%. Serikali kama mbia wako lazima ikata sehemu ya VAT hiyo na kukupa certificate. Kuomba invoice bila VAT ili kuepuka withholding ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya VAT. Thibitisha na TRA utaratibu sahihi.

question_sw: BRELA inasaidia katika kufanikisha suala la migogoro ya wanahisa — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. BRELA si chombo cha utatuzi wa migogoro. Migogoro ya wanahisa inashughulikiwa kupitia mahakama ya kibiashara, usuluhishi, au mediation — si BRELA. BRELA inasimamia usajili na nyaraka za kisheria, lakini haina mamlaka ya utatuzi wa migogoro kati ya wanahisa.
question_en: BRELA helps resolve shareholder disputes — is this true?
answer_en: No. BRELA is not a dispute resolution body. Shareholder disputes are handled through the commercial court, arbitration, or mediation — not BRELA. BRELA administers registration and legal documents, but has no authority to resolve disputes between shareholders.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: Companies Act or arbitration Act update

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya ushuru wa stempu na kodi ya ardhi (land rent) Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa stempu na kodi ya ardhi ni mambo mawili tofauti kabisa. Ushuru wa stempu ni kodi ya mara moja inayolipwa kwenye hati za kisheria kama uhamishaji wa ardhi — inalipwa na mnunuzi mara moja. Kodi ya ardhi (ground rent/land rent) ni malipo ya kila mwaka kwa Serikali kwa matumizi ya ardhi ya umma (hekta/ekari) — inalipwa mwaka hadi mwaka na mmiliki au mpangishaji.
question_en: What is the difference between stamp duty and land rent in Tanzania?
answer_en: Stamp duty and land rent are two completely separate things. Stamp duty is a one-time tax paid on legal instruments like land transfer — paid once by the buyer. Land rent is an annual payment to the Government for use of public land — paid year after year by the owner or leaseholder.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or land rent policy update

instruction: Bonasi ya mwisho wa mwaka inalipwa kwa fedha — inaingizwa kwenye SDL base?
output: Ndiyo — bonasi inayolipwa kwa FEDHA inaingizwa kwenye SDL base kwa mwezi ilipokwa. SDL inajumuisha malipo yote ya fedha kwa wafanyakazi, ikijumuisha: mshahara wa msingi, posho za fedha (allowances), bonasi za fedha, na malipo mengine ya fedha. Bonasi ya mwisho wa mwaka inalipwa kwa fedha — hivyo inaongezwa kwenye SDL base ya mwezi huo. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Mchango wa WCF ni asilimia 1 ya mshahara wa mfanyakazi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango sahihi cha mchango wa WCF ni asilimia 0.5 — si asilimia 1. Asilimia 0.5 inakokotolewa kutoka kwa jumla ya mshahara wote wa wafanyakazi (gross emoluments). Kiwango cha asilimia 1 ni kosa — si sahihi chini ya sheria.
question_en: The WCF contribution is 1% of employee salary — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The correct WCF contribution rate is 0.5% — not 1%. The 0.5% is calculated on total gross employee wages (gross emoluments). A rate of 1% is incorrect under the law.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Mfanyabiashara asiyejua tofauti ya zero-rated na exempt anaweza kupoteza nini?
answer_sw: Anaweza kupoteza input VAT yake. Mfanyabiashara anayedhani mauzo yake ni 'exempt' (wakati yako zero-rated) anaweza kushindwa kudai input VAT anayostahili — anapoteza pesa halisi. Na kinyume chake, mfanyabiashara anayedhani mauzo yake ni 'zero-rated' (wakati yako exempt) anaweza kudai input VAT isiyostahiliwa — akabiliane na adhabu. Ujuzi wa tofauti hii ni muhimu.
question_en: What can a business lose by not knowing the difference between zero-rated and exempt?
answer_en: They can lose their input VAT. A business that thinks its sales are 'exempt' (when they are actually zero-rated) may fail to claim input VAT it is entitled to — losing real money. Conversely, a business that thinks its sales are 'zero-rated' (when they are exempt) may claim unentitled input VAT — and face penalties. Understanding this distinction is critical.

question_sw: Nilinunua Bitcoin kwa TZS 2M na kuiuza kwa TZS 5M — ni kodi gani ninastahili kulipa?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa mapato ya cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, USDT, nk) ni mada inayohitaji uelewa wa hivi karibuni wa miongozo ya TRA — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Tanzania bado inaendelea kuweka sera yake ya kodi ya cryptocurrency. Muona TRA moja kwa moja au mhesabu wa kodi aliyehitimu kwa mwongozo wa hivi karibuni. Epuka kutoa maelezo ya kodi yanayoweza kukusababishia matatizo ya kisheria.
question_en: I bought Bitcoin for TZS 2M and sold it for TZS 5M — what tax do I owe?
answer_en: Tax on cryptocurrency income (Bitcoin, USDT, etc.) requires current knowledge of TRA guidelines — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Tanzania is still developing its cryptocurrency tax policy. Consult TRA directly or a qualified tax accountant for the most current guidance. Avoid acting on tax advice that could cause you legal problems.

question_sw: Ninataka kujua: SDL ya mwaka mzima kwa kampuni yenye mishahara ya TZS 8,000,000 kwa mwezi na wafanyakazi 13.
answer_sw: SDL ya kila mwezi: TZS 8,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 280,000. SDL ya mwaka mzima: TZS 280,000 × 12 = TZS 3,360,000. Hii inalipwa kwa awamu 12 (kila mwezi), mwisho siku ya 7 ya kila mwezi. SDL = Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi), inalipwa na mwajiri, haijumuishi malipo ya PAYE, NSSF, au WCF.
question_en: I want to know: annual SDL for a company with monthly payroll TZS 8,000,000 and 13 employees.
answer_en: Monthly SDL: TZS 8,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 280,000. Annual SDL: TZS 280,000 × 12 = TZS 3,360,000. This is paid in 12 instalments (monthly), due by the 7th of each month. SDL = Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi), paid by the employer, separate from PAYE, NSSF, or WCF payments.

question_sw: Je, NSSF inakatwa kabla ya kuhesabu PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mchango wa lazima wa NSSF (asilimia 10 ya mfanyakazi) unakatwa mshahara ghafi na unapunguza msingi wa PAYE. Kwa mfano, mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara TZS 600,000 analipa NSSF TZS 60,000; PAYE inacheswa kwa TZS 540,000. Thibitisha na TRA na NSSF.
question_en: Is NSSF deducted before calculating PAYE?
answer_en: Yes. The mandatory employee NSSF contribution (10% of gross wage) is deducted from gross salary before calculating PAYE. For example, an employee earning TZS 600,000 pays TZS 60,000 NSSF; PAYE is calculated on TZS 540,000. Confirm with TRA and NSSF.

instruction: Biashara yangu ina wafanyakazi HASA 10 tu — lazima nilipe SDL?
output: Ndiyo — ukiwa na wafanyakazi 10 hasa, unakuwa kwenye kizingiti cha SDL na lazima ulipe. Kizingiti cha SDL ni wafanyakazi 10 AU ZAIDI. Wafanyakazi 10 hasa = unafikia kizingiti, SDL inatakiwa. Wafanyakazi 9 = bado chini ya kizingiti, SDL haihitajiki kwa kawaida. Mara idadi ikiwa 10, anza kulipa SDL = 3.5% x jumla ya mishahara ya fedha ya wafanyakazi wote. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, mauzo ya huduma nje ya nchi yana VAT 0% kama bidhaa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo kwa ujumla — huduma zinazotolewa kwa wateja nje ya Tanzania kwa matumizi nje (exported services) zinaweza kustahili kiwango cha 0%. Hata hivyo, kanuni za 'place of supply' ni ngumu — kama huduma inatumika Tanzania hata kama mlipaji yuko nje, VAT ya kawaida inaweza kutumika. Thibitisha muundo wako maalum na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: Do exported services also carry 0% VAT like goods?
answer_en: Generally yes — services supplied to customers outside Tanzania for use outside (exported services) may qualify for the 0% rate. However, the rules on 'place of supply' are complex — if a service is used in Tanzania even if the payer is abroad, regular VAT may apply. Confirm your specific structure with a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Je, TIN ya kampuni inaweza kutumika badala ya TIN ya mfanyakazi kwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Hapana. PAYE inahitaji TIN ya mfanyakazi binafsi — si TIN ya kampuni. Mfanyakazi (mgeni au raia) lazima awe na TIN yake mwenyewe. Mwajiri anawasilisha PAYE kwa TIN ya kampuni lakini PAYE inaruhusiwa kwa TIN ya mfanyakazi maalum. Zinaweza kuhitajika TIN zote mbili.
question_en: Can a company TIN be used instead of an employee TIN for PAYE?
answer_en: No. PAYE requires the individual employee's TIN — not the company TIN. An employee (foreign or citizen) must have their own TIN. The employer remits PAYE using the company TIN but PAYE is attributed to the specific employee's TIN. Both TINs may be required.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Usambazaji wa bidhaa nje ya Tanzania Bara unastahili VAT ya Tanzania?
answer_sw: Bidhaa zinazosambazwa au huduma zinazofurahiwa nje ya Tanzania Bara zinastahili kiwango cha sifuri (zero-rated) kwa kutoa uthibitisho. Hii inatofautiana na msamaha (exempt) — msajiliwa wa VAT anaweza kudai input tax credit kwa usambazaji wa zero-rated. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Is a supply consumed outside Tanzania Mainland subject to Tanzania VAT?
answer_en: Supplies consumed or enjoyed outside Tanzania Mainland are zero-rated upon proof. This differs from exempt — a VAT-registered person can claim input tax credit on zero-rated supplies. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya ada za huduma (service fees) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya ada za huduma (service fees) ni asilimia 5 kwa wakazi na asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on service fees in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on service fees is 5% for residents and 15% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Bima ya maisha (life insurance) ina levy tofauti na bima ya kawaida (general insurance) Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Tofauti ya levy kati ya bima ya maisha na bima ya kawaida inashughulikiwa chini ya sheria ya bima na kanuni za TIRA — ni mada tofauti na kodi zinazoshughulikiwa na TRA. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: NSSF inahesabiwaje? Mwajiri analipa ngapi na mfanyakazi analipa ngapi?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Mfano: mshahara wa TZS 500,000 → Mwajiri: TZS 500,000 × 10% = TZS 50,000. Mfanyakazi: TZS 500,000 × 10% = TZS 50,000 (ikiwa imejumuishwa kwenye mshahara). Jumla ya mchango: TZS 100,000 kwa mwezi.

instruction: TRA inanikagua EFD. Wana mamlaka ya kuangalia rekodi zangu za miamala ya nyuma?
output: Ndiyo. TRA ina mamlaka kamili ya kukagua rekodi zote za miamala zilizohifadhiwa kwenye mfumo wa EFD, ikiwa ni pamoja na miamala ya miaka ya nyuma. Rekodi za EFD zinapelekwa moja kwa moja kwenye seva za TRA (real-time reporting). Hakikisha miamala yote ya biashara yako imefanywa kupitia EFD na kutoa risiti. Ikiwa kuna kasoro, TRA inaweza kutoa tathmini ya ziada ya kodi (additional assessment).
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kuomba msamaha wa SDL vipi?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anayetaka msamaha wa SDL lazima aandike ombi rasmi kwa Kamishna wa TRA akitoa sababu za kisheria za msamaha, kama vile hadhi ya EPZ, hali ya shirika lisilo la faida, au msamaha mwingine uliowekwa kisheria. Ombi linapaswa kuambatanishwa na: cheti cha usajili wa shirika, hati inayothibitisha hadhi ya msamaha (k.m. cheti cha EPZA au hati ya shirika lisilo la faida), na nyaraka za BRELA. TRA itapitia ombi na kutoa uamuzi kwa maandishi. Usidai msamaha kabla ya kupata uamuzi wa TRA.
answer_en: An employer seeking SDL exemption must write a formal application to the TRA Commissioner General stating the legal grounds for exemption, such as EPZ status, non-profit organisation status, or another statutory exemption. The application should be accompanied by: the organisation's registration certificate, documentation confirming exemption status (e.g., EPZA certificate or non-profit deed), and BRELA documents. TRA will review the application and issue a written decision. Do not claim exemption before receiving TRA's written decision.
question_en: How can an employer apply for an SDL exemption?

question_sw: Posho ya nyumba na posho ya usafiri — zinajumuishwa kwenye SDL?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kwa ujumla, posho za mara kwa mara kama posho ya nyumba na usafiri zinajumuishwa kwenye jumla ya mishahara inayotumika kuhesabu SDL. Inahusisha malipo yote ya kawaida ya mwajiri kwa mwajiriwa. Thibitisha muundo maalum na mshauri wako wa kodi.
question_en: Housing allowance and transport allowance — are they included in SDL?
answer_en: Yes. Generally, regular allowances such as housing and transport allowances are included in the total payroll used to calculate SDL. This covers all regular employer payments to employees. Confirm your specific structure with your tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Uhusiano kati ya EFD na VAT ni nini?
answer_sw: EFD ni chombo cha utekelezaji wa VAT. Biashara iliyosajiliwa kwa VAT inatozea wateja VAT ya asilimia 18 kwenye kila muamala — na risiti ya EFD ndiyo hati rasmi inayoonyesha VAT hiyo. Bila EFD, hakuna uthibitisho wa kisheria wa VAT. Seva ya TRA inakusanya taarifa za EFD na TRA inazitumia kulinganisha na VAT returns. EFD + VAT return + malipo ya VAT ndio 'mzunguko kamili' wa wajibu wa VAT.
question_en: What is the relationship between EFD and VAT?
answer_en: EFD is the enforcement tool for VAT. A VAT-registered business charges customers 18% VAT on every transaction — and the EFD receipt is the official document evidencing that VAT. Without EFD, there is no official proof of VAT. TRA's server collects EFD data and TRA uses it to verify against VAT returns. EFD + VAT return + VAT payment is the 'complete cycle' of VAT obligation.

question_sw: Je, GN 487A inaathiri wawekezaji wa kigeni wanaoweka mtaji Tanzania?
answer_sw: GN 487A inahusu shughuli MAALUM za biashara ya kila siku — kama biashara ya rejareja, salon, na uhamisho wa pesa ya simu. Uwekezaji wa mtaji mkubwa (kama kujenga hoteli, kiwanda, au mradi wa miundombinu) kwa kawaida HAUATHIRIWI na GN 487A. Shughuli zilizozuiwa ni za biashara ndogo ndogo — si uwekezaji mkubwa wa kimkakati.
question_en: Does GN 487A affect foreign investors placing capital in Tanzania?
answer_en: GN 487A concerns SPECIFIC everyday trade activities — such as retail trade, salons, and mobile money transfers. Large capital investment (such as building a hotel, factory, or infrastructure project) is generally NOT affected by GN 487A. The prohibited activities are small-business trades — not large strategic investments.

question_sw: Usajili wa OSHA unagharimu kiasi gani kwa biashara ndogo?
answer_sw: Ada ya usajili wa OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inategemea ukubwa wa biashara — idadi ya wafanyakazi na aina ya biashara. Kwa biashara ndogo zenye wafanyakazi chache (kama 10), ada inaweza kuwa TZS 50,000-150,000 kwa mwaka. Mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi 10+ kwenye Mainland Tanzania analazimika kusajili OSHA. Angalia osha.go.tz kwa jedwali la ada la hali ya sasa.
question_en: How much does OSHA registration cost for a small business?
answer_en: The OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) registration fee depends on business size — number of employees and type of business. For small businesses with few workers (say 10), fees can range from TZS 50,000-150,000 per year. Employers with 10+ workers on Mainland Tanzania are required to register with OSHA. Check osha.go.tz for the current fee schedule.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Je, ongezeko la mshahara wa GN 605A lilikuwa la asilimia ngapi kwa wastani?
answer_sw: Kwa mujibu wa GN 605A, ongezeko la wastani kwa sekta binafsi lilikuwa asilimia 33.4 — kutoka Shilingi 275,060 hadi Shilingi 358,322 kwa mwezi. Mwaka uliopita (2022), viwango vya mshahara vilikuwa vya chini zaidi; GN 605A imeviongeza kwa kiasi kikubwa.
question_en: What was the average percentage increase under GN 605A?
answer_en: Under GN 605A the average private sector increase was 33.4% — from TZS 275,060 to TZS 358,322 per month. The 2022 rates were significantly lower; GN 605A raised them substantially.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya mshahara wa chini (minimum wage) na mshahara wa maisha (living wage) ni nini?
answer_sw: Mshahara wa chini (GN 605A) ni kiwango cha kisheria cha chini kabisa ambacho mwajiri analazimika kulipa — ni wajibu wa kisheria. Mshahara wa maisha ni kiasi kinachodhaniwa kinahitajika kwa mtu kuishi kwa heshima — si lazima kisheria lakini ni lengo la kibinadamu. GN 605A inaweka mshahara wa chini; mshahara wa maisha Tanzania unakadiriwa kuwa wa juu zaidi.
question_en: What is the difference between minimum wage and living wage?
answer_en: The minimum wage (GN 605A) is the legally mandated floor an employer must pay — it is a legal obligation. A living wage is the amount estimated to cover dignified living — not legally required but a human wellbeing target. GN 605A sets the minimum; Tanzania's estimated living wage is higher.

question_sw: PAYE inalipwa na mfanyakazi mwenyewe kwa TRA moja kwa moja — mwajiri hana wajibu wa kukata?
answer_sw: Hapana. PAYE ni mfumo wa PAYE-AS-YOU-EARN ambapo MWAJIRI ndiye anayelazimika KUKATA PAYE kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi na kuipeleka TRA. Mfanyakazi hajalazimishwa kulipa moja kwa moja kwa TRA isipokuwa katika hali maalum (kama ana mapato ya ziada). Wajibu mkubwa ni wa mwajiri.
question_en: PAYE is paid directly to TRA by the employee themselves — the employer has no deduction obligation?
answer_en: No. PAYE is a Pay-As-You-Earn system where the EMPLOYER is required to DEDUCT PAYE from the employee's salary and remit it to TRA. The employee is not required to pay directly to TRA unless in special circumstances (such as having additional income). The primary obligation rests with the employer.

question_sw: NSSF imetoa tathmini ya michango ya ziada dhidi ya kampuni yangu ambayo naona ni makosa. Naweza kupinga vipi?
answer_sw: Unaweza kupinga tathmini ya NSSF kwa njia zifuatazo: kwanza, wasiliana na ofisi ya NSSF kwa maandishi ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kupokea tathmini, ukitoa ushahidi wa payroll yako halisi (rekodi za mshahara, slips za malipo, na rekodi za benki). Ikiwa tathmini bado hairidhishi, unaweza kupiga rufaa kwa Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa NSSF. Kama bado hujaridhika, uzo unaendelea hadi Mahakama ya Kazi (Labour Court). Hifadhi rekodi zote za malipo ya NSSF na mishahara kwa miaka 5 ili kujibu tathmini.
answer_en: You can dispute an NSSF assessment in these steps: first, contact the NSSF office in writing within 30 days of receiving the assessment, providing evidence of your actual payroll (salary records, payslips, and bank records). If the assessment is still unsatisfactory, you can appeal to the NSSF Director General. If still unsatisfied, the dispute proceeds to the Labour Court. Keep all NSSF payment and salary records for 5 years to respond to assessments.
question_en: NSSF has issued an excess contribution assessment against my company that I believe is wrong. How can I dispute it?
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act amendment or Labour Court rules change

question_sw: Je, VAT refund ya watalii (tourist VAT refund) inapatikana Tanzania?
answer_sw: Sina uhakika wa hali ya sasa ya mfumo wa VAT refund kwa watalii Tanzania. Nchi nyingine zina mifumo kama hiyo lakini utekelezaji wake Tanzania unabadilika. Thibitisha na TRA au Bodi ya Utalii ya Tanzania (TTB) kuhusu hali ya sasa ya VAT refund kwa watalii.
question_en: Is a tourist VAT refund available in Tanzania?
answer_en: I am not certain of the current status of a tourist VAT refund scheme in Tanzania. Some countries have such schemes but implementation in Tanzania is evolving. Verify with TRA or the Tanzania Tourism Board (TTB) about the current status of tourist VAT refunds.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio kwa kampuni zingine (zisizoorodheshwa DSE) ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio kwa kampuni zisizoorodheshwa DSE ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi. Kama kampuni inayopokea gawio inamiliki zaidi ya asilimia 25 ya hisa — kiwango ni asilimia 5. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on dividends from non-DSE-listed companies?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on dividends from non-DSE-listed companies is 10% for residents and 10% for non-residents. If the recipient company holds 25%+ of shares — the rate is 5%. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: TRA inafanya ukaguzi wa SDL vipi na wanakagua nini?
answer_sw: TRA wanaweza kufanya ukaguzi wa SDL kwa mpango au baada ya kupokea taarifa za udanganyifu. Wakati wa ukaguzi, TRA wanakagua: orodha za mishahara (payroll) kwa miaka inayopitiwa, rekodi za benki za malipo ya mishahara, return za SDL zilizowasilishwa, mikataba ya ajira, na rekodi za kuidhinisha wafanyakazi. Tofauti kati ya mishahara iliyotangazwa kwenye return za PAYE na ile ya SDL ni dalili ya tatizo. Kuhifadhi rekodi za mishahara kwa miaka 5 angalau ni lazima.
answer_en: TRA may conduct SDL audits on a planned basis or after receiving fraud reports. During an audit, TRA examines: payroll records for the years under review, bank statements showing salary payments, submitted SDL returns, employment contracts, and staff confirmation records. A discrepancy between salaries declared on PAYE returns and SDL returns is a red flag. Maintaining payroll records for at least 5 years is mandatory.
question_en: How does TRA conduct an SDL audit and what do they examine?

question_sw: Mama lishe mgeni karibu na ofisi yangu — je, sheria inamsemaje?
answer_sw: Chini ya GN 487A (2025), biashara ya rejareja ya chakula — ikiwa ni pamoja na mama lishe wanaoandaa na kuuza chakula — ni kati ya shughuli zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania. Mama lishe huyu mgeni anaweza kukiuka GN 487A kama anachukuliwa kuendesha biashara yake binafsi. Adhabu inayowezekana ni faini ya TZS milioni 10 au zaidi na kifungo cha hadi miezi 6. Hali yake ya kisheria inahitaji uchunguzi — ikiwezekana apate ushauri wa wakili wa uhamiaji.
question_en: There is a foreign mama lishe (street food seller) near my office — what does the law say?
answer_en: Under GN 487A (2025), retail food business — including mama lishe who prepare and sell food — falls within the prohibited activities for non-Tanzanian citizens. This foreign mama lishe may be violating GN 487A if they are considered to be running their own business. Potential penalties are a TZS 10 million or more fine and up to 6 months imprisonment. Their legal situation requires review — they should ideally get immigration legal advice.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: GN 605A ni nini na inaweza kuathiri biashara yangu vipi?
answer_sw: GN 605A ni Agizo la Serikali linaloweka kiwango cha chini cha mshahara kwa sekta mbalimbali Tanzania. Agizo hili lilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Kama mwajiri, lazima ulipe wafanyakazi wako angalau kiwango kilichowekwa kwa sekta yako — kutolipa ni kosa la kisheria.
question_en: What is GN 605A and how does it affect my business?
answer_en: GN 605A is a Government Notice setting the minimum wage across sectors in Tanzania. It took effect on 1 January 2026. As an employer you must pay at least the floor set for your sector — failure to comply is a legal offence.

question_sw: Mwajiri anahitaji kujua gharama za uzingatiaji (compliance) za kila mfanyakazi mpya anayeajiri Tanzania — ni kiasi gani kwa mfanyakazi mmoja?
answer_sw: Gharama za uzingatiaji kwa kila mfanyakazi mpya Tanzania (mbali na mshahara) ni: NSSF mwajiri: asilimia 10 ya mshahara wa jumla kila mwezi (si ada ya usajili), WCF: asilimia 0.5 ya mshahara wa mwaka, SDL (ikiwa wafanyakazi 10+): asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla kila mwezi. Kwa mfano, mfanyakazi wa TZS 500,000/mwezi: NSSF TZS 50,000/mwezi + WCF TZS 2,500/mwezi + SDL TZS 17,500/mwezi (ikiwa ≥10) = TZS 70,000/mwezi ya ziada ya uzingatiaji.
question_en: What compliance costs per new employee does an employer need to know in Tanzania?
answer_en: Compliance costs per new Tanzania employee (beyond salary): NSSF employer: 10% of gross monthly wage (not a registration fee), WCF: 0.5% of annual wage, SDL (if 10+ employees): 3.5% of gross monthly wage. For example, an employee on TZS 500,000/month: NSSF TZS 50,000/month + WCF TZS 2,500/month + SDL TZS 17,500/month (if ≥10) = TZS 70,000/month extra compliance cost.

instruction: SDL na PAYE — zote zinalipwa tarehe 7?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Ndio — SDL na PAYE zote mbili zinalipwa tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kumbuka: VAT return ni tarehe 20 (tofauti). Kalenda ya kodi: tarehe 7 (SDL + PAYE + WCF) | tarehe 20 (VAT return) | tarehe 9 ya mwezi ujao (NSSF, kwa makampuni fulani — thibitisha na NSSF).

question_sw: Je, visa ya mgeni inafutwa PAMOJA na faini na kifungo, au ni adhabu mbadala?
answer_sw: Kufutwa kwa visa kunakwenda PAMOJA na faini na kifungo — si badala yake. Mgeni anakabiliwa na adhabu tatu wakati mmoja: (1) faini ya angalau TZS 10M, (2) kifungo hadi miezi 6, NA (3) visa kufutwa. Kufutwa kwa visa ni matokeo ya ziada — si uchaguzi wa korti bali ni lazima inayofuata uamuzi wa hatia.
question_en: Is visa revocation for a non-citizen issued TOGETHER with the fine and imprisonment, or is it an alternative penalty?
answer_en: Visa revocation comes TOGETHER with the fine and imprisonment — not instead of them. The non-citizen faces all three at the same time: (1) fine of at least TZS 10M, (2) imprisonment up to 6 months, AND (3) visa revocation. Visa revocation is an additional consequence — not a court choice but a mandatory result that follows a finding of guilt.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Kampuni ya nje (foreign company) inaweza kumiliki duka la reja reja Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana chini ya GN 487A. Biashara ya reja reja ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni. Kampuni inayomilikiwa na wageni haiwezi kufanya biashara ya reja reja Tanzania Bara. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na TIC.
question_en: Can a foreign-owned company own a retail shop in Tanzania?
answer_en: No under GN 487A. Retail trade is one of the 15 activities prohibited for non-citizens. A company owned by foreigners cannot conduct retail business in Tanzania Mainland. Confirm with the Immigration Department and TIC.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

instruction: Biashara yangu inapokea malipo kwa kadi ya benki — EFD yangu lazima iwe na uwezo wa ku-process kadi?
output: EFD inaweza kutoa risiti bila kujali jinsi ya malipo — malipo ya kadi, pesa taslimu, au kidijitali. Hata kama mfumo wa kadi ni tofauti na EFD, lazima bado utoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala. EFD na mfumo wa kulipa kwa kadi (POS machine) vinaweza kuwa tofauti — lakini kila mauzo yanayofanywa kwenye POS lazima yaingizwe kwenye EFD pia na risiti itolewe. TRA inajua kuwa wafanyabiashara wengine wana POS na EFD tofauti — inatarajiwa unganisho bora zaidi katika siku zijazo. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Biashara yangu ya uuzaji wa bidhaa za msimu inapata TZS 150M kwa miezi 4 ya msimu — VAT?
output: TZS 150M kwa miezi 4 inazidi TZS 100M kwa miezi 6 — lazima usajili VAT. Kizingiti cha TZS 100M/6 miezi kinahusika hata kama kinatokea kwa msimu. Usidhani unaweza kuepuka VAT kwa sababu mauzo ni ya msimu — kizingiti kinafanya kazi kwa mauzo halisi ya kipindi chochote cha miezi 6.

question_sw: Mwekezaji mgeni Tanzania anahitaji kibali gani cha makazi?
answer_sw: Mwekezaji mgeni anayefanya biashara kwa akaunti yake mwenyewe anahitaji Kibali cha Makazi daraja A (Residence Permit Class A) — kinachojulikana kama kibali cha mwekezaji. Daraja A ni kwa wanaojitegemea (self-employed) na wawekezaji wa kigeni. Kinatolewa kwa wanaofanya uwekezaji unaokidhi vigezo vya TIC. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na TIC.
question_en: What residence permit does a foreign investor in Tanzania need?
answer_en: A foreign investor running a business on their own account needs a Class A Residence Permit — known as the investor permit. Class A is for self-employed persons and foreign investors. It is granted to those making investments meeting TIC criteria. Confirm with the Immigration Department and TIC.
next_review_trigger: Immigration regulation change or GN 487A update

question_sw: Fomu ya P45 inatumika Tanzania wakati mfanyakazi anaondoka kazini — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Fomu ya P45 ni fomu ya Uingereza (UK) na HAIPO Tanzania. Tanzania inatumia Hati ya Kuondoka (Leaving Certificate) na fomu ya P9 (taarifa ya mwaka ya PAYE). Mwajiri hutoa Hati ya Kuondoka kwa mfanyakazi anayeacha kazi, si P45.
question_en: Form P45 is used in Tanzania when an employee leaves employment — is this true?
answer_en: No. Form P45 is a UK form and DOES NOT EXIST in Tanzania. Tanzania uses a Leaving Certificate and the P9 form (annual PAYE return). An employer issues a Leaving Certificate to a departing employee, not a P45.

question_sw: Nnataka kuingiza bidhaa kutoka nje ya nchi na kuzisambaza Tanzania. Ninahitaji leseni ya uingizaji bidhaa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Uingizaji wa bidhaa Tanzania unahitaji: TIN iliyosajiliwa na TRA, nambari ya msimbo wa biashara (TIN-based importer code) kutoka TRA, na wakati mwingine leseni maalum ya bidhaa fulani — kwa mfano, dawa (TMDA), chakula (TMDA), silaha (Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani). Bidhaa zote zinazoingia Tanzania zinapita forodha na zinaweza kukaguliwa. Ikiwa unaingiza zaidi ya TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka, ulazimishwa kusajili VAT. Angalia pia orodha ya bidhaa zilizopigwa marufuku au zinazohitaji vibali maalum.
answer_en: Yes. Importing goods to Tanzania requires: a TIN registered with TRA, an importer code (TIN-based) from TRA, and sometimes a specific product licence — for example, medicines (TMDA), food (TMDA), weapons (Ministry of Interior). All goods entering Tanzania pass through customs and may be inspected. If you import more than TZS 200,000,000 per year, VAT registration is required. Also check the list of prohibited goods or goods requiring special permits.
question_en: I want to import goods from abroad and distribute them in Tanzania. Do I need an import licence?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TMDA regulation change

instruction: NSSF inahitajika kwa waajiri wote au kuna kizingiti cha wafanyakazi?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. NSSF inahitajika kwa WAAJIRI WOTE — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi 1: NSSF inahitajika. Mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi 500: NSSF inahitajika. Tofauti na SDL (kizingiti cha 10+ wafanyakazi) — NSSF haina kizingiti.

instruction: Nimeambiwa SDL inaanzia kwa wafanyakazi 5 — sahihi?
output: Hapana — kizingiti si wafanyakazi 5. SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kizingiti sahihi ni wafanyakazi 10 — si 5, si 15, si 20. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) iwapo una shaka.

instruction: Kampuni yangu mama iko India — vigezo vya bei ya uhamisho (transfer pricing) Tanzania ni vipi?
output: Kanuni ya msingi ya transfer pricing Tanzania ni arm's length principle katika Income Tax Act Sehemu 33 — miamala kati ya kampuni zinazohusiana lazima ifanane na bei za soko. Kwa uchambuzi wa kesi yako: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Bei ya uhamisho (transfer pricing) kati ya kampuni zilizounganishwa kimataifa ni mada tofauti inayohitaji utaalamu maalum wa kodi ya kimataifa. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kupata cheti cha utii wa kodi (tax clearance certificate) wakati pingamizi linaendelea?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida, cheti cha utii wa kodi hakitolewa wakati kuna kesi ya kodi inayoendelea au deni lisilolipwa la kodi ambalo halijatatua. TRA inaweza kuwa na sera zake za kuzingatia hali maalum. Inashauriwa kushauriana na TRA moja kwa moja kuhusu hali yako ya kibinafsi.
question_en: Can I obtain a tax clearance certificate while an objection is in progress?
answer_en: Generally a tax clearance certificate is not issued when there is an active tax dispute or unsettled tax debt. TRA may have its own policies for specific circumstances. It is advisable to consult TRA directly about your individual situation.

question_sw: PAYE na withholding tax (WHT) kwa wasomi wa nje — ni nini tofauti?
answer_sw: PAYE: kodi ya mapato ya ajira inayokatwa na MWAJIRI kwa MFANYAKAZI aliyehiriwa (employed person). WHT ya nje: kodi inayokatwa kwenye malipo ya huduma (consulting fees, management fees, royalties) kwa MKANDARASI asiyehiriwa au mtu wa nje ya nchi. PAYE = ajira; WHT = huduma/bidhaa kutoka nje. Ni mifumo miwili tofauti.
question_en: PAYE and withholding tax (WHT) for foreign professionals — what is the difference?
answer_en: PAYE: income tax on employment earnings deducted by the EMPLOYER from a HIRED EMPLOYEE (employed person). WHT on foreigners: tax deducted on payments for services (consulting fees, management fees, royalties) to an INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR or non-resident. PAYE = employment; WHT = services/goods from abroad. They are two separate frameworks.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

instruction: Saluni ya nywele inayomilikiwa na mgeni Tanzania — ni ukiukwaji wa GN 487A?
