output: Ndiyo — saluni na huduma za urembo ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A (tarehe 28 Julai 2025). Hii inajumuisha saluni za nywele, saluni za kucha, spa, na huduma zote za urembo wa kibinafsi. Mgeni anayemiliki au kuendesha saluni anakabiliwa na: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: VAT ya biashara yangu ni TZS 500,000 lakini input VAT yangu ni TZS 700,000 — ninafanyaje?
output: Ukiwa na input VAT (TZS 700,000) zaidi ya output VAT (TZS 500,000), una REFUND ya VAT ya TZS 200,000 kutoka TRA. Mchakato wa VAT refund: (1) Wasilisha VAT return ya kawaida tarehe 20 ukionyesha tofauti ya refund; (2) TRA inakagua madai ya refund — inaweza kuchukua muda; (3) Kama refund inathibitishwa, TRA itarudisha pesa au itazidisha kwa miezi ijayo. Biashara zinazofanya mauzo ya nje ya nchi (exports) za 0% mara nyingi zina hali hii ya input VAT zaidi. TRA ina muda wa miezi 6 wa kisheria kurudisha refund. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni anaishi Tanzania na anafanya kazi Tanzania — anakuwa mkazi wa kodi (tax resident)?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, mtu aliyekaa Tanzania kwa siku 183 au zaidi katika mwaka wa kodi anakuwa mkazi wa kodi Tanzania. Hali ya mkazi wa kodi inaathiri jinsi mapato yake yoyote nje ya Tanzania yanavyoshughulikiwa. Kwa PAYE ya mfanyakazi, mwajiri anakata kwa kiwango cha kawaida bila kujali hali ya makazi — thibitisha tofauti za non-resident na TRA.
question_en: A foreign employee living and working in Tanzania — do they become a tax resident?
answer_en: Generally, a person who has stayed in Tanzania for 183 or more days in a tax year becomes a Tanzania tax resident. Tax residency affects how their worldwide income is treated. For employee PAYE, the employer deducts at standard rates regardless of residence status — verify non-resident differences with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: SDL inatumiwa kufundisha wafanyakazi wa kampuni yangu moja kwa moja?
answer_sw: Si moja kwa moja. SDL inakwenda TRA/VETA na inachangia mfumo mkubwa wa mafunzo ya ufundi. Kampuni haipati sehemu ya SDL yake moja kwa moja. Wafanyakazi wanaweza kufaidika kwa kuingia kwenye mafunzo ya VETA, lakini si kulipwa SDL moja kwa moja.
question_en: Is SDL used to train my company's employees directly?
answer_en: Not directly. SDL goes to TRA/VETA and contributes to the broader vocational training system. A company does not receive its SDL share back directly. Employees can benefit by accessing VETA training, but not from SDL being paid back directly.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Mfanyakazi aliyekuwa amelipwa nusu mshahara wakati wa ugonjwa — NSSF inahesabiwaje?
answer_sw: NSSF inahesabiwaje kwa msingi wa mshahara uliolipwa halisi. Ikiwa mfanyakazi alilipwa nusu mshahara (50%) wakati wa ugonjwa, NSSF inahesabiwaje kwa msingi wa nusu mshahara hiyo: (nusu mshahara) × 20% = NSSF. Mwajiri 10% na mfanyakazi 10% ya mshahara uliodhalilishwa. Tarehe ya mwisho inabaki ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara.
question_en: An employee was paid half salary during illness — how is NSSF calculated?
answer_en: NSSF is calculated on actual wages paid. If an employee was paid half salary (50%) during illness, NSSF is calculated on that half salary: (half salary) × 20% = NSSF. Employer 10% and employee 10% on the reduced salary. The deadline remains within one month after the salary month.

question_sw: EFD receipt na VAT invoice — ni hati moja au mbili tofauti?
answer_sw: Ni hati MBILI TOFAUTI. VAT invoice: hati rasmi ya kibiashara inayotolewa na msambazaji kwa mnunuzi ikiwa na maelezo kamili ya VAT (jina, TIN, kiasi, kiwango). EFD receipt: hati inayotolewa na mashine ya EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) inayothibitisha mauzo ya biashara — mara nyingi inajumuisha maelezo ya VAT pia. Kwa biashara zilizosajiliwa VAT, EFD receipt ndiyo nyaraka inayothibitishwa na TRA. Zote mbili zinaweza kuhitajika katika hali tofauti.
question_en: EFD receipt and VAT invoice — are they one document or two different ones?
answer_en: They are TWO DIFFERENT documents. VAT invoice: a formal commercial document issued by a supplier to a buyer with full VAT details (name, TIN, amount, rate). EFD receipt: a document issued by an EFD machine (Electronic Fiscal Device) confirming a business sale — often includes VAT details too. For VAT-registered businesses, the EFD receipt is TRA's verified document. Both may be required in different situations.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ina wafanyakazi 12. Je, tunahitaji kulipa SDL na kiwango chake ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni yenye wafanyakazi 12 inalazimika kulipa SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi). Kiwango ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara mkubwa ya wafanyakazi wote 12. Mwajiri ndiye anayelipia — hakatiwi kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Mwisho wa malipo: siku ya 7 ya mwezi unaofuata, pamoja na PAYE.
question_en: My company has 12 employees. Do we need to pay SDL and what is the rate?
answer_en: Yes. A company with 12 employees is required to pay SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi). The rate is 3.5% of the total gross payroll of all 12 employees. The employer pays it — it is not deducted from employee salaries. Deadline: 7th of the following month, together with PAYE.

instruction: Serikali inapata asilimia ngapi ya mapato ya madini? Mgawanyo kati ya serikali na kampuni ya madini ni upi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mgawanyo wa mapato ya madini kati ya serikali na kampuni unashughulikiwa chini ya Mining Act, MIDA, na masharti ya mkataba wa uwekezaji — inajumuisha royalty, kodi ya mapato, na mgawanyo wa faida (profit sharing). Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: GN 605A inaathiri SDL na VAT — vipi?
output: GN 605A (ongezeko la mshahara wa chini, 1 Januari 2026) inaathiri zote kwa njia tofauti: SDL: inaathiriwa moja kwa moja — mishahara inayoongezeka inaongeza SDL base (3.5% ya mishahara). Mfanyakazi aliyepata mshahara mdogo sasa anapata zaidi → SDL inaongezeka. VAT: haihusiani moja kwa moja na mishahara — VAT inategemea mapato ya mauzo ya bidhaa/huduma. Lakini kama mwajiri anapandisha bei za bidhaa/huduma zake kwa wateja kujaza gharama za mishahara → mapato yanaweza kuongezeka → kizingiti cha VAT kinakaribiwa. Kwa muhtasari: GN 605A → mishahara juu → SDL juu (moja kwa moja); VAT inategemea uamuzi wa bei za biashara. Thibitisha na TRA na GN 605A.

instruction: Dereva wa boda boda au bajaj ambaye ni mgeni Tanzania — je, GN 487A inahusika?
output: Ndiyo — boda boda na bajaj ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A (tarehe 28 Julai 2025). Mgeni anayeendesha boda boda au bajaj kwa biashara anakabiliwa na: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Hata kama mgeni anaendesha boda boda moja tu, sheria inatumika. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na Polisi wa Usalama Barabarani.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ya bima Tanzania — ushuru wa malipo ya bima (insurance premium levy) ni asilimia ngapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Ushuru wa malipo ya bima (insurance premium levy) unashughulikiwa na TIRA (Tanzania Insurance Regulatory Authority) na inahitaji utaalamu maalum wa sekta ya bima. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TIRA kupitia tira.go.tz. Wasiliana pia na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Nikiongeza mwenzi mpya katika biashara yangu ya jina — ninahitaji kubadilisha nini BRELA?
output: Kuongeza mwenzi katika biashara ya jina kunabadilisha muundo wa kisheria — tayari sio sole trader bali ni ubia (partnership). Unapaswa: (1) Kufuta au kusasisha usajili wa biashara ya jina kwenye BRELA kuonyesha muundo mpya; (2) Kuandika mkataba wa ubia (partnership agreement) kwa wakili; (3) Kwa ubia rasmi, BRELA usajili upya unaweza kuhitajika. Njia nyingine bora zaidi: badala ya ubia, anzisha kampuni ya hisa ambapo wote mnawe hisa — hii inalinda mali za kibinafsi vizuri zaidi. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz na wakili wa biashara.

instruction: Mshahara wa TZS 271,000 kwa mwezi — PAYE ni kiasi gani?
output:
Hesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 271,000/mwezi:
Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 = TZS 0
Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 1,000 × 8% = TZS 80
PAYE ya jumla: TZS 80/mwezi
Ziada ya TZS 1,000 juu ya TZS 270,000 inalipwa kodi ya 8%.

instruction: Ninataka kuuza hisa zangu zote katika kampuni ya sekta ya utalii Tanzania — capital gains tax inakuja namna gani?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Kodi ya mapato ya mtaji (capital gains tax) kwa mauzo ya hisa katika kampuni za Tanzania inashughulikiwa chini ya Income Tax Act na inategemea hali ya mkazi au asiye mkazi. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Nini tofauti kati ya 'kumiliki biashara' na 'kufanya kazi' chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: GN 487A inazuia watu wasio raia KUMILIKI na KUENDESHA biashara katika makundi 15 — si 'kufanya kazi' kwa ujumla. Tofauti muhimu: Kumiliki/Kuendesha: wewe ni mmiliki wa biashara, unafanya maamuzi ya biashara, unafaidika moja kwa moja na faida — hii imezuiliwa. Kufanya kazi: wewe ni mfanyakazi wa mshahara wa kampuni inayomilikiwa na Mtanzania — hii inaruhusiwa kwa vibali sahihi vya kazi. Mfano: mgeni anayemiliki saluni (KUMILIKI) = kuvunja GN 487A. Mgeni anayefanya kazi kama msusi wa mshahara katika saluni inayomilikiwa na Mtanzania = halali (kwa kibali cha kazi sahihi).
question_en: What is the difference between 'owning a business' and 'working' under GN 487A?
answer_en: GN 487A prohibits non-citizens from OWNING and OPERATING businesses in the 15 categories — not 'working' in general. The key distinction: Owning/Operating: you are the business owner, you make business decisions, you directly benefit from profits — this is prohibited. Working: you are a salaried employee of a Tanzanian-owned company — this is allowed with a valid work permit. Example: a non-citizen who owns a salon (OWNING) = violates GN 487A. A non-citizen working as a salaried hairdresser in a Tanzanian-owned salon = legal (with a valid work permit).
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania haijasajiliwa DSE lakini inamilikiwa asilimia 100 na kampuni ya Uingereza — inatumia kiwango cha asilimia 25 au asilimia 30?
answer_sw: Umiliki na kiwango cha kodi ya DSE ni mambo tofauti. Kiwango cha asilimia 25 kinatokana na ORODHA ya hisa kwenye DSE kwa umma Tanzania — si umiliki wa kigeni. Kampuni inayomilikiwa na Uingereza asilimia 100 ambayo haijaorodhesha DSE inalipa kiwango cha kawaida cha asilimia 30. Umiliki wa kigeni peke yake haupunguzi kiwango cha kodi.
question_en: A Tanzania company not listed on DSE but 100% owned by a UK company — does it use the 25% or 30% rate?
answer_en: DSE listing and tax rate are separate matters. The 25% rate comes from LISTING shares on the DSE for the public in Tanzania — not from foreign ownership. A company that is 100% UK-owned but not DSE-listed pays the standard 30% rate. Foreign ownership alone does not reduce the tax rate.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or DSE rule update

instruction: Anuwai kamili ya viwango vya mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni ipi — kutoka chini kabisa hadi juu kabisa?
output:
Anuwai kamili ya viwango vya mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni:

CHINI KABISA: karibu TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi (baadhi ya sekta za jumla)
WASTANI: TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi (wastani wa sekta zote 16)
JUU KABISA: karibu TZS 765,900 kwa mwezi (sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati)

Ongezeko la wastani ni asilimia 33.4. Viwango halisi vya sekta yako na sub-sector vinapatikana kwenye orodha ya GN 605A (sekta 16, sub-sectors 46). Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

question_sw: Je, ada za biashara za WhatsApp Business zina kodi Tanzania?
answer_sw: WhatsApp Business (toleo la bure) halitozi ada — kwa hivyo hakuna swali la kodi la moja kwa moja. WhatsApp Business API (inayotumiwa na makampuni makubwa) inaweza kuwa na ada kutoka Meta — hizi zinastahili kuzingatiwa kama huduma za kidijitali za nje ya nchi. Sina uhakika wa hali halisi ya kodi ya WhatsApp Business API Tanzania. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: Are there taxes in Tanzania on WhatsApp Business fees?
answer_en: WhatsApp Business (free version) has no fees — so there is no direct tax question. WhatsApp Business API (used by large companies) may have fees from Meta — these could be considered foreign digital services and subject to withholding tax considerations. I am not certain of the exact tax status of WhatsApp Business API in Tanzania. Verify with a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: Je, mzigo wa kuthibitisha ujuzi wa kipekee wa mfanyakazi wa kigeni uko kwa mwajiri au mfanyakazi?
answer_sw: Mzigo wa kuthibitisha uko KWA MWAJIRI. Ni mwajiri — si mfanyakazi — anayepaswa kuwasilisha ushahidi kwa Idara ya Uhamiaji kwamba: ujuzi uliodaiwa ni wa kipekee, hautapatikana kwa Watanzania, na jaribio la kweli la kuajiri Mtanzania lilifanywa. Mwajiri ambaye hatekelezi ushahidi huu atalipiga ombi lake.
question_en: Does the burden of proving a foreign worker's specialist skills lie with the employer or the worker?
answer_en: The burden of proof lies with the EMPLOYER. It is the employer — not the worker — who must submit evidence to the Immigration Department that: the claimed skills are specialist, are not available from Tanzanians, and a genuine attempt to hire a Tanzanian was made. An employer who fails to supply this evidence will have their application rejected.

instruction: Adhabu ya GN 487A inatekelezwa na taasisi gani — TRA, Polisi, au Idara ya Uhamiaji?
output: Utekelezaji unahusisha taasisi nyingi: (1) Polisi na Idara ya Uhamiaji wanashughulikia ukamataji na uchunguzi; (2) Mahakama (si polisi wala TRA) inaamua adhabu ya jinai — faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6; (3) Idara ya Uhamiaji inatekeleza kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. TRA haihusiki moja kwa moja na GN 487A — wanashughulikia kodi tu. Kampeni ya utekelezaji ya Sep–Oct 2025 iliongozwa na Idara ya Uhamiaji. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Msaidizi Mtanzania anaweza kupata faini ZAIDI ya TZS 5M ikiwa uharibifu ni mkubwa?
answer_sw: Hapana — kwa makosa ya GN 487A peke yake, korti haiwezi kutoza msaidizi zaidi ya TZS 5M kwa sababu 5M ni kiwango cha juu kilichowekwa na sheria. Hata hivyo, ikiwa msaidizi amefanya makosa mengine ya kisheria — ulaghai, unyang'anyi wa biashara, au kuvunja sheria nyingine — korti inaweza kutoza adhabu za ziada kwa makosa hayo mengine.
question_en: Can a Tanzanian facilitator be fined MORE than TZS 5M if the damage is extensive?
answer_en: No — under GN 487A specifically, a court cannot fine a facilitator more than TZS 5M because 5M is the maximum ceiling set by the law. However, if the facilitator has committed other legal offences — fraud, business theft, or violation of other laws — a court may impose additional penalties for those separate offences.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mgahawa wangu wa karibu na soko unapata TZS 250,000,000 kwa mwaka. Je, ninalazimika na EFD?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mauzo ya TZS 250,000,000 kwa mwaka yanazidi kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT (TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12). Lazima ujisajili kwa VAT na baada ya usajili, unahitaji EFD au VFD. Ukichelewa kusajili VAT na EFD, unaweza kukabili adhabu za malimbikizo ya VAT. Hatua: (1) Jisajili kwa VAT na TRA; (2) Pata EFD au VFD kutoka kwa muuzaji aliyeidhinishwa; (3) Anza kutoa risiti za EFD.
question_en: My restaurant near the market earns TZS 250,000,000 per year. Am I required to have EFD?
answer_en: Yes. Sales of TZS 250,000,000 per year exceed the VAT registration threshold (TZS 200,000,000 in 12 months). You must register for VAT and after registration, you need EFD or VFD. Delaying VAT and EFD registration may result in backdated VAT penalties. Steps: (1) Register for VAT with TRA; (2) Get an EFD or VFD from an approved supplier; (3) Start issuing EFD receipts.

question_sw: Muhtasari: GN 487A inamaanisha nini kwa mfanyabiashara mgeni Tanzania?
answer_sw: GN 487A (28 Julai 2025) inamaanisha: (1) Shughuli 15 zimefungwa kwa umiliki na uendeshaji wa raia wa kigeni — biashara ya jumla, rejareja, mobile money, salon, ukarabati wa simu na nyingine. (2) Ukikiuka: faini ya angalau TZS 10M, hadi miezi 6 gerezani, visa inafutwa. (3) Mtanzania anayekusaidia kukiuka: faini ya TZS 5M au miezi 3. (4) Utekelezaji: Idara ya Uhamiaji. (5) Kigezo: uraia — si muda wa makazi, si utaifa, si leseni ya zamani.
question_en: Summary: what does GN 487A mean for a non-citizen business operator in Tanzania?
answer_en: GN 487A (28 July 2025) means: (1) 15 activities are closed to ownership and operation by non-citizens — wholesale, retail, mobile money, salon, phone repair and others. (2) If you violate: minimum TZS 10M fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, visa revoked. (3) Tanzanian who helps you violate: TZS 5M fine or 3 months. (4) Enforcement: Immigration Services Department. (5) Criterion: citizenship — not length of residence, not nationality, not a prior licence.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Adhabu ya biashara isiyosajiliwa VAT inayokusanya VAT ni nini?
answer_sw: Biashara isiyosajiliwa inayokusanya VAT inaweza kukabiliwa na adhabu kama vile: (1) kurudisha VAT yote iliyokusanywa kwa TRA bila kupewa mkopo wowote wa pembejeo; (2) faini za kodi za ziada kwa ukiukaji wa makusudi; (3) kuzuiwa kwa biashara hadi kusajilishwa. Pia: wateja waliodai input VAT kutoka biashara isiyosajiliwa wanaweza kukabiliwa na marekebisho ya kodi — TRA inaweza kukataa madai yao.
question_en: What is the penalty for an unregistered business that collects VAT?
answer_en: An unregistered business collecting VAT may face penalties such as: (1) remitting all collected VAT to TRA without receiving any input VAT credit; (2) additional tax penalties for deliberate violation; (3) business closure until registration. Also: customers who claimed input VAT from the unregistered business may face tax assessments — TRA may reject their claims.

instruction: PAYE inalipwa TRA tarehe ngapi kila mwezi?
output: PAYE inalipwa TRA tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Mfano: PAYE ya Januari → ilipe kabla ya tarehe 7 Februari. Kuchelewa kulipa PAYE kunasababisha faini ya 2.5% ya PAYE iliyochelewa kwa kila mwezi, pamoja na riba ya kila siku ya kuchelewa chini ya Tax Administration Act. Usifanye makosa: tarehe 20 ni kwa VAT — tarehe 7 ni kwa PAYE na SDL.

question_sw: Biashara mpya iliyosajili VAT ina muda gani wa kupata na kusajili EFD Tanzania?
answer_sw: Biashara inayosajili VAT Tanzania inapaswa kupata na kusajili EFD haraka iwezekanavyo — kwa kawaida ndani ya muda mfupi wa kuanza kufanya mauzo ya VAT. TRA inaweza kutoa mwongozo mahususi wa muda wa kupata EFD baada ya usajili wa VAT. Kufanya mauzo ya VAT bila EFD (baada ya kulazimishwa) ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya VAT na EFD.
question_en: A new VAT-registered business — how much time does it have to obtain and register an EFD in Tanzania?
answer_en: A business registering for VAT in Tanzania should obtain and register an EFD as quickly as possible — generally within a short period of starting to make VAT sales. TRA may provide specific timing guidance on EFD acquisition after VAT registration. Making VAT sales without an EFD (after being required to) is a violation of VAT and EFD law.

instruction: Kampuni yangu mama nje ya Tanzania inatoa dhamana (guarantee) kwa mkopo wangu — TRA inaona dhamana hii vipi?
output: Dhamana ya kampuni mama (parent guarantee) kwa mikopo ya kampuni tanzu inaweza kuathiri tathmini ya transfer pricing chini ya kanuni za TRA. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa jinsi ya kuweka thamani ya dhamana na nyaraka zinazohitajika kwa TRA. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Biashara yangu ina mapato ya TZS 40,000,000 kwa mwaka. Ninatumia mfumo wa kodi ya makisio (presumptive tax)?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, biashara yenye mapato ya mwaka kati ya TZS 4,000,000 na TZS 100,000,000 inaweza kutumia mfumo wa kodi ya makisio (presumptive tax). Mapato ya TZS 40,000,000 yanaingia ndani ya kiwango hiki. Kwa mfumo huu, kodi inakokotolewa kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa awali (fixed rate) kulingana na aina ya biashara na eneo — si kwenye faida halisi. Huhitajiki kutunza vitabu kamili vya uhasibu (full accounts). Hata hivyo, kama biashara yako imesajiliwa VAT au una wafanyakazi wengi, unaweza kulazimishwa kutumia mfumo wa kawaida. Angalia na TRA.
answer_en: Yes, a business with annual turnover between TZS 4,000,000 and TZS 100,000,000 may use the presumptive tax system. TZS 40,000,000 in revenue falls within this range. Under this system, tax is calculated at a predetermined rate based on the type of business and location — not on actual profit. You are not required to maintain full accounting records. However, if your business is VAT registered or you have many employees, you may be required to use the normal system. Check with TRA.
question_en: My business has revenue of TZS 40,000,000 per year. Do I use the presumptive tax system?
primary_source_name: TRA — presumptive tax system ITA Cap.332
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to presumptive thresholds

question_sw: Mwajiriwa anayedai fidia ya WCF lazima apitie mahakama — WCF haiwezi kulipa moja kwa moja — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. WCF ina utaratibu wa kudai fidia moja kwa moja BILA mahakama kwa hali nyingi za kawaida za ajali za kazi. Mfanyakazi au mwajiri anaweza kuwasilisha madai kupitia mfumo wa WCF (portal.wcf.go.tz) au ofisi ya WCF moja kwa moja. Mahakama inahitajika tu ikiwa dawa imekataliwa na WCF na mwathiriwa anataka kupinga uamuzi huo. Kwa ajali za kawaida, WCF ina mchakato wa malipo ya moja kwa moja.
question_en: A worker claiming WCF compensation must go through court — WCF cannot pay directly — is this correct?
answer_en: No. WCF has a direct claim procedure WITHOUT court for most ordinary workplace accident cases. A worker or employer can file claims through the WCF system (portal.wcf.go.tz) or WCF office directly. Court is only needed if a claim is rejected by WCF and the claimant wants to challenge that decision. For ordinary accidents, WCF has a direct payment process.

instruction: Wakili wa mahakama ana mauzo ya TZS 80M kwa mwaka — anahitaji VAT?
output: Wataalamu wa kisheria (wakili, mhasibu, daktari) wana hali maalum kwa VAT Tanzania. Wataalamu walioidhinishwa (CPA, wakili, wahandisi) LAZIMA wasajili VAT bila kujali kizingiti cha mauzo. Hii ni mahitaji ya kisheria chini ya VAT Act — si hiari. Sajili kupitia TRA (tra.go.tz) mara tu unapopata leseni yako ya kitaalamu. Ufumbuzi: wasiliana na TRA au mwanasheria wa kodi kujua hali yako halisi kama wakili.

question_sw: Je, mwajiri analazimika kuwa na huduma ya msaada wa kwanza (first aid) kazini?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Waajiri wanalazimika kutoa vifaa vya msaada wa kwanza mahali pa kazi na kuhakikisha kuwa wafanyakazi waliofunzwa msaada wa kwanza wako kazini. Idadi ya mafundi wa msaada wa kwanza inategemea saizi ya mahali pa kazi.
question_en: Is an employer required to have first aid facilities at work?
answer_en: Yes. Employers must provide first aid equipment at the workplace and ensure trained first aiders are available. The number of first aiders required depends on the size of the workplace.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Tanzania inaweka kiwango cha chini cha mtaji wa kampuni (minimum share capital)?
answer_sw: Hapana. Tanzania haina kiwango cha chini cha lazima cha mtaji wa hisa kwa kampuni za kikomo cha dhima. Kampuni inaweza kuanzishwa na mtaji mdogo tu — kwa mfano, hisa moja. Hata hivyo, benki na sekta fulani zinaweza kuwa na mahitaji yao ya mtaji wa chini kwa sababu za udhibiti.
question_en: Does Tanzania set a minimum share capital for companies?
answer_en: No. Tanzania has no mandatory minimum share capital requirement for limited companies. A company can be incorporated with very little capital — for example, one share. However, banks and certain regulated sectors may have their own minimum capital requirements for regulatory purposes.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Biashara yangu haijafika kizingiti cha TZS 11M — je, ninahitaji EFD?
output: Kizingiti cha EFD ni mauzo ya TZS 11,000,000 kwa mwaka au zaidi. Biashara zenye mauzo chini ya TZS 11M inaweza kutumia risiti za kawaida. Hata hivyo, biashara ZOTE zilizosajiliwa VAT lazima zitumie EFD, bila kujali kiwango cha mauzo. Kama umesajiliwa VAT, EFD ni ya lazima. Thibitisha hali yako na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa maelekezo sahihi.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: GN 605A na amri ya mishahara ya 2022 — ipi ilifuta ipi?
output:
GN 605A ILIFUTA amri ya mishahara ya 2022 — si kinyume chake. Hii ni muhimu sana kuelewa:

AMRI YA 2022 = ya zamani, imefutwa kuanzia 1 Januari 2026.
GN 605A = mpya, inayotumika sasa kuanzia 1 Januari 2026.

GN 605A haijafutwa — bado ipo na inafanya kazi. Amri ya 2022 ndiyo iliyofutwa. GN 605A ilichukua mahali pa amri ya 2022. Thibitisha na MLYWF, PKF Eastern Africa, au TanzLII.

question_sw: Manufaa ya WCF yanajumuisha nini kwa mfanyakazi aliyeumia?
answer_sw: Manufaa ya WCF kwa mfanyakazi aliyeumia yanajumuisha: gharama za matibabu (hospitali, dawa, upasuaji), posho ya ulemavu wa muda (wakati wa kupumzika kutokana na majeraha), fidia ya ulemavu wa kudumu, na manufaa ya kifo (kwa familia ikiwa mfanyakazi amefariki). WCF haifuniki hasara za mali.
question_en: What benefits does WCF include for an injured worker?
answer_en: WCF benefits for an injured worker include: medical expenses (hospital, medicine, surgery), temporary disability allowance (during recovery from injury), permanent disability compensation, and death benefits (to family if the worker dies). WCF does not cover property losses.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Mgeni ana biashara ndogo sana (TZS 100,000/mwezi) — GN 487A bado inatumika?
output: Ndiyo — hakuna msamaha wa kiasi cha mapato au ukubwa wa biashara katika GN 487A. Sheria haisemi 'biashara ndogo zinasamehewa' au 'chini ya kiasi fulani ipo salama.' Hata biashara ndogo sana, hata yenye mapato ya TZS 100,000 au machinga mmoja wa barabarani — kama mmiliki ni mgeni na shughuli ipo katika orodha ya 15, GN 487A inatumika kikamilifu. Adhabu ya kiwango cha chini (TZS milioni 10) inazidi mapato ya miaka 100 kwa biashara ndogo hiyo. kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Kampuni mama (parent company) inaweza kudai VAT ya kampuni binti (subsidiary)?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, kila kampuni ni mfanyabiashara tofauti wa VAT — kampuni mama haiwezi kudai input VAT ya kampuni binti na kinyume chake. Hata hivyo, kuna mifumo ya 'VAT group registration' ambapo makampuni yanayohusiana yanaweza kusajiliwa pamoja kwa VAT. Thibitisha upatikanaji wa mfumo huu Tanzania na TRA.
question_en: Can a parent company claim VAT of a subsidiary?
answer_en: Generally, each company is a separate VAT entity — a parent company cannot claim the subsidiary's input VAT and vice versa. However, there are 'VAT group registration' frameworks where related companies can register together for VAT. Verify availability of this framework in Tanzania with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Uhamishaji wa ardhi kati ya kampuni mama na tanzu yake (subsidiary) una ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo kwa ujumla. Uhamishaji wa ardhi kati ya kampuni mbili za Tanzania — hata kama ni kampuni mama na tanzu — una ushuru wa stempu wa asilimia 1. Misamaha maalum ya kikundi cha kampuni (group relief) inaweza kutumika katika hali fulani, lakini si moja kwa moja. Omba ushauri wa mwanasheria wa kodi au TRA kabla ya mauzo ya ndani ya kikundi.
question_en: Does a land transfer between a parent company and its subsidiary attract stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes generally. A land transfer between two Tanzania companies — even parent and subsidiary — attracts 1% stamp duty. Specific group relief exemptions may apply in certain circumstances but are not automatic. Seek advice from a tax lawyer or TRA before intra-group transfers.

question_sw: Mwanasheria alisema kuna VAT ya asilimia 5 kwa bidhaa za msingi (basic commodities). Je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Hakuna kiwango cha VAT cha asilimia 5 kwa 'bidhaa za msingi' au bidhaa nyingine zozote Tanzania Bara. Kiwango cha VAT ni asilimia 18 tu — kiwango kimoja cha kawaida. Bidhaa za msingi fulani (kama vile baadhi ya nafaka) zinaweza kuwa zero-rated (asilimia 0) au exempt — si asilimia 5. Mshauri yeyote anayesema asilimia 5 ana kosa.
question_en: A lawyer said there is 5% VAT on basic commodities. Is that true?
answer_en: No. There is no 5% VAT rate for 'basic commodities' or any other goods on Mainland Tanzania. The VAT rate is 18% only — one standard rate. Some basic commodities (such as certain grains) may be zero-rated (0%) or exempt — not 5%. Any adviser claiming 5% is incorrect.

question_sw: Wakati kampuni mpya inaandikishwa, Hati ya Kuasisi Ushirika (Memorandum of Association) inahitaji kodi ya stempu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Memorandum of Association ya kampuni inahitaji kodi ya stempu ya TZS 10,000 kulingana na jedwali la Sheria ya Kodi ya Stempu. Hati hii lazima ipigwe stempu wakati wa usajili wa kampuni au kabla ya hapo. Kwa ushirika (partnership), ada ya kodi ya stempu inategemea mtaji wa ushirika: TZS 1,000 kama mtaji hauzidi TZS 10,000; TZS 5,000 kama mtaji kati ya TZS 100,000 na TZS 1,000,000; na TZS 10,000 katika hali nyingine.
answer_en: Yes. A company's Memorandum of Association requires stamp duty of TZS 10,000 under the schedule of the Stamp Duty Act. This document must be stamped at the time of company registration or earlier. For a partnership deed, the stamp duty depends on the partnership capital: TZS 1,000 if capital does not exceed TZS 10,000; TZS 5,000 if capital is between TZS 100,000 and TZS 1,000,000; and TZS 10,000 in other cases.
question_en: When a new company is registered, does the Memorandum of Association require stamp duty?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — MoA and partnership schedule

question_sw: Asha ni mfanyabiashara wa mpaka huko Tunduma — ana duka la vipande vya magari, si raia. Nini hatari yake?
answer_sw: Asha yuko katika hatari kubwa ya kisheria. Biashara ya vipande vya magari ni moja ya makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania chini ya GN 487A. Kama Asha si raia wa Tanzania na anaendesha duka hilo kama biashara yake, anakiuka amri hii. Adhabu ni: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 jela, na kufutwa kwa viza na kurushwa nchini kwake. Asha anahitaji ushauri wa wakili wa haraka na kufikiria kuhamisha biashara kwa raia wa Tanzania, au kuacha kabisa.
question_en: Asha is a cross-border trader at Tunduma — she has a spare parts shop and is not a citizen. What is her risk?
answer_en: Asha is at serious legal risk. Spare parts trade is one of the 15 categories prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens under GN 487A. If Asha is not a Tanzanian citizen and operates that shop as her own business, she is violating this Order. Penalties are: a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation with deportation. Asha urgently needs legal advice and should consider transferring the business to a Tanzanian citizen, or closing it entirely.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Faini ya Mtanzania na faini ya mgeni ni sawa? Kusema kweli.
answer_sw: Hapana, si sawa. Mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A: faini ya angalau TZS 10,000,000 na hadi miezi 6 gerezani na kufutwa kwa visa. Mtanzania anayenusuru ukiukaji: faini ya TZS 5,000,000 AU miezi 3 gerezani. Adhabu ya mgeni ni kali zaidi.
question_en: Is the fine for a Tanzanian and a non-citizen the same? Honestly.
answer_en: No, they are not the same. Non-citizen violating GN 487A: minimum TZS 10,000,000 fine plus up to 6 months imprisonment plus visa revocation. Tanzanian facilitating a violation: TZS 5,000,000 fine OR 3 months imprisonment. The non-citizen's penalty is harsher.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Maana ya SDL ni "Skills Delivery Levy" — je, ni hivyo?
answer_sw: Hapana. Jina sahihi ni Skills Development Levy — si "Skills Delivery Levy". Kwa Kiswahili: Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi. Neno muhimu ni "Development" (Kukuza) — kodi hii inafadhili ukuzaji wa ujuzi wa wafanyakazi. Kiwango: asilimia 3.5, mwajiri peke yake, wafanyakazi 10+, siku 7 ya mwezi unaofuata.
question_en: SDL means "Skills Delivery Levy" — is that right?
answer_en: No. The correct name is Skills Development Levy — not "Skills Delivery Levy". In Swahili: Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi. The key word is "Development" (Kukuza) — this levy funds skills development for workers. Rate: 3.5%, employer only, 10+ employees, due 7th of following month.

question_sw: TIN ya TRA inagharimu kiasi gani na inachukua muda gani kupata?
answer_sw: TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) ya TRA Tanzania inapatikana BURE — hakuna ada. Unaweza kuomba mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa TRA (tra.go.tz) au ofisini. Kawaida inachukua siku 1-3 za kazi. Unahitaji: hati ya utambulisho (NIDA/passport), ushahidi wa anwani, na kwa kampuni, hati za BRELA. TIN inahitajika kwa kila mwanahisa na mkurugenzi wa kampuni pia.
question_en: How much does a TRA TIN cost and how long does it take to obtain?
answer_en: A TRA TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) in Tanzania is FREE — no fee. You can apply online through the TRA system (tra.go.tz) or in person. It typically takes 1-3 working days. You need: ID document (NIDA/passport), proof of address, and for a company, BRELA documents. A TIN is also required for each shareholder and director of the company.

question_sw: Biashara yenye TIN tu lakini bila leseni ya LGA inaweza kufanya biashara halali Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. TIN inaonyesha usajili wa kodi — haiipi ruhusa ya kufanya biashara. Leseni ya biashara ya LGA ndiyo inayokuruhusu kisheria kufungua na kuendesha biashara katika eneo fulani. Biashara yenye TIN tu bado inaweza kukutana na ukaguzi wa LGA na kutozwa faini ya kufanya biashara bila leseni. TIN na leseni ya LGA ni mahitaji tofauti yanayofanya kazi pamoja.
question_en: Can a business with only a TIN but no LGA licence operate legally in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. A TIN shows tax registration — it does not grant permission to operate a business. The LGA business licence is what legally authorises you to open and run a business in a specific area. A business with only a TIN can still face LGA inspection and be fined for operating without a licence. TIN and LGA licence are separate requirements that work together.

instruction: Ninafanya biashara ya cryptocurrency kama chanzo changu kikuu cha mapato — hii inaathiriwa na kodi gani Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Utaratibu wa kodi wa mapato ya biashara ya cryptocurrency Tanzania bado unajengwa — BoT na TRA ndiyo mamlaka zinazohusika. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz, na BoT kupitia bot.go.tz.

instruction: Nina mfanyakazi mmoja tu — nilipe SDL au WCF au vyote viwili?
output: SDL = asilimia 3.5 → TRA → waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. WCF = asilimia 0.5 → Mamlaka ya WCF → WAAJIRI WOTE (hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi 1). Tofauti kubwa: WCF haina kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi — mwajiri yeyote analipa. Kwa mfanyakazi MMOJA: SDL: HAPANA — unahi wafanyakazi 10+ kwa SDL. WCF: NDIYO — hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi 1 lazima asajili na kulipa WCF (0.5%). Thibitisha usajili wako wa WCF kupitia portal.wcf.go.tz.

question_sw: Ushirika (partnership) unalipa kodi ya mapato ya kampuni?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ushirika (partnership) haulipi kodi ya mapato ya kampuni kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato Tanzania. Badala yake, kila mshirika analipa kodi binafsi kwenye sehemu yake ya faida ya ushirika kulingana na uwiano wa ugawaji uliokubaliwa (profit sharing ratio). Faida ya mshirika inajumuishwa kwenye mapato yake ya mtu binafsi na inatozwa kwa kiwango cha kodi ya mtu binafsi (0%–30%). Ushirika unahitaji kuwasilisha return ya habari (information return) TRA ikionyesha jumla ya faida na jinsi ilivyogawanywa kati ya washirika.
answer_en: No. A partnership does not pay corporation tax under Tanzania's Income Tax Act. Instead, each partner pays personal tax on their share of the partnership profit according to the agreed profit sharing ratio. The partner's share is added to their personal income and taxed at individual income tax rates (0%–30%). The partnership must file an information return with TRA showing total profit and how it was distributed among partners.
question_en: Does a partnership pay corporation tax?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — partnership tax treatment

instruction: Nikichanganya mapato ya biashara mbili (mkahawa na duka) — kizingiti cha VAT pia kinachanganywa?
output: Ndiyo — kama mmiliki mmoja ana biashara mbili au zaidi, mapato yote yanajumuishwa kwa madhumuni ya kizingiti cha VAT. Kwa mfano: mkahawa = TZS 120M/mwaka; duka = TZS 90M/mwaka. Jumla = TZS 210M — umepita kizingiti cha TZS 200M. Hata kama kila biashara peke yake haijafikia kizingiti, mmiliki mmoja anayefikia TZS 200M kwa jumla lazima asajili VAT. Hata hivyo, kama kila biashara ina TIN tofauti na inafanya kazi kwa uhuru kabisa (tofauti kisheria) — hali inaweza kutofautiana. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa hali yako maalum.

question_sw: SDL inahesabiwa juu ya mishahara halisi (net) au mishahara kabla ya kodi (gross)?
answer_sw: SDL inahesabiwa juu ya mishahara ya jumla (gross payroll) — si mishahara ya net (baada ya PAYE). Hii inamaanisha unajumuisha mshahara wote kabla ya kukata kodi au michango mingine.
question_en: Is SDL calculated on net salaries or gross salaries (before tax)?
answer_en: SDL is calculated on gross payroll — not net salaries (after PAYE). This means you include total salaries before any tax deductions or other contributions.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Ninajua viwango vya PAYE lakini ninahitaji hesabu ya sahihi ya PAYE ya mshahara wa TZS 900,000 — unaweza kunisaidia?
answer_sw: Ninajua viwango vya PAYE Tanzania vizuri (bendi 1: 0%; bendi 2: 8%; bendi 3: 20%; bendi 4: 25%; bendi 5: 30%; Kizingiti cha mapato yasiyotozwa kodi: TZS 3,240,000/mwaka (TZS 270,000/mwezi kwa 0% — imejengwa ndani ya Bendi 1, hakuna punguzo tofauti la kila mwezi). lakini mahesabu ya mshahara mahususi yako nje ya mipaka yangu. Thibitisha na TRA IDRAS (taidras.tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Kwa mshahara wa TZS 900,000, bendi 1, 2, 3, na sehemu ya bendi 4 zitatumika — TRA IDRAS itahesabu sahihi.
question_en: I know the PAYE rates but I need an accurate calculation for a salary of TZS 900,000 — can you help?
answer_en: I know Tanzania's PAYE rates well (band 1: 0%; band 2: 8%; band 3: 20%; band 4: 25%; band 5: 30%; Annual tax-free threshold: TZS 3,240,000/year (TZS 270,000/month at 0% — built into Band 1, no separate monthly relief). but specific salary calculations are outside my coverage. Verify with TRA IDRAS (taidras.tra.go.tz) or a qualified tax adviser. For a TZS 900,000 salary, bands 1, 2, 3, and part of band 4 will apply — TRA IDRAS will calculate accurately.

question_sw: BRELA inaweza kusaidia kuthibitisha kampuni ya Tanzania kwa mbia wa kigeni — mchakato gani?
answer_sw: Kuthibitisha kampuni kwa mbia wa kigeni, BRELA inaweza kutoa: Certificate of Compliance (Form 23), nakala iliyothibitishwa ya Cheti cha Uanzishwaji, na matokeo ya utafutaji wa rejesta. Hati hizi zinaweza kuhitaji kuthibitishwa na apostille au ushauri wa kisheria kwa nchi husika. Angalia mahitaji maalum ya nchi ya mbia wako.
question_en: How can BRELA help verify a Tanzania company for a foreign partner — what is the process?
answer_en: To verify a company for a foreign partner, BRELA can provide: a Certificate of Compliance (Form 23), a certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation, and register search results. These documents may need apostille certification or legal notarisation for the relevant country. Check the specific requirements of your partner's country.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mgeni ana duka la vifaa vya ujenzi (hardware) — je, GN 487A inasimamia?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Duka la vifaa vya ujenzi ni biashara ya rejareja — na biashara ya rejareja imekatazwa wazi kwa raia wa kigeni. Mgeni hawezi kumiliki au kuendesha duka la hardware Tanzania Bara. Anaweza kufanya kazi kama mwajiriwa wa duka kama ana kibali cha kazi, lakini hawezi kuwa mmiliki.
question_en: A non-citizen has a hardware store — does GN 487A apply?
answer_en: Yes. A hardware store is retail trade — and retail trade is explicitly prohibited for non-citizens. A non-citizen cannot own or operate a hardware store in Mainland Tanzania. They may work as an employee in the store if they have a work permit, but they cannot be the owner.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Biashara ya usafirishaji (bodaboda, daladala) inahitaji usajili wowote mbali na leseni ya udereva Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara ya usafirishaji Tanzania inahitaji: (1) leseni ya udereva binafsi, (2) usajili wa gari (SUMATRA/TANROADS), (3) TIN ya TRA kwa biashara, (4) leseni ya biashara ya LGA ikiwa una kikosi cha magari, (5) NSSF ikiwa una madereva waliofanywa waajiriwa (si wakusudia wa kujitegemea). Bodaboda anayefanya kazi kwa kujitegemea ana mahitaji tofauti kidogo na kampuni ya bodaboda iliyosajiliwa.
question_en: Does a transport business (bodaboda, daladala) need any registration beyond a driving licence in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. A Tanzania transport business needs: (1) personal driving licence, (2) vehicle registration (SUMATRA/TANROADS), (3) TRA TIN for the business, (4) LGA business licence if running a fleet, (5) NSSF if drivers are formal employees (not independent contractors). A self-employed bodaboda rider has slightly different requirements from a registered bodaboda company.

instruction: Annual return ya BRELA imelipwa — faini ya kuchelewa ni ngapi kwa mwezi?
output: Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi au sehemu ya mwezi — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Ada ya kawaida ya kuwasilisha inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz.

instruction: Mbia wangu wa serikali anasema kiwango cha withholding ya huduma ni tofauti na kwa bidhaa — hii ni kweli?
output: Ndiyo, hii ni kweli. Kiwango cha withholding kwa huduma ni tofauti na kile cha bidhaa. Kwa hesabu sahihi ya kiasi kinachokatwa kwenye invoice yako ya huduma maalum, thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) au wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Kampuni inapata hasara ya TZS 20,000,000 mwaka huu. Je, hasara hiyo inaweza kubebwa mbele na kupunguza kodi ya miaka ijayo?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Hasara ya biashara inayothibitishwa na TRA inaweza kubebwa mbele na kutumiwa kupunguza mapato yanayotozwa kodi ya miaka ijayo. Hata hivyo, kuna kikomo cha muda: hasara inaweza kubebwa mbele kwa kipindi fulani tu kulingana na Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato — thibitisha muda halisi wa sasa na TRA au mshauri wa kodi kwa sababu kanuni hii inapitiwa mara kwa mara. Tangu Finance Act 2024: baada ya miaka 4 mfululizo ya hasara, asilimia 60 tu ya mapato ya mwaka wa 5 inaweza kutumika kupunguza hasara zilizobebwa mbele (ilipungua kutoka asilimia 70). Hasara haiwezi kubebwa nyuma (carry back) nchini Tanzania.
answer_en: Yes. A business loss confirmed by TRA can be carried forward and used to reduce taxable income in future years. However, there is a time limit: losses can only be carried forward for a specific period under the Income Tax Act — confirm the current period with TRA or a tax consultant as this rule is reviewed periodically. Since Finance Act 2024: after 4 consecutive loss years, only 60% of year 5 income can be offset against carried forward losses (reduced from 70%). Losses cannot be carried back in Tanzania.
question_en: A company incurs a loss of TZS 20,000,000 this year. Can that loss be carried forward to reduce tax in future years?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — loss carry forward

instruction: OSHA inashughulikia pia sekta ya kilimo au ni viwanda tu?
output: OSHA inashughulikia MAHALI POTE PA KAZI Tanzania Bara — ikiwa ni pamoja na sekta ya kilimo, viwanda, ofisi, maduka, hospitali, na kadhalika. Hakuna sekta iliyosamehewa na OSHA moja kwa moja. Hata shamba la kilimo lenye wafanyakazi wa kulipwa lina wajibu wa msingi wa OSHA. Hata hivyo, mahitaji yanaweza kutofautiana kulingana na sekta na hatari yake: Sekta za hatari zaidi (ujenzi, migodi, kemikali) zina mahitaji ya ziada. Sekta za hatari ndogo (ofisi) zina mahitaji ya msingi. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz kwa mahitaji maalum ya sekta yako.

question_sw: EFD machine ni nini na inafanya kazi gani?
answer_sw: EFD ni mashine ya Electronic Fiscal Device — chombo cha kielektroniki kilichoidhinishwa na TRA kinachotumika kutoa risiti za kielektroniki (fiscal receipts) kwa wateja. Mashine hii imeunganishwa na mfumo wa TRA moja kwa moja, na inasajili kila muamala wa biashara na kutuma taarifa kwa TRA. Madhumuni yake ni kuhakikisha ukweli wa mauzo na kukusanya VAT kwa usahihi. Biashara zote zilizosajiliwa VAT zinahitajika kuwa na EFD. Thibitisha na TRA kwa sababu kanuni za EFD zinaweza kusasishwa.
question_en: What is an EFD machine and what does it do?
answer_en: EFD stands for Electronic Fiscal Device — a TRA-approved electronic device used to issue fiscal receipts to customers. The machine is directly connected to TRA's system and records every business transaction, transmitting data to TRA automatically. Its purpose is to ensure sales accuracy and correct VAT collection. All VAT-registered businesses are required to have an EFD.

question_sw: Kampuni iliyopata hasara miaka miwili mfululizo inaweza kubeba hasara hiyo mbele bila kikomo chochote — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kamili. Hasara zinaweza kubebwa mbele (loss carry-forward) Tanzania, lakini Finance Act 2024 iliongeza kikwazo: baada ya miaka MINNE mfululizo ya hasara, asilimia 60 tu ya faida ya mwaka wa tano inaweza kutumika kulipa hasara zilizobebwa. Kwa kampuni iliyopata hasara miaka miwili tu, bado hakuna kikwazo — lakini anzisha kumbukumbu nzuri za hesabu kwa sababu kikwazo kinaingia baada ya mwaka wa nne.
question_en: A company that made losses for two consecutive years can carry those losses forward without any limit — is this true?
answer_en: Not entirely true. Losses can be carried forward in Tanzania, but Finance Act 2024 added a restriction: after FOUR consecutive loss years, only 60% of year-five profit can be used to offset carried-forward losses. For a company that has only lost for two years, there is still no restriction — but keep good accounting records because the restriction kicks in after year four.

question_sw: Je, kila biashara lazima iwe na EFD, au ni kwa wale walilosajiliwa VAT tu?
answer_sw: EFD inahitajika hasa kwa biashara zilizosajiliwa VAT. Kama umesajiliwa VAT na TRA, ni lazima uwe na EFD iliyoidhinishwa na uitumie kutoa fiscal receipt kwa kila muamala wa mauzo. Biashara ndogo ambazo bado hazijafika kizingiti cha VAT na hazijasajiliwa kwa hiari hazihitajiki na EFD kwa mujibu wa sheria, ingawa TRA inaweza kutoa mwongozo tofauti. Thibitisha na TRA kama biashara yako inahitaji EFD.
question_en: Does every business need an EFD, or only VAT-registered businesses?
answer_en: EFD is specifically required for VAT-registered businesses. If you are registered for VAT with TRA, you must have a TRA-approved EFD and use it to issue a fiscal receipt for every sales transaction. Small businesses that have not yet reached the VAT threshold and are not voluntarily registered are not legally required to have an EFD, though TRA may provide different guidance. Confirm with TRA whether your business requires an EFD.

question_sw: Matangazo ya mtandaoni (online ads) yanayolipwa na kampuni ya Tanzania — VAT inatumika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni ya Tanzania inayolipa kwa huduma za matangazo ya mtandaoni (kama Google Ads, Meta Ads) inapaswa kuzingatia VAT au withholding tax inayohusika. Kwa huduma kutoka watoa wa nje, withholding tax ya 6% (services) inaweza kutumika kuanzia 1 Julai 2025. Thibitisha muundo maalum na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: Online advertising payments by a Tanzanian company — does VAT apply?
answer_en: Yes. A Tanzanian company paying for online advertising services (like Google Ads, Meta Ads) should consider applicable VAT or withholding tax. For services from foreign providers, 6% withholding tax (services) may apply from 1 July 2025. Confirm specific structure with a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

instruction: Naweza kusajili NGO au taasisi ya elimu BRELA?
output: NGO na taasisi za elimu hazisajiliwa chini ya Companies Act kupitia BRELA kwa njia ya kawaida — NGO zinasajiliwa chini ya Societies Act (polisi) au Trustees' Incorporation Act (AG's office). BRELA inashughulikia aina TATU peke yake: BRELA inasajili aina TATU za biashara: 1. Biashara ya jina (sole trader/business name) 2. Ubia (partnership) 3. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company). Hakuna aina nyingine ya nne au ya tano chini ya Companies Act Tanzania. Wasiliana na Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi wa Jamii kwa usajili wa NGO.

question_sw: GN 487A inakataza shughuli ngapi kwa raia wa kigeni, na zipi kuu miongoni mwake?
answer_sw: GN 487A inakataza jumla ya shughuli 15 kwa raia wa kigeni. Miongoni mwa zilizotajwa wazi ni: biashara ya jumla (wholesale) na rejareja (retail), uhamishaji wa pesa wa simu (mobile money transfers), ukarabati wa simu (phone repair), na salon za nywele. Kuna shughuli nyingine 11 zilizoorodheshwa katika amri kamili.
question_en: How many activities does GN 487A prohibit for non-citizens, and what are the main ones?
answer_en: GN 487A prohibits a total of 15 business activities for non-citizens. Among those explicitly mentioned are: wholesale and retail trade, mobile money transfers, phone repair, and hair salons. There are 11 other activities listed in the full order.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Tangu GN 487A ilitangazwa, je, kuna mabadiliko yoyote au marekebisho?
answer_sw: Kulingana na taarifa za hadi Juni 2026, hakuna marekebisho rasmi ya GN 487A yaliyotangazwa kwenye Gazeti la Serikali. Amri ilibaki kama ilivyosajiliwa mwaka 2025. Operesheni ya utekelezaji ilifanyika (Septemba-Oktoba 2025) na sheria bado inafanya kazi. Inashauriwa daima kuthibitisha hali ya sasa ya GN 487A kwenye TanzLII.org au kupitia wakili wa biashara wa Tanzania, kwa sababu sheria za Tanzania zinaweza kubadilishwa au kufutwa wakati wowote kupitia Gazette.
question_en: Since GN 487A was published, are there any changes or amendments?
answer_en: According to information available up to June 2026, no official amendments to GN 487A have been published in the Government Gazette. The Order remained as gazetted in 2025. The enforcement exercise took place (September-October 2025) and the law continues to be in force. It is always advisable to verify the current status of GN 487A at TanzLII.org or through a Tanzanian business lawyer, as Tanzanian laws can be amended or revoked at any time through the Gazette.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Naweza kuripoti mauzo kidogo zaidi kwa TRA ili nisivuke kizingiti cha VAT?
answer_sw: Hapana — hii ni udanganyifu wa kodi (tax evasion) ambao ni kosa la jinai Tanzania. TRA inaweza kupata taarifa za malipo kutoka mabenki, mobile money operators, na wanunuzi wako. Ukigunduliwa, adhabu ni kubwa: kulipa VAT yote iliyopaswa pamoja na riba, faini nzito, na uwezekano wa mashtaka ya jinai. Ripoti mauzo halisi daima. Wasiliana na TRA kwenye tra.go.tz.
question_en: Can I report lower sales to TRA to avoid crossing the VAT threshold?
answer_en: No — this is tax evasion, which is a criminal offence in Tanzania. TRA can obtain payment records from banks, mobile money operators, and your buyers. If discovered: repaying all unpaid VAT plus interest, heavy fines, and potential criminal prosecution. Always report your actual sales. Contact TRA at tra.go.tz.
primary_source_name: Tanzania Revenue Authority — Value Added Tax

question_sw: GN 487A ni nini? Imeniathiri vipi kama mfanyabiashara Tanzania?
answer_sw: GN 487A ni 'Government Notice No. 487A' — Amri ya Serikali ya Tanzania inayoitwa 'Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order'. Ilitangazwa tarehe 28 Julai 2025 na kuanza kutumika siku hiyo hiyo. Inazuia raia wa kigeni kufanya shughuli za biashara katika makundi 15 maalum ambayo yamehifadhiwa kwa raia wa Tanzania peke yao. Kama wewe ni raia wa Tanzania, GN 487A inakupa nafasi ya kuchukua shughuli hizi. Kama wewe ni raia wa kigeni, lazima uache au utaadhibiwa. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji au wakili.
question_en: What is GN 487A? How does it affect me as a business person in Tanzania?
answer_en: GN 487A is 'Government Notice No. 487A' — the Tanzanian government order titled 'Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order'. It was gazetted on 28 July 2025 and took effect the same day. It prohibits non-citizens from conducting business activities in 15 specified categories reserved exclusively for Tanzanian citizens. If you are a Tanzanian citizen, GN 487A gives you the opportunity to take over these activities. If you are a non-citizen, you must cease or face penalties. Confirm with the Immigration Services Department or a lawyer.
next_review_trigger: When GN 487A is amended or enforcement rules are updated

question_sw: Adhabu gani inatumika kwa biashara inayofanya kazi bila leseni ya serikali ya mtaa?
answer_sw: Kufanya biashara bila leseni ya LGA ni kosa la kisheria nchini Tanzania. Adhabu zinaweza kujumuisha: faini za pesa, kufungwa kwa biashara hadi leseni ipatikane, na hata mashtaka ya jinai dhidi ya mmiliki wa biashara. Mwanzo kawaida ni onyo na faini la awali, lakini ufuatiliaji unaweza kusababisha kufungwa kwa biashara. Halmashauri nyingi zina maafisa wa ukaguzi wanaosafiri mara kwa mara kuangalia leseni. Usijaribu kufanya biashara bila leseni — gharama ya leseni ni ndogo ukilinganisha na adhabu.
answer_en: Operating a business without an LGA licence is a criminal offence in Tanzania. Penalties may include: monetary fines, closure of the business until a licence is obtained, and even criminal prosecution of the business owner. The initial response is typically a warning and an initial fine, but continued non-compliance can lead to business closure. Many councils have inspection officers who patrol regularly to check licences. Do not attempt to operate without a licence — the licence cost is small compared to the penalties.
question_en: What penalty applies to a business operating without a local government licence?

question_sw: Je, GN 487A ni sawa na visa restriction au kikwazo cha uingiaji nchini?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A si kikwazo cha uingiaji nchini (visa restriction). Ni amri ya LESENI ZA BIASHARA inayozuia watu wasio raia kufanya biashara katika sekta 15 zilizoorodheshwa. Mgeni anaweza kuingia Tanzania kwa viza ya kawaida ya utalii au biashara — GN 487A haitazuia uingiaji wake. Lakini akifanya biashara iliyozuiliwa (kama kufungua duka la rejareja au saluni) akiwa ndani ya Tanzania, atapata adhabu ya faini ya TZS milioni 10 au zaidi, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza yake.
question_en: Is GN 487A the same as a visa restriction or entry ban?
answer_en: No. GN 487A is not an entry ban or visa restriction. It is a BUSINESS LICENSING ORDER that prohibits non-citizens from operating businesses in 15 listed sectors. A foreigner can still enter Tanzania on a normal tourist or business visa — GN 487A does not block entry. However, if they operate a prohibited business (such as opening a retail shop or salon) while inside Tanzania, they face a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Je, biashara inayouza nje ya nchi (export) inahitaji EFD Tanzania?
output: Biashara ya usafirishaji nje ya nchi (exporter) inayofanya kazi Tanzania inahitaji kuzingatia: (1) EFD kwa mauzo ya NDANI ya Tanzania — ndiyo inahitajika; (2) Mauzo ya nje ya nchi (exports) kwa kawaida yana VAT ya 0% (zero-rated) — lakini bado yanahitaji nyaraka za mauzo na rekodi sahihi; (3) Input VAT inayolipwa kwa malighafi ya bidhaa za kuuza nje inaweza kudaiwa kwa refund. EFD inasaidia kurekodi muamala wote — hata wa nje ya nchi kwa madhumuni ya rekodi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kuhusu wajibu wako maalum wa EFD na VAT ya exports.

question_sw: Kampuni ya kigeni (foreign company) inaweza kusajiliwa Tanzania — je, mchakato ni gani?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni ya kigeni inaweza kusajiliwa Tanzania kama tawi (branch). Mchakato unajumuisha: kuwasilisha nyaraka za kampuni mama (Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association), kuwasilisha maombi ya BRELA, kulipa ada ya USD 750 kwa usajili wa hati zilizothibitishwa na USD 220 kwa ufunguzi wa faili (thibitisha bei za sasa kwenye brela.go.tz), na kupata Cheti cha Usajili wa Kampuni ya Kigeni. Pia inahitajika kupata hati za TRA, BRELA business permit, na leseni nyingine.
question_en: Can a foreign company register in Tanzania — what is the process?
answer_en: Yes. A foreign company can register in Tanzania as a branch. The process includes: submitting parent company documents (Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles), filing BRELA application, paying a fee of USD 750 (certified copy registration) plus USD 220 (document filing) — verify current fees at brela.go.tz, and receiving a Foreign Company Registration Certificate. TRA registration, BRELA business permit, and other licences are also required.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: BRELA fee or Companies Act update

question_sw: Kiwango cha usajili wa OSHA ni wafanyakazi 5 au zaidi — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango sahihi cha usajili wa OSHA ni wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi — si 5. Kiwango cha wafanyakazi 5 si cha kisheria na hakipo katika Sheria ya OSHA ya 2003. Biashara zinazopata wafanyakazi 10 ndizo zinazolazimika kusajiliwa.
question_en: The OSHA registration threshold is 5 or more employees — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The correct OSHA registration threshold is 10 or more employees — not 5. A threshold of 5 is not statutory and does not appear in the OSHA Act 2003. Businesses reaching 10 employees are the ones required to register.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Ninafanya kazi nje ya nchi (UK) na kupata mshahara hapo — lazima nilipe PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: PAYE ya mapato ya watu wanaoishi au kufanya kazi nje ya Tanzania ni eneo ngumu la sheria ya mapato ya kimataifa — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Suala hili linahusisha hali ya makazi ya kodi (tax residency), mikataba ya kuzuia kodi mara mbili, na sheria ya ndani ya Tanzania. Muona mhesabu wa kodi wa kimataifa aliyehitimu.
question_en: I work abroad (UK) and earn a salary there — must I pay PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE on income for people living or working outside Tanzania is a complex area of international income tax law — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. This issue involves tax residency status, double taxation treaties, and Tanzania's domestic law. Consult a qualified international tax accountant.
next_review_trigger: Income Tax Act changes or treaty updates

question_sw: Je, kununua kutoka msambazaji asiyesajiliwa VAT kunaathiri haki yangu ya kudai input VAT?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kununua kutoka msambazaji asiyesajiliwa VAT kunamaanisha hakuna VAT ya kisheria iliyotozwa kwenye ununuzi huo — hivyo hakuna input VAT ya kudai. Hata kama bei ya msambazaji huyo ni ya juu, hutapata input VAT credit. Kwa madhumuni ya VAT, kununua kutoka wasambazaji waliosajilistwaa VAT ni muhimu.
question_en: Does buying from a non-VAT-registered supplier affect my right to claim input VAT?
answer_en: Yes. Buying from a non-VAT-registered supplier means no legitimate VAT was charged on that purchase — so there is no input VAT to claim. Even if that supplier charges a higher price, you will not get an input VAT credit. For VAT purposes, buying from VAT-registered suppliers is important.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Je, kampuni yenye mfuko wa pensheni wake inalazimika pia kulipa NSSF?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — kwa ujumla, NSSF ni wajibu wa lazima bila kujali kama kampuni ina mfuko wa pensheni wa ndani (occupational pension fund). NSSF na mifuko ya pensheni ya biashara ni mifumo tofauti. Hata hivyo, kwa kampuni zenye mifuko iliyoidhinishwa na Social Security Regulatory Authority (SSRA), mazingira ya kutolipa NSSF na badala yake kulipa kwenye mfuko wa pensheni ulioathirishwa yanawezekana — wasiliana na SSRA kwa mwongozo.
question_en: Must a company with its own pension fund also pay NSSF?
answer_en: Yes — in general, NSSF is a mandatory obligation regardless of whether the company has an internal occupational pension fund. NSSF and occupational pension schemes are separate systems. However, for companies with funds approved by the Social Security Regulatory Authority (SSRA), exemption arrangements where contributions go to the approved fund instead of NSSF may be possible — contact SSRA for guidance.

question_sw: Kiwango cha mchango wa WCF ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha mchango wa WCF ni asilimia 0.5 ya mshahara wote wa wafanyakazi (gross emoluments). Mchango huu unalipwa na MWAJIRI peke yake — mfanyakazi hakatiwi chochote. Mwajiri analipa asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara yote.
question_en: What is the WCF contribution rate?
answer_en: The WCF contribution rate is 0.5% of total employee wages (gross emoluments). This contribution is paid by the EMPLOYER only — the employee has nothing deducted. The employer pays 0.5% of total payroll.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Muda wa kutuma pingamizi ni miezi 3 — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Muda wa kutuma pingamizi kwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA ni siku 30 — si miezi 3. Siku 30 zinahesabika kutoka tarehe ya kupokea tathmini ya kodi. Miezi 3 ni muda tofauti unaohusiana na uamuzi wa Kamishna (ambao ni miezi 6), si muda wa kuwasilisha pingamizi.
question_en: The objection filing period is 3 months — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The objection filing period with the TRA Commissioner General is 30 DAYS — not 3 months. The 30 days are counted from the date of receiving the tax assessment. Three months is a different period related to the Commissioner's decision timeframe (which is actually 6 months), not the filing deadline.

question_sw: Biashara ya mtu mmoja (sole proprietorship) inahitaji akaunti ya benki tofauti na akaunti yake binafsi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kisheria, haijawekwa wazi kwamba biashara ya mtu mmoja lazima iwe na akaunti tofauti ya benki ya biashara. Hata hivyo, vitendo vya kibiashara na kodi vinahitaji sana: (1) TRA inaweza kuuliza rekodi za fedha za biashara — kuchanganya na akaunti binafsi kunafanya hivi vigumu, (2) benki nyingi zinahitaji akaunti ya biashara kwa mikopo ya biashara, (3) wasambazaji na wateja wa biashara mara nyingi wanapendelea kulipa akaunti ya biashara rasmi.
question_en: Does a sole proprietorship in Tanzania need a separate bank account from their personal account?
answer_en: Legally, it is not explicitly required that a sole proprietorship have a separate business bank account. However, business and tax practice strongly requires: (1) TRA can request business financial records — mixing with personal account makes this very difficult, (2) most banks require a business account for business loans, (3) suppliers and business customers often prefer to pay a formal business account.

question_sw: Mtu anasema: 'GN 487A inalenga Wachina peke yake, ilitangazwa 2024, na adhabu ni TZS 500,000.' Sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana — kila sehemu ni kosa. GN 487A: (1) inatumika kwa raia WOTE wa kigeni — si Wachina peke yake; (2) ilitangazwa 28 Julai 2025 — si 2024; (3) faini ya chini ni TZS 10,000,000 — si TZS 500,000. Habari hizi tatu ni potofu kabisa.
question_en: Someone says: 'GN 487A targets only Chinese, was announced in 2024, and the fine is TZS 500,000.' Correct?
answer_en: No — every part is wrong. GN 487A: (1) applies to ALL non-citizens — not only Chinese people; (2) was announced 28 July 2025 — not 2024; (3) the minimum fine is TZS 10,000,000 — not TZS 500,000. All three pieces of information are completely false.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Je, serikali na taasisi zake zinastahili VAT Tanzania?
answer_sw: Serikali na taasisi zake zinaweza kuwa wasajiliwa wa VAT kama zinafanya shughuli za kiuchumi. Pia zinaweza kuwa wakala wa zuio ya VAT. Thibitisha hali halisi ya shughuli za taasisi husika na TRA.
question_en: Are government entities and institutions subject to VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: Government entities and institutions may be VAT registrants if they carry on economic activities. They may also serve as VAT withholding agents. Confirm the specific situation for the institution concerned with TRA.

instruction: Mpiga picha wa harusi au video studio inayomilikiwa na mgeni — je, GN 487A inasema nini?
output: Upigaji picha na video ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A (tarehe 28 Julai 2025). Hii inajumuisha upigaji picha wa harusi, matukio, studio za picha, utengenezaji wa video, na huduma za video call. Mgeni anayemiliki au kuendesha biashara ya upigaji picha au video anakabiliwa na: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Kampuni yangu imepewa heshima ya kuwa 'qualifying buyer' na muuzaji wetu — je, hiyo ni sahihi kisheria?
output: Hapana — 'qualifying buyer' si cheo kinachopewa na muuzaji. Ni orodha ya TRA iliyotangazwa rasmi. Muuzaji hawezi 'kuamua' mnunuzi wake ni qualifying buyer — ni TRA peke yake inayobainisha. Ikiwa muuzaji wako anakuambia wewe ni qualifying buyer bila uteuzi rasmi wa CG wa TRA — huenda ana makosa au anaongeza usumbufu wa kisheria. Kama una shaka, omba muuzaji wako onyeshe tangazo rasmi la TRA linaloonyesha wewe ni qualifying buyer. Bila tangazo hilo, kampuni yako ya kawaida haifanyi withholding. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: OSHA na WCF ni chombo kimoja cha serikali Tanzania — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. OSHA na WCF ni vyombo TOFAUTI vya serikali: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inasimamia usalama na afya mahali pa kazi — inakagua, inadhibiti, na inasimamia. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ni mfuko wa bima ya ajali za kazi — inalipa fidia kwa wafanyakazi walioumia. Mwajiri analazimika kusajili NA OSHA NA WCF kwa madhumuni tofauti.
question_en: OSHA and WCF are the same government body in Tanzania — is this correct?
answer_en: No. OSHA and WCF are SEPARATE government bodies: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) supervises workplace safety and health — it inspects, regulates, and enforces. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) is a workplace accident insurance fund — it pays compensation to injured workers. An employer must register with BOTH OSHA and WCF for different purposes.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act or WCF Act amendment

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayeacha kazi anapata kodi yake ya PAYE iliyokatwa kwa mwaka yote ikiwa ni refund — je, hii ni haki yake?
answer_sw: Si moja kwa moja. Kodi ya PAYE inayolipwa kupitia mwajiri kwa mwaka huhesabiwa kwa kuzingatia kipato chake chote cha mwaka. Ikiwa mfanyakazi alikatwa PAYE zaidi ya kiasi kinachohitajika (kwa mfano, alikuwa na miezi michache ya kazi tu), anaweza kudai refund kupitia tamko la kodi ya mwaka (TRA). Hata hivyo, kama alikatwa PAYE sahihi, hana haki ya refund kiotomatiki tu kwa sababu ya kuacha kazi.
question_en: An employee who leaves a job gets all their PAYE deducted for the year back as a refund — is this their right?
answer_en: Not automatically. PAYE paid through an employer for the year is calculated against their total annual income. If an employee was over-deducted (for example, they only worked a few months), they can claim a refund through the annual tax return (TRA). However, if the correct PAYE was withheld, they are not automatically entitled to a refund just because they left employment.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or PAYE procedure update

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya NSSF na WCF ni nini?
answer_sw: NSSF (National Social Security Fund) ni hifadhi ya jamii ya muda mrefu — pensheni, faida za matibabu, faida za uzazi. Kiwango: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ni fidia ya mfanyakazi aliyeumia kazini — inahusu majeraha ya mahali pa kazi, ulemavu wa kazi, na kifo kazini. Kiwango: mwajiri peke yake asilimia 0.5 ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Zote mbili ni lazima na zinalipwa kwa mwajiri, lakini zinaenda taasisi tofauti.
question_en: What is the difference between NSSF and WCF?
answer_en: NSSF (National Social Security Fund) is long-term social security — pension, medical benefits, maternity benefits. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) is compensation for work-related injuries — it covers workplace injuries, work-related disability, and death at work. Rate: employer only at 0.5% of gross wage. Both are mandatory and paid by the employer, but go to different institutions.

question_sw: EFD inaweza kusaidia kupambana na wizi wa wafanyakazi (staff theft) kwenye biashara ya rejareja Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa njia fulani. EFD inarekodia kila muamala na inaweza kuonyesha takwimu za mauzo kwa kila kasher au saa. Meneja anaweza kulinganisha mauzo ya EFD na stoo iliyokuwepo ili kutambua tofauti. Hata hivyo, EFD imeundwa kwa madhumuni ya kodi ya TRA — si mfumo wa kudhibiti wizi hasa. Biashara zinazohitaji udhibiti mkali wa ulinzi wa ndani zinapaswa kutumia mifumo ya akaunti ya ndani ya ziada.
question_en: Can an EFD help prevent staff theft in a retail business in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes, to some extent. An EFD records every transaction and can show sales figures per cashier or per hour. A manager can compare EFD sales against stock held to identify discrepancies. However, the EFD is designed for TRA tax purposes — not specifically as a theft control system. Businesses needing strict internal security controls should use additional internal accounting systems.

question_sw: PAYE inacheswa vipi kwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 358,322?
answer_sw: Mshahara ghafi TZS 358,322. Punguza NSSF ya mfanyakazi (10%): TZS 358,322 − TZS 35,832 = TZS 322,490. Kanda za PAYE: TZS 0–270,000 = TZS 0; TZS 270,001–322,490 (TZS 52,490 × 8%) = TZS 4,199. Baada ya punguzo la kibinafsi TZS 26,000, TZS 4,199 ? TZS 26,000 < 0, kwa hiyo PAYE = TZS 0. Thibitisha hesabu na TRA.
question_en: How is PAYE calculated on the GN 605A average minimum wage of TZS 358,322?
answer_en: Gross wage TZS 358,322. Deduct employee NSSF (10%): TZS 358,322 − TZS 35,832 = TZS 322,490. PAYE bands: TZS 0–270,000 = TZS 0; TZS 270,001–322,490 (TZS 52,490 × 8%) = TZS 4,199. After personal relief TZS 26,000, TZS 4,199 ? TZS 26,000 < 0, therefore PAYE = TZS 0. Confirm the calculation with TRA.
next_review_trigger: New wage order or Finance Act rate change

instruction: Je, wizara ya serikali lazima isajiliwe TRA kama withholding agent?
output: Ndiyo. Wizara na taasisi za serikali zinazofanya manunuzi kutoka wasambazaji waliosailiwa VAT lazima ziwe na hadhi ya withholding agent iliyothibitishwa na TRA. Bila usajilishaji huo, hana ruhusa ya kisheria ya kukata VAT ya msambazaji. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa utaratibu sahihi.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: Mgeni ana TIN ya Tanzania — je, TIN inamlinda dhidi ya GN 487A?
output: Hapana — TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) ni nambari ya kodi peke yake — si ruhusa ya kufanya biashara yoyote. TIN inahitajika kulipa kodi, si kuidhinisha aina ya biashara. GN 487A ni sheria tofauti inayozuia aina za shughuli kwa raia wa kigeni — TRA na GN 487A ni mifumo tofauti ya kisheria. Kwa hiyo mgeni mwenye TIN bado anakabiliwa na GN 487A kwa shughuli zote 15 katika orodha. Hata Mtanzania mwenye TIN anahitaji kuzingatia sheria nyingine za biashara — TIN si 'leseni ya biashara yoyote'. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Z-report lazima ipigwe wakati gani — usiku au asubuhi?
answer_sw: Z-report inatolewa MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — kabla EFD haijazimwa kwa usiku. Si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Utaratibu wa kawaida: (1) Funga mauzo ya mwisho wa siku; (2) Toa Z-report; (3) Hakikisha Z-report imepelekwa seva ya TRA; (4) Zima au acha EFD. Kutoa Z-report asubuhi ya siku inayofuata kunaweza kusababisha tatizo la data — muamala wa siku moja unaweza kuonekana kwenye siku nyingine.
question_en: When must the Z-report be generated — evening or morning?
answer_en: The Z-report must be generated at the END OF THE BUSINESS DAY — before powering off the EFD for the night. Not in the morning of the following day. Normal procedure: (1) Complete the last sale of the day; (2) Generate Z-report; (3) Confirm Z-report has been transmitted to TRA server; (4) Shut down or leave EFD. Generating a Z-report in the morning of the following day may cause data problems — a day's transactions may appear under a different date.

question_sw: Familia yangu kutoka nje ina kinu cha kusaga unga kijijini — je, inabidi wafanye nini?
answer_sw: Chini ya GN 487A (2025), kusaga nafaka na unga (flour milling) ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania. Familia yako lazima isimamishe shughuli hii au ihamishie umiliki kwa raia wa Tanzania kisheria kabla hawajakamatwa. Ukiwa umeendelea bila kubadilisha muundo wa umiliki, wanaweza kupata faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza. Njia bora ni kupata ushauri wa wakili kuhusu jinsi ya kubadilisha muundo wa biashara haraka.
question_en: My family from abroad runs a flour mill in a village — what should they do?
answer_en: Under GN 487A (2025), flour milling is one of the 15 business activities prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens. Your family must cease this activity or legally transfer ownership to a Tanzanian citizen before facing enforcement. Continuing without changing the ownership structure risks a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. The best course is to seek legal advice about restructuring the business quickly.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Malipo ya Tigo Pesa yanarekodi kwenye akaunti yangu ya simu — hii inatosha badala ya EFD?
output: Malipo ya simu (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money) yanahitaji risiti ya EFD kama malipo ya kawaida. Njia ya malipo haiathiri wajibu wa kutoa risiti — kila muamala wa mauzo lazima upate risiti ya EFD. Rekodi ya Tigo Pesa kwenye akaunti yako ya simu haitoshi — TRA inahitaji risiti ya EFD ambayo inaunganishwa moja kwa moja na TIMS. Rekodi za simu za pesa hazitumii kama nyaraka za kodi zinazolingana na EFD.
