question_sw: Usajili wa OSHA na usajili wa WCF — lazima usajilishe wote wawili?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — ni usajili MBILI TOFAUTI kwa taasisi tofauti. Usajili wa OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority): mwajiri lazima asajilishe mahali pa kazi kwa OSHA na kufuata kanuni za usalama. Usajili wa WCF (Workers Compensation Fund): mwajiri lazima asajilishe wafanyakazi kwa WCF na kulipa michango ya bima ya ajali. Usajilishe ZOTE MBILI — hazibadilishani.
question_en: OSHA registration and WCF registration — must you register for both?
answer_en: Yes — they are TWO SEPARATE registrations with different institutions. OSHA registration (Occupational Safety and Health Authority): an employer must register the workplace with OSHA and comply with safety standards. WCF registration (Workers Compensation Fund): an employer must register employees with WCF and pay accident insurance contributions. Register for BOTH — they are not interchangeable.

question_sw: Tangu lini GN 605A ilianza kutumika na ilifanyaje kwa amri ya mishahara ya mwaka 2022?
answer_sw: GN 605A ilitangazwa rasmi tarehe 13 Oktoba 2025 na ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Amri hii ilifuta na kubadilisha amri ya mishahara ya 2022 moja kwa moja. Mwajiri yeyote aliyeendelea kulipa viwango vya 2022 baada ya tarehe 1 Januari 2026 alikuwa anakiuka sheria hata kama mkataba wa ajira uliendelea kutaja viwango vya zamani. Viwango vipya viliongezeka kwa wastani wa asilimia 33.4: kutoka TZS 275,060 hadi TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi kwa sekta nyingi za sekta binafsi.
question_en: When did GN 605A take effect and what happened to the 2022 wage order?
answer_en: GN 605A was gazetted on 13 October 2025 and took effect on 1 January 2026. This order revoked and replaced the 2022 wage order entirely. Any employer still paying 2022 rates after 1 January 2026 was in violation of the law even if employment contracts still referenced the old rates. The new rates represent an average increase of 33.4%: from TZS 275,060 to TZS 358,322 per month across most private sector sub-sectors.
next_review_trigger: New minimum wage order gazetted replacing GN 605A

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio kwa ada za leseni (licence fees) zinazolipwa nje ya nchi ni asilimia 15 — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ada za leseni (licence fees) au mrabaha (royalties) zinazolipwa kwa mtu asiye mkazi Tanzania zina kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 15. Kiwango hiki kinatumika kwa ada za haki miliki ya akili, haki za matumizi ya programu za kompyuta, alama za biashara, na hati miliki. Angalia DTA inayohusika kwa kiwango kilichopunguzwa.
question_en: The withholding tax rate on licence fees paid abroad is 15% — is this correct?
answer_en: Yes. Licence fees or royalties paid to a non-resident in Tanzania carry a 15% withholding tax. This rate applies to payments for intellectual property, software usage rights, trademarks, and patents. Check the applicable DTA for a reduced rate.

question_sw: Jirani Mtanzania alilipa TZS 5M na akafungwa miezi 3 kwa kumsaidia mgeni. Je, hii ni adhabu sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana — adhabu hii haiko sahihi. Adhabu ya msaidizi Mtanzania ni faini ya hadi TZS 5M AU kifungo hadi miezi 3 — si zote mbili pamoja. Kumlazimisha jirani alipe 5M NA kufungwa wakati huo huo ni kuvuka mipaka ya sheria. Jirani anastahili moja tu kati ya mbili: faini (hadi 5M) au kifungo (hadi miezi 3).
question_en: A Tanzanian neighbour paid TZS 5M and was also imprisoned for 3 months for facilitating a non-citizen. Is this the correct penalty?
answer_en: No — this penalty is incorrect. A Tanzanian facilitator's penalty is a fine of up to TZS 5M OR imprisonment up to 3 months — not both together. Forcing the neighbour to pay 5M AND be imprisoned simultaneously exceeds the legal limits. The neighbour is entitled to only one of the two: a fine (up to 5M) or imprisonment (up to 3 months).
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: P9 form na P9A form — ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: P9 form: hati ya muhtasari wa kodi ya kila mwaka inayotolewa na mwajiri kwa mfanyakazi — inaonyesha jumla ya mapato na PAYE iliyokatwa mwaka mzima. Inatakiwa kabla ya 31 Machi. P9A: ni toleo la zamani au fomu ya ziada kwa hali maalum — matumizi yake yanategemea kanuni za sasa za TRA. Thibitisha fomu inayohitajika sasa na TRA.
question_en: P9 form and P9A form — what is the difference?
answer_en: P9 form: an annual tax summary document issued by the employer to the employee — showing total income and PAYE deducted for the whole year. Required before 31 March. P9A: an older version or supplementary form for specific situations — its current use depends on current TRA rules. Verify the currently required form with TRA.

question_sw: Ninasajilishwa VAT sasa hivi — jinsi ya kupata EFD machine?
answer_sw: Baada ya kupata usajilishaji wako wa VAT, unaweza kupata EFD kupitia hatua hizi: 1) Nenda TRA au wasiliana nao kuhusu orodha ya wasambazaji wa EFD walioidhinishwa Tanzania. 2) Nunua au kodi EFD kutoka kwa msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa — usichukue mashine yoyote. 3) Msambazaji ataifunga EFD na kuiandikisha kwenye mfumo wa TRA. 4) Baada ya ufungaji, EFD yako itaunganishwa moja kwa moja na TRA. Gharama za EFD zinatofautiana — thibitisha na msambazaji.
question_en: I am registering for VAT now — how do I get an EFD machine?
answer_en: After receiving your VAT registration, you can obtain an EFD through these steps: 1) Contact TRA for the list of TRA-approved EFD suppliers in Tanzania. 2) Purchase or lease an EFD from an approved supplier — do not use any unregistered device. 3) The supplier will install and register the EFD on TRA's system. 4) After installation, your EFD will be directly linked to TRA. EFD costs vary — confirm with the supplier.
next_review_trigger: When TRA updates EFD procurement procedures

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anaweza kufanya kazi kwa masaa ya ziada nje ya masaa ya mkataba wake — je, kinaathiri kibali chake?
answer_sw: Masaa ya ziada ya mfanyakazi wa kigeni kwa mwajiri WAKE MWENYEWE hayaathiri kibali chake — ni sehemu ya mkataba wake wa ajira na mwajiri aliyetajwa kwenye kibali. Tatizo linatokea ikiwa 'overtime' ni kwa mwajiri WA PILI — hiyo itahitaji ruhusa ya ziada ya uhamiaji.
question_en: Can a foreign worker do overtime outside their contract hours — does it affect their permit?
answer_en: Overtime for the foreign worker's OWN employer does not affect their permit — it is part of their employment relationship with the employer named on the permit. The problem arises if the 'overtime' is for a SECOND employer — that would require additional immigration authorisation.

question_sw: Je, mwajiri anaweza kupunguza malipo ya ziada kama posho ya usafiri kutoka mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A lazima ulipwe kamili — posho za ziada kama usafiri, chakula, au makazi hazihesabiwi kama sehemu ya mshahara wa chini isipokuwa sheria inaruhusu hilo moja kwa moja. Mwajiri hawezi kutumia posho kupunguza mshahara wa msingi.
question_en: Can an employer deduct transport allowances from the minimum wage payment?
answer_en: No. The GN 605A minimum wage must be paid in full — additional allowances like transport, food, or housing do not count as part of the minimum wage unless the law explicitly permits it. An employer cannot use allowances to reduce the basic salary below the floor.

question_sw: Je, kuna msamaha wowote wa kodi ya stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kuna baadhi ya misamaha ya kodi ya stempu chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Stempu, ikiwa ni pamoja na: hati zinazofanywa na au kwa ajili ya Serikali ya Tanzania, hati zinazohusiana na mazingira ya dharura ya umma, na hati maalum zilizoorodheshwa kwenye jedwali la msamaha wa sheria. Wakati wa shaka kuhusu kama hati yako inastahili msamaha, wasiliana na Afisa wa Stempu wa TRA au ofisi ya TRA iliyo karibu nawe.
answer_en: Yes. There are some stamp duty exemptions under the Stamp Duty Act, including: instruments made by or for the Government of Tanzania, instruments relating to public emergency circumstances, and specific instruments listed in the exemption schedule of the Act. When in doubt about whether your document qualifies for an exemption, contact the TRA Stamp Duty Officer or your nearest TRA office.
question_en: Are there any stamp duty exemptions in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — exemptions
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to stamp duty exemptions

instruction: Ninaweza kusajili VAT hata kama mauzo yangu ni TZS 50M tu kwa mwaka?
output: Ndio — usajili wa hiari wa VAT unaruhusiwa hata chini ya kizingiti. TRA inakuruhusu kusajili VAT kwa hiari iwapo biashara yako imesajiliwa kisheria. Faida kuu: unaweza kudai VAT ya manunuzi yako (input VAT) kama rejareja. Omba usajili wa hiari wa VAT kupitia tra.go.tz au ofisi ya TRA karibu nawe.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya utafiti (research) Tanzania anahitaji aina gani ya kibali?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya utafiti au uchunguzi (kama utafiti wa kisayansi, uchunguzi wa madini) anahitaji kibali cha Darasa D. Darasa D ni maalum kwa utafiti na uchunguzi wa rasilimali asili. Inatofautiana na Darasa B (ajira ya kawaida) kwa sababu utafiti una asili na masharti tofauti.
question_en: What type of permit does a foreigner conducting research in Tanzania need?
answer_en: A foreigner conducting research or prospecting (such as scientific research or mineral prospecting) needs a Class D permit. Class D is specific to research and natural resource prospecting. It differs from Class B (regular employment) because research has a different nature and conditions.

question_sw: Adhabu kwa mwajiri anayelipa chini ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A ni nini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anayelipa chini ya kiwango cha mshahara wa chini anaweza kukabili: malimbikizo ya tofauti ya mshahara, faini chini ya ELRA, au kesi ya kisheria iliyowasilishwa na mfanyakazi. Ukaguzi wa MLYWF unaweza kuanzisha hatua za kisheria. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: What is the penalty for an employer paying below the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: An employer paying below the minimum wage may face: back-payment of wage shortfalls, fines under ELRA, or legal proceedings filed by the employee. MLYWF labour inspectors can initiate enforcement action. Confirm with a legal adviser.

question_sw: Msajiliwa wa VAT ambaye hajafikia kizingiti anapaswa kujisajili wenyewe — je, TRA anaweza kumsajili bila ombi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ikiwa Kamishna Mkuu ameridhika kwamba mtu anahitajika kusajiliwa VAT na ana sababu nzuri — ikiwemo kulinda mapato ya serikali — anaweza kumsajili bila ombi na kumwarifu ndani ya siku 14 baada ya usajili. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Can TRA register a business for VAT without an application?
answer_en: Yes. If the Commissioner General is satisfied that a person must register for VAT and there is good reason — including protection of government revenue — they can register that person without an application and notify them within 14 days of registration. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Wizara ya Fedha ikiwa inanipa malipo kama msambazaji wa vifaa, itakata nini?
output: Wizara ya Fedha ni mfano wa withholding agent anayehitimu. Anakata sehemu ya VAT iliyoko kwenye invoice yako kabla ya kukupa malipo kamili. Bidhaa na huduma vina viwango tofauti vya withholding. Kwa hesabu sahihi ya kiasi kinachokatwa, thibitisha na TRA kwa hesabu halisi (tra.go.tz). Serikali itakupa certificate ya withholding inayoonyesha kiasi kilichokatwa.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Biashara inaweza kutumia programu ya kompyuta (software POS) badala ya EFD machine Tanzania?
answer_sw: TRA Tanzania inazidi kukubali mifumo ya software ya POS (Virtual EFD/Electronic Fiscal Receipt) kama mbadala wa EFD za kawaida za vifaa (hardware) katika hali fulani. Mfumo wa software lazima uidhiniwe na TRA na uunganishwe na mfumo wa TRA moja kwa moja. Usitumie programu yoyote ya POS bila uthibitisho kwamba imeidhinishwa na TRA — angalia TRA kwa hali ya sasa ya mifumo iliyoidhinishwa.
question_en: Can a business use a computer software (POS system) instead of an EFD machine in Tanzania?
answer_en: TRA Tanzania is increasingly accepting software POS systems (Virtual EFD/Electronic Fiscal Receipt) as alternatives to traditional hardware EFDs in certain situations. The software system must be TRA-approved and connected directly to TRA's system. Do not use any POS software without confirming it is TRA-approved — check TRA for the current list of approved systems.
next_review_trigger: TRA virtual EFD or software POS approval update

question_sw: Viwango vya mchango wa NSSF kwa mwajiri na mfanyakazi ni vipi?
answer_sw: Viwango vya NSSF nchini Tanzania ni: Mwajiri: asilimia 10 ya mshahara wa jumla (gross salary) wa mfanyakazi. Mfanyakazi: asilimia 10 ya mshahara wake wa jumla. Jumla ya mchango: asilimia 20 ya mshahara wa jumla kila mwezi. Mwajiri anakata mchango wa mfanyakazi kutoka mshahara na anachangia sehemu yake mwenyewe, kisha anapeleka jumla (asilimia 20) kwa NSSF. Thibitisha viwango vya sasa na NSSF kwenye nssf.or.tz.
question_en: What are the NSSF contribution rates for employer and employee?
answer_en: NSSF contribution rates in Tanzania are: Employer: 10% of the employee's gross salary. Employee: 10% of their own gross salary. Total contribution: 20% of gross salary per month. The employer deducts the employee's share from their salary and adds their own contribution, then remits the combined 20% to NSSF. Confirm current rates with NSSF at nssf.or.tz.
next_review_trigger: When NSSF Act is amended — VERIFY exact effective date from nssf.or.tz before training

instruction: Patent ya uvumbuzi wangu — BRELA inasimamia au ni ARIPO ya kikanda?
output: Tanzania ina chaguo mbili za hataza (patent): (1) BRELA ya Tanzania peke yake — kwa ulinzi wa Tanzania Bara tu; (2) ARIPO (African Regional Intellectual Property Organization) — kwa ulinzi wa nchi nyingi za Afrika Mashariki kwa jibu moja. BRELA ndiyo mamlaka ya ndani ya Tanzania kwa hataza, trademarks, industrial designs, na utility models. COSOTA (tofauti na BRELA) inashughulikia copyrights peke yake. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au ARIPO kwa ulinzi wa kikanda.

instruction: Input VAT maana yake nini na ninaweza kudai lini?
output: Input VAT: VAT unayolipa wakati unaponunua bidhaa au huduma kwa biashara yako. Output VAT: VAT unayokusanya kutoka kwa wateja wako. Unapaswa kulipa TRA: Output VAT MINUS Input VAT. Unaweza kudai input VAT ukiwa umesajiliwa VAT na una invoice halisi ya VAT kutoka kwa wazabuni. Kama output VAT ni ndogo kuliko input VAT: unastahili rejareja ya VAT kutoka TRA.

instruction: Mtu anayetoa taarifa (whistleblower) kuhusu mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A — ana ulinzi wowote?
output: GN 487A haisemi wazi juu ya ulinzi wa whistleblowers. Hata hivyo, Tanzania ina sheria ya jumla ya ulinzi wa whistleblowers katika mazingira fulani. Mtu anayetoa taarifa kuhusu ukiukwaji wa GN 487A kwa Idara ya Uhamiaji au polisi anaweza: (1) Kutoa taarifa kwa siri (anonymous tip) kwa polisi au Idara ya Uhamiaji; (2) Kuthibitisha kwa maandishi kwa Idara ya Uhamiaji. Hata hivyo, ulinzi rasmi wa kisheria dhidi ya kulipizwa kisasi kwa GN 487A peke yake haujabainishwa wazi. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa kisheria kwa hali yako maalum.

question_sw: SDL inamaanisha nini — ni Skills Development Levy au disability leave?
answer_sw: SDL inamaanisha Skills Development Levy — Ushuru wa Maendeleo ya Ujuzi. Si disability leave (likizo ya ulemavu), si sick leave, si aina yoyote ya likizo. Ni ushuru wa serikali anaolipa mwajiri kwa Serikali kila mwezi ili kusaidia mafunzo ya ufundi nchini.
question_en: What does SDL stand for — is it Skills Development Levy or disability leave?
answer_en: SDL stands for Skills Development Levy. It is NOT disability leave, sick leave, or any type of leave. It is a government levy paid monthly by the employer to fund vocational and skills training in Tanzania.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Mgeni anafundisha darasa lake la lugha ya Kiingereza — GN 487A inasimamia?
answer_sw: Huduma za elimu na mafunzo hazipo kwenye orodha ya 15 ya GN 487A. Mgeni anayeendesha shule ya lugha au darasa la binafsi hana vizuizi vya GN 487A. Hata hivyo, bado anahitaji kibali cha kazi kinachofaa kufundisha Tanzania.
question_en: A non-citizen teaches their own English language class — does GN 487A apply?
answer_en: Education and training services are not on GN 487A's list of 15 prohibited activities. A non-citizen running a language school or private tutoring class faces no GN 487A restrictions. However, they still need an appropriate work permit to teach in Tanzania.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Thamani ya nyumba ya kampuni inajumuishwa katika PAYE vipi?
answer_sw: Kama mwajiri anatoa nyumba kwa mfanyakazi, thamani ya nyumba hiyo inajumuishwa katika mapato ya mfanyakazi kwa madhumuni ya PAYE. Thamani inahesabiwa kulingana na kanuni za TRA — kwa kawaida ni asilimia ya mshahara wa msingi au kodi ya soko. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is employer-provided housing included in PAYE calculation?
answer_en: If an employer provides housing to an employee, the value of that housing is included in the employee's income for PAYE purposes. The value is calculated according to TRA rules — typically a percentage of basic salary or market rent. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Posho ya usafiri inapaswa kulipwa PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: Inategemea: posho ya usafiri inayolipwa kupita kiasi cha gharama halisi za kazi (reimbursement ya kweli) inastahili PAYE. Posho inayolipwa kama nyongeza ya mshahara — bila kuhusiana na safari ya kazi — inastahili PAYE kamili. Thibitisha mtiririko halisi na TRA.
question_en: Is a transport allowance subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: It depends: transport allowance paid beyond actual business travel costs (genuine reimbursement) is subject to PAYE. Allowances paid as a salary top-up — not related to business travel — are fully subject to PAYE. Confirm the actual arrangement with TRA.

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutolipa ushuru wa stempu kwa wakati Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Adhabu ya kutolipa ushuru wa stempu kwa wakati Tanzania inajumuisha: riba kwenye kiasi kilichochelewa, adhabu ya ziada inayoweza kuhesabiwa kama asilimia ya ushuru uliochelewa. Pia hati inaweza kukosaushuru wa kutosha na kuathiri nguvu yake ya kisheria. Kulipa mapema na kupata hati kupigiwa muhuri ni njia ya kuzuia adhabu hizi.
question_en: What is the penalty for not paying stamp duty on time in Tanzania?
answer_en: The penalty for late stamp duty payment in Tanzania includes: interest on the overdue amount, and an additional penalty which may be calculated as a percentage of the overdue duty. Also the instrument may be insufficiently stamped and its legal force affected. Paying promptly and having the instrument stamped is the way to avoid these penalties.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or Tax Administration Act update

question_sw: Biashara ya mauzo ya mtandaoni peke yake (online-only) inahitaji usajili wa BRELA Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara yoyote inayofanya shughuli Tanzania — ikiwa ni pamoja na biashara ya mtandaoni peke yake — inahitaji usajili wa kisheria. Ikiwa ni biashara ya mtu mmoja, angalau jina la biashara linapaswa kusajiliwa BRELA. Ikiwa ni kampuni, kampuni lazima isajiliwe BRELA. TIN pia inahitajika. Biashara ya mtandaoni peke yake HAIEPUKI mahitaji ya kisheria ya Tanzania.
question_en: Does an online-only business need BRELA registration in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Any business operating in Tanzania — including an online-only business — needs legal registration. If it is a sole proprietorship, at minimum the business name should be registered at BRELA. If it is a company, the company must be registered at BRELA. A TIN is also required. An online-only business does NOT escape Tanzania's legal registration requirements.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Ninataka kufanya uwekezaji wa hisa kwenye DSE (Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange) — kodi ya gawio (dividend) ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kodi ya gawio (dividend withholding tax) kwa hisa za DSE na uwekezaji wa DSE kwa ujumla ni eneo linaloenda zaidi ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Ninajua kwamba Tanzania ina kodi ya zuio kwa gawio lakini kiwango kinachofaa kwa hali yako (raia wa Tanzania, mgeni, mtu binafsi, kampuni) kinatofautiana. Wasiliana na brokers wa DSE, TRA, au mhesabu wa uwekezaji aliyehitimu.
question_en: I want to invest in shares on the DSE — how much is the dividend tax?
answer_en: Dividend withholding tax on DSE shares and DSE investment generally is beyond my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. I know Tanzania has a withholding tax on dividends but the applicable rate for your situation (Tanzanian citizen, non-citizen, individual, company) varies. Contact DSE brokers, TRA, or a qualified investment accountant.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment on dividend WHT rates

instruction: Kama ninauzwa TZS 12M mwaka — ninunue EFD haraka au ninaweza kusubiri?
output: EFD inahitajika kulingana na kizingiti cha mauzo kilichowekwa na TRA — thibitisha kizingiti cha sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz). VAT registered businesses ZOTE lazima zitumie EFD bila kujali kiasi cha mauzo. Kwa mauzo ya TZS 12M kwa mwaka, umepita kizingiti cha TZS 11M — EFD inahitajika. Wasiliana na TRA au msambazaji wa EFD mara moja. Kutowasilisha risiti za EFD baada ya kupitisha kizingiti ni ukiukaji wa sheria ya kodi.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unalipwa kwa shilingi au unaweza kulipwa kwa dola za Marekani?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unalipwa kwa SHILINGI YA TANZANIA (TZS) — si dola. Hata kama muamala wenyewe ulifanywa kwa dola (kwa mfano, mauzo ya ardhi kwa USD), kiasi cha ushuru kinabadilishwa kulingana na kiwango cha ubadilishaji wa Benki Kuu ya Tanzania (BoT) siku ya malipo.
question_en: Is Tanzania stamp duty paid in Tanzanian shillings or can it be paid in US dollars?
answer_en: Tanzania stamp duty is paid in TANZANIAN SHILLINGS (TZS) — not dollars. Even if the underlying transaction was in dollars (for example, a land sale in USD), the duty amount is converted at the Bank of Tanzania (BoT) exchange rate on the payment date.

question_sw: Nina ruhusa ya uwekezaji (investor permit) kutoka Idara ya Uhamiaji Tanzania. Je, ninaweza kufungua duka la rejareja kwa msingi wa ruhusa hii?
answer_sw: Hapana — ruhusa ya uwekezaji hailindi mgeni dhidi ya GN 487A. Biashara ya rejareja (retail trade) imeorodheshwa moja kwa moja kwenye biashara 15 zilizopigwa marufuku. Mgeni aliyepewa ruhusa ya uwekezaji anaruhusiwa kuwekeza katika sekta zilizoidhinishwa — lakini kama sekta hiyo ipo kwenye orodha ya marufuku, ruhusa ya uwekezaji haibadilishi marufuku hiyo. Wasiliana na BRELA na Idara ya Uhamiaji ili kuthibitisha aina ya biashara inayoruhusiwa kwa ruhusa yako kabla ya kuanza operesheni yoyote.
question_en: I hold an investor permit from Tanzania Immigration Department. Can I open a retail shop based on this permit?
answer_en: No — an investor permit does not exempt a non-citizen from GN 487A. Retail trade is explicitly listed among the 15 prohibited business categories. A non-citizen holding an investor permit may invest in approved sectors — but if the sector is on the prohibited list the investor permit does not override the prohibition. Consult BRELA and the Immigration Department to confirm which activities your specific permit authorises before commencing any operations.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A or investor permit regulation changes

instruction: Tofauti ya biashara ya jina, ubia, na kampuni ya hisa ni nini kwa BRELA?
output: BRELA inasajili aina TATU za biashara: 1. Biashara ya jina (sole trader/business name) 2. Ubia (partnership) 3. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company). Hakuna aina nyingine ya nne au ya tano chini ya Companies Act Tanzania. Biashara ya jina (sole trader): mmiliki mmoja, anahusika kikamilifu kwa madeni. Ubia (partnership): wamiliki wawili au zaidi, wanashiriki faida na madeni. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company): chombo huru kisheria, wanahisa wana dhamana ndogo tu.

question_sw: Mwajiri mpya — lini anapaswa kusajili NSSF?
answer_sw: Mwajiri mpya anapaswa kusajili NSSF mara tu anapoanza kuajiri wafanyakazi. Usajili unafanywa kupitia Lango la Huduma la NSSF (NSSF Self Service Portal) au ofisi yoyote ya NSSF. Thibitisha tarehe na mahitaji ya usajili na NSSF.
question_en: When must a new employer register with NSSF?
answer_en: A new employer must register with NSSF as soon as they start employing workers. Registration is done through the NSSF Self Service Portal or any NSSF office. Confirm the registration timeline and requirements with NSSF.

instruction: Msambazaji wangu aliyenipa EFD amefilisika. EFD yangu bado inatumika?
output: EFD yako iliyoanzishwa (activated) tayari kwenye mfumo wa TRA itaendelea kufanya kazi. Tatizo ni matengenezo na msaada wa kiufundi. Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) kupata maelekezo kuhusu jinsi ya kupata msambazaji mpya aliyeidhinishwa akuchukue. TRA inaweza kukuunganisha na msambazaji mwingine aliyeidhinishwa atakayehudumia EFD yako.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi anaweza kulipa NSSF yake mwenyewe wakati wa likizo bila malipo?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi anaweza kulipa michango ya NSSF kwa hiari wakati wa likizo bila malipo ili kulinda akaunti yake ya NSSF na kuendelea kukusanya miezi ya mchango. Hii inasaidia kuhakikisha mfanyakazi anafikia miezi 180 ya michango inayohitajika kwa pensheni kamili. Wasiliana na NSSF kwa utaratibu wa kulipa kama mwanachama anayechangia kwa hiari.
question_en: Can an employee pay their own NSSF during unpaid leave?
answer_en: Yes. An employee can voluntarily pay NSSF contributions during unpaid leave to protect their NSSF account and continue accumulating contribution months. This helps ensure the employee reaches the 180 contribution months needed for full pension. Contact NSSF for the procedure to pay as a voluntary contributing member.

question_sw: Kazi ya ziada (overtime) inalipwa PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Malipo ya kazi ya ziada yanajumuishwa katika jumla ya mapato ya mwezi na yanastahili PAYE kwa kiwango kinacholingana na kanda ya mapato. Hakuna kiwango maalum cha PAYE kwa overtime peke yake. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Is overtime pay subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Overtime pay is included in total monthly earnings and is subject to PAYE at the applicable rate band. There is no separate PAYE rate for overtime. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Biashara ya usafirishaji (taxi, bodaboda) inahitaji EFD Tanzania?
answer_sw: Biashara za usafirishaji wa abiria kama bodaboda na taxi zimekuwa nje ya listi ya lazima ya EFD kwa kawaida — hasa kwa madereva wa kujitegemea wenye mauzo madogo. Hata hivyo, kampuni kubwa za usafirishaji zilizosajili VAT au zile TRA zilizotamua lazima zitumie EFD. Angalia TRA moja kwa moja kwa ufafanuzi wa hali yako ya biashara ya usafirishaji.
question_en: Does a transport business (taxi, bodaboda) need an EFD in Tanzania?
answer_en: Passenger transport businesses like bodaboda and taxis have generally been outside the mandatory EFD list — especially for independent drivers with small turnover. However, large transport companies that are VAT-registered or those directed by TRA must use an EFD. Check TRA directly for clarification for your specific transport business situation.

question_sw: Muda wa Kamishna kujibu pingamizi ni miezi 3 — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Muda wa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA kujibu pingamizi ni miezi 6 — si miezi 3. Baada ya miezi 6 bila jibu, pingamizi linachukuliwa kama limekataliwa na mlipaji kodi anaweza kwenda TRAB. Miezi 3 si muda sahihi kwa hatua hii.
question_en: The Commissioner's response period for an objection is 3 months — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The TRA Commissioner General's response period for an objection is 6 MONTHS — not 3 months. After 6 months without a response the objection is deemed rejected and the taxpayer can proceed to TRAB. Three months is not the correct timeframe for this step.

question_sw: VAT refund na VAT compliance — jinsi zinavyohusiana?
answer_sw: Compliance na VAT (kuwasilisha returns kwa wakati, kulipa VAT, kuhifadhi kumbukumbu) ndiyo msingi wa haki ya kudai VAT refund. TRA inachunguza historia ya compliance wakati inashughulikia madai ya refund. Biashara yenye historia nzuri ya compliance (returns zote za wakati, hakuna deni la VAT) ina nafasi nzuri zaidi ya kupata refund yake haraka.
question_en: VAT refund and VAT compliance — how are they related?
answer_en: VAT compliance (filing returns on time, paying VAT, keeping records) is the foundation of the right to claim a VAT refund. TRA examines compliance history when processing refund claims. A business with a good compliance record (all returns on time, no VAT debt) has a much better chance of receiving its refund quickly.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

instruction: EPZ kampuni yangu iko exempt ya VAT — msamaha huu unashughulikia manunuzi yote ndani ya Tanzania au nje tu?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Upeo wa msamaha wa VAT kwa kampuni za EPZ unashughulikiwa chini ya EPZ Act na kanuni za EPZA na TRA — inajumuisha masharti ya soko la ndani dhidi ya mauzo ya nje (exports). Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Mfanyakazi mkurugenzi wangu anapata TZS 1,500,000 kwa mwezi — PAYE yake ni kiasi gani?
output:
PAYE ya mshahara wa TZS 1,500,000 kwa mwezi inakokotolewa kwa kanda za PAYE kama ifuatavyo:

Kanda 1 (0%): TZS 0 hadi 270,000 — kodi = TZS 0
Kanda 2 (8%): TZS 270,001 hadi 520,000 — TZS 250,000 x 8% = TZS 20,000
Kanda 3 (20%): TZS 520,001 hadi 760,000 — TZS 240,000 x 20% = TZS 48,000
Kanda 4 (25%): TZS 760,001 hadi 1,000,000 — TZS 240,000 x 25% = TZS 60,000
Kanda 5 (30%): TZS 1,000,001 hadi 1,500,000 — TZS 500,000 x 30% = TZS 150,000

Jumla ya PAYE = TZS 278,000 kwa mwezi.

PAYE hii inakatwa mshahara wa mfanyakazi na kuwasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: GN 487A na usajili wa TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) — je, mwekezaji wa kigeni mwenye TIC anaweza kufanya biashara ya rejareja?
output: Hapana — usajili wa TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) unaruhusu wawekezaji wa kigeni kuwekeza katika sekta zilizobainishwa (kama kilimo, viwanda, utalii) kwa masharti maalum. Lakini biashara ya rejareja, saluni, ukarabati wa simu, na shughuli zingine 14 za GN 487A hazijaidhinishwa na TIC kwa wageni — hazipo katika orodha ya sekta zinazoruhusiwa na TIC kwa wawekezaji wa kigeni. GN 487A na TIC ni mifumo miwili tofauti: TIC inasimamia uwekezaji mkubwa katika sekta maalum; GN 487A inazuia shughuli ndogo ndogo kwa wageni wote. Thibitisha na TIC (tic.go.tz) na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Biashara ya kilimo kubwa — GN 487A inazuia mgeni kulima kwa faida?
answer_sw: Kilimo kwa ujumla hakiko kwenye orodha ya shughuli 15 zilizokatazwa na GN 487A. Hata hivyo, uuzaji wa rejareja wa mazao unaweza kuathiriwa ikiwa unachukuliwa kama biashara ya rejareja. Kwa uwekezaji mkubwa wa kilimo, makubaliano na TIC yanaweza kuhitajika. Thibitisha na mwanasheria.
question_en: Large-scale agriculture — does GN 487A prevent a non-citizen from farming commercially?
answer_en: Agriculture in general is not on the list of 15 prohibited activities under GN 487A. However, retail sale of farm produce could be affected if treated as retail trade. For large agricultural investments, agreements with TIC may be required. Verify with a lawyer.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: NSSF inalipwa tarehe ngapi kwa mwezi?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. NSSF inapaswa kulipwa ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara — yaani kabla ya mwisho wa mwezi unaofuata. Thibitisha tarehe halisi ya sasa na NSSF (nssf.or.tz) kwani inaweza kubainishwa zaidi na ofisi yako ya NSSF. Kuchelewa kulipa NSSF kunasababisha faini — lipa mapema.

question_sw: Kiwango cha WHT kwa gawio (dividends) kwa wakazi ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha withholding tax kwa gawio kwa wakazi wa Tanzania ni asilimia 10. Kwa wasio wakazi, kiwango pia ni asilimia 10. Mwajiri au kampuni inayotoa gawio inalazimika kukata WHT kabla ya kulipa mpokeaji.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on dividends for residents?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on dividends for Tanzania residents is 10%. For non-residents the rate is also 10%. The paying company must deduct WHT before remitting dividends to the recipient.

question_sw: Tunalipa wafanyakazi mshahara wa msingi pamoja na posho za usafiri na chakula. SDL ya asilimia 3.5 inahesabiwa kwenye nini hasa?
answer_sw: SDL (Skills Development Levy) ya asilimia 3.5 inahesabiwa kwenye mishahara yote ya jumla (gross wages) — hii inajumuisha: mshahara wa msingi, posho za usafiri, posho za chakula, bonasi, na malipo mengine yote ya mfanyakazi yanayohusiana na ajira. Posho za fedha taslimu zinajumuishwa hata kama zinalipwa tofauti. Faida zisizo za fedha (kama nyumba inayotolewa bure) zinatathminiwa kwa thamani ya soko. Tumia jumla ya gharama zote za wafanyakazi kama msingi wa SDL — si mshahara wa msingi peke yake.
question_en: We pay employees a basic salary plus transport and meal allowances. Is the 3.5% SDL calculated on the full package or basic salary only?
answer_en: SDL (Skills Development Levy) at 3.5% is calculated on total gross wages — this includes: basic salary, transport allowances, meal allowances, bonuses, and all other employment-related payments. Cash allowances are included even if paid separately. Non-cash benefits such as a rent-free house are valued at market rate. Use the total employment cost as the SDL base — not basic salary alone.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or base

question_sw: Je, biashara yangu inayouza bidhaa za zero-rated na bidhaa za standard lazima ifanye nini?
answer_sw: Biashara inayouza aina zote mbili (zero-rated na standard rated) ni 'partially exempt'. Unapaswa: (1) Kufuatilia kwa makini mauzo ya aina kila moja; (2) Kuhesabu input VAT inayodaiwa kwa uwiano wa mauzo ya standard rated; (3) Kudai sehemu ya input VAT inayohusiana na mauzo ya standard na zero-rated tu (si exempt). Kiwango cha VAT kwa bidhaa za standard ni asilimia 18 — si asilimia 5.
question_en: My business sells both zero-rated and standard-rated goods. What must I do?
answer_en: A business selling both types (zero-rated and standard-rated) is 'partially exempt'. You must: (1) Track sales of each type carefully; (2) Calculate claimable input VAT based on the proportion of standard-rated sales; (3) Only claim the portion of input VAT related to standard-rated and zero-rated sales (not exempt). The VAT rate on standard goods is 18% — not 5%.

instruction: Naweza kuwekeza kwenye ardhi ya Tanzania kama mgeni (foreigner) — ninunue wapi na vipi?
output: Suala la uwekezaji wa ardhi kwa wageni lina utata wa kisheria unaohusisha Sheria ya Ardhi ya Tanzania na masharti maalum ya uwekezaji. Sina uhakika wa maelezo yote ya kisheria ya hali yako maalum — hii iko nje ya maarifa yangu ya ushauri wa kodi na biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi na mwanasheria wa ardhi aliyehitimu kwa mwelekeo sahihi. Tanzania Investment Centre (tic.go.tz) pia inaweza kusaidia.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Mwajiri anahitaji TIN kabla ya kumwomba mfanyakazi mgeni kibali cha kazi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni lazima iwe na TIN iliyotolewa na TRA na iwe imesajiliwa kisheria Tanzania kabla ya kuomba kibali cha kazi kwa mfanyakazi mgeni. Idara ya Uhamiaji inataka uthibitisho wa usajili wa kampuni na hali ya kodi. Thibitisha na TRA na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Does an employer need a TIN before sponsoring a foreign work permit in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. The company must have a TRA-issued TIN and be legally registered in Tanzania before applying for a work permit for a foreign employee. The Immigration Department requires proof of company registration and tax compliance. Confirm with TRA and the Immigration Department.

instruction: TIMS ni nini na inahusiana vipi na EFD yangu?
output: TIMS (Tanzania Integrated Management System) ni mfumo wa TRA unaounganisha EFD zote Tanzania kwa wakati halisi. Kila risiti unayopiga kwenye EFD yako inatumwa moja kwa moja kwa TRA kupitia TIMS — inatosha TRA kuona mauzo yako wakati huo huo. Faida kwako: ikiwa EFD itaharibika, rekodi za TIMS zinaendelea. Hatari: kukwepa risiti kunaonekana mara moja kwenye TIMS.

question_sw: Je, mwajiri anaweza kulipa mshahara mdogo kuliko GN 605A kama mfanyakazi amekubali?
answer_sw: Hapana. Makubaliano ya mtu mmoja mmoja hayawezi kupunguza haki ya kisheria ya mshahara wa chini. GN 605A ni kiwango cha chini kabisa — hata kama mfanyakazi 'amekubali' kulipwa kidogo, makubaliano hayo si ya kisheria na hayafai.
question_en: Can an employer pay below GN 605A if the employee agrees?
answer_en: No. Individual agreements cannot reduce the statutory minimum wage entitlement. GN 605A is an absolute floor — even if an employee 'agrees' to less, that agreement is void and unenforceable.

question_sw: Mapato ya kilimo ya mkulima binafsi — yanalazimu kodi ya mapato Tanzania?
answer_sw: Matibabu ya kodi ya mapato ya kilimo Tanzania ni ngumu na yanategemea kiwango cha mapato na muundo wa biashara. Wakulima wadogo wanaweza kuwa na hali tofauti na wazalishaji wakubwa wa kibiashara. Sina uhakika wa masharti ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA kuhusu hali yako maalum ya kilimo.
question_en: Does a private farmer's agricultural income require income tax in Tanzania?
answer_en: The income tax treatment of agricultural income in Tanzania is complex and depends on income levels and business structure. Smallholder farmers may have different treatment than large commercial producers. I am not certain of current rules. Verify with TRA about your specific farming situation.

instruction: VAT inaweza kusamehewa (waived) kama biashara ina shida ya fedha?
output: Hapana — VAT haiwezi kusamehewa kwa sababu ya shida ya fedha za biashara. VAT ni pesa ya wateja (umekusanya kutoka kwao kwa niaba ya TRA) — si pesa yako. Kukusanya VAT na kutolipa TRA ni tofauti na tatizo la fedha la biashara — ni ukwepaji wa kodi. TRA ina haki ya kudai VAT yote iliyokusanywa, faini, na riba bila kujali hali ya biashara. Kama una shida ya kulipa VAT — wasiliana na TRA mapema ili kupanga ratiba ya malipo (TRA ina uwezo wa kupanga awamu za kulipa). Lakini kusamehe VAT yenyewe — hapana. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa mazungumzo ya ratiba ya malipo.

instruction: Kampuni ya bodi ya baharini (shipping company) — inalipa kodi gani maalum Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Kodi maalum kwa kampuni za usafirishaji wa baharini (shipping companies) Tanzania — kama agency fees, port charges, na kodi maalum za sekta — ni mada ya kisheria ya baharini nje ya wigo wangu wa VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia compliance ya biashara ya kawaida Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na Tanzania Ports Authority, TRA, au mshauri wa kodi wa sekta ya baharini.

instruction: Mtu alilalamika NSSF kwa mwajiri wake ambaye hakumlipa — NSSF inafanya nini?
output: NSSF ina uwezo wa kuchunguza malalamiko ya wafanyakazi kuhusu mwajiri asiye kulipa michango: (1) NSSF inachunguza rekodi za mwajiri — wanakagua michango iliyowasilishwa dhidi ya wafanyakazi waliopo; (2) Kama uthibitisho unakutwa — NSSF inatoa notisi ya malipo kwa mwajiri; (3) Kama mwajiri halipi — NSSF inaweza kuchukua hatua za kisheria ikiwa ni pamoja na madai ya mahakama; (4) Wakurugenzi wa kampuni wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi. Mfanyakazi ana haki ya: kulalamika moja kwa moja kwa NSSF (nssf.or.tz), kulalamika kwa Mahakama ya Kazi (Labour Court), au kupitia Mkurugenzi wa Kazi (Director of Labour). Thibitisha na nssf.or.tz.

question_sw: Kampuni ina wafanyakazi 10 — inalipa SDL. Je, ikiwa idadi ya wafanyakazi inashuka chini ya 10?
answer_sw: Kama idadi ya wafanyakazi inashuka chini ya 10 kwa kudumu, wajibu wa SDL unaweza kutoweka. Hata hivyo, thibitisha na TRA kuhusu utaratibu wa kujiondoa rasmi. Kupungua kwa muda mfupi (kwa mwezi mmoja) kunaweza kusababisha tofauti — thibitisha.
question_en: A company has 10 employees — it pays SDL. What if the employee count drops below 10?
answer_en: If the employee count permanently drops below 10, the SDL obligation may cease. However, verify with TRA on the formal deregistration process. A temporary drop (for one month) may have different treatment — verify.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: Thamani ya nyumba yangu kwa stamp duty — TRA wanaithamini vipi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mbinu za uthamini wa mali isiyohamika (property valuation) kwa madhumuni ya stamp duty Tanzania — value assessment procedures, appeal mechanisms, na taratibu za TRA — ni mada ya kisheria ya ardhi inayohitaji utaalamu maalum nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT ya biashara, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Wasiliana na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz au mtathmini wa ardhi (valuer) aliyehitimu.

instruction: EFD — ninaweza kuuza bidhaa kwa bei ya chini kuliko gharama (bia ya soko) na bado EFD inafanya kazi?
output: EFD inasajili muamala kama unavyouingiza — bei ya kuuza, kiasi, na aina ya bidhaa. Haisemi kama bei ni 'ya kawaida' au la. Hata hivyo, TRA inaweza kuangalia biashara inayouza kwa bei za chini sana kwa wakati mrefu — hii inaweza kuonyesha mapato yanayoficha. Maswali yanaweza kutokea kama: mauzo ya chini sana dhidi ya stoo kubwa; faida isiyo na mantiki. EFD yenyewe haizuii uuzaji kwa bei yoyote — lakini rekodi zote za EFD zinajilimbikizia na TRA inaweza kuzichunguza. Hakikisha bei zinazoingia kwenye EFD ni za kweli. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Biashara ndogo Tanzania inaweza kutumia mfumo wa 'lump sum tax' badala ya kuhesabu kodi halisi ya mapato?
answer_sw: Tanzania haina mfumo rasmi wa 'lump sum tax' kwa biashara ndogo kwa ujumla. Hata hivyo, kuna mfumo wa kodi ndogo ya mauzo (minimum turnover tax) ya asilimia 1 kwa biashara zisizofanya faida. Baadhi ya LGA zinaweza kuwa na mifumo rahisi ya kodi ya biashara ndogo (presumptive tax) lakini hizi ni za eneo, si za TRA ya kitaifa. Angalia TRA na LGA yako kwa chaguo zilizopo.
question_en: Can a small Tanzania business use a 'lump sum tax' system instead of calculating actual income tax?
answer_en: Tanzania does not have a general formal 'lump sum tax' system for small businesses. However, there is a minimum turnover tax system at 1% for businesses that do not make a profit. Some LGAs may have simplified small business tax systems (presumptive tax) but these are local, not national TRA. Check with TRA and your LGA for available options.
next_review_trigger: Tax policy for small businesses update

question_sw: Kodi ya zuio kwenye huduma za usimamizi (management fees) kwa mkazi Tanzania ni asilimia 5 — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kodi ya zuio kwenye ada za usimamizi zinazolipwa kwa MKAZI Tanzania ni asilimia 5. Lakini kwa ASIYE MKAZI, kiwango ni asilimia 15. Hii ni tofauti muhimu. Mkazi = mtu au kampuni inayoishi/ipo Tanzania kwa zaidi ya siku 183 kwa mwaka wa fedha. Kagua hali ya ukazi wa mpokeaji kabla ya kushikilia kodi.
question_en: Withholding tax on management service fees to a Tanzania resident is 5% — is this correct?
answer_en: Yes, 5% for a resident. But for a NON-RESIDENT, the rate is 15%. This is an important distinction. Resident = a person or company that lives in or is present in Tanzania for more than 183 days of the financial year. Verify the residency status of the recipient before withholding.

question_sw: Mgeni akikamatwa akifanya biashara iliyozuiliwa, hatua za kisheria ni zipi?
answer_sw: Chini ya GN 487A (2025), mgeni anayekamatwa akifanya biashara iliyozuiliwa anakabiliwa na hatua zifuatazo: (1) Biashara inafungwa mara moja na vitu vya biashara vinaweza kukamatwa, (2) Mgeni anashtakiwa mahakamani, (3) Akipatikana na hatia, anaweza kupata faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, AU vyote viwili, (4) Viza yake inafutwa, (5) Anaweza kufukuzwa nchini (deportation). Operesheni ya utekelezaji wa kwanza (Sep-Oct 2025) ilionyesha kwamba biashara zilifungwa haraka bila fursa ya kuomba msamaha.
question_en: If a non-citizen is arrested for operating a prohibited business, what are the legal steps?
answer_en: Under GN 487A (2025), a non-citizen arrested for operating a prohibited business faces: (1) Immediate business closure and possible seizure of business goods, (2) Criminal prosecution in court, (3) If convicted, a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, OR both, (4) Visa revocation, (5) Possible deportation. The first enforcement exercise (Sep-Oct 2025) showed that businesses were closed swiftly without opportunity for leniency.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Machinga (muuzaji mdogo wa barabarani) ambaye ni mgeni — GN 487A inasema nini?
output: Biashara ndogo za barabarani (machinga) ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A (tarehe 28 Julai 2025). Hii inajumuisha muuzaji yeyote wa barabarani, sokoni, au maeneo ya umma ambaye ni raia wa kigeni. Hata biashara ndogo sana inayofanywa na mgeni inakiuka GN 487A. Adhabu: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kupunguza mshahara wa mfanyakazi ili kufidia mchango wa NSSF wa mwajiri — je, inaruhusiwa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mchango wa mwajiri wa NSSF (asilimia 10) ni GHARAMA YA MWAJIRI — HAIWEZI kukatwa kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi au kupunguza mshahara wake. Mfanyakazi analipa sehemu yake (asilimia 10) ambayo inakatwa kutoka mshahara wake, lakini sehemu ya mwajiri (asilimia 10) inalipwa na MWAJIRI mwenyewe kwa gharama zake. Mwajiri anayepunguza mshahara wa mfanyakazi kulipa mchango wake wa NSSF anakiuka sheria ya kazi na NSSF.
question_en: Can an employer reduce a worker's salary to compensate for the employer's NSSF contribution — is this permitted in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. The employer's NSSF contribution (10%) is the EMPLOYER'S COST — it cannot be deducted from the employee's salary or reduce their wage. The employee pays their share (10%) which is deducted from their salary, but the employer's share (10%) is paid by the EMPLOYER themselves from their own funds. An employer who reduces a worker's salary to pay their NSSF contribution violates labour law and NSSF law.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Kampuni ya bima inalipa kodi gani maalum Tanzania — premium tax ipo?
answer_sw: Kampuni za bima zina mfumo maalum wa kodi na usimamizi wa TIRA (Tanzania Insurance Regulatory Authority). Premium tax na tozo maalum za bima zinaweza kutumika. Sina uhakika wa viwango vya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au TIRA.
question_en: What special taxes does an insurance company pay in Tanzania — is there a premium tax?
answer_en: Insurance companies have a specialized tax framework regulated by TIRA (Tanzania Insurance Regulatory Authority). Premium taxes and special insurance levies may apply. I am not certain of current rates. Verify with TRA or TIRA.

question_sw: Ongezeko la wastani la mshahara chini ya GN 605A ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Ongezeko la wastani la sekta ya faragha chini ya GN 605A ni asilimia 33.4 — kutoka TZS 275,060 hadi TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi. Hii ni wastani kwa sekta zote; sekta fulani zinaongezeka zaidi. Thibitisha kiasi halisi cha sekta yako na MLYWF.
question_en: What is the average wage increase under GN 605A?
answer_en: The average private sector increase under GN 605A is 33.4% — from TZS 275,060 to TZS 358,322 per month. This is the average across all sectors; some sectors increase by more. Confirm your sector's exact amount with MLYWF.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni anayeomba DTA relief — mchakato wake ni upi?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, mchakato ni: (1) Mfanyakazi anathibitisha hali yake ya mkazi wa kodi katika nchi ya asili na haki za DTA; (2) Wasilisha ombi kwa Kamishna wa TRA ukiambatisha ushahidi wa kodi inayolipwa nje; (3) Subiri kibali rasmi cha TRA kabla ya kutoa marekebisho yoyote ya PAYE; (4) Hifadhi uthibitishaji wote. Mchakato maalum unategemea DTA inayohusika.
question_en: A foreign employee applying for DTA relief — what is the process?
answer_en: Generally, the process is: (1) The employee confirms their tax residency in the home country and DTA entitlements; (2) Submit an application to the TRA Commissioner with evidence of taxes paid abroad; (3) Wait for formal TRA approval before making any PAYE adjustments; (4) Maintain all documentation. The specific process depends on the applicable DTA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Je, 'gross wage' kwa NSSF ni sawa na 'gross salary' kwenye payslip?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla ndiyo — mshahara mkubwa wa jumla (gross wage) kwa NSSF ni jumla ya malipo yote ya mfanyakazi kabla ya makato: mshahara wa msingi, posho za kawaida, overtime, na malipo mengine yanayolipwa kawaida. Si jumla ya aina yoyote ya malipo ya pekee au reimbursements. Kiwango: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya gross wage. Msingi huu ni tofauti na 'basic salary' — NSSF haihesabiwi kwa mshahara wa msingi peke yake.
question_en: Is 'gross wage' for NSSF the same as 'gross salary' on the payslip?
answer_en: Generally yes — gross wage for NSSF is the total of all regular employee payments before deductions: basic salary, regular allowances, overtime, and other regularly paid components. It does not include one-off special payments or reimbursements. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. This base differs from 'basic salary' — NSSF is not calculated on basic salary alone.

question_sw: Je, SDL inaathiri PAYE ya mfanyakazi?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL (Skills and Development Levy) inalipwa na mwajiri kutoka mfuko wake mwenyewe — haikimuzi mfanyakazi. SDL haifanyi mabadiliko kwenye msingi wa PAYE wa mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Does SDL affect an employee's PAYE calculation?
answer_en: No. SDL (Skills and Development Levy) is paid by the employer from their own funds — it is not deducted from the employee. SDL does not change the employee's PAYE base. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri alipuka (liquidation) — je, SDL inaendelea kulipwa?
answer_sw: Katika mchakato wa ufilisi (liquidation), mdhamini (liquidator) analipa madeni ya serikali ikiwa ni pamoja na SDL iliyobakia. SDL iliyokwisha kulipwa ni faida kwa wafanyakazi — ilikwenda kwa VETA/TRA. SDL inayobakia ni deni la awali (priority debt) katika ufilisi.
question_en: An employer goes into liquidation — does SDL continue to be paid?
answer_en: During liquidation, the liquidator pays government debts including outstanding SDL. SDL already paid was for the benefit of employees — it went to VETA/TRA. Outstanding SDL is a priority debt in the liquidation process.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Mshahara wa mfanyakazi unabadilika kutoka TZS 500,000 hadi TZS 900,000 kuanzia Aprili. PAYE ya Aprili inahesabiwaje?
answer_sw: PAYE ya Aprili inategemea mshahara mpya wa TZS 900,000. Mwajiri anahesabu kwa mwezi huo peke yake: Kundi 1 (0–270,000): TZS 0. Kundi 2 (270,001–520,000): 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000. Kundi 3 (520,001–760,000): 240,000 × 20% = TZS 48,000. Kundi 4 (760,001–900,000): 140,000 × 25% = TZS 35,000. Jumla = TZS 103,000. Punguzo la kibinafsi TZS 26,000. PAYE ya Aprili = TZS 77,000. Hakuna marekebisho ya nyuma kwa miezi iliyopita.
answer_en: April PAYE is based on the new salary of TZS 900,000. The employer calculates for that month alone: Band 1 (0–270,000): TZS 0. Band 2 (270,001–520,000): 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000. Band 3 (520,001–760,000): 240,000 × 20% = TZS 48,000. Band 4 (760,001–900,000): 140,000 × 25% = TZS 35,000. Total = TZS 103,000. Personal relief TZS 26,000. April PAYE = TZS 77,000. No retrospective adjustment for prior months.
question_en: An employee's salary changes from TZS 500,000 to TZS 900,000 from April. How is April's PAYE calculated?

instruction: Naweza kuondoa mfanyakazi kwenye NSSF kama ameomba?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Hapana — mfanyakazi hawezi kuomba kutokuwa na NSSF. NSSF ni ya lazima (mandatory) kwa wafanyakazi wote. Hata kama mfanyakazi ana pension nyingine ya kibinafsi, bado analipa NSSF. Mwajiri ana wajibu wa kisheria wa kuripoti na kulipa NSSF kwa kila mfanyakazi.

instruction: Nikiwa msambazaji wa EFD nchini Tanzania, ninahitaji nini kupata idhini ya TRA?
output: Msambazaji wa EFD anahitaji idhini rasmi kutoka TRA. Mchakato wa kupata idhini unajumuisha maombi rasmi kwa TRA, uthibitisho wa ubora wa EFD machine, na makubaliano ya ushirikiano na TRA kuhusu uanzishaji wa mashine na mafunzo. Kwa maelekezo kamili ya utaratibu wa kupata idhini, wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) moja kwa moja — mahitaji yanaweza kubadilika.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anafariki kabla ya kustaafu. Familia yake inapata mafao gani ya NSSF?
answer_sw: Familia ya mfanyakazi aliyefariki inastahili mafao ya maisha (survivor benefits) kutoka NSSF. Wategemezi wa kisheria (mke/mume, watoto chini ya miaka 18, na wazazi wanaotegemea) wanaweza kudai: mafao ya kifo (death grant) — malipo ya mara moja — na mafao ya urithi (survivors pension) kwa wategemezi. Kuomba mafao haya, familia inapaswa: kwenda ofisi ya NSSF na cheti cha kifo, hati za utambulisho wa wategemezi, cheti cha ndoa, na cheti cha kuzaliwa kwa watoto. Madai lazima yafanyike ndani ya muda maalum.
answer_en: The family of a deceased employee is entitled to survivor benefits from NSSF. Legal dependants (spouse, children under 18, and dependent parents) may claim: a death grant (lump sum payment) and a survivor's pension for dependants. To claim these benefits, the family must: go to an NSSF office with a death certificate, identification documents of dependants, a marriage certificate, and birth certificates of children. Claims must be made within a specific time period.
question_en: An employee dies before retirement. What NSSF benefits does their family receive?
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act amendment to survivor benefits

question_sw: GN 487A ilianza kutumika lini Tanzania?
answer_sw: GN 487A — yaani Amri ya 'Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025' — ilianza kutumika rasmi tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Amri hii ilisajiliwa (gazetted) na Serikali ya Tanzania na inaathiri wageni wote wanaofanya biashara katika makundi 15 yaliyoorodheshwa. Operesheni ya utekelezaji wa awali ilifanywa na Idara ya Uhamiaji kati ya 11 Septemba na 8 Oktoba 2025. Biashara zilizokuwepo kabla ya tarehe hii hazikupewa muda maalum wa kustaafu — amri ilianza mara moja.
question_en: When did GN 487A come into effect in Tanzania?
answer_en: GN 487A — the 'Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025' — officially came into effect on 28 July 2025. The Order was gazetted by the Government of Tanzania and affects all non-citizens operating businesses in the 15 listed categories. The initial enforcement exercise was conducted by the Immigration Department between 11 September and 8 October 2025. Businesses that existed before this date were not given a specific wind-down period — the Order took immediate effect.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Mfanyabiashara mmoja asiye na wafanyakazi — bado anahitaji kusajili BRELA?
output: Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. Idadi ya wafanyakazi haibadilishi wajibu wa kusajili BRELA. Hata mfanyabiashara peke yake bila mfanyakazi yeyote lazima asajili biashara yake. Usajili ndio msingi wa uhalali wa biashara Tanzania.

instruction: PAYE ya mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara TZS 800,000 kwa mwezi — nionyeshe hesabu kamili.
output:
Hesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 800,000/mwezi:
Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 = TZS 0
Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000
Bendi 3 (20%): TZS 240,000 × 20% = TZS 48,000
Bendi 4 (25%): TZS 40,000 × 25% = TZS 10,000
PAYE ya jumla: TZS 78,000/mwezi
TZS 40,000 ya ziada juu ya TZS 760,000 iko Bendi 4 (25%) = TZS 10,000.

instruction: Pension yangu kutoka Uingereza — inalipiwa kodi Tanzania ikiwa ninaishi hapa?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Kodi ya pensheni inayotoka nje ya nchi kwa mtu anayeishi Tanzania ni mada inayohusisha DTA, hali ya ukazi (residency status), na Income Tax Act — hizi ni nyanja za kisheria za kodi ya kimataifa nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA kwa biashara za kawaida. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi wa kimataifa au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kuna uhusiano gani kati ya BRELA, TRA, OSHA, na NSSF — wanashiriki taarifa?
answer_sw: Vyombo vya serikali vya Tanzania vina uhusiano wa kushirikiana taarifa unaoendelea kukua. TRA inashirikiana na BRELA — usajili wa kampuni BRELA mara nyingi unahusishwa na mfumo wa TIN moja kwa moja. TRA inaweza kupata taarifa za ajira kutoka NSSF ili kutathmini PAYE na SDL. OSHA na WCF wanaweza pia kushiriki taarifa na TRA. Hii inamaanisha biashara isiyofuata sheria moja inaweza kugunduliwa kupitia chombo kingine.
question_en: What is the relationship between BRELA, TRA, OSHA, and NSSF — do they share information?
answer_en: Tanzania government agencies have a growing data-sharing relationship. TRA cooperates with BRELA — company registration at BRELA is often linked directly to the TIN system. TRA can obtain employment data from NSSF to assess PAYE and SDL. OSHA and WCF may also share data with TRA. This means a business that fails to comply with one agency can be discovered through another.

question_sw: Ninajisajili kwenye mfumo wa IDRAS wa TRA mtandaoni — hatua za kimsingi ni zipi?
answer_sw: Hatua za kujiandikisha kwenye IDRAS (Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System) ya TRA: (1) Nenda kwenye tovuti ya TRA (tra.go.tz) na bonyeza kiungo cha e-Services au IDRAS. (2) Chagua 'Register' au 'Jiandikishe' na jaza fomu kwa kutumia TIN yako iliyosajiliwa. (3) Thibitisha akaunti yako kwa njia ya barua pepe au simu. (4) Ingia kwa mara ya kwanza, seti nywila mpya, na thibitisha maelezo ya biashara yako. (5) Sasa unaweza kuwasilisha returns za PAYE, VAT, SDL na mengine, na kupata PRN za malipo. Kama una tatizo la usajili, tembelea ofisi yoyote ya TRA ukiwa na TIN na hati za biashara.
answer_en: Steps to register on TRA's IDRAS (Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System): (1) Go to the TRA website (tra.go.tz) and click the e-Services or IDRAS link. (2) Select 'Register' and complete the form using your registered TIN. (3) Verify your account via email or phone. (4) Log in for the first time, set a new password, and confirm your business details. (5) You can now file PAYE, VAT, SDL and other returns, and obtain payment PRNs. If you have a registration problem, visit any TRA office with your TIN and business documents.
question_en: I'm registering on TRA's IDRAS system online — what are the basic steps?

question_sw: Mgeni anaweza kufanya kazi Tanzania kwa visa ya utalii ikiwa atapata idhini ya mdomo kutoka mwajiri — je, hii inaruhuliwa?
answer_sw: Hapana. Idhini ya mdomo kutoka mwajiri haina thamani ya kisheria kwa uhamiaji. Kufanya kazi kwa visa ya utalii ni kosa la kisheria hata kama mwajiri amekuambia ni sawa. Mfanyakazi wa kigeni LAZIMA apate kibali rasmi cha kazi kutoka Idara ya Uhamiaji kabla ya kuanza kazi yoyote inayolipwa Tanzania.
question_en: A foreigner can work in Tanzania on a tourist visa if they get verbal approval from the employer — is this permitted?
answer_en: No. Verbal approval from an employer has no legal value for immigration purposes. Working on a tourist visa is a criminal offence even if the employer told you it is fine. A foreign worker MUST obtain a formal work permit from the Immigration Department before starting any paid work in Tanzania.

instruction: SDL 3.5% inakokotolewa kutoka kwa mshahara gani — halisi au kiwango cha chini cha GN605A?
output: SDL ya 3.5% inakokotolewa kutoka jumla halisi ya malipo ya fedha (gross cash emoluments) unayolipa mfanyakazi — si kutoka kiwango cha chini cha GN605A. Kwa hivyo kama unalipa zaidi ya kiwango cha chini, SDL inakokotolewa kutoka mshahara halisi unaolipwa. SDL inatumika kwa wajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi kwenye Tanzania Bara. Kwa msaada wa mahesabu ya SDL, wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi au TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina biashara na kampuni mama yake (related party) — je, kuna kanuni maalum za kodi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Transfer pricing (bei ya uhamishaji kati ya kampuni zinazohusiana) ni mada ngumu ya kodi ya kimataifa inayohitaji utaalamu wa hali ya juu nje ya wigo wangu wa VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia compliance ya biashara ya kawaida Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz au kampuni ya ushauri wa kodi ya kimataifa (EY, KPMG, PWC Tanzania) kwa jibu sahihi.

instruction: SDL inahesabiwaje? Ni mwajiri au mfanyakazi analipa?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Mfanyakazi HALIPIWI SDL kwenye mshahara wake — mwajiri ndiye analipa kwa jina lake mwenyewe. Mfano: wafanyakazi 10 wenye jumla ya mishahara TZS 3,000,000 → SDL = TZS 105,000.

question_sw: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa TRA, mlipa kodi ana haki gani anayopaswa kujua?
answer_sw: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa TRA, mlipa kodi ana haki zifuatazo: haki ya kupewa taarifa ya mapema ya ukaguzi (advance notice) isipokuwa ukaguzi wa ghafla ulioidhinishwa kisheria, haki ya kuomba nakala ya amri ya ukaguzi, haki ya kuwasiliana na mshauri wa kodi au wakili wakati wote wa ukaguzi, haki ya kujibu maswali kwa maandishi badala ya kwa mdomo, haki ya kupinga matokeo ya ukaguzi kabla ya tathmini ya mwisho, na haki ya kupata nakala ya ripoti ya ukaguzi. Msaada wa mshauri wa kodi uliosajiliwa unasaidia kulinda haki hizi.
answer_en: During a TRA audit, the taxpayer has the following rights: the right to receive advance notice of the audit (except for a court-authorised surprise audit), the right to request a copy of the audit order, the right to consult a tax adviser or lawyer at all times during the audit, the right to respond to questions in writing rather than verbally, the right to challenge audit findings before a final assessment is issued, and the right to receive a copy of the audit report. Support from a registered tax consultant helps protect these rights.
question_en: During a TRA audit, what rights does the taxpayer have that they should know?

instruction: Je, serikali ya Tanzania inagawana mapato ya madini na serikali za mitaa — jinsi gani?
output: Royalties za madini zinasimamiwa na Sheria ya Madini Tanzania na zinategemea aina ya madini yanayochimbwa. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Mgawanyo wa mapato ya madini kati ya serikali kuu na serikali za mitaa unashughulikiwa chini ya Sheria ya Madini na Sheria ya Fedha za Serikali za Mitaa — inahitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na Wizara ya Madini au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Wasiliana pia na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: 'Mnunuzi anayehitimu' (qualifying buyer) kwa VAT withholding ni nani hasa — ni mtu yeyote aliyesajili VAT?
answer_sw: Hapana — 'mnunuzi anayehitimu' (qualifying buyer) si mtu yeyote aliyesajili VAT. Qualifying buyer ni: (a) Wizara za Serikali na taasisi za serikali; (b) taasisi zinazohifadhi mapato yake mwenyewe (self-accounting entities); au (c) mtu aliyeteuliwa rasmi na Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA kama wakala wa zuio la VAT (designated VAT withholding agent). Kampuni ya kawaida iliyosajili VAT si qualifying buyer — haiwezi kuzuia VAT ya wasambazaji wake bila uteuzi maalum wa TRA.
question_en: Who exactly is a 'qualifying buyer' for VAT withholding — is it anyone who has registered for VAT?
answer_en: No — a 'qualifying buyer' is not anyone who has registered for VAT. A qualifying buyer is: (a) Government ministries and government institutions; (b) self-accounting entities; or (c) a person formally designated by the TRA Commissioner General as a designated VAT withholding agent. An ordinary company that has registered for VAT is NOT a qualifying buyer — it cannot withhold VAT from its suppliers without a specific TRA designation.
