question_sw: Kubadilisha kibali cha kazi kunaondoa mipaka ya GN 487A — kweli au uongo?
answer_sw: Uongo. Kibali cha kazi kinahusu aina ya kazi unayoruhusiwa kufanya kama MWAJIRIWA. GN 487A inahusu aina za biashara unazoruhusiwa KUMILIKI au KUENDESHA. Hata ukiwa na Class A, D, au E, bado huwezi kumiliki biashara iliyoorodheshwa kwenye GN 487A. Ni vikwazo viwili tofauti kabisa.
question_en: Changing a work permit removes GN 487A restrictions — true or false?
answer_en: False. A work permit governs the type of employment you are permitted to do as an EMPLOYEE. GN 487A governs the types of businesses you are permitted to OWN or OPERATE. Even with a Class A, D, or E permit, you still cannot own a business listed under GN 487A. They are two completely separate restrictions.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Muda wa kuwasilisha pingamizi kwa TRA ni siku ngapi baada ya kupokea tathmini?
answer_sw: Muda wa kuwasilisha pingamizi kwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA ni siku 30 baada ya kupokea tathmini ya kodi. Ikiwa muda huu umepita bila pingamizi, tathmini inakuwa ya mwisho kisheria. Katika hali fulani za kipekee inaweza kuomba muda wa ziada, lakini hii si ya kawaida.
question_en: Within how many days of receiving a tax assessment must an objection to TRA be filed?
answer_en: An objection to the TRA Commissioner General must be filed within 30 days of receiving the tax assessment. If this period passes without an objection the assessment becomes final in law. In exceptional circumstances an extension may be requested, but this is not guaranteed.

instruction: Mwuzaji wa stendi ya soko — je, lazima atumie EFD?
output: Inategemea aina ya biashara na orodha ya TRA: EFD inahitajika kwa makundi maalum ya biashara yaliyobainishwa na TRA — vikundi vinavyojumuisha wauzaji wengi wa soko kama duka la rejareja, hoteli, migahawa, maduka ya nguo, maduka ya dawa, n.k. Mwuzaji mdogo wa stendi (machinga) ambaye si katika mfumo wa kodi ya kawaida anaweza kuwa amepewa muda wa mazoea. Hata hivyo, biashara inayokua na kufikia kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200M/mwaka) au iliyosajiliwa VAT LAZIMA itumie EFD. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kuhusu hali yako maalum.

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kudai input VAT ya miaka iliyopita ambayo haikudaiwa wakati wake?
answer_sw: Kuna ukomo wa muda (time limit) wa kudai input VAT. Tanzania inatumia ukomo wa miaka 3 kwa marekebisho ya kodi kwa ujumla. Input VAT isiyodaiwa baada ya ukomo huu inaweza kupotea. Thibitisha ukomo halisi wa sasa na TRA au mshauri wa kodi — na jaribu kudai input VAT kwa wakati wake kila mwezi.
question_en: Can I claim input VAT from past years that was not claimed at the time?
answer_en: There is a time limit for claiming input VAT. Tanzania generally applies a 3-year limit for tax amendments. Unclaimed input VAT after this limit may be forfeited. Confirm the current exact limit with TRA or a tax advisor — and try to claim input VAT on time each month.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Mtu mmoja alisema SDL ni "Staff Development Levy". Je, ni jina sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Jina sahihi ni Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi kwa Kiswahili. Si "Staff Development Levy". Inajumuisha maana pana ya kukuza ujuzi kwa wafanyakazi wote, si tu wafanyakazi wa ndani ya shirika. Kiwango ni asilimia 3.5, mwajiri peke yake, wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi.
question_en: Someone said SDL is "Staff Development Levy". Is that the correct name?
answer_en: No. The correct name is Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi in Swahili. Not "Staff Development Levy". It covers the broader meaning of skills development for all workers, not just internal staff. Rate: 3.5%, employer only, 10 or more employees.

question_sw: Adhabu ya mgeni (non-citizen) anayekutwa akifanya biashara iliyokatazwa chini ya GN 487A ni nini hasa?
answer_sw: Adhabu kamili ya mgeni ni adhabu TATU PAMOJA: (1) faini ya ISIYOPUNGUA TZS 10,000,000 (si zaidi ya — ni kiwango cha CHINI); (2) kifungo kisichozidi miezi 6; NA (3) kufutwa kwa visa na kibali chake cha ukaazi. Maneno muhimu: 'isiyopungua' inamaanisha TZS 10M ni adhabu ya CHINI KABISA — korti inaweza kutoza zaidi. Adhabu hizi tatu zinakwenda pamoja — si moja au nyingine.
question_en: What exactly is the penalty for a non-citizen caught conducting a prohibited business under GN 487A?
answer_en: The full penalty for a non-citizen is THREE penalties TOGETHER: (1) a fine NOT LESS THAN TZS 10,000,000 (not a maximum — it is the MINIMUM); (2) imprisonment not exceeding 6 months; AND (3) revocation of their visa and residence permit. Key language: 'not less than' means TZS 10M is the FLOOR — a court may impose more. All three penalties apply together — not one or the other.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Kampuni hakulipa kodi ya awali (provisional tax) kwa wakati. Matokeo yake ni nini?
answer_sw: Kushindwa kulipa kodi ya awali kwa wakati kunasababisha: riba ya kisheria (statutory interest) inayohesabiwaje kwa kiwango kilichowekwa na Benki Kuu na kuwa inayolipwa kama adhabu kwa TRA. Riba inakusanyika kila siku kutoka tarehe ya mwisho ya malipo iliyopita. Zaidi ya hayo, ikiwa kampuni hakulipa kodi ya awali yoyote kwa mwaka mzima na inaongeza mzigo mkubwa wa kodi mwishoni mwa mwaka, TRA inaweza kuanza hatua za utekelezaji wa kisheria. Ni muhimu kulipa awamu zote kwa wakati — Machi 31, Juni 30, Septemba 30, na Desemba 31.
answer_en: Failure to pay provisional tax on time results in: statutory interest calculated at the rate set by the Central Bank, payable as a penalty to TRA. Interest accumulates daily from the date the payment was due. Additionally, if a company pays no provisional tax at all during the year and accumulates a large tax burden at year end, TRA may initiate legal enforcement steps. It is essential to pay all instalments on time — 31 March, 30 June, 30 September, and 31 December.
question_en: A company did not pay provisional tax on time. What are the consequences?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — provisional tax late payment
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to interest rates

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni aliyeajiriwa Tanzania anahitaji kusajiliwa NSSF na WCF — je, wana haki sawa na Watanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi wa kigeni aliyeajiriwa kisheria Tanzania (mwenye kibali halisi cha kazi) ana haki sawa za kisheria za NSSF na WCF kama mfanyakazi wa Kitanzania. Mwajiri lazima asajili mfanyakazi wa kigeni NSSF na WCF na kuwasilisha michango. Uraia wa mfanyakazi hauathiri wajibu wa mwajiri wa kuhifadhi bima na manufaa ya kijamii.
question_en: Is a foreign employee hired in Tanzania required to be registered with NSSF and WCF — do they have equal rights to Tanzanians?
answer_en: Yes. A foreign worker lawfully employed in Tanzania (with a valid work permit) has the same legal rights to NSSF and WCF as a Tanzanian employee. The employer must register the foreign worker with NSSF and WCF and remit contributions. The worker's citizenship does not affect the employer's obligation to maintain social security and insurance coverage.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi anayeomba kazi mpya ana haki ya kuuliza mwajiri wa zamani mshahara wake wote?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi ana haki ya kupokea malipo yake yote ya mwisho ikiwa ni pamoja na mshahara wa mwisho, malipo ya likizo iliyosalia, na posho nyingine zote zinazodaiwa. Mwajiri ana wajibu wa kulipa haya ndani ya siku 7 baada ya kumaliza ajira.
question_en: When leaving a job does an employee have a right to receive all owed wages?
answer_en: Yes. An employee is entitled to receive all final payments including last salary, accrued leave pay, and any other owed allowances. The employer must pay these within 7 days of termination of employment.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Kampuni ya uwekezaji iliyoidhinishwa (TIC) inapata msamaha wa kodi. Je, msamaha huo unaweza kudumishwa daima?
answer_sw: Hapana. Misamaha ya kodi inayotolewa na Kituo cha Uwekezaji Tanzania (TIC) chini ya Sheria ya Uwekezaji wa Tanzania ina kipindi maalum cha miaka kadhaa. Kampuni lazima itimize masharti ya uwekezaji (kama vile mimi wa uwekezaji, idadi ya wafanyakazi, na sekta) kudumisha msamaha. Msamaha unaweza kuondolewa ikiwa masharti hayatimizwi au mwaka wake unaisha bila kuhuishwa. Angalia hati yako ya usajili wa TIC kwa masharti mahususi na muda.
answer_en: No. Tax incentives granted by the Tanzania Investment Centre (TIC) under the Tanzania Investment Act have a specific period of several years. The company must meet investment conditions (such as investment amount, employee numbers, and sector) to maintain the exemption. The exemption may be withdrawn if conditions are not met or its term expires without renewal. Review your TIC registration certificate for specific conditions and duration.
question_en: A TIC-approved investment company receives a tax exemption. Can that exemption be maintained permanently?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — TIC investment incentives
next_review_trigger: TIC incentive policy change or Investment Act amendment

instruction: Mfanyakazi wa kazi ya muda (part-time) ambaye anafanya kazi siku 3 kwa wiki — anahesabiwa katika kizingiti cha 10 cha SDL?
output: Ndiyo — SDL inazingatia IDADI ya wafanyakazi wote (full-time na part-time) ambao wanafanya kazi kwako, bila kujali muda wa kazi. Mfanyakazi wa part-time anahesabiwa kama mfanyakazi mmoja kamili kwa madhumuni ya kizingiti cha 10. Kwa SDL base (malipo): unalipa 3.5% ya kiasi halisi unachompa mfanyakazi wa part-time (si mshahara kamili kwa kuwa anafanya siku 3 tu). Kwa hiyo kama una wafanyakazi 8 wa full-time na 2 wa part-time = wafanyakazi 10 — SDL inaanza. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: NSSF inapaswa kulipwa tarehe ngapi kila mwezi?
output: NSSF lazima iwasilishwe ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwisho wa mwezi wa malipo ya wafanyakazi — kwa kawaida ifikapo tarehe ya mwisho wa mwezi unaofuata. Kwa mfano: mishahara ya Januari → NSSF iwasilishwe kabla ya mwisho wa Februari. Thibitisha tarehe halisi ya sasa na nssf.or.tz — tarehe inaweza kubadilika. Muhimu: usisubiri mpaka mwisho — lipa mapema kuepuka mkusanyiko wa faini ya 5%/mwezi. Thibitisha na nssf.or.tz kwa tarehe halisi ya sasa.

instruction: BRELA inasajili biashara ngapi — nimesikia kuna zaidi ya kumi?
output: Hapana — BRELA inasajili aina TATU za biashara: 1. Biashara ya jina (sole trader/business name) 2. Ubia (partnership) 3. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company). Hakuna aina nyingine ya nne au ya tano chini ya Companies Act Tanzania. Nambari 16 au nyingine kubwa inaweza kutoka chanzo kisicho sahihi. Thibitisha kila wakati na brela.go.tz.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mmoja analipwa TZS 800,000 kwa mwezi. SDL ya mfanyakazi huyu peke yake ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — haihesabiwi kwa mfanyakazi mmoja mmoja. Inatolewa kwa msingi wa jumla ya mishahara yote ya kampuni. Ikiwa kampuni ina wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, SDL = jumla ya mishahara yote × 3.5%. Kwa mfano: wafanyakazi 10 wote wanaolipwa TZS 800,000 kila mmoja = jumla TZS 8,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 280,000 SDL kwa mwezi.
question_en: One employee earns TZS 800,000 per month. What is the SDL for this employee alone?
answer_en: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — is not calculated per individual employee. It is based on the company's total gross payroll. If the company has 10 or more employees, SDL = total payroll × 3.5%. Example: 10 employees each earning TZS 800,000 = total TZS 8,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 280,000 SDL per month.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anapata TZS 800,000 kwa mwezi. Hesabu PAYE yake hatua kwa hatua.
question_en: An employee earns TZS 800,000 per month. Calculate their PAYE step by step.
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — worked example ITA Cap.332 Finance Act 2025

question_sw: Mtu asiye raia wa Tanzania anaweza kuwa wakala wa M-Pesa au Airtel Money?
answer_sw: Hapana. Chini ya GN 487A (2025), huduma za uhamisho wa pesa kwa simu (mobile money agent services) ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania. Mtu asiye raia hawezi kuwa wakala wa M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa, au mtandao wowote wa pesa za simu kama biashara yake binafsi. Adhabu kwa ukiukwaji ni faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 na kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 jela, pamoja na kufutwa kwa viza. Raia wa Tanzania wanaofanya uwezeshaji wanahatarisha faini ya TZS milioni 5 au kifungo cha miezi 3.
question_en: Can a non-Tanzanian citizen become an M-Pesa or Airtel Money agent?
answer_en: No. Under GN 487A (2025), mobile money transfer agent services are one of the 15 business activities prohibited for non-citizens. A non-citizen cannot operate as an M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa, or any mobile money network agent as their own business. Penalties for violation are a minimum TZS 10 million fine and up to 6 months imprisonment, plus visa revocation. Tanzanian citizens who facilitate such arrangements risk a TZS 5 million fine or 3 months imprisonment.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya riba (interest) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya riba ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on interest in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on interest is 10% for residents and 10% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kazi ya ziada (overtime) inalipwa PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Malipo ya kazi ya ziada yanajumuishwa katika jumla ya mapato ya mwezi na yanastahili PAYE kwa kiwango kinacholingana na kanda ya mapato. Hakuna kiwango maalum cha PAYE kwa overtime peke yake. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Is overtime pay subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Overtime pay is included in total monthly earnings and is subject to PAYE at the applicable rate band. There is no separate PAYE rate for overtime. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania yenye makao makuu Mombasa Kenya — inaweza kusajiliwa Tanzania bila tawi (branch) rasmi?
answer_sw: Kampuni ya kigeni inayofanya shughuli Tanzania inahitaji kusajili tawi lake (foreign branch) kwa BRELA Tanzania. Kampuni ya Kenya inayouza bidhaa au kutoa huduma Tanzania kwa njia ya kawaida ya biashara lazima isajili tawi la Tanzania. Kampuni isiyosajili tawi inafanya shughuli nje ya sheria na inaweza kusababisha matatizo ya kodi na kisheria kwa Tanzania.
question_en: A Tanzania company with headquarters in Mombasa Kenya — can it operate in Tanzania without a formal branch?
answer_en: A foreign company conducting business in Tanzania needs to register its branch (foreign branch) with BRELA Tanzania. A Kenya company regularly selling goods or providing services in Tanzania must register a Tanzania branch. A company that does not register a branch is operating outside the law and can create tax and legal problems in Tanzania.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: Companies Act or foreign branch registration update

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana posho za nyumba (housing allowance) na chakula (meal allowance). Je, hizi zinatozwa NSSF?
answer_sw: Posho zinazolipwa kawaida kama sehemu ya mshahara (housing allowance, meal allowance) kwa ujumla zinajumuishwa kwenye msingi wa NSSF — yaani mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Hii ni kwa sababu NSSF inategemea 'gross wage' si 'basic salary'. Posho zinazolipwa mara moja au zinazorejesha gharama halisi (reimbursements) zinaweza kushughulikiwa tofauti. Wasiliana na NSSF kwa mwongozo wa aina mahususi za posho.
question_en: An employee has housing and meal allowances. Are these subject to NSSF?
answer_en: Allowances regularly paid as part of compensation (housing allowance, meal allowance) are generally included in the NSSF gross wage base. This is because NSSF is based on 'gross wage' not 'basic salary'. One-off allowances or genuine reimbursements of actual expenses may be treated differently. Contact NSSF for guidance on specific types of allowances.

question_sw: WHT na VAT withholding ni tofauti — kampuni inaweza kuchanganya?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, hizi ni ushuru tofauti kabisa. WHT (Withholding Tax) inahusu kodi ya mapato kwenye malipo ya huduma, gawio, na riba. VAT withholding (3%/6% kuanzia Julai 2025) inahusu VAT inayopitiwa kwa wakala wa serikali. Kampuni inapaswa kuhesabu na kuripoti kila moja tofauti — kutafsiriwa pamoja ni kosa la kisheria.
question_en: WHT and VAT withholding are different — can a company confuse them?
answer_en: Yes, these are completely different taxes. WHT (Withholding Tax) covers income tax on service payments, dividends, and interest. VAT withholding (3%/6% from July 2025) covers VAT channelled through government agencies. A company must calculate and report each separately — confusing them is a legal error.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act WHT and VAT amendment

question_sw: SDL inakatwa kutoka kwa mfanyakazi au mwajiri ndiye analipa?
answer_sw: Mwajiri ndiye analipa SDL — hakatiwi kutoka kwa mfanyakazi. Hii ni tofauti muhimu na PAYE (ambayo inakatwa kutoka kwa mshahara wa mfanyakazi). SDL ni gharama ya mwajiri peke yake, inayolipwa TRA kama ushuru tofauti.
question_en: Is SDL deducted from the employee or does the employer pay it?
answer_en: The employer pays SDL — it is NOT deducted from the employee's salary. This is an important difference from PAYE (which is deducted from the employee's pay). SDL is entirely the employer's cost, paid to TRA as a separate levy.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: Mwajiri mpya anapaswa kusajili na NSSF lini?
output: Kila mwajiri lazima asajiliwe NSSF haraka iwezekanavyo baada ya kuanza kuajiri. Usajilishaji wa NSSF lazima ufanyike mapema mara ajira ya kwanza inapoanza — wasiliana na NSSF (nssf.or.tz) kwa tarehe halisi ya mwisho. Kuchelewa kusajili kunaweza kusababisha adhabu na malipo ya nyuma.

question_sw: GN 605A na CBA (makubaliano ya pamoja ya mishahara) vinaendanaje?
answer_sw: GN 605A inaweka kiwango cha chini cha lazima cha kisheria. CBA inaweza kuweka viwango vya juu kuliko GN 605A — na hivyo inatumika kwa wafanyakazi wanaofunikwa na CBA hiyo. CBA haiwezi kuweka viwango vya chini kuliko GN 605A — hilo haliruhusiwi kisheria. GN 605A ni sakafu; CBA inaweza kuwa dari la juu.
question_en: How do GN 605A and a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) interact?
answer_en: GN 605A sets the mandatory legal floor. A CBA can set rates higher than GN 605A — and those higher rates apply to workers covered by that CBA. A CBA cannot set rates below GN 605A — that is legally prohibited. GN 605A is the floor; a CBA can be a higher ceiling.

question_sw: Nataka kufungua biashara ya kuuza nguo — ninahitaji nini BRELA?
answer_sw: Kwa biashara ya nguo, unahitaji kusajili jina la biashara au kampuni na BRELA. Hatua ni: (1) chagua jina na lilithbitishe BRELA halijachukuliwa, (2) wasilisha fomu ya usajili na ada (karibu Shilingi 20,000-50,000), (3) pata cheti cha usajili. Kisha nenda TRA kwa TIN na leseni ya biashara ya manispaa.
question_en: I want to start a clothes selling business — what do I need from BRELA?
answer_en: For a clothes business you need to register a business name or company with BRELA. The steps are: (1) choose a name and confirm with BRELA it is not taken, (2) submit the registration form and fee (approximately TZS 20,000-50,000), (3) receive your registration certificate. Then go to TRA for a TIN and the municipal trading licence.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mfanyabiashara wa Tanzania anaweza kutumia STR kuuza bidhaa Kenya?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyabiashara wa Tanzania anaweza kutumia STR kuuza bidhaa Kenya (na nchi nyingine wanachama) kama masharti yanakidhiwa: bidhaa zimezalishwa Tanzania (originating ✓), zipo kwenye Common List (✓), na thamani haitazidi USD 2,000 kwa msafara (✓). STR inafanya kazi kwa njia mbili — kuingiza na kutoa bidhaa.
question_en: Can a Tanzanian trader use STR to sell goods in Kenya?
answer_en: Yes. A Tanzanian trader can use STR to sell goods in Kenya (and other member states) if conditions are met: goods produced in Tanzania (originating ✓), on the Common List (✓), and value does not exceed USD 2,000 per consignment (✓). STR works in both directions — importing and exporting.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayeumia mahali pa kazi Tanzania analipwa fidia na OSHA moja kwa moja — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Fidia ya mfanyakazi aliyeumia mahali pa kazi inalipwa na WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) — SI OSHA. OSHA inasimamia usalama na afya mahali pa kazi na inachunguza ajali. WCF ndiyo inayolipa fidia kwa wafanyakazi walioumia au kufiwa. OSHA na WCF ni vyombo tofauti vya serikali vinavyofanya kazi tofauti.
question_en: A worker injured in the workplace in Tanzania is paid compensation directly by OSHA — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Compensation for a worker injured in the workplace is paid by WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) — NOT OSHA. OSHA supervises workplace safety and health and investigates accidents. WCF is what pays compensation to injured or bereaved workers. OSHA and WCF are separate government bodies doing different work.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act or WCF Act amendment

question_sw: Posho ya makazi (housing allowance) haizingatiwi kama mapato ya PAYE — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Posho ya makazi kwa ujumla inajumuishwa kama mapato yanayotoza PAYE. Isipokuwa kama nyumba inatolewa moja kwa moja na mwajiri (sio posho ya pesa), kuna ufupisho maalum. Lakini posho ya makazi inayolipwa kwa pesa nyingi moja kwa moja kwa mfanyakazi inatoza PAYE kwa kawaida.
question_en: Housing allowance is not considered PAYE taxable income — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Housing allowance is generally included as PAYE-taxable income. Unless housing is provided directly by the employer (not as a cash allowance), specific provisions apply. But a housing allowance paid as cash directly to the employee is normally subject to PAYE.

question_sw: Kaka yangu aliyekuwa mgeni lakini sasa ana uraia wa Tanzania — je, GN 487A inamzuia bado?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mtu aliyepata uraia wa Tanzania kwa njia ya kisheria sio tena 'mgeni' kwa madhumuni ya GN 487A. GN 487A inazuia 'watu wasio raia wa Tanzania' — na kaka yako sasa ni raia wa Tanzania. Anaweza kufanya biashara katika makundi yote 15 yaliyozuiliwa kwa wageni, kwa sababu kama raia wa Tanzania ana haki kamili za kibiashara. Atahitaji leseni za kawaida za biashara, usajili wa TRA, na vibali vingine vya kawaida, lakini si kizuizi cha GN 487A.
question_en: My brother used to be a non-citizen but now has Tanzanian citizenship — does GN 487A still restrict him?
answer_en: No. A person who has lawfully obtained Tanzanian citizenship is no longer a 'non-citizen' for GN 487A purposes. GN 487A restricts 'persons who are not Tanzanian citizens' — and your brother is now a Tanzanian citizen. He can operate businesses in all 15 categories that were previously restricted for non-citizens, because as a Tanzanian citizen he has full business rights. He will need the normal business licences, TRA registration, and other standard permits, but not the GN 487A restriction.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya riba (interest) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya riba ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on interest in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on interest is 10% for residents and 10% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: VAT withholding agent ni nani hasa? Biashara yangu inaandaa kupeleka zabuni serikalini.
output: Mnunuzi anayehitimu (qualifying withholding agent) ni mtu au taasisi iliyoteuliwa na TRA kukata sehemu ya VAT ya msambazaji wakati wa malipo. Wanunuzi wanaohitimu mara nyingi ni wizara za serikali, taasisi za umma, na watu wengine walioidhinishwa rasmi na Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA. Ili kujua kama biashara yako inaweza kuwa withholding agent, wasiliana na TRA moja kwa moja (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Usajili wa VAT unahitajika lini Tanzania?
output: Usajili wa VAT ni lazima ukifika kizingiti cha TZS milioni 200 kwa miezi 12 au TZS milioni 100 kwa miezi 6. Kizingiti cha TZS 200M/12 miezi: ukipita kiasi hiki katika mwaka wowote, lazima usajili VAT ndani ya siku 30. Chanzo: VAT Act na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Kampuni ya kilimo Tanzania yenye wafanyakazi wa msimu 50 — inahitaji kusajili OSHA na WCF kwa wafanyakazi hao?
answer_sw: Wafanyakazi wa msimu wanaolipwa mishahara bado wanashughulikiwa na sheria za kazi Tanzania. WCF: mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi hata 1 (ikiwa ni pamoja na wa msimu) anahitaji WCF — bima ya ajali inashughulikia wafanyakazi wote. OSHA: ikiwa jumla ya wafanyakazi (ikiwa ni pamoja na wa msimu) inafika 10+, mwajiri analazimishwa kusajili OSHA. Kilimo kina hatari za maalum (kemikali, vifaa vya kulima) zinazofanya OSHA muhimu zaidi.
question_en: A farming company in Tanzania with 50 seasonal workers — does it need to register with OSHA and WCF for those workers?
answer_en: Seasonal workers receiving wages are still covered by Tanzania labour law. WCF: an employer with even 1 worker (including seasonal) needs WCF — accident insurance covers all workers. OSHA: if total worker count (including seasonal) reaches 10+, the employer is required to register with OSHA. Agriculture has specific hazards (chemicals, farming equipment) that make OSHA even more important.
next_review_trigger: Workers Compensation Act or OSHA Act amendment

question_sw: Mfanyabiashara wa mpakani wa Tunduma — GN 487A inamsimamia?
answer_sw: Kama mfanyabiashara ni raia wa Tanzania, GN 487A haimsimamia — inalinda raia wa Tanzania katika sekta zilizokatazwa kwa wageni. Kama mfanyabiashara ni raia wa kigeni (Zambia, au nchi nyingine), GN 487A inaweza kutumika kama anafanya shughuli zilizo kwenye orodha ya 15 (kama biashara ya rejareja). Uraia ndio kigezo.
question_en: A border trader at Tunduma — does GN 487A apply to them?
answer_en: If the trader is a Tanzanian citizen, GN 487A does not apply to them — it protects Tanzanian citizens in sectors prohibited to foreigners. If the trader is a non-citizen (Zambian, or from another country), GN 487A may apply if they are conducting activities on the list of 15 (like retail trade). Citizenship is the criterion.

question_sw: Faini ya kuchelewa kulipa NSSF Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Faini ya kuchelewa kulipa NSSF ni asilimia 5 ya kiwango kilichochelewa kwa kila mwezi au sehemu ya mwezi baada ya tarehe ya malipo. Faini inakusanywa kama deni kutoka kwa mwajiri. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: What is the penalty for late NSSF contribution payment in Tanzania?
answer_en: The late NSSF contribution penalty is 5% of the unpaid amount for each month or part of a month after the due date. The penalty is recovered as a debt from the employer. Confirm with NSSF.

instruction: Kwa nini mtu anayetumia jina lake mwenyewe bado anahitaji BRELA? Inaonekana kama faida ndogo.
output: Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. Faida za vitendo: (1) Unaweza kufungua akaunti ya benki kwa jina la biashara. (2) Unaweza kuingia mikataba rasmi. (3) Unalindwa na mtu mwingine kutumia jina lako la biashara. (4) Wateja wakubwa na serikali wanahitaji cheti cha BRELA. Usajili ni hatua ya msingi ya biashara halali.

instruction: Nilichelewa annual return BRELA kwa miezi 3 — ninapaswa kulipa kiasi gani?
output: Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Thibitisha ada halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz). Thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA kwani yanaweza kutumia mwezi wowote wa sehemu kama mwezi kamili.

question_sw: Kampuni yetu iko katika Eneo la Usindikaji wa Uuzaji Nje (EPZ). Je, tunalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Kampuni zilizo ndani ya Eneo la Usindikaji wa Uuzaji Nje (Export Processing Zone — EPZ) zina msamaha wa SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — kulingana na faida za EPZ. Msamaha huu ni sehemu ya vivutio vya uwekezaji vya EPZ Tanzania. Thibitisha hali yako ya msamaha na EPZ Authority na TRA kwa maandishi kabla ya kusimama kulipa SDL.
question_en: Our company is in an Export Processing Zone (EPZ). Do we pay SDL?
answer_en: Companies located within an Export Processing Zone (EPZ) are exempt from SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — as part of the EPZ investment incentives package. This exemption is part of Tanzania's EPZ investment incentives. Confirm your exemption status in writing with the EPZ Authority and TRA before stopping SDL payments.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio kwa kampuni zingine (zisizoorodheshwa DSE) ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio kwa kampuni zisizoorodheshwa DSE ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi. Kama kampuni inayopokea gawio inamiliki zaidi ya asilimia 25 ya hisa — kiwango ni asilimia 5. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on dividends from non-DSE-listed companies?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on dividends from non-DSE-listed companies is 10% for residents and 10% for non-residents. If the recipient company holds 25%+ of shares — the rate is 5%. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Adhabu ya msaidizi Mtanzania ni faini YA TZS 5M NA kifungo miezi 3 — ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Si sahihi — adhabu ya msaidizi ni faini ya hadi TZS 5M AU kifungo hadi miezi 3, si zote mbili. Neno 'AU' ni muhimu sana hapa — korti inachagua moja kati ya hizi mbili. Tofauti na mgeni ambapo adhabu TATU zinakwenda pamoja (faini NA kifungo NA visa kufutwa), msaidizi anapata adhabu moja tu kati ya mbili zilizotajwa.
question_en: Is the Tanzanian facilitator's penalty a TZS 5M fine AND 3 months imprisonment — is that correct?
answer_en: That is not correct — the facilitator's penalty is a fine of up to TZS 5M OR imprisonment up to 3 months, not both. The word 'OR' is critical here — the court chooses one of the two. Unlike the non-citizen where THREE penalties apply together (fine AND imprisonment AND visa revocation), the facilitator receives only one of the two stated penalties.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mwajiri analipa PAYE ifikapo tarehe 20 ya kila mwezi unaofuata — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. PAYE inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 ya kila mwezi unaofuata — si tarehe 20. Tarehe 20 ni kwa VATreturn (si PAYE). Mwajiri analazimika kulipa PAYE ya mwezi uliopita ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kuchelewa kunaleta adhabu ya asilimia 2.5.
question_en: An employer pays PAYE by the 20th of each following month — is this correct?
answer_en: No. PAYE is remitted by the 7th of each following month — not the 20th. The 20th is the VAT return deadline (not PAYE). An employer must remit last month's PAYE by the 7th of the following month. Late payment attracts a 2.5% penalty.

instruction: Kwa nini kufutwa kwa visa ni lazima daima — je, korti haiwezi kusamehe?
output: Kufutwa kwa visa ni adhabu ya kisheria inayotekelezwa moja kwa moja chini ya GN 487A na Sheria ya Uhamiaji — si adhabu ya hiari ya korti. Korti inaamua faini AU kifungo (hapa ina uamuzi), lakini kufutwa kwa visa siyo chini ya uamuzi huo. Inatekelezwa na Idara ya Uhamiaji kama hatua tofauti ya kisheria. Hii inamaanisha hata mgeni 'aliyesamehewa' na korti bado anakabiliwa na kufutwa kwa visa na kuondoka Tanzania. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Mgeni ana biashara mbili zilizopigwa marufuku — anapata adhabu mara mbili?
answer_sw: GN 487A haitoi jibu wazi kuhusu biashara nyingi zilizovunjwa wakati mmoja. Kanuni ya jumla ya kisheria Tanzania ni kwamba kila kosa tofauti linaweza kusababisha adhabu tofauti. Hata hivyo, mahakama inaweza kuunganisha adhabu (concurrent sentences) au kuzitoa tofauti (consecutive). Suala hili linahitaji mshauri wa kisheria kwa kesi yako mahususi.
question_en: A non-citizen has two prohibited businesses — do they receive double penalties?
answer_en: GN 487A does not give an explicit answer on multiple violations prosecuted simultaneously. The general Tanzanian legal principle is that each separate offence may result in a separate penalty. However, a court may impose concurrent sentences (running together) or consecutive sentences (one after another). This question requires a legal adviser for your specific case.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Kampuni iliyofutwa orodha BRELA kwa kutokuwasilisha annual return — inaweza kufufuliwa?
output: Ndiyo — kampuni iliyofutwa orodha (deregistered) inaweza kuomba kufufuliwa (restoration) kwa BRELA, lakini mchakato huu unahusisha: (1) Kulipa faini zilizokusanyika zote; (2) Kuwasilisha annual returns zilizokosekana; (3) Kulipa ada ya kufufua kampuni; (4) Mchakato wa kisheria unaopitiwa na BRELA — unaweza kuchukua muda. Wakati kampuni imefutwa orodha, haiwezi kisheria kufanya biashara, kuingia mikataba, au kushikilia mali. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz kwa mchakato kamili wa kufufua.

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kuendelea kufanya biashara wakati kesi ya kodi iko TRAB — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo kwa kawaida. Kesi ya kodi inayoendelea mbele ya TRAB haizuii kampuni kuendelea kufanya biashara. Hata hivyo, TRA inaweza kuchukua hatua za makusanyo kwa kiasi kisichopingwa au kisicholipwa. Cheti cha utii wa kodi kinaweza kuathirika.
question_en: Can a company continue to operate while a tax case is before TRAB — is this true?
answer_en: Yes, generally. A pending TRAB tax case does not stop a company from continuing to operate. However, TRA can take collection action for undisputed or unpaid amounts. A tax clearance certificate may be affected.

question_sw: Mtu anasema GN 487A ni vibali vya kazi vipya kwa wageni — kweli au uongo?
answer_sw: Uongo kabisa. GN 487A haina uhusiano na vibali vya kazi (work permits). Vibali vya kazi — Class A hadi G — vinasimamia mtu anayefanya kazi kama MWAJIRIWA. GN 487A inasimamia aina za biashara ambazo raia wa kigeni hawezi KUMILIKI au KUENDESHA. Ni sheria mbili tofauti kabisa zenye masharti tofauti.
question_en: Someone says GN 487A is new work permits for foreigners — true or false?
answer_en: Completely false. GN 487A has no connection to work permits. Work permits — Class A through G — govern a person working as an EMPLOYEE. GN 487A governs the types of businesses a non-citizen cannot OWN or OPERATE. They are two completely separate laws with different requirements.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Ongezeko la mshahara wa GN 605A lilikuwa asilimia 20 kwa wastani — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ongezeko la wastani lilikuwa asilimia 33.4 — si asilimia 20. Mshahara wa wastani uliongezeka kutoka Shilingi 275,060 hadi Shilingi 358,322. Ongezeko la asilimia 20 lingekuwa likifikia tu Shilingi 330,072 — namba hiyo si sahihi.
question_en: The GN 605A wage increase was 20% on average — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The average increase was 33.4% — not 20%. The average minimum wage rose from TZS 275,060 to TZS 358,322. A 20% increase would have reached only TZS 330,072 — that figure is incorrect.

question_sw: Je, EAC Simplified Trade Regime inafanya kazi vipi kwa biashara ya mpakani?
answer_sw: Maswali ya EAC Simplified Trade Regime (STR) yanaingia katika Tier 1B ya msaada wangu — ambayo bado haijafunguliwa. Kwa sasa ninashughulikia maswali ya kodi za ndani za Tanzania Bara (Tier 1A): VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, GN 487A, EFD. Kwa STR, tembelea eac.int au wasiliana na ofisi za forodha za karibu nawe. Je, una swali la kodi ya ndani Tanzania?
question_en: How does the EAC Simplified Trade Regime work for cross-border trade?
answer_en: EAC Simplified Trade Regime (STR) questions fall under Tier 1B of my assistance — which is not yet open. I currently handle Tanzania Mainland domestic tax questions (Tier 1A): VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, GN 487A, EFD. For STR, visit eac.int or contact your nearest customs office. Do you have a Tanzania domestic tax question?

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni anasema wanalipa kodi UK — wanaweza kuepuka PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: Si kiotomatikilai. Hata kama mfanyakazi analipa kodi UK, PAYE Tanzania bado inatumika kwa mshahara unaotokana na kazi Tanzania isipokuwa wanapata ruhusa maalum kupitia DTA ya Tanzania-UK na TRA inakubali exemption rasmi. Omba rasmi — usitegemea tu madai ya mfanyakazi bila uthibitisho wa TRA.
question_en: A foreign employee says they pay taxes in the UK — can they avoid Tanzania PAYE?
answer_en: Not automatically. Even if an employee pays UK taxes, Tanzania PAYE still applies to income from work in Tanzania unless they obtain specific relief through the Tanzania-UK DTA and TRA formally approves the exemption. Apply formally — do not simply rely on employee claims without TRA confirmation.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

instruction: Ninaishi Uingereza lakini nina nyumba Tanzania — ninapoiuza, kodi ni nini?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Hali ya kodi kwa wasiokuwa wakazi (non-residents) wanaomuza mali Tanzania ni mada inayohusisha makubaliano ya kuzuia kodi mara mbili (Double Taxation Agreement) na taratibu maalum za TRA — iko nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz au mshauri wa kodi wa kimataifa.

question_sw: Je, mkaguzi (contractor) anayefanya kazi ofisini kwangu anahitaji OSHA?
answer_sw: Mwajiri mkuu (principal employer) anabeba wajibu wa usalama wa kila mtu mahali pa kazi, ikiwa ni pamoja na wakandarasi. Kama mkandarasi anafanya kazi yenye hatari katika eneo lako, lazima uhakikishe anafuata viwango vya usalama vya OSHA na ana bima ya WCF.
question_en: Does a contractor working on my premises need OSHA coverage?
answer_en: The principal employer bears safety responsibility for everyone on the premises, including contractors. If a contractor performs hazardous work at your site you must ensure they meet OSHA safety standards and have WCF insurance.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Sheria ya kazi ya Zanzibar ni sawa na Tanzania Bara?
answer_sw: Hapana. Zanzibar ina sheria zake za kazi tofauti na Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA) ya Tanzania Bara. Ninashughulikia sheria za kazi za Tanzania Bara peke yake — ELRA, GN 605A (kiwango cha chini cha mshahara), NSSF, SDL. Kwa sheria za kazi za Zanzibar, wasiliana na ofisi za kazi Zanzibar au mshauri wa sheria wa Zanzibar. Je, kuna swali la kazi Tanzania Bara?
question_en: Is Zanzibar labour law the same as Mainland Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Zanzibar has its own labour laws separate from the Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA) of Mainland Tanzania. I handle Mainland Tanzania labour law only — ELRA, GN 605A (minimum wage), NSSF, SDL. For Zanzibar labour law, contact the Zanzibar labour office or a Zanzibar legal adviser. Is there a Mainland Tanzania labour question?

question_sw: BRELA inasajili ushirikiano (partnership) pia?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. BRELA inasajili ushirikiano (partnership) kama aina ya biashara. Ushirikiano unaweza kusajiliwa kama jina la biashara. Ushirikiano unahitaji angalau washirika wawili na mkataba wa ushirikiano (partnership agreement) unashauriwa sana ingawa si wa lazima kisheria.
question_en: Does BRELA also register partnerships?
answer_en: Yes. BRELA registers partnerships as a form of business. A partnership can be registered as a business name. A partnership requires at least two partners and a partnership agreement is strongly advised although not legally mandatory.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: Companies Act or Partnership Act update

question_sw: Mkurugenzi Mkurugenzi (MD) analipwa TZS 5,000,000 kwa mwezi. NSSF yake ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: NSSF ya MD: mshahara wa TZS 5,000,000 × 20% = TZS 1,000,000 kwa mwezi. Kampuni inalipa: TZS 5,000,000 × 10% = TZS 500,000. MD analipa (kutoka mshahara wake): TZS 5,000,000 × 10% = TZS 500,000. Msingi ni mshahara mkubwa wa jumla — si mshahara wa msingi. Wasilisha ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara.
question_en: The Managing Director is paid TZS 5,000,000 per month. How much is their NSSF?
answer_en: NSSF for the MD: salary TZS 5,000,000 × 20% = TZS 1,000,000 total per month. Company pays: TZS 5,000,000 × 10% = TZS 500,000. MD pays (from their salary): TZS 5,000,000 × 10% = TZS 500,000. Base is gross wage — not basic salary. Submit within one month after the salary month.

instruction: Mgeni wa kigeni alikuwa ni mshirika wa kimya tu (silent partner) katika duka la rejareja — je, GN 487A inamhusu?
output: Ndiyo — GN 487A inazuia pia 'kuwezesha' mgeni kufanya biashara iliyokatazwa. Mshirika wa kimya anayeweka mtaji au kupata faida kutoka biashara iliyokatazwa anaweza kushughulikiwa kama mwenye uhusiano na ukiukwaji. Hii inaweza kuhusisha pia Mtanzania aliyekubali kuwa mshirika wa kimya. Adhabu ya mgeni (faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6) PAMOJA NA kufutwa kwa visa inaweza kutumika. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: SDL yangu ya mwezi mmoja ni kiasi gani kama jumla ya mishahara ni TZS 5,000,000?
output: SDL inakokotolewa kwa 3.5% ya jumla ya malipo ya fedha ya wafanyakazi wote. Kwa mfano: jumla ya mishahara = TZS 5,000,000. SDL = 3.5% × TZS 5,000,000 = TZS 175,000. Hii inamlipwa TRA na MWAJIRI peke yake — si kukatwa kwa mfanyakazi. Wafanyakazi hawapotezi chochote kwa SDL. Pia kumbuka: kizingiti ni wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi — kama una wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi na mishahara ya TZS 5M, SDL yako ni TZS 175,000. Tarehe ya mwisho: 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu anapata TZS 600,000 kwa mwezi. PAYE inayolipwa ni TZS ngapi?
answer_sw: Mahesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 600,000/mwezi: Kundi la 1 (TZS 0–270,000): 0% = TZS 0. Kundi la 2 (TZS 270,001–520,000): 250,000 × 9% = TZS 22,500. Kundi la 3 (TZS 520,001–600,000): 80,000 × 20% = TZS 16,000. Jumla kabla ya punguzo = TZS 36,000. Punguzo la kibinafsi = TZS 26,000. PAYE inayolipwa = TZS 36,000 − TZS 26,000 = TZS 10,000. Mwajiri anawasilisha TZS 10,000 TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata.
answer_en: PAYE calculation for TZS 600,000/month: Band 1 (TZS 0–270,000): 0% = TZS 0. Band 2 (TZS 270,001–520,000): 250,000 × 9% = TZS 22,500. Band 3 (TZS 520,001–600,000): 80,000 × 20% = TZS 16,000. Total before relief = TZS 36,000. Personal relief = TZS 26,000. PAYE payable = TZS 36,000 − TZS 26,000 = TZS 10,000. The employer remits TZS 10,000 to TRA by the 7th of the following month.
question_en: My employee earns TZS 600,000 per month. How much PAYE is payable?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — worked example ITA Cap.332 Finance Act 2025

instruction: Je, ninaweza kutoa risiti ya mkono badala ya EFD kwa wateja wanaotaka haraka?
output: Hapana. Kama biashara yako iko kwenye kiwango kinachohitaji EFD (mauzo TZS 11M+ au umesajiliwa VAT), lazima utoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala. Risiti za mkono hazikubaliwi kama mbadala wa EFD. Kutoza bila EFD ni ukiukwaji wa sheria hata kama mauzo ni madogo na mteja anataka haraka. Kama EFD haifanyi kazi, ripoti kwa msambazaji na omba ruhusa ya sementara kutoka TRA.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: OSHA inaweza kunifungia biashara yangu?
output: Tofauti kati ya OSHA, WCF, na NSSF: OSHA = kuzuia ajali na usalama mahali pa kazi (prevention/regulation). WCF = kulipa fidia baada ya ajali ya kazi (compensation). NSSF = pensheni na usalama wa jamii wa muda mrefu (pension/social security). Ndio — OSHA ina mamlaka ya kufunga biashara au maeneo yenye hatari ya mara moja (imminent danger). Ukaguzi wa OSHA ukipata: Hatari ya mara moja kwa maisha → OSHA inaweza kusimamisha kazi mara moja. Ukiukaji wa kawaida → OSHA inatoa onyo na muda wa kurekebisha. Kutofuata amri ya OSHA → faini na hatua za kisheria zaidi.

question_sw: Royalty ya madini Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Royalty ya madini (mining royalties) iko nje ya mipaka ya msaada wangu wa sasa — ninashughulikia kodi za biashara za kawaida kwa Tanzania Bara: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF. Royalty ya madini inajumuisha Sheria ya Madini (Mining Act) na kanuni za TMAA (Tanzania Minerals Audit Agency). Kwa maswali ya madini, wasiliana na Wizara ya Madini au TMAA. Je, una swali la kodi ya kawaida ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: What is the mining royalty rate in Tanzania?
answer_en: Mining royalties are outside my current scope — I handle routine business taxes for Mainland Tanzania: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF. Mining royalties involve the Mining Act and TMAA (Tanzania Minerals Audit Agency) regulations. For mining questions, contact the Ministry of Minerals or TMAA. Is there a routine tax question I can help with?

instruction: Biashara yangu ina wafanyakazi 3 tu — je, OSHA bado inahitajika?
output: Ndiyo — OSHA inatumika kwa WAAJIRI WOTE bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Hakuna kikwazo cha idadi kwa OSHA — hata biashara ya mfanyakazi 1 inashughulikiwa. Tofauti na SDL (wafanyakazi 10+), OSHA inalenga MAZINGIRA ya kazi na usalama — sio idadi ya wafanyakazi. Hata mwajiri wa nyumbani mwenye msaidizi mmoja wa nyumba ana wajibu wa kuzingatia mahitaji ya msingi ya usalama. Mahali pote pa kazi Tanzania Bara lazima lisajiliwe na OSHA na lizingatie kanuni za usalama. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ya madini inapaswa kulipa kodi gani zote — royalty, VAT, PAYE, na nyingine?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Wajibu wote wa kodi kwa kampuni za madini — ikiwemo royalty, kodi ya mapato, WHT, na VAT — unashughulikiwa chini ya Mining Act, Income Tax Act, na mikataba ya uwekezaji. Hii ni mada ngumu inayohitaji mshauri maalum wa sekta ya madini. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayestaafu anapokea mafao ya NSSF vipi?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi anayestaafu baada ya kufikia umri wa miaka 60 (au 55 kwa wafanyakazi wa uchimbaji madini) anapaswa: kuwasilisha fomu ya madai ya mafao (benefit claim form) katika ofisi yoyote ya NSSF, kuambatanisha hati za utambulisho, barua ya kuthibitisha kustaafu kutoka kwa mwajiri, na cheti cha kuzaliwa. NSSF itatathmini miaka ya uchangiaji (minimum 180 months/miaka 15 kwa mafao kamili). Malipo yanafanywa kupitia akaunti ya benki. Kwa staafu wa kabla ya wakati, thibitisha masharti na NSSF.
answer_en: An employee retiring at age 60 (or 55 for mining sector employees) must: submit a benefit claim form at any NSSF office, attach identification documents, a retirement confirmation letter from the employer, and a birth certificate. NSSF will assess the contribution years (minimum 180 months/15 years for full benefits). Payment is made via bank account. For early retirement, confirm conditions with NSSF.
question_en: How does a retiring employee receive their NSSF pension benefits?
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act amendment to retirement age or benefit calculation

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana waajiri wawili — anaweza kutoa namba moja ya NSSF kwa wote?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi ana namba moja tu ya NSSF (NSSF number) — hii ndiyo inayotumika bila kujali idadi ya waajiri. Kila mwajiri anawasilisha michango kwa namba hiyo hiyo ya NSSF. NSSF inakusanya michango yote na kuiongeza kwenye akaunti moja ya mfanyakazi. Kiwango ni 10% ya mwajiri + 10% ya mfanyakazi = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla, kwa kila mwajiri tofauti tofauti.
question_en: An employee has two employers — can they give one NSSF number to both?
answer_en: Yes. An employee has only one NSSF number — this is used regardless of the number of employers. Each employer submits contributions under that same NSSF number. NSSF aggregates all contributions and adds them to one employee account. The rate is 10% employer + 10% employee = 20% of gross wage, calculated separately by each employer.

question_sw: Mwanandoa wa kigeni ana uraia wa nchi mbili — Tanzania na nchi yake ya asili. Je, ana tatizo la GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana — mtu mwenye uraia wa Tanzania (hata kama pia ana uraia wa nchi nyingine) hana matatizo ya GN 487A kwa biashara. GN 487A inaangalia kama mtu ni 'raia wa Tanzania' kwa maana ya BRELA, TRA, na Idara ya Uhamiaji. Mtu mwenye pasipoti ya Tanzania na TIN ya Tanzania anachukuliwa raia kwa madhumuni haya hata kama ana uraia mwingine pia.
question_en: A foreign-born spouse has dual citizenship — Tanzania and their country of origin. Do they have a GN 487A problem?
answer_en: No — a person with Tanzanian citizenship (even if they also hold another country's citizenship) has no GN 487A problem for business. GN 487A looks at whether a person is a 'Tanzanian citizen' in the sense recognised by BRELA, TRA, and the Immigration Department. A person with a Tanzanian passport and Tanzanian TIN is treated as a citizen for these purposes even if they also hold another citizenship.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A or citizenship law changes

instruction: OSHA inatumika kwa biashara ndogo — wafanyakazi wachache?
output: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inatumika kwa MAENEO YOTE ya kazi Tanzania — bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Hata duka lenye mfanyakazi 1 linahitaji kufuata kanuni za OSHA. Mahitaji ya msingi kwa maeneo yote: Mazingira salama ya kufanyia kazi, mwanga wa kutosha, usafi, upatikanaji wa maji. Usajili na OSHA (osha.go.tz) unahitajika kwa biashara zote.

instruction: Kizingiti cha VAT ni kwa bidhaa tu au huduma pia?
output: Kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200M/12 miezi au TZS 100M/6 miezi) kinahusika kwa: Mauzo ya bidhaa, Utoaji wa huduma, Mchanganyiko wa bidhaa na huduma. Aina ya biashara haiathiri kizingiti — inathiri tu KIWANGO cha VAT (18% standard, 16% B2C digital, 0% exports, au exempt). Mauzo yote yanajumuishwa kufikia kizingiti.

instruction: Kizingiti cha wafanyakazi kwa WCF — ni 10 kama SDL au tofauti?
output: SDL = asilimia 3.5 → TRA → waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. WCF = asilimia 0.5 → Mamlaka ya WCF → WAAJIRI WOTE (hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi 1). Tofauti kubwa: WCF haina kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi — mwajiri yeyote analipa. WCF haina kizingiti — mwajiri yeyote mwenye mfanyakazi hata mmoja lazima asajili WCF. SDL ina kizingiti cha wafanyakazi 10+. Tofauti hii ni muhimu sana — wengi hukosa WCF wakifikiri wanahitaji wafanyakazi 10+ kwanza.

question_sw: Gharama za mafunzo ya wafanyakazi zinaweza kukatwa kama gharama ya biashara kwenye kodi ya mapato?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Gharama za mafunzo ya wafanyakazi (kama ada za kozi, semina, vitabu, na safari za mafunzo) zinazohusiana moja kwa moja na biashara zinaweza kukatwa kama gharama ya biashara inayoruhusiwa (allowable expense) kwenye kodi ya mapato ya kampuni. Hii ni kwa mafunzo ya kweli ya biashara — si kwa elimu ya kibinafsi ya mmiliki isiyohusiana na biashara. Hifadhi risiti na rekodi za mafunzo kwa madhumuni ya ukaguzi. Gharama za mafunzo zinazofidiwa na SDL (mifuko ya VETA) haziwezi kudaiwa tena kama gharama ya biashara.
answer_en: Yes. Employee training costs (such as course fees, seminars, books, and training travel) directly related to the business can be deducted as an allowable business expense for corporation tax. This applies to genuine business training — not personal education of the owner unrelated to the business. Keep receipts and training records for audit purposes. Training costs reimbursed by SDL (VETA funds) cannot be claimed again as a business expense.
question_en: Can employee training costs be deducted as a business expense for income tax?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — deductible training costs

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu unalipwa kwenye bei ya mauzo au thamani ya soko — lipi ni kubwa?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unahesabiwa kwa kuzingatia KIASI KIKUBWA ZAIDI kati ya (a) bei ya mauzo iliyoandikwa kwenye mkataba, au (b) thamani ya soko ya mali. Hii inazuia uwezekano wa kupunguza thamani iliyoandikwa ili kulipa ushuru mdogo zaidi. TRA inaweza kutathmini thamani ya soko yenyewe ikiwa inaamini thamani iliyoandikwa ni ndogo kupita kiasi.
question_en: Is stamp duty calculated on the sale price or market value — which is greater?
answer_en: Tanzania stamp duty is calculated on whichever is GREATER of: (a) the sale price written in the contract, or (b) the market value of the property. This prevents the possibility of understating the written value to pay less duty. TRA can assess market value itself if it believes the stated value is unreasonably low.

question_sw: Kodi ya mwaka ya makato ya PAYE ya mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa Shilingi 8,000,000 kwa mwezi inahesabiwaje?
answer_sw: Kwa mshahara wa Shilingi 8,000,000 kwa mwezi, PAYE inahesabika kwa kanda kama ifuatavyo: Shilingi 0: kanda ya asilimia sifuri (hadi 270,000). Shilingi 270,001–520,000 = Shilingi 250,000 × 8% = Shilingi 20,000. Shilingi 520,001–760,000 = Shilingi 240,000 × 20% = Shilingi 48,000. Shilingi 760,001–1,000,000 = Shilingi 240,000 × 25% = Shilingi 60,000. Zaidi ya 1,000,000 = Shilingi 7,000,000 × 30% = Shilingi 2,100,000. Jumla ya PAYE = Shilingi 2,228,000 kwa mwezi.
question_en: How is monthly PAYE calculated for an employee earning TZS 8,000,000 per month?

question_sw: PAYE inatumika kwa mwaka au kwa mwezi? Kwa nini mwaka wote unahusika?
answer_sw: PAYE inahesabiwaje kwa msingi wa mwezi — kila mwezi mwajiri anahesabu PAYE kwenye mshahara wa mwezi huo na kuwasilisha TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Hata hivyo, mwaka wote unafaa kwa sababu: mfanyakazi anaweza kuwa na mapato mengine (kutoka vyanzo vingine) ambayo yanabadilisha kiwango halisi cha kodi. Ikiwa PAYE inayokatwa na waajiri wote kwa mwaka wote ni kidogo kuliko kodi halisi ya mwaka, mfanyakazi lazima alipe tofauti kupitia return ya mtu binafsi. Kwa mfanyakazi mmoja na mwajiri mmoja tu, hesabu ya mwezi mara 12 kawaida inatoa jibu sahihi.
answer_en: PAYE is calculated on a monthly basis — each month the employer calculates PAYE on that month's salary and remits to TRA by the 7th of the following month. However, the full year matters because: an employee may have other income (from other sources) that changes their actual tax rate. If PAYE withheld by all employers for the full year is less than the actual annual tax owed, the employee must pay the difference through an individual tax return. For a single employee with a single employer, monthly calculation × 12 generally produces the correct answer.
question_en: Is PAYE calculated monthly or annually? Why does the full year matter?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — monthly vs annual basis

question_sw: Nani anastahili punguzo la kibinafsi la PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: Punguzo la kibinafsi la TZS 26,000/mwezi linapatikana kwa wakazi wa Tanzania (residents) wote ambao wana mapato ya ajira yanayotozwa PAYE. Raia wa Tanzania na wageni wenye makazi Tanzania wanastahili. Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi kwa waajiri wengi anapata punguzo mara moja tu kupitia mwajiri mkuu wake (primary employer). Wageni wasio na makazi Tanzania hawastahili punguzo la kibinafsi. Mwajiri anahusika kuhakikisha punguzo linatumika kwa usahihi wakati wa kuhesabu PAYE ya mwezi.
answer_en: The personal relief of TZS 26,000/month is available to all Tanzania residents (wakazi) who have employment income subject to PAYE. Tanzanian citizens and foreigners resident in Tanzania qualify. An employee working for multiple employers receives the relief only once through their primary employer. Non-resident foreigners do not qualify for personal relief. The employer is responsible for ensuring the relief is correctly applied when calculating monthly PAYE.
question_en: Who qualifies for the PAYE personal relief in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — personal relief eligibility ITA Cap.332

question_sw: Mimi ni Mtanzania — GN 487A inazuia mimi kufanya rejareja au jumla?
answer_sw: Hapana — GN 487A haikuzuii wewe kama Mtanzania kufanya biashara ya rejareja au jumla. Vikwazo vya GN 487A ni kwa wageni peke yake. Wewe kama raia wa Tanzania una uhuru kamili wa kufanya biashara hizi na biashara zingine zote zinazoruhusiwa na sheria ya Tanzania. Unastahili tu kufuata sheria za kawaida za biashara: TIN, leseni, BRELA, nk.
question_en: I am a Tanzanian — does GN 487A prohibit me from doing retail or wholesale trade?
answer_en: No — GN 487A does not prohibit you as a Tanzanian from conducting retail or wholesale trade. GN 487A restrictions are for non-citizens only. As a Tanzanian citizen you are fully free to conduct these and all other businesses permitted by Tanzanian law. You only need to comply with the usual business regulations: TIN, licences, BRELA registration, etc.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Rafiki yangu alisema kizingiti cha VAT cha miezi 6 pia ni TZS 200M — kweli au uwongo?
answer_sw: UWONGO — rafiki yako ana kosa. Kizingiti cha miezi 6 ni TZS 100,000,000 (milioni MIA), si TZS 200M. Kizingiti cha TZS 200M ni cha miezi 12 tu. Makosa kama haya yanaweza kusababisha biashara nyingi kukosa usajili wa VAT waliotakiwa — TRA inaweza kutoza adhabu za kodi na faida kwa kipindi chote ambacho biashara ilikimbia usajili.
question_en: My friend said the 6-month VAT threshold is also TZS 200M — true or false?
answer_en: FALSE — your friend is mistaken. The 6-month threshold is TZS 100,000,000 (one hundred million), not TZS 200M. The TZS 200M threshold applies only to the 12-month period. Errors like this can cause many businesses to miss required VAT registration — TRA may charge tax penalties and interest for the entire period during which the business evaded registration.

instruction: Adhabu ya kutotoa risiti ya EFD ni nini?
output: Adhabu kwa kukosa kutoa risiti ya EFD ni pamoja na: faini ya pesa, kufungwa kwa biashara kwa muda, na uwezekano wa mashtaka ya udanganyifu wa kodi. TRA ina mamlaka ya kufika bila taarifa (surprise inspection) na kukagua miamala. Epuka adhabu hizi kwa kutoa risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala bila ubaguzi. Kwa kiasi halisi cha faini, thibitisha na TRA kwa maelekezo ya sasa.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Kodi ya ongezeko la thamani (VAT) kwa dawa ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Dawa nyingi za binadamu Tanzania zimewekwa kwenye orodha ya zero-rated — yaani VAT ni asilimia 0. Hata hivyo, kuna bidhaa za dawa ambazo zinalipwa VAT ya asilimia 18 (kiwango cha kawaida). Kiwango cha asilimia 5 au asilimia 10 haipo kabisa kwenye mfumo wa VAT Tanzania. Angalia orodha rasmi ya TRA kujua bidhaa gani za dawa ni zero-rated na zipi zinatozwa asilimia 18.
question_en: What is the VAT rate on medicines in Tanzania?
answer_en: Most human medicines in Tanzania are zero-rated — meaning the VAT rate is 0%. However, some pharmaceutical products are subject to the standard 18% VAT. A rate of 5% or 10% does not exist at all in Tanzania's VAT system. Check the official TRA list to determine which medicines are zero-rated and which attract 18%.

question_sw: Mgeni alipewa faini ya TZS 8 milioni na hakufungwa. Je, hii ni adhabu sahihi chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana — faini ya TZS 8,000,000 ni CHINI ya kiwango cha chini cha TZS 10,000,000 kilichowekwa na GN 487A. Kama korti ilitoa adhabu hiyo, ni kosa la kisheria — faini lazima iwe TZS 10M au zaidi. Kuhusu kutofungwa: gazeti inasema 'faini AU kifungo' — korti inachagua moja, kwa hivyo kutofungwa si kosa la kisheria kama faini ilitolewa badala yake. Lakini kutofutwa kwa visa NI kosa — visa lazima ifutwe (NA) na iende pamoja na faini au kifungo iwe yoyote iliyotolewa. Mshtakiwa anaweza kupinga faini ndogo na kukosekana kwa kufutwa kwa visa mahakamani. Mshtakiwa anaweza kupinga uamuzi huo mahakamani.
question_en: A non-citizen was fined TZS 8 million and not imprisoned. Is this a correct penalty under GN 487A?
answer_en: No — a fine of TZS 8,000,000 is BELOW the minimum of TZS 10,000,000 set by GN 487A. If a court issued such a penalty it would be a legal error — the fine must be TZS 10M or more. No — a fine of TZS 8,000,000 is BELOW the mandatory minimum of TZS 10,000,000. The fine alone is a legal error — the court must impose at least TZS 10M. On imprisonment: the gazette says 'fine OR imprisonment' — the court chooses one, so not being imprisoned is not automatically wrong if the fine was imposed. However, NOT revoking the visa IS a separate error — visa revocation is mandatory (AND) and must accompany whichever penalty the court imposes. The defendant can appeal both the below-minimum fine and the missing visa revocation. The defendant could challenge such a ruling on appeal.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: BRELA inaweza kufuta kampuni bila taarifa ya awali?
output: BRELA hufuata mchakato wa kisheria kabla ya kufuta orodha kampuni: (1) Kutuma notisi rasmi kwa kampuni (barua au gazeti rasmi); (2) Kutoa muda wa kujibu au kuwasilisha annual returns zilizokosekana; (3) Kama hakuna jibu — kufuta orodha rasmi. Kampuni zinapaswa kuhakikisha BRELA ina anwani sahihi ya mawasiliano — kama anwani imebadilika na kampuni haijapokea notisi, kufutwa kunaweza kutokea bila ujuzi wa kampuni. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz mara kwa mara.

question_sw: Mteja analipa kwa M-Pesa. Je, bado ninatoa risiti ya EFD?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Aina ya malipo (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, pesa taslimu, kadi ya benki) haiathiri wajibu wa kutoa risiti ya EFD. Kwa kila muamala wa mauzo, lazima utoe risiti ya EFD — bila kujali jinsi mteja atanavyolipa. Malipo ya simu za mkononi yanaweza kuwa na risiti ya mwenyewe (M-Pesa receipt), lakini hii haibadilishi wajibu wa EFD wako. Risiti ya EFD ni wajibu wako wa kodi — si wa mteja.
question_en: A customer pays by M-Pesa. Do I still issue an EFD receipt?
answer_en: Yes. The payment method (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, cash, bank card) does not affect the obligation to issue an EFD receipt. For every sales transaction, you must issue an EFD receipt — regardless of how the customer pays. Mobile money payments may generate their own receipts (M-Pesa receipt), but this does not replace your EFD obligation. The EFD receipt is your tax obligation — not the customer's.

question_sw: NSSF inaendelea kukusanya michango ikiwa kampuni imefungwa kwa sababu ya COVID au dharura — je, kuna msamaha?
answer_sw: NSSF Tanzania haikutoa msamaha wa jumla wa michango wakati wa COVID-19 kwa biashara. Hata biashara zilizofungwa kwa amri ya serikali wakati wa janga, ikiwa zilikuwa bado na wafanyakazi walioendelea kulipwa mishahara, zililazimika kuendelea kuwasilisha michango ya NSSF. Biashara ambazo hazikuweza kulipa ziliweza kuwasiliana na NSSF kuhusu mpango wa malipo au hali yao. Angalia NSSF moja kwa moja kwa taarifa za hali maalum kama dharura za baadaye.
question_en: Does NSSF continue collecting contributions if a company closes due to COVID or emergency — is there an exemption?
answer_en: NSSF Tanzania did not provide a general COVID-19 contribution waiver for businesses. Even businesses closed by government order during the pandemic, if they still had employees who continued to be paid wages, were required to continue submitting NSSF contributions. Businesses that could not pay could contact NSSF about a payment plan or their situation. Check NSSF directly for information on specific situations like future emergencies.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Shamba la kahawa linaajiri wafanyakazi wa msimu wa mavuno kwa miezi 3 tu. Je, lazima litoe PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, ikiwa mshahara wa msimu unazidi kiwango kisichoweza kutozwa kodi. Kiwango cha msingi kisicotozwa kodi ni TZS 270,000 kwa mwezi. Kama mfanyakazi wa msimu anapata zaidi ya TZS 270,000 kwa mwezi, mwajiri lazima akatae PAYE ya mwezi huo na kuiwasilisha TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Wafanyakazi wa msimu hawana msamaha maalum wa PAYE.
answer_en: Yes, if the seasonal salary exceeds the tax-free threshold. The tax-free threshold is TZS 270,000 per month. If a seasonal worker earns more than TZS 270,000 per month, the employer must deduct PAYE for that month and remit to TRA by the 7th of the following month. Seasonal workers have no special PAYE exemption.
question_en: A coffee farm employs seasonal workers for harvest for only 3 months. Must it deduct PAYE?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — Income Tax Act Cap.332
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to tax bands

question_sw: Hati ya uhamishaji wa gari (motor vehicle transfer) ina ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Uhamishaji wa gari Tanzania una ada za kusajilisha gari (registration transfer fee) zinazolipwa kwa Mamlaka ya Usimamizi wa Usafiri wa Nchi Kavu (SUMATRA) au TANROADS — hizi si ushuru wa stempu kwa njia ya kawaida. Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unajumuisha zaidi hati za ardhi, mkopo, na mikataba maalum. Angalia SUMATRA/TRA kwa ada zinazohusika na magari.
question_en: Does a motor vehicle transfer instrument attract stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: Motor vehicle transfers in Tanzania involve registration transfer fees paid to SUMATRA or TANROADS — these are not stamp duty in the conventional sense. Tanzania stamp duty primarily covers land instruments, loans, and specified contracts. Check SUMATRA/TRA for fees applicable to vehicles.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or vehicle registration fee update

question_sw: Malipo ya kodi ya kampuni yanaweza kufanywa kwa pesa taslimu ofisini kwa TRA — je, hii ni njia inayokubalika?
answer_sw: Hapana. TRA Tanzania inashughulikia malipo ya kodi ya kampuni kupitia mfumo wa TANEPS/PRN (Payment Reference Number) kwa benki zilizoidhinishwa, au kupitia mfumo wa malipo ya mtandaoni (e-payment). Malipo ya pesa taslimu moja kwa moja ofisini kwa kiasi kikubwa cha kodi hayakubaliwi na yanaweza kusababisha matatizo ya kiutawala. Tumia PRN kupitia benki au mfumo wa malipo ya TRA.
question_en: Corporate tax payments can be made in cash at the TRA office — is this an accepted method?
answer_en: No. TRA Tanzania handles corporate tax payments through the TANEPS/PRN (Payment Reference Number) system at authorised banks, or through the e-payment online system. Direct cash payments at the office for large tax amounts are not accepted and can cause administrative problems. Use PRN through a bank or TRA's payment system.

instruction: Je, mkaguzi wa OSHA anaweza kukuambia kufunga mashine au zana fulani?
output: Ndiyo. Mkaguzi wa OSHA ana mamlaka ya kutoa amri ya kusimamisha (improvement notice au prohibition notice) kwa mashine, zana, au mchakato wowote unaosababisha hatari kwa usalama. Mashine au eneo linaloweza kusababisha madhara lazima lisimamishwe hadi hatari imeondolewa. Kupinga amri ya OSHA ni kosa zito. Fuata maelekezo ya mkaguzi na ufanye marekebisho yanayohitajika haraka.
