instruction: Mwajiri anaweza kubadilisha mgawanyo wa NSSF kutoka 10+10 hadi 15+5 — ni rahisi?
output: Ndiyo, mwajiri anaweza kubadilisha mgawanyo wa NSSF kwa kuchagua mgawanyo mpya — 10+10 (kawaida), 15+5, au 20+0 (mwajiri analipa yote). Mabadiliko yanafanywa kwa taarifa kwa NSSF na kwa wafanyakazi. Jumla lazima ibaki asilimia 20. Kwa utaratibu rasmi wa kubadilisha mgawanyo, wasiliana na NSSF (nssf.or.tz) au ofisi ya NSSF karibu nawe.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: GN 487A ilianza kutumika lini — je, biashara zilizokuwepo mapema zinalindwa?
answer_sw: GN 487A ilianza kutumika tarehe 28 Julai 2025 — siku ile ilipotangazwa. Hakukuwa na kipindi cha mpito (grace period) kilichotangazwa rasmi kwa biashara zilizokuwepo. Hii inamaanisha hata biashara zilizokuwa zikifanya kazi kabla ya tarehe hiyo zilihitajika kutii sheria mara moja. Kama una wasiwasi kuhusu biashara iliyokuwepo, wasiliana na wakili wa biashara au Idara ya Uhamiaji haraka — usiendelee bila ushauri wa kisheria.
question_en: When did GN 487A take effect — are businesses that existed before protected?
answer_en: GN 487A took effect on 28 July 2025 — the day it was gazetted. No formal grace period for pre-existing businesses was officially announced. This means businesses already operating before that date were required to comply immediately. If you have concerns about a pre-existing business, contact a business lawyer or the Immigration Services Department urgently — do not continue without legal advice.
next_review_trigger: When GN 487A is amended or implementation guidance updated

question_sw: Nambari ya usajili wa VAT inatumika kwa madhumuni gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Nambari ya usajili wa VAT (VAT registration number) inatumika: kwenye hati za VAT (invoices, returns), pamoja na TIN kwenye nyaraka za rasmi za VAT, na lazima ionekane kwenye Cheti cha Usajili cha VAT mahali panapoonekana kazini. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the VAT registration number used for in Tanzania?
answer_en: The VAT registration number is used: on VAT documents (invoices, returns), alongside the TIN on official VAT documents, and must be displayed on the VAT Registration Certificate in a visible place at the principal business premises. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Biashara yangu ina wafanyakazi wa msimu (seasonal) kwa miezi 3 tu — SDL inakokotolewa vipi?
output: SDL inakokotolewa KILA MWEZI ambapo biashara ina wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, bila kujali kama ni wa msimu au wa kudumu. Kwa mfano: kama una wafanyakazi wa msimu 15 kwa miezi 3 (Januari–Machi), SDL inalipwa kwa miezi 3 ile ile tu. Miezi mingine (Aprili–Desemba) ukiwa na chini ya wafanyakazi 10 — hakuna SDL. Kila mwezi unakokotolewa kwa hali ya wafanyakazi na mishahara ya MWEZI HULE — si wastani wa mwaka. Kwa hivyo biashara za msimu zinalipa SDL miezi inayofanya kazi tu. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Je, Tanzania ina kodi ya uchafuzi wa mazingira (environmental tax)?
answer_sw: Ushuru au kodi ya mazingira Tanzania ni eneo maalum zaidi ya mipaka ya msaada wangu wa sasa — ninashughulikia kodi kuu za biashara: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD, GN 487A. Kwa masuala ya ushuru wa mazingira na kanuni za mazingira, wasiliana na National Environment Management Council (NEMC) au Wizara ya Mazingira. Je, kuna swali la kodi ya kawaida ya biashara ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: Does Tanzania have an environmental pollution tax?
answer_en: Environmental levies or taxes in Tanzania are a more specialised area beyond my current scope — I handle main business taxes: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD, GN 487A. For environmental levies and regulations, contact the National Environment Management Council (NEMC) or the Ministry of Environment. Is there a routine business tax question I can help with?

instruction: Nimesajili biashara BRELA lakini sijapata TIN bado — ninaweza kuanza kupokea malipo?
output: Kisheria, kuanza kupokea malipo ya biashara bila TIN kunaweza kuwa tatizo la kodi. TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) ya TRA inahitajika kwa shughuli zote za biashara za kodi — VAT, PAYE, SDL, na malipo ya kodi yoyote. Biashara nyingi za Tanzania zinahitaji TIN kwa: kufungua akaunti ya benki, kutoa invoice rasmi, kusajili EFD, na kuwasilisha marudisho ya kodi. BRELA inakusajili kisheria kama chombo — TRA inakusajili kwa kodi. Omba TIN haraka iwezekanavyo kupitia TRA (tra.go.tz au ofisi ya karibu). Thibitisha na TRA.

instruction: EFD — kuna leseni ya kila mwaka au ni ya kudumu baada ya kusajiliwa mara moja?
output: EFD inasajiliwa mara moja kwa TRA — si leseni ya kila mwaka. Hata hivyo, TRA inaweza kuhitaji: (1) Usasishaji (update) wa programu ya EFD kila mara inapotolewa na TRA au muuzaji; (2) Uhakika wa mfumo (compliance check) kama TRA inabadilisha mahitaji; (3) Kubadilisha EFD kama toleo la zamani linafutwa msaada. Pia kama EFD inaharibiwa au inaibiwa — inabidi kusajili upya kwa TRA. Malipo ya ziada ya kila mwaka yanaweza kuwa kwa muuzaji wa EFD kwa huduma ya matengenezo — si TRA. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na muuzaji wako wa EFD.

question_sw: Mgeni anafanya ukarabati wa simu Tanzania — ana hatari gani?
answer_sw: Ukarabati wa simu ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku na GN 487A. Mgeni anayefanya ukarabati wa simu bila kibali anakabili: faini ya chini ya TZS 10,000,000, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: A non-citizen is running a phone repair shop in Tanzania — what is their risk?
answer_en: Phone repair is one of the 15 activities prohibited by GN 487A. A non-citizen operating phone repair without authorisation faces: a minimum TZS 10,000,000 fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. Confirm with the Immigration Department.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

instruction: GN 605A ilitangazwa (gazetted) na kuanza kutumika (effective) tarehe moja — au ni tarehe tofauti mbili?
output:
Ni tarehe TOFAUTI MBILI:

Ilitangazwa (gazetted): 13 Oktoba 2025 — hii ni tarehe GN 605A ilipochapishwa kwenye Gazeti la Serikali.
Ilianza kutumika (effective): 1 Januari 2026 — hii ni tarehe viwango vipya vya mshahara wa chini vilipoanza kulazimika kisheria.

Kwa vitendo: hata kama GN 605A ilikuwepo kwenye gazeti tangu Oktoba 2025, waajiri hawakuwa na wajibu wa kulipa viwango vipya mpaka 1 Januari 2026. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa, VELMA Law, au TanzLII.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya mrabaha (royalties) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya mrabaha ni asilimia 15 — kiwango kimoja kwa wakazi na wasio wakazi wote. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on royalties in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on royalties is 15% — a single rate for both residents and non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: VAT ya 16% ya B2C e-payment — inamaanisha nini kwa vitendo?
answer_sw: Kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025, malipo ya kielektroniki ya B2C (wateja wanaolipa bidhaa/huduma kwa njia ya simu au mtandao) yanabeba kiwango cha VAT cha 16% — badala ya 18% ya kawaida. Hii inaathiri mifumo ya malipo ya kidijitali kama M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, kadi za benki, na njia nyingine za malipo ya kielektroniki. Maelezo ya utekelezaji bado yanangojewa kutoka TRA.
question_en: The 16% B2C e-payment VAT — what does it mean in practice?
answer_en: From 1 September 2025, B2C electronic payments (consumers paying for goods/services via mobile or internet) carry a 16% VAT rate — instead of the standard 18%. This affects digital payment systems like M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, bank cards, and other electronic payment methods. Implementation details are still awaited from TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

instruction: Thamani ya ardhi yangu inakadiriwa vipi kwa ajili ya kuhesabu stamp duty Tanzania?
output: Stamp duty inatumika kwa uhamisho wa mali Tanzania. Viwango na taratibu halisi vinategemea aina ya mali na thamani yake inayotathminiwa na mthamini aliyesajiliwa. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Tathmini ya thamani ya ardhi kwa stamp duty inafanywa na wathamini waliosajiliwa (registered valuers) na inashughulikiwa na Ofisi ya Ardhi — inahitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu, Ofisi ya Ardhi, au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Ninafanya biashara ya usafi — wafanyakazi 15. Je, ninalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. SDL (Skills Development Levy) inatakiwa kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Una wafanyakazi 15, kwa hivyo unalipa SDL. Kiwango ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mshahara wote wa wafanyakazi wako. Inalipwa TRA pamoja na PAYE kila mwezi ifikapo tarehe 7.
question_en: I run a cleaning business — 15 employees. Do I pay SDL?
answer_en: Yes. SDL (Skills Development Levy) is required for employers with 10 or more employees. You have 15 staff, so you pay SDL. The rate is 3.5% of total wages paid to all employees. It is paid to TRA together with PAYE every month by the 7th.

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inayomilikiwa 100% na mgeni — inaweza kufanya biashara ya rejareja kama kampuni (si kama mtu binafsi)?
answer_sw: Hapana — GN 487A inazuia biashara kwa wageni hata kwa njia ya kampuni. Ikiwa mgeni ndiye mmiliki wa 100% na/au mwenye nguvu za uamuzi wa kampuni inayofanya rejareja — hali hii inachukuliwa ukiukaji wa GN 487A. Muundo wa kampuni (limited liability) si ngao dhidi ya sheria hii. Idara ya Uhamiaji na TRA wanaangalia kwa makini umiliki wa kampuni wakati wa uchunguzi wa GN 487A.
question_en: A Tanzanian company 100% owned by a non-citizen — can it conduct retail trade as a company (not as an individual)?
answer_en: No — GN 487A prohibits businesses by non-citizens even through a company structure. If a non-citizen is 100% owner and/or decision-maker of a company conducting retail trade — this situation is treated as a GN 487A violation. The corporate structure (limited liability) is not a shield against this law. The Immigration Department and TRA scrutinise company ownership closely during GN 487A investigations.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Ushonaji wa nguo — umekatazwa kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Ushonaji wa nguo (tailoring and garment making) haukutajwa moja kwa moja kama kategoria tofauti katika Ratiba ya GN 487A. Unaweza kuangukia chini ya Kategoria 15 'Umiliki na uendeshaji wa viwanda vidogo na vidogo sana (micro and small industries)' kama unafanywa kama biashara ya viwanda vidogo. Kwa sababu haukutajwa wazi, thibitisha hali yako mahususi na Idara ya Uhamiaji au wakili kabla ya kuhitimisha kama umejumuishwa au la., pamoja na biashara nyingine kama rejareja, jumla, uhamisho wa pesa, ukarabati wa simu, salon, na kinyozi. Wageni wanaofanya kazi ya ushonaji kama biashara ya kibiashara wanakiuka GN 487A.
question_en: Is tailoring/garment making prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A?
answer_en: Tailoring and garment making is not explicitly named as a separate category in the GN 487A Schedule. It may fall under Category 15 'Ownership and operation of micro and small industries' if operated as a small industrial activity. If you operate a tailoring business as a micro or small industry, it is likely covered. However, since it is not explicitly named, verify your specific situation with the Immigration Department or a lawyer before assuming it is or is not covered., alongside other businesses such as retail, wholesale, mobile money transfers, phone repair, hair salons, and barbershops. Non-citizens conducting tailoring as a commercial business are violating GN 487A.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A prohibited category list

question_sw: SDL na NSSF ni kitu kimoja?
answer_sw: Hapana, ni tofauti kabisa. NSSF ni mchango wa hifadhi ya jamii (asilimia 10 mwajiri + asilimia 10 mfanyakazi). SDL ni Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi — inayolipwa na mwajiri peke yake kwa kiwango cha asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla, kwa wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, mwisho siku 7 ya mwezi unaofuata.
question_en: Are SDL and NSSF the same thing?
answer_en: No, they are completely different. NSSF is a social security contribution (10% employer + 10% employee). SDL is the Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi — paid by the employer only at 3.5% of gross payroll, for employers with 10 or more employees, due by the 7th of the following month.

question_sw: GN 487A ya mwaka 2025 inazungumzia nini hasa?
answer_sw: GN 487A (Government Notice 487A, 2025) ni Amri ya Leseni za Biashara inayozuia wageni kufanya shughuli fulani za biashara nchini Tanzania — inaitwa rasmi 'Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025'. Amri hii HAIHUSU vibali vya makazi wala vibali vya kazi. Inazuia watu wasio raia wa Tanzania kufanya biashara katika makundi 15 maalum, kuanzia tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Adhabu ni faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, pamoja na kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 na kufutwa kwa viza.
question_en: What exactly does GN 487A of 2025 cover?
answer_en: GN 487A (Government Notice 487A, 2025) is a Business Licensing Order that prohibits non-citizens from conducting certain business activities in Tanzania — its full name is the 'Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025'. This Order is NOT about residence permits or work permits. It prohibits non-Tanzanian nationals from operating in 15 specific business categories, effective 28 July 2025. Penalties are a minimum TZS 10 million fine plus up to 6 months imprisonment and visa revocation.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Mgeni amefanya ukiukwaji wa GN 487A mara tatu — vitendo tofauti, kesi moja au tatu?
output: Ukiukwaji wa mara nyingi unaweza kuongeza uzito wa kesi na uamuzi wa mahakama. Ingawa GN 487A haisemi idadi ya kesi wazi, vitendo tofauti vya ukiukwaji vinaweza kuchukuliwa kama makosa tofauti. Korti ina uamuzi wa kutoa faini kubwa zaidi kuliko TZS milioni 10 (kwa sababu hiyo ni kiwango cha chini tu) kulingana na uzito wa vitendo vyote. Kwa kila ukiukwaji, adhabu ya kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Kama mwajiri, gharama zangu za ziada juu ya mshahara wa chini ni nini?
answer_sw: Juu ya mshahara wa chini, mwajiri analipa: NSSF asilimia 10 ya mshahara, SDL asilimia 3.5 (kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi), na WCF asilimia 0.5. Kwa hivyo gharama halisi ni mshahara + asilimia 14 (au asilimia 10.5 kwa biashara ndogo chini ya wafanyakazi 10).
question_en: As an employer, what additional costs do I pay on top of the minimum wage?
answer_en: On top of the minimum wage an employer pays: NSSF 10% of salary, SDL 3.5% (for employers with 10 or more staff), and WCF 0.5%. Total employer cost is salary + ~14% (or ~10.5% for small businesses under 10 staff).

instruction: BRELA annual return — deadline ni wakati gani wa mwaka?
output: Hakuna tarehe maalum ya 30 Septemba kwa annual returns za BRELA — tarehe inategemea tarehe ya usajili wa kampuni yako. Annual return inapaswa kuwasilishwa kulingana na tarehe ya kumbukumbu ya usajili wa kampuni yako (anniversary date) — si lazima mwaka wa kifedha. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kwa tarehe yako halisi. Kila kampuni ina tarehe yake maalum inayohusiana na tarehe ya mwisho wa mwaka wake wa biashara. Mbinu bora: ingia kwenye mfumo wa BRELA online mara baada ya mwisho wa mwaka wako wa biashara.

question_sw: Withholding tax ya 6% ya huduma — inaathiri malipo ya kidijitali?
answer_sw: Withholding tax ya 6% kwenye huduma (services) ilianza 1 Julai 2025 chini ya Sheria ya Fedha 2025. Inaathiri malipo ya huduma zinazotolewa — ikiwa ni pamoja na huduma za kidijitali kama programu (software), ushauri wa IT, na huduma za wingu (cloud) kutoka watoa wa nje. Mlipaji wa Tanzania lazima ashikilie 6% na ailipe TRA.
question_en: 6% withholding tax on services — does it affect digital payments?
answer_en: The 6% withholding tax on services started 1 July 2025 under the Finance Act 2025. It affects payments for services supplied — including digital services like software, IT consulting, and cloud services from foreign providers. The Tanzanian payer must withhold 6% and remit it to TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni ana haki ya kupata nakala ya kibali chake mwenyewe?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi wa kigeni ana haki ya kupata na kushikilia nakala ya kibali chake cha kazi. Hati hii inaonyesha hali yake ya kisheria ya kufanya kazi Tanzania. Ni busara kubeba nakala ya kibali wakati wa kufanya kazi au kusafiri Tanzania kwa madhumuni ya kazi.
question_en: Is a foreign worker entitled to receive a copy of their own work permit?
answer_en: Yes. A foreign worker is entitled to receive and hold a copy of their work permit. This document demonstrates their lawful employment status in Tanzania. It is advisable to carry a copy of the permit when working or travelling in Tanzania for work purposes.

question_sw: Je, Tanzania ina VAT ya asilimia 5 kwa bidhaa zilizo 'essential'?
answer_sw: Hapana. Tanzania haina kiwango cha VAT cha asilimia 5 cha aina yoyote — including 'essential goods'. Bidhaa fulani za muhimu (kama nafaka, dawa, baadhi ya vifaa vya kilimo) zinaweza kuwa zero-rated (asilimia 0) au exempt, lakini asilimia 5 haipo. Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT ni asilimia 18 tu.
question_en: Does Tanzania have 5% VAT on 'essential' goods?
answer_en: No. Tanzania does not have a 5% VAT rate of any kind — including for 'essential goods'. Some essential items (like certain grains, medicines, some agricultural inputs) may be zero-rated (0%) or exempt, but 5% does not exist. The standard VAT rate is 18% only.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya WCF na NSSF ni nini — wote wawili wanahusiana na manufaa ya wafanyakazi?
answer_sw: WCF inashughulikia MAJERAHA NA MAGONJWA ya kazi peke yake — ajali za kazini na magonjwa yanayotokana na kazi. NSSF inashughulikia USALAMA WA JAMII kwa ujumla — pensheni ya uzee, manufaa ya mama na mtoto, na manufaa ya ulemavu usio wa kazi. Waajiri wanawajibika kwa zote mbili, na wajibu wao ni tofauti.
question_en: What is the difference between WCF and NSSF — both relate to employee benefits?
answer_en: WCF covers WORK INJURIES AND DISEASES only — workplace accidents and occupational diseases. NSSF covers GENERAL SOCIAL SECURITY — retirement pension, maternity benefits, and non-work disability. Employers are obligated to both, with separate obligations.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: SDL inalipwa tarehe ngapi kila mwezi — na je, ni tofauti na PAYE?
output: SDL inalipwa tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata — SAWA NA PAYE. Hakuna tofauti ya tarehe kati ya SDL na PAYE. SDL na PAYE zote mbili zinawasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Mfano: kodi zote mbili za Desemba zinawasilishwa ifikapo 7 Januari. Kukumbuka rahisi: SDL na PAYE = tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata, bila ubaguzi. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Kama VAT ni 18%, mbona wakati mwingine ninaona 16% kwenye risiti?
output: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. 16% ni kiwango kipya cha B2C malipo ya kidijitali tangu Septemba 2025 — lakini linatumika kwa huduma maalum za kidijitali zinazolipwa na watumiaji wa kawaida (B2C). Kwa biashara nyingi za kawaida: 18% bado ndiyo kiwango sahihi. Ukiona 16% kwenye risiti ya kawaida ya biashara (si digital/mtandaoni), thibitisha na mzabuni.

question_sw: Sekta ya umma inalipwa mshahara gani Tanzania tangu Julai 2025?
answer_sw: Wafanyakazi wa serikali (sekta ya umma) Tanzania Bara wanalipwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 500,000 kwa mwezi, kuanzia Julai 2025, kufuatia tangazo la Rais Samia. GN 605A inashughulikia sekta ya faragha peke yake. Thibitisha na Hazina au PSC kwa hati rasmi inayothibitisha kiwango na tarehe ya kuanza.
question_en: What is the public sector minimum wage in Tanzania since July 2025?
answer_en: Government employees (public sector) in Tanzania Mainland receive a minimum wage of TZS 500,000 per month from July 2025, following President Samia's announcement. GN 605A covers the private sector only. Confirm with the Treasury or PSC for the official instrument confirming the rate and effective date.

question_sw: Nini tofauti kati ya usajili wa biashara BRELA na leseni ya biashara ya serikali ya mtaa?
answer_sw: BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) inasajili biashara kisheria — yaani inazipa hadhi ya kisheria ya kufanya biashara Tanzania kama kampuni au jina la biashara. Leseni ya biashara ya serikali ya mtaa (LGA) ni ruhusa ya kufanya shughuli mahususi katika eneo la mtaa fulani — inatolewa na Halmashauri husika. Biashara nyingi zinahitaji ZOTE mbili: usajili wa BRELA kwanza, kisha leseni ya LGA ya eneo unakofanya biashara. Ni wajibu tofauti mbili za kisheria.
answer_en: BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) legally registers a business — giving it a legal identity to operate in Tanzania as a company or business name. The Local Government Authority (LGA) business licence is a permit to conduct specific activities in a particular area — issued by the relevant council. Most businesses need BOTH: BRELA registration first, then an LGA licence for the area where they operate. They are two separate legal obligations.
question_en: What is the difference between BRELA business registration and a local government business licence?
primary_source_name: BRELA — business registration vs LGA licensing

question_sw: Biashara ya vipande vya magari (spare parts) inaweza kumilikiwa na mgeni?
answer_sw: Hapana. Biashara ya vipande vya magari na elektroniki (spare parts trading) ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania chini ya GN 487A (2025). Maduka ya vipande vya magari, baisikeli, au vifaa vya elektroniki yanayomilikiwa na wageni yamezuiwa. Adhabu ni faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza. Raia wa Tanzania anayemruhusu mgeni kutumia jina lake la biashara kwa hili anakabiliwa na faini ya TZS milioni 5 au kifungo cha miezi 3.
question_en: Can a non-citizen own a spare parts (car/electronics) business?
answer_en: No. Spare parts trading for vehicles and electronics is one of the 15 business activities prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens under GN 487A (2025). Shops selling car, bicycle, or electronics spare parts that are non-citizen-owned are prohibited. Penalties are a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. A Tanzanian who allows a non-citizen to use their business name for this faces a TZS 5 million fine or 3 months imprisonment.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Kwa mwajiri wa hoteli na utalii, mshahara wa chini ni Shilingi ngapi?
answer_sw: Sekta ya hoteli na utalii ina kiwango chake maalum chini ya GN 605A. Angalia jedwali la GN 605A kwa kiwango sahihi cha sekta ya hoteli na utalii — kiwango hiki ni zaidi ya kiwango cha jumla cha Shilingi 175,000 kwa mwezi.
question_en: For a hotel and tourism employer, what is the minimum wage?
answer_en: The hotel and tourism sector has its own specific rate under GN 605A. Check the GN 605A schedule for the exact hotel and tourism sector rate — it is above the general floor of approximately TZS 175,000 per month.

question_sw: Utaratibu wa ufafanuzi wa hiari (voluntary disclosure) wa TRA unanifahamisha nini na ninapata faida gani?
answer_sw: Utaratibu wa ufafanuzi wa hiari unaruhusu mlipa kodi kutangaza makosa ya kodi bila kusubiri ukaguzi wa TRA. Faida za ufafanuzi wa hiari ni: kupunguza adhabu (mara nyingi kwa asilimia 50 au zaidi) kulingana na jinsi unavyoshirikiana na TRA, kupunguza uwezekano wa mashtaka ya jinai kwa ukwepaji makusudi wa kodi, na kuonyesha nia njema ya kutii sheria. Unahitaji: kuwasilisha taarifa kamili ya mapato/hasara iliyokosekana, kulipa kodi kamili inayostahili, na kuomba rasmi kupitia TRA. Toa taarifa kabla ya TRA kukujua — ikiwa TRA wameshaanza kukuchunguza, hakuna faida za ufafanuzi wa hiari.
answer_en: The voluntary disclosure procedure allows a taxpayer to declare tax errors without waiting for a TRA audit. Benefits of voluntary disclosure include: reduced penalties (often by 50% or more) depending on the degree of cooperation with TRA, reduced risk of criminal prosecution for deliberate tax evasion, and demonstrating good faith compliance. You need to: submit a complete statement of missing income/tax, pay the full tax owed, and apply formally through TRA. Disclose before TRA discovers you — if TRA has already started investigating you, voluntary disclosure benefits no longer apply.
question_en: What does TRA's voluntary disclosure procedure offer and what benefits do I receive?

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa huduma ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa usambazaji wa huduma na wakala wa zuio (qualifying buyer) ni asilimia 6, kulingana na Kifungu cha 5(5) cha Sheria ya VAT. Hii ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the VAT withholding rate on services in Tanzania?
answer_en: The VAT withholding obligation on supply of services by the Withholding Agent under Section 5(5) of the VAT Act is 6%, effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mtu anayetengeneza na kuuza asali (honey) kijijini — anahitaji usajili gani?
answer_sw: Mtengenezaji wa asali anayouza kibiashara kwa kawaida anahitaji: (1) Leseni ya biashara kutoka halmashauri; (2) TIN kama biashara inazalisha mapato ya mara kwa mara; (3) Kibali cha usafi wa chakula kutoka TFDA/TMDA au Ofisi ya Afya ya Wilaya; (4) Kama mauzo yanafika TZS 200M/mwaka, usajili wa VAT. Thibitisha masharti maalum na halmashauri na TMDA.
question_en: A person who makes and sells honey in a village — what registration is required?
answer_en: A honey producer selling commercially typically needs: (1) A business licence from the local council; (2) A TIN if the business generates regular income; (3) A food safety permit from TFDA/TMDA or the District Health Office; (4) If sales reach TZS 200M/year, VAT registration. Confirm specific requirements with the local council and TMDA.

instruction: TIRA inafanya nini kwenye udhibiti wa sekta ya bima Tanzania na kuhusiana na ushuru?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa undani wa sekta ya bima. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Jukumu la TIRA (Tanzania Insurance Regulatory Authority) katika udhibiti wa sekta ya bima na ushuru wake inahitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na TIRA moja kwa moja kupitia tira.go.tz. Wasiliana pia na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kampuni inayopigwa kodi mara mbili (Tanzania na nchi nyingine) inafanya nini?
answer_sw: Tanzania ina Mikataba ya Kuepuka Kutozwa Kodi Mara Mbili (DTA) na nchi kadhaa. Ikiwa mbia wako wa biashara katika nchi yenye DTA na Tanzania, angalia masharti ya DTA kwa unafuu wa kodi. Ikiwa hakuna DTA, unaweza kudai mkopo wa kodi ya nje (foreign tax credit) dhidi ya kodi ya Tanzania kulingana na sheria ya kodi.
question_en: What should a company do if it is being taxed twice (Tanzania and another country)?
answer_en: Tanzania has Double Taxation Agreements (DTAs) with several countries. If your business partner is in a country with a DTA with Tanzania, check the DTA terms for tax relief. If there is no DTA, you may claim a foreign tax credit against Tanzania tax under tax law.

question_sw: Mfanyabiashara wa mpakani anahitaji hati gani kutumia STR?
answer_sw: Hati zinazohitajika kwa STR: (1) Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) — kuthibitisha asili ya bidhaa; (2) Simplified Customs Document (SCD) — fomu rahisi ya forodha; (3) Utambulisho wa kibinafsi (kitambulisho cha taifa au pasipoti). Pia, orodha ya bidhaa na bei zake ni muhimu. Ofisi ya forodha itaweza kukusaidia zaidi.
question_en: What documents does a border trader need to use STR?
answer_en: Documents needed for STR: (1) Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) — to prove the origin of goods; (2) Simplified Customs Document (SCD) — the simplified customs form; (3) Personal identification (national ID or passport). Additionally, a list of goods and their prices is important. The customs office can assist you further.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

instruction: Usajili wa biashara Zanzibar — ninafanya kwa BRELA au kuna ofisi tofauti?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Usajili wa biashara Zanzibar unashughulikiwa chini ya mamlaka za Zanzibar (ZIPA — Zanzibar Investment Promotion Authority na ofisi nyingine) — BRELA inashughulikia Tanzania Bara tu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Serikali ya Kenya inazuia nini kwa wafanyabiashara wa Tanzania wanaouza Kenya?
answer_sw: Sheria za biashara na kodi za Kenya ziko nje ya mipaka yangu kabisa — ninashughulikia Tanzania Bara tu. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Kwa maswali ya biashara nchini Kenya: wasiliana na Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) au biashara.go.ke. Ninaweza kukusaidia kuhusu mahitaji ya Tanzania kwa bidhaa zinazotoka Tanzania kwenda Kenya (kama export procedures, EAC STR, nk).
question_en: What does the Kenyan government restrict for Tanzanian traders selling in Kenya?
answer_en: Kenyan trade laws and taxes are completely outside my scope — I cover Tanzania Mainland only. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. For Kenya business questions: contact Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) or biashara.go.ke. I can help you with Tanzania-side requirements for goods moving from Tanzania to Kenya (such as export procedures, EAC STR, etc.).
next_review_trigger: Not applicable — Kenya out of scope

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi kwa misingi ya mkataba (contract) — mshahara wake unajumuishwa kwenye SDL?
answer_sw: Inategemea hali ya mkataba. Mfanyakazi wa mkataba anayepewa mshahara wa kawaida na mwajiri wake (employee relationship) — mshahara wake unajumuishwa kwenye SDL. Mkandarasi anayejitegemea (self-employed contractor) anayetoa ankara — mara nyingi haingii kwenye SDL. Muundo sahihi wa kisheria ndio unaotoa jibu.
question_en: A contract worker — is their salary included in SDL?
answer_en: It depends on the contract arrangement. A contract employee receiving regular salary from their employer (employee relationship) — their salary is included in SDL. An independent self-employed contractor who issues invoices — typically not included in SDL. The exact legal structure determines the answer.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Kuna adhabu ya nguvu kwa kutolipa SDL au tu faini ndogo?
answer_sw: Adhabu ya kutolipa SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — inaweza kuwa kubwa: riba ya kuchelewa (kawaida asilimia 2 kwa mwezi au zaidi), faini za hadi asilimia fulani ya kiasi kilichodaiwa, ukaguzi wa kina wa malipo yote, tathmini ya nyuma hadi miaka mitano, na hatua za kisheria za jinai katika kesi kali. Ushirikiano wa mapema na TRA unapunguza adhabu. Usisita kulipa SDL hata kama una shida ya fedha — wasiliana na TRA kwanza.
question_en: Are SDL non-payment penalties severe or just a small fine?
answer_en: Penalties for non-payment of SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — can be severe: late interest (typically 2% per month or more), fines up to a percentage of the amount owed, full payroll audits, back-assessments up to five years, and criminal proceedings in serious cases. Early cooperation with TRA reduces penalties. Do not delay SDL even if facing cash flow difficulties — contact TRA first.

instruction: Kufunga kampuni Tanzania — mchakato ni upi?
output: Kufunga kampuni rasmi (winding up/striking off) ni mchakato rasmi kupitia BRELA. Aina mbili: (1) Striking off — kampuni ndogo isiyofanya biashara inaweza kuomba kufutwa na BRELA; (2) Winding up — kufunga kampuni yenye madeni au michakato ya kibiashara, inayohitaji mwanasheria. Katika hali zote mbili, lazima kodi zote zilipwe kwanza na TRA ithibitishe kutokuwa na madeni ya kodi. Wasiliana na mwanasheria na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kwa utaratibu kamili.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Je, kampuni mpya lazima ijisajili kwa VAT mara inapofungua biashara?
answer_sw: Hapana lazima mara moja, lakini lazima ufuatilie mauzo yako. Usajili wa lazima unafuata pale unapofika kizingiti: mauzo ya TZS 200M katika miezi 12, au TZS 100M katika miezi 6. Ukifikia kizingiti, una siku 30 za kujisajili. Huna budi kujisajili siku ya kwanza ya biashara — ila kwa hiari unaweza kufanya hivyo. Kiwango cha VAT utakacho zoza ni asilimia 18.
question_en: Must a new company register for VAT as soon as it opens?
answer_en: Not necessarily on day one, but you must monitor your turnover. Mandatory registration follows when you reach the threshold: TZS 200M in 12 months, or TZS 100M in 6 months. Once reached, you have 30 days to register. You do not have to register on the first day of business — though voluntary registration is possible. The VAT rate you will charge is 18%.

question_sw: Gharama ya usajili wa OSHA kila mwaka ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Gharama ya usajili wa OSHA inategemea sekta na saizi ya mahali pa kazi. Angalia jedwali la ada la OSHA kwa kiwango sahihi cha sekta yako — ada mbalimbali zinatumika kwa viwanda, ofisi, maduka na mahali pa kazi mengine.
question_en: How much does the annual OSHA registration fee cost?
answer_en: The OSHA registration fee depends on your sector and workplace size. Check the OSHA fee schedule for your sector's exact rate — different rates apply to factories, offices, shops, and other workplace types.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Ninaweza kusajiliwa VAT hiari (voluntarily) kabla sijafika kizingiti?
output: Ndiyo. Unaweza kuomba usajilishaji wa hiari wa VAT hata kama mauzo yako hayajafika kizingiti. Hii inakufaa kama unauza kwa biashara zilizosajiliwa VAT — watakuruhusu kudai pembejeo ya VAT (input VAT) kwenye ununuzi wako. Omba kwa Kamishna wa TRA (tra.go.tz). Faida: unaweza kudai pembejeo ya VAT. Hasara: unajibika kwa taratibu zote za VAT, vikiwemo EFD na filing ya kila mwezi.

Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: Biashara yangu ina wafanyakazi 55 — je, ninahitaji safety officer wa OSHA?
output: Ndiyo — OSHA inahitaji kampuni zenye wafanyakazi 50 AU ZAIDI (katika sekta ya jumla) kuteuwa SAFETY OFFICER maalum (aliyefunzwa usalama wa mahali pa kazi). Kwa sekta ya ujenzi (construction): kizingiti ni wafanyakazi 20 au zaidi — kizingiti ni chini zaidi kwa sababu ujenzi una hatari zaidi. Kwa biashara yako ya wafanyakazi 55 (sekta ya jumla): lazima kuwe na safety officer aliyeteuliwa. Kama huna safety officer: ukaguzi wa OSHA utakuta upungufu — faini na hatua za kisheria zinaweza kufuata. Wakurugenzi wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi kwa kutofuata mahitaji ya OSHA. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, NSSF inakatwa kabla ya kuhesabu PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mchango wa lazima wa NSSF (asilimia 10 ya mfanyakazi) unakatwa mshahara ghafi na unapunguza msingi wa PAYE. Kwa mfano, mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara TZS 600,000 analipa NSSF TZS 60,000; PAYE inacheswa kwa TZS 540,000. Thibitisha na TRA na NSSF.
question_en: Is NSSF deducted before calculating PAYE?
answer_en: Yes. The mandatory employee NSSF contribution (10% of gross wage) is deducted from gross salary before calculating PAYE. For example, an employee earning TZS 600,000 pays TZS 60,000 NSSF; PAYE is calculated on TZS 540,000. Confirm with TRA and NSSF.

question_sw: Kampuni ya nje inayofanya biashara Tanzania tu kwa mtandao — ina wajibu wa kusajiliwa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hili ni suala la kisheria la 'permanent establishment' (PE). Kampuni ya nje inayotoa huduma Tanzania kwa mtandao tu inaweza au isihitajike kusajiliwa Tanzania kulingana na PE analysis. Sina uhakika wa mwelekeo halisi wa sheria ya Tanzania kwa kesi hii. Thibitisha na mwanasheria wa biashara au TRA.
question_en: A foreign company doing business in Tanzania only via internet — must it register in Tanzania?
answer_en: This is a legal 'permanent establishment' (PE) question. A foreign company providing services in Tanzania only via internet may or may not need to register in Tanzania depending on the PE analysis. I am not certain of Tanzania's current legal position on this. Verify with a business lawyer or TRA.

instruction: TRA inaweza kunipiga faini kwa kutokuwa na EFD wakati mauzo yangu yako TZS 15M kwa mwaka?
output: EFD inahitajika kulingana na kizingiti cha mauzo kilichowekwa na TRA — thibitisha kizingiti cha sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz). VAT registered businesses ZOTE lazima zitumie EFD bila kujali kiasi cha mauzo. Ndio — TRA ina mamlaka ya kukupiga faini kwa kutotumia EFD ukiwa umepitisha kizingiti cha TZS 11M. Faini za EFD zinaweza kuwa nzito: TRA inaweza kupiga faini ya kutoa risiti za uongo au kutokuwasilisha risiti kabisa. Nunua na usajili EFD haraka iwezekanavyo ukiwa umepitisha TZS 11M kwa mwaka.

question_sw: Jirani yangu mgeni anauza mahindi na maharage sokoni — je, ana tatizo la sheria?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, labda ana tatizo. Chini ya GN 487A (2025), biashara ya rejareja — ikiwa ni pamoja na kuuza mazao ya kilimo sokoni — ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania. Kama jirani yako mgeni anauza mahindi, maharage, au mazao mengine kama biashara yake binafsi, anakiuka GN 487A. Adhabu ni faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 na kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 jela. Unaweza kumwambia aone wakili au asilimame mpaka apate ushauri sahihi wa kisheria.
question_en: My foreign neighbour sells maize and beans at the market — do they have a legal problem?
answer_en: Yes, possibly. Under GN 487A (2025), retail trade — including selling agricultural produce at a market — is one of the 15 activities prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens. If your neighbour is selling maize, beans, or other produce as their own business, they are violating GN 487A. Penalties are a minimum TZS 10 million fine and up to 6 months imprisonment. You can advise them to see a lawyer or stop until they get proper legal advice.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Serikali inaweza kutoa muda wa mpito kwa waajiri wadogo kushindwa kulipa mshahara wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: Hapana muda maalum wa mpito uliotangazwa. GN 605A ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026 bila muda wa mpito kwa saizi ya biashara. Waajiri wote wanatarajiwa kufuata tarehe hiyo bila kujali ukubwa wa biashara.
question_en: Has the government given small employers a transition period for GN 605A compliance?
answer_en: No specific transition period was announced. GN 605A took effect on 1 January 2026 without a size-based transition period. All employers were expected to comply from that date regardless of business size.

question_sw: Ninafungua ofisi ndogo ya biashara — je, ninahitaji OSHA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, ofisi za biashara zinahesabiwa kama 'mahali pa kazi' (workplace) chini ya sheria ya OSHA Tanzania. Hata ofisi ndogo inayohusika na wafanyakazi inaweza kuhitajika kusajiliwa na OSHA. Viwango vya usalama vinavyohitajika vinajumuisha mambo kama vya: mwanga wa kutosha, hewa safi, njia za kutoka wakati wa dharura, na mazingira ya kazi salama. Thibitisha mahitaji yako maalum na OSHA kwenye osha.go.tz kabla ya kufungua ofisi.
question_en: I am opening a small business office — do I need OSHA?
answer_en: Yes, business offices are considered a 'workplace' under Tanzania's OSHA law. Even a small office that involves employees may be required to register with OSHA. Required safety standards cover aspects such as: adequate lighting, ventilation, emergency exits, and safe working conditions. Confirm your specific requirements with OSHA at osha.go.tz before opening your office.
primary_source_name: Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania ni mkubwa kiasi gani kwa uhamishaji wa ardhi wa TZS 500M?
answer_sw: Kwa uhamishaji wa ardhi wenye thamani ya TZS 500,000,000, ushuru wa stempu wa asilimia 1 ni TZS 5,000,000. Hii ni hesabu rahisi: thamani × asilimia 1 = TZS 500,000,000 × 0.01 = TZS 5,000,000. Ikiwa thamani ya soko ni zaidi ya bei ya mauzo iliyoandikwa, ushuru unahesabiwa kwa thamani ya soko.
question_en: How large is Tanzania stamp duty for a land transfer worth TZS 500M?
answer_en: For a land transfer worth TZS 500,000,000, the 1% stamp duty is TZS 5,000,000. This is a simple calculation: value × 1% = TZS 500,000,000 × 0.01 = TZS 5,000,000. If the market value exceeds the stated sale price, the duty is calculated on the market value.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or Stamp Duty Act amendment

instruction: Ninaanza biashara — EFD niihitajiwaje?
output: EFD inahitajika kulingana na kizingiti cha mauzo kilichowekwa na TRA — thibitisha kizingiti cha sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz). VAT registered businesses ZOTE lazima zitumie EFD bila kujali kiasi cha mauzo. Mpya wa biashara: (1) Chini ya TZS 11M kwa mwaka — EFD haihitajiki bado (endelea kufuatilia mauzo yako). (2) TZS 11M hadi TZS 200M kwa mwaka — EFD inaweza kuhitajika. (3) TZS 200M+ (au TZS 100M/miezi 6) — lazima usajili VAT na utumie EFD. Nunua EFD kupitia wasambazaji walioidhinishwa na TRA.

question_sw: Je, visa inafutwa pamoja na faini — au ni hatua ya ziada?
answer_sw: Kufutwa kwa visa ni sehemu ya kawaida ya adhabu — si hatua ya ziada ya hiari. Raia wa kigeni aliyepatikana na hatia ya kukiuka GN 487A anaweza kupoteza visa yake na kulazimishwa kuondoka Tanzania. Faini na kufutwa kwa visa vinafanyika pamoja.
question_en: Is visa revocation part of the penalty, or an optional extra step?
answer_en: Visa revocation is a standard part of the penalty — not an optional additional step. A non-citizen found guilty of violating GN 487A can lose their visa and be required to leave Tanzania. The fine and visa revocation happen together.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Kizingiti cha STR ni Dola ngapi — USD 2,000 au USD 3,000?
answer_sw: Kizingiti cha STR ni Dola za Marekani 2,000 (USD 2,000) kwa msafara mmoja (per consignment) — si USD 3,000. Bidhaa zenye thamani ya hadi USD 2,000 zinaweza kupita bila ushuru wa forodha kama zipo kwenye Common List. Kama thamani inazidi USD 2,000, utaratibu wa kawaida wa forodha unatumika.
question_en: What is the STR threshold — USD 2,000 or USD 3,000?
answer_en: The STR threshold is USD 2,000 per consignment — not USD 3,000. Goods worth up to USD 2,000 can pass duty-free if they are on the Common List. If the value exceeds USD 2,000, the standard customs process applies.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

instruction: Ninaweza kulipa SDL mapema kabla ya tarehe 7 — au lazima nisubiri hadi tarehe 7 hasa?
output: Unaweza kulipa SDL mapema kabla ya tarehe 7 — hii ni vyema na haipingwi na TRA. Tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata ni tarehe ya MWISHO (deadline), si tarehe ya lazima ya kulipa. Malipo ya mapema yanakuepusha na faini ya kuchelewa. Hata hivyo, SDL na PAYE zote zinatakiwa kulipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 — kulipa SDL mapema lakini PAYE baadaye bado kunafanya PAYE kuwa na ucheleweshaji. Thibitisha tarehe za malipo na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Duka la kukarabati simu la mgeni wa China katika soko — je, GN 487A inasema nini?
output: Ukarabati wa simu ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A (tarehe 28 Julai 2025). Hii inajumuisha ukarabati wa simu za mkononi, kompyuta ndogo, viombo vya umeme, na vifaa vya teknolojia. Mgeni anayeendesha duka la kukarabati simu anakabiliwa na: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Hata duka ndogo la sokoni linahusika. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: BRELA inaweza kusimamisha biashara yangu bila hukumu ya mahakama?
output: BRELA ina mamlaka ya kufuta orodha kampuni (deregistration) kwa kutokuwasilisha annual returns — lakini hii si kusimamisha biashara kwa vitendo. Kufutwa orodha kunamaanisha kampuni haipo kisheria — si polisi wanaokuja kufunga duka. Wakati kampuni imefutwa orodha: hawezi kuingia mikataba mipya kisheria; benki inaweza kugandamiza akaunti; wadai wanaweza kupinga shughuli. TRA inaweza kuomba mahakama isimamishe biashara kwa madeni ya kodi. Ili kuepuka hali hizi, wasilisha annual returns kwa wakati. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz.

instruction: Kampuni ya SEZ Tanzania inasamehewa VAT kwenye manunuzi yake yote?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara kwa biashara za kawaida. Msamaha wa VAT kwa kampuni za SEZ (Special Economic Zones) inashughulikiwa na EPZA na inahitaji utaalamu maalum wa sheria za uwekezaji. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au EPZA kupitia epza.go.tz.

question_sw: Biashara yangu ina msimu wa biashara (seasonal business) — mauzo yangu ya majira ya kiangazi ni TZS 130M kwa miezi 4. Je, lazima nisajili VAT?
answer_sw: Hata kama ni biashara ya msimu, ukizidi TZS 100M katika kipindi chochote cha miezi 6 — au TZS 200M katika kipindi chochote cha miezi 12 — usajili wa VAT ni wa lazima. Mauzo ya TZS 130M kwa miezi 4 ni mauzo ya haraka sana. Angalia kama katika kipindi chochote cha miezi 6 unaathiriwa na msimu huo mauzo yanazidi TZS 100M — kama ndivyo, usajili ni wa lazima. Msimu wa biashara haukuepusha na sheria ya VAT.
question_en: My business is seasonal — my summer sales are TZS 130M over 4 months. Must I register for VAT?
answer_en: Even if it is a seasonal business, if you exceed TZS 100M in any 6-month period — or TZS 200M in any 12-month period — VAT registration is mandatory. Sales of TZS 130M over 4 months is a very high rate. Check whether in any 6-month period affected by that season the sales exceed TZS 100M — if so, registration is mandatory. Seasonal trading does not exempt you from VAT law.

instruction: Ninauza bidhaa kwa serikali — bado ninatoa risiti ya EFD?
output: Ndiyo — mauzo kwa serikali, taasisi za umma, na NGO bado yanahitaji risiti ya EFD. EFD haitegemei aina ya mteja — inategemea muamala wa biashara. Hata mauzo ya bidhaa au huduma kwa wizara, halmashauri, shule za serikali, au hospitali za umma yanahitaji: (1) Risiti ya EFD; (2) Tax invoice kama mteja amesajiliwa VAT na anataka kudai input VAT. Kwa mauzo makubwa kwa serikali inaweza pia kuhitajika purchase order na mkataba rasmi — lakini hilo si badala ya EFD. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Shirika lisilo la faida (NGO au asasi ya kiraia) linalipa SDL?
answer_sw: NGO na asasi za kiraia zilizosajiliwa rasmi zinaweza kupata msamaha wa SDL — lakini si kwa kiotomatiki. Mashirika lazima yathibitishe hadhi yao ya msamaha kwa TRA kila mwaka. Ikiwa NGO inaajiri wafanyakazi na inalipa mishahara, na bado haina msamaha rasmi wa maandishi kutoka TRA, wajibu wa SDL unabaki. Mashirika yanayopokea msamaha lazima yathibitishe mwaka kwa mwaka kwamba bado yanastahili.
answer_en: NGOs and civil society organisations that are formally registered may qualify for SDL exemption — but not automatically. Organisations must confirm their exemption status with TRA annually. If an NGO employs staff and pays salaries, and does not yet have a formal written exemption from TRA, the SDL obligation remains. Organisations receiving exemption must confirm annually that they still qualify.
question_en: Does a non-profit organisation (NGO or civil society) pay SDL?

instruction: Qualifying buyer amechukua withholding ya 3% kwa bidhaa — toeni certificate lini?
output: Withholding certificate kwa bidhaa (3%) lazima itolewe SIKU YA MUAMALA — siku pesa zinalipwa au bidhaa zinapokelewa, ikijua ni kipi kinachokuja kwanza kwa muamala huo. Certificate hiyo inaonyesha: kiasi cha VAT kilichokatwa (3% ya bei), tarehe, jina la muuzaji na mnunuzi, na nambari ya TIN. Muuzaji anahitaji certificate hii kusuluhisha akaunti yake ya VAT — anapopokea certificate, anajua ni kiasi gani cha VAT tayari kimekwisha tolewa kwa niaba yake. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa fomu sahihi ya certificate.

instruction: Kampuni yangu haikuwasilisha annual return BRELA kwa mwaka mmoja — nini kitatokea?
output: Kushindwa kuwasilisha annual return BRELA kunasababisha: (1) Faini ya TZS 2,500 kwa kila mwezi au sehemu ya mwezi wa kuchelewa — zinakusanyika kila mwezi; (2) Hatari ya kampuni kufutwa orodha (deregistration) — BRELA ina uwezo wa kufuta kampuni isiyozingatia; (3) Hatari ya kampuni kuonekana 'dormant' au inactive kwenye rekodi rasmi; (4) Vikwazo vya biashara — benki na wadau wa biashara wanaweza kukataa kufanya nao biashara bila uthibitisho wa hali ya sasa. Ada ya kawaida ya annual return ni TZS 22,000 pamoja na faini. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz.

instruction: Mfanyakazi wangu anapata nyumba ya kukaa kutoka kampuni — hii inaathiri PAYE?
output: Ndio — makao ya kampuni (housing benefit) yanazingatiwa kama mapato ya mfanyakazi na yanaweza kuongezwa kwenye mshahara wake kwa PAYE. TRA ina kanuni za jinsi ya kuthamini makao ya kampuni (deemed income). Thamani inayoongezwa kwenye mshahara wa mfanyakazi → PAYE inahesabika kwa jumla. Thibitisha jinsi ya kuthamini makao na mwanasheria wa kodi au TRA.

instruction: Mgeni aliyekamatwa akifanya biashara ya rejareja Tanzania anaweza kupewa faini NA kifungo kwa wakati mmoja?
output: Hapana. Adhabu kwa mgeni chini ya GN 487A ni: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 — si zote mbili pamoja kwa kosa moja. Hata hivyo,  Muundo wa adhabu ni: faini ya angalau TZS 10M AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na

question_sw: NSSF Tanzania ina mipaka ya chini ya mchango — je, kuna kiwango cha chini?
answer_sw: Hakuna kiwango cha chini cha shilingi kilichowekwa kisheria kwa michango ya NSSF. Mchango ni asilimia ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla — 20% (mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10%). Hata mfanyakazi anayepata mshahara mdogo sana analipa NSSF kwa asilimia hiyo hiyo. Kiwango cha chini cha mshahara (GN 605A — TZS 175,000-765,900 kulingana na sekta) kinaathiri kiwango cha chini cha mshahara, si hesabu ya NSSF.
question_en: Does NSSF have a minimum contribution floor?
answer_en: There is no legally prescribed minimum shilling amount for NSSF contributions. The contribution is a percentage of gross wage — 20% (employer 10% + employee 10%). Even an employee earning a very low wage pays NSSF at that same percentage. The minimum wage (GN 605A — TZS 175,000-765,900 by sector) affects the minimum wage payable, not the NSSF calculation.

question_sw: Ada za mkurugenzi wa Tanzania (mkazi) zinatoza asilimia 20 ya WHT — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ada za mkurugenzi wa Tanzania mkazi zinatoza WHT ya asilimia 15 — si asilimia 20. Zaidi ya hayo, kiwango cha asilimia 15 kinatumika pia kwa wakurugenzi wasio wakazi — TRA inatumia kiwango kimoja cha asilimia 15 kwa ada za mkurugenzi (wasio mkurugenzi wa wakati wote) bila kujali wakazi au la. Kiwango cha asilimia 20 kwa ada za mkurugenzi si sahihi.
question_en: Director fees for a Tanzanian (resident) director attract 20% WHT — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Director fees for a Tanzania resident director attract 15% WHT — not 20%. Furthermore, the 15% rate also applies to non-resident directors — TRA applies a single rate of 15% for director fees (non-full-time directors) regardless of residency. A 20% rate for director fees is incorrect.

question_sw: Wakili aliyesajiliwa Tanzania — ana mauzo ya TZS 50M kwa mwaka tu. Lazima asajili VAT?
answer_sw: NDIYO — wakili aliyesajiliwa (advocate) lazima asajili VAT bila kujali kiasi cha mauzo yake. Hata kama ana mauzo ya TZS 50M, TZS 10M, au hata hakuna mauzo yoyote bado — usajili wa VAT ni sharti la kufanya kazi kama wakili aliyeidhinishwa. Hii ni tofauti na biashara ya kawaida ambayo inahitaji kufikia kizingiti cha TZS 200M kwanza.
question_en: A registered advocate in Tanzania — their annual fees are only TZS 50M. Must they register for VAT?
answer_en: YES — a registered advocate must register for VAT regardless of the amount of their fees. Even if they earn TZS 50M, TZS 10M, or even zero fees yet — VAT registration is a requirement for practising as a licensed advocate. This differs from ordinary businesses which need to reach the TZS 200M threshold first.

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kupunguza kodi ya mapato kwa kununua magari ya kampuni na kuyadai kama gharama — je, inaruhusiwa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, lakini kwa masharti. Kampuni inaweza kudai gharama ya kushuka kwa thamani (depreciation/capital allowance) kwenye magari yaliyonunuliwa kwa madhumuni ya biashara. TRA ina ratiba ya capital allowances (asilimia 25-37.5 kulingana na aina). Hata hivyo: (1) gharama za kibinafsi haziruhusiwi kudaiwa, (2) magari ya anasa yanaweza kupunguzwa kiwango cha madai, na (3) bei ya ununuzi kamili haiwezi kudaiwa mara moja — inasambazwa kwa miaka.
question_en: A company can reduce income tax by buying company cars and claiming them as expenses — is this allowed?
answer_en: Yes, but with conditions. A company can claim capital allowances (depreciation) on vehicles purchased for business purposes. TRA has a capital allowance schedule (25–37.5% depending on class). However: (1) personal-use expenses cannot be claimed, (2) luxury vehicles may have capped allowances, and (3) the full purchase price cannot be claimed at once — it is spread over years.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or capital allowance schedule update

question_sw: OSHA na WCF — vinahusu usalama wa kazi lakini ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority): inasimamia USALAMA mahali pa kazi — ukaguzi wa mahali pa kazi, mafunzo ya usalama, usajili wa mwajiri wa OSHA. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund): inatoa FIDIA ya pesa kwa mfanyakazi aliyeumia kazini. OSHA = kuzuia ajali; WCF = kulipa fidia baada ya ajali. Ni taasisi mbili tofauti lakini zinafanya kazi pamoja katika kuzuia na kukabiliana na ajali za kazi.
question_en: OSHA and WCF — both related to workplace safety but what is the difference?
answer_en: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority): oversees WORKPLACE SAFETY — workplace inspections, safety training, employer OSHA registration. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund): provides CASH COMPENSATION to injured workers. OSHA = accident prevention; WCF = paying compensation after an accident. They are two different institutions that work together in preventing and responding to workplace accidents.

question_sw: Je, ushuru wa stempu unaweza kuepukwa kwa kuandika mkataba nje ya Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kufanya au kusaini mkataba nje ya Tanzania HAKUEPUSHI ushuru wa stempu Tanzania ikiwa mkataba unatumika au unatekelezwa Tanzania. Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu Tanzania inashughulikia nyaraka zinazohusiana na mali au biashara Tanzania bila kujali mahali ziliposainiwa.
question_en: Can stamp duty be avoided by writing a contract outside Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Signing or drafting a contract outside Tanzania does NOT avoid Tanzania stamp duty if the contract is used or executed in Tanzania. The Tanzania Stamp Duty Act covers instruments relating to Tanzania property or business regardless of where they were signed.

instruction: PAYE ya mshahara wa TZS 520,000 kwa mwezi ni ngapi?
output:
Hesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 520,000/mwezi:
Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 = TZS 0
Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000
PAYE ya jumla: TZS 20,000/mwezi
TZS 520,000 ni mwisho wa Bendi 2 — PAYE ya juu kabisa ya Bendi 2 bila kuingia Bendi 3.

question_sw: EFD inasaidia biashara kuhesabu jumla ya VAT inayodaiwa kwa wateja au inalipwa kwa wasambazaji Tanzania vipi?
answer_sw: EFD inasaidia kwa mwelekeo mmoja wa VAT — inahesabu OUTPUT VAT (VAT inayodaiwa kwa wateja kwenye mauzo). Kwa INPUT VAT (VAT inayolipwa kwa wasambazaji kwenye manunuzi), biashara lazima ihifadhi risiti za EFD na ankara za VAT za wasambazaji wake na kuziingiza kwenye tamko lake la VAT la kila mwezi. EFD ya biashara yako HAIREKORDI manunuzi yako — unahitaji mfumo wa akaunti wa ndani kwa hilo.
question_en: How does an EFD help a business calculate total VAT charged to customers or paid to suppliers in Tanzania?
answer_en: An EFD helps with one direction of VAT — it calculates OUTPUT VAT (VAT charged to customers on sales). For INPUT VAT (VAT paid to suppliers on purchases), the business must keep EFD receipts and VAT invoices from its suppliers and enter them in its monthly VAT return. Your business EFD does NOT record your purchases — you need an internal accounting system for that.

question_sw: Biashara za kimataifa za bidhaa (import/export) pia zinakatazwa kwa wageni?
answer_sw: Biashara za uagizaji na uuzaji nje (import/export) si miongoni mwa biashara 15 zilizopigwa marufuku moja kwa moja na GN 487A. GN 487A inazuia hasa biashara ndogo na za kati zinazofanywa moja kwa moja na wageni kwenye masoko ya ndani. Wageni wanaweza kwa ujumla kufanya biashara za kimataifa ikiwa wana vibali sahihi vya biashara. Hata hivyo, uuzaji wa bidhaa zilizoagizwa moja kwa moja kwa wateja wa kawaida (retail import) unaweza kuzingatiwa ukiukaji.
question_en: Are international goods trade (import/export) businesses also prohibited for non-citizens?
answer_en: Import and export trade is not directly among the 15 business categories explicitly prohibited by GN 487A. GN 487A specifically prohibits small and medium businesses conducted directly by non-citizens in domestic markets. Non-citizens may generally conduct international trade businesses if they have the correct business permits. However, selling imported goods directly to ordinary customers (retail import) may be considered a violation.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

Certificate lazima ionekane kwenye mahali panaoonekana kwenye biashara yako.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania hulipwa kwenye thamani ya ardhi TU au pia kwenye majengo yaliyo juu ya ardhi hiyo?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa stempu wa asilimia 1 unahesabiwa kwenye THAMANI YA JUMLA ya uhamishaji — yaani thamani ya ardhi NA majengo yote yaliyo juu yake pamoja. Haigawanywi ardhi na majengo kwa madhumuni ya ushuru wa stempu. Thamani ya mali yote inayohamishwa (ardhi + majengo) ndiyo msingi wa kuhesabu ushuru.
question_en: Is Tanzania stamp duty paid on the land value ONLY or also on the buildings on it?
answer_en: The 1% stamp duty is calculated on the TOTAL transfer value — meaning the value of the land AND all buildings on it combined. There is no separation of land and buildings for stamp duty purposes. The value of the entire property being transferred (land + buildings) is the basis for the calculation.

instruction: Nilikuwa nadhani GN 605A ilianza Septemba 2025 — hii ni sahihi?
output:

Ilitangazwa (gazetted): 13 Oktoba 2025
Ilianza kutumika (effective): 1 JANUARI 2026

Septemba 2025 ni tarehe ya jambo tofauti kabisa — ni tarehe ya mabadiliko ya VAT kwa malipo ya kidijitali B2C (16%) chini ya Finance Act 2025. Usichanganye tarehe hizi mbili tofauti. Kwa GN 605A ya mishahara ya chini: wafanyakazi wana haki ya viwango vipya kuanzia 1 Januari 2026 peke yake. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina wafanyakazi katika sekta nyingi — vipi ninabainisha kiwango cha mshahara kwa kila mmoja?
output: Kila mfanyakazi lazima alipwe kulingana na kiwango cha sekta na subsekta yake maalum kama inavyoainishwa katika GN605A. Huwezi kutumia kiwango kimoja kwa wafanyakazi wote wa sekta tofauti. Hatua: (1) ainisha sekta na subsekta ya kila mfanyakazi kulingana na kazi anayofanya; (2) tazama GN605A kwa kiwango cha sekta hiyo; (3) hakikisha mshahara wake hauteremki chini ya kiwango hicho. Mshauri wa kazi (HR consultant) anaweza kukusaidia.

question_sw: Mwajiri wa Tanzania anahitaji kuwapa vifaa vya usalama (PPE) wafanyakazi wake — au wafanyakazi wanunue wenyewe?
answer_sw: MWAJIRI ndiye analazimika kuwapa wafanyakazi vifaa vya usalama (PPE — Personal Protective Equipment) BURE kwa gharama za mwajiri. Hii ni wajibu wa kisheria chini ya OSHA Act. Mwajiri HAWEZI kumtaka mfanyakazi anunue vifaa vya usalama kwa pesa zake mwenyewe. Pia mwajiri lazima ahakikishe vifaa vipo katika hali nzuri na wafanyakazi wanajua kutumia PPE ipasavyo.
question_en: Is a Tanzania employer required to provide safety equipment (PPE) to workers — or do workers buy their own?
answer_en: The EMPLOYER is required to provide workers with personal protective equipment (PPE) FREE of charge at the employer's expense. This is a legal obligation under the OSHA Act. An employer CANNOT require a worker to buy their own safety equipment. The employer must also ensure equipment is in good condition and workers know how to use PPE properly.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Kanda ya juu kabisa ya PAYE ni asilimia 35 — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kanda ya juu kabisa ya PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia 30 — si asilimia 35. Kiwango cha asilimia 30 kinatumika kwa mapato yanayozidi Shilingi 1,000,000 kwa mwezi. Kiwango cha asilimia 35 hakipo katika muundo wa PAYE wa Tanzania.
question_en: The top PAYE band is 35% — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The top PAYE band in Tanzania is 30% — not 35%. The 30% rate applies to income above TZS 1,000,000 per month. A 35% rate does not exist in Tanzania's PAYE structure.

instruction: Daktari alisema nina ugonjwa wa moyo — dawa gani ninaweza kuchukua?
output: Nje ya maarifa yangu kabisa. Maswali ya matibabu na dawa ni nje ya wigo wa utaalamu wangu wa biashara na kodi. Kwa ushauri wa matibabu, wasiliana na daktari wako au nenda hospitalini. Maisha yako ni muhimu — tafadhali pata msaada wa kitaalamu wa matibabu mara moja.

question_sw: Kampuni iliyosajiliwa BRELA inahitaji leseni nyingine pia au BRELA peke yake inatosha?
answer_sw: Usajili wa BRELA unatoa uhalali wa kisheria wa kampuni au biashara, lakini si leseni za sekta maalum. Biashara nyingi zinahitaji leseni za ziada kama: leseni ya biashara ya manispaa, leseni za TRA (TIN, VAT), vibali vya mazingira (NEMC), leseni za sekta maalum (TFDA/TMDA kwa dawa, NBS kwa viwango), na nyingine.
question_en: Does a BRELA-registered company need other licences too or is BRELA registration alone enough?
answer_en: BRELA registration gives a company its legal existence, but not sector-specific licences. Most businesses need additional licences including: municipal trading licence, TRA registrations (TIN, VAT), environmental permit (NEMC), sector licences (TMDA for medicines, TBS for standards), and others.

instruction: Je, kukosa kutoa risiti ya EFD kwa mteja ni udanganyifu wa kodi?
output: Ndiyo, TRA inaweza kuainisha kukosa kutoa risiti ya EFD kama udanganyifu wa kodi (tax evasion) kwa sababu miamala inayokosekana kwenye mfumo wa EFD haionekani kwa TRA. Hii ni ukiukwaji mkubwa ambao unaweza kusababisha: faini kubwa, uchunguzi wa kodi, au hatua za kisheria. Toa risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala bila ubaguzi.
