instruction: PAYE ya mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 1,000,000 hasa kwa mwezi ni kiasi gani?
output:
PAYE ya mshahara wa TZS 1,000,000 hasa kwa mwezi inakokotolewa kwa kanda za PAYE kama ifuatavyo:

Kanda 1 (0%): TZS 0 hadi 270,000 — kodi = TZS 0
Kanda 2 (8%): TZS 270,001 hadi 520,000 — TZS 250,000 x 8% = TZS 20,000
Kanda 3 (20%): TZS 520,001 hadi 760,000 — TZS 240,000 x 20% = TZS 48,000
Kanda 4 (25%): TZS 760,001 hadi 1,000,000 — TZS 240,000 x 25% = TZS 60,000

Jumla ya PAYE = TZS 128,000 kwa mwezi.

Mshahara wa TZS 1,000,001 na zaidi unaanza kuingia kanda ya 5 (30%). Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Rafiki yangu wa kigeni anataka kutumia jina langu kufungua duka la rejareja — ninaweza kukubaliana?
answer_sw: Hapana — hii ni hatua yenye hatari kubwa kwa ajili yako wewe mwenyewe. GN 487A inaadhibu raia wa Tanzania wanaowasaidia wageni kukiuka marufuku. Adhabu yako kama raia wa Tanzania: faini ya TZS milioni 5 au kifungo cha miezi 3 gerezani. Duka linaweza kufungwa na wewe unaweza kufunguliwa kesi ya jinai. Usikubali. Wasiliana na wakili kabla ya kuchukua hatua yoyote.
question_en: My foreign friend wants to use my name to open a retail shop — can I agree to this?
answer_en: No — this is extremely risky for you personally. GN 487A penalises Tanzanian citizens who assist non-citizens to violate the prohibition. Your penalty as a Tanzanian: TZS 5 million fine or 3 months imprisonment. The shop can be closed and you can face criminal prosecution. Do not agree to this. Consult a lawyer before taking any action.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya rejareja ndogo — ninahitaji kampuni ya hisa au biashara ya jina?
output: Kwa biashara ndogo ya rejareja, mambo muhimu ya kuzingatia: BIASHARA YA JINA: rahisi na nafuu kuanzisha (BRELA ada ndogo), lakini mmiliki anashikiliwa kibinafsi kwa madeni. Inafaa kwa biashara ndogo sana zenye hatari ndogo za madeni. KAMPUNI YA HISA: inahitaji mtaji wa usajili (min TZS 95,000 kwa BRELA), annual returns, na akaunti rasmi — lakini inalinda mali za kibinafsi. Inafaa ukipanga kukua, kutaka mkopo wa benki, au kufanya mikataba mikubwa. Maamuzi inategemea ukubwa wa hatari, mipango ya ukuaji, na mahitaji ya wadau wako. Thibitisha na wakili au mshauri wa biashara.

question_sw: Kama mfanyakazi wa muda (casual worker) — mwajiri wake anahitajika kumlipa NSSF?
answer_sw: Hii ni eneo lenye utata na linalohitaji uthibitisho wa hivi karibuni na NSSF. Kwa mujibu wa sheria ya NSSF Tanzania, wafanyakazi wa aina mbalimbali — ikiwa ni pamoja na wale wa mkataba wa muda mfupi — wanaweza kuhitimu ufikiwa wa NSSF. Hata hivyo, sheria inaweza kutofautisha kati ya 'casual' na 'mfanyakazi wa kudumu'. Usifanye uamuzi bila kuuliza NSSF moja kwa moja. Wasiliana na NSSF kwenye nssf.or.tz kwa mwongozo wa hali yako maalum.
question_en: If I hire casual (temporary) workers — must I pay NSSF for them?
answer_en: This is an area that requires up-to-date confirmation directly from NSSF. Under Tanzania's NSSF Act, various categories of workers — including those on short-term contracts — may qualify for NSSF coverage. However, the law may distinguish between 'casual' and 'permanent' employees. Do not make assumptions — ask NSSF directly. Contact NSSF at nssf.or.tz for guidance on your specific situation.
next_review_trigger: When NSSF Act is amended — VERIFY exact effective date from nssf.or.tz before training

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inaweza kuwa na mkurugenzi mmoja tu — je, ni lazima kuwe na wawili?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni ya binafsi (private limited company) ya Tanzania inaweza kuwa na mkurugenzi mmoja tu — si lazima kuwe na wawili. Hata hivyo, kampuni ya umma (public company) inaweza kuwa na mahitaji tofauti ya idadi ya wakurugenzi. Memorandum na Articles of Association inaweza pia kuweka mahitaji ya kampuni mwenyewe.
question_en: Can a Tanzanian company have just one director — is it mandatory to have two?
answer_en: Yes. A Tanzanian private limited company can have just one director — there is no requirement for two. However a public company may have different director number requirements. The Memorandum and Articles of Association can also set the company's own requirements.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mkulima anayeuza mazao yake sokoni mwenyewe — PAYE inahitajika?
answer_sw: Hapana kwa kawaida. Mkulima anayeuza mazao yake mwenyewe si mfanyakazi wa mtu mwingine — kwa hivyo PAYE haihusiki. PAYE ni kwa wafanyakazi waliohiriwa tu. Kama mkulima ana wafanyakazi wake, ndipo anaweza kuwa na wajibu wa PAYE kwa wafanyakazi hao.
question_en: A farmer who sells their own produce at the market — is PAYE required?
answer_en: Generally no. A farmer selling their own produce is not an employee of someone else — so PAYE does not apply to them. PAYE is only for hired employees. If the farmer has hired workers, then they may have PAYE obligations for those workers.

question_sw: Idara ya Uhamiaji Tanzania inafanya kazi saa ngapi na iko wapi?
answer_sw: Idara ya Uhamiaji ya Tanzania ina makao makuu Dar es Salaam na ofisi za mikoa kote nchini. Maombi ya vibali vya kazi yanaweza kuwasilishwa kwenye ofisi kuu au ofisi za mkoa. Angalia tovuti ya immigration.go.tz kwa maelezo ya hali ya sasa ya saa za kufanya kazi, anwani, na taratibu za maombi mtandaoni.
question_en: What are the Tanzania Immigration Department's hours and where is it located?
answer_en: The Tanzania Immigration Department has its headquarters in Dar es Salaam and regional offices across the country. Work permit applications can be submitted at the main office or regional offices. Check immigration.go.tz for current operating hours, addresses, and online application procedures.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anaweza kubadilisha mwajiri bila kuomba kibali kipya kwa sababu kibali chake bado ni halali — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kibali cha Darasa B kinaambatanishwa na mwajiri MAALUM aliyetajwa kwenye kibali. Kubadilisha mwajiri bila kibali kipya au marekebisho ya kibali kilichopo ni ukiukwaji. Mfanyakazi lazima apate kibali kipya kinachomtaja mwajiri mpya, au mwajiri mpya aomba uhamisho rasmi kutoka Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: A foreign worker can change employer without applying for a new permit because their permit is still valid — is this correct?
answer_en: No. A Class B permit is tied to the SPECIFIC employer named on the permit. Changing employers without a new permit or amendment to the existing one is a violation. The worker must obtain a new permit naming the new employer, or the new employer must apply for a formal transfer from the Immigration Department.

question_sw: SDL, NSSF, WCF, PAYE — muhtasari wa ni nani analipa nini.
answer_sw: PAYE: mfanyakazi hulipa (mwajiri anaikata na kuipeleka TRA, tarehe 7). NSSF: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (inakwenda NSSF). WCF: mwajiri 0.5% peke yake (inakwenda WCF). SDL: mwajiri 3.5% peke yake kwa wafanyakazi ≥10 (inakwenda TRA, tarehe 7). Sehemu za mfanyakazi: PAYE + NSSF. Sehemu za mwajiri peke yake: NSSF (10%) + WCF + SDL.
question_en: SDL, NSSF, WCF, PAYE — summary of who pays what.
answer_en: PAYE: employee pays (employer deducts and remits to TRA, by 7th). NSSF: employer 10% + employee 10% (goes to NSSF). WCF: employer 0.5% only (goes to WCF). SDL: employer 3.5% only for ≥10 employees (goes to TRA, by 7th). Employee's portions: PAYE + NSSF. Employer-only portions: NSSF (10%) + WCF + SDL.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: Mgeni wa India amefunguliwa kesi chini ya GN 487A kwa kuendesha saluni — kama korti itatoa faini, je, visa yake itafutwa pia?
output: Ndiyo — kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Hii ni hatua tofauti inayotekelezwa na Idara ya Uhamiaji — tofauti na uamuzi wa korti wa faini au kifungo. Muundo wa adhabu: korti inaamua faini AU kifungo; Idara ya Uhamiaji inashughulikia hali ya visa. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Safety officer anafanya nini hasa na ana sifa gani?
output: Afisa usalama (safety officer) anahitajika: Sekta ya jumla: wafanyakazi 50 au zaidi. Sekta ya ujenzi: wafanyakazi 20 au zaidi. Majukumu ya safety officer: (1) Ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara wa mahali pa kazi. (2) Kutoa mafunzo ya usalama kwa wafanyakazi. (3) Kuandika na kusambaza ripoti za ajali na hatari. (4) Kuhakikisha vifaa vya usalama (PPE) vinatumika. (5) Kuwasiliana na OSHA kuhusu ukaguzi na taarifa. Sifa: mafunzo ya usalama na afya mahali pa kazi (yanatolewa na OSHA na taasisi zilizoidhinishwa).

instruction: Kampuni yangu inaagiza huduma kutoka kampuni mama yake Dubai — bei ya baina ni nini kwa kodi Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Utaratibu wa bei za uhamishaji (transfer pricing) kwa muamala wa baina ya kampuni zinazohusiana ni mada ya kodi ya kimataifa — arm's length principle, documentation requirements, na taratibu maalum za TRA — zote ziko nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Wasiliana na TRA au mshauri wa kodi wa kimataifa kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Msambazaji wa nje ya nchi (exporter) anaweza kudai refund ya VAT — kwa nini?
answer_sw: Exports (mauzo nje ya nchi) zinabeba kiwango cha VAT cha 0% (zero-rated). Hii inamaanisha exporter hakusanyi VAT kutoka kwa wateja wake wa nje — output VAT = 0. Lakini exporter bado ananunua bidhaa/huduma Tanzania na kulipa input VAT ya kawaida (18%). Kwa hivyo input VAT > output VAT, na exporter ana haki ya kudai refund ya input VAT iliyolipwa.
question_en: An exporter can claim a VAT refund — why?
answer_en: Exports carry a 0% VAT rate (zero-rated). This means the exporter does not collect VAT from foreign customers — output VAT = 0. But the exporter still buys goods/services in Tanzania and pays regular input VAT (18%). Therefore input VAT > output VAT, and the exporter is entitled to claim a refund of the input VAT paid.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Mwajiri wa ndani ya nyumba (nyumba ya binafsi, msaidizi wa nyumbani) — analipa SDL?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida, waajiri wa msaidizi wa nyumbani (nyumba za binafsi wenye msaidizi mmoja au wachache) wako nje ya mfumo wa SDL wa kawaida wa biashara. Hata hivyo, hali maalum inaweza kutofautiana. Thibitisha na TRA kama unashuku una wajibu.
question_en: A domestic employer (private home, household helper) — do they pay SDL?
answer_en: Generally, employers of domestic workers (private households with one or few helpers) are outside the standard business SDL framework. However, specific situations may vary. Verify with TRA if you suspect you have an obligation.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Kiwango cha chini kabisa cha mshahara chini ya GN 605A ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha chini kabisa kwa sekta ya jumla ni karibu TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi. Viwango vinafikia hadi TZS 765,900 kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati. Thibitisha kiwango halisi cha sekta yako na MLYWF.
question_en: What is the lowest minimum wage under GN 605A?
answer_en: The lowest minimum wage for the general sector is approximately TZS 175,000 per month. Rates reach up to TZS 765,900 for the international mining and energy sector. Confirm your sector's exact rate with MLYWF.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa viwanda (manufacturing) ana mshahara wa chini wa kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Sekta ya viwanda na uzalishaji ina kiwango chake katika GN 605A. Kiwango hiki ni cha wastani — zaidi ya kiwango cha jumla cha Shilingi 175,000 lakini chini ya sekta za madini. Angalia jedwali la GN 605A kwa kiwango sahihi cha sekta ya viwanda.
question_en: What minimum wage applies to a manufacturing worker?
answer_en: The manufacturing sector has its own rate in GN 605A — a mid-tier rate above the general floor of TZS 175,000 but below mining sectors. Check the GN 605A schedule for the exact manufacturing rate.

instruction: Ni aina gani za biashara zinazosajiliwa na BRELA Tanzania Bara?
output: BRELA inasajili aina TATU za biashara: 1. Biashara ya jina (sole trader/business name) 2. Ubia (partnership) 3. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company). Hakuna aina nyingine ya nne au ya tano chini ya Companies Act Tanzania. Kila aina ina mahitaji tofauti ya usajili, ada, na utaratibu wa kuwasilisha taarifa. Tembelea brela.go.tz kwa maelezo kamili.

question_sw: Je, VAT ya chakula Tanzania ni asilimia 5?
answer_sw: Hapana. Tanzania haina kiwango cha VAT kilichopunguzwa cha asilimia 5 wala asilimia 10. Kiwango kimoja tu cha VAT kinacho Tanzania Bara ni asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida. Bidhaa za chakula fulani zinaweza kuwa zero-rated (asilimia 0) au zimesamehewa kabisa (exempt), lakini hakuna kiwango cha kati cha asilimia 5. Thibisha hali ya kila bidhaa na TRA.
question_en: Is food VAT in Tanzania 5%?
answer_en: No. Tanzania does not have a reduced VAT rate of 5% or 10%. There is only one VAT rate on Mainland Tanzania: 18% standard rate. Some food items may be zero-rated (0%) or fully exempt, but there is no intermediate 5% rate. Confirm the status of each product with TRA.

instruction: Kampuni yangu huchimba dhahabu Mara — royalties ya madini ni asilimia ngapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Royalties za madini (gold, minerals) zinaamuliwa na Sheria ya Madini ya Tanzania (Mining Act) na zinasimamiwa na Wizara ya Madini — si TRA peke yake. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na Wizara ya Madini, TRA, au mshauri wa kodi wa sekta ya madini kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kufikia makubaliano (settlement) na TRA nje ya mahakama — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRA ina mchakato wa kusuluhisha migogoro ya kodi nje ya mahakama. Msuluhishi (alternative dispute resolution) unaweza kuwa wa haraka na wa bei nafuu kuliko kesi za mahakama. Makubaliano yanaweza kujumuisha kufuta sehemu ya adhabu au riba ikiwa msingi wa kodi unakubaliwa. Shauriana na mshauri wa kodi kwanza.
question_en: Can a company reach a settlement with TRA outside of court — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. TRA has a process for settling tax disputes outside court. Alternative dispute resolution can be faster and less costly than court proceedings. Settlements may include waiving some penalties or interest if the underlying tax liability is accepted. Consult a tax adviser first.

question_sw: Mtu lazima asajili VAT ndani ya muda gani baada ya kufikia kizingiti?
answer_sw: Mtu anayehitajika kusajiliwa VAT lazima afanye maombi kwa Kamishna Mkuu ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kufikia kizingiti. Kukosa kusajili kwa wakati kunaweza kusababisha usajili wa lazima na faini. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Within what time must a business register for VAT after reaching the threshold?
answer_en: A person required to register for VAT must apply to the Commissioner General within 30 days of reaching the threshold. Failing to register on time may result in compulsory registration and penalties. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari wa mada ngumu ya GN 487A: vitu 4 muhimu ambavyo mfanyabiashara yeyote lazima avijue.
answer_sw: Vitu 4 muhimu vya GN 487A kwa mfanyabiashara: (1) NANI: Wageni (non-citizens) tu — Watanzania hawakabiwi vikwazo vya GN 487A. (2) NINI: Makundi 15 ya biashara yakiwemo rejareja, jumla, mobile money, ukarabati wa simu, salon, kinyozi, ushonaji, na mengine. (3) ADHABU: Mgeni = angalau TZS 10M NA kifungo NA visa kufutwa; Msaidizi Mtanzania = hadi TZS 5M AU kifungo miezi 3. (4) NJIA ZA KUKWEPA HAZIFANYI KAZI: Ndoa, ukaazi wa muda mrefu, kampuni ya Tanzania, 49%/51% bandia — zote hazizuii GN 487A bila uraia wa kweli wa Tanzania.
question_en: Summary of the complex GN 487A topic: 4 critical things any business person must know.
answer_en: 4 critical GN 487A things for any business person: (1) WHO: Non-citizens only — Tanzanians are not subject to GN 487A restrictions. (2) WHAT: 15 business categories including retail, wholesale, mobile money, phone repair, hair salons, barbershops, tailoring, and others. (3) PENALTIES: Non-citizen = at least TZS 10M AND imprisonment AND visa revocation; Tanzanian facilitator = up to TZS 5M OR 3 months' imprisonment. (4) CIRCUMVENTION METHODS DO NOT WORK: Marriage, long residency, Tanzanian company, fake 49%/51% — none of these prevent GN 487A without genuine Tanzanian citizenship.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Nini kinatokea nikisairishwa kwa EFD na TRA?
answer_sw: Ikiwa EFD yako imesimamishwa na TRA: (1) Huwezi kutoa risiti za kisheria mpaka tatizo litatatuliwe; (2) Kufanya biashara bila EFD inayofanya kazi (kwa biashara ya VAT) ni kinyume cha sheria; (3) Wasiliana na TRA mara moja kujua sababu ya kusimamishwa; (4) Tatua tatizo (kulipa deni la kodi, kurekebisha EFD, n.k.) ili kurejesha EFD. Usiendelee kufanya biashara bila kurejesha EFD ya kisheria.
question_en: What happens if my EFD is suspended by TRA?
answer_en: If your EFD is suspended by TRA: (1) You cannot issue legal receipts until the issue is resolved; (2) Conducting business without a functioning EFD (for a VAT business) is unlawful; (3) Contact TRA immediately to find out the reason for suspension; (4) Resolve the issue (pay tax debt, repair EFD, etc.) to restore EFD. Do not continue business without restoring a legal EFD.

instruction: PAYE ya mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 300,000 kwa mwezi — inakokotolewa vipi?
output: Mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 300,000/mwezi: Band 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 → kodi = TZS 0. Ziada: TZS 300,000 − TZS 270,000 = TZS 30,000. Band 2 (8%): TZS 30,000 × 8% = TZS 2,400. PAYE ya mwezi = TZS 2,400. Hakuna punguzo la kibinafsi (personal relief) tofauti — kizingiti cha 0% (TZS 270,000) NDIYO punguzo la ufanisi. Kwa hivyo mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 300,000 analipa PAYE ya TZS 2,400/mwezi tu — kiasi kidogo kwa sababu ana mshahara mdogo unaopita kidogo mstari wa TZS 270,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayepata TZS 400,000 kwa mwezi analipa PAYE ngapi?
answer_sw: PAYE kwa TZS 400,000/mwezi: Kundi 1 (0–270,000): TZS 0. Kundi 2 (270,001–400,000): 130,000 × 9% = TZS 11,700. Jumla kabla ya punguzo = TZS 11,700. Punguzo la kibinafsi = TZS 26,000. Kwa sababu TZS 11,700 ni chini ya punguzo la TZS 26,000, PAYE inayolipwa = TZS 0. Mwajiri hahitajiki kuwasilisha PAYE kwa mwezi huo — lakini bado lazima atume return ya PAYE (nil return) kama inavyohitajika.
answer_en: PAYE for TZS 400,000/month: Band 1 (0–270,000): TZS 0. Band 2 (270,001–400,000): 130,000 × 9% = TZS 11,700. Total before relief = TZS 11,700. Personal relief = TZS 26,000. Since TZS 11,700 is less than the TZS 26,000 relief, PAYE payable = TZS 0. The employer does not need to remit PAYE that month — but must still file a PAYE return (nil return) as required.
question_en: An employee earning TZS 400,000 per month — how much PAYE do they pay?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — worked example ITA Cap.332 Finance Act 2025

instruction: Kampuni ya mafuta inachimba gesi asilia Tanzania — royalties ni nini na zinalipiwa wapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Royalties za mafuta na gesi (petroleum royalties) zinaamuliwa na Sheria ya Mafuta (Petroleum Act), makubaliano ya PSA, na TPDC/TMSA — ni mada tofauti kabisa nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na TPDC, TRA, au mshauri wa kodi wa sekta ya nishati kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: WHT kwa msaada wa kiufundi (technical assistance) kutoka kampuni ya kigeni ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: WHT kwa ada za msaada wa kiufundi na usimamizi kutoka kampuni ya kigeni (wasio wakazi) ni asilimia 15. Kwa kampuni ya ndani (wakazi), kiwango ni asilimia 5. Tofauti hii ni muhimu kwa makampuni yanayopanga mikataba ya ushauri wa kimataifa.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on technical assistance from a foreign company?
answer_en: WHT on technical assistance and management fees from a foreign (non-resident) company is 15%. For a domestic (resident) company the rate is 5%. This difference is important for companies contracting international advisory services.

question_sw: Common List ya STR ina bidhaa ngapi na ina bidhaa gani?
answer_sw: Common List ya STR ina takriban bidhaa 370 zilizoidhinishwa. Inajumuisha hasa: mazao ya kilimo (mahindi, viazi, mboga, matunda), vyakula vya kaya, nguo za kawaida, na bidhaa ndogo ndogo za kila siku. Orodha kamili inapatikana kwenye ofisi za forodha au tovuti za EAC/COMESA.
question_en: How many products are on the STR Common List and what does it include?
answer_en: The STR Common List has approximately 370 approved products. It mainly includes: agricultural produce (maize, potatoes, vegetables, fruits), household food items, everyday clothing, and small everyday goods. The full list is available at customs offices or on EAC/COMESA websites.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Mtu anayenunua ardhi Tanzania kwa mara ya kwanza ana msamaha wowote wa ushuru wa stempu — kama 'first home buyer' msamaha wa nchi nyingine?
answer_sw: Tanzania haina mfumo maalum wa msamaha wa ushuru wa stempu kwa wanunuzi wa nyumba kwa mara ya kwanza (first-time buyer) kama nchi kama Uingereza au Australia. Ushuru wa stempu wa asilimia 1 unatumika kwa wanunuzi wote bila kujali iwapo ni ununuzi wao wa kwanza au la.
question_en: Does a first-time land buyer in Tanzania get any stamp duty exemption — like a 'first home buyer' relief in other countries?
answer_en: Tanzania does not have a dedicated first-time buyer stamp duty exemption like countries such as the UK or Australia. The flat 1% stamp duty applies to all buyers regardless of whether it is their first purchase.

question_sw: Mwekezaji wa kigeni mwenye hisa katika kampuni ya Tanzania — je, GN 487A inamzuia?
answer_sw: Si kwa njia ya moja kwa moja. GN 487A inalenga biashara zinazomilikiwa au kuendeshwa NA wageni moja kwa moja — si uwekezaji wa hisa kwa ujumla. Mwekezaji wa kigeni mwenye hisa ndogo (minority shareholder) katika kampuni ya Tanzania inayomilikiwa na Watanzania kwa wengi haizuiwi na GN 487A, mradi kampuni inafanya kazi katika sekta zinazoruhusu uwekezaji wa kigeni. Hata hivyo, kama mwekezaji huyu ndiye mkurugenzi mtendaji anayeendesha moja ya sekta 15 zilizozuiliwa, hali inaweza kuwa tofauti. Ushauri wa kisheria unapendekezwa.
question_en: A foreign investor with shares in a Tanzanian company — does GN 487A restrict them?
answer_en: Not directly. GN 487A targets businesses owned or operated BY non-citizens directly — not general shareholding. A foreign investor who is a minority shareholder in a Tanzanian-majority-owned company is not restricted by GN 487A, provided the company operates in sectors that allow foreign investment. However, if that investor is also the managing director operating one of the 15 prohibited sectors, the situation may differ. Legal advice is recommended.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Je, kiwango cha VAT Tanzania kimebadilika kutoka asilimia 18 kwenda asilimia 16 mwaka 2025?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT Tanzania Bara kilibaki asilimia 18 mwaka 2025. Kilichobadilika ni VAT ya malipo ya kidijitali (B2C e-payment) ambayo Finance Act 2025 ilipanga asilimia 16 kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025 — lakini hii ni kwa aina maalum ya muamala wa kidijitali peke yake, si kiwango cha kawaida. Kwa biashara ya kawaida ya Tanzania, VAT ni asilimia 18.
question_en: Did Tanzania's VAT rate change from 18% to 16% in 2025?
answer_en: No. The standard VAT rate on Mainland Tanzania remained at 18% throughout 2025. What changed is that Finance Act 2025 set a 16% rate specifically for B2C e-payment transactions effective 1 September 2025 — but this applies to that specific digital transaction category only, not the standard rate. For regular Tanzanian business, VAT is 18%.

instruction: NSSF inakokotolewa kutoka kwa mshahara gani na ni asilimia ngapi?
output: NSSF jumla ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara wa jumla (gross wage). Mgawanyo wa kawaida: mwajiri anachangia asilimia 10 na mfanyakazi anachangia asilimia 10. Hata hivyo, kuna mgawanyo mwingine halali: mwajiri asilimia 15 na mfanyakazi asilimia 5; au mwajiri asilimia 20 na mfanyakazi asilimia 0 (mwajiri analipa yote). Chaguo la mgawanyo ni la mwajiri — lakini jumla lazima iwe asilimia 20.

instruction: Korti imetoa hukumu ya kifungo cha miezi 3 tu (si faini) — je, adhabu nyingine zipo?
output: Ndiyo — hata kama korti imetoa kifungo tu bila faini,  Hii inamaanisha mgeni huyo lazima ataondoka Tanzania baada ya kutumikia kifungo (au awali). Pia biashara iliyokuwa ikifanywa lazima ifungwe mara moja. Kwa hiyo muundo kamili wa adhabu ni: (faini AU kifungo — korti huchagua) NA

instruction: Daktari binafsi aliye na kliniki ndogo — anahitaji kusajili VAT?
output: Huduma za afya (medical services) nyingi zimesamehewa VAT (exempt) Tanzania. Hata hivyo, daktari aliyeidhinishwa anapaswa kuthibitisha na TRA: (1) Je, huduma zake ni exempt au standard rated? (2) Je, ana wajibu wowote wa usajili kama mtaalamu aliyeidhinishwa? Thibitisha hali yako maalum na TRA kwa sababu sekta ya afya ina kanuni maalum za VAT.

question_sw: Leseni ya biashara ya LGA inagharimu kiasi gani na inahuishwa lini?
answer_sw: Ada ya leseni ya biashara ya Mamlaka ya Serikali za Mitaa (LGA) inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya biashara, eneo, na ukubwa. Kwa biashara ndogo za kawaida mji mkubwa, ada inaweza kuanzia TZS 50,000 hadi TZS 500,000+ kwa mwaka. Leseni huhuishwa kila mwaka — tarehe ya mwisho ni 31 Machi ya mwaka unaofuata. Kuendesha biashara bila leseni ya LGA ni kosa na kunaweza kusababisha faini au kufungwa kwa biashara.
question_en: How much does an LGA business licence cost and when is it renewed?
answer_en: The Local Government Authority (LGA) business licence fee varies by business type, location, and size. For ordinary small businesses in major cities, fees can range from TZS 50,000 to TZS 500,000+ per year. Licences are renewed annually — the deadline is 31 March of the following year. Operating without an LGA business licence is an offence and can result in fines or business closure.

question_sw: Adhabu ya mgeni kufanya kazi bila kibali ni kama ile ya mgeni kufanya biashara iliyozuiwa chini ya GN 487A — je, viwango ni sawa?
answer_sw: Hapana, viwango si sawa. Kufanya kazi bila kibali cha kazi: adhabu ya jumla chini ya Sheria ya Uhamiaji. Kufanya biashara iliyozuiwa chini ya GN 487A: faini ya angalau Shilingi 10,000,000 + kifungo hadi miezi 6 + kufutwa kwa viza — viwango maalum zaidi na vikali zaidi. GN 487A ina viwango vya adhabu vilivyobainishwa wazi.
question_en: The penalty for a foreigner working without a permit is the same as for conducting a GN 487A-prohibited business — are the levels the same?
answer_en: No, the levels are not the same. Working without a work permit: general penalty under the Immigration Act. Conducting a GN 487A-prohibited business: minimum TZS 10,000,000 fine + up to 6 months imprisonment + visa revocation — more specific and harsher. GN 487A has clearly stated penalty levels.

question_sw: Ni bora zaidi kuweka pesa benki au kununua ardhi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Uamuzi wa uwekezaji wa kibinafsi (benki vs ardhi) ni nje ya upeo wangu. Ninashughulikia kodi za biashara na usajili Tanzania Bara — si ushauri wa uwekezaji wa kibinafsi. Kwa ushauri wa uwekezaji, wasiliana na mshauri wa fedha aliyesajiliwa au Capital Markets and Securities Authority (CMSA) Tanzania kwa maswali ya masoko ya mitaji. Je, kuna swali la kodi ya biashara ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: Is it better to put money in a bank or buy land in Tanzania?
answer_en: Personal investment decisions (bank vs land) are outside my scope. I handle business taxes and registration for Mainland Tanzania — not personal investment advice. For investment advice, contact a registered financial adviser or the Capital Markets and Securities Authority (CMSA) Tanzania for capital markets questions. Is there a business tax question I can help with?

instruction: Kampuni yangu ya EPZ inapaswa kulipa SDL kwa wafanyakazi wake?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Wajibu wa SDL kwa kampuni za EPZ/SEZ unashughulikiwa chini ya EPZ Act na mkataba wa EPZA — masharti yanaweza kutofautiana na kampuni za kawaida za Tanzania Bara. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, VAT inastahili kwa bidhaa na huduma zote Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. VAT inastahili kwa usambazaji unaostahili (taxable supply) peke yake unaofanywa na mtu msajiliwa katika mwendo wa shughuli za kiuchumi. Usambazaji fulani una kiwango cha sifuri (zero-rated) au umeachiliwa (exempt). Thibitisha hali ya bidhaa/huduma yako na TRA.
question_en: Does VAT apply to all goods and services in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. VAT applies only to taxable supplies made by a registered person in the course of economic activities. Some supplies are zero-rated or exempt. Confirm the status of your goods/services with TRA.

instruction: Nina mfanyakazi mmoja tu wa kujaribu (probation) — nimsajili NSSF?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Ndio — mfanyakazi wa kipindi cha majaribio (probation) bado ni mfanyakazi. Lazima usajili NSSF tangu siku ya kwanza ya kazi — hakuna msamaha wa kipindi cha majaribio. Kusajili mapema kunakuepusha faini na madai ya NSSF baadaye.

instruction: Ninanunua nyumba ya TZS 300M Dar es Salaam — stamp duty yake ni ngapi na nani analipa?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Stamp duty kwa uhamishaji wa mali isiyohamishika inashughulikiwa chini ya Stamp Duty Act — kiwango na mtu anayeilipa vinategemea aina ya muamala na thamani iliyokadiriwa na mthamini wa serikali. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kama na ofisi ndogo ya wafanyakazi 5, bado nahitaji kufuata sheria ya OSHA?
answer_sw: Ingawa usajili rasmi wa OSHA unatakiwa kwa wafanyakazi 10+, masharti ya msingi ya usalama ya OSHA yanatumika kwa biashara zote. Hii inajumuisha: mazingira salama ya kazi, hewa safi, taa ya kutosha, na msaada wa kwanza. Usalama wa wafanyakazi ni wajibu wa kisheria bila kujali saizi.
question_en: If I have a small office of 5 employees do I still need to follow OSHA law?
answer_en: Although formal OSHA registration is required for 10+ employees, the basic OSHA safety requirements apply to all businesses. This includes: safe working environment, adequate ventilation, sufficient lighting, and first aid. Employee safety is a legal duty regardless of size.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Mfuko wangu wa pensheni (pension fund) — kodi yake inakuwaje wakati wa kustaafu?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa mafao ya pensheni na mifuko ya pensheni wakati wa kustaafu ni eneo maalum la sheria ya jamii na kodi — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Kodi ya mafao ya pensheni inategemea mfuko (NSSF, PSPF, GEPF, nk), aina ya malipo (mkupuo au malipo ya kila mwezi), na sheria inayosimamia mfuko huo. Wasiliana na msimamizi wa mfuko wako au mhesabu wa kodi aliyehitimu.
question_en: My pension fund — how is it taxed when I retire?
answer_en: Taxation of pension benefits and pension funds at retirement is a specialised area of social security and tax law — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Pension benefit taxation depends on the fund (NSSF, PSPF, GEPF, etc.), type of payment (lump sum or monthly), and the law governing that fund. Contact your fund administrator or a qualified tax accountant.

instruction: Mgeni wa kigeni ana hisa 10% tu katika kampuni ya rejareja — je, GN 487A inahusika?
output: GN 487A inazuia raia wa kigeni kufanya biashara au kushiriki kwa kiasi kinachohusika katika orodha ya 15. Kuwa na hisa ndogo inaweza kuonekana kama 'kuwezesha' biashara iliyokatazwa. Sheria haisemi kiwango cha hisa kinachokubalika — inazungumzia ushiriki wa biashara kwa ujumla. Hata hisa ndogo 10% katika biashara ya rejareja inaweza kuwa tatizo kisheria. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji kuhusu hali yako maalum.

instruction: Kwa nini watu wanasema VAT 5% Tanzania — inakuja wapi nambari hii?
output: Nambari ya 5% inaweza kutoka: (1) Makosa ya mtandaoni au vyanzo visivyo sahihi. (2) Mfumo wa kodi wa nchi nyingine (VAT ya Kenya ilikuwa na 8% kwa vitu fulani). (3) SDL (Skills Development Levy) ya 3.5% inayoweza kuchanganywa na VAT. Ukweli: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania.

instruction: OSHA inashughulikia malalamiko ya wafanyakazi kuhusu usalama mahali pa kazi?
output: Ndiyo. Wafanyakazi wanaweza toa malalamiko ya usalama moja kwa moja kwa OSHA (osha.go.tz) — hata bila taarifa ya mwajiri kwanza. Malalamiko yanaweza kusababisha ukaguzi wa ghafla. Kama mwajiri, kushughulikia malalamiko ya usalama kwa uzito na haraka ni bora — kusubiri OSHA ikuje kunaweza kusababisha adhabu kubwa. Anzisha njia ya ndani ya malalamiko ya usalama ili kutatua matatizo mapema.

question_sw: Msimamizi wa mgahawa wa kijiji (kama mfanyakazi) — mwajiri wake analazimika kulipa nini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri wa msimamizi wa mgahawa analazimika: (1) PAYE — kukata na kuwasilisha TRA tarehe 7; (2) NSSF — 10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi; (3) WCF — 0.5% ya mshahara (bima ya ajali); (4) SDL — 3.5% kama mwajiri ana wafanyakazi 10+; (5) Kufuata GN 605A — kulipa mshahara wa chini unaofaa kwa sekta. Hizi zinatumika hata kwa mgahawa mdogo wa kijiji.
question_en: A village restaurant manager (as an employee) — what must their employer pay?
answer_en: The employer of a restaurant manager must: (1) PAYE — deduct and remit to TRA by the 7th; (2) NSSF — 10% employer + 10% employee; (3) WCF — 0.5% of salary (accident insurance); (4) SDL — 3.5% if employer has 10+ employees; (5) Follow GN 605A — pay minimum wage applicable to the sector. These apply even for a small village restaurant.

question_sw: Ni adhabu gani TATU za GN 487A kwa mgeni — zitaje kwa mpangilio?
answer_sw: Adhabu TATU za GN 487A kwa mgeni (raia wa kigeni) kwa mpangilio: (1) FAINI isiyopungua TZS 10,000,000 — kiwango cha chini, korti inaweza kutoza zaidi; (2) KIFUNGO kisichozidi miezi 6 — kiwango cha juu; (3) KUFUTWA kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi — lazima iende pamoja na adhabu nyingine. Jinsi adhabu zinavyounganika: faini AU kifungo (korti inachagua moja) NA visa kufutwa (lazima daima). Faini ina kiwango cha chini cha TZS 10M. Kifungo ni kiwango cha juu cha miezi 6 — korti inaweza au isitoe. Visa inafutwa kwa NA — inaambatana na adhabu yoyote korti itakayotoa na haiwezi kuepukwa.
question_en: What are the THREE GN 487A penalties for a non-citizen — list them in order?
answer_en: The THREE GN 487A penalties for a non-citizen (foreign national) in order: (1) FINE not less than TZS 10,000,000 — minimum floor, court may impose more; (2) IMPRISONMENT not exceeding 6 months — maximum ceiling; (3) REVOCATION of visa and residence permit — must accompany the other penalties. How the penalties connect: fine OR imprisonment (court chooses one) AND visa revocation (always mandatory). The fine has a mandatory minimum of TZS 10M. Imprisonment is a maximum of 6 months — the court may or may not impose it. Visa revocation is connected by AND — it accompanies whichever penalty the court imposes and is non-negotiable.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Biashara yangu iko mpakani mwa Tanzania na Kenya — GN 487A inatumika pia maeneo ya mpakani?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. GN 487A inatumika Tanzania Bara yote, ikiwa ni pamoja na maeneo ya mpakani kama Namanga, Holili, Tunduma, na Kabanga. Wafanyabiashara wa msalaba wa mpaka (cross-border traders) ambao si raia wa Tanzania bado wanazuiwa kufanya biashara katika makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa nchini Tanzania. Soko la STR (Simplified Trade Regime) la EAC halitoi ulinzi dhidi ya GN 487A. Mfanyabiashara mgeni anayeuza moja kwa moja katika soko la Tanzania (rejareja au jumla) anakiuka GN 487A hata kama anapita mpakani kila siku.
question_en: My business is at the Tanzania-Kenya border — does GN 487A also apply in border areas?
answer_en: Yes. GN 487A applies throughout Tanzania Mainland, including border areas such as Namanga, Holili, Tunduma, and Kabanga. Cross-border traders who are not Tanzanian citizens are still prohibited from operating businesses in the 15 restricted categories within Tanzania. The EAC Simplified Trade Regime (STR) does not provide protection against GN 487A. A non-citizen trader who sells directly in Tanzanian markets (retail or wholesale) violates GN 487A even if they cross the border daily.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Muda wa kuwasilisha hoja ya pingamizi ya kodi TRA ni siku 30. Je, muda huu unaweza kuongezwa?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla muda wa siku 30 ni mgumu kuongezwa. Sheria ya Mapato ya Kodi (Tax Revenue Appeals Act) inaweka muda huu kama masharti ya awali — kushindwa kuwasilisha ndani ya siku 30 kunaweza kusababisha hoja yako kutokubalika. Hata hivyo, kwa hali za kipekee za nguvu ya lazima (force majeure) au ushahidi wa thabiti kwamba haikuwezekana kuwasilisha kwa wakati, Kamishna anaweza kwa hiari kuruhusu upanuzi. Omba ndani ya siku 7 kabla ya kumalizika kwa siku 30. Kamishna anaweza kutoa nyongeza ya hadi siku 30 zaidi ikiwa sababu ni nzuri. Hii ni haki iliyoko kisheria — si bahati.
answer_en: Generally the 30-day period is very difficult to extend. The Tax Revenue Appeals Act treats this period as a condition precedent — failing to file within 30 days may result in your objection being rejected as inadmissible. However, in exceptional cases of genuine force majeure or strong evidence that filing was genuinely impossible, the Commissioner may at discretion allow an extension. Apply within 7 days before the 30-day limit expires. The Commissioner may grant up to 30 additional days if reasonable grounds exist. This is a statutory right — not a matter of luck.
question_en: The deadline for filing a TRA tax objection is 30 days. Can this period be extended?

question_sw: Agizo la mshahara wa 2022 bado lina nguvu kwa biashara ndogo ndogo (SME)?
answer_sw: Hapana. Agizo la 2022 lilifutwa kwa waajiri WOTE tarehe 1 Januari 2026 bila kujali ukubwa wa biashara. Hakuna kifungu cha msamaha kwa SME. Waajiri wote — wakubwa na wadogo — lazima wafuate GN 605A kuanzia Januari 2026.
question_en: The 2022 Wage Order is still valid for small businesses (SMEs)?
answer_en: No. The 2022 order was revoked for ALL employers on 1 January 2026 regardless of business size. There is no SME exemption clause. All employers — large and small — must comply with GN 605A from January 2026.

question_sw: Kama tawi moja linaharibika EFD, je matawi mengine yanaendelea kufanya biashara?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. EFD ya kila tawi inafanya kazi kwa kujitegemea — uharibika wa EFD ya tawi moja haukuathiri matawi mengine. Tawi lenye EFD iliyoharibika linapaswa: (1) Kutaarififu TRA ndani ya masaa 24; (2) Kutumia stakabadhi za mkono kwa muda; (3) Kurekebisha EFD haraka. Matawi mengine yanaendelea kwa kawaida.
question_en: If one branch's EFD breaks down, do other branches continue operating?
answer_en: Yes. Each branch's EFD operates independently — a breakdown at one branch does not affect other branches. The branch with the broken EFD must: (1) Notify TRA within 24 hours; (2) Use manual receipts temporarily; (3) Repair the EFD quickly. Other branches continue operating normally.

question_sw: Jinsi ya kupata cheti cha kodi ya zuio (withholding tax certificate) Tanzania?
answer_sw: Cheti cha kodi ya zuio kinapatikana kupitia mfumo wa malipo ya kodi (Tax Payment) kwenye Lango la Walipa Kodi (Taxpayer Portal) wa TRA. Kinachapishwa na wakala wa zuio au mtu aliyekatwa kodi (withholdee) baada ya malipo kukamilika. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How do you obtain a withholding tax certificate in Tanzania?
answer_en: A withholding tax certificate is obtained through the Tax Payment section of TRA's Taxpayer Portal. It can be printed by either the withholding agent or the withholdee after payment is completed. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, BRELA inaweza kufuta kampuni bila idhini ya wamiliki wake Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. BRELA inaweza kufuta kampuni kwenye rejista yake (administrative strike-off) ikiwa: (1) kampuni imeshindwa kuwasilisha annual return kwa miaka miwili au zaidi, (2) kuna ushahidi kwamba kampuni haifanyi tena shughuli. BRELA kawaida inatoa notisi kabla ya kufuta. Wamiliki wanaweza kupinga au kurudisha kampuni ikiwa kufutwa kulifanywa kwa kosa. Kampuni iliyofutwa na BRELA haina nguvu ya kisheria.
question_en: Can BRELA deregister a company without the owners' consent in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. BRELA can administratively strike off a company from its register if: (1) the company has failed to file annual returns for two or more years, (2) there is evidence the company is no longer operating. BRELA usually gives notice before striking off. Owners can object or restore the company if the strike-off was done in error. A company struck off by BRELA has no legal force.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: Companies Act or BRELA administrative policy update

question_sw: Mgeni anayeishi Tanzania kwa miaka 20 ana haki maalum chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A inategemea URAIA, si muda wa makazi. Mtu anayeishi Tanzania kwa miaka 20 bila kupata uraia wa Tanzania bado anachukuliwa kuwa raia wa kigeni chini ya amri hii. Muda wa makazi haumpi msamaha wowote.
question_en: Does a non-citizen living in Tanzania for 20 years have special rights under GN 487A?
answer_en: No. GN 487A is based on CITIZENSHIP, not length of residence. A person who has lived in Tanzania for 20 years without obtaining Tanzanian citizenship is still considered a non-citizen under this order. Length of residence provides no exemption.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Mwajiri anapata adhabu ya asilimia 10 mara moja kwa kuchelewa kulipa PAYE — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Adhabu ya PAYE ni asilimia 2.5 kwa kila MWEZI wa ucheleweshaji — si asilimia 10 mara moja. Kwa hivyo baada ya miezi 4, jumla ya adhabu inakuwa asilimia 10, lakini inakua kwa mwezi. Kiwango cha asilimia 10 mara moja si sahihi chini ya sheria ya Tanzania.
question_en: An employer receives a one-time 10% penalty for late PAYE payment — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The PAYE penalty is 2.5% for each MONTH of delay — not a one-time 10%. After 4 months of delay the cumulative penalty reaches 10%, but it accrues monthly. A one-time flat 10% rate is incorrect under Tanzania law.

question_sw: Wafanyakazi wa nyumbani (domestic workers) hawamo kwenye GN 605A — ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana, si kweli. Wafanyakazi wa nyumbani wamejumuishwa katika GN 605A na wana kiwango chao cha mshahara wa chini. Hakuna msamaha kwa wafanyakazi wa nyumbani — waajiri wa nyumbani lazima pia wafuate agizo hili.
question_en: Domestic workers are not covered by GN 605A — is this correct?
answer_en: No, this is incorrect. Domestic workers are included in GN 605A and have their own minimum wage rate. There is no exemption for domestic workers — household employers must also comply with this order.

question_sw: Posho ya usafiri ya TZS 50,000 kwa mwezi inayolipwa kwa mfanyakazi — inatozwa PAYE au la?
answer_sw: Inategemea jinsi inavyolipwa. Ikiwa ni posho ya jumla (flat allowance) bila kuhitajika risiti — inatozwa PAYE. Ikiwa ni malipo ya gharama halisi za usafiri wa biashara yanayolipwa dhidi ya risiti — hayatozwi PAYE. Posho nyingi za usafiri zinazolipwa kwa wafanyakazi wa Tanzania zinachukuliwa kama sehemu ya mapato ya ajira na zinatozwa PAYE. Hakikisha una sera ya gharama wazi inayoelezea msingi wa malipo.
answer_en: It depends on how it is paid. If it is a flat allowance without requiring receipts — it is subject to PAYE. If it is reimbursement of actual business travel costs against receipts — it is not subject to PAYE. Most transport allowances paid to employees in Tanzania are treated as part of employment income and are subject to PAYE. Ensure you have a clear expenses policy explaining the basis of payment.
question_en: A transport allowance of TZS 50,000 per month paid to an employee — is it subject to PAYE or not?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or TRA circular on allowances

instruction: NSSF imesajili wafanyakazi wote lakini mwezi huu kampuni haina fedha za kulipa — inafanyaje?
output: Hali hii inahitaji hatua haraka: (1) Wasiliana na NSSF MAPEMA — kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho — eleza hali na omba muda wa ziada au mpango wa malipo (payment plan); (2) NSSF ina uwezo wa kupanga ratiba ya malipo kwa hali za dharura — lakini omba kabla ya kukosekana, si baada; (3) Faini ya 5%/mwezi itaanza kuhesabiwa siku ya kuchelewa — ukiwasiliana mapema, NSSF inaweza kupunguza faini; (4) Toa kipaumbele kwa malipo ya NSSF — ni haki za wafanyakazi, si kodi ya kawaida. Kumbuka: mwajiri anakusanya sehemu ya mfanyakazi (10%) tayari — pesa hizo si za mwajiri. Thibitisha na nssf.or.tz.

question_sw: Mshahara wa chini unatumika kwa wafanyakazi wa muda (part-time) pia?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. GN 605A inatumika kwa wafanyakazi wa muda. Kiwango kinahesabiwa kwa uwiano wa masaa ya kufanya kazi — kama mfanyakazi anafanya nusu ya masaa ya kawaida, analipwa angalau nusu ya mshahara wa chini wa mwezi.
question_en: Does the minimum wage apply to part-time workers too?
answer_en: Yes. GN 605A applies to part-time workers. The rate is calculated proportionally — if a worker works half the standard hours, they must receive at least half the monthly minimum wage.

question_sw: Bonasi ya mwisho wa mwaka — inajumuishwa kwenye msingi wa SDL?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa ujumla bonasi na malipo ya kipekee yanajumuishwa kwenye msingi wa SDL kwa mwezi yanalipwa. Ikiwa bonasi inalipwa Desemba, SDL inahesabiwa kwa jumla ya mishahara ya Desemba ikiwa ni pamoja na bonasi. Thibitisha muundo maalum na TRA au mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: Year-end bonus — is it included in the SDL base?
answer_en: Yes, generally bonuses and one-time payments are included in the SDL base for the month they are paid. If a bonus is paid in December, SDL is calculated on the total December payroll including the bonus. Confirm specific structures with TRA or a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: GN 487A inasema mgeni atafungwa miezi 6 — hii ni lazima au korti inaweza kutoa chini ya miezi 6?
answer_sw: Kifungo cha miezi 6 ni KIWANGO CHA JUU — si lazima. GN 487A inasema 'kisichozidi miezi 6' maana yake korti inaweza kutoa siku 1, mwezi 1, miezi 3, au hadi miezi 6 kulingana na hali. Kwa faini, GN 487A inasema 'isiyopungua TZS 10M' — hapa korti haiwezi kutoa chini ya 10M. Kwa hivyo faini ina kiwango cha chini (lazima angalau 10M) lakini kifungo hakina kiwango cha chini kilichowekwa.
question_en: GN 487A says a non-citizen will be imprisoned for 6 months — is this mandatory or can the court give less than 6 months?
answer_en: The 6-month imprisonment is a MAXIMUM — not mandatory. GN 487A says 'not exceeding 6 months' meaning a court may give 1 day, 1 month, 3 months, or up to 6 months depending on circumstances. For the fine, GN 487A says 'not less than TZS 10M' — here the court cannot give less than 10M. So the fine has a mandatory minimum (at least 10M) but imprisonment has no stated minimum.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Kampuni inampa mfanyakazi gari la kampuni kutumia nyumbani na kazini. Je, thamani ya gari hilo inatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Matumizi ya kibinafsi ya gari la kampuni yanachukuliwa kama faida ya ajira (benefit in kind) na yanajumuishwa kwenye mapato yanayotozwa PAYE. TRA inakadiri thamani ya matumizi ya kibinafsi kulingana na kanuni. Mwajiri lazima aongeze thamani hiyo kwenye mshahara wa mwezi wakati anahesabu PAYE. Hoja kwamba gari ni la kazi peke yake haipokewi bila ushahidi wa kutosha.
answer_en: Yes. Personal use of a company car is treated as a benefit in kind and is included in taxable employment income subject to PAYE. TRA estimates the value of private use according to prescribed rules. The employer must add this deemed value to the employee's monthly salary when calculating PAYE. A claim that the car is used purely for business purposes requires sufficient evidence.
question_en: A company provides an employee with a company car for both home and work use. Is the value of the car use subject to PAYE?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — Income Tax Act Cap.332 s.7

question_sw: Kiwango cha pili cha PAYE ni asilimia 9 kwa mapato kati ya Shilingi 270,001 na 520,000 kwa mwezi — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango cha pili cha PAYE ni asilimia 8 — si asilimia 9. Kanda za PAYE kwa mwezi ni: asilimia sifuri (hadi Shilingi 270,000), asilimia 8 (Shilingi 270,001 hadi 520,000), asilimia 20 (Shilingi 520,001 hadi 760,000), asilimia 25 (Shilingi 760,001 hadi 1,000,000), na asilimia 30 (zaidi ya Shilingi 1,000,000).
question_en: The second PAYE band is 9% on income between TZS 270,001 and 520,000 per month — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The second PAYE band is 8% — not 9%. The monthly PAYE bands are: 0% (up to TZS 270,000), 8% (TZS 270,001–520,000), 20% (TZS 520,001–760,000), 25% (TZS 760,001–1,000,000), and 30% (above TZS 1,000,000).
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to PAYE bands

question_sw: Withholding tax kwa programu (software licences) za nje — kiwango gani?
answer_sw: Withholding tax kwenye huduma (services) kutoka nje ya nchi, ikiwa ni pamoja na leseni za programu (software licences), ni 6% kuanzia 1 Julai 2025 (Sheria ya Fedha 2025). Kampuni ya Tanzania inayolipa kwa leseni ya programu ya nje ya nchi lazima ishikilie 6% na ilipe TRA. Kiwango cha 3% kinatumiwa kwa bidhaa, si huduma.
question_en: Withholding tax on foreign software licences — what rate?
answer_en: Withholding tax on services from foreign countries, including software licences, is 6% from 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025). A Tanzanian company paying for a foreign software licence must withhold 6% and remit it to TRA. The 3% rate applies to goods, not services.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

instruction: Mgeni aliyekuwa na biashara halali kabla ya GN 487A — aliweza kuendelea hadi lini?
output: GN 487A ilianza kutumika tarehe 28 Julai 2025 — siku ile ile ilipotangazwa. GN 487A ina masharti ya mpito: wageni waliokuwa na leseni halali tarehe 28 Julai 2025 katika shughuli zilizokatazwa waliruhusiwa kuendelea mpaka leseni zao ziishe. Baada ya leseni kuisha, upya (renewal) haukuruhusiwa na leseni mpya haikuweza kutolewa. Kampeni ya utekelezaji ilianza 11 Septemba 2025 na ilimalizika 8 Oktoba 2025, lakini sheria yenyewe ilianza tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Kwa hiyo biashara iliyoendelea BAADA ya 28 Julai 2025 inakiuka sheria, hata kama ilianzishwa kabla. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Personal relief ya PAYE inapatikana kwa wafanyakazi wageni?
answer_sw: Personal relief ya TZS 270,000/mwezi (TZS 3,240,000/mwaka) kwa kawaida inapatikana kwa wafanyakazi wanaofanya kazi Tanzania — raia na wageni wenye hali ya makazi ya kawaida. Hata hivyo, hali ya personal relief kwa wasio na makazi (non-residents) inaweza kutofautiana. Thibitisha na TRA kwa hali maalum ya mfanyakazi wako.
question_en: Is the PAYE personal relief available to foreign employees?
answer_en: Personal relief of TZS 270,000/month (TZS 3,240,000/year) is generally available to employees working in Tanzania — citizens and foreigners with regular residence status. However, personal relief treatment for non-residents may differ. Verify with TRA for your employee's specific situation.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Mgeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania anahitaji kibali gani?
answer_sw: Mgeni anayeajiriwa na kampuni Tanzania anahitaji Kibali cha Makazi daraja C (Residence Permit Class C) — kibali cha kufanya kazi. Kibali hutolewa na Idara ya Uhamiaji. Mgeni lazima awe na mwajiri rasmi kabla ya kuomba kibali. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What permit does a foreign national employed in Tanzania need?
answer_en: A foreign national employed by a company in Tanzania needs a Class C Residence Permit — a work permit. It is issued by the Immigration Department. The foreigner must have a formal employer before applying. Confirm with the Immigration Department.
next_review_trigger: GN 487A enforcement update or immigration regulation change

question_sw: PAYE inafanya kazi vipi — inatumika kwenye mshahara wote au kwa bendi?
answer_sw: PAYE inafanya kazi KWA BENDI (progressive taxation) — si kwenye mshahara wote kwa kiwango kimoja. Mfano wa mshahara wa TZS 600,000: Bendi 1 (0-270,000): TZS 0 kodi; Bendi 2 (270,001-520,000): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000; Bendi 3 (520,001-600,000): TZS 80,000 × 20% = TZS 16,000; Jumla ya PAYE: TZS 36,000. Kumbuka: PAYE Tanzania haina punguzo la kibinafsi tofauti la kila mwezi linalotakiwa kukatwa — kiwango cha sifuri hadi TZS 270,000 ndiyo ruhusa pekee iliyojengwa ndani ya mfumo. Kwa mahesabu ya mshahara mahususi tumia TRA IDRAS (taidras.tra.go.tz). Tafadhali tumia TRA IDRAS kwa mahesabu sahihi ya mshahara wako.
question_en: How does PAYE work — does it apply to the full salary or by band?
answer_en: PAYE works BY BAND (progressive taxation) — not on the full salary at one rate. Example for TZS 600,000 salary: Band 1 (0-270,000): TZS 0 tax; Band 2 (270,001-520,000): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000; Band 3 (520,001-600,000): TZS 80,000 × 20% = TZS 16,000; Total PAYE: TZS 36,000. Note: Tanzania's PAYE has no separate monthly personal relief deduction — the zero-rate up to TZS 270,000 is the only built-in allowance. For specific salary calculations use TRA IDRAS (taidras.tra.go.tz). Please use TRA IDRAS for accurate calculations for your specific salary.

question_sw: Wakati kampuni inabadilisha mwaka wake wa fedha (financial year), inahitaji ruhusa ya TRA — au inaweza kubadilisha yenyewe?
answer_sw: Kampuni inayotaka kubadilisha mwaka wake wa fedha Tanzania inahitaji idhini ya TRA. Kubadilisha bila ruhusa kunaweza kusababisha mgongano wa vipindi vya kuwasilisha na shida za makokotoo ya kodi ya awali. Omba TRA mapema na ubainishe kipindi cha mpito.
question_en: When a company changes its financial year it needs TRA permission — or can it change on its own?
answer_en: A company wishing to change its financial year in Tanzania needs TRA approval. Changing without permission can cause overlapping filing periods and provisional tax calculation problems. Apply to TRA in advance and specify the transition period.

question_sw: Hati gani zinahitajika kudai refund ya VAT?
answer_sw: Hati za kawaida zinazohitajika kudai VAT refund ni pamoja na: (1) Nakala za VAT invoices za ununuzi (zilizotolewa na wasambazaji waliosajilistwaa VAT); (2) Risiti za EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) zinazohusiana; (3) Hati za mauzo (invoices za output VAT); (4) Kwa exporters: hati za usafirishaji nje (export documents) kama custom entries, bills of lading; (5) Rejista ya VAT iliyosasishwa. Hati zote lazima ziwe halali na kuthibitishwa.
question_en: What documents are needed to claim a VAT refund?
answer_en: Documents typically required for a VAT refund claim include: (1) Copies of purchase VAT invoices (issued by VAT-registered suppliers); (2) Related EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) receipts; (3) Sales documents (output VAT invoices); (4) For exporters: export documents such as customs entries, bills of lading; (5) Updated VAT register. All documents must be genuine and verifiable.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

instruction: Leseni yangu ya biashara inaisha mwezi ujao — naweza kuomba upya kama mgeni?
output: GN 487A ya 28 Julai 2025 ina kipengele cha mpito (transitional provision): mgeni aliyekuwa na leseni halisi kabla ya tarehe ya kufanya kazi ya GN 487A anaweza kuendelea na shughuli hiyo hadi leseni yake inaisha — lakini hawezi kuomba upya (renewal) wa leseni hiyo. Kama shughuli yako ipo kwenye orodha ya marufuku ya GN 487A: HUWEZI kuomba upya (renewal) — GN 487A inazuia renewal kwa shughuli zilizokatazwa. Hatua ya haraka: wasiliana na wakili wa uhamiaji KABLA leseni haijafika mwisho kujua chaguzi lako (mabadiliko ya biashara, ubia na raia wa Tanzania, au kufunga biashara).

question_sw: Je, biashara ndogo yenye mauzo ya TZS 50 milioni kwa mwaka inalazimika kulipa VAT?
answer_sw: Hapana — mauzo ya TZS 50,000,000 kwa mwaka yako chini ya kizingiti cha lazima cha usajili wa VAT (TZS 200M kwa miezi 12 au TZS 100M kwa miezi 6). Biashara yako haihitajiwi kujisajili kwa VAT kwa lazima. Unaweza kuchagua kujisajili kwa hiari ikiwa unataka kudai input VAT. Kiwango cha VAT — ukisajiliwa — ni asilimia 18.
question_en: Must a small business with TZS 50 million annual sales pay VAT?
answer_en: No — sales of TZS 50,000,000 per year are below the mandatory VAT registration threshold (TZS 200M in 12 months or TZS 100M in 6 months). Your business is not required to register for VAT. You may choose voluntary registration if you want to claim input VAT. The VAT rate — if registered — is 18%.

instruction: Ni nani anachangia zaidi kwenye NSSF — mwajiri au mfanyakazi?
output: Kwa mgawanyo wa kawaida, wote wawili wanachangia kwa kiasi sawa — mwajiri anachangia asilimia 10 na mfanyakazi anachangia asilimia 10, jumla asilimia 20. Hata hivyo, mwajiri anaweza kuchagua kuchangia zaidi: mgawanyo wa 15+5 (mwajiri zaidi) au 20+0 (mwajiri analipa yote). Mfanyakazi hawezi kuchangia zaidi ya asilimia 10 — kikomo chake ni asilimia 10 tu. Kiasi kinachopelekwa NSSF daima ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara wa jumla.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Mwajiri mpya anahitaji kusajili wafanyakazi wake wa zamani (waliokuwepo kabla ya kuanzishwa kwake) NSSF?
answer_sw: Wakati biashara mpya inachukua (acquires) biashara nyingine na wafanyakazi wake, wajibu wa NSSF unategemea muundo wa muamala. Ikiwa ni ununuzi wa biashara (asset purchase) na wafanyakazi wanaajiriwa upya, mwajiri mpya anasajili wafanyakazi wake upya na NSSF. Ikiwa ni ununuzi wa hisa (share purchase), kampuni inabaki sawa na NSSF na wafanyakazi wake — mwajiri mpya (wanaohisa) wanachukua majukumu ya NSSF ya kampuni.
question_en: Does a new employer need to register employees who were there before their acquisition with NSSF?
answer_en: When a new business acquires another business and its employees, the NSSF obligation depends on the transaction structure. If it is an asset purchase with employees re-hired, the new employer re-registers the employees with NSSF. If it is a share purchase, the company remains the same with NSSF and its employees — the new employer (shareholders) takes over the company's NSSF obligations.
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act or employment transfer law update

instruction: Mkurugenzi Mkuu anapata TZS 2,000,000 kwa mwezi — PAYE kamili ni ngapi?
output:
Hesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 2,000,000/mwezi:
Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 = TZS 0
Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000
Bendi 3 (20%): TZS 240,000 × 20% = TZS 48,000
Bendi 4 (25%): TZS 240,000 × 25% = TZS 60,000
Bendi 5 (30%): TZS 1,000,000 × 30% = TZS 300,000
PAYE ya jumla: TZS 428,000/mwezi
TZS 1,000,000 ya ziada juu ya TZS 1,000,000 iko Bendi 5 (30%) = TZS 300,000.

question_sw: Mtu anayeweka taarifa ya kodi ya uongo anaweza kuadhibiwa vipi?
answer_sw: Kutoa taarifa ya kodi ya uongo au kupotosha TRA ni kosa la jinai chini ya Sheria ya Usimamizi wa Kodi. Adhabu zinaweza kujumuisha: faini kubwa, malipo ya kodi iliyokosekana na riba, na kifungo cha jela. Mlipaji kodi anayegundua makosa na kujirekebisha kwa hiari ana uwezekano wa kupata adhabu ndogo.
question_en: What penalties can a person who files a false tax return face?
answer_en: Filing a false tax return or misleading TRA is a criminal offence under the Tax Administration Act. Penalties can include: large fines, payment of unpaid tax with interest, and imprisonment. A taxpayer who discovers errors and self-corrects voluntarily has a possibility of reduced penalties.

instruction: GN 487A ilitekelezwa na kupitishwa na nani — ni amri ya Rais au ya Waziri?
output: GN 487A ni Government Notice (Tangazo la Serikali) lililotolewa chini ya Sheria ya Leseni za Biashara (Business Licensing Act) — inaweza kutolewa na Waziri mwenye dhamana bila kuhitaji kupita Bungeni. Ni amri ya kiutawala (ministerial order) yenye nguvu ya kisheria sawa na sheria. Hii ni tofauti na Sheria ya Bunge ambayo inahitaji kupita hatua za Bunge. Kwa hivyo GN 487A inaweza kubadilishwa au kufutwa na tangazo jipya la serikali bila kupita Bungeni — lakini bado ina nguvu kamili ya kisheria kwa sasa hivi. Thibitisha na tangazo rasmi la Serikali na TanzLII.

instruction: Kama sina wafanyakazi — nafanya kazi peke yangu — OSHA bado inanishughulikia?
output: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inatumika kwa MAENEO YOTE ya kazi Tanzania — bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Kwa mfanyabiashara peke yake (sole trader bila wafanyakazi): Kanuni za OSHA zinaweza kutumika kwa eneo lako la kazi hata kama wewe ni mfanyakazi peke yako. Lengo la OSHA ni usalama wa ENEO LA KAZI — si tu usalama wa wafanyakazi. Thibitisha mahitaji yako maalum na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anabadilisha kazi kutoka kampuni A hadi kampuni B. Michango yake ya NSSF inahamia vipi?
answer_sw: Michango ya NSSF haihitajiki 'kuhamia' — inabaki kwenye akaunti ya NSSF ya mwanachama na inaendelea kujengwa bila kujali mabadiliko ya mwajiri. Nambari ya NSSF ya mwanachama inabaki ile ile, na mwajiri mpya anaendelea kuchangia kwenye nambari hiyo ile. Mfanyakazi anapaswa kumwarifu mwajiri mpya nambari yake ya NSSF mara anapokuwa ameajiriwa. Kama mwajiri mpya hajui nambari yako ya NSSF, unaweza kuomba nambari kutoka ofisi yoyote ya NSSF au kwa kutumia portal ya mtandaoni.
answer_en: NSSF contributions do not need to 'transfer' — they remain in the member's NSSF account and continue to accumulate regardless of employer changes. The member's NSSF number stays the same, and the new employer continues contributing to that same number. The employee should inform the new employer of their NSSF number when they start work. If the new employer does not know your NSSF number, you can request it from any NSSF office or through the online portal.
question_en: An employee changes jobs from Company A to Company B. How do their NSSF contributions transfer?

question_sw: Biashara ya kuhamisha pesa (money transfer) inahitaji leseni gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Biashara ya kuhamisha pesa inahitaji leseni ya maalum kutoka Benki Kuu ya Tanzania (BoT) chini ya Sheria ya Huduma za Malipo ya Mwaka 2015. Hii ni pamoja na: wakala wa kampuni kubwa ya pesa kama M-Pesa au Airtel Money (wanayohitaji idhini ya kampuni mama), au mwenye leseni wa kujitegemea wa huduma za malipo. Leseni za BoT ni za aina nyingi — thibitisha aina ya huduma unayotaka kutoa. GN 487A (Julai 2025) pia inapiga marufuku raia wasio Watanzania kufanya biashara ya kuhamisha pesa.
answer_en: A money transfer business requires a special licence from the Bank of Tanzania (BoT) under the Payment Services Act 2015. This includes: being an agent of a large money company like M-Pesa or Airtel Money (requiring parent company authorisation), or being an independent licensed payment service provider. BoT licences come in multiple categories — confirm the type of service you wish to provide. GN 487A (July 2025) also prohibits non-Tanzanian citizens from conducting money transfer business.
question_en: What licence does a money transfer business need in Tanzania?
next_review_trigger: BoT Payment Services Act amendment or GN 487A revision

instruction: Kampuni yangu imepata hasara kwa miaka 5 mfululizo — je, ninaweza kubeba hasara hizi mbele?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Sheria za kubeba hasara za kodi (tax loss carry-forward) Tanzania — pamoja na mabadiliko ya Finance Act 2024 kuhusu kampuni zenye hasara za mfululizo — ni mada ya Income Tax Act inayohitaji uchambuzi wa kina wa hali ya kodi ya biashara. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi wa biashara aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Vibali 15 vya shughuli vilivyopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A ni vipi?
answer_sw: GN 487A (iliyoanza Julai 2025) inapiga marufuku wageni kufanya: biashara ya jumla/reja reja, uhamishaji wa pesa za simu, ukarabati wa simu, saluni na ususi, na shughuli 11 nyingine zilizoorodheshwa kwenye amri. Biashara ya usambazaji mdogo inajumuishwa. Thibitisha orodha kamili na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What are the 15 business activities prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A?
answer_en: GN 487A (effective July 2025) prohibits non-citizens from conducting: wholesale/retail trade, mobile money transfers, phone repair, salon and hairdressing business, and 11 other activities listed in the order. Small distribution business is included. Confirm the full list with the Immigration Department.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: Kampuni yangu inafunza wanafunzi (apprentices) chini ya mpango wa serikali. Je, hii inaathiri wajibu wa SDL?
answer_sw: Hali ya wanafunzi wa mafunzo na SDL inategemea muundo wa mpango: ikiwa mwanafunzi analipwa posho ya mafunzo (training allowance) tu — si mshahara kamili wa ajira — posho hiyo inaweza kutolewa kwenye msingi wa SDL. Ikiwa mwanafunzi anachukuliwa kama mfanyakazi kamili na analipwa mshahara, SDL inatumika. Mipango ya mafunzo iliyoidhinishwa na serikali inaweza kuwa na masharti tofauti — thibitisha na VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) na TRA kabla ya kuamua jinsi ya kuhesabu.
answer_en: The SDL treatment of apprentices depends on the programme structure: if the apprentice receives only a training allowance — not a full employment salary — that allowance may be excluded from the SDL base. If the apprentice is treated as a full employee and paid a salary, SDL applies. Government-approved training programmes may have different conditions — confirm with VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) and TRA before deciding how to calculate.
question_en: My company trains apprentices under a government scheme. Does this affect the SDL obligation?
next_review_trigger: VETA Act amendment or TRA circular on apprenticeship SDL

instruction: Annual return ya BRELA ni nini na hulipwa lini?
output: Annual return ni taarifa ya mwaka inayowasilishwa BRELA na kila kampuni iliyosajiliwa. Ina taarifa kuhusu wakurugenzi, wanahisa, na anwani ya ofisi. Annual return hulipwa na kuwasilishwa katika mwezi ule ule mwaka wowote ambao kampuni ilisajiliwa — si Desemba pekee. Kwa ada ya sasa ya annual return na taratibu, angalia brela.go.tz au mfumo wa ORS — usitegemee ada zilizopita kwani zinaweza kubadilika.

question_sw: Kampuni inayotoa sadaka (donation) kwa taasisi za hisani inalipwa kodi kidogo kwa sababu sadaka ni gharama inayopunguzwa — je, TRA inakubali sadaka zote?
answer_sw: TRA inakubali sadaka kama gharama inayopunguzwa LAKINI kwa masharti: (1) taasisi inayopokea lazima iwe na usajili wa hisani unaotambuliwa na TRA, (2) sadaka lazima idhibitiwe kwa nyaraka (risiti ya sadaka), na (3) kikomo fulani cha sadaka kinaweza kutumika. Sadaka kwa watu binafsi au taasisi zisizotambuliwa hazipunguzwi. Hakikisha usajili wa taasisi kabla ya kudai.
question_en: A company making a donation to a charity pays less tax because donations are deductible — does TRA accept all donations?
answer_en: TRA accepts donations as deductible expenses BUT with conditions: (1) the receiving institution must be TRA-recognised registered charity, (2) donations must be documented (donation receipt), and (3) a cap on deductible donations may apply. Donations to individuals or unrecognised institutions are not deductible. Verify the institution's registration before claiming.

question_sw: Watu binafsi wanaopata kipato cha chini ya TZS 270,000 kwa mwezi hawalipi kodi yoyote ya mapato — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mtu binafsi anayepata kipato kisichozidi TZS 270,000 kwa mwezi (band ya kwanza ya PAYE) analipa kodi ya PAYE ya asilimia 0 kwenye kipato hicho. Kizingiti hiki kinamaanisha wafanyakazi wa mshahara mdogo hawalazimiki kulipa PAYE. Hata hivyo, bado inashauriwa kusajiliwa na TIN na mwajiri bado analazimika kuwasilisha malipo ya PAYE (hata kama ni sifuri) kwenye TRA.
question_en: Individuals earning below TZS 270,000 per month pay no income tax at all — is this correct?
answer_en: Yes. An individual earning up to TZS 270,000 per month (first PAYE band) pays 0% PAYE on that income. This threshold means low-wage workers are not required to pay PAYE. However, it is still advisable to have a TIN and the employer is still required to submit PAYE returns (even if zero) to TRA.

question_sw: Aina gani za biashara ninaweza kusajilisha na BRELA?
answer_sw: BRELA inasajilisha aina kuu tatu za miundo ya biashara: 1) Jina la Biashara (Business Name) — kwa wafanyabiashara peke yao (sole traders); ni rahisi na bei nafuu zaidi kusajilisha. 2) Ushirikiano (Partnership) — kwa watu wawili au zaidi wanaomiliki biashara pamoja bila kuunda kampuni rasmi. 3) Kampuni yenye ukomo (Limited Liability Company) — ina hali ya kisheria yake tofauti na wamiliki wake; inakinga wamiliki dhidi ya madeni ya kibinafsi zaidi. Pia kuna kampuni za umma (public companies) kwa biashara kubwa. Thibitisha na BRELA aina inayofaa biashara yako.
question_en: What types of business can I register with BRELA?
answer_en: BRELA registers three main business structures: 1) Business Name — for sole traders; simplest and least expensive to register. 2) Partnership — for two or more people co-owning a business without forming a formal company. 3) Limited Liability Company — has its own legal identity separate from its owners; provides greater protection of owners' personal assets from business debts. Public companies are also available for larger businesses. Confirm with BRELA which structure suits your business.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya jumla — ninahesabu vipi kama nifike kizingiti cha VAT kwa miezi 6?
output: Hesabu mauzo yako ya jumla (kabla ya kodi) kwa miezi 6 mfululizo yoyote — si lazima kuanza Januari. Kama jumla ya miezi 6 mfululizo inazidi TZS 100,000,000, umefika kizingiti na lazima usajiliwe VAT. Ongezeko la mauzo kwenye mfululizo wa miezi — linachozunguka kila mwezi — ndilo kinachoangaliwa. Wasiliana na wahasibu au mshauri wa kodi kukusaidia kuhesabu kwa usahihi.

question_sw: STR ililenga kuwasaidia wafanyabiashara gani?
answer_sw: STR ililenga kuwasaidia wafanyabiashara wadogo wa mpakani — hasa wanawake wanaouza mazao, vyakula, na bidhaa ndogo ndogo kati ya nchi za EAC na COMESA. Biashara kubwa na makampuni makubwa yanayoagiza bidhaa kwa wingi bado yanatumia utaratibu wa kawaida wa forodha.
question_en: Who does STR aim to help?
answer_en: STR was designed to help small border traders — especially women selling produce, food, and small goods between EAC and COMESA countries. Large businesses and companies importing goods in large quantities still use the standard customs process.
