instruction: Ninauza biashara yangu nzima ikiwemo mali zote, dhamana, na jina la biashara — capital gains tax yake ni ngapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Uamuzi wa capital gains tax kwa mauzo ya biashara nzima ni mgumu na unajumuisha tathmini ya kila kipande cha mali chini ya Income Tax Act — inahitaji utaalamu maalum wa kodi ya mapato. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: EAC STR na COMESA STR — ni tofauti au mfumo mmoja?
answer_sw: EAC STR na COMESA STR ni mifumo inayofanana na inayounganishwa — si tofauti kabisa. Nchi nyingi za EAC pia ni wanachama wa COMESA, na wanaheshimu mifumo yote miwili. Masharti ya msingi (USD 2,000, Common List) yanafanana sana. Mabadiliko madogo yanaweza kuwepo kwa nchi maalum — thibitisha na ofisi ya forodha.
question_en: EAC STR and COMESA STR — are they different or the same framework?
answer_en: EAC STR and COMESA STR are similar and interconnected frameworks — not completely separate. Many EAC countries are also COMESA members, and they honor both frameworks. The core conditions (USD 2,000, Common List) are very similar. Minor variations may exist for specific countries — verify with the customs office.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: WHT kwa ada za usimamizi na huduma za kitaalamu (management/professional fees) kwa wakazi ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha WHT kwa ada za usimamizi na huduma za kitaalamu kwa wakazi ni asilimia 5. Kwa wasio wakazi, kiwango ni asilimia 15. Tofauti hii kati ya wakazi na wasio wakazi ni muhimu kwa makampuni yanayolipa ada kwa wataalam wa kigeni.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on management and professional service fees for residents?
answer_en: The WHT rate on management and professional service fees for residents is 5%. For non-residents the rate is 15%. This difference between residents and non-residents is important for companies paying fees to foreign experts.

question_sw: GN 605A inahusu wafanyakazi wa sekta ya kilimo?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Sekta ya kilimo imejumuishwa katika GN 605A. Kiwango halisi cha mshahara wa chini kwa kilimo kinatofautiana na sekta nyingine — thibitisha kiwango cha sasa kwa sekta ya kilimo na MLYWF.
question_en: Does GN 605A apply to workers in the agricultural sector?
answer_en: Yes. The agricultural sector is included in GN 605A. The exact minimum wage for agriculture differs from other sectors — confirm the current agricultural sector rate with MLYWF.

question_sw: Kampuni zangu inaona invoice kutoka kwa msambazaji inayosema '10% VAT included'. Je, hii ni halali Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango cha VAT cha asilimia 10 hakipo Tanzania Bara. Invoice hiyo ni makosa au ni ya nje ya Tanzania. Kiwango cha halisi cha VAT Tanzania ni asilimia 18. Ikiwa msambazaji ni Tanzania na ana usajili wa VAT, anapaswa kutozea asilimia 18. Ripoti invoice hii ya makosa kwa TRA au mwambie msambazaji asahihishe.
question_en: My company receives invoices from a supplier showing '10% VAT included'. Is this legal in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. A 10% VAT rate does not exist on Mainland Tanzania. That invoice is either an error or relates to a non-Tanzanian transaction. The correct VAT rate in Tanzania is 18%. If the supplier is Tanzanian and VAT-registered, they should be charging 18%. Report this erroneous invoice to TRA or ask the supplier to correct it.

question_sw: Mshahara mdogo zaidi kwa mfanyakazi wa kawaida ni shilingi ngapi sasa hivi?
answer_sw: Kwa mfanyakazi wa kawaida, mshahara wa chini ni karibu Shilingi 175,000 kwa mwezi kuanzia Januari 2026. Huyu ni mfanyakazi wa chini kabisa katika ngazi ya sekta — sekta za madini ya kimataifa zinaweza kufikia Shilingi 765,900. Angalia jedwali la GN 605A kwa sekta yako.
question_en: What is the minimum wage for a general worker now?
answer_en: For a general worker the minimum wage floor is approximately TZS 175,000 per month from January 2026. This is the lowest tier — international mining/energy can reach TZS 765,900. Check the GN 605A schedule for your specific sector.

question_sw: Ukaguzi wa TRA (tax audit) unafanywa mara ngapi kwa biashara ndogo Tanzania?
answer_sw: TRA inafanya ukaguzi wa kodi kulingana na tathmini ya hatari (risk-based auditing). Biashara ndogo iliyofuata vizuri sheria za kodi inaweza isikaguliwe kwa miaka mingi. Ukaguzi unaweza kusababishwa na: tofauti kubwa kati ya mapato yaliyoripotiwa na mauzo ya benki, malalamiko ya watu wengine, sekta zenye hatari ya juu, au uteuzi wa nasibu. Huhifadhi rekodi nzuri za miaka 5+ kwa ajili ya ukaguzi wowote.
question_en: How often does TRA conduct a tax audit on a small business in Tanzania?
answer_en: TRA conducts tax audits based on risk assessment (risk-based auditing). A small business that has complied well with tax laws may not be audited for many years. An audit can be triggered by: large discrepancy between reported income and bank deposits, complaints from others, high-risk sectors, or random selection. Keep good records for 5+ years in case of any audit.

question_sw: Je, mwajiri anaweza kulipa mshahara wa chini kwa sehemu sehemu (manunuzi badala ya fedha)?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mshahara wa chini lazima ulipwe kwa fedha taslimu au kwa njia ya benki. Malipo kwa bidhaa, makazi, au faida nyingine yanaweza kuhesabiwa kama sehemu ya mshahara tu kama sheria inaruhusu na hayapunguzi sehemu ya fedha chini ya kiwango cha chini.
question_en: Can an employer pay the minimum wage partly in kind (goods instead of cash)?
answer_en: No. The minimum wage must be paid in cash or via bank. Payments in goods, housing, or other benefits can only count as part of salary if the law permits it and they do not reduce the cash component below the minimum wage floor.

question_sw: Je, biashara inayotoa risiti za EFD lazima iwasilishe VAT return pia?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Risiti ya EFD na VAT return ni wajibu tofauti mbili: (1) Risiti za EFD: zinatoka kwa kila muamala wakati unaotokea; (2) VAT return: inawasilishwa kila mwezi, mwisho wa tarehe 20, na inajumuisha malipo ya VAT inayodaiwa. Kutoa risiti za EFD bila kuwasilisha VAT return ni ukiukaji wa wajibu wa kodi. Seva ya TRA inaweza kuona biashara zinazotoa risiti lakini hazisailishi returns — hizi zinakuwa lengwa la ukaguzi.
question_en: Must a business issuing EFD receipts also submit VAT returns?
answer_en: Yes. EFD receipts and VAT returns are two separate obligations: (1) EFD receipts: issued for every transaction as it occurs; (2) VAT return: submitted monthly, by the 20th, and includes the VAT payment owed. Issuing EFD receipts without submitting VAT returns is a tax compliance violation. TRA's server can identify businesses issuing receipts but not filing returns — these become audit targets.

question_sw: Mwajiri mdogo mwenye wafanyakazi 3 tu anahitaji EFD machine?
answer_sw: Wajibu wa EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) unategemea aina ya biashara na ukubwa wa mauzo — SI idadi ya wafanyakazi. EFD inahitajika kwa: biashara zote zilizosajili VAT, baadhi ya biashara zilizo na mauzo ya chini lakini zimeorodheshwa na TRA. Biashara ndogo isiyo na usajili wa VAT na isiyo kwenye orodha ya TRA inaweza isihitaji EFD. Angalia TRA moja kwa moja kwa biashara yako.
question_en: Does a small employer with only 3 workers need an EFD machine?
answer_en: The EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) obligation depends on business type and turnover — NOT the number of employees. EFD is required for: all VAT-registered businesses, some businesses with lower turnover but listed by TRA. A small business not registered for VAT and not on TRA's list may not need an EFD. Check directly with TRA for your specific business.

instruction: Kampuni ya kigeni inayoingia Tanzania — inahitaji nini kutoka BRELA?
output: Kampuni ya kigeni inayofanya kazi Tanzania inapaswa kusajili TAWI (branch) kwa BRELA chini ya Sehemu XII ya Companies Act. Ada za tawi la kigeni: USD 750 (nakala iliyothibitishwa ya hati za kampuni mama) + USD 220 (kufungua faili na kusajili hati). Faini ya kuchelewa kwa tawi la kigeni ni USD 25/mwezi. Mbadala: kuanzisha kampuni mpya ya Tanzania (subsidiary) badala ya tawi. Tawi na kampuni ya Tanzania zina mifumo tofauti ya kisheria na kodi. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Mtanzania anayeonyesha mgeni kama mfanyakazi wake kwenye biashara — hii ni msaada (facilitating)?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — kuonyesha mgeni kama 'mfanyakazi' wakati kweli ni yeye anayeendesha au kumiliki biashara ni njia ya kawaida ya 'kuwezesha' iliyopigwa marufuku na GN 487A. Idara ya Uhamiaji na TRA wanachunguza hali kama hizi — wanaangalia ni nani anafanya maamuzi ya biashara, kupokea pesa, na kuendesha operesheni za kila siku. Udhihirisho wa kisheria (jina la kumbukumbu) si kinga dhidi ya uchunguzi.
question_en: A Tanzanian shows a non-citizen as their employee in the business — is this facilitating?
answer_en: Yes — presenting a non-citizen as an 'employee' when they are actually running or owning the business is a common method of 'facilitating' prohibited by GN 487A. The Immigration Department and TRA investigate such arrangements — they look at who makes business decisions, receives money, and runs daily operations. Formal appearance (name on record) is not protection against investigation.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Kampuni mpya inayoanza (intending trader) inaweza kusajili VAT bila kuwa na mapato bado?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mtu anayekusudia kufanya biashara (intending trader) anaweza kuomba usajili wa VAT 'wakati wowote' mradi atoe ushahidi wa kutosha kama vile mikataba, zabuni, mipango ya ujenzi, mipango ya biashara, au ufadhili wa benki. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Can a new start-up (intending trader) register for VAT with no revenue yet?
answer_en: Yes. An intending trader can apply for VAT registration 'at any time' provided they present sufficient evidence such as contracts, tenders, building plans, business plans, or bank financing. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Dereva wangu wa kibinafsi ni mfanyakazi wa nyumbani au wa biashara — NSSF tofauti?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Haijalishi kama dereva ni 'wa nyumbani' au 'wa biashara' — kama yeye ni mfanyakazi wako wa kawaida, ana haki ya NSSF. NSSF Act inajumuisha wafanyakazi wote wa biashara NA wafanyakazi wa nyumbani. Wajibu wako: sajili dereva wako kwa NSSF na lipa 10% yako + kata 10% yake kila mwezi.

question_sw: Malipo ya bonasi hazikodiwi PAYE kwa sababu si mshahara wa msingi — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Bonasi ni mapato yanayotoka kwa ajira na YANAWEZA KUPIGWA KODI ya PAYE. Bonasi inaongezwa kwenye mshahara wa mwezi wa mfanyakazi na jumla yake inakabiliwa na kanda za PAYE. Waajiri wanapaswa kuhesabu PAYE kwenye bonasi kwa wakati wa kulipa.
question_en: Bonus payments are not subject to PAYE because they are not basic salary — is this true?
answer_en: No. Bonuses are employment income and ARE subject to PAYE. A bonus is added to the employee's monthly salary and the total is subject to PAYE bands. Employers must calculate PAYE on the bonus at the time of payment.

question_sw: WHT kwa kodi ya pango (rent) kwa wakazi na wasio wakazi ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: WHT kwa kodi ya pango (rent) kwa wakazi wa Tanzania ni asilimia 10. Kwa wasio wakazi, kiwango ni asilimia 20. Mtu anayelipia kodi ya pango kwa mmiliki wa nyumba analazimika kukata WHT kabla ya kulipa na kulipa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on rent for residents and non-residents?
answer_en: WHT on rent for Tanzania residents is 10%. For non-residents the rate is 20%. The person paying rent to a property owner must deduct WHT before paying and remit to TRA by the 7th of the following month.

instruction: Ninauza online. Je, ninahitaji EFD kwa mauzo ya mtandaoni?
output: Ndiyo. Biashara za mtandaoni (e-commerce) zinazofuata kizingiti cha EFD (mauzo TZS 11M+ kwa mwaka, au zilizosajiliwa VAT) lazima zitoe risiti ya EFD. TRA imeandaa miongozo (maelekezo) maalum kwa biashara za mtandaoni. Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) kupata maelekezo sahihi ya jinsi ya kuunganisha mfumo wako wa mauzo ya mtandaoni na EFD.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania analipa NSSF?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania Bara na kupokea mshahara analazimika kulipa NSSF. Kiwango ni sawa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Raia wa kigeni wanaofanya kazi Tanzania wanastahili faida za NSSF baada ya kukusanya michango ya kutosha. Tofauti pekee inaweza kuwa katika mazingira ya makubaliano ya pande mbili ya hifadhi ya jamii — wasiliana na NSSF.
question_en: Does a foreign employee working in Tanzania pay NSSF?
answer_en: Yes. A foreign employee working on Mainland Tanzania and receiving wages is required to contribute to NSSF. The rate is the same: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. Foreign nationals working in Tanzania are entitled to NSSF benefits after accumulating sufficient contributions. The only difference may be in the context of bilateral social security agreements — contact NSSF.

question_sw: Biashara yangu ya kawaida (duka la nguo) haijafika TZS 200M. Lakini pia mimi ni CPA. Je, lazima nisajili VAT?
answer_sw: Kama CPA aliyesajiliwa, SHUGHULI ZAKO ZA UHASIBU zinastahili usajili wa VAT bila kujali mapato — hii imethibitishwa na TRA. Kwa duka lako la nguo kama biashara TOFAUTI isiyohusiana: kizingiti cha kawaida cha TZS 200M kwa miezi 12 au TZS 100M kwa miezi 6 kinatumika kwa biashara hiyo tofauti. Leseni yako ya CPA haifanyi usajili wa VAT wa lazima kwa biashara zako zote ambazo hazihusiani na uhasibu. Hata hivyo, shughuli zote lazima ziorodheshwe kwa TRA — thibitisha hali yako maalum ya pamoja na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Hata kama ungekuwa tu mfanyabiashara wa nguo bila leseni ya CPA, ungepaswa pia kusajili VAT ukifikia kizingiti cha TZS 200M. Kwa hali yako, usajili ni wa lazima haraka.
question_en: My ordinary business (clothing shop) has not reached TZS 200M. But I am also a CPA. Must I register for VAT?
answer_en: As a registered CPA, your PROFESSIONAL ACCOUNTING SERVICES activity requires immediate VAT registration regardless of fees earned — this is confirmed by TRA. For your clothing shop as a SEPARATE unrelated business: the standard threshold of TZS 200M per 12 months or TZS 100M per 6 months applies to that business independently. Your CPA registration does not automatically extend mandatory VAT registration to your unrelated clothing business. However, both activities must be declared to TRA — confirm your specific combined situation with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Even if you were just a clothing trader without a CPA licence, you would need to register for VAT once reaching the TZS 200M threshold. In your situation, registration is immediately mandatory.

instruction: NSSF inatoa mafao ya kifo — familia yangu itanufaika vipi?
output: Ndiyo. NSSF inatoa mafao ya kifo (death benefits) kwa familia ya mwanachama aliyefariki. Mafao yanaweza kujumuisha: malipo ya mkupuo kwa wahusika walioorodheshwa, msaada wa mazishi, na pensheni kwa watoto au mwenzi. Kiasi na masharti ya mafao yanategemea muda wa uanachama na michango iliyolipwa. Kwa maelezo kamili ya mafao ya kifo na jinsi ya kudai, thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.or.tz).

question_sw: TRA inakagua nini wakati wa ukaguzi wa EFD?
answer_sw: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa EFD, TRA inakagua: (1) EFD imesajiliwa ipasavyo na TIN sahihi; (2) Risiti zote zinatolewa na zinapelekwa kwenye seva ya TRA; (3) Z-reports za kila siku zinatolewa na zinawasilishwa; (4) Hesabu za VAT kwenye returns zinalingana na taarifa za EFD kwenye seva ya TRA; (5) Hakuna tofauti kati ya mauzo kwenye hesabu na mauzo kwenye EFD; (6) EFD haijaharisiwa au kubadilishwa.
question_en: What does TRA check during an EFD audit?
answer_en: During an EFD audit, TRA checks: (1) EFD is properly registered with the correct TIN; (2) All receipts are being issued and transmitted to TRA's server; (3) Daily Z-reports are generated and submitted; (4) VAT calculations on returns match EFD data on TRA's server; (5) No discrepancy between accounting sales figures and EFD sales data; (6) EFD has not been tampered with or modified.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa muda wa majaribio (probationary) ana haki ya mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kipindi cha majaribio hakimzuii mfanyakazi kupata mshahara wa chini. GN 605A inatumika tangu siku ya kwanza ya ajira, bila kujali kama mfanyakazi yuko katika kipindi cha majaribio au la.
question_en: Does a probationary employee get the minimum wage?
answer_en: Yes. The probationary period does not exempt the employer from paying the minimum wage. GN 605A applies from day one of employment, regardless of whether the employee is on probation.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya GN 487A (biashara) na sheria ya kazi (labor law) ni nini kwa mgeni?
answer_sw: Tofauti kuu kwa wageni: GN 487A (biashara): inazuia mgeni KUMILIKI au KUENDESHA biashara fulani. Ni kuhusu BIASHARA ya mgeni mwenyewe. Sheria ya kazi (Work Permit): inaruhusu mgeni kufanya KAZI ya AJIRA kwa kampuni ya Tanzania. Ni kuhusu mgeni kufanya kazi kwa MTU MWINGINE. Mgeni anaweza kuwa na kibali cha kazi halali cha kufanya kazi kama daktari mkuu — lakini akifungua kliniki yake binafsi, anakiuka GN 487A. Hizi ni mifumo miwili tofauti.
question_en: What is the difference between GN 487A (business) and labour law for a non-citizen?
answer_en: Key difference for non-citizens: GN 487A (business): prohibits a non-citizen from OWNING or RUNNING certain businesses. It is about the non-citizen's OWN BUSINESS. Labour law (Work Permit): permits a non-citizen to do EMPLOYED WORK for a Tanzanian company. It is about a non-citizen working for SOMEONE ELSE. A non-citizen may hold a valid work permit to work as a chief doctor — but if they open their own private clinic, they violate GN 487A. These are two different systems.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A or immigration regulations

question_sw: Mtoa huduma wa nje ya nchi anayetoa huduma za kidijitali Tanzania — wajibu wake wa VAT ni nini?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, sheria ya VAT Tanzania inaweza kuhitaji watoa huduma wa kidijitali wa nje ya nchi wanaotoa huduma kwa wateja Tanzania kusajiliwa kwa VAT Tanzania. Hata hivyo, masharti maalum ya kizingiti cha usajili na mchakato wa utekelezaji yanategemea kanuni za TRA. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: A non-resident digital service provider supplying services to Tanzania — what are their VAT obligations?
answer_en: Generally, Tanzania VAT law may require non-resident digital service providers supplying services to Tanzanian customers to register for Tanzania VAT. However, specific registration threshold requirements and enforcement processes depend on TRA regulations. Verify with TRA or a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: Rafiki yangu wa Kiindia alipewa onyo tu bila faini wala kifungo. Je, GN 487A inaruhusu onyo?
answer_sw: Sheria ya GN 487A haitaji 'onyo' kama adhabu rasmi — inabainisha faini ya angalau TZS 10M, kifungo hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa visa. Onyo si adhabu iliyotajwa katika sheria. Hata hivyo, wakati wa ukaguzi wa mara ya kwanza au kabla ya kesi, mamlaka inaweza kutoa tahadhari ya kiutawala. Hii si onyo rasmi wa kisheria — ikiwa kesi itafunguliwa mahakamani, adhabu kamili zinatumika.
question_en: My Indian friend was only warned with no fine or imprisonment. Does GN 487A allow warnings?
answer_en: GN 487A law does not provide for a 'warning' as a formal penalty — it specifies a fine of at least TZS 10M, imprisonment up to 6 months, and visa revocation. A warning is not a stated penalty in the law. However, during initial inspections or pre-prosecution, authorities may issue an administrative caution. This is not a formal legal warning — if a case goes to court, the full penalties apply.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Biashara ya B2C ya malipo ya kidijitali ina VAT ya asilimia ngapi kuanzia Septemba 2025?
answer_sw: Shughuli za B2C za malipo ya kidijitali (e-payment) zinalipwa VAT ya asilimia 16 kuanzia tarehe 1 Septemba 2025. Kanuni za utekelezaji zingali zinasubiriwa kutoka kwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA. Thibitisha hali ya sasa na TRA.
question_en: What VAT rate applies to B2C digital payment transactions from September 2025?
answer_en: B2C e-payment transactions are subject to 16% VAT from 1 September 2025. Implementation rules are pending a notice from the TRA Commissioner General. Confirm the current status with TRA.

question_sw: STR ina zana gani kuu 4 za biashara?
answer_sw: STR ina zana 4 kuu: (1) Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) — hati inayothibitisha asili ya bidhaa; (2) Simplified Customs Document (SCD) — fomu rahisi ya forodha badala ya fomu ngumu; (3) Common List — orodha ya bidhaa ~370 zinazostahili STR; (4) Kizingiti cha USD 2,000 — mipaka ya thamani ya msafara.
question_en: What are the 4 main STR instruments?
answer_en: STR has 4 main instruments: (1) Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) — a document certifying the origin of goods; (2) Simplified Customs Document (SCD) — a simplified customs form instead of complex forms; (3) Common List — list of ~370 eligible goods; (4) USD 2,000 threshold — the consignment value limit.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Adhabu ya Mtanzania anayemsaidia mgeni kufanya biashara iliyokatazwa ni nini — ni sawa na ya mgeni?
answer_sw: Hapana — adhabu ya msaidizi Mtanzania ni TOFAUTI kabisa na ya mgeni: faini ya ISIYOZIDI TZS 5,000,000 AU kifungo kisichozidi miezi 3 — si zote mbili pamoja. Tofauti kuu tatu: (1) kiasi: 5M si 10M; (2) muundo: AU (si NA); (3) hakuna kufutwa kwa visa kwa sababu Mtanzania si mgeni.
question_en: Is the penalty for a Tanzanian who helps a non-citizen conduct a prohibited business the same as for the non-citizen?
answer_en: No — the Tanzanian facilitator's penalty is completely DIFFERENT from the non-citizen's: a fine NOT EXCEEDING TZS 5,000,000 OR imprisonment not exceeding 3 months — not both together. Three key differences: (1) amount: 5M not 10M; (2) structure: OR not AND; (3) no visa revocation because the Tanzanian is not a foreigner.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Amri ya mishahara ya 2022 bado inatumika Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Amri ya mishahara ya 2022 ilifutwa rasmi kuanzia tarehe 1 Januari 2026 wakati GN 605A ilipoanza kutumika. Mwajiri anayendelea kulipa kwa viwango vya 2022 anakiuka sheria. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Is the 2022 wage order still valid in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. The 2022 wage order was formally revoked from 1 January 2026 when GN 605A came into force. An employer continuing to pay at 2022 rates is violating the law. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni analipa kwa kiwango gani cha PAYE — kina tofauti na raia?
answer_sw: Kwa wafanyakazi wa kawaida wa ajira (employees), viwango vya PAYE ni sawa kwa raia na wageni wanaofanya kazi Tanzania. Viwango vya PAYE vya Tanzania (mwaka 2025/2026) ni vya kijumla: 0% kwa chini ya TZS 270,000/mwezi, 8%-30% kwa viwango vya juu zaidi. Tofauti inaweza kuwepo kwa watu wa hali maalum kama wasio na makazi (non-residents) — thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Does a foreign employee pay PAYE at a different rate from a citizen?
answer_en: For regular employees, PAYE rates are the same for citizens and foreigners working in Tanzania. Tanzania PAYE rates (2025/2026) are graduated: 0% below TZS 270,000/month, 8%-30% for higher brackets. Differences may exist for persons with special status like non-residents — verify with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari: SDL inamaanisha nini kwa mwajiri wa kawaida Tanzania?
answer_sw: SDL (Skills Development Levy) kwa mwajiri: (1) Jina kamili: Skills Development Levy — si disability leave wala aina yoyote ya likizo; (2) Kiwango: 3.5% ya gross payroll; (3) Kizingiti: wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi; (4) Analipa: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi); (5) Kwenda: TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata; (6) Lengo: kufadhili mafunzo ya ufundi (VETA).
question_en: Summary: what does SDL mean for a typical employer in Tanzania?
answer_en: SDL (Skills Development Levy) for the employer: (1) Full name: Skills Development Levy — not disability leave or any type of leave; (2) Rate: 3.5% of gross payroll; (3) Threshold: 10 or more employees; (4) Payer: employer only (not the employee); (5) Destination: TRA by the 7th of the following month; (6) Purpose: to fund vocational training (VETA).
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unahusiana na 'Capital Gains Tax' (kodi ya faida ya mtaji) — ni mambo sawa?
answer_sw: Hapana, ni mambo tofauti kabisa. Ushuru wa stempu ni kodi kwenye HATI YA KISHERIA ya uhamishaji — inayolipwa mara moja kwenye thamani ya uhamishaji. Kodi ya faida ya mtaji (capital gain) ni kodi kwenye FAIDA inayopatikana na muuzaji — tofauti kati ya bei ya mauzo na gharama ya ununuzi wa awali. Mnunuzi analipa ushuru wa stempu; muuzaji anaweza kulipa kodi ya faida ya mtaji.
question_en: Are Tanzania stamp duty and Capital Gains Tax the same thing?
answer_en: No, these are completely different things. Stamp duty is a tax on the LEGAL INSTRUMENT of transfer — paid once on the transfer value. Capital gains tax is a tax on the PROFIT earned by the seller — the difference between the sale price and original purchase cost. The buyer pays stamp duty; the seller may pay capital gains tax.

question_sw: Kampuni inayolipa mshahara kwa pesa taslimu (bila akaunti ya benki) inaweza kulipa PAYE na NSSF kwa njia hiyo hiyo?
answer_sw: Malipo ya PAYE na NSSF TRA yanafanywa kupitia mfumo wa PRN/benki au e-payment ya TRA — SI kwa pesa taslimu ofisini. Hata kama kampuni inalipa mishahara ya wafanyakazi kwa pesa taslimu, mwajiri bado analazimishwa kuwasilisha PAYE na NSSF kupitia njia rasmi za malipo za TRA na NSSF. Hifadhi rekodi za mishahara ya pesa taslimu kama ushahidi.
question_en: Can a company that pays wages in cash (without bank accounts) also pay PAYE and NSSF the same way?
answer_en: PAYE and NSSF payments to TRA are made through the PRN/bank system or TRA e-payment — NOT by cash at the office. Even if a company pays employee wages in cash, the employer is still required to remit PAYE and NSSF through TRA's and NSSF's official payment channels. Keep records of cash wage payments as evidence.

instruction: GN 487A ina msamaha kwa wageni wanaofanya biashara kubwa (zaidi ya TZS milioni 100)?
output: Hapana — GN 487A haijatoa msamaha wowote kulingana na ukubwa wa biashara au kiasi cha mtaji. Sheria inazuia shughuli zote 15 kwa raia wote wa kigeni bila kizingiti cha mapato, mtaji, au ukubwa wa biashara. Mwekezaji mkubwa wa kigeni (TZS bilioni 10 iliyowekwa) bado anakabiliwa na marufuku ikiwa anafanya rejareja, saluni, au shughuli nyingine yoyote katika orodha ya 15. Kwa mwekezaji mkubwa wa kigeni, shughuli zilizoruhusiwa zaidi ni uwekezaji wa kilimo, viwanda, utalii, na maeneo ya uzalishaji — si rejareja au saluni. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na BRELA.

question_sw: Hati ya ushirika wa VICOBA au SACCOS ina ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Nyaraka za VICOBA (vikundi vya akiba) na SACCOS zinaweza kuwa na mfumo maalum wa ushuru au zisamehewa kwa sababu ya asili yao ya ushirika wa jamii. Hata hivyo, ikiwa SACCOS inaingia mikataba ya mkopo au mali ya ardhi, sehemu hizo za mikataba zina ushuru wa kawaida. Angalia TRA na Mamlaka ya SACCOS kwa mwongozo mahususi.
question_en: Does a VICOBA or SACCOS formation instrument attract stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: VICOBA (savings group) and SACCOS documents may have a special tax treatment or be exempt due to their community cooperative nature. However, if a SACCOS enters loan contracts or land-related instruments, those parts carry normal stamp duty. Check TRA and the SACCOS Authority for specific guidance.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or cooperative law update

question_sw: Biashara ya mtu mmoja (sole trader) hailazimiki kusajiliwa kwa TRA ikiwa mauzo yake hayafiki kizingiti cha VAT — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kamili. Ingawa biashara yenye mauzo chini ya kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200M kwa mwaka) hailazimiki kusajili VAT, LAZIMA kusajiliwa na TRA kwa ajili ya kodi ya mapato ikiwa inapata faida. Kila mtu anayefanya biashara Tanzania anapaswa kuwa na TIN na kuwasilisha tamko la kodi ya mwaka. Kusajili VAT na kusajili TRA kwa kodi ya mapato ni mambo mawili tofauti.
question_en: A sole trader does not need to register with TRA if their turnover is below the VAT threshold — is this true?
answer_en: Not entirely true. Although a business below the VAT threshold (TZS 200M/year) does not need to register for VAT, it MUST still register with TRA for income tax if it earns a profit. Every person doing business in Tanzania should have a TIN and submit an annual tax return. VAT registration and TRA income tax registration are two separate requirements.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi kwa waajiri wawili analipa NSSF mara mbili?
answer_sw: Inategemea: kila mwajiri anapaswa kulipa NSSF kwa mfanyakazi wake. Kama mfanyakazi ana waajiri wawili, NSSF inalipwa na kila mwajiri kwa kipande cha mshahara kinachohusika. Thibitisha mpangilio sahihi na NSSF.
question_en: Does an employee working for two employers pay NSSF twice?
answer_en: It depends: each employer must pay NSSF for their employee. If an employee has two employers, each pays NSSF on their respective portion of wages. Confirm the correct arrangement with NSSF.

question_sw: EFD machine ikivunjika au kuharibika Tanzania — biashara inafanya nini?
answer_sw: Ikiwa EFD machine inavunjika: (1) ripoti kwa TRA haraka (kupitia mfumo wa TRA au msambazaji wako wa EFD), (2) usifanye mauzo bila EFD kwa muda wowote bila ruhusa ya TRA — hii ni kosa, (3) TRA inaweza kutoa ruhusa ya muda mfupi ya kuandika risiti za mkono wakati wa kusubiri ukarabati, (4) mashine iliyoharibika lazima irekebishwe na msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa, si mtu yeyote. Hifadhi rekodi za mauzo yaliyofanywa wakati EFD haikufanya kazi.
question_en: If an EFD machine breaks down in Tanzania — what does the business do?
answer_en: If an EFD machine breaks down: (1) report to TRA promptly (via TRA system or your EFD supplier), (2) do not make sales without the EFD for any period without TRA authorisation — this is an offence, (3) TRA may grant short-term permission to write manual receipts while awaiting repair, (4) the broken machine must be repaired by an authorised supplier, not just anyone. Keep records of sales made while the EFD was not functioning.

instruction: Kampuni ya kuua wadudu (pest control) inayomilikiwa na mgeni — je, iko katika orodha ya GN 487A?
output: Ndiyo — udhibiti wa wadudu (pest control) ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A (tarehe 28 Julai 2025). Hii inajumuisha huduma za kuua mende, panya, mbu, na wadudu wengine katika nyumba na ofisi. Mgeni anayemiliki au kuendesha kampuni ya pest control anakabiliwa na: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: SDL na WCF ni ushuru ule ule unaolipwa pamoja — au ni ushuru tofauti?
output:
Ni ushuru TOFAUTI KABISA — si ushuru mmoja:

SDL = 3.5% ya mishahara ya fedha — inalipwa TRA — inafadhili mafunzo ya ujuzi (skills training).
WCF = 0.5% ya mishahara ya fedha — inalipwa Mamlaka ya WCF (si TRA) — inafadhili fidia ya majeruhi wa kazi.

Zote mbili ni za mwajiri peke yake — hazikuatwi kwa mfanyakazi. Zinalipwa kwa mamlaka TOFAUTI. Thibitisha tarehe na utaratibu wa kila moja na TRA (tra.go.tz) na Mamlaka ya WCF.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi (part-time) ana haki ya mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa msingi wa pro-rata. Mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi ana haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A kuhesabiwa kwa idadi ya masaa aliyofanya kazi ikilinganishwa na masaa ya kawaida ya wiki ya kazi. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Does a part-time worker have the right to the minimum wage under GN 605A?
answer_en: Yes, on a pro-rata basis. A part-time worker is entitled to the GN 605A minimum wage calculated according to the hours worked compared to the normal working week. Confirm with MLYWF.

instruction: Mgeni anafanya kazi kwa biashara ya mama yake Mtanzania kama msaidizi — GN 487A inasema nini?
output: Kama mgeni ni MWAJIRIWA tu wa biashara ya mama yake Mtanzania (si mmiliki, si mbia, si mdhibiti), na anafanya kazi kwa mshahara — hali hii ni tofauti na kumiliki biashara. GN 487A inalenga raia wa kigeni kufanya biashara wenyewe katika orodha ya 15. Hata hivyo, kama mgeni anafanya kazi bila kibali rasmi cha kazi (Class B permit), hilo ni ukiukwaji wa sheria nyingine ya uhamiaji. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kuhusu hali yako maalum.

question_sw: PAYE inacheswa vipi kwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 358,322?
answer_sw: Mshahara ghafi TZS 358,322. Punguza NSSF ya mfanyakazi (10%): TZS 358,322 − TZS 35,832 = TZS 322,490. Kanda za PAYE: TZS 0–270,000 = TZS 0; TZS 270,001–322,490 (TZS 52,490 × 8%) = TZS 4,199. PAYE ya mwezi: TZS 4,199. Thibitisha hesabu na TRA.
question_en: How is PAYE calculated on the GN 605A average minimum wage of TZS 358,322?
answer_en: Gross wage TZS 358,322. Deduct employee NSSF (10%): TZS 358,322 − TZS 35,832 = TZS 322,490. PAYE bands: TZS 0–270,000 = TZS 0; TZS 270,001–322,490 (TZS 52,490 × 8%) = TZS 4,199. Monthly PAYE: TZS 4,199. Confirm the calculation with TRA.
next_review_trigger: New wage order or Finance Act rate change

instruction: Je, GN605A ina kiwango kimoja cha mshahara kwa wafanyakazi wote Tanzania?
output: Hapana. GN605A haina kiwango kimoja cha wote — ina sekta 16 na subsekta nyingi, kila moja ikiwa na kiwango chake maalum. Viwango vinatofautiana sana kati ya sekta: kutoka TZS 80,000 (wafanyakazi wa nyumbani fulani) hadi TZS 765,900 (nishati ya kimataifa). Kila mwajiri lazima atumie kiwango cha sekta yake — si wastani wa taifa. Thibitisha kiwango cha sekta yako kwa kupitia GN605A kwenye tanzlii.org.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: WCF mchango unalipwa TRA au WCF moja kwa moja?
answer_sw: Mchango wa WCF unalipwa moja kwa moja kwa WORKERS COMPENSATION FUND (WCF) — si kwa TRA. WCF ni shirika lake tofauti linalosimamiwa na Wizara ya Kazi. Usajili, malipo ya mchango, na madai yote yanashughulikiwa na WCF, si TRA.
question_en: Is the WCF contribution paid to TRA or directly to WCF?
answer_en: The WCF contribution is paid directly to the WORKERS COMPENSATION FUND (WCF) — not to TRA. WCF is a separate organisation managed by the Ministry of Labour. Registration, contribution payments, and all claims are handled by WCF, not TRA.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: NSSF Tanzania inashughulikia bima ya afya (health insurance) — NSSF italipa gharama za hospitali za mwajiriwa — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Si sahihi kabisa. NSSF (National Social Security Fund) Tanzania ni mfuko wa pensheni na manufaa ya kijamii — si bima ya afya ya kila siku. NSSF inalipa: pensheni ya uzee (miaka 60/55), manufaa ya ulemavu, manufaa ya kifo cha mapema. Kwa bima ya afya ya hospitali, Tanzania ina mfumo tofauti — NHIF (National Health Insurance Fund) au CHF (Community Health Fund). NSSF na NHIF ni mifumo tofauti ya bima ya kijamii.
question_en: NSSF Tanzania covers health insurance — NSSF will pay an employee's hospital bills — is this correct?
answer_en: Not quite. NSSF (National Social Security Fund) Tanzania is a pension and social benefits fund — not everyday health insurance. NSSF pays: old-age pension (age 60/55), disability benefits, early death benefits. For hospital health insurance, Tanzania has a separate system — NHIF (National Health Insurance Fund) or CHF (Community Health Fund). NSSF and NHIF are different social insurance systems.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act or NHIF Act amendment

instruction: Ninauza bidhaa zangu kwa kampuni dada yangu nje ya Tanzania kwa bei nafuu — TRA inaweza kusema nini?
output: TRA ina mamlaka ya kupinga bei za miamala kati ya kampuni washirika (related party transactions) ikiwa hazifuati bei ya soko (arm's length principle) chini ya kanuni za transfer pricing. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa kiwango halisi cha hatari, njia za kujilinda, na nyaraka zinazohitajika kwa TRA. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Nataka kununua hisa kwenye soko la hisa la New York (NYSE). Nifanye vipi Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu. Kununua hisa katika masoko ya kimataifa kama NYSE kunahusisha kanuni za fedha za kimataifa, ruhusa za Benki Kuu ya Tanzania, na sheria za mabadiliko ya fedha. Nje ya maarifa yangu ya ushauri wa kodi na biashara Tanzania. Wasiliana na mshauri wa fedha aliyehitimu au Benki Kuu ya Tanzania (bot.go.tz) kwa mwelekeo sahihi.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Mshauri wa kigeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania kwa wiki moja haahitaji kusajiliwa TRA kwa sababu atakuwa Tanzania kwa muda mfupi tu — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Si sahihi kamili. Mshauri wa kigeni anayepokea malipo kwa kazi aliyofanya Tanzania anapaswa kulipa kodi ya Tanzania kwenye mapato hayo. Hata ikiwa yuko Tanzania kwa muda mfupi, mwajiri wake wa Tanzania (au kampuni inayomhusisha) ina wajibu wa kushikilia kodi ya zuio (WHT) kwenye malipo. Hii inatumika bila kujali muda wa kukaa Tanzania.
question_en: A foreign consultant working in Tanzania for one week doesn't need to register with TRA because they will only be in Tanzania briefly — is this correct?
answer_en: Not entirely correct. A foreign consultant receiving payment for work done in Tanzania must pay Tanzania tax on that income. Even if present briefly, their Tanzania employer or contracting company has an obligation to withhold tax (WHT) on the payments. This applies regardless of the length of stay in Tanzania.

question_sw: Mtu asiye raia anayefanya biashara bila kibali Tanzania anakabili adhabu gani?
answer_sw: Chini ya GN 487A (iliyoanza Julai 2025): faini ya chini ya TZS 10,000,000 na/au kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 na kufutwa kwa viza. Sheria hii inashughulikia shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni — ikiwemo biashara ya jumla/reja reja, uhamishaji wa pesa za simu, ukarabati wa simu, na saluni. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What penalty does a non-citizen face for doing business without a permit in Tanzania?
answer_en: Under GN 487A (effective July 2025): a minimum fine of TZS 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 6 months plus visa revocation. This order covers 15 activities prohibited for non-citizens — including wholesale/retail trade, mobile money transfers, phone repair, and salons. Confirm with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Kiwango cha pili cha PAYE ni asilimia 9 tangu Finance Act 2023 — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango cha pili cha PAYE ni asilimia 8 — hii haikubadilishwa hadi asilimia 9 na Finance Act 2023 wala Finance Act nyingine yoyote. Kanda ya asilimia 8 bado inatumika kwa mapato kati ya Shilingi 270,001 na 520,000 kwa mwezi. Kiwango cha asilimia 9 si sahihi chini ya sheria ya Tanzania.
question_en: The second PAYE band is 9% since the Finance Act 2023 — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The second PAYE band is 8% — it was not changed to 9% by Finance Act 2023 or any other Finance Act. The 8% band still applies to income between TZS 270,001 and 520,000 per month. A rate of 9% is incorrect under Tanzania tax law.

instruction: Ni nini maana ya kudai pembejeo ya VAT (input VAT claim)?
output: Pembejeo ya VAT (input VAT) ni VAT unayolipa kwa mauzo unayonunua kwa biashara yako. Kama biashara yako imesajiliwa VAT, unaweza kudai pembejeo hiyo kurudi dhidi ya VAT unayokusanya kutoka kwa wateja (output VAT). Kwa mfano: ulinunua bidhaa na kulipa VAT ya TZS 50,000 (pembejeo) na ukakusanya VAT ya TZS 80,000 kutoka wateja (output) — unalipa TRA TZS 30,000 tu. Hii inapunguza mzigo wako wa kodi.

instruction: Tofauti kati ya bidhaa zero-rated na exempt kwa VAT ni nini?
output: Zero-rated: bidhaa zinazolipiwa VAT ya 0% — biashara inaweza kudai pembejeo ya VAT (input VAT) kwenye ununuzi. Exempt: bidhaa ambazo haziko ndani ya mfumo wa VAT kabisa — biashara haiwezi kudai pembejeo. Tofauti hii ni muhimu sana kwa biashara zinazonunua vifaa: kama unauza bidhaa exempt pekee, huwezi kudai input VAT. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi au TRA kujua kundi la bidhaa zako.

question_sw: Ninaweza kulipa kodi zangu zote TRA kupitia GePG mtandaoni bila kwenda ofisi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) inaruhusu kulipa kodi nyingi za TRA mtandaoni bila kwenda ofisi, ikiwa ni pamoja na PAYE, VAT, SDL, kodi ya makisio, na kodi za nyingine. Hatua: (1) Wasilisha return yako kwenye mfumo wa TRA (IDRAS au portal ya TRA) ili kupata nambari ya rejesta ya malipo (PRN). (2) Lipa kupitia benki inayoshiriki na GePG, ATM, internet banking, au simu za pesa (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa). (3) Hifadhi uthibitisho wa malipo kwa rekodi zako. Malipo yanafanyika mara moja na yanachukuliwa kama malipo rasmi.
answer_en: Yes. GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) allows payment of most TRA taxes online without visiting an office, including PAYE, VAT, SDL, presumptive tax, and other taxes. Steps: (1) File your return on TRA's system (IDRAS or TRA portal) to obtain a payment reference number (PRN). (2) Pay via a GePG-connected bank, ATM, internet banking, or mobile money (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa). (3) Keep the payment confirmation for your records. Payment is processed immediately and treated as official tax payment.
question_en: Can I pay all my TRA taxes via GePG online without visiting an office?
primary_source_name: TRA GePG — online tax payment system

question_sw: Watoa huduma wa kitaalamu (professional service providers) wanastahili VAT Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, watoa huduma wa kitaalamu wanastahili usajili wa VAT kama wanafikia kizingiti cha TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6. Wanaweza pia kusajili kwa hiari kabla ya kufikia kizingiti. Thibitisha hali ya huduma zako maalum na TRA.
question_en: Do professional service providers qualify for VAT registration in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes, professional service providers qualify for VAT registration if they reach the TZS 200M/year or TZS 100M/6-month threshold. They can also voluntarily register before reaching the threshold. Confirm the status of your specific services with TRA.

instruction: Mgeni ana vibali vyote vya kazi na biashara — BRELA, TIN, kila kitu — bado GN 487A inamhusu?
output: Ndiyo — kuwa na vibali vyote vya biashara (BRELA, TIN, permit ya kazi) hakumsamehe mgeni wa GN 487A. GN 487A ni zuio la aina ya biashara — si zuio la utaratibu wa usajili. Sheria inasema raia wa kigeni hawezi KUFANYA biashara katika orodha ya 15, hata kama wamesajili vizuri. Hiyo ndiyo maana ya 'marufuku ya biashara' — si marufuku ya kutosajili. Adhabu: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Wateja wangu wanalipa kwa njia nyingi — taslimu, M-Pesa, na kadi. EFD inavyofanya kazi kwa kila moja?
output: Malipo ya simu (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money) yanahitaji risiti ya EFD kama malipo ya kawaida. Njia ya malipo haiathiri wajibu wa kutoa risiti — kila muamala wa mauzo lazima upate risiti ya EFD. EFD ya kisasa inasaidia kurekodi aina tofauti za malipo: Taslimu → chagua 'Cash' kwenye EFD. M-Pesa/Tigo Pesa/Airtel Money → chagua 'Mobile Money'. Kadi ya benki → chagua 'Card/Electronic'. Kila aina inapata risiti yake ya EFD inayoonyesha njia ya malipo.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa probation alitolewa kazi mwezi wa 3. Je, NSSF iliyolipwa inarejeshwa?
answer_sw: Hapana — NSSF iliyolipwa hairejiswi kwa mwajiri wala mfanyakazi wakati ajira inaisha kabla ya muda. Michango iliyolipwa inabaki kwenye akaunti ya NSSF ya mfanyakazi. Mfanyakazi anaweza kupata faida za muda mfupi (short-term benefits) au kuhifadhi michango hiyo kwa ajira yake ijayo. Mwajiri hawezi kudai kurejeshwa kwa michango ya mwajiri aliyolipa.
question_en: A probationary employee was terminated in month 3. Is NSSF paid refunded?
answer_en: No — paid NSSF is not refunded to either the employer or employee when employment ends before completion. Contributions paid remain in the employee's NSSF account. The employee may access short-term benefits or retain those contributions for future employment. The employer cannot claim a refund of employer contributions already paid.

instruction: Ninajua kampuni zangu mbili zinahitaji arm's length pricing — lakini kwa sababu zangu za biashara, lazima nitoe punguzo kwa kampuni dada. Je, TRA itapinga?
output: Punguzo la bei kwa sababu za biashara (commercial justification) linaweza kukubalika chini ya kanuni za transfer pricing lakini lazima liwe na nyaraka imara za kusaidia. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa mipaka ya kisheria, nyaraka zinazohitajika, na jinsi ya kupata makubaliano ya awali (advance pricing agreement) na TRA. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Mwajiri anaweza kulipa SDL kabla ya mwisho wa mwezi badala ya tarehe ya 7?
output: Ndiyo — mwajiri anaweza kulipa SDL kabla ya tarehe ya 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kulipa mapema ni halali kabisa na hakunakiliwa kama tatizo. Faida za kulipa mapema: (1) Unahakikisha hufikwi na muda wa dharura; (2) Unaepuka kuchelewa kutokana na matatizo ya benki au mfumo wa TRA; (3) Unaonyesha ushirikiano mzuri na TRA. Hakuna faida ya ziada ya kifedha kwa kulipa mapema (hakuna riba ya SDL kwa kulipa mapema). Tarehe ya 7 ni kikomo cha juu — si siku ya lazima ya kulipa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa utaratibu wa malipo ya mapema.

instruction: Kampuni yangu inanunua mchanganyiko wa bidhaa (IT laptop) na huduma (ufungaji wa programu) pamoja — withholding ni ngapi?
output: Kwa mchanganyiko wa bidhaa na huduma, withholding inatumika kwa vipande tofauti: SEHEMU YA BIDHAA (laptop) → 3% withholding; SEHEMU YA HUDUMA (ufungaji wa programu/installation) → 6% withholding. Ikiwezekana, omba muuzaji atoe invoice tofauti au ahesabu wazi kiasi cha bidhaa na huduma — ili uweze kutumia kiwango sahihi kwa kila sehemu. Kama muuzaji hakutofautisha, kushauriana na mshauri wa kodi kunashauriwa. Pia withholding certificate lazima itolewa kwa wakati unaofaa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: EFD machine yangu imeharibika — TRA wanasema niwasiliane na msambazaji. Msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa ni nani?
output: Msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa (approved supplier) ni kampuni iliyopata idhini rasmi ya TRA kuuza na kushughulikia EFD machines Tanzania. Nunua au karabatia EFD yako kutoka kwa msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa TRA tu — kwa orodha ya sasa ya wasambazaji walioidhinishwa, angalia kwenye tra.go.tz. Msambazaji asiyeidhinishwa hawezi kuwasha (activate) EFD yako kwenye mfumo wa TRA.

instruction: Nalipa premium ya bima ya afya kwa wafanyakazi wangu — je, inaweza kukatwa kama gharama ya kodi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Uzingatifu wa kodi wa premiums za bima ya afya kama gharama inayokatwa (tax-deductible expense) kwa makampuni ni mada ya Income Tax Act inayohitaji uchambuzi maalum wa hesabu za kodi wa biashara — nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: OSHA inaweza kufunga biashara kwa sababu ya ukiukwaji wa usalama Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. OSHA ina mamlaka ya kutoa amri ya kusimamisha shughuli (stop order) au kufunga mahali pa kazi ikiwa panahatarisha usalama wa wafanyakazi kwa kiwango kikubwa. Mkaguzi wa OSHA anaweza kutoa: notisi ya kuboresha (improvement notice) kwa ukiukwaji mdogo, amri ya kusimamisha (prohibition notice) kwa hatari ya haraka, au kusimamisha shughuli hadi hatari itakapoondolewa. Kufunga kwa OSHA si suala la uhasibu — ni suala la usalama wa mwili.
question_en: Can OSHA close a business for safety violations in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. OSHA has authority to issue a stop order or close a workplace if it poses a major threat to worker safety. An OSHA inspector can issue: an improvement notice for minor violations, a prohibition notice for immediate danger, or suspend operations until the hazard is removed. OSHA closure is not an accounting matter — it is a physical safety matter.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

instruction: Muuzaji wa VAT anayenunua bidhaa kwa gharama na kuziuza — je, anatumia VAT withholding au output/input VAT?
output: Muuzaji wa VAT anafanya kazi na mfumo wa kawaida wa output/input VAT: Output VAT: anapotoza VAT (18%) kwa wateja wake — hii ni 'deni' lake kwa TRA. Input VAT: anapokea VAT (18%) kwenye manunuzi yake — hii ni 'mkopo' wake dhidi ya deni. Kama muuzaji ni qualifying buyer: pia anachukua withholding (3%/6%) kutoka kwa wauzaji wake. Withholding iliyochukuliwa si sawa na input VAT — ni tofauti. Mfumo wa VAT kwa muuzaji: output VAT − input VAT = VAT inayolipwa TRA. Withholding inayochukuliwa inatumwa TRA tofauti. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa mwongozo maalum.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya mapato ya kampuni (corporate income tax) Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kawaida cha kodi ya mapato ya kampuni Tanzania ni asilimia 30 ya faida inayotozwa kodi. Kampuni zilizoorodheshwa kwenye Soko la Hisa la Dar es Salaam (DSE) zinapata kiwango cha pungufu cha asilimia 25. Kampuni ndogo zinazofanya biashara kwa njia ya mfumo wa kodi ya makisio (presumptive tax) zinalipa kwa njia tofauti kulingana na mapato. Kiwango hiki kinaweza kubadilika kufuatia Sheria ya Fedha ya kila mwaka.
answer_en: The standard corporate income tax rate in Tanzania is 30% of taxable profit. Companies listed on the Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange (DSE) benefit from a reduced rate of 25%. Small businesses operating under the presumptive tax system pay at different rates based on turnover. This rate may change following each annual Finance Act.
question_en: What is the corporate income tax rate in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — Income Tax Act Cap.332

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina mkopo kutoka kwa mwanzo wa kampuni mama — mkopo huo unahesabiwaje kwa transfer pricing?
output: Mikopo kati ya kampuni washirika (related party loans) lazima iwe na riba inayolingana na bei ya soko (arm's length rate) chini ya kanuni za transfer pricing Tanzania. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa kiwango maalum cha riba kinachokubaliwa na TRA na jinsi ya kuandika nyaraka. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Adhabu ya mwajiri asiyekata PAYE ya mfanyakazi mgeni ni nini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri asiyekata PAYE ya mfanyakazi (raia au mgeni) anakabiliwa na: (1) Adhabu ya 2.5% ya kila mwezi juu ya kiasi kilichokosekana; (2) Riba inayoendelea; (3) TRA inaweza kufanya ukaguzi na kudai PAYE na adhabu zote. Mwajiri anaweza pia kuwa liable kibinafsi kwa PAYE isiyolipwa — hata kama mfanyakazi ameshaacha kazi.
question_en: What is the penalty for an employer who fails to deduct PAYE for a foreign employee?
answer_en: An employer who fails to deduct PAYE for any employee (citizen or foreign) faces: (1) A 2.5% penalty per month on the shortfall; (2) Ongoing interest; (3) TRA may audit and claim all PAYE and penalties due. The employer can also be personally liable for unpaid PAYE — even after the employee has left.

instruction: Mtunza watoto wangu (babysitter) analipwa mara kwa mara — NSSF inahitajika?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Hata babysitter anayefanya kazi mara kwa mara kama mfanyakazi wako wa kawaida anaweza kustahili NSSF kulingana na hali ya mkataba. Mfanyakazi wa kawaida (regular employee): NSSF inahitajika. Kazi ya mara moja tu (one-off task): inaweza kuwa mikataba ya huduma, si employment. Thibitisha hali ya mkataba na mwanasheria wa kazi au NSSF.

instruction: Nimesikia SDL na PAYE zinalipwa siku tofauti za mwezi — hii ni kweli?
output: Hapana — si kweli. SDL na PAYE zote mbili zinalipwa TRA kwa siku MOJA — ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Hakuna utaratibu wa kulipa SDL siku moja na PAYE siku nyingine tofauti. Zote mbili zinawasilishwa pamoja ifikapo tarehe 7. Mfano: SDL na PAYE za Machi zinawasilishwa ifikapo 7 Aprili. Thibitisha tarehe hii na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Mgeni mwenye kibali cha makazi daraja C anaweza kufanya shughuli zilizopigwa marufuku na GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A inaweka marufuku ya aina ya shughuli — hata kibali cha kazi halimruhusu mgeni kufanya shughuli zilizoorodheshwa kwenye amri. Sheria hizi mbili zinatumika pamoja. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: Can a non-citizen with a Class C residence permit conduct activities prohibited by GN 487A?
answer_en: No. GN 487A restricts the type of activity — even a work permit does not authorise a non-citizen to conduct activities listed in the order. Both laws apply concurrently. Confirm with the Immigration Department and a legal adviser.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni (expatriate) analipa PAYE Tanzania kwa njia gani?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania na kupata mshahara Tanzania analipa PAYE kwa njia ile ile ya wafanyakazi wa ndani — mwajiri anakata PAYE na kulipa TRA kila mwezi. Ikiwa mfanyakazi ana makao makuu Tanzania, analipa kodi ya mapato yote duniani. Mikataba ya kuepuka kutozwa kodi mara mbili (DTAs) inaweza kutoa uondoaji kwa nchi fulani.
question_en: How does a foreign (expatriate) employee pay PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: A foreign employee working in Tanzania and receiving a Tanzania salary pays PAYE the same way as local employees — the employer deducts PAYE and remits to TRA monthly. If the employee has permanent establishment in Tanzania, worldwide income may be taxable. Double Taxation Agreements (DTAs) may provide relief for specific countries.

question_sw: Biashara ya mtu binafsi (sole trader) inahitaji usajili wa BRELA — je, ni lazima?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mtu binafsi anayefanya biashara Tanzania chini ya jina lolote (isipokuwa jina lake mwenyewe) analazimika kusajili jina la biashara kwa BRELA. Ikiwa unafanya biashara kwa jina lako mwenyewe tu (kwa mfano, 'John Mwamba — Fundi Umeme'), usajili wa BRELA si lazima kisheria, ingawa inashauriwa.
question_en: Does a sole trader need BRELA registration — is it mandatory?
answer_en: Yes. An individual trading in Tanzania under any name (other than their own full name) must register the business name with BRELA. If you trade exclusively under your own personal name (for example, 'John Mwamba — Electrician'), BRELA registration is not legally required, though it is advisable.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Duka la dawa linaweza kumilikiwa na daktari mgeni Tanzania?
answer_sw: Duka la dawa (pharmacy) linasimamiwa na sheria za afya za Tanzania — haswa Mamlaka ya Chakula na Dawa (TFDA/TMDA). GN 487A inazuia biashara ya rejareja kwa ujumla, lakini dawa ni sekta maalum inayohitaji leseni za TMDA. Kama mgeni ana leseni ya TMDA na biashara yake inafanya kazi kama duka la dawa rasmi (pharmacy), hali yake inategemea jinsi GN 487A inavyotafsiriwa kwa sekta ya afya. Mshauri wa kisheria anayeelewa sheria za afya na GN 487A anahitajika kusaidia kuelewa kikamilifu. Ushauri wa kisheria ni muhimu kabla ya kufanya maamuzi.
question_en: Can a foreign doctor own a pharmacy in Tanzania?
answer_en: A pharmacy is regulated by Tanzania health laws — specifically the Tanzania Medicines and Medical Devices Authority (TMDA). GN 487A restricts retail trade broadly, but medicine is a specialised sector requiring TMDA licences. If a non-citizen has a TMDA licence and the business operates as a formal pharmacy, their situation depends on how GN 487A is interpreted for the health sector. A legal adviser who understands both health laws and GN 487A is needed for a full answer. Legal advice is essential before making decisions.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Ardhi ya kilimo (agricultural land) ina kiwango tofauti cha ushuru wa stempu kuliko ardhi ya makazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu Tanzania inaweza kuwa na tofauti za ushuru kulingana na aina ya ardhi au matumizi yake. Kwa ujumla, kiwango cha kawaida cha asilimia 1 kinatumika kwa aina nyingi za ardhi. Msamaha au kupunguzwa kwa ushuru kwa ardhi ya kilimo unaweza kutegemea masharti mahususi ya kisheria. Angalia TRA moja kwa moja kwa aina yako ya ardhi.
question_en: Does agricultural land have a different stamp duty rate than residential land in Tanzania?
answer_en: The Tanzania Stamp Duty Act may have variations based on type of land or its use. Generally, the standard 1% rate applies to most land types. An exemption or reduction for agricultural land may depend on specific legal conditions. Check TRA directly for your type of land.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or land use policy update

instruction: Kama mnunuzi anayehitimu, nikose kukata VAT — ninakabiliwa na nini?
output: Kushindwa kukata VAT kama withholding agent ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya VAT Act. TRA inaweza kukuamrisha kulipa kiasi kilichokosekana pamoja na riba na faini. Lazima uhakikishe mfumo wako wa malipo una withholding procedure sahihi. Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi ili ujue wajibu wako kamili.

Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Wakili mpya aliyeidhinishwa leo — anaweza kuanza kufanya kazi bila kusajili VAT kwanza?
answer_sw: Hapana — wakili aliyeidhinishwa hivi karibuni anapaswa kusajili VAT kama sehemu ya mahitaji ya kuweza kufanya mazoezi ya kisheria Tanzania. Ni vizuri kusajili VAT KABLA au WAKATI wa kuanza mazoezi — si baadaye. Kusimamia wateja bila usajili wa VAT unapoishia linapaswa kulipa inaweza kusababisha adhabu za kodi na matatizo na Tanganyika Law Society.
question_en: A newly admitted advocate today — can they start practising without first registering for VAT?
answer_en: No — a newly admitted advocate should register for VAT as part of the requirements to practise law in Tanzania. It is advisable to register for VAT BEFORE or AT THE TIME of starting practice — not later. Managing clients without VAT registration when you should be registered may result in tax penalties and complications with the Tanganyika Law Society.

instruction: SDL inalipwa na mwajiri, mfanyakazi, au wote wawili?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. SDL inalipwa na MWAJIRI PEKE YAKE — mfanyakazi halipiwi SDL wowote. Tofauti na NSSF (mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10%) — SDL ni ya upande mmoja tu. Mwajiri analipa 3.5% ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi wake wote kwenye TRA.

question_sw: Biashara yangu haijasajiliwa VAT — lakini ninaweka VAT ya 18% kwenye invoice zangu kwa sababu wateja wanauliza. Je, hii inaruhusiwa?
answer_sw: HAPANA — hii ni kinyume kabisa cha sheria. Ni biashara zilizosajiliwa VAT TU ambazo zinaruhusiwa kukusanya VAT na kuitoa kwenye invoice. Biashara isiyosajiliwa VAT inayoweka VAT kwenye invoice inafanya vitendo viwili visivyo halali: (1) inakusanya pesa ambazo si yake kisheria na si zake kwa wateja; (2) inaweza kutoa 'input VAT credit ya uwongo' kwa wateja wanaotaka kudai mkopo. TRA inaweza kushtaki biashara kama hiyo na kutoza adhabu kali.
question_en: My business is not VAT registered — but I put 18% VAT on my invoices because clients ask for it. Is this permitted?
answer_en: NO — this is completely against the law. Only VAT-REGISTERED businesses are permitted to charge VAT and show it on invoices. An unregistered business putting VAT on invoices commits two unlawful acts: (1) it is collecting money it is not legally entitled to from clients; (2) it may be issuing 'false input VAT credits' to clients who want to claim credits. TRA may prosecute such a business and impose severe penalties.

instruction: Biashara yangu inafikia TZS 150M kwa miezi 6 — je, lazima nisajili VAT?
output: Ndiyo — kizingiti cha 6 miezi ni TZS 100M. Kwa biashara yako iliyofikia TZS 150M katika miezi 6, umepita kizingiti cha TZS 100M — lazima usajili VAT HARAKA (mara kizingiti kinapofikiwa). Usisubiri mwisho wa mwaka — usajili unatakiwa ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kufikia kizingiti. Kama ulifikia TZS 100M ndani ya miezi 6 lakini hukusajili — unaweza kukabiliwa na adhabu ya kuchelewa. Pia kumbuka kizingiti kingine: TZS 200M kwa miezi 12 — hata hii ikipitiwa kwa mwaka mzima lazima usajili. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kupeleka malipo ya NSSF ni lini kila mwezi?
output: Malipo ya NSSF inayopelekwa lazima ifikapo mwishoni mwa mwezi unaofuata mwezi wa malipo ya mishahara. Kwa mfano, mishahara ya Januari — NSSF inayopelekwa ifikapo mwishoni mwa Februari. Kwa tarehe halisi ya mwisho ya sasa, thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.or.tz) moja kwa moja kwani tarehe inaweza kubadilika.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: EFD yangu inachapisha risiti lakini haipeleki data TRA. Je, ninajua vipi?
answer_sw: Dalili kwamba EFD haipeleki data TRA ni pamoja na: taa ya 'offline' au 'no connection' kwenye EFD, risiti zinazotolewa bila Fiscal Receipt Number ya mfululizo sahihi, au taarifa za makosa kwenye kiolesura cha EFD. Ukigundua EFD yako haipeleki data: (1) Angalia muunganiko wa intaneti; (2) Wasiliana na muuzaji wa EFD; (3) Taarifa TRA ndani ya masaa 24. Biashara inaweza kuendelea lakini tatizo lazima litatatuliwe haraka.
question_en: My EFD is printing receipts but not transmitting data to TRA. How do I know?
answer_en: Signs that EFD is not transmitting data to TRA include: 'offline' or 'no connection' indicator light on the EFD, receipts issued without correct sequential Fiscal Receipt Numbers, or error messages on the EFD interface. If you discover your EFD is not transmitting: (1) Check the internet connection; (2) Contact the EFD supplier; (3) Notify TRA within 24 hours. Business may continue but the issue must be resolved quickly.

instruction: Mimi si mkazi Tanzania (non-resident) — nikiuza mali yangu Tanzania, capital gains tax inanishughulikia vipi?
output: Faida inayotokana na uuzaji wa mali kama ardhi, hisa, au majengo inaweza kuwa taxable chini ya Income Tax Act Tanzania. Hesabu halisi inategemea thamani ya ununuzi (cost base), thamani ya uuzaji, na hali yako kama mkazi au asiye mkazi. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Hali ya capital gains tax kwa wasio wakazi (non-residents) inashughulikiwa tofauti chini ya Income Tax Act na mikataba ya kuzuia kodi mara mbili (DTAs) — inahitaji utaalamu maalum wa kodi ya kimataifa. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kampuni inayoanza mnamo Julai inaanza PAYE kuanzia Januari ya mwaka unaofuata — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. PAYE inaanza mara moja tu mfanyakazi anaanza kulipwa mshahara unaopita kiwango cha msamaha cha Shilingi 270,000 kwa mwezi. Hakuna kipindi cha kusubiri hadi Januari — wajibu wa PAYE unaanza mwezi wa kwanza wa malipo. Kampuni mpya inapaswa kuomba TIN na kusajili PAYE mara inapoanza kulipa mishahara.
question_en: A company starting in July begins PAYE only from January of the following year — is this true?
answer_en: No. PAYE begins immediately once an employee is paid a salary exceeding the TZS 270,000 per month exemption. There is no waiting until January — PAYE obligation starts in the first month of payment. A new company should obtain a TIN and register for PAYE as soon as it begins paying salaries.

question_sw: Ninauza mchanga na mawe kwa ajili ya ujenzi — kuna kodi maalum ya rasilimali za ardhi?
answer_sw: Kodi na tozo zinazohusiana na uchimbaji na uuzaji wa rasilimali za ardhi (mchanga, mawe, kokoto) ni eneo la kisheria la madini na mazingira — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Shughuli hizi zinasimamiwa na Wizara ya Madini, NEMC (National Environment Management Council), na serikali za mitaa ambazo zinaweza kutoza ada na ushuru maalum. Wasiliana na mamlaka hizi moja kwa moja.
question_en: I sell sand and stones for construction — is there a special natural resources tax?
answer_en: Taxes and levies related to extraction and sale of natural resources (sand, stones, gravel) are a legal area of mining and environment law — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. These activities are regulated by the Ministry of Minerals, NEMC (National Environment Management Council), and local governments which may charge special fees and levies. Contact these authorities directly.
next_review_trigger: Mining or natural resources regulation changes

question_sw: Land rent (kodi ya ardhi) kwa ekari moja Tanzania — ni TZS ngapi kwa mwaka?
answer_sw: Land rent (tozo za ardhi) zinatofautiana sana kulingana na: eneo la ardhi (Dar es Salaam vs mikoani), mji au kijiji, na matumizi ya ardhi (biashara, kilimo, makazi). Sina uhakika wa viwango vya sasa. Thibitisha na Halmashauri yako ya Wilaya au Wizara ya Ardhi.
question_en: Land rent for one acre in Tanzania — how much per year in TZS?
answer_en: Land rent varies significantly depending on: location (Dar es Salaam vs upcountry), urban or village classification, and land use type (commercial, agricultural, residential). I am not certain of current rates. Verify with your District Council or the Ministry of Lands.

question_sw: Amri ya kuzuia (prohibition notice) kutoka OSHA inatofautiana vipi na notisi ya uboreshaji?
answer_sw: Notisi ya uboreshaji inakupa muda wa kurekebisha tatizo. Amri ya kuzuia, kinyume chake, inahitaji kazi kusimamishwa MARA MOJA kwa sababu kuna hatari ya haraka ya kifo au majeraha makubwa. Mwajiri hawezi kuendelea na shughuli mpaka hatari isimamishwe.
question_en: How does a prohibition notice from OSHA differ from an improvement notice?
answer_en: An improvement notice gives you time to fix a problem. A prohibition notice, by contrast, requires work to stop IMMEDIATELY because there is an imminent risk of death or serious injury. The employer cannot resume operations until the danger is eliminated.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Raia wa EAC — Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi — wana msamaha kutoka GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A haitoi msamaha kwa raia wa nchi za EAC. Licha ya Itifaki ya Soko la Pamoja la EAC, amri hii inatumika kwa raia wote wa kigeni, ikiwa ni pamoja na raia wa Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, na Sudan Kusini. Wote wanashughulikiwa kama raia wa kigeni chini ya GN 487A.
question_en: Are EAC citizens — Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi — exempt from GN 487A?
answer_en: No. GN 487A does not exempt EAC citizens. Despite the EAC Common Market Protocol, this order applies to all non-citizens, including citizens of Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, and South Sudan. They are all treated as non-citizens under GN 487A.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: Wakurugenzi wa kampuni wanaweza kushikiliwa watu binafsi kwa madeni ya kampuni?
output: Inategemea muundo wa kampuni: KAMPUNI YA HISA (limited company): wakurugenzi kwa kawaida hawashikiwi kibinafsi kwa madeni ya kampuni — kampuni ni chombo cha kisheria tofauti (separate legal entity). Hata hivyo, wakurugenzi wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi kama: (1) walifanya vitendo vya ulaghai; (2) waliendeshea kampuni wakijua itashindwa; (3) walitoa dhamana ya kibinafsi. MFANYABIASHARA MMOJA (sole trader): mmiliki anashikiliwa kibinafsi kwa madeni yote — hakuna tofauti kati ya mali ya biashara na mali ya kibinafsi. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Niambie jinsi ya kulipa kodi nchini Uingereza (UK).
answer_sw: Sijui mfumo wa kodi wa Uingereza — ninasaidia na maswali ya kodi ya biashara ya Tanzania Bara peke yake. Kwa maswali ya kodi ya UK, wasiliana na HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) kwa gov.uk/government/organisations/hm-revenue-customs. Je, kuna swali la kodi ya Tanzania naweza kukusaidia?
question_en: Tell me how to pay taxes in the United Kingdom.
answer_en: I do not cover the UK tax system — I assist with Mainland Tanzania business tax questions only. For UK tax questions, contact HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) at gov.uk/government/organisations/hm-revenue-customs. Is there a Tanzania tax question I can help with?

instruction: Mfanyakazi wa kujitegemea (self-employed/freelancer) — anaweza kusajili NSSF?
output: Ndiyo — watu wanaofanya kazi ya kujitegemea (self-employed) wanaweza kusajili NSSF kwa hiari (voluntary membership). Kwa wanachama wa hiari: Jumla ya michango = 20% ya mapato wanayochagua kama msingi (au kiwango cha chini kilichobainishwa na NSSF); Mwanachama wa hiari analipa 20% mzima mwenyewe — hakuna mwajiri wa kuchangia 10%. Faida: pensheni wakati wa uzeeni, mafao ya ulemavu, na mafao ya familia. Hata mwanamuziki, mkulima binafsi, au mwenye biashara ndogo anaweza kusajili NSSF kwa hiari. Thibitisha na nssf.or.tz kwa utaratibu wa usajili.

question_sw: Mwajiri mwenye matawi mengi atalipa NSSF ofisi ipi?
answer_sw: Michango ya waajiri wenye ofisi zaidi ya mkoa mmoja inalipwa kwenye Ofisi ya NSSF ambayo mchango ulipelekwa. Ofisi za kikanda zinahitajika kushirikiana ili kuhakikisha uzingatiaji wa mwajiri mwenye matawi tofauti. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: Which NSSF office does a multi-branch employer pay contributions to?
answer_en: Contributions for employers with offices in more than one region are accounted for at the NSSF office where the contribution was remitted. Regional offices must cooperate to ensure compliance of employers with different branches. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: WCF inalipia majeraha ya nje ya mahali pa kazi — kama mfanyakazi alianguka akitoka kazini — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kwa ujumla. WCF inashughulikia majeraha YANAYOTOKANA NA KAZI peke yake — yaani yanayotokea wakati wa kufanya kazi au katika safari ya kazi inayoidhinishwa. Mfanyakazi aliyeumia nyumbani au wakati wa safari ya kibinafsi hakiwa na haki ya madai ya WCF.
question_en: WCF covers injuries outside the workplace — like a worker who fell on the way home — is this true?
answer_en: Not as a general rule. WCF covers WORK-RELATED injuries only — those occurring during the performance of work or on an authorised work journey. An employee injured at home or during a personal trip is not entitled to a WCF claim.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: SDL ya mwezi huu — inawasilishwa tarehe 20 au tarehe 7 ya mwezi ujao?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Tarehe sahihi: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata — si tarehe 20. Tarehe 20 ni kwa VAT return — usifanye makosa kati ya SDL na VAT deadlines. SDL: tarehe 7 | VAT return: tarehe 20 | PAYE: tarehe 7.

instruction: Mgeni ana duka la kuuza simu MPYA (si ukarabati) — je, GN 487A inasema nini?
output: Simu mpya zinauzwa katika duka la rejareja — na biashara ya rejareja ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A (tarehe 28 Julai 2025). Tofauti muhimu: ukarabati wa simu ni shughuli 4 katika orodha (pia imekatazwa), lakini duka la kuuza simu mpya linalohusika zaidi ni shughuli 1 (biashara ya rejareja). Kwa njia yoyote, duka la simu (mpya au ukarabati) linalomilikiwa na mgeni linakiuka GN 487A. Adhabu: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: EFD inahusiana na mfumo wa TIMS (Tanzania Integrated Management System) wa TRA vipi?
answer_sw: TIMS (Tanzania Integrated Management System) ni mfumo mkuu wa usimamizi wa kodi wa TRA unaounganisha taarifa nyingi za kodi. EFD inaunganishwa na TIMS kwa kupeleka data ya mauzo moja kwa moja. Hii inaruhusu TRA kulinganisha data ya EFD na: tamko la VAT lililowasilishwa, PAYE, na kodi nyingine, katika mfumo mmoja wa ufuatiliaji wa uzingatiaji. Makampuni yenye EFD yanaonekana zaidi kwenye mfumo wa TRA kuliko biashara zisizo na EFD.
question_en: How does an EFD relate to TRA's TIMS (Tanzania Integrated Management System)?
answer_en: TIMS (Tanzania Integrated Management System) is TRA's central tax management system that integrates multiple tax data sources. An EFD connects to TIMS by transmitting sales data directly. This allows TRA to cross-reference EFD data against: filed VAT returns, PAYE, and other taxes, within one compliance tracking system. Companies with EFDs are more visible in TRA's system than businesses without EFDs.
next_review_trigger: TRA TIMS or EFD integration update

question_sw: Annual return ya BRELA inawasilishwa kila mwaka hata kama kampuni haifanyi biashara?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Annual return ya BRELA inawasilishwa KILA MWAKA bila kujali kama kampuni inafanya biashara au la — hata kama iko dormant. Kampuni dormant inaweza kutangaza hali yake lakini bado ina wajibu wa kuwasilisha annual return. Kutofanya hivyo kunasababisha faini na hatimaye kufutwa.
question_en: Is the BRELA annual return filed every year even if the company is not trading?
answer_en: Yes. The BRELA annual return is filed EVERY YEAR regardless of whether the company is trading or not — even if dormant. A dormant company can declare its status but still has an obligation to file an annual return. Failure to do so results in penalties and eventual strike off.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayeacha kazi kabla ya miaka 15 ya michango anapoteza NSSF yake yote Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mfanyakazi anayeacha kazi kabla ya miaka 15 (miezi 180) ya michango HAPOTEZI michango yake yote. Anaweza: (1) kuomba faida ya kujitolea/kujisogeza (withdrawal benefit) kwa michango aliyochangia, au (2) kuendelea kuwa mwanachama na kuchangia kwa mwajiri mwingine hadi afikia miezi 180. Manufaa atakayopata yanategemea michango halisi aliyochangia — si sifuri.
question_en: A worker who leaves employment before 15 years of contributions loses all their NSSF in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. A worker who leaves employment before 15 years (180 months) of contributions does NOT lose all their contributions. They can: (1) apply for a withdrawal benefit for contributions paid, or (2) remain a member and contribute with a new employer until reaching 180 months. The benefits they receive depend on actual contributions paid — not zero.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni aliyekasirika na sheria ya PAYE — wapi anaweza kupata msaada?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni mwenye malalamiko ya PAYE anaweza: (1) Wasiliana na idara ya HR/uhasibu ya mwajiri wake kwanza; (2) Wasiliana na TRA moja kwa moja kuuliza maswali au kuripoti tatizo; (3) Piga rufaa kwa Kamishna wa TRA kama tatizo halijatatuliwa; (4) Tafuta msaada wa TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) kwa malalamiko rasmi; (5) Tafuta ushauri wa mwanasheria au mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: A foreign employee confused about PAYE law — where can they get help?
answer_en: A foreign employee with PAYE concerns can: (1) Contact their employer's HR/accounting department first; (2) Contact TRA directly to ask questions or report a problem; (3) Appeal to the TRA Commissioner if the issue is unresolved; (4) Seek TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) for formal complaints; (5) Seek advice from a lawyer or tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: TRAB inaweza kuamua dhidi ya TRA na kumpa mlipaji kodi ushindi kamili — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRAB ni bodi huru ambayo inaweza kuamua dhidi ya TRA na kutoa ushindi kamili au sehemu ya ushindi kwa mlipaji kodi. Ikiwa TRAB ikitoa ushindi kamili, TRA inaweza kurudisha kiasi kilicholipwa na kufuta tathmini. TRAB ni njia muhimu ya kupata haki kwa mlipaji kodi.
question_en: Can TRAB decide against TRA and give the taxpayer a complete win — is this true?
