answer_en: Yes. TRAB is an independent board that can decide against TRA and award a complete or partial win to the taxpayer. If TRAB grants a complete win, TRA must refund amounts paid and cancel the assessment. TRAB is an important avenue for taxpayer justice.

question_sw: Msanifu majengo (architect) mpya — anaweza kusubiri hadi mauzo yake yafike TZS 200M kwanza?
answer_sw: Hapana — msanifu majengo aliyesajiliwa (registered architect) hawezi kusubiri kizingiti cha TZS 200M. Kama daktari, wakili, na mhandisi, msanifu majengo lazima asajili VAT kama sehemu ya mahitaji ya kupata na kudumisha leseni yake ya kitaalamu. Kutosajili VAT wakati ukiendesha biashara ya kitaalamu kama msanifu majengo aliyeidhinishwa ni ukiukaji wa sheria ya kodi.
question_en: A new architect — can they wait until their fees reach TZS 200M first?
answer_en: No — a registered architect cannot wait for the TZS 200M threshold. Like doctors, lawyers, and engineers, an architect must register for VAT as part of the requirements to obtain and maintain their professional licence. Failing to register for VAT while operating as a licensed professional architect is a violation of tax law.

instruction: Mabadiliko ya SDL yanayotokana na GN 605A — yalianza kulipwa kutoka Septemba 2025?
output: Hapana — mabadiliko ya SDL yanayotokana na GN 605A yalianza kutumika tarehe 1 JANUARI 2026, si Septemba 2025. Septemba 2025 ni tarehe ya jambo tofauti — mabadiliko ya VAT ya B2C chini ya Finance Act 2025, si GN 605A. GN 605A ilianza 1 Januari 2026, hivyo SDL inayohusiana na ongezeko la mishahara ya GN 605A pia inaanza kutoka malipo ya Januari 2026 — yaani SDL ya Januari inalipwa ifikapo 7 Februari 2026. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Nimeambiwa EFD ni kwa wafanyabiashara wa TZS 40M au zaidi — sahihi?
output: Hapana, si sahihi. EFD inahitajika kulingana na kizingiti cha mauzo kilichowekwa na TRA — thibitisha kizingiti cha sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz). VAT registered businesses ZOTE lazima zitumie EFD bila kujali kiasi cha mauzo. Kizingiti sahihi ni TZS milioni 11 — si 40M. Thibitisha kila wakati na TRA (tra.go.tz) au ofisi ya TRA karibu nawe.

question_sw: Mwajiriwa anayefanya kazi sehemu ya wakati (part-time) Tanzania hajalazimishwa na NSSF — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Sheria ya NSSF Tanzania kwa ujumla inasema wafanyakazi wanaolipwa mishahara ya mara kwa mara lazima wasajiliwe NSSF — ikiwa ni pamoja na wafanyakazi wa sehemu ya wakati. NSSF inaweza kuhusika kwa mfanyakazi wa sehemu ya wakati anayelipwa mshahara unaostahili michango. Angalia NSSF moja kwa moja kwa mwongozo mahususi wa wafanyakazi wa sehemu ya wakati.
question_en: A part-time employee in Tanzania is not covered by NSSF — is this correct?
answer_en: The Tanzania NSSF Act generally requires all workers receiving regular wages to be registered with NSSF — including part-time workers. NSSF may cover a part-time worker receiving wages that qualify for contributions. Check with NSSF directly for specific guidance on part-time worker coverage.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

instruction: Faida ya kusajili VAT kwa hiari (voluntary registration) kabla ya kizingiti ni nini?
output: Faida za usajili wa hiari wa VAT: (1) Unaweza kudai input VAT (VAT uliyo nayo kwenye manunuzi ya biashara). (2) Wateja wako wakubwa (kampuni, serikali) wanaweza kuhitaji invoice ya VAT. (3) Unaweka heshima ya biashara mbele ya wateja wa kitaasisi. Hasara: lazima utoe risiti za VAT, uwasilishe VAT return kila mwezi, na utumie EFD. Pima manufaa dhidi ya mzigo wa uzingatifu (compliance burden).

instruction: Nikiwasilisha VAT return — ninajaza fomu kwa viwango gani?
output: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Kwenye VAT return (Fomu ya TRA): Standard rated sales: 18% Zero-rated sales (exports na zingine): 0% B2C digital services (tangu Sep 2025): 16% Exempt supplies: zinaonyeshwa tofauti bila kodi. Hakuna nafasi ya 5% kwenye fomu sahihi ya TRA.

question_sw: Shirika la madini linanipa mrabaha (royalty) — kiwango cha kodi ya mrabaha ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kodi ya mrabaha wa madini (mining royalties) ni eneo maalum la uchumi wa madini Tanzania — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Viwango vya mrabaha vya madini vinasimamiwa na Sheria ya Madini na vinatofautiana kulingana na aina ya madini (dhahabu, almasi, makaa ya mawe, nk). Muona mhesabu wa kodi aliyebobea katika sekta ya madini au Wizara ya Madini Tanzania moja kwa moja.
question_en: A mining company is giving me royalties — what is the royalty tax rate?
answer_en: Mining royalty tax is a specialised area of Tanzania's mining economy — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Mining royalty rates are governed by the Mining Act and vary depending on the type of mineral (gold, diamonds, coal, etc.). Consult a tax accountant specialised in the mining sector or the Tanzania Ministry of Minerals directly.
next_review_trigger: Mining Act or Finance Act amendment on royalty rates

question_sw: NGO yetu ina wafanyakazi 15. Je, tunasamehewa SDL?
answer_sw: Mashirika yasiyo ya faida (NGO) yanaweza kuwa na msamaha wa SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — kulingana na hali ya usajili na shughuli zao. Msamaha si wa moja kwa moja — NGO lazima iombe na kupata uthibitisho kutoka TRA. Thibitisha hali ya msamaha wako wa SDL kwa maandishi na TRA. Hadi utakapopata uthibitisho rasmi, lipa SDL ili kuepuka adhabu.
question_en: Our NGO has 15 employees. Are we exempt from SDL?
answer_en: Non-governmental organizations (NGOs) may be exempt from SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — depending on their registration status and activities. Exemption is not automatic — the NGO must apply for and obtain written confirmation from TRA. Confirm your SDL exemption status in writing with TRA. Until you receive official confirmation, continue paying SDL to avoid penalties.

instruction: Chips za kompyuta na semiconductors zinaingizwa Tanzania — je, zina ushuru wa forodha?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ushuru wa bidhaa za teknolojia na semiconductors (technology import duty) unategemea msimbo wa HS Code na taratibu za EAC/COMESA — mada hii iko nje ya wigo wangu wa biashara ya ndani. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na sheria za biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na TRA Forodha na Ushuru kupitia tra.go.tz kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kusajili PAYE TRA lini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kusajili PAYE kabla ya kuanza kulipa mshahara wa kwanza wa mfanyakazi. Usajili unafanywa kupitia mfumo wa IDRAS kwenye tovuti ya TRA. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: When must an employer register for PAYE with TRA?
answer_en: An employer must register for PAYE before paying the first employee's salary. Registration is done through the IDRAS system on the TRA website. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, raia wa kigeni mwenye ndoa na Mtanzania ana msamaha kutoka GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ndoa na raia wa Tanzania haimpi mwenzi mgeni uraia wa Tanzania wala msamaha kutoka GN 487A. Uraia unapatikana kupitia mchakato rasmi wa uraia — si ndoa peke yake. Hadi hapo, mwenzi mgeni bado anazingatiwa kama raia wa kigeni chini ya amri hii.
question_en: Does a non-citizen married to a Tanzanian get an exemption from GN 487A?
answer_en: No. Marriage to a Tanzanian citizen does not confer Tanzanian citizenship or an exemption from GN 487A. Citizenship is obtained through a formal naturalization process — not marriage alone. Until then, the foreign spouse is still treated as a non-citizen under this order.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: Kampuni yangu haijafanya annual return kwa miaka 3 — inaweza kufutwa BRELA?
output: Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Miaka 3 ya kukosa annual return ni hali hatari sana. Kwa miaka 2 na zaidi, BRELA ina mamlaka ya kufuta kampuni kwenye orodha (deregister). Hatua ya haraka: wasiliana na BRELA moja kwa moja kubadilisha hali ya kampuni yako kabla ya kufutwa.

question_sw: EFD machine inanunuliwa wapi Tanzania — mwajiri ananunua wenyewe au TRA inatoa?
answer_sw: MWAJIRI (biashara) ndiye anayenunua EFD — TRA haitoi mashine bure. Mashine lazima inunuliwe kutoka kwa wasambazaji wa EFD walioidhinishwa na TRA. Wasambazaji walioidhinishwa wanajulikana kwenye tovuti ya TRA. Kununua EFD kutoka chanzo kisichoidhinishwa ni kosa — mashine lazima iwe kwenye mfumo wa TRA na iwe imesajiliwa ipasavyo kabla ya kuanza kutumia.
question_en: Where is an EFD machine purchased in Tanzania — does the employer buy it or does TRA provide it?
answer_en: The EMPLOYER (business) buys the EFD — TRA does not provide machines for free. The machine must be purchased from TRA-approved EFD suppliers. Approved suppliers are listed on the TRA website. Buying an EFD from an unapproved source is an offence — the machine must be on the TRA system and properly registered before starting to use it.

instruction: Kampuni yangu itaomba leseni ya EPZ Tanzania — pumziko la kodi (tax holiday) linachukua muda gani?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara kwa biashara za kawaida. Masharti ya pumziko la kodi (tax holiday) na mwelekeo wa kampuni za EPZ inashughulikiwa na EPZA (Export Processing Zones Authority) na inahitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au EPZA kupitia epza.go.tz. Wasiliana pia na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Sheria ya Tanzania inasema nini kuhusu ushuru wa kupindukia (excise duty) kwa vinywaji baridi?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa kupindukia (excise duty) kwa vinywaji na bidhaa nyingine maalum ni eneo la sheria ya Excise Duty na Finance Act ambalo linaenda zaidi ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Viwango vya excise duty hasa kwa vinywaji baridi, pombe, sigara, nk vinaweza kubadilika kila mwaka na Finance Act. Wasiliana na TRA — Idara ya Kodi za Ndani au angalia Finance Act ya hivi karibuni.
question_en: What does Tanzanian law say about excise duty on soft drinks?
answer_en: Excise duty on beverages and other specific goods is an area of Excise Duty law and the Finance Act that goes beyond my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Excise duty rates specifically for soft drinks, alcohol, cigarettes, etc. may change annually with the Finance Act. Contact TRA — Domestic Revenue Department or check the latest Finance Act.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment on excise duty rates

question_sw: Biashara ya mgeni ilianza kabla ya GN 487A — je, ina muda wa kukaa hadi itakapokamilika?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A haikutoa muda wowote wa kustaafu (grace period) kwa biashara zilizokuwepo kabla ya amri kuanza mwaka 2025. Amri ilianza kutumika mara moja tarehe 28 Julai 2025 bila kipindi cha mpito. Biashara yoyote ya mgeni katika makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa ilipaswa kusimama au kuhamishiwa umiliki kwa Mtanzania mara amri iliposajiliwa. Kuendelea kufanya biashara hiyo baada ya tarehe hiyo ni kuvunja sheria moja kwa moja. Mgeni aliyekuwa na biashara kama hiyo anapaswa kuona wakili haraka.
question_en: A non-citizen's business started before GN 487A — does it have a grace period to wind down?
answer_en: No. GN 487A did not provide any grace period (wind-down period) for businesses that existed before the Order came into force in 2025. The Order took effect immediately on 28 July 2025 without any transition period. Any non-citizen business in the 15 prohibited categories was required to stop or transfer ownership to a Tanzanian immediately when the Order was gazetted. Continuing such a business after that date is a direct violation. A non-citizen who had such a business should see a lawyer urgently.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Z-report ya EFD inapigwa wakati gani — mwisho wa siku au asubuhi ya kesho?
output: Z-report lazima ipigwe MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Z-report inafunga muhtasari wa mauzo ya siku hiyo yote na kuutuma kwa TRA kupitia TIMS (mfumo wa mtandao). Ukiipiga asubuhi ya kesho: muhtasari wa siku moja utakosekana kwenye rekodi za TRA.

question_sw: Je, bonasi na motisha zinapaswa kulipwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Bonasi, motisha (incentives), na malipo ya kipekee yote yanajumuishwa katika mapato yanayostahili PAYE. Yanalipwa mwezi yanayotolewa na PAYE inacheswa kwa msingi wa mwezi huo. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Are bonuses and incentives subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Bonuses, incentives, and one-off payments are all included in PAYE-liable income. They are taxed in the month paid, with PAYE calculated on the total income for that month. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mgeni mwenye TIC certificate (cheti cha uwekezaji kutoka TIC) ana ulinzi dhidi ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Si kwa ujumla. TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) certificate inaruhusu uwekezaji wa kigeni katika sekta maalum za uwekezaji mkubwa — kama uzalishaji wa viwanda, madini, kilimo cha biashara kubwa. Hata hivyo, TIC certificate haizuii matumizi ya GN 487A kwa sekta zilizozuiliwa kama biashara ya rejareja, saluni, au ukarabati wa simu. Mwekezaji wa kigeni mwenye TIC certificate bado hawezi kufanya biashara katika makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa. TIC na GN 487A ni mifumo tofauti — mshauri wa kisheria anaweza kusaidia kuelewa jinsi inavyoathiri uwekezaji wako mahususi.
question_en: A non-citizen with a TIC certificate (investment certificate from Tanzania Investment Centre) — are they protected from GN 487A?
answer_en: Not generally. A TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) certificate permits foreign investment in specific large-scale investment sectors — such as industrial manufacturing, mining, large-scale commercial agriculture. However, a TIC certificate does not override GN 487A for the prohibited sectors such as retail trade, salons, or phone repair. A foreign investor with a TIC certificate still cannot operate businesses in the 15 prohibited categories. TIC and GN 487A are separate frameworks — a legal adviser can help understand how it affects your specific investment.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: WCF inafidia tu ajali za mahali pa kazi — si magonjwa yanayotokana na kazi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) Tanzania inashughulikia ZOTE MBILI: (1) ajali za mahali pa kazi (workplace accidents) — majeraha ya haraka kama kuanguka, kuumwa na mashine, na (2) magonjwa yanayotokana na kazi (occupational diseases) — magonjwa yanayoendelea kwa muda mrefu kutokana na mazingira ya kazi kama ugonjwa wa mapafu kwa uchimbaji madini, upotezaji wa kusikia kwa kelele. Mwajiri anaweza kulipwa fidia kwa aina zote mbili.
question_en: WCF only covers workplace accidents — not work-related diseases — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Tanzania's WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) covers BOTH: (1) workplace accidents — immediate injuries like falls, machine injuries, and (2) occupational diseases — long-term illnesses arising from work environment such as lung disease from mining, hearing loss from noise. A worker can claim compensation for both types.

question_sw: Je, TRA inaweza kutekeleza GN 487A wakati wa ukaguzi wa kodi?
answer_sw: TRA inashughulikia masuala ya kodi — si utekelezaji wa amri za leseni za biashara kama GN 487A. Utekelezaji wa GN 487A ni kazi ya Idara ya Uhamiaji. Wakati wa ukaguzi wa kodi, TRA inaweza RIPOTI tuhuma kwa Uhamiaji, lakini hana mamlaka ya kutekeleza GN 487A wenyewe.
question_en: Can TRA enforce GN 487A during a tax audit?
answer_en: TRA handles tax matters — not enforcement of business licensing orders like GN 487A. GN 487A enforcement is the responsibility of the Immigration Services Department. During a tax audit, TRA may REFER suspicions to Immigration, but TRA does not have authority to enforce GN 487A independently.
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: SSRA ni nini na inahusiana vipi na NSSF?
answer_sw: SSRA (Social Security Regulatory Authority) ni msimamizi wa mifuko yote ya hifadhi ya jamii Tanzania — ikiwemo NSSF, PPF, GEPF, na LAPF. SSRA inaweka viwango vya utawala, haki za washiriki, na miongozo ya uwekezaji kwa mifuko yote. NSSF yenyewe ni mfuko mkubwa zaidi wa hifadhi ya jamii Tanzania, unaoshughulikia sekta kubwa ya binafsi. Kiwango cha mchango wa NSSF: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla.
question_en: What is SSRA and how does it relate to NSSF?
answer_en: SSRA (Social Security Regulatory Authority) is the regulator of all social security funds in Tanzania — including NSSF, PPF, GEPF, and LAPF. SSRA sets governance standards, member rights, and investment guidelines for all funds. NSSF itself is Tanzania's largest social security fund, covering most of the private sector. NSSF contribution rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu kwenye uhamishaji wa ardhi au majengo Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa stempu kwenye uhamishaji wa ardhi au majengo Tanzania ni asilimia 1 BAPA (flat rate) ya thamani ya malipo au thamani ya soko — whichever is higher. Hakuna kiwango cha ngazi (tiered) kama 0.5% kwa sehemu ya kwanza. Asilimia 1 inatumika kwenye thamani yote ya uhamishaji.
question_en: What is the stamp duty rate on transfer of land or buildings in Tanzania?
answer_en: Stamp duty on transfer of land or buildings in Tanzania is a FLAT 1% of the consideration or market value — whichever is higher. There is no tiered structure such as 0.5% on the first portion. The 1% applies on the full transfer value.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or Stamp Duty Act amendment

question_sw: Sekta ya umma inalipwa mshahara gani Tanzania tangu Julai 2025?
answer_sw: Wafanyakazi wa serikali (sekta ya umma) Tanzania Bara wanalipwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 500,000 kwa mwezi, kuanzia Julai 2025, kufuatia tangazo la Rais Samia. GN 605A inashughulikia sekta ya faragha peke yake. Thibitisha na Hazina.
question_en: What is the public sector minimum wage in Tanzania since July 2025?
answer_en: Government employees (public sector) in Tanzania Mainland receive a minimum wage of TZS 500,000 per month from July 2025, following President Samia's announcement. GN 605A covers the private sector only. Confirm with the Treasury.

question_sw: Mshahara wa mfanyakazi mgeni unaopatikana nje ya Tanzania — PAYE Tanzania inatumika?
answer_sw: Inategemea hali ya usajili wa kazi. Ikiwa mfanyakazi anafanya kazi Tanzania kwa ajili ya mwajiri wa Tanzania na mshahara unalipwa nje ya nchi, TRA inaweza bado kuhitaji PAYE Tanzania. 'Shadow payroll' ni mfumo unaotumika katika hali kama hizi — mwajiri anahifadhi rekodi za PAYE Tanzania hata kama mshahara unalipwa nje. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: A foreign employee's salary paid outside Tanzania — does Tanzania PAYE apply?
answer_en: It depends on the employment arrangement. If the employee works in Tanzania for a Tanzanian employer and salary is paid outside the country, TRA may still require Tanzania PAYE. 'Shadow payroll' is a system used in such cases — the employer maintains Tanzania PAYE records even though salary is paid abroad. Verify with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Je, EFD lazima iwe na muunganiko wa intaneti daima?
answer_sw: EFD ya kisasa inahitaji muunganiko wa intaneti ili kupeleka taarifa kwa seva ya TRA. Ikiwa intaneti itakatika, EFD inaweza kuhifadhi taarifa za muamala (offline mode) na kuzipeleka seva ya TRA muunganiko unapofufuka. Biashara haistahili kusimamisha mauzo kwa sababu ya kukatika kwa intaneti — EFD inaendelea kutoa risiti — lakini taarifa zinapelekwa mara muunganiko utakapofufuka. Kumbuka kurejesha muunganiko haraka iwezekanavyo.
question_en: Must an EFD always be connected to the internet?
answer_en: Modern EFDs require an internet connection to transmit data to TRA's server. If internet is disconnected, the EFD can store transaction data (offline mode) and transmit to TRA's server when reconnected. Business should not stop sales due to internet outage — the EFD continues issuing receipts — but data must be transmitted as soon as the connection is restored. Restore connectivity as quickly as possible.

question_sw: Je, risiti ya EFD ni lazima itolewe kwa kila mauzo — hata TZS 1,000?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kwa biashara iliyosajiliwa kwa VAT na EFD, kila muamala wa mauzo unastahili risiti ya EFD — bila kujali kiasi. Hata mauzo ya TZS 1,000 yanahitaji risiti ya EFD. Kutotoa risiti ni ukiukaji wa sheria ya VAT na EFD. TRA inaweza kufanya ukaguzi na kusimamisha EFD au kutoza adhabu kwa kutokutoa risiti.
question_en: Must an EFD receipt be issued for every sale — even TZS 1,000?
answer_en: Yes. For a VAT-registered business with EFD, every sales transaction requires an EFD receipt — regardless of amount. Even a TZS 1,000 sale requires an EFD receipt. Failure to issue a receipt is a violation of VAT and EFD regulations. TRA may conduct inspections and suspend EFD or impose penalties for non-issuance.

question_sw: Je, bima ya gari inalipwa ushuru gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Maswali ya kodi na ushuru kwa sekta ya bima (insurance) ni nje ya upeo wangu wa sasa. Ninashughulikia kodi kuu za biashara za Tanzania Bara: VAT (18%), PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD. Kwa maswali ya bima na ushuru wake, wasiliana na TIRA (Tanzania Insurance Regulatory Authority) au TRA. Je, una swali la kodi ya VAT au PAYE ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: What tax applies to motor vehicle insurance in Tanzania?
answer_en: Questions about taxes on the insurance sector are outside my current scope. I cover main Tanzania Mainland business taxes: VAT (18%), PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD. For insurance and its tax treatment, contact TIRA (Tanzania Insurance Regulatory Authority) or TRA. Do you have a VAT or PAYE question I can help with?

question_sw: WCF inalipa gharama za matibabu zote bila kikomo — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kabisa. WCF inalipia gharama za matibabu zinazohusiana na jeraha la kazi, lakini kuna mipaka na masharti kulingana na sheria na miongozo ya WCF. Gharama zinazohusiana moja kwa moja na jeraha la kazi zinafunikwa; gharama za hali za awali za kiafya au matibabu yasiyohusiana hazifunikwi.
question_en: WCF pays all medical costs without limit — is this true?
answer_en: Not entirely. WCF pays medical costs related to the work injury, but there are limits and conditions under the law and WCF guidelines. Costs directly related to the work injury are covered; costs for pre-existing conditions or unrelated treatment are not.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Mke na mume wanaofanya biashara pamoja — ni bora kuwa partnership au kampuni?
output: Kwa mke na mume wanaofanya biashara pamoja, chaguzi kuu: UBIA (partnership) kati ya wao: rahisi kuanzisha, lakini kila mwenzi anashikiliwa kibinafsi kwa madeni yote. Tatizo: madeni ya biashara yanaweza kuathiri mali zote za familia. KAMPUNI YA HISA (wakiwa wanahisa wawili): inatoa ulinzi wa mali za kibinafsi (limited liability), kampuni inabaki hata mmoja akifariki, rahisi zaidi kuomba mkopo wa biashara kwa benki. BRELA usajili wa kampuni: min TZS 95,000, annual returns TZS 22,000/mwaka. Familia nyingi wanachagua kampuni kwa ulinzi na ukuaji wa muda mrefu. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Kampuni ndogo yenye mauzo ya TZS 100M kwa mwaka inalipa kodi ya mapato ya kawaida ya asilimia 30 — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Si lazima. Kampuni ndogo yenye mauzo chini ya kizingiti fulani inaweza kulipa kodi ya mapato ya chini (minimum turnover tax) badala ya kodi ya kawaida ya asilimia 30, ikiwa kodi ya asilimia 30 kwenye faida ingewa ndogo zaidi kuliko kodi ya chini ya mauzo. Kodi ya chini ya mauzo ni asilimia 1 ya mauzo ya jumla (wef 1 Julai 2025). Kampuni inalipa KIWANGO KIKUBWA ZAIDI kati ya kodi ya mapato ya kawaida na kodi ya chini.
question_en: A small company with TZS 100M annual turnover pays the standard 30% income tax — is this correct?
answer_en: Not necessarily. A small company below a certain threshold may pay minimum turnover tax instead of standard 30% if the 30% on profit would be less than the minimum tax. Minimum turnover tax is 1% of gross turnover (effective 1 July 2025). A company pays the HIGHER of: standard income tax OR minimum turnover tax.

question_sw: Je, Tanzania ina kodi ya urithi (inheritance tax)?
answer_sw: Kodi ya urithi (inheritance tax) ni suala maalum la kisheria na kodi linalozidi upeo wangu wa sasa. Ninashughulikia kodi za kawaida za biashara: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD. Kwa maswali ya kodi ya urithi au kodi za mali zilizopitishwa, wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyesajiliwa au TRA moja kwa moja. Hili linahitaji ushauri wa kitaalamu.
question_en: Does Tanzania have an inheritance tax?
answer_en: Inheritance tax is a specialised legal and tax matter beyond my current scope. I handle routine business taxes: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD. For inheritance tax or estate transfer tax questions, contact a registered tax consultant or TRA directly. This requires professional advice.

question_sw: Hisa za kampuni ya binafsi za Tanzania zinaweza kuuzwa vipi?
answer_sw: Hisa za kampuni ya binafsi (private company) zinauzwa kwa idhini ya bodi ya wakurugenzi au kwa mujibu wa Articles of Association. Mara nyingi, wanahisa wengine wa kampuni wana haki ya kwanza ya kununua (pre-emption rights). Mauzi ya hisa yanabidi kusajiliwa na BRELA. Kampuni ya umma (public company) inaweza kuuza hisa kwa umma kupitia DSE (Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange).
question_en: How can shares in a Tanzanian private company be transferred?
answer_en: Shares in a private company are transferred with the approval of the board of directors or as provided in the Articles of Association. Often other shareholders have pre-emption rights (first right to buy). Share transfers must be filed with BRELA. A public company can sell shares to the public through DSE (Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange).
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Kiwango cha insurance premium levy Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Insurance premium levy iko nje ya mipaka ya msaada wangu wa sasa — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD, na GN 487A kwa Tanzania Bara. Kwa maswali ya insurance premium levy, wasiliana na Tanzania Insurance Regulatory Authority (TIRA) kwa tira.go.tz au TRA Customs and Excise kwa mwongozo wa asilimia. Je, kuna swali lingine la kodi ya Tanzania ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: What is the insurance premium levy rate in Tanzania?
answer_en: Insurance premium levy is outside my current scope — I cover VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD, and GN 487A for Mainland Tanzania. For insurance premium levy questions, contact Tanzania Insurance Regulatory Authority (TIRA) at tira.go.tz or TRA. Is there another Tanzania tax question I can help with?

instruction: Niliuza ardhi yangu jijini Dar es Salaam na kupata faida ya TZS 50M — ninalipa capital gains tax ngapi na lini?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Kodi ya mapato ya mtaji (capital gains tax) kwa mauzo ya ardhi inashughulikiwa chini ya Income Tax Act — inahitaji tathmini ya thamani ya msingi (cost base), thamani ya uuzaji, na muda wa umiliki. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Mabenki ya kimataifa yanayofanya kazi Tanzania yako chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. Taasisi za fedha (mabenki, makampuni ya bima) zinasimamia chini ya sheria maalum za sekta ya fedha na Bank of Tanzania (BoT). GN 487A inalenga biashara ndogo na za kati za kila siku — si taasisi za fedha zenye leseni rasmi za BoT au TIRA.
question_en: Do international banks operating in Tanzania fall under GN 487A?
answer_en: No. Financial institutions (banks, insurance companies) are regulated under specific financial sector laws and the Bank of Tanzania (BoT). GN 487A targets everyday small and medium businesses — not financial institutions with formal BoT or TIRA licences.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Mishahara ya wafanyakazi 15 ni: 5 wanapata TZS 1,200,000 na 10 wanapata TZS 600,000. SDL ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Jumla ya mishahara: (5 × TZS 1,200,000) + (10 × TZS 600,000) = TZS 6,000,000 + TZS 6,000,000 = TZS 12,000,000. SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi): TZS 12,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 420,000 kwa mwezi. Mwajiri analipa jumla hii — hajikatui kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi yeyote.
question_en: Payroll for 15 employees: 5 earn TZS 1,200,000 and 10 earn TZS 600,000. What is the SDL?
answer_en: Total payroll: (5 × TZS 1,200,000) + (10 × TZS 600,000) = TZS 6,000,000 + TZS 6,000,000 = TZS 12,000,000. SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi): TZS 12,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 420,000 per month. The employer pays this total — it is not deducted from any employee's salary.

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi wa serikali analipa NSSF au PPF?
answer_sw: Wafanyakazi wa serikali kwa ujumla wanachangia PPF (Public Service Pension Fund) badala ya NSSF. NSSF inashughulikia hasa sekta ya binafsi. PPF ni mfuko wa pensheni wa wafanyakazi wa umma. Hata hivyo, wafanyakazi wa mashirika ya serikali (parastatal organizations) wanaweza kuchangia NSSF kulingana na makubaliano ya ajira. Kwa kuthibitisha mfuko sahihi kwa aina yako ya kazi, wasiliana na mwajiri wako au SSRA.
question_en: Does a government employee pay NSSF or PPF?
answer_en: Government employees generally contribute to PPF (Public Service Pension Fund) rather than NSSF. NSSF primarily covers the private sector. PPF is the pension fund for public service employees. However, employees of parastatal organisations may contribute to NSSF depending on their employment terms. To confirm the correct fund for your type of work, contact your employer or SSRA.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya kilimo inaajiri wafanyakazi wa msimu tu (seasonal workers) — SDL inatumika vipi?
output: Kwa wafanyakazi wa msimu, SDL inatumika kwa miezi ya msimu tu — wakati wafanyakazi wanaofanya kazi na idadi yao ikiwa 10 au zaidi. Kwa miezi ambapo wafanyakazi wa msimu hawafanyi kazi (idadi chini ya 10), SDL haihitajiki kwa miezi hiyo. Kwa vitendo: hesabu idadi ya wafanyakazi kila mwezi — miezi ya msimu (wafanyakazi 10 na zaidi) lipa SDL; miezi ya amani (chini ya 10) SDL haihitajiki. Thibitisha utaratibu huu na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: GN 605A ilianza kutumika tarehe ngapi hasa?
output:
GN 605A ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 JANUARI 2026 — si Septemba 2025 wala Oktoba 2025. Tarehe mbili muhimu za kuelewa:

Tarehe 13 Oktoba 2025: GN 605A ilitangazwa rasmi (gazetted) kwenye Gazeti la Serikali.
Tarehe 1 Januari 2026: GN 605A ilianza kutumika (effective date) — viwango vipya vya mshahara wa chini vilianza kulazimika kisheria.

Tarehe za 2025 mara nyingi zinachanganywa na tarehe nyingine kama vile tarehe ya Finance Act 2025. Kumbuka: GN 605A ilianza 1 Januari 2026, si kabla ya hapo. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa, VELMA Law, au TanzLII.

question_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kuweka rekodi gani za PAYE?
answer_sw: Mwajiri lazima aweke: orodha ya wafanyakazi na TIN zao, hesabu za mishahara, hesabu za PAYE kwa kila mfanyakazi, stakabadhi za malipo ya TRA, na fomu za PAYE P9. Rekodi hizi zinahifadhiwa kwa miaka 5. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What PAYE records must an employer maintain?
answer_en: An employer must keep: employee list with their TINs, payroll calculations, PAYE calculations per employee, TRA payment receipts, and PAYE P9 forms. Records must be kept for 5 years. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: EFD inaathiriwa na mabadiliko ya VAT ya asilimia 16 ya mauzo ya kidijitali B2C iliyoanza Septemba 2025 Tanzania?
answer_sw: B2C e-payment VAT ya asilimia 16 (ikilinganishwa na kiwango cha kawaida cha 18%) ni utaratibu tofauti unaohusiana na mauzo ya kidijitali. Sheria za utekelezaji bado zinasubiriwa kutoka kwa Kamishna Mkuu. Biashara za mtandaoni zinazotumia EFD lazima zifuate mwongozo wa TRA mara utakapotolewa kuhusu jinsi EFD itakavyo kushughulikia kiwango kipya cha asilimia 16 kwa muamala wa B2C.
question_en: Is an EFD affected by the 16% B2C digital sales VAT that started in September 2025 in Tanzania?
answer_en: The B2C e-payment VAT at 16% (compared to the standard 18%) is a separate arrangement related to digital sales. Implementation rules are still awaited from the Commissioner General. Online businesses using EFDs must follow TRA guidance when issued on how the EFD will handle the new 16% rate for B2C transactions.
next_review_trigger: TRA B2C e-payment VAT implementation update

instruction: Uelewa wangu: VAT Tanzania ni 5% kwa bidhaa za msingi na 18% kwa bidhaa za anasa. Sahihi?
output: Hapana — uelewa huo si sahihi. Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Tanzania HAINA reduced rate ya 5% hata kwa bidhaa za msingi. Bidhaa za msingi zinaweza kuwa zero-rated (0%) au exempt (zimesamehewa kabisa) — si 5%. Tofauti kati ya 0% na exempt ni muhimu kwa madai ya input VAT.

instruction: Annual return ya BRELA inapaswa kuwasilishwa lini kila mwaka?
output: Annual return ya BRELA inapaswa kuwasilishwa ndani ya miezi 18 kutoka tarehe ya kuanzishwa kwa kampuni (kwa kampuni mpya), na kisha kila mwaka. Tarehe halisi inategemea tarehe ya usajili wa kampuni. Ada ni TZS 22,000 kwa kuwasilisha kwa wakati. Faini ya kuchelewa ni TZS 2,500 kwa kila mwezi au sehemu ya mwezi. BRELA inashauriwa kuwasilishwa mapema ili kuepuka mkusanyiko wa faini. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz kwa tarehe yako maalum.

instruction: Msingi wa kisheria wa viwango vya sasa vya mshahara wa chini wa sekta binafsi Tanzania ni upi?
output: Msingi wa kisheria ni GN 605A (Government Notice 605A) — iliyotangazwa tarehe 13 Oktoba 2025 na kuanza kutumika 1 Januari 2026. GN 605A ilifuta amri ya mishahara ya 2022 na kuweka viwango vipya kwa sekta 16 na sub-sectors 46. Amri ya 2022 si msingi wa kisheria tena — imefutwa. GN 605A ndiyo inayotumika sasa. Thibitisha hali ya kisheria ya sasa na TanzLII (tanzlii.org), PKF Eastern Africa, au MLYWF.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi yuko likizo ya uzazi (maternity leave). Je, NSSF inaendelea kulipwa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wakati wa likizo ya uzazi inayolipwa (paid maternity leave), mwajiri anapaswa kuendelea kulipa NSSF kwa kiwango cha kawaida kwa mshahara unaolipwa. Kiwango ni mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Ikiwa mfanyakazi yuko likizo ya uzazi bila malipo, hali inategemea kama mshahara unalipwa au la — michango ya NSSF inafuata malipo ya mshahara halisi.
question_en: An employee is on maternity leave. Does NSSF continue to be paid?
answer_en: Yes. During paid maternity leave, the employer must continue paying NSSF at the standard rate on wages paid. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. If the employee is on unpaid maternity leave, the situation depends on whether wages are being paid — NSSF contributions follow actual wage payments.

instruction: Duka la mitumba (nguo za pili) linayomilikiwa na mgeni — je, GN 487A inasema nini?
output: Biashara ya nguo za pili (mitumba) ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A (tarehe 28 Julai 2025). Hii inajumuisha maduka ya mitumba, gunia la nguo za pili, na biashara yoyote ya nguo zilizotumiwa. Mgeni anayemiliki au kuendesha duka la mitumba anakabiliwa na: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Risiti ya EFD lazima itolewa kwa manunuzi yote — ikiwa ni pamoja na manunuzi madogo ya TZS 500 Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Sheria ya EFD inaitaji risiti itolewe kwa kila muamala bila kujali kiasi chake. Hata kwa nunuzi ndogo ya TZS 500, biashara iliyolazimika kutumia EFD lazima itoe risiti ya EFD. Hakuna kizingiti cha chini cha kiasi ambacho kinakuruhusu kutotoa risiti ya EFD.
question_en: Must an EFD receipt be issued for all purchases — including small purchases of TZS 500 in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. EFD law requires a receipt to be issued for every transaction regardless of amount. Even for a small TZS 500 purchase, a business required to use an EFD must issue an EFD receipt. There is no minimum amount threshold that allows you to skip issuing an EFD receipt.

instruction: Nilikuwa na leseni ya duka kabla ya GN 487A — ninaweza kuendelea kufanya biashara?
output: GN 487A ya 28 Julai 2025 ina kipengele cha mpito (transitional provision): mgeni aliyekuwa na leseni halisi kabla ya tarehe ya kufanya kazi ya GN 487A anaweza kuendelea na shughuli hiyo hadi leseni yake inaisha — lakini hawezi kuomba upya (renewal) wa leseni hiyo. Maana: ukiwa na leseni iliyotolewa KABLA ya 28 Julai 2025 na bado halisi: unaweza kuendelea mpaka leseni inaisha. Lakini: ukiomba upya leseni baada ya GN 487A, maombi yako yatakataliwa kama shughuli hiyo ipo kwenye orodha ya marufuku ya GN 487A. Wasiliana na wakili wa uhamiaji kwa hali yako maalum.

question_sw: NSSF inalipwa kwa njia gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: NSSF inalipwa kupitia mfumo wa GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway). Mwajiri analazimika pia kutoa nyaraka za usaidizi (fomu NSSF/CON.05) kwenye ofisi ya NSSF mara tu baada ya malipo — kwa utoaji wa kimwili au njia ya kielektroniki. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How is NSSF paid in Tanzania?
answer_en: NSSF is paid through the GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) system. The employer must also submit supporting documents (NSSF/CON.05 form) to the NSSF office immediately after payment — by physical delivery or electronic means. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Orodha ya kodi ya zuio Tanzania: riba ni asilimia ngapi kwa mkazi na asiye mkazi?
answer_sw: Kodi ya zuio kwenye riba (interest) Tanzania: kwa MKAZI ni asilimia 10; kwa ASIYE MKAZI ni asilimia 10 pia (lakini DTA inaweza kupunguza). Kiwango kimoja (10%) kinatumika kwa pande zote mbili kwa riba — tofauti na ada za usimamizi ambapo mkazi hulipa 5% na asiye mkazi hulipa 15%.
question_en: Tanzania withholding tax list: what rate does interest attract for resident and non-resident?
answer_en: Withholding tax on interest in Tanzania: for RESIDENT is 10%; for NON-RESIDENT is also 10% (but DTA may reduce it). A single rate (10%) applies to both parties for interest — unlike management fees where a resident pays 5% and a non-resident pays 15%.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ndogo ina wafanyakazi 3 tu — nchi ina kanuni ya NSSF?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Ndio — hata wafanyakazi 3 wanastahili NSSF. Hakuna kizingiti cha ukubwa. Ukiwa na wafanyakazi 3, unapaswa: (1) Sajili kampuni yako kwa NSSF (nssf.or.tz). (2) Sajili wafanyakazi wako wote. (3) Lipa NSSF kila mwezi (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi).

instruction: Nilianza biashara mwezi huu — ninahitaji kusajili VAT sasa?
output: Kwa biashara mpya: usajili wa VAT unahitajika ukipita kizingiti, si mwanzoni. Fuatilia mauzo yako: Miezi 6 ya kwanza: ukifika TZS 100M → sajili VAT mara moja. Mwaka mmoja: ukifika TZS 200M → sajili VAT mara moja. Pia zingatia: usajili wa hiari (voluntary) unapatikana hata kabla ya kizingiti iwapo wateja wako wakubwa wanahitaji invoice ya VAT.

instruction: VAT kwa huduma za ujenzi (construction services) — ni 18% ya kawaida?
output: Ndiyo — huduma za ujenzi Tanzania zinalipa VAT ya kawaida ya 18%. Hata hivyo, kuna mambo muhimu ya kuzingatia: Bidhaa za ujenzi (saruji, nondo, matofali) = bidhaa — zinaweza kuwa na withholding ya 3% kwa qualifying buyer. Huduma za ujenzi (kazi ya ujenzi, usanifu, usimamizi) = huduma — withholding ya 6% kwa qualifying buyer. Katika ujenzi mkubwa (government contracts), mara nyingi serikali (qualifying buyer) inakata 6% ya VAT kwenye malipo ya huduma za kontrakta. Kwa hivyo kontrakta anatarajia kupokea malipo pungufu ya 6% withholding. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Biashara ya pombe za kienyeji (pombe) — leseni na kodi zinahitajika?
answer_sw: Utengenezaji na uuzaji wa pombe za kienyeji unasimamia chini ya sheria ya pombe Tanzania na mamlaka za serikali za mitaa. Leseni zinahitajika kutoka Halmashauri ya Wilaya. Kodi za biashara zinahusu hali ya usajili wa biashara na kiwango cha mapato. Sina uhakika wa masharti yote. Thibitisha na Halmashauri yako ya Wilaya.
question_en: A traditional brew business — what licences and taxes are required?
answer_en: Manufacturing and selling traditional brews is regulated under Tanzania's liquor laws and local government authorities. Licences are required from the District Council. Business taxes depend on registration status and income levels. I am not certain of all requirements. Verify with your District Council.

question_sw: Kiwango cha withholding tax kwa royalties kwa wakazi wa Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha withholding tax kwa royalties kwa WAKAZI wa Tanzania ni asilimia 15. Kwa WASIO WAKAZI, kiwango pia ni asilimia 15. Kiwango hiki kinatumika kwa malipo ya haki ya matumizi ya mali ya kiakili, mauzo ya teknolojia, na malipo yanayofanana.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on royalties for Tanzania residents?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on royalties for Tanzania RESIDENTS is 15%. For NON-RESIDENTS the rate is also 15%. This rate applies to payments for use of intellectual property rights, technology transfers, and similar payments.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kulipa mshahara wa chini mdogo kama mfanyakazi amekubali maandikoni?
answer_sw: Hapana. Makubaliano ya maandishi hayawezi kupunguza haki ya kisheria ya mshahara wa chini. GN 605A ni sheria ya lazima — hata kama mfanyakazi ametia sahihi makubaliano ya kulipwa kidogo, makubaliano hayo si ya kisheria. Mwajiri bado ana wajibu wa kisheria.
question_en: Can an employer pay below minimum wage if the employee agreed in writing?
answer_en: No. A written agreement cannot waive the statutory minimum wage entitlement. GN 605A is mandatory law — even if an employee has signed an agreement to receive less, that agreement is void. The employer still has a legal obligation.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni aliye na Class A work permit (investor) — analipa PAYE?
answer_sw: Class A work permit ni ya wawekezaji wanaojitegemea — si wafanyakazi waliohiriwa. Mmiliki wa Class A anayefanya kazi kama mwajiriwa (employed) katika kampuni yake anahitaji kutathmini hali yake ya kisheria. Lakini kama mtu ana mshahara kutoka kampuni, PAYE itatumika. Thibitisha muundo maalum na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: A foreign employee with a Class A work permit (investor) — do they pay PAYE?
answer_en: Class A is for self-employed investors — not hired employees. A Class A holder working as an employee in their own company needs to assess their legal status. But if a person receives a salary from a company, PAYE applies. Confirm the specific structure with a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Je, biashara inaweza kupata msamaha wa kodi kwa kuwa biashara ya wanawake Tanzania?
answer_sw: Sheria za kodi za Tanzania hazitoi msamaha wa jumla wa kodi tu kwa sababu biashara inamilikiwa na mwanamke. Hata hivyo, kuna vitu vinavyosaidia biashara za wanawake: NMB Bank na DFI pakiti (IFC/BII) zinasaidia biashara za wanawake kwa mikopo, baadhi ya programu za maendeleo zinaweza kutoa ruzuku zisizo za kodi. Uzingatiaji wa kodi bado unahitajika kwa biashara zote.
question_en: Can a business get tax exemption for being a women-owned business in Tanzania?
answer_en: Tanzania tax laws do not provide a general tax exemption simply because a business is women-owned. However, there are things that help women-owned businesses: NMB Bank and DFI packages (IFC/BII) support women's businesses with loans, some development programmes may offer non-tax grants. Tax compliance is still required for all businesses.

question_sw: Kodi ya awali ya PAYE ya Shilingi sifuri inaendelea hadi mshahara wa Shilingi 300,000 kwa mwezi — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kanda ya asilimia sifuri ya PAYE inaendelea hadi Shilingi 270,000 kwa mwezi — si Shilingi 300,000. Mapato yanayozidi Shilingi 270,000 yanaanza kupigwa kodi ya asilimia 8 (kanda ya pili). Kiwango cha Shilingi 300,000 si sahihi.
question_en: The zero-rate PAYE band continues up to TZS 300,000 per month — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The zero-rate PAYE band runs up to TZS 270,000 per month — not TZS 300,000. Income above TZS 270,000 starts being taxed at 8% (second band). The figure of TZS 300,000 is incorrect.

question_sw: Muda wa usajili wa BRELA unachukua muda gani?
answer_sw: Usajili wa BRELA mara nyingi unachukua siku 3 hadi 5 za kazi ikiwa nyaraka zote ziko sahihi. BRELA inafanya usajili wa haraka (express registration) ndani ya siku 1-2 kwa ada ya ziada. Usajili wa online kupitia mfumo wa BRELA unaweza kuwa haraka zaidi. Kuchelewa kunaweza kutokea kama nyaraka zina makosa.
question_en: How long does BRELA registration take?
answer_en: BRELA registration typically takes 3 to 5 working days if all documents are correct. BRELA offers express registration within 1-2 days for an additional fee. Online registration through the BRELA system may be faster. Delays can occur if documents have errors.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kutumia michango ya NSSF iliyokatwa kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi kwa matumizi ya kampuni kabla ya kuwasilisha — je, hii ni haramu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, hii ni HARAMU kabisa. Pesa iliyokatwa kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi kama mchango wa NSSF ni pesa ya mfanyakazi iliyoshikiliwa na mwajiri kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi. Mwajiri HANA haki ya kutumia pesa hizi kwa madhumuni yoyote ya kampuni. Kutumia michango ya NSSF ya wafanyakazi ni wizi na ni kosa la jinai chini ya Sheria ya NSSF na sheria za kazi.
question_en: Can an employer use NSSF contributions deducted from employee wages for company use before remitting — is this illegal?
answer_en: Yes, this is completely ILLEGAL. Money deducted from an employee's wages as NSSF contributions is the employee's money held by the employer on the employee's behalf. The employer has NO right to use this money for any company purpose. Using workers' NSSF contributions is theft and is a criminal offence under the NSSF Act and labour laws.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act or criminal code amendment

instruction: Msafi wa ofisi yangu analipwa na kampuni nyingine ya usafi — mimi ninalipia NSSF yake?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Msafi wa kampuni nyingine: unayemlipia ni kampuni ya usafi — kampuni hiyo ndiyo mwajiri wake. Mwajiri halisi ndiye analipa NSSF. Kama unalipa mtu binafsi moja kwa moja (mkataba wako binafsi): wewe ndiyo mwajiri — una wajibu wa NSSF. Angalia mkataba wako kujua nani ni mwajiri rasmi.

instruction: Withholding certificate ya VAT — lazima itolewe lini hasa?
output: Withholding certificate ya VAT lazima itolewe siku VAT inakuwa ya kulipwa — ambayo ni wakati malipo yanafanywa au bidhaa/huduma zinapopokelewa, ikijua ni kipi kinachokuja kwanza. Kumbuka tofauti muhimu: tarehe ya mwisho ya withholding certificate = siku VAT inapaswa kulipwa (tarehe ya muamala). Tarehe ya 20 ya mwezi = tarehe ya mwisho ya kuwasilisha VAT RETURN — hiyo ni wajibu tofauti kabisa. Makosa ya kawaida: kutoa withholding certificate tarehe 20 badala ya siku ya muamala. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kulipa kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) TRA ni ipi?
answer_sw: Kodi ya zuio lazima ilipwe TRA ndani ya siku 7 baada ya mwisho wa kila mwezi wa kalenda. Kwa mfano, kodi ya zuio iliyokatwa Januari inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 Februari. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax remittance deadline in Tanzania?
answer_en: Withholding tax must be remitted to TRA within 7 days after the end of each calendar month. For example, withholding tax deducted in January is due by 7 February. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri amebadilisha wadhifa wa wafanyakazi 3 kuwa wapya mwezi huu — SDL inaathirika?
answer_sw: SDL inategemea jumla ya wafanyakazi na mishahara kwa mwezi husika — si mabadiliko ya udhifa. Kwa mwezi wa mpito (watu wanakuja na kuondoka), hesabu wafanyakazi wote waliohudumika mwezi huo. Hata wanaojiunga nusu mwezi wanaweza kuhesabiwa. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: My employer replaced 3 workers with new ones this month — how does this affect SDL?
answer_en: SDL depends on the total employee count and payroll for that month — not changes in staffing. For a transition month (people joining and leaving), count all employees who served that month. Even those joining mid-month may be counted. Verify with a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Mkataba wa biashara ambao pande mbili zinasaini Tanzania unahitaji ushuru wa stempu kiotomatiki?
answer_sw: Si kila mkataba wa biashara unahitaji ushuru wa stempu Tanzania. Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu inaorodhesha nyaraka MAALUM zinazohitaji kupigwa stempu — kama hati za uhamishaji wa ardhi, dhamana, na mikataba maalum. Mikataba ya kawaida ya utoaji wa huduma au bidhaa kati ya makampuni mawili inaweza isihitaji ushuru wa stempu. Angalia jedwali la Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu kwa aina yako ya mkataba.
question_en: Does a business contract signed by two parties in Tanzania automatically require stamp duty?
answer_en: Not every business contract requires stamp duty in Tanzania. The Stamp Duty Act lists SPECIFIC instruments that need to be stamped — such as land transfer deeds, securities, and specified contracts. Ordinary service or goods contracts between two companies may not require stamp duty. Check the schedule of the Stamp Duty Act for your type of contract.

question_sw: Je, ruzuku ya matibabu (medical allowance) inastahili PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ruzuku ya matibabu inayolipwa moja kwa moja kwa mfanyakazi (cash allowance) inastahili PAYE. Malipo ya matibabu yanayolipwa moja kwa moja kwa hospitali au insurer kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi yanaweza kuwa na nafuu — thibitisha kiasi na TRA.
question_en: Is a medical allowance subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: A medical allowance paid directly to the employee as cash is subject to PAYE. Payments made directly to a hospital or insurer on behalf of the employee may receive a tax relief — confirm the threshold and arrangement with TRA.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anapata overtime ya TZS 200,000 na bonus ya TZS 300,000 mwezi huu. Je, vinatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Overtime na bonus zote zinaongezwa kwenye mshahara wa kawaida wa mwezi huo kabla ya kuhesabu PAYE. Kwa mfano, mshahara wa msingi wa TZS 500,000 + overtime TZS 200,000 + bonus TZS 300,000 = mapato ya mwezi TZS 1,000,000. PAYE inakokotolewa kwenye TZS 1,000,000 kulingana na jedwali la PAYE. Hakuna msamaha maalum wa overtime au bonus Tanzania.
answer_en: Yes. Overtime and bonuses are both added to the regular monthly salary before calculating PAYE. For example: basic salary TZS 500,000 + overtime TZS 200,000 + bonus TZS 300,000 = monthly income TZS 1,000,000. PAYE is calculated on TZS 1,000,000 according to the PAYE tax bands. There is no special exemption for overtime or bonuses in Tanzania.
question_en: An employee receives overtime of TZS 200,000 and a bonus of TZS 300,000 this month. Are they subject to PAYE?

instruction: Ninanunua bidhaa za chakula kutoka Tanzania — je, VAT inakatwa?
output: Bidhaa za chakula Tanzania zina matibabu mbalimbali ya VAT kulingana na aina: Zero-rated (0% VAT): mazao ya kilimo ya msingi yasiyosindikwa (nafaka, mboga za mashamba); dawa za dawa; mauzo ya nje ya nchi (exports). Exempt (hazilipwi VAT): baadhi ya bidhaa maalum zilizoorodheshwa na sheria. Standard rate (18% VAT): chakula kilichosindikwa, bidhaa za chakula zilizopakiwa, na chakula kutoka migahawa na hoteli. Kama unanunua mazao mabichi kutoka mkulima si lazima VAT. Ukiwa unanunua chakula kilichosindikwa kutoka kampuni ya VAT — utalipa VAT 18%. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa orodha ya bidhaa.

question_sw: Gharama yote ya mwajiri kwa mfanyakazi mmoja mwenye mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kwa mshahara wa chini wa wastani wa TZS 358,322/mwezi: NSSF ya mwajiri TZS 35,832 (10%); SDL TZS 12,541 (3.5%); WCF TZS 1,792 (0.5%). Jumla ya gharama ya ziada kwa mwajiri: TZS 50,165. Gharama yote ya mwajiri: TZS 358,322 + TZS 50,165 = TZS 408,487/mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA na NSSF.
question_en: What is the total employer cost for one employee at the GN 605A average minimum wage?
answer_en: On TZS 358,322/month minimum wage: employer NSSF TZS 35,832 (10%); SDL TZS 12,541 (3.5%); WCF TZS 1,792 (0.5%). Total employer add-on cost: TZS 50,165. Full employer cost: TZS 358,322 + TZS 50,165 = TZS 408,487/month. Confirm with TRA and NSSF.
next_review_trigger: New wage order or statutory rate change

question_sw: NSSF inachukua hatua gani dhidi ya mwajiri asiyolipa michango ya wafanyakazi?
answer_sw: NSSF ina hatua kadhaa za utekelezaji dhidi ya waajiri wasiotii: kwanza, onyo rasmi na hati ya kudai malipo. Kama malipo hayafanyiki, NSSF inaweza: kutumia kisheria ili kunyang'anya mali za mwajiri, kutoa amri ya kushikilia akaunti za benki, kupeleka kesi mahakamani ya kazi au jinai, na kutoa faini ya 5% kwa kila mwezi wa ucheleweshaji wa michango isiyolipwa. Waajiri wanaohukumiwa wanaweza pia kupoteza haki ya kupata mikataba ya serikali.
answer_en: NSSF has several enforcement steps against non-compliant employers: first, a formal warning and demand notice for payment. If payment is not made, NSSF may: use legal process to seize employer assets, issue orders to freeze bank accounts, take the matter to a labour or criminal court, and impose a 5% penalty for each month of delay on unpaid contributions. Convicted employers may also lose the right to obtain government contracts.
question_en: What action does NSSF take against an employer who does not pay employee contributions?

instruction: Kiwango cha stamp duty kwa ununuzi wa ardhi Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
output: Stamp duty inatumika kwa uhamisho wa mali Tanzania. Viwango na taratibu halisi vinategemea aina ya mali na thamani yake inayotathminiwa na mthamini aliyesajiliwa. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Viwango vya stamp duty kwa ardhi na mali vinashughulikiwa na Ofisi ya Ardhi na TRA, na vinaweza kutofautiana kulingana na aina ya mali na hali ya mnunuzi. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Wafanyakazi wa nyumbani (domestic workers) — wanaathiri kizingiti cha SDL?
output: Hapana — wafanyakazi wa nyumbani (domestic workers) kama wapishi, walinzi wa nyumbani, na wasaidizi wa familia ambao wanafanya kazi katika kaya ya kibinafsi (si biashara) HAWAINGII katika kizingiti cha SDL. SDL inalenga waajiri wa BIASHARA (commercial employers) — si kaya za kibinafsi. Hata hivyo, waajiri wa kaya za kibinafsi bado wana wajibu mwingine: (1) Kudhibiti kodi ya PAYE kwa wafanyakazi wa nyumbani wenye mapato yanayopita TZS 270,000/mwezi; (2) Kuzingatia GN 605A ya mshahara wa chini kwa sekta ya kazi za nyumbani. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa mwongozo maalum.

question_sw: PAYE tofauti na kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) ni nini?
answer_sw: PAYE inahusu mapato ya ajira tu — mwajiri anakata na kulipa kila mwezi. Kodi ya zuio inahusu malipo mengine kama vile gawio (dividends), riba, ada za ushauri, na pango — wakala mwingine (mtu anayetoa malipo) anakata na kulipa. Viwango na tarehe za malipo zinatofautiana. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the difference between PAYE and withholding tax in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE relates only to employment income — the employer deducts and remits monthly. Withholding tax covers other payments such as dividends, interest, consultancy fees, and rent — the paying party deducts and remits. Rates and deadlines differ. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Kamera za usalama na CCTV zinaingizwa kutoka Dubai — ushuru wa kuingiza ni kiasi gani?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ushuru wa forodha kwa vifaa vya CCTV na usalama unategemea HS Code na EAC Common External Tariff — mada hii iko nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara ya ndani. Wasiliana na TRA Customs and Excise kupitia tra.go.tz au mshauri wa forodha aliyehitimu kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Msimamizi wa kiwanda kidogo cha kusaga mahindi (posho mill) — ana wajibu gani?
answer_sw: Mmiliki wa posho mill anahitaji: (1) Leseni ya biashara kutoka halmashauri; (2) TIN kwa TRA; (3) Kama ana wafanyakazi waliohiriwa: PAYE, NSSF, WCF; (4) SDL kama wafanyakazi ≥10; (5) Usajili wa OSHA kama ana wafanyakazi na mashine ya hatari; (6) Kama mauzo yanafikia TZS 200M/mwaka: VAT. Kwa posho mill ndogo ya kawaida, PAYE na NSSF vinaweza visihitajike kama mmiliki anafanya kazi peke yake.
question_en: The owner of a small grain milling business (posho mill) — what obligations do they have?
answer_en: A posho mill owner needs: (1) A business licence from the local council; (2) A TIN with TRA; (3) If they have hired employees: PAYE, NSSF, WCF; (4) SDL if ≥10 employees; (5) OSHA registration if they have employees and dangerous machinery; (6) If sales reach TZS 200M/year: VAT. For a small typical posho mill, PAYE and NSSF may not apply if the owner works alone.

question_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kutoa choo cha kutosha na maji safi mahali pa kazi Tanzania — OSHA inasimamia hili?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. OSHA Tanzania inasimamia vifaa vya msingi vya usafi na afya mahali pa kazi, ikiwa ni pamoja na: vyoo vya kutosha kwa idadi ya wafanyakazi, maji safi ya kunywa, nafasi ya kutosha ya kufanyia kazi, hewa safi, na taa ya kutosha. Hizi ni mahitaji ya msingi ya sheria ya OSHA — si 'ziada' zinazotegemea hiari ya mwajiri. Mkaguzi wa OSHA anaweza kutoa notisi ya kuboresha ikiwa mahitaji haya hayajakamilika.
question_en: Is an employer required to provide adequate toilets and clean water at the workplace in Tanzania — does OSHA regulate this?
answer_en: Yes. OSHA Tanzania regulates basic sanitation and health facilities at the workplace, including: adequate toilets for the number of workers, clean drinking water, sufficient workspace, fresh air, and adequate lighting. These are basic legal requirements under OSHA law — not extras that depend on employer discretion. An OSHA inspector can issue an improvement notice if these requirements are not met.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Mkaguzi wa OSHA anaweza kuingia mahali pa kazi bila notisi — je, hii inaruhusiwa kisheria?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wakaguzi wa OSHA Tanzania wana mamlaka ya kisheria ya kuingia mahali pa kazi bila notisi ya mapema kwa madhumuni ya ukaguzi wa usalama. Hii ni nguvu ya kisheria chini ya OSHA Act ili kuhakikisha ukaguzi wa kweli — sio ukaguzi wa kuandaliwa. Mwajiri ana wajibu wa kuruhusu mkaguzi wa OSHA aingie na kushirikiana naye.
question_en: Can an OSHA inspector enter a workplace without notice — is this legally permitted?
answer_en: Yes. OSHA inspectors in Tanzania have legal authority to enter a workplace without advance notice for safety inspection purposes. This is a statutory power under the OSHA Act to ensure genuine inspection — not a prepared inspection. The employer has an obligation to allow an OSHA inspector to enter and cooperate with them.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Muuzaji wa jumla kutoka India ana ghala la bidhaa Dar — je, GN 487A inamhusu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, GN 487A inamhusu moja kwa moja. Biashara ya jumla (wholesale trade) ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuendesha ghala la bidhaa na kuuza kwa wingi. Muuzaji huyu kutoka India lazima asimamishe shughuli hii au ahamishie umiliki kwa raia wa Tanzania kwa njia inayokubalika kisheria. Kutofuata amri hii kunaweza kusababisha faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza. Anashauriwa kupata ushauri wa kisheria haraka.
question_en: A wholesale trader from India has a warehouse in Dar — does GN 487A apply to him?
answer_en: Yes, GN 487A directly applies to him. Wholesale trade is one of the 15 business activities prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens, including operating a product warehouse and selling in bulk. This trader from India must cease the activity or transfer ownership to a Tanzanian citizen through a legally compliant structure. Non-compliance may result in a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. He is advised to seek legal advice urgently.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Tanzania ina mikataba ya kuzuia kodi mara mbili (DTA) na nchi zipi?
answer_sw: Sina uhakika wa orodha kamili ya sasa ya mikataba ya DTA ya Tanzania. Kwa ujumla, Tanzania ina mikataba na nchi kadhaa — lakini orodha na masharti yao yanabadilika. Thibitisha orodha ya sasa ya mikataba ya DTA ya Tanzania na TRA au mshauri wa kodi wa kimataifa.
question_en: Which countries does Tanzania have Double Taxation Agreements (DTAs) with?
answer_en: I am not certain of the current complete list of Tanzania's DTA agreements. Generally, Tanzania has agreements with several countries — but the list and their terms change over time. Verify the current list of Tanzania's DTAs with TRA or an international tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Je, tofauti kati ya kuendesha duka na kufanya kazi katika duka ni nini chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Kuendesha duka (operating): mmiliki au meneja mkuu anayefanya maamuzi ya biashara — hii imekatazwa kwa raia wa kigeni kwa shughuli 15. Kufanya kazi katika duka (working as employee): mfanyakazi anayetekeleza maelekezo ya mwajiri chini ya kibali cha kazi halali — hii hairuhusiwi na GN 487A. Ni tofauti muhimu.
question_en: What is the difference between operating a shop and working in a shop under GN 487A?
answer_en: Operating a shop: being the owner or primary manager who makes business decisions — this is prohibited for non-citizens across the 15 activities. Working in a shop as an employee: a worker carrying out an employer's instructions under a valid work permit — GN 487A does not prohibit this. It is an important distinction.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: Bidhaa za ujenzi (cement, nondo) zina VAT ngapi Tanzania?
output: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Bidhaa za ujenzi kama saruji (cement) na nondo mara nyingi zina VAT ya 18% (standard rate). Baadhi ya nyenzo maalum za ujenzi zinaweza kuwa na hali tofauti — thibitisha na TRA.

instruction: Wanaohitimu kama VAT withholding agents Tanzania ni akina nani hasa?
output: Wanaohitimu kama VAT withholding agents ni pamoja na: wizara za serikali na taasisi za umma, kampuni za bima zilizoteuliwa, benki na taasisi za fedha, makampuni ya simu yaliyoteuliwa, na biashara nyingine zilizopewa hadhi rasmi na TRA. Orodha kamili inapatikana kwenye TRA. Uliza TRA kama una shaka kuhusu mbia wako.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya duka ndogo mwenye wafanyakazi 2 — inahitaji usajilishaji wa OSHA?
output: Ndiyo. OSHA inatumika kwa WOTE wanaomiliki mahali pa kazi na wafanyakazi — hakuna kizingiti cha chini cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Duka lako lenye wafanyakazi 2 linalazimika kuzingatia OHS Act Na. 5 wa 2003. Usajilishaji, tathmini ya hatari, na kuhakikisha usalama ni wajibu wako kama mwajiri. Wasiliana na OSHA (osha.go.tz) kwa hatua za usajilishaji.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: Mhandisi wa ujenzi aliyesajiliwa Engineers Registration Board — VAT inamshughulikia lini?
output: Wahandisi walioidhinishwa wana hali maalum kwa VAT — TRA inaweza kuhitaji usajili bila kujali kizingiti cha kawaida cha TZS 200M. Kanuni ya jumla: wataalamu wote walioidhinishwa waangalie mwongozo maalum wa TRA kwa sekta yao. Hatua: wasiliana na TRA au mwanasheria wa kodi kujua mahitaji yako kama mhandisi.

question_sw: Adhabu kwa mwajiri anayelipa chini ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A ni nini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anayelipa chini ya kiwango cha mshahara wa chini anaweza kukabili: malimbikizo ya tofauti ya mshahara, faini chini ya ELRA, au kesi ya kisheria iliyowasilishwa na mfanyakazi. Ukaguzi wa MLYWF unaweza kuanzisha hatua za kisheria. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: What is the penalty for an employer paying below the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: An employer paying below the minimum wage may face: back-payment of wage shortfalls, fines under ELRA, or legal proceedings filed by the employee. MLYWF labour inspectors can initiate enforcement action. Confirm with a legal adviser.

question_sw: Wakala wa zuio (withholding agent) ni nani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Wakala wa zuio ni mtu anayehitajika kisheria kukata kodi ya zuio kutoka kwa malipo anayofanya. Wakala wa zuio ni: serikali na taasisi zake, makampuni, na watu binafsi waliotajwa na sheria. Wakala anapaswa kusajiliwa TRA na kulipa ndani ya siku 7. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Who is a withholding agent in Tanzania?
answer_en: A withholding agent is a person legally required to deduct withholding tax from payments they make. Withholding agents include: government and its institutions, companies, and specified individuals. The agent must be registered with TRA and pay within 7 days. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mshauri (consultant) mgeni anayesaidia biashara ya Mtanzania — ni ukiukaji wa GN 487A?
answer_sw: GN 487A inakataza KUMILIKI na KUENDESHA biashara — si kutoa ushauri (consulting). Mshauri mgeni mwenye kibali cha kazi kinachofaa anaweza kutoa ushauri wa kibiashara bila kukiuka GN 487A. Tatizo linatokea tu 'ushauri' unapogeuka kuwa uendeshaji wa biashara moja kwa moja.
question_en: A foreign consultant helping a Tanzanian business — is this a GN 487A violation?
answer_en: GN 487A prohibits OWNING and OPERATING businesses — not providing consultancy. A foreign consultant with an appropriate work permit can provide business advice without violating GN 487A. The problem only arises if 'consulting' turns into directly operating the business.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi kinaweza kuhamishiwa kampuni nyingine bila kuomba upya?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida, kibali cha kazi Tanzania hakim transfer otomatiki kwa kampuni nyingine. Mabadiliko ya mwajiri yanahitaji mchakato rasmi wa uhamiaji — ama kuomba kibali kipya au marekebisho ya kibali kilichopo kupitia Idara ya Uhamiaji. Omba ushauri kutoka Idara ya Uhamiaji kwa hali maalum.
question_en: Can a work permit be transferred to a different company without reapplying?
answer_en: Generally, a Tanzania work permit does not transfer automatically to another company. A change of employer requires a formal immigration process — either a new permit application or an amendment to the existing permit through the Immigration Department. Seek guidance from the Immigration Department for specific circumstances.

instruction: Input VAT yangu ya mwezi ni TZS 2,000,000 na output VAT ni TZS 1,500,000 — nifanye nini?
output: Una hali ya VAT refund: output VAT (TZS 1,500,000) ni ndogo kuliko input VAT (TZS 2,000,000). Tofauti ya TZS 500,000 ni refund inayostahiki kutoka TRA. Jinsi ya kufanya: (1) Wasilisha VAT return yako ya kawaida tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata ukionyesha tofauti ya refund; (2) Omba rasmi refund au uomba izidishiwe kwa miezi ijayo; (3) TRA itakagua madai — kuna taratibu za ukaguzi. Biashara za exports (zero-rated) mara nyingi zina input VAT zaidi — refund ni haki ya kawaida ya kisheria. TRA ina muda wa miezi 6 wa kisheria kukusaidia. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Je, GN 487A inazuia raia wa kigeni KUISHI Tanzania au KUFANYA BIASHARA?
answer_sw: GN 487A inazuia AINA za biashara — si makazi. Raia wa kigeni ana haki ya kuomba kibali cha makazi na kukaa Tanzania vizuri. GN 487A inasema tu kwamba mkazi huyo mgeni hawezi KUMILIKI au KUENDESHA mojawapo ya shughuli 15 maalum zilizokatazwa.
question_en: Does GN 487A prohibit non-citizens from LIVING in Tanzania or from DOING BUSINESS?
answer_en: GN 487A restricts TYPES of business activity — not residency. A non-citizen has the right to apply for a residence permit and live in Tanzania lawfully. GN 487A only says that the foreign resident cannot OWN or OPERATE one of the 15 specific prohibited activities.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Je, ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unatumika kwa hati za kidijitali (e-contracts/digital agreements) zilizosainiwa mtandaoni?
answer_sw: Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu Tanzania (Stamp Duty Act) iliandikwa kabla ya enzi ya mikataba ya kidijitali. Hati za kidijitali au mikataba iliyosainiwa mtandaoni kwenye mazingira ya Tanzania yanaweza bado kuhitaji ushuru wa stempu ikiwa yanashughulikia aina za miamala zilizoorodheshwa kwenye sheria. Mfumo wa kisheria wa Tanzania wa e-transactions (e-Transactions Act) unasimamia hati za kidijitali. Angalia TRA au mwanasheria kwa hali yako.
question_en: Does Tanzania stamp duty apply to digital instruments (e-contracts/digital agreements) signed online?
answer_en: The Tanzania Stamp Duty Act was written before the era of digital contracts. Digital instruments or contracts signed online in Tanzania may still require stamp duty if they deal with listed transaction types. Tanzania's electronic transactions legal framework (e-Transactions Act) governs digital instruments. Check TRA or a lawyer for your specific situation.
next_review_trigger: e-Transactions Act or Stamp Duty Act update

question_sw: Kampuni inatoa nyumba kwa mfanyakazi mgeni bila gharama — je, thamani yake ni mapato?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Nyumba inayotolewa bure na mwajiri (accommodation in kind) inachukuliwa kama manufaa ya kazi (employment benefit) inayopaswa kuthaminiwa na kujumlishwa kwenye mapato ya ajira kwa madhumuni ya PAYE. Thamani ya nyumba iliyotolewa bure inakokotolewa kwa kiwango cha soko au kwa njia iliyowekwa na TRA.
question_en: A company provides free housing to a foreign employee — is the value treated as income?
answer_en: Yes. Employer-provided housing (accommodation in kind) is treated as an employment benefit that must be valued and added to employment income for PAYE purposes. The value of free housing is calculated at market rates or by a TRA-prescribed method.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

instruction: Mgeni analipa faini ya TZS milioni 10 kwa hiari kabla ya kesi — je, korti itafuta kesi na mgeni aendelee na biashara?
output: Hapana — kulipa mapema hakufuti kesi wala haki ya kuendelea na biashara. GN 487A ni kosa la jinai linalohitaji uamuzi wa mahakama. Hata kama mgeni amelipa kiasi, bado atachunguzwa, atashtakiwa, na mahakama itaamua adhabu rasmi (faini AU kifungo) PAMOJA NA kufutwa kwa visa. kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Pia, biashara iliyokatazwa lazima ifungwe bila kujali. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kutekeleza GN 605A ndani ya muda gani?
answer_sw: Mwajiri alipaswa kutekeleza GN 605A kuanzia malipo ya kwanza ya mishahara ya Januari 2026. Utekelezaji haukuwa na kipindi cha mpito — ufanisi ulianza moja kwa moja tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: When must an employer implement GN 605A?
answer_en: Employers were required to implement GN 605A from the first payroll of January 2026. There was no transition period — the order took effect immediately on 1 January 2026. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Je, ninahitaji kuwasilisha ripoti ya kila mwaka (annual return) kwa BRELA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Makampuni yaliyosajiliwa na BRELA yanahitajika kuwasilisha annual return kila mwaka kumpa BRELA taarifa za hivi karibuni za kampuni — ikiwa ni pamoja na majina ya wakurugenzi, anwani ya ofisi ya makao makuu, na maelezo ya wamiliki wa hisa. Kushindwa kuwasilisha annual return kwa wakati kunaweza kusababisha faini au hata kufutwa kwa usajilishaji wa kampuni. Thibitisha tarehe ya kufunga (deadline) ya annual return yako na BRELA.
question_en: Do I need to file an annual return with BRELA?
answer_en: Yes. Companies registered with BRELA are required to file an annual return each year to keep BRELA's records updated — including names of directors, registered office address, and shareholder details. Failing to file the annual return on time can result in fines or even deregistration of your company. Confirm the annual return deadline with BRELA.
next_review_trigger: When Companies Act annual return requirements are amended

question_sw: TRAB na mahakama ya kawaida (High Court) vinafanana — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) ni bodi maalum ya kodi iliyoundwa chini ya Sheria ya Rufaa ya Mapato ya Kodi. Mahakama ya Juu (High Court) ni mahakama ya jumla. Rufaa za kodi lazima zianze TRAB kabla ya kwenda mahakama. Kutokupitia TRAB kwanza ni kukosa mchakato wa kawaida wa kisheria.
question_en: TRAB and the ordinary court (High Court) are the same — is this true?
answer_en: No. TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) is a specialist tax board established under the Tax Revenue Appeals Act. The High Court is a general court. Tax appeals must start at TRAB before going to court. Bypassing TRAB is a failure to follow the proper legal process.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa bidhaa ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa usambazaji wa bidhaa na wakala wa zuio (qualifying buyer) ni asilimia 3, kulingana na Kifungu cha 5(5) cha Sheria ya VAT. Hii ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the VAT withholding rate on goods in Tanzania?
answer_en: The VAT withholding obligation on supply of goods by the Withholding Agent under Section 5(5) of the VAT Act is 3%, effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kumfuta mfanyakazi wa kigeni bila kumrudisha nchini kwake — je, ana wajibu gani?
answer_sw: Ikiwa mfanyakazi wa kigeni (Darasa B) anafutwa kazi, mwajiri ana wajibu wa: (1) kumwarifu Idara ya Uhamiaji kuhusu mwisho wa ajira, (2) kibali cha kazi kinaomba kufutwa au kuhuishwa kwa mwajiri mpya, na (3) kuhakikisha mfanyakazi anarudi katika hali ya halali. Mwajiri anaweza pia kubeba gharama za kurudi kwake.
question_en: If an employer dismisses a foreign worker what immigration obligations apply?
answer_en: If a Class B foreign worker is dismissed, the employer must: (1) notify the Immigration Department of the end of employment, (2) the work permit needs to be cancelled or transferred to a new employer, and (3) ensure the worker returns to lawful status. The employer may also bear repatriation costs.

question_sw: Je, GN 487A inaathiri makampuni makubwa ya kimataifa yanayofanya kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Inategemea muundo wa umiliki na aina ya biashara. GN 487A inazuia watu binafsi wasio raia wa Tanzania kumiliki biashara katika makundi 15 maalum. Makampuni makubwa ya kimataifa (kama MNCs) yanayofanya kazi Tanzania kwa njia ya kampuni iliyosajiliwa Tanzania yanaweza kuathiriwa kama mmiliki mkuu au mkurugenzi mtendaji ni mgeni anayeendesha moja ya biashara 15 zilizozuiliwa. Kampuni zinazofanya kazi katika sekta zisizozuiliwa (kama madini, uzalishaji wa viwandani, IT, fedha rasmi) kwa ujumla haziathiriwi. Ushauri wa kisheria ni muhimu kwa kila kampuni kutathmini muundo wake.
question_en: Does GN 487A affect large multinational companies operating in Tanzania?
answer_en: It depends on ownership structure and business type. GN 487A prohibits individual non-Tanzanian citizens from owning businesses in 15 specific categories.
