instruction: Wafanyakazi wa sehemu ya muda (part-time) wanajumuishwa kwenye hesabu ya wafanyakazi 10 wa SDL?
output: Ndiyo — wafanyakazi wa sehemu ya muda (part-time) wanajumuishwa kwenye hesabu ya wafanyakazi wa SDL. Kila mtu anayefanya kazi kwa ajira (employment relationship) na kupata mshahara wa fedha anahesabiwa. Mfano: una wafanyakazi 7 wa wakati wote na wafanyakazi 4 wa sehemu ya muda — jumla ya 11, unafikia kizingiti cha SDL. SDL inakokotolewa kwa mishahara ya fedha ya WOTE (wakati wote na sehemu ya muda). Thibitisha utaratibu huu na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: GN 605A imeinua mishahara — je, hii inaathiri kizingiti cha VAT cha TZS 200M?
output: Hapana — kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT (TZS 200M kwa mwaka au TZS 100M kwa miezi 6) hakibadiliki kwa sababu ya ongezeko la mishahara ya GN 605A. Kizingiti cha VAT kinahesabu MAPATO ya biashara (mauzo ya bidhaa au huduma), si malipo ya wafanyakazi. GN 605A iliathiri mishahara ya wafanyakazi (ikainua mshahara wa chini) — hii inaongeza gharama za biashara na inaweza kupunguza faida — lakini haibadilishi kizingiti cha VAT. Hata hivyo, kama ongezeko la mishahara linafanya biashara kupandisha bei, na bei hizo zinaongeza mapato ya jumla hadi zaidi ya TZS 200M — ndipo kizingiti cha VAT kinahusika. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: VAT return inawasilishwa lini — ni tarehe 20 ya kila mwezi?
output: Ndiyo — VAT return lazima iwasilishwe na VAT inayolipwa TRA kabla ya au tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata. Mfano: VAT ya Januari (mapato ya Januari) → iwasilishwe kabla ya 20 Februari. Kumbuka tofauti: tarehe 20 = tarehe ya VAT RETURN na MALIPO ya VAT. Tarehe nyingine zinazohusiana na VAT: withholding certificate inatoka siku ya muamala (si tarehe 20); qualifying buyer anatuma withholding ndani ya VAT withholding inalipwa TRA tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata — siku ile ile ya VAT return ya kawaida. Si siku 7. Thibitisha na TRA tra.go.tz.. Kama tarehe 20 ni Jumapili au sikukuu — unaweza kuwasilisha siku ya kazi inayofuata. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Ikiwa sekta yangu haipo kwenye jedwali la GN 605A, ninatumia kiwango gani?
answer_sw: Ikiwa sekta yako haipo moja kwa moja kwenye jedwali la GN 605A, tumia kiwango cha jumla (general) cha karibu Shilingi 175,000 kwa mwezi kama kiwango cha chini. Inashauriwa kushauriana na Wizara ya Kazi kwa ufafanuzi.
question_en: If my sector is not listed in the GN 605A schedule, which rate applies?
answer_en: If your sector is not directly listed in the GN 605A schedule, apply the general minimum rate of approximately TZS 175,000 per month as the floor. It is advisable to consult the Ministry of Labour for clarification.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Katika ununuzi wa ardhi Tanzania — mnunuzi au muuzaji ndiye analayepaswa kulipa stamp duty?
output: Stamp duty inatumika kwa uhamisho wa mali Tanzania. Viwango na taratibu halisi vinategemea aina ya mali na thamani yake inayotathminiwa na mthamini aliyesajiliwa. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wajibu wa kulipa stamp duty katika uhamisho wa ardhi unashughulikiwa chini ya Sheria ya Stamp Duty na unategemea masharti ya mkataba wa ununuzi — inahitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kusahihisha VAT return iliyokwisha wasilishwa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRA inaruhusu marekebisho (amendments) ya VAT returns zilizowahi wasilishwa ndani ya muda unaoruhusiwa. Wasilisha VAT return ya marekebisho inayoonyesha tofauti. Kama marekebisho yanasababisha VAT zaidi kulipa, riba na adhabu zinaweza kutumika. Fanya marekebisho mapema iwezekanavyo.
question_en: Can I correct a VAT return that has already been filed?
answer_en: Yes. TRA allows amendments to previously filed VAT returns within the permitted timeframe. Submit an amended VAT return showing the differences. If amendments result in additional VAT payable, interest and penalties may apply. Make corrections as early as possible.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Exporters wana kipaumbele katika refund ya VAT — kweli au uongo?
answer_sw: Kweli kwa ujumla. TRA inatoa kipaumbele kwa exporters katika usindikaji wa VAT refund kwa sababu biashara ya nje ni muhimu kwa uchumi. Exporters wenye mauzo ya zero-rated yanayoonyesha VAT input credit za halali mara nyingi hupata refund haraka zaidi kuliko biashara za ndani. Thibitisha utaratibu wa sasa na TRA.
question_en: Exporters get priority in VAT refunds — true or false?
answer_en: Generally true. TRA gives priority to exporters in processing VAT refunds because foreign trade is important to the economy. Exporters with zero-rated sales showing legitimate input VAT credits often receive refunds faster than domestic businesses. Confirm current procedures with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Kodi ya zuio ya mwisho (final withholding tax) na isiyo ya mwisho (non-final) ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: Kodi ya zuio ya mwisho: mpokeaji haawezi kudai mkopo wa kodi — kodi hiyo ndiyo ya mwisho kabisa kwa mapato hayo. Kodi ya zuio isiyo ya mwisho: mpokeaji anaweza kudai mkopo dhidi ya kodi yake ya mwaka. Thibitisha hali ya malipo yako na TRA.
question_en: What is the difference between final and non-final withholding tax in Tanzania?
answer_en: Final withholding tax: the recipient cannot claim a tax credit — it is the final tax on that income. Non-final withholding tax: the recipient can claim a credit against their annual tax liability. Confirm your payment classification with TRA.

question_sw: SDL na PAYE — ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: PAYE (Pay As You Earn): kodi ya mapato inayokatwa kutoka kwa MFANYAKAZI na kulipwa TRA na mwajiri kwa niaba yake. SDL (Skills Development Levy): ushuru wa 3.5% anaolipa MWAJIRI mwenyewe, si mfanyakazi. PAYE ni kodi ya mfanyakazi; SDL ni ushuru wa mwajiri.
question_en: SDL and PAYE — what is the difference?
answer_en: PAYE (Pay As You Earn): income tax deducted from the EMPLOYEE and remitted to TRA by the employer on their behalf. SDL (Skills Development Levy): a 3.5% levy paid by the EMPLOYER themselves, not the employee. PAYE is the employee's tax; SDL is the employer's levy.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: Niliuza hisa zangu katika kampuni — je, ninapaswa kulipa kodi yoyote kwa faida niliyopata?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Kodi inayotokana na faida ya kuuza hisa (capital gains on share disposal) ni mada ya Income Tax Act ambayo iko nje ya wigo wangu wa mada. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Naweza kulipa mshahara mdogo rasmi na kiasi kikubwa kwa njia nyingine ili kupunguza NSSF?
answer_sw: Hapana — hii ni ukiukwaji wa kisheria wenye hatari kubwa. NSSF na TRA wanaweza kufanya ukaguzi wa malipo yote ya wafanyakazi, ikiwa ni pamoja na mobile money na benki. Kulipa mshahara mdogo rasmi kwa makusudi ili kupunguza NSSF kunachukuliwa kuwa udanganyifu. Adhabu zinajumuisha riba, faini nzito, na uwezekano wa mashtaka ya jinai kwa wakurugenzi. Lipa NSSF kwa usahihi kila mwezi. Wasiliana na NSSF kwenye nssf.or.tz.
question_en: Can I pay a lower official salary and extra amounts through other channels to reduce NSSF contributions?
answer_en: No — this is a serious legal violation. NSSF and TRA can audit all employee payments including mobile money and bank transfers. Deliberately understating official salaries to reduce NSSF is treated as fraud. Consequences include interest, heavy fines, and potential criminal prosecution of company directors. Pay NSSF accurately every month. Contact NSSF at nssf.or.tz.
next_review_trigger: When NSSF Act is amended — VERIFY exact effective date from nssf.or.tz before training

question_sw: Ni adhabu gani MBILI za GN 487A kwa msaidizi Mtanzania — zitaje kwa mpangilio na maneno sahihi?
answer_sw: Adhabu MBILI za GN 487A kwa msaidizi Mtanzania kwa mpangilio: (1) FAINI isiyozidi TZS 5,000,000 — kiwango cha juu (si cha chini); AU (2) KIFUNGO kisichozidi miezi 3 — kiwango cha juu. Neno la kiungo: AU — si NA. Korti inachagua moja kati ya mbili hizi. Hakuna kufutwa kwa visa — msaidizi ni Mtanzania. Msaidizi hana adhabu tatu — ana mbili tu na korti inachagua moja.
question_en: What are the TWO GN 487A penalties for a Tanzanian facilitator — list them in order with exact words?
answer_en: The TWO GN 487A penalties for a Tanzanian facilitator in order: (1) FINE not exceeding TZS 5,000,000 — a maximum ceiling (not a minimum); OR (2) IMPRISONMENT not exceeding 3 months — a maximum ceiling. Connective word: OR — not AND. The court chooses one of these two. No visa revocation — the facilitator is Tanzanian. The facilitator does not have three penalties — only two and the court picks one.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mgeni ana mkoba wa fedha anaoumba biashara mpya — anaweza kufanya nini bila kukiuka GN 487A?
answer_sw: Kuna sekta nyingi ambazo hazizuiliwi na GN 487A na zinaweza kuvutia uwekezaji wa kigeni, kama: uzalishaji wa viwanda, kilimo cha biashara kubwa, madini, ujenzi, teknolojia ya habari, utalii (hotel na lodge, si wakala), afya (hospitali, kliniki), elimu (shule na vyuo), na huduma za kitaalamu (kama sheria na uhasibu kwa firm zilizosajiliwa). Mwekezaji anapaswa kuchunguza sekta hizi na kushauriana na TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) na wakili wa biashara ili kupata mwelekeo sahihi wa jinsi ya kuwekeza kwa njia ya kisheria.
question_en: A non-citizen investor has capital to start a new business — what can they do without violating GN 487A?
answer_en: There are many sectors not restricted by GN 487A that can attract foreign investment, such as: industrial manufacturing, large-scale commercial agriculture, mining, construction, information technology, tourism (hotels and lodges, not agencies), health (hospitals, clinics), education (schools and colleges), and professional services (such as law and accounting for registered firms). Investors should explore these sectors and consult TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) and a business lawyer to get proper guidance on how to invest legally.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Uganda ina kizingiti gani cha usajili wa VAT?
answer_sw: Samahani, sijui kuhusu mfumo wa VAT Uganda. Ninasaidia maswali ya Tanzania Bara tu. Kwa Uganda, wasiliana na Uganda Revenue Authority (URA) kwa ura.go.ug. Je, una swali kuhusu VAT Tanzania? Kizingiti cha VAT Tanzania ni TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12 au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6.
question_en: What is the VAT registration threshold in Uganda?
answer_en: I am sorry, I do not cover Uganda's VAT system. I assist with Mainland Tanzania questions only. For Uganda, contact the Uganda Revenue Authority (URA) at ura.go.ug. Do you have a question about Tanzania VAT? Tanzania's threshold is TZS 200,000,000 per 12 months or TZS 100,000,000 per 6 months.

question_sw: NSSF na PPSMB (PPF) — ni mifumo sawa ya pensheni Tanzania — je, mwajiri anachagua mmoja tu?
answer_sw: NSSF na PPF (Parastatal Pension Fund, inayoitwa pia PPSMB) ni mifumo TOFAUTI ya pensheni Tanzania. NSSF inahudumia wafanyakazi wa sekta ya kibinafsi hasa. PPF inahudumia wafanyakazi wa mashirika ya umma na baadhi ya mashirika ya kibinafsi. Kwa kawaida, mwajiri hawana chaguo — mfumo unategemea aina ya mwajiri (sekta ya umma vs kibinafsi). Angalia mwongozo wa serikali kwa biashara yako maalum.
question_en: NSSF and PPSMB (PPF) — are they the same pension system in Tanzania — does the employer just choose one?
answer_en: NSSF and PPF (Parastatal Pension Fund, also called PPSMB) are DIFFERENT pension systems in Tanzania. NSSF primarily serves private sector employees. PPF serves employees of public institutions and some private ones. Generally, an employer does not have a choice — the system depends on the type of employer (public vs private sector). Check government guidance for your specific type of business.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania
next_review_trigger: Pension sector merger or harmonisation update

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari wa haraka: mgeni TZS ngapi? Msaidizi TZS ngapi? Ni NA au AU? Visa inahusu nani?
answer_sw: Muhtasari: MGENI — faini ya angalau TZS 10,000,000 (kiwango cha chini) NA kifungo hadi miezi 6 NA visa kufutwa. MSAIDIZI — faini ya hadi TZS 5,000,000 (kiwango cha juu) AU kifungo hadi miezi 3. Kwa mgeni: faini AU kifungo (korti inachagua) NA visa kufutwa DAIMA lazima. Kwa msaidizi: faini AU kifungo tu (korti inachagua), bila visa kufutwa. Tofauti kuu: kwa mgeni visa kufutwa ni NA — haiwezi kuepukwa. Chaguo ni kati ya faini na kifungo tu, si kama visa itafutwa au la. Visa inahusu mgeni peke yake — si msaidizi Mtanzania.
question_en: Quick summary: non-citizen how much? Facilitator how much? AND or OR? Visa for whom?
answer_en: Summary: NON-CITIZEN — fine of at least TZS 10,000,000 (minimum) AND imprisonment up to 6 months AND visa revoked. FACILITATOR — fine of up to TZS 5,000,000 (maximum) OR imprisonment up to 3 months. For non-citizen: fine OR imprisonment (court chooses one) AND visa revocation always mandatory. For facilitator: fine OR imprisonment only (court chooses one), no visa revocation. Key distinction: for the non-citizen the visa revocation is always AND — it cannot be avoided. The choice is only between fine and imprisonment, not whether to revoke the visa. Visa applies to non-citizen only — not Tanzanian facilitator.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mzungumzo wa mshahara (CBA) unaweza kuleta mshahara wa juu kuliko GN 605A?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Makubaliano ya pamoja ya mishahara (CBA) yanaweza kuweka viwango vya juu zaidi kuliko GN 605A — na hivyo ni bora kwa mfanyakazi. Lakini hayawezi kuweka viwango vya chini kuliko GN 605A. GN 605A ni sakafu ya chini, si dari la juu.
question_en: Can a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) set wages higher than GN 605A?
answer_en: Yes. A CBA can set rates higher than GN 605A — which benefits the employee. But it cannot set rates below GN 605A. GN 605A is a floor, not a ceiling.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina matawi matatu — kizingiti cha VAT kinahesabu matawi yote pamoja?
output: Ndio — kwa kampuni moja (legal entity moja), mauzo ya matawi yote yanahesabiwa pamoja kwa kizingiti cha VAT. Matawi mawili + makao makuu: mauzo yote yajumuishwe. Ukifika TZS 200M/12 miezi au TZS 100M/6 miezi kwa jumla, kampuni nzima lazima isajili VAT — si tawi moja tu.

instruction: Mgeni ana permit ya kufanya kazi (Class B) Tanzania — anaweza kufungua biashara yake mwenyewe?
output: Hapana moja kwa moja. Class B Residence Permit ni kwa mtu AJIRIWA na kampuni halisi — si kwa kufanya biashara ya kujitegemea. Kama mgeni mwenye Class B anataka kufungua biashara yake mwenyewe, anahitaji Class A Residence Permit (kwa wawekezaji wa kujitegemea). Zaidi ya hayo, hata na Class A, kama biashara ipo katika orodha ya 15 za GN 487A — bado ni marufuku. Mgeni mwenye Class B anafanya kazi kwa mwajiri — si mwajiri mwenyewe. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Muda mzima wa mchakato wa kupinga kodi kutoka tathmini hadi Mahakama ya Rufaa unaweza kuchukua muda gani?
answer_sw: Mchakato mzima unaweza kuchukua miaka mingi: pingamizi (miezi 6 ya Kamishna) + TRAB (miezi 6-12 ya kusikilizwa) + TRAT (miaka 1-2) + Mahakama ya Rufaa (miaka 2-5). Kwa jumla, kesi ngumu ya kodi inaweza kuchukua miaka 5-10 hadi kupata uamuzi wa mwisho. Makubaliano ya mapema ni ya busara mara nyingi.
question_en: How long can the full tax dispute process from assessment to Court of Appeal take?
answer_en: The full process can take many years: objection (Commissioner's 6 months) + TRAB (6-12 months of hearings) + TRAT (1-2 years) + Court of Appeal (2-5 years). Overall, a complex tax case can take 5-10 years to reach a final decision. Early settlement is often prudent.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya ankara ya VAT (VAT invoice) na risiti ya EFD Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Ankara ya VAT (VAT invoice) na risiti ya EFD ni nyaraka tofauti lakini zinaweza kufanya kazi pamoja: Risiti ya EFD ni uthibitisho wa malipo uliotolewa na mashine ya EFD. Ankara ya VAT ni hati ya biashara inayoonyesha maelezo ya bidhaa/huduma, kiasi cha VAT, na TIN za pande zote — inahitajika kwa madai ya input VAT. Biashara nyingi zinatoa risiti ya EFD NA ankara ya VAT pamoja kwa wateja wa biashara (B2B). Kwa wateja wa kawaida (B2C), risiti ya EFD inatosha.
question_en: What is the difference between a VAT invoice and an EFD receipt in Tanzania?
answer_en: A VAT invoice and an EFD receipt are different documents but can work together: An EFD receipt is proof of payment issued by the EFD machine. A VAT invoice is a commercial document showing details of goods/services, VAT amount, and both parties' TINs — required for input VAT claims. Most businesses issue both an EFD receipt AND a VAT invoice together for business customers (B2B). For regular customers (B2C), the EFD receipt is sufficient.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD or VAT invoice requirement update

instruction: Nataka kufunga biashara yangu ya sole trader. Niwasiliane na nani?
output: Kufunga biashara ya sole trader (business name) inayohusisha kusimamisha usajilishaji wa BRELA: (1) wasiliana na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kupata fomu za kufuta usajilishaji; (2) hakikisha kodi zote za TRA zimelipwa — TRA lazima ithibitishe kutokuwa na madeni; (3) wasilisha nyaraka za kufunga BRELA; (4) pata uthibitisho wa kufutwa. Usisahau pia kusasisha leseni nyingine zozote za biashara.

Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Input VAT na Output VAT — tofauti yao nini?
answer_sw: Output VAT: VAT unayokusanya kutoka kwa wateja wako unapowauzia bidhaa/huduma — inakwenda TRA. Input VAT: VAT unayolipa kwa wanaokulaz bidhaa/huduma — inaweza kupunguzwa kutoka output VAT yako. Net VAT = Output VAT - Input VAT. Kama output > input, unatuma tofauti TRA. Kama input > output, una 'VAT credit' ambayo unaweza kubeba au kudai kama refund.
question_en: Input VAT and Output VAT — what is the difference?
answer_en: Output VAT: VAT you collect from your customers when you sell goods/services — it goes to TRA. Input VAT: VAT you pay to your suppliers — it can be deducted from your output VAT. Net VAT = Output VAT - Input VAT. If output > input, you remit the difference to TRA. If input > output, you have a 'VAT credit' which you can carry forward or claim as a refund.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Adhabu gani inatumika kwa hati isiyopigwa stempu inayowasilishwa mahakamani?
answer_sw: Hati isiyopigwa stempu haiwezi kukubalika kama ushahidi mahakamani bila kwanza kulipa kodi ya stempu inayostahili pamoja na adhabu inayotozwa na Mahakama. Pia, mtu anayetumia hati isiyo na stempu kama ushahidi anaweza kulazimishwa kulipa kodi ya stempu yenyewe. Zaidi ya hayo, Sheria ya Kodi ya Stempu ina adhabu za jinai kwa kukwepa kwa makusudi. Daima piga stempu hati ndani ya siku 30 kuepuka matatizo makubwa mahakamani.
answer_en: A document without stamp duty cannot be admitted as evidence in court without first paying the applicable stamp duty plus a penalty imposed by the Court. Additionally, a person seeking to use an unstamped document as evidence may be ordered to pay the stamp duty themselves. Furthermore, the Stamp Duty Act carries criminal penalties for deliberate evasion. Always stamp documents within 30 days to avoid major problems in court.
question_en: What penalty applies to an unstamped document submitted as evidence in court?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — penalties for unstamped instruments

instruction: Afisa wa TRA amekuja ofisini bila kupanga — ana mamlaka ya kuangalia EFD yangu moja kwa moja?
output: Ndiyo. TRA ina mamlaka ya kukagua EFD yako bila taarifa ya awali (surprise inspection). Hii ni sehemu ya utekelezaji wa sheria ya EFD. Afisa ana haki ya kuangalia mfumo wako, kulinganisha rekodi za EFD na vitabu vya hesabu, na kutoa tathmini kama ataona tofauti. Shiriki kikamilifu na umpatie taarifa zote anazoomba — kukataa ni ukiukwaji wa ziada.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi alifanya kazi Tanzania, kisha Kenya, kisha Tanzania tena — akaunti ya NSSF inafanya kazi vipi?
answer_sw: Akaunti ya NSSF ya Tanzania inabaki pale mfanyakazi anapoondoka Tanzania. Michango iliyolipwa kabla ya kuondoka inabaki. Wakati mfanyakazi anarudi Tanzania na kuajiriwa tena, anaendelea na namba ile ile ya NSSF na akaunti yake ya awali. Hata hivyo, miezi ya kufanya kazi Kenya haijumuishwi katika hesabu ya miezi ya michango ya NSSF ya Tanzania. Kwa mwongozo wa hali hii, wasiliana na NSSF.
question_en: An employee worked in Tanzania, then Kenya, then Tanzania again — how does the NSSF account work?
answer_en: The Tanzania NSSF account remains when an employee leaves Tanzania. Contributions made before leaving remain in the account. When the employee returns to Tanzania and is re-employed, they continue with the same NSSF number and their original account. However, months worked in Kenya do not count towards Tanzania NSSF contribution months. For guidance on this situation, contact NSSF.

question_sw: Mgeni ana kibali cha kazi cha mwaka mmoja. Je, kibali hiki kimempa ruhusa ya kufanya biashara ya jumla?
answer_sw: Hapana — kibali cha kazi (work permit) kinamruhusu mgeni kufanya kazi kwa MWAJIRI MAALUM katika kazi iliyobainishwa kwenye kibali. Hakiruhusu kufanya biashara huru ya jumla au aina nyingine yoyote iliyopigwa marufuku na GN 487A. Biashara ya jumla imekatazwa wazi na GN 487A — kibali cha kazi hakibadilishi marufuku hii. Mgeni anayetaka kufanya biashara ya jumla Tanzania anahitaji zaidi ya kibali cha kazi — suala hili linahitaji ushauri wa kisheria.
question_en: A non-citizen has a one-year work permit. Does this permit them to conduct wholesale trade?
answer_en: No — a work permit allows a non-citizen to work for a SPECIFIC EMPLOYER in the job specified on the permit. It does not permit independent wholesale trade or any other business category prohibited by GN 487A. Wholesale trade is explicitly prohibited by GN 487A — a work permit does not change this prohibition. A non-citizen wishing to conduct wholesale trade in Tanzania needs more than a work permit — this matter requires legal advice.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A or work permit regulations

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni (expatriate) Tanzania analipa PAYE kama Mtanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. PAYE inatumika kwa wafanyakazi WOTE wanaofanya kazi Tanzania — wakiwemo wageni na wasio na makazi ya kudumu. Mwajiri analazimika kukata PAYE kutoka kwa mshahara wa mfanyakazi mgeni na kulipa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata, kama ilivyo kwa wafanyakazi wote wengine.
question_en: Does a foreign (expatriate) employee in Tanzania pay PAYE like a Tanzanian?
answer_en: Yes. PAYE applies to ALL employees working in Tanzania — including foreigners and non-permanent residents. The employer is required to deduct PAYE from a foreign employee's salary and remit to TRA by the 7th of the following month, just as with all other employees.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Ikiwa kampuni haikukata WHT inayostahili, nani atabeba adhabu — kampuni au mpokeaji?
answer_sw: KAMPUNI (mlipaji) ndiye atabeba adhabu ya kutokukata WHT. TRA inaweza kudai WHT iliyokosekana, adhabu ya ucheleweshaji (2.5% kwa mwezi), na riba ya kisheria kutoka kwa kampuni — si kwa mpokeaji. Hii ndiyo sababu ni muhimu kwa kampuni kufuatilia WHT yote kwenye malipo yanayostahili.
question_en: If a company failed to deduct required WHT, who bears the penalty — the company or the recipient?
answer_en: The COMPANY (payer) bears the penalty for failure to deduct WHT. TRA can demand the unpaid WHT, late payment penalty (2.5% per month), and statutory interest from the company — not from the recipient. This is why it is critical for companies to track all WHT on qualifying payments.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa benki ana kiwango cha juu cha mshahara wa chini kuliko wengine?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Sekta ya benki na fedha ina kiwango cha mshahara wa chini cha juu zaidi chini ya GN 605A ikilinganishwa na sekta nyingi. Sekta hii iko katika ngazi ya juu za jedwali la GN 605A — angalia jedwali maalum kwa kiwango sahihi.
question_en: Does a bank employee have a higher minimum wage floor than others?
answer_en: Yes. The banking and finance sector has a higher minimum wage floor under GN 605A compared to many other sectors. This sector sits in the upper tiers of the GN 605A schedule — check the specific schedule for the exact rate.

question_sw: Je, kila mpaka wa Tanzania una uwezo wa kushughulikia STR?
answer_sw: Sina uhakika wa orodha kamili ya mipaka yote inayoshughulikia STR Tanzania. Mipaka mikubwa kama Namanga (Kenya), Mutukula (Uganda), na Tunduma (Zambia) kwa ujumla ina mfumo wa STR. Lakini mipaka midogo au ya mbali inaweza kuwa na uwezo tofauti. Thibitisha na Tanzania Revenue Authority (TRA) au ofisi ya forodha ya mpaka unaolengwa.
question_en: Does every Tanzanian border crossing have STR capacity?
answer_en: I am not certain of the complete list of Tanzania border crossings with STR capacity. Major crossings like Namanga (Kenya), Mutukula (Uganda), and Tunduma (Zambia) generally have STR systems in place. But smaller or remote crossings may have different capacity. Verify with TRA or the specific border's customs office.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Ujumla: hatua muhimu 5 kwa mwajiri wa Tanzania aliye na mfanyakazi mgeni.
answer_sw: Hatua 5 muhimu: (1) Omba TIN kwa mfanyakazi mapema; (2) Kata PAYE kwa viwango sahihi kuanzia mshahara wa kwanza; (3) Jumuisha manufaa yote (nyumba, gari, ada za shule) kwenye msingi wa PAYE; (4) Wasilisha PAYE return na malipo kabla ya tarehe 7 ya kila mwezi; (5) Toa P9 kabla ya 31 Machi. Fuata pia NSSF, SDL, na WCF kama inavyotumika.
question_en: Summary: 5 key steps for a Tanzanian employer with a foreign employee.
answer_en: 5 Key steps: (1) Apply for a TIN for the employee early; (2) Deduct PAYE at correct rates from the first salary; (3) Include all benefits (housing, car, school fees) in the PAYE base; (4) File PAYE returns and payments before the 7th of each month; (5) Issue P9 before 31 March. Also follow NSSF, SDL, and WCF as applicable.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

instruction: Udhibiti wadudu (pest control) — mgeni anaweza kuendesha biashara hii Tanzania?
output: GN 487A inakataza shughuli 15 kwa wasio raia Tanzania. Udhibiti wadudu (pest control/fumigation) uko kwenye orodha ya marufuku ya GN 487A. Mgeni hawezi kuendesha biashara hii Tanzania Bara. Hata kama ana ujuzi maalum wa kimataifa wa kemikali au mbinu, sheria inazuia hii. Suluhisho la kisheria: ubia na raia wa Tanzania mwenye leseni na ujuzi unaohitajika.

question_sw: Mgeni wa China ana duka la simu (ukarabati) na duka la rejareja — ni moja au yote mawili yanabeba tatizo la GN 487A?
answer_sw: Yote MAWILI yanabeba tatizo. Ukarabati wa simu NA biashara ya rejareja — zote mbili ziko kwenye orodha ya biashara 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A. Mgeni anayeendesha duka moja au duka mbili za aina hizi anakiuka GN 487A. Kila kesi ni ukiukaji tofauti unaostahili adhabu.
question_en: A Chinese non-citizen has a phone repair shop and a retail shop — does only one or do both carry a GN 487A problem?
answer_en: BOTH carry a problem. Phone repair AND retail trade — both are on the list of 15 prohibited business categories for non-citizens under GN 487A. A non-citizen running one or both shops of these types is violating GN 487A. Each case is a separate violation that deserves a penalty.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Adhabu ya chini kabisa kwa mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A ni ngapi — TZS 500,000 au zaidi?
answer_sw: Faini ya chini kabisa ni TZS 10,000,000 (milioni kumi) — si TZS 500,000 wala TZS 1,000,000. Mbali na faini, mshtakiwa anaweza pia kupata kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 gerezani NA kufutwa kwa visa yake. Ni adhabu kali mno.
question_en: What is the minimum penalty for a non-citizen violating GN 487A — TZS 500,000 or more?
answer_en: The minimum fine is TZS 10,000,000 (ten million) — not TZS 500,000 or TZS 1,000,000. In addition to the fine, the offender may face up to 6 months imprisonment AND visa revocation. The penalties are severe.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Je, kampuni mpya inahitaji usajili wa OSHA kabla ya kuanza kufanya kazi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni mpya yenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi inapaswa kusajiliwa na OSHA KABLA ya kuanza shughuli, au haraka iwezekanavyo baada ya kufikia wafanyakazi 10. Kuanza kufanya kazi bila usajili ni ukiukwaji wa sheria.
question_en: Does a new company need OSHA registration before starting operations?
answer_en: Yes. A new company with 10 or more employees should register with OSHA BEFORE commencing operations, or as soon as possible after reaching 10 employees. Operating without registration is a legal violation.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Biashara ya utalii (tour operator) inahitaji leseni gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Biashara ya utalii inahitaji leseni ya mwendeshaji wa utalii (tour operator licence) kutoka Bodi ya Utalii Tanzania (TTB — Tanzania Tourist Board). Pia inahitaji: usajili wa BRELA kama kampuni au jina la biashara, leseni ya LGA ya halmashauri husika, na TIN/VAT ikiwa mapato yanazidi kizingiti. Kwa safari za mwituni (wildlife safaris), leseni ya ziada kutoka TAWA (Tanzania Wildlife Authority) inaweza kuhitajika. Leseni ya TTB inahuishwa kila mwaka na inahitaji uthibitisho wa uwezo wa kifedha na kitaaluma.
answer_en: A tourism business requires a tour operator licence from the Tanzania Tourist Board (TTB). It also requires: BRELA registration as a company or business name, an LGA licence from the relevant council, and TIN/VAT if income exceeds the threshold. For wildlife safaris, an additional licence from TAWA (Tanzania Wildlife Authority) may be required. The TTB licence is renewed annually and requires proof of financial and professional capacity.
question_en: What licence does a tourism business (tour operator) need in Tanzania?

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina mkopo kutoka kampuni mama yake nje ya Tanzania — kiwango gani cha riba kinachukuliwa kuwa cha kawaida (arm's length)?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Transfer pricing na mkopo wa kampuni washirika (related party loans) inashughulikiwa chini ya Income Tax Act na kanuni za transfer pricing za TRA — inahitaji tathmini ya kiwango cha soko. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kampuni ilinunua jengo kwa biashara na kulipa VAT — inaweza kudai refund?
answer_sw: Ununuzi wa mali isiyohamishika (jengo) unaweza kuzalisha input VAT kama muuzaji alikuwa amesajiliwa VAT na shughuli inastahili. Hata hivyo, mauzo ya ardhi na majengo kwa kawaida yana matibabu maalum ya VAT Tanzania. Thibitisha hali ya VAT ya ununuzi maalum wa jengo lako na mshauri wa kodi au TRA.
question_en: A company bought a building for business and paid VAT — can it claim a refund?
answer_en: Purchasing immovable property (a building) can generate input VAT if the seller was VAT-registered and the supply qualifies. However, sales of land and buildings generally have special VAT treatment in Tanzania. Confirm the VAT status of your specific building purchase with a tax advisor or TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Je, huduma za usafi wa nyumba (cleaning services) zimekatazwa kwa wageni?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — huduma za usafi wa nyumba na ofisi (domestic and commercial cleaning services) ziko kwenye orodha ya biashara 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A. Wageni wanaoendesha kampuni za usafi, kuajiri wafanyakazi wa kusafisha, au kutoa huduma za usafi kama biashara wanakiuka GN 487A.
question_en: Are domestic and commercial cleaning services prohibited for non-citizens?
answer_en: Yes — domestic and commercial cleaning services are on the list of 15 business categories prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A. Non-citizens who operate cleaning companies, employ cleaning workers, or provide cleaning services as a business are violating GN 487A.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A prohibited category list

question_sw: Mwajiri ameacha kulipa PAYE ya mfanyakazi mgeni — mfanyakazi huyo ana hatari gani?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi anaweza kukabiliwa na deni la kodi la kibinafsi kwa PAYE isiyolipwa hata kama mwajiri ndiye aliyekosea. Unashauriwa: (1) Wasiliana na TRA kuripoti tatizo; (2) Hifadhi ushahidi wa mshahara wako na makato yoyote (payslips); (3) Omba msaada wa kisheria kama inabidi. Usitegemea kwamba TRA itamchukulia mwajiri tu.
question_en: An employer has stopped paying PAYE for a foreign employee — what risk does the employee face?
answer_en: The employee may face a personal tax liability for unpaid PAYE even if it was the employer's fault. You are advised to: (1) Contact TRA to report the issue; (2) Keep evidence of your salary and any deductions (payslips); (3) Seek legal help if needed. Do not assume TRA will only pursue the employer.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Mtu lazima asajili VAT ndani ya muda gani baada ya kufikia kizingiti?
answer_sw: Mtu anayehitajika kusajiliwa VAT lazima afanye maombi kwa Kamishna Mkuu ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kufikia kizingiti. Kukosa kusajili kwa wakati kunaweza kusababisha usajili wa lazima na faini. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Within what time must a business register for VAT after reaching the threshold?
answer_en: A person required to register for VAT must apply to the Commissioner General within 30 days of reaching the threshold. Failing to register on time may result in compulsory registration and penalties. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kama TRA haikujibu pingamizi langu baada ya miezi 6, ninafanya nini?
answer_sw: Ikiwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA hajatoa uamuzi ndani ya miezi 6, pingamizi linachukuliwa kama limekataliwa kisheria. Unaweza basi kukata rufaa moja kwa moja kwa TRAB ndani ya siku 45. Hakuna haja ya kusubiri muda zaidi — tuma rufaa yako kwa TRAB haraka.
question_en: If TRA does not respond to my objection after 6 months what do I do?
answer_en: If the TRA Commissioner General has not issued a decision within 6 months, the objection is deemed rejected by law. You can then appeal directly to TRAB within 45 days. There is no need to wait longer — file your TRAB appeal promptly.

instruction: Mauzo yangu yabadilika sana kila mwezi — ninajuaje nimefikia kizingiti cha VAT?
output: Fuatilia mauzo yako kila mwezi kwa njia mbili: (1) Jumla ya miezi 12 iliyopita: ukifika TZS 200M → sajili VAT. (2) Jumla ya miezi 6 yoyote ya mfululizo: ukifika TZS 100M → sajili VAT. Mbinu: weka jedwali la mauzo yako kila mwezi. Ukiona mwenendo wa kupanda, jiandae kwa usajili kabla ya kuvuka kizingiti.

question_sw: Kama mfanyakazi anakataa kufanya kazi kwa sababu ya hatari ya usalama, ana haki?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wafanyakazi wana haki ya kukataa kufanya kazi yenye hatari ya haraka na ya kweli ya kifo au majeraha makubwa. Mwajiri haruhusiwi kumfuta mfanyakazi kwa kukataa kufanya kazi hatari. Haki hii inalindwa na Sheria ya OSHA.
question_en: If a worker refuses to work due to a safety hazard do they have the right?
answer_en: Yes. Workers have the right to refuse to perform work that poses an imminent and genuine risk of death or serious injury. An employer may not dismiss an employee for refusing to perform dangerous work. This right is protected under the OSHA Act.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Naona mgeni ana biashara iliyokatazwa — naridhika nani?
answer_sw: Ripoti Idara ya Uhamiaji iliyo karibu nawe au ofisi ya Mkurugenzi wa Wilaya (DC). Unaweza pia kuwasiliana na Polisi. Usihatarisha usalama wako mwenyewe kwa kukabiliana na mtu mwenyewe — ripoti kwa mamlaka rasmi badala yake.
question_en: I see a non-citizen with a prohibited business — who do I report to?
answer_en: Report to the nearest Immigration Services Department office or the District Commissioner's (DC) office. You may also contact the Police. Do not put yourself at risk by confronting the person directly — report to official authorities instead.
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu unalipwa kwa TRA vipi — mchakato ni upi?
answer_sw: Mchakato wa kulipa ushuru wa stempu Tanzania: (1) amua kiasi cha ushuru kinachohitajika kulingana na aina ya hati na thamani, (2) tembelea ofisi ya TRA au tumia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa TRA kupata PRN (Payment Reference Number), (3) lipa kupitia benki iliyoidhinishwa au mfumo wa e-payment, (4) hati yako inachapishwa/kupigiwa muhuri wa stempu na TRA kama uthibitisho wa malipo.
question_en: How is stamp duty paid to TRA — what is the process?
answer_en: Stamp duty payment process in Tanzania: (1) determine the required duty amount based on instrument type and value, (2) visit a TRA office or use the TRA online system to get a PRN (Payment Reference Number), (3) pay through an authorised bank or e-payment system, (4) your instrument is stamped or endorsed by TRA as proof of payment.

question_sw: WHT kwa malipo ya royalties kwa kampuni ya kigeni ni sawa na kwa kampuni ya ndani — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo kwa royalties — kiwango cha WHT kwa royalties ni asilimia 15 kwa wakazi NA wasio wakazi. Hii inaifanya royalties tofauti na aina nyingine za malipo ambapo wakazi wanafaidika na kiwango cha chini. Kwa royalties, kiwango ni sawa kwa wote.
question_en: WHT on royalties paid to a foreign company is the same as for a domestic company — is this true?
answer_en: Yes for royalties — the WHT rate on royalties is 15% for both residents AND non-residents. This makes royalties different from other payment types where residents benefit from a lower rate. For royalties the rate is equal for all.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu ana namba ya NSSF ya zamani asiyoijua. Je, tunafanya nini?
answer_sw: Ikiwa mfanyakazi hajui namba yake ya zamani ya NSSF, hatua ni: (1) Tembelea ofisi ya NSSF karibu nawe na kitambulisho cha taifa (NIDA) au pasipoti; (2) NSSF itafuta namba yake ya zamani kwa kutumia taarifa zake za kibinafsi; (3) Kama hakuna akaunti ya zamani, NSSF itasajili upya. Mwajiri asimwandikishe mfanyakazi kwa namba mpya bila kwanza kuthibitisha hali yake ya sasa na NSSF.
question_en: My employee has an old NSSF number they don't know. What do we do?
answer_en: If an employee doesn't know their old NSSF number, the steps are: (1) Visit the nearest NSSF office with a national ID (NIDA) or passport; (2) NSSF will search for their old number using their personal details; (3) If no old account exists, NSSF will register afresh. The employer should not register the employee with a new number without first confirming their status with NSSF.

question_sw: Mgahawa wangu unahitaji leseni maalum zaidi ya leseni ya kawaida ya LGA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mgahawa na biashara za chakula zinahitaji leseni maalum za ziada, ambazo ni pamoja na: leseni ya chakula (food handling certificate) kutoka kwa Mamlaka ya Chakula na Dawa Tanzania (TMDA), cheti cha afya (health certificate) cha watumishi wote wanaoshughulikia chakula, ukaguzi wa mazingira na usafi wa mazingira (environmental health inspection) kutoka Halmashauri, na wakati mwingine leseni ya biashara ya vinywaji. Ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara hufanywa na maafisa wa afya wa Halmashauri.
answer_en: Yes. Restaurants and food businesses require additional special licences beyond the standard LGA licence, including: a food handling certificate from the Tanzania Medicines and Medical Devices Authority (TMDA), health certificates for all food handlers, an environmental and public health inspection from the Council, and sometimes a beverages business licence. Regular inspections are carried out by council health officers.
question_en: Does my restaurant need additional licences beyond the standard LGA licence?
next_review_trigger: TMDA Act amendment or LGA licence category change

instruction: SDL na NSSF — zinafanana vipi?
output: SDL na NSSF zinafanana kwa kuwa zote ni malipo yanayohusiana na wafanyakazi — lakini ni tofauti kabisa: SDL (→ TRA): 3.5% ya mishahara ya fedha; MWAJIRI peke yake; inaenda mfuko wa mafunzo; kizingiti: wafanyakazi 10+. NSSF (→ NSSF Fund): 10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi = 20% jumla; wote wanashiriki; inaenda mfuko wa pensheni; hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Tofauti muhimu: SDL ni mwajiri peke yake, NSSF ni mwajiri + mfanyakazi. SDL ni kwa waajiri wenye 10+ wafanyakazi; NSSF ni kwa waajiri WOTE. Vyote vinachangia usafi wa biashara lakini kwa madhumuni tofauti kabisa. Thibitisha na TRA na nssf.or.tz.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi kwa wakati huu huu kwa waajiri wawili analipa PAYE mara moja tu — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi kwa waajiri wawili kwa wakati mmoja — yaani ana ajira mbili — ana wajibu wa kuhakikisha PAYE yote inalipwa kwa mshahara wake wote. Kila mwajiri anakata PAYE kwa mshahara wake. Mfanyakazi anaweza kuwa na deni la PAYE ziada ikiwa kanda za PAYE hazikusomwa pamoja. Ni bora kukubaliana na mwajiri mmoja kuhusu mapato yote.
question_en: An employee working for two employers simultaneously pays PAYE only once — is this true?
answer_en: No. An employee with two simultaneous employers has an obligation to ensure all PAYE is paid on total income. Each employer deducts PAYE on their portion. There may be additional PAYE due if bands were not applied cumulatively. It is best to arrange with one employer to aggregate all income for PAYE purposes.

question_sw: BRELA ya kampuni iliyosajiliwa inaweza kuona taarifa zake na mtu yeyote — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Rejesta ya BRELA ni ya umma. Mtu yeyote anaweza kufanya utafutaji kwenye tovuti ya BRELA ili kuona: jina la kampuni, tarehe ya uanzishwaji, wakurugenzi walioorodheshwa, na hali ya usajili. Utafutaji huu ni wa bure au wa ada ndogo.
question_en: Can anyone view the details of a BRELA-registered company — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. The BRELA register is public. Anyone can search the BRELA website to see: company name, incorporation date, listed directors, and registration status. This search is free or for a small fee.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Kampuni ina headquarters na tawi moja. Je, VAT return inawasilishwa kwa kila tawi au kwa pamoja?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, kampuni yenye TIN moja ina VAT return moja inayojumuisha taarifa za biashara zote — vikoa vyote na matawi yote. Hata hivyo, kwa vitendo, kila tawi linaweza kuwa na EFD yake tofauti inayopeleka taarifa za mauzo kwa seva ya TRA. TRA inajumuisha taarifa hizi kwa TIN moja kwenye mfumo wake. Wasiliana na TRA kwa mwongozo wa jinsi ya kuwasilisha VAT return kwa kampuni yenye matawi mengi.
question_en: A company has headquarters and one branch. Is VAT return submitted per branch or combined?
answer_en: Generally, a company with one TIN has one VAT return covering all business activity — all locations and branches. However, in practice, each branch may have its own EFD that separately transmits sales data to TRA's server. TRA aggregates these under one TIN in its system. Contact TRA for guidance on submitting VAT returns for a multi-branch company.

question_sw: WHT kwa bima (insurance premiums) ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: WHT kwa malipo ya bima ni asilimia 5. Hii inatumika kwa malipo ya premium ya bima yanayolipwa kwa kampuni za bima. Kiwango hiki kinatumika bila kujali kama kampuni ya bima ni ya ndani au ya kigeni.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on insurance premiums?
answer_en: WHT on insurance premium payments is 5%. This applies to insurance premium payments made to insurance companies. This rate applies regardless of whether the insurance company is domestic or foreign.

question_sw: Wakili wa kigeni anaweza kufungua ofisi ya kisheria Tanzania?
answer_sw: Huduma za kisheria zinasimamiwa na Sheria ya Watetezi (Advocates Act) ya Tanzania, si tu GN 487A. Ili kufanya kazi kama wakili Tanzania, mtu lazima awe mwanachama wa chama cha mawakili cha Tanzania (TLS — Tanganyika Law Society) na awe amesajiliwa na Mahakama Kuu. Sheria ya Watetezi inaweza kuzuia wageni kufanya kazi kama watetezi wanaosimama mahakamani bila vikwazo. GN 487A haitaji huduma za kisheria (legal services) kama moja ya makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa wazi. Hata hivyo, vikwazo vya TLS vinaweza kutumika. Mshauri wa TLS au wakili wa kienyeji anahitajika kwa ushauri sahihi.
question_en: Can a foreign lawyer open a law office in Tanzania?
answer_en: Legal services are regulated by Tanzania's Advocates Act, not just GN 487A. To practice as an advocate in Tanzania, one must be a member of the Tanzanyika Law Society (TLS) and registered with the High Court. The Advocates Act may restrict non-citizens from serving as advocates appearing in court without limitations. GN 487A does not list legal services (legal services) as one of the 15 explicitly prohibited categories. However, TLS restrictions may apply. Consultation with TLS or a local lawyer is needed for accurate advice.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: BRELA inaweza kukataa kusajili jina la kampuni — ni sababu zipi?
answer_sw: BRELA inaweza kukataa kusajili jina la kampuni kama: jina lingine sawa tayari lipo kwenye rejesta, jina linadanganya au linaelekeza vibaya umma, jina linatumia maneno yanayohitaji kibali (kama 'Serikali', 'Taifa', 'Benki'), au jina linakiuka sheria. Maombi yaliyokataliwa yanaweza kupigiwa rufaa.
question_en: Can BRELA refuse to register a company name — what are the reasons?
answer_en: BRELA can refuse to register a company name if: an identical or similar name already exists in the register, the name is misleading or deceptive, the name uses words requiring approval (such as 'Government', 'National', 'Bank'), or the name violates law. Rejected applications can be appealed.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: WCF na NSSF ni sawa — ni shirika moja tu — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. WCF na NSSF ni mashirika tofauti yanayofanya kazi tofauti. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) inashughulikia BIMA ya AJALI za kazi peke yake. NSSF (National Social Security Fund) inashughulikia USALAMA WA JAMII kwa upana zaidi — pensheni, matibabu, mama na mtoto. Waajiri lazima wasajiliwe na ZOTE MBILI tofauti.
question_en: WCF and NSSF are the same — they are just one organisation — is this true?
answer_en: No. WCF and NSSF are separate organisations with different functions. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) handles WORKPLACE ACCIDENT INSURANCE only. NSSF (National Social Security Fund) handles BROADER SOCIAL SECURITY — pensions, medical, maternity. Employers must register with BOTH separately.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: GN 487A ina nguvu ya kisheria au ni mwongozo tu?
answer_sw: GN 487A ina nguvu kamili ya kisheria. Ni amri rasmi iliyosajiliwa kwenye Tanzania Government Gazette, iliyotolewa chini ya Sheria ya Leseni za Biashara (Business Licensing Act). Kwa sababu imesajiliwa rasmi (gazetted), ina nguvu ya sheria kama ilivyo sheria yoyote nyingine ya Tanzania. Kutofuata amri hii kunasababisha mashtaka ya jinai (criminal prosecution), si adhabu za kiutawala tu. Idara ya Uhamiaji ina nguvu ya kukamata na kushtaki watu wanaokiuka GN 487A moja kwa moja bila taarifa ya awali.
question_en: Does GN 487A have legal force or is it just a guideline?
answer_en: GN 487A has full legal force. It is a formal Order published in the Tanzania Government Gazette, issued under the Business Licensing Act. Because it is officially gazetted, it has the same force as any other Tanzanian law. Non-compliance results in criminal prosecution, not just administrative penalties. The Immigration Department has the power to arrest and prosecute persons violating GN 487A directly, without prior warning.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Kama mmiliki wa biashara ya jina nafariki — biashara inakuwa mali ya familia yangu?
output: Hali ya biashara ya jina inapokufa mmiliki ni ngumu kisheria: biashara ya jina HAIWEZI kuendelea kwa jina hilo — inakufa pamoja na mmiliki kisheria. Familia inaweza: (1) Kurithi mali za biashara (vifaa, hesabu, stoo); (2) Kuanzisha biashara mpya (jina jipya au kampuni) na kutumia mali zilizo; (3) Kuendelea na biashara iwapo wanapata usajili mpya. Tofauti na kampuni ya hisa: kampuni inaendelea hata mmiliki/mwanachama akifariki — hisa zinaendelea. Kwa biashara inayotaka kuendelea familia, kampuni inashauriwa. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Adhabu za kutotumia EFD au kutotoa risiti ya EFD Tanzania ni zipi?
answer_sw: Adhabu za kukiuka sheria za EFD Tanzania ni kali: (1) faini ya kiasi kikubwa kwa kutotoa risiti ya EFD, (2) kufungwa kwa biashara kwa muda — TRA ina mamlaka ya kufunga biashara inayokiuka sheria za EFD, (3) ukaguzi wa kina wa biashara yako na TRA, (4) hatari ya tathmini ya kodi kwa kipindi kilichopita. Faini na adhabu zinaweza kuwa TZS 1M-5M au zaidi kulingana na ukiukwaji.
question_en: What are the penalties for not using an EFD or not issuing an EFD receipt in Tanzania?
answer_en: Penalties for EFD law violations in Tanzania are severe: (1) large fines for not issuing an EFD receipt, (2) temporary business closure — TRA has authority to close a business that violates EFD rules, (3) detailed TRA audit of your business, (4) risk of tax assessment for past periods. Fines and penalties can be TZS 1M-5M or more depending on the violation.

instruction: Nilipiwa faini kwa kuchelewa kusajiliwa VAT. Je, faini ni ngapi?
output: Adhabu kwa kushindwa kusajiliwa VAT kwa wakati ni: faini ya hadi TZS 200,000 NA/AU kifungo cha miezi 2 hadi 12 PAMOJA NA riba kwenye VAT yote iliyostahili kukusanywa na kutolipwa. Kumbuka: kuchelewa kusajiliwa ni tofauti na kuchelewa kulipa VAT — zote mbili zina adhabu. Kama una tatizo la usajilishaji uliochelewa, wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) na mshauri wa kodi haraka.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Orodha ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiwa kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A ni zipi?
answer_sw: GN 487A inazuia raia wa kigeni kufanya shughuli hizi: biashara ya jumla na rejareja, uhamisho wa pesa ya simu (mobile money), ukarabati wa simu, salon na kinyozi, na shughuli nyingine 11 zilizo kwenye jedwali la GN 487A. Kwa orodha kamili ya shughuli 15, angalia gazeti rasmi la serikali (GN 487A ya tarehe 28 Julai 2025) au tanzlii.org.
question_en: What are the 15 business activities prohibited for foreigners under GN 487A?
answer_en: GN 487A prohibits foreign nationals from conducting: wholesale and retail trade, mobile money transfers, phone repair, salon and barber businesses, and 11 other activities listed in the GN 487A schedule. For the full list of all 15 activities see the official Government Gazette (GN 487A dated 28 July 2025) or tanzlii.org.

instruction: Biashara yangu inalipa PAYE na SDL kwa wakati — bado inahitajika kusajili OSHA?
output: Ndiyo — kulipa PAYE na SDL kwa wakati hakubadilishi wajibu wa kusajili OSHA. Hizi ni mifumo tofauti: PAYE na SDL → TRA (kodi); OSHA → Mamlaka ya Usalama na Afya ya Mahali pa Kazi (udhibiti wa mazingira ya kazi). Kila mfumo una wajibu wake tofauti na taasisi yake tofauti. Biashara inayolipa kodi vizuri bado inaweza kufungwa na OSHA kwa kukosa kuzingatia kanuni za usalama wa mahali pa kazi. OSHA inafanya ukaguzi wa usalama — si wa kodi. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz kwa mahitaji ya usajili na ukaguzi.

instruction: Ninaweza kusajili kampuni Zanzibar badala ya Tanzania Bara kwa faida za kodi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa masuala ya Zanzibar. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia Tanzania Bara peke yake. Uamuzi wa kusajili kampuni Zanzibar dhidi ya Tanzania Bara unahusisha mifumo tofauti ya kodi na kisheria — ZRB inasimamiwa tofauti na TRA. Wasiliana na ZRB kupitia zrb.go.tz au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu kwa uamuzi huu. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu.

instruction: Kuna njia ya kupunguza faini ya kuchelewa BRELA?
output: Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Hakuna orodha ya punguzo rasmi la faini katika kanuni za BRELA. Njia bora: wasiliana na BRELA moja kwa moja ikieleza hali yako — wakati mwingine BRELA inaweza kushauriana, lakini hii si haki iliyohakikishwa. Kuwasilisha mapema ni mkakati pekee wa kuepuka faini.

instruction: Kampuni ya kusafisha ofisi au nyumba inayomilikiwa na mgeni — je, GN 487A inahusika?
output: Ndiyo — huduma za usafi (kusafisha ofisi, nyumba, au maeneo ya umma) ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A (tarehe 28 Julai 2025). Mgeni anayemiliki au kudhibiti kampuni ya kusafisha anakabiliwa na: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Hata kama wafanyakazi wote ni Watanzania, kama mmiliki ni mgeni — sheria inatumika. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Mgeni wa Kenya anadai nchi za EAC zinaruhusiwa kufanya biashara yoyote Tanzania — je, hii ni kweli?
output: Hapana — GN 487A inatumika kwa raia wote wa kigeni bila kujali utaifa au uanachama wa EAC. Hata raia wa Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, au nchi nyingine za EAC wanakabiliwa na vikwazo sawa vya orodha ya 15 za biashara zilizopigwa marufuku. Itifaki za EAC za soko la pamoja zinahusu biashara ya bidhaa, si haki ya raia binafsi kufanya biashara yoyote wanayotaka. Adhabu ni sawa: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji. GN 487A kwa maandishi yake inatumika kwa non-citizens wote bila kutenganisha raia wa EAC. Hata hivyo, uhusiano wake na haki za EAC Common Market Protocol (uhuru wa kuanzisha biashara na huduma) unaweza kuhitaji tafsiri ya kisheria ya kina. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Pande mbili zinaweza kukubaliana kwenye mkataba kwamba muuzaji atalipa ushuru wa stempu — je, hii inaweza kuepuka wajibu wa mnunuzi?
answer_sw: Makubaliano ya kibinafsi kati ya muuzaji na mnunuzi kuhusu nani atalipa ushuru wa stempu yanafanya kazi kati yao. Lakini mbele ya TRA na mahakama, ushuru wa stempu bado unabaki wajibu wa kisheria wa pande ya kawaida (mnunuzi). Ikiwa muuzaji alipaswa kulipa lakini hakufanya, mnunuzi anaweza bado kulazimika kulipa ili hati isimame kisheria.
question_en: Can both parties agree in the contract that the seller will pay stamp duty — does this avoid the buyer's obligation?
answer_en: A private agreement between seller and buyer about who pays stamp duty works between themselves. But before TRA and courts, stamp duty remains the statutory obligation of the usual party (buyer). If the seller was supposed to pay but didn't, the buyer may still be required to pay to make the instrument stand legally.

question_sw: Huduma za benki zinalipwa VAT Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Huduma za fedha/benki nyingi Tanzania zimesamehewa VAT (VAT exempt) — hazilipwi VAT. Hata hivyo, 'exempt' ina maana kwamba benki haiwezi kudai input VAT kwenye gharama zake za uendeshaji. Kumbuka: kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT Tanzania ni asilimia 18 — huduma za benki ni mfano wa exempt supplies, si bidhaa/huduma zinazotozwa asilimia 5 au 10.
question_en: Are banking services subject to VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Most financial/banking services in Tanzania are VAT exempt — not subject to VAT. However, 'exempt' means the bank cannot claim input VAT on its operating costs. Note: the standard VAT rate in Tanzania is 18% — banking services are an example of exempt supplies, not goods/services charged at 5% or 10%.

question_sw: Asili ya bidhaa (originating status) na Common List — ni tofauti gani kwa STR?
answer_sw: Hii ni tofauti muhimu sana kwa STR: ORIGINATING STATUS inamaanisha bidhaa imezalishwa ndani ya nchi za EAC/COMESA — hii inahitajika. COMMON LIST inamaanisha aina ya bidhaa imo kwenye orodha ya ~370 zilizoidhinishwa — hii pia inahitajika. Hizi ni masharti MAWILI TOFAUTI. Bidhaa inayotoka EAC lakini haipo kwenye Common List HAIPATWI manufaa ya STR. Bidhaa ipo kwenye Common List lakini imezalishwa China HAIPATWI manufaa ya STR pia.
question_en: Originating status and the Common List — what is the difference for STR?
answer_en: This is a critical STR distinction: ORIGINATING STATUS means goods were produced within EAC/COMESA countries — this is required. COMMON LIST means the type of goods is among the ~370 approved items — this is also required. These are TWO SEPARATE conditions. Goods from EAC that are NOT on the Common List do NOT qualify for STR benefits. Goods that ARE on the Common List but produced in China also do NOT qualify for STR benefits.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: VAT ya uingizaji (imports) inafanyaje kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: VAT ya asilimia 18 inastahili kwa uingizaji wa bidhaa zinazostahili kutoka nje ya Tanzania Bara. Uingizaji wa huduma pia unastahili VAT. Sheria za kawaida za Forodha zinatumika. Thibitisha mahitaji ya VAT ya uingizaji na TRA na Forodha.
question_en: How does VAT on imports work in Tanzania?
answer_en: 18% VAT applies to the importation of taxable goods from outside Tanzania Mainland. Importation of services is also subject to VAT. Normal Customs laws and procedures apply. Confirm import VAT requirements with TRA and Customs.

question_sw: Viwango vya PAYE Tanzania kwa 2025/2026 ni vipi?
answer_sw: Viwango vya PAYE Tanzania Bara (Finance Act 2025): TZS 0–270,000/mwezi: 0%; TZS 270,001–520,000: 8% ya ziada; TZS 520,001–760,000: 20% ya ziada + TZS 20,000; TZS 760,001–1,000,000: 25% ya ziada + TZS 68,000; zaidi ya TZS 1,000,000: 30% ya ziada + TZS 128,000. Thibitisha na TRA baada ya kila Finance Act.
question_en: What are the PAYE rates in Tanzania for 2025/2026?
answer_en: Tanzania Mainland PAYE bands (Finance Act 2025): TZS 0–270,000/month: 0%; TZS 270,001–520,000: 8% on excess; TZS 520,001–760,000: 20% on excess + TZS 20,000; TZS 760,001–1,000,000: 25% on excess + TZS 68,000; over TZS 1,000,000: 30% on excess + TZS 128,000. Confirm with TRA after each Finance Act.

question_sw: Ununuzi wa chakula cha ofisi kwa wafanyakazi — VAT inaweza kudaiwa?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, ununuzi wa chakula kwa wafanyakazi (kama si sehemu ya mauzo ya biashara) unachukuliwa kama matumizi ya kibinafsi — na input VAT yake mara nyingi haiwezi kudaiwa. Hata hivyo, kama kampuni inauza chakula au inaendesha mkahawa kama sehemu ya biashara yake, hali inaweza kutofautiana. Thibitisha na mshauri.
question_en: Office food purchases for employees — can VAT be claimed?
answer_en: Generally, food purchases for employees (if not part of the business's sales) are treated as personal consumption — and input VAT on them often cannot be claimed. However, if the company sells food or runs a cafeteria as part of its business, the situation may differ. Verify with an advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

instruction: Biashara yangu inasajiliwa NSSF lakini ina wafanyakazi 2 tu — kuna kikwazo cha idadi?
output: Hapana — NSSF haina kikwazo cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi MMOJA ana wajibu wa kushajili na kuwasilisha NSSF. Tofauti na SDL (ambayo inahitaji wafanyakazi 10+), NSSF inatumika kwa WAAJIRI WOTE bila kujali idadi. Kwa biashara yenye wafanyakazi 2: wote wawili lazima wasajiliwe NSSF na mwajiri achangie 10%+10% kwa kila mmoja. Ada ndogo za idadi kubwa hazibadilishi hali — kanuni ni sawa. Thibitisha na nssf.or.tz.

question_sw: Mwajiri mwenye matawi mengi atalipa NSSF ofisi ipi?
answer_sw: Michango ya waajiri wenye ofisi zaidi ya mkoa mmoja inalipwa kwenye Ofisi ya NSSF ambayo mchango ulipelekwa. Ofisi za kikanda zinahitajika kushirikiana ili kuhakikisha uzingatiaji wa mwajiri mwenye matawi tofauti. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: Which NSSF office does a multi-branch employer pay contributions to?
answer_en: Contributions for employers with offices in more than one region are accounted for at the NSSF office where the contribution was remitted. Regional offices must cooperate to ensure compliance of employers with different branches. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: EFD inahusiana vipi na VAT — VAT inaonekana kwenye risiti ya EFD vipi?
answer_sw: EFD inashughulikia VAT kiotomatiki kwenye kila muamala: (1) inahesabu kiasi cha VAT (18%) kwenye bei ya mauzo inayostahili, (2) inaonyesha bei kabla ya VAT, kiasi cha VAT, na jumla inayojumuisha VAT kwenye risiti, (3) inarekodia data ya VAT moja kwa moja kwa mfumo wa TRA ili kuandaa tamko la VAT la kila mwezi. Hii inamaanisha data ya tamko lako la VAT inatoka moja kwa moja kwenye rekodi za EFD.
question_en: How does an EFD relate to VAT — how does VAT appear on an EFD receipt?
answer_en: An EFD handles VAT automatically on every transaction: (1) it calculates the VAT amount (18%) on the taxable sale price, (2) it shows the pre-VAT price, VAT amount, and VAT-inclusive total on the receipt, (3) it records VAT data directly to TRA's system to prepare the monthly VAT return. This means your VAT return data comes directly from EFD records.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act VAT or EFD system update

question_sw: Mchakato wa kuomba kibali cha kazi Darasa B Tanzania unachukua muda gani?
answer_sw: Mchakato wa kuomba kibali cha kazi Darasa B unachukua kwa kawaida wiki 4 hadi 8 kutoka tarehe ya kuwasilisha maombi kamili. Hatua ni: (1) mwajiri anawasilisha maombi na nyaraka zote kwa Idara ya Uhamiaji, (2) Idara inakagua na kutathmini, (3) kibali kinatolewa au kukataliwa. Maombi yaliyokosekana nyaraka yanachelewesha mchakato.
question_en: How long does the Class B work permit application process take in Tanzania?
answer_en: The Class B work permit application typically takes 4 to 8 weeks from the date of a complete submission. Steps are: (1) employer submits application and all documents to the Immigration Department, (2) the Department reviews and assesses, (3) permit is issued or refused. Incomplete applications cause delays.

question_sw: EFD inasaidia watu maskini wa Tanzania vipi — risiti za EFD zinawafaidia wananchi?
answer_sw: Risiti za EFD zinalinda wananchi kwa njia kadhaa: (1) biashara iliyotoa risiti ya EFD inathibitisha kwamba alilipa VAT halisi na hakudanganya bei, (2) wananchi wanaweza kutumia risiti za EFD kama ushahidi wa manunuzi kwa madhumuni ya udanganyifu wa bidhaa, (3) TRA inapata mapato zaidi ya kodi ambayo yanaweza kutumiwa kwa huduma za umma. Kampeni ya TRA ya 'Omba Risiti' inawahimiza wananchi kudai risiti za EFD.
question_en: How do EFDs help ordinary Tanzanians — do EFD receipts benefit citizens?
answer_en: EFD receipts protect citizens in several ways: (1) a business that issued an EFD receipt proves it paid the actual VAT and did not deceive on price, (2) citizens can use EFD receipts as purchase evidence for product fraud claims, (3) TRA receives more tax revenue which can be used for public services. TRA's 'Omba Risiti' (Ask for Receipt) campaign encourages citizens to demand EFD receipts.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD public awareness campaign update

instruction: Ningependa kujua — nini tofauti kati ya kampuni iliyofutwa (deregistered) na iliyolala (dormant) BRELA?
output: Tofauti muhimu: Kampuni iliyolala (dormant): bado ipo kwenye orodha ya BRELA, lazima bado iwasilishe annual returns (na kodi kwa TRA), lakini haifanyi shughuli za biashara. Kampuni iliyofutwa (deregistered): imefutwa kabisa kwenye orodha — haina uwezo wowote wa kisheria. Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Kampuni iliyolala lakini haijafanya annual return bado inakusanya faini ya kuchelewa.

question_sw: Mwajiri wa nyumbani (domestic employer) hana wajibu wa PAYE kwa msaidizi wa nyumbani — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kwa ujumla. Ikiwa msaidizi wa nyumbani anapata mshahara unaozidi kiwango cha PAYE cha asilimia sifuri (Shilingi 270,000 kwa mwezi), basi PAYE inatakiwa kisheria. Waajiri wa nyumbani mara nyingi hawajui wajibu huu, lakini sheria inatumika. Msaidizi mwenye mshahara wa GN 605A ya chini ana PAYE kidogo au la.
question_en: A domestic employer has no PAYE obligation for a household worker — is this true?
answer_en: Not as a general rule. If a household worker earns above the PAYE zero-rate threshold (TZS 270,000 per month), PAYE is legally required. Domestic employers often don't know this obligation, but the law applies. A worker at the lower GN 605A rate would have minimal or no PAYE.

question_sw: Ni fani zipi hasa ambazo lazima zisajili VAT bila kujali mauzo chini ya sheria ya Tanzania?
answer_sw: Fani kuu zinazohitajika kusajili VAT bila kujali mauzo ni: (1) Mawakili (advocates) walioidhinishwa na Tanganyika Law Society; (2) Wahasibu na wakaguzi (CPA/auditors) walioidhinishwa na NBAA; (3) Wahandisi walioidhinishwa na Engineers Registration Board (ERB); (4) Wasanifu majengo walioidhinishwa na Architects and Quantity Surveyors Registration Board; (5) Madaktari walioidhinishwa na Medical Council. Orodha kamili inapatikana kutoka TRA moja kwa moja.
question_en: Which professions specifically must register for VAT regardless of turnover under Tanzanian law?
answer_en: The main professions required to register for VAT regardless of turnover are: (1) Advocates licensed by the Tanganyika Law Society; (2) Accountants and auditors (CPA/auditors) licensed by NBAA; (3) Engineers licensed by the Engineers Registration Board (ERB); (4) Architects licensed by the Architects and Quantity Surveyors Registration Board; (5) Doctors licensed by the Medical Council. A complete list is available directly from TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA update to professional VAT list

question_sw: Mgeni ana kinyozi na pia anafundisha kukata nywele. Kufundisha pia kunakatazwa?
answer_sw: Kinyozi (barbershop) kama biashara ya uendeshaji imekatazwa wazi. Kufundisha (training/shule ya ufundi) ni swali tofauti — GN 487A inazuia biashara za uendeshaji zilizoorodheshwa, si kila aina ya shughuli inayohusiana. Hata hivyo, kama 'kufundisha' ni njia ya kukwepa kinyozi kilichokatazwa (mnunuzi wa huduma ni mteja wa kinyozi), inaweza bado kuzingatiwa ukiukaji. Wasiliana na Idara ya Uhamiaji kwa ufafanuzi.
question_en: A non-citizen runs a barbershop and also teaches haircutting. Is the teaching also prohibited?
answer_en: A barbershop as an operational business is explicitly prohibited. Teaching (training/vocational school) is a separate question — GN 487A prohibits the listed operational businesses, not every related activity. However, if the 'teaching' is a way to disguise a prohibited barbershop (the service recipient is effectively a barber customer), it may still be considered a violation. Consult the Immigration Department for clarification.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Mgeni anasimamia tu (manager) biashara ya Mtanzania — si mmiliki — GN 487A bado inahusika?
output: GN 487A inazuia raia wa kigeni kufanya biashara au kuendesha shughuli katika orodha ya 15. Kusimamia biashara kama mkurugenzi mtendaji au meneja mkuu — hata bila umiliki — kunaweza kuchukuliwa kama kufanya biashara kisheria. Idara ya Uhamiaji wanaweza kuchunguza mtu anayedhibiti operesheni halisi ya biashara, si tu jina katika hati. Kama mgeni ni meneja lakini anadhibiti maamuzi yote — hali hii iko katika hatari ya kisheria. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Kama ninatarajia kumwajiri mfanyakazi wa kwanza, niandae mazingira ya OSHA vipi?
output: Kabla ya kumwajiri mfanyakazi wa kwanza: (1) sajili mahali pa kazi na OSHA (osha.go.tz) — hii ni wajibu wa kisheria kuanzia mfanyakazi 1; (2) fanya tathmini ya hatari za usalama mahali pako pa kazi; (3) andaa sera ya usalama na afya; (4) hifadhi vifaa vya msaada wa kwanza (first aid kit); (5) hakikisha njia za kutoka dharura (emergency exits) zipo na zimewekwa alama. Hatua hizi zinakuandaa vizuri kwa ukaguzi wowote wa OSHA.
