Hata hivyo, ikiwa biashara yako itakua na mauzo yatafikia TZS 100,000,000 katika miezi 6 au TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka, utahitaji kusajili VAT na EFD.
question_en: I sell vegetables at the market for TZS 500,000 per month. Do I need an EFD?
answer_en: No, not currently. Sales of TZS 500,000 per month (TZS 6,000,000 per year) are far below the VAT registration threshold (TZS 200,000,000 per year). You are not required to register for VAT, and therefore EFD does not apply to you. However, if your business grows and sales reach TZS 100,000,000 in 6 months or TZS 200,000,000 per year, you will need to register for VAT and EFD.

question_sw: Biashara mpya ndogo ya Tanzania inahitaji kusajiliwa wapi kwanza?
answer_sw: Biashara mpya ndogo ya Tanzania inaanza kwa: (1) BRELA — kusajili jina la biashara au kampuni (TZS 50,000 kwa hifadhi ya jina, TZS 95,000+ kwa uanzishaji wa kampuni), (2) TRA — kupata TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) bila ada, (3) TRA — kusajili VAT ikiwa mauzo yanazidi TZS 200M/mwaka, (4) LGA ya eneo lako — leseni ya biashara. Mpangilio huu wa usajili unafuatwa kwa kawaida.
question_en: Where does a new small Tanzania business need to register first?
answer_en: A new small Tanzania business starts with: (1) BRELA — register the business name or company (TZS 50,000 for name reservation, TZS 95,000+ for company incorporation), (2) TRA — get a TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) at no fee, (3) TRA — register for VAT if turnover exceeds TZS 200M/year, (4) Local Government Authority (LGA) — business licence. This registration sequence is the standard path.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: BRELA fee update or LGA fee change

question_sw: Wateja wanaolipa pesa taslimu — naweza kutotoa risiti ya EFD kwa sababu ni pesa taslimu tu?
answer_sw: Hapana. Aina ya malipo haibadilishi wajibu wa kutoa risiti ya EFD. Sheria ya VAT Tanzania inaitaka risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala — pesa taslimu, mobile money, benki, au njia nyingine yoyote. TRA inafanya ukaguzi wa ghafla na wateja wanaweza kuripoti biashara ambazo hazitoi risiti. Kila muamala, toa risiti ya EFD. Thibitisha na TRA kwenye tra.go.tz.
question_en: My customers pay cash — can I skip the EFD receipt because it is cash only?
answer_en: No. The payment method does not change the obligation to issue an EFD receipt. Tanzania's VAT law requires an EFD receipt for every transaction — cash, mobile money, bank transfer, or any other method. TRA conducts surprise inspections and customers can report businesses that skip receipts. Every transaction, issue an EFD receipt. Confirm with TRA at tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kiwango cha asilimia ya riba ya kisheria ya TRA kwenye kodi iliyochelewa ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Riba ya kisheria ya TRA kwenye kodi iliyochelewa imewekwa kwa kiwango cha asilimia 5 kwa mwezi (au kiwango kinachotangazwa mara kwa mara). Hii inaendelea kukusanyika kwa kila mwezi wa ucheleweshaji. Ni muhimu kulipa kodi kwa wakati ili kuepuka mrundikano wa riba.
question_en: What is the TRA statutory interest rate on overdue tax?
answer_en: TRA statutory interest on overdue tax is set at 5% per month (or the rate periodically announced). This continues to accrue for every month of delay. It is important to pay tax on time to avoid accumulating interest charges.

instruction: Mzigo wa bidhaa unaoingia Tanzania kutoka nje — withholding ya VAT inatumika?
output: VAT withholding (3%/6%) inalenga MAUZO YA NDANI ya Tanzania kati ya qualifying buyer na muuzaji wa Tanzania. Bidhaa zinazoingizwa kutoka nje zinalipa VAT ya forodha (customs VAT) wakati wa kuingia nchini — mfumo tofauti. Withholding ya VAT ya ndani haihusiki na mauzo ya forodha/import. Hata hivyo, baadaye muuzaji wa Tanzania anayezisambaza bidhaa hizo ndani ya nchi — mauzo ya ndani yanaweza kuwa na withholding kwa qualifying buyer. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa mwongozo maalum wa bidhaa za kuagiza na VAT.

instruction: Ni lini wakurugenzi wa kampuni wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi hata kampuni ni ya hisa?
output: Wakurugenzi wa kampuni ya hisa wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi katika hali hizi maalum: (1) Fraudulent trading — kuendesha biashara kwa udanganyifu ukijua kampuni haiwezi kulipa; (2) Wrongful trading — kuendesha biashara ukijua insolvency inakaribia bila kuchukua hatua; (3) Dhamana ya kibinafsi (personal guarantee) waliyotoa kwa mkopo; (4) Kosa la makusudi la kutolipa kodi — TRA inaweza kufuatilia wakurugenzi kibinafsi kwa PAYE na VAT isiyolipwa; (5) Ultra vires acts — kutenda nje ya mamlaka ya kampuni. Hii inaitwa 'lifting the corporate veil'. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Ni wafanyakazi wa aina gani wanahitaji uchunguzi wa afya wa mara kwa mara?
answer_sw: Wafanyakazi wanaofanya kazi katika mazingira hatari — kemikali, vumbi la madini, kelele kali, au mionzi — wanalazimika kupata uchunguzi wa afya wa mara kwa mara. Mwajiri anawajibika kupanga na kulipa kwa uchunguzi huu.
question_en: Which workers require regular health surveillance?
answer_en: Workers in hazardous environments — chemicals, mineral dust, excessive noise, or radiation — must undergo periodic health surveillance. The employer is responsible for arranging and paying for these examinations.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Je, mwanawake mdogo wa mipaka anaweza kutumia STR bila msaada wa mwanasheria?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — hilo ndilo lengo lake. STR iliundwa ili wafanyabiashara wadogo, wakiwemo wanawake wasio na elimu ya juu ya biashara, waweze kutumia forodha kwa urahisi zaidi. Hati (SCO, SCD) ni rahisi zaidi kuliko utaratibu wa kawaida. Ofisi za forodha za mpakani zinapaswa kuwa na wataalam wa kusaidia.
question_en: Can a small woman border trader use STR without a lawyer?
answer_en: Yes — that is exactly the purpose. STR was designed so that small traders, including women without advanced business education, can navigate customs more easily. The documents (SCO, SCD) are simpler than the standard process. Border customs offices should have staff available to assist.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Biashara ya Tanzania iliyo kwenye eneo la EPZ (Export Processing Zone) ina msamaha wa kodi gani?
answer_sw: Kampuni zilizo kwenye EPZ (Export Processing Zone) Tanzania zinaweza kupata vivutio maalum vya kodi kutoka EPZA (Export Processing Zones Authority): msamaha wa kodi ya kampuni kwa miaka 10 ya kwanza, msamaha wa VAT na ushuru wa forodha kwenye vifaa vya uzalishaji, na vivutio vingine. Vivutio hivi ni vya kipekee kwa EPZ — HAVIHUSU biashara za nje ya EPZ. Biashara lazima isajiliwe rasmi na EPZA kupata vivutio hivi.
question_en: What tax exemptions does a Tanzania business in an EPZ (Export Processing Zone) have?
answer_en: Companies in Tanzania's EPZ (Export Processing Zone) may receive special tax incentives from EPZA (Export Processing Zones Authority): 10-year corporate tax holiday, VAT and customs duty exemption on production equipment, and other incentives. These incentives are unique to EPZ — they DO NOT apply to businesses outside EPZ. A business must be formally registered with EPZA to access these incentives.
next_review_trigger: EPZA incentives or Finance Act update

instruction: Nilisahau kupiga Z-report usiku wa jana — sasa nifanye nini?
output: Z-report lazima ipigwe MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Ukisahau: piga Z-report haraka iwezekanavyo asubuhi ya leo, kabla ya mauzo mapya. Z-report iliyochelewa itabainisha tarehe ya jana — hii inaweza kuonekana na TRA. Epuka kukosea mara nyingi: weka mwagizo wa kikumbusho ili upige Z-report kila siku.

question_sw: OSHA inspekta ana mamlaka gani wanapokuja kukagua biashara yangu?
answer_sw: Inspekta wa OSHA ana mamlaka ya: kuingia mahali pa kazi bila notisi awali (wakati wa saa za kazi), kuchunguza rekodi za usalama, kuhoji wafanyakazi, kuchukua sampuli, na kutoa notisi ya uboreshaji (improvement notice) au amri ya kuzuia (prohibition notice) ikiwa kuna hatari.
question_en: What powers does an OSHA inspector have when visiting my business?
answer_en: An OSHA inspector has authority to: enter the workplace without prior notice (during working hours), examine safety records, interview employees, take samples, and issue an improvement notice or prohibition notice if a hazard exists.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Mwajiri analipa PAYE kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi mgeni — je, thamani ya kodi hiyo pia inabeba PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wakati mwajiri analipa PAYE kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi (tax equalization au tax gross-up), thamani ya PAYE hiyo inakuwa manufaa ya ziada ya ajira — ambayo yenyewe pia inabeba PAYE. Hii inasababisha athari ya 'PAYE juu ya PAYE' (cascading tax). Mahesabu ya tax equalization ni ngumu na mara nyingi yanahitaji mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: An employer pays PAYE on behalf of a foreign employee — does the value of that tax also carry PAYE?
answer_en: Yes. When the employer pays PAYE on behalf of the employee (tax equalization or tax gross-up), the value of that PAYE becomes an additional employment benefit — which itself also carries PAYE. This creates a 'PAYE on PAYE' cascading effect. Tax equalization calculations are complex and often require a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Meneja wangu anapata TZS 1,200,000 kwa mwezi. PAYE yake ni TZS ngapi?
question_en: My manager earns TZS 1,200,000 per month. How much PAYE do they owe?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — worked example ITA Cap.332 Finance Act 2025

question_sw: Kampuni inayohangaika na mtiririko wa pesa inaweza kuomba TRA kusimamisha ukusanyaji wa kodi kwa miezi sita — je, ipo utaratibu huo rasmi?
answer_sw: Hakuna msamaha rasmi wa 'kusimamisha kodi kwa miezi sita' Tanzania. Hata hivyo, TRA ina utaratibu wa kupanga malipo ya awamu (instalment plan) kwa walipakodi wenye matatizo ya kweli ya mtiririko wa pesa. Unaweza kuwasiliana na TRA moja kwa moja kueleza hali yako na kuomba mpango wa malipo. Riba ya kuchelewa bado inaendelea hata wakati wa mpango wa malipo — lakini adhabu inaweza kupunguzwa kwa sababu ya ushirikiano.
question_en: A company struggling with cash flow can ask TRA to suspend tax collection for six months — is there such a formal procedure?
answer_en: There is no formal 'six-month tax suspension' in Tanzania. However, TRA has a procedure for arranging payment instalments (instalment plan) for taxpayers with genuine cash-flow difficulties. You can contact TRA directly to explain your situation and request a payment plan. Late interest continues to accrue even during a payment plan — but penalties may be reduced due to cooperation.

instruction: EPZ investors — wanaanza kulipa kodi baada ya miaka mingapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Kipindi cha msamaha wa kodi (tax holiday) kwa wawekezaji wa EPZ/SEZ Tanzania — muda, masharti, na upanuzi wake — vinaamuliwa na EPZA na makubaliano ya uwekezaji maalum nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na EPZA (epza.go.tz) au TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) kwa jibu sahihi.

instruction: Amri ya mshahara wa 2022 ilifutwa rasmi — lini?
output: Ndiyo, Amri ya Mshahara wa Chini ya Sekta Binafsi ya mwaka 2022 ilifutwa rasmi na GN605A kuanzia tarehe 31 Desemba 2025. Tangu Januari 1, 2026, amri hiyo ya 2022 haina nguvu yoyote ya kisheria. Mwajiri yeyote anayeendelea kutumia viwango vya 2022 baada ya Januari 2026 anakiuka sheria. Viwango vilivyopo sasa ni vile vya GN605A peke yake.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: PAYE haihusiani na SDL — zinalipwa kwa njia tofauti kabisa na hazihusiani — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kabisa. PAYE na SDL zote mbili zinatolewa na mwajiri na zinajumuishwa katika mahesabu ya mishahara (payroll). Ingawa ni ushuru tofauti — PAYE inalipwa TRA, SDL inalipwa TRA pia — zinafanywa pamoja kwenye mzunguko wa mishahara. Mwajiri hulipa PAYE kwa niaba ya wafanyakazi na SDL kwa niaba yake mwenyewe.
question_en: PAYE and SDL are completely separate and have no relation — is this true?
answer_en: Not entirely. Both PAYE and SDL are employer-managed and included in payroll calculations. Though they are different levies — PAYE paid to TRA, SDL also paid to TRA — they are handled together in the payroll cycle. The employer remits PAYE on behalf of employees and SDL on their own behalf.

instruction: Kuna training levy ya Tanzania — tofauti na SDL?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Kama kuna ushuru wa mafunzo maalum zaidi ya SDL (Skills Development Levy ya 3.5%) Tanzania, au kama maana yako ni SDL yenyewe, ninahitaji uthibitisho zaidi kutoka chanzo cha msingi. Kwa SDL ninajua vizuri: ni 3.5% ya malipo ya wafanyakazi, kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, inalipwa TRA. Lakini kama una ushuru mwingine maalum akilini, tafadhali wasiliana na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz au mshauri wa kodi kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Rafiki anasema: 'SDL ya 5% inakatwa kutoka kwa mfanyakazi na inalipiwa NSSF.' Sahihi?
answer_sw: Kila sehemu ni kosa. SDL: (1) ni 3.5% — si 5%; (2) inalipwa na MWAJIRI — haikatiwi kwa mfanyakazi; (3) inalipwa TRA — si NSSF. NSSF ni mfumo tofauti kabisa (10%+10%, mwajiri na mfanyakazi). Habari hizi tatu ni potofu.
question_en: A friend says: 'SDL of 5% is deducted from the employee and paid to NSSF.' Correct?
answer_en: Every part is wrong. SDL: (1) is 3.5% — not 5%; (2) is paid by the EMPLOYER — not deducted from employees; (3) is paid to TRA — not NSSF. NSSF is a completely separate framework (10%+10%, employer and employee). All three pieces of information are false.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: Nilikuwa na wafanyakazi 12 na nikalipa SDL — sasa nimebakiwa na wafanyakazi 8 tu. Bado nilazimika kulipa SDL?
output: Idadi ya sasa ya wafanyakazi ndiyo inayohusika kwa kila mwezi. Ukiwa na wafanyakazi 8 kwa mwezi huu, umeshuka chini ya kizingiti cha SDL (wafanyakazi 10) — SDL haihitajiki kwa mwezi huo. Hata hivyo, fuatilia idadi kwa makini kila mwezi — mara idadi ikiwa 10 tena, SDL inatakiwa kulipwa tena mara moja. Thibitisha utaratibu sahihi wa kufuatilia kizingiti na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Malipo ya fidia ya kuachishwa kazi (severance pay) hayapigwi kodi — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kabisa. Sehemu ya malipo ya fidia ya kuachishwa kazi inaweza kuwa exempt kutoka kodi. Hata hivyo, sehemu inayozidi kiwango cha kisheria kinachoruhusiwa inaweza kutoza kodi. Waajiri wanapaswa kushauriana na TRA au mshauri wa kodi kwa maelezo ya kina ya mwaka husika.
question_en: Severance pay on termination is entirely tax-free — is this true?
answer_en: Not entirely. Part of severance pay on termination may be exempt from tax. However, the amount exceeding the permitted statutory threshold may be taxable. Employers should consult TRA or a tax adviser for the specific treatment in the relevant year.

instruction: NSSF rate ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Kiwango: 10% kwa mwajiri + 10% kwa mfanyakazi = 20% ya jumla. Hakuna kiwango kingine — si 5%, si 15%, si 7.5%. Chanzo: NSSF Act na kanuni za NSSF (nssf.or.tz).

question_sw: Gharama za utangazaji (advertising) na masoko (marketing) zinaweza kukatwa kwenye kodi ya mapato ya kampuni?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Gharama za utangazaji na masoko zinazohusiana moja kwa moja na biashara — kama vile matangazo ya televisheni, redio, mitandao ya jamii, mabango, na gharama za burudani za wateja wa biashara (business entertainment) — zinaweza kukatwa kama gharama za biashara zinazoruhusiwa. Hata hivyo, gharama za burudani za wateja ambazo ni za kupita kiasi au zisizo na uhusiano wa wazi na biashara zinaweza kupingwa na TRA. Hifadhi risiti na eleza uhusiano wa kila gharama na biashara. Matumizi ya kibinafsi (burudani la familia au marafiki) hayaruhusiwi.
answer_en: Yes. Advertising and marketing costs directly related to the business — such as television, radio, social media, billboards, and business customer entertainment costs — can be deducted as allowable business expenses. However, customer entertainment costs that are excessive or have no clear business connection may be challenged by TRA. Keep receipts and document the business purpose of each cost. Personal entertainment (family or friends) is not permitted.
question_en: Can advertising and marketing costs be deducted for a company's income tax?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — deductible marketing costs

question_sw: NSSF inalipwa ndani ya muda gani baada ya mwisho wa mwezi?
answer_sw: Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya NSSF Kifungu cha 12, mchango wa NSSF unapaswa kulipwa ndani ya mwezi mmoja (within one month) baada ya mwisho wa mwezi husika. Thibitisha tarehe halisi na NSSF kwani sheria inaweza kusomwa tofauti na mazoea ya vitendo.
question_en: Within what period must NSSF contributions be paid after the end of the month?
answer_en: Under the NSSF Act Section 12, contributions must be paid within one month after the end of the relevant month. Confirm the exact deadline with NSSF as the law may be interpreted differently from practical arrangements.

question_sw: Tax clearance certificate na TIN certificate — ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: TIN certificate: hati inayothibitisha una TIN (Tax Identification Number) — inathibitisha umesajiliwa na TRA. Inatolewa baada ya usajili wa TIN. Tax clearance certificate: hati inayothibitisha huna deni la kodi lililolipwa — inaonyesha una hali nzuri ya kodi. Inatolewa baada ya kulipa kodi zote zinazodaiwa. TIN = utambulisho; Tax clearance = uthibitisho wa uzuri wa kodi.
question_en: Tax clearance certificate and TIN certificate — what is the difference?
answer_en: TIN certificate: a document confirming you have a TIN (Tax Identification Number) — it confirms you are registered with TRA. Issued after TIN registration. Tax clearance certificate: a document confirming you have no outstanding tax debt — it shows your tax standing is clean. Issued after paying all owed taxes. TIN = identity; Tax clearance = confirmation of good tax standing.

question_sw: Mfanyabiashara mdogo anayekusanya pesa za kikundi kwa biashara (VICOBA leader) — ana wajibu wa kodi?
answer_sw: Kiongozi wa VICOBA anayekusanya na kusimamia pesa za kikundi kwa niaba ya wanachama — si mfanyabiashara peke yake. Pesa za kikundi si mapato yake ya kibinafsi. Hata hivyo, kama kiongozi ana mshahara au posho kutoka kwa kikundi, hiyo inaweza kuwa mapato yanayolazimika kodi. Fanya ufafanuzi wa kisheria kwa kiongozi anayekusudia kupata malipo.
question_en: A small business person collecting group savings as VICOBA leader — do they have tax obligations?
answer_en: A VICOBA leader collecting and managing group funds on behalf of members — is not themselves running a business. Group funds are not their personal income. However, if the leader receives a salary or allowance from the group, that may be taxable income. Seek legal clarity for a leader intending to receive payment.

question_sw: Mwajiri anasema: 'Sisi tuna wafanyakazi 10, lakini tunalipa SDL ya 2% tu.' Je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kama kampuni ina wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, kiwango cha SDL ni 3.5% — si 2%. Kulipa 2% tu kunaacha deni la 1.5% kwa TRA, ambayo itasababisha adhabu na riba. Lipeni SDL sahihi ya 3.5% ya jumla ya mishahara.
question_en: An employer says: 'We have 10 employees but only pay 2% SDL.' Is this correct?
answer_en: No. If a company has 10 or more employees, the SDL rate is 3.5% — not 2%. Paying only 2% leaves a 1.5% debt to TRA, which will attract penalties and interest. Pay the correct SDL of 3.5% of total payroll.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ilifanya hasara mwaka huu — je, bado nalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. SDL inahesabiwa kwa mishahara (gross payroll) — si faida ya kampuni. Hata kampuni inayofanya hasara inalipa SDL kama ina wafanyakazi 10+ na inalipalipa mishahara. SDL si kodi ya mapato — ni ushuru wa mwajiri kulingana na mishahara.
question_en: My company made a loss this year — do I still pay SDL?
answer_en: Yes. SDL is calculated on payroll (gross salaries) — not company profit. Even a loss-making company pays SDL if it has 10+ employees and is paying salaries. SDL is not an income tax — it is an employer levy based on payroll.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: Kampuni limited by shares Tanzania — mchakato wa usajilishaji ni upi?
output: Usajilishaji wa kampuni limited by shares kupitia BRELA: (1) angalia na hifadhi jina la kampuni (ORS); (2) andaa Memorandum na Articles of Association; (3) jaza fomu za kuanzisha kampuni; (4) lipa ada za usajilishaji; (5) pokea Certificate of Incorporation. Kwa ada za sasa, hatua kamili, na fomu maalum, angalia brela.go.tz au mfumo wa ORS (ors.brela.go.tz) — usitegemee taarifa za zamani za ada kwani zinaweza kubadilika.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Mwezi huu Siku ya 7 ni Jumamosi. Je, nalipa SDL siku ya 8 (Jumatatu)?
answer_sw: Ikiwa tarehe ya mwisho wa kulipa SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — inakuwa siku ya mapumziko (Jumamosi, Jumapili, au sikukuu), tarehe ya mwisho huhamishwa hadi siku ya kazi inayofuata — yaani Jumatatu. Hii ni kanuni ya kawaida ya ushuru Tanzania. Lipa siku ya Jumatatu bila hofu ya adhabu, lakini thibisha hii na TRA kila mara ya shaka.
question_en: This month the 7th falls on a Saturday. Do I pay SDL on the 8th (Monday)?
answer_en: If the SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — deadline falls on a public holiday, Saturday, or Sunday, the deadline is moved to the next working day — i.e., Monday. This is the standard Tanzanian tax rule. Pay on Monday without fear of penalty, but confirm this with TRA whenever in doubt.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa majaribio (probationary employee) ana haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi katika kipindi cha majaribio ana haki ya angalau kiwango cha chini cha GN 605A cha sekta husika. Muda wa majaribio haupunguzi haki ya mshahara wa chini. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Is a probationary employee entitled to the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: Yes. An employee on probation is entitled to at least the GN 605A minimum wage for their sector. The probation period does not reduce the right to minimum pay. Confirm with MLYWF.

instruction: Ninanunua saruji (cement) na nondo (steel bars) kwa ujenzi — VAT withholding ni asilimia ngapi?
output: Vifaa vya ujenzi kama saruji na nondo ni BIDHAA (goods) — kwa hivyo VAT withholding ni 3% (si 6%). Kanuni ya msingi ya withholding wa VAT: BIDHAA → 3%; HUDUMA → 6%. Malipo ya VAT withholding yanafanywa na mnunuzi anayehitimu (qualifying buyer) kutoka jumla ya bei inayolipwa kwa muuzaji. Kumbuka: withholding certificate lazima itolewa siku VAT inakuwa ya kulipwa — si tarehe ya 20 (ambayo ni tarehe ya kuwasilisha VAT return tofauti). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya kibali cha kazi (work permit) na ruhusa ya kukaa (residence permit) ni nini?
answer_sw: Kibali cha kazi (work permit) kinaruhusu mgeni kufanya kazi maalum na mwajiri maalum Tanzania. Ruhusa ya kukaa (residence permit) kinaruhusu mgeni kukaa Tanzania kwa muda mrefu lakini si lazima kufanya kazi. Mfanyakazi wa kigeni mara nyingi anahitaji vyote viwili — kibali cha kazi kwa ajili ya ajira yake NA ruhusa ya kukaa kwa ajili ya makazi yake Tanzania.
question_en: What is the difference between a work permit and a residence permit?
answer_en: A work permit authorises a foreigner to perform specific work with a specific employer in Tanzania. A residence permit authorises a foreigner to live in Tanzania long-term but does not necessarily authorise employment. A foreign worker often needs both — a work permit for their employment AND a residence permit for their residence in Tanzania.

instruction: Biashara yangu imefungwa na TRA kwa kukosa risiti za EFD — inafunguliwa vipi?
output: Kufungwa kwa biashara na TRA kwa ukiukwaji wa EFD kunahitaji: (1) Kulipa faini zote na adhabu zilizotolewa na TRA; (2) Kuwasilisha maelezo ya jinsi utakavyozingatia sheria ya EFD siku zijazo (compliance plan); (3) Kupata idhini ya TRA ya ufunguzi tena — kwa kawaida kwa barua rasmi; (4) Kuhakikisha EFD inafanya kazi vizuri kabla ya kufungua. Mchakato mzima unaweza kuchukua siku kadhaa hadi wiki. Wakati biashara imefungwa, hakuna mauzo yanayoweza kufanywa kisheria. Wasiliana na TRA mara moja na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Mchakato halisi wa kufungua tena baada ya closure ya TRA unategemea aina ya ukiukwaji na maamuzi ya TRA. Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) moja kwa moja kwa mwongozo wa kesi yako maalum. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Kiwango cha usajili wa OSHA kinaanza kwa wafanyakazi wangapi?
answer_sw: Waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi wanalazimika kusajili mahali pao pa kazi na OSHA kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Usalama na Afya Kazini ya 2003. Biashara zenye wafanyakazi chini ya 10 hazihitajiki rasmi kusajiliwa, ingawa sheria bado inatumika.
question_en: From how many employees does OSHA registration become mandatory?
answer_en: Employers with 10 or more employees must register their workplace with OSHA under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2003. Businesses with fewer than 10 employees are not formally required to register, though the Act's general provisions still apply.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act amendment or threshold change

instruction: Je, GN 487A inazuia mgeni kufundisha katika shule ya kibinafsi?
output: Ufundishaji katika shule ya kibinafsi haujaorodheshwa wazi katika orodha ya 15 za GN 487A. Orodha ya 15 ni: rejareja, jumla, saluni, ukarabati simu, uhamishaji pesa, usafi, ushonaji, upigaji picha, usafirishaji mdogo, delivery, uchapishaji, udhibiti wadudu, mitumba, machinga, na boda boda/bajaj. Hata hivyo, mgeni anayefundisha anahitaji vibali sahihi vya kazi (Class B permit) na idhini ya Wizara ya Elimu. GN 487A peke yake haizuii ufundishaji — lakini sheria nyingine za vibali vya kazi zinatumika. Thibitisha na Wizara ya Elimu na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ina wafanyakazi 3: mmoja anapata TZS 300,000, mwingine TZS 650,000, wa tatu TZS 1,500,000. Jumla ya PAYE ya kampuni kwa mwezi ni TZS ngapi?
question_en: My company has 3 employees: one earns TZS 300,000, another TZS 650,000, third TZS 1,500,000. What is the company's total monthly PAYE?

question_sw: Mtu wa nje ana duka la rejareja la chakula karibu na nyumba yangu — ni halali?
answer_sw: Hapana. Biashara ya rejareja (retail trade), ikiwa ni pamoja na maduka ya chakula, ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania chini ya GN 487A (2025). Mtu huyu wa nje anakiuka amri hii na anaweza kupata adhabu ya faini ya TZS milioni 10 au zaidi pamoja na kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 na kufutwa kwa viza. Kama unataka kuripoti, unaweza kuwasiliana na Idara ya Uhamiaji au Ofisi ya Msajili wa Biashara (BRELA).
question_en: A foreign national has a small retail food shop near my house — is this legal?
answer_en: No. Retail trade, including food shops, is one of the 15 business activities prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens under GN 487A (2025). This foreign national is violating the Order and may face a TZS 10 million or more fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. If you want to report this, you can contact the Immigration Department or the Business Registrations and Licensing Agency (BRELA).
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kulipa kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) TRA ni ipi?
answer_sw: Kodi ya zuio lazima ilipwe TRA ndani ya siku 7 baada ya mwisho wa kila mwezi wa kalenda. Kwa mfano, kodi ya zuio iliyokatwa Januari inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 Februari. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax remittance deadline in Tanzania?
answer_en: Withholding tax must be remitted to TRA within 7 days after the end of each calendar month. For example, withholding tax deducted in January is due by 7 February. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Premiums za bima za afya za wafanyakazi zinastahili msamaha wa insurance premium levy?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Msamaha wa insurance premium levy kwa aina mbalimbali za bima inashughulikiwa chini ya sheria ya bima na kanuni za TIRA — inahitaji mshauri maalum wa sekta ya bima au kushauriana na TIRA moja kwa moja. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Ninafungua biashara mpya — EFD ninapata wapi na inagharimu kiasi gani?
output: EFD inaweza kupatikana kutoka: (1) Wauzaji wa EFD walioidhinishwa na TRA (orodha ya wauzaji ipo kwenye tra.go.tz); (2) Aina za EFD: ECR (Electronic Cash Register), POS (Point of Sale terminal), na ETS (Electronic Tax Stamps) kwa bidhaa maalum. Bei ya EFD inategemea aina na muuzaji — inategemea aina ya kifaa na muuzaji aliyeidhinishwa na TRA. Wasiliana na muuzaji wa EFD moja kwa moja kwa bei za sasa, au angalia orodha ya wauzaji walioidhinishwa kwenye tra.go.tz. TRA inahitajika kusajili EFD yako rasmi kabla ya kuanza kutumia — hii inafanywa kwa TRA moja kwa moja. Isipokuwa TRA imeidhinisha, EFD haifanyi kazi kama fiscal device. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Watoto wa raia wa kigeni waliozaliwa Tanzania — GN 487A inawasimamia?
answer_sw: Inategemea hali ya uraia wao. Ikiwa mtoto amepata uraia wa Tanzania, GN 487A haimthiri. Ikiwa mtoto bado ni raia wa kigeni licha ya kuzaliwa Tanzania, GN 487A inatumika. Mshauri wa kisheria anaweza kusaidia kutathmini hali ya uraia wa kila mmoja.
question_en: Children of non-citizens born in Tanzania — does GN 487A apply to them?
answer_en: It depends on their citizenship status. If a child has obtained Tanzanian citizenship, GN 487A does not apply to them. If the child remains a non-citizen despite being born in Tanzania, GN 487A applies. A legal adviser can help assess each person's citizenship status.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya PAYE na kodi ya mapato ya kampuni ni nini?
answer_sw: PAYE (Pay As You Earn) ni kodi inayokatwa na mwajiri kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi kila mwezi na kuiwasilisha TRA. Ni kodi ya mfanyakazi, si mwajiri. Kodi ya mapato ya kampuni ni kodi inayolipwa na kampuni yenyewe kwenye faida yake baada ya kutoa gharama zinazoruhusiwa. Kampuni inaweza kulipa PAYE kwa niaba ya wafanyakazi wake NA kulipa kodi ya mapato ya kampuni kwenye faida yake — hizi ni wajibu tofauti mbili.
answer_en: PAYE (Pay As You Earn) is tax withheld by an employer from an employee's salary each month and remitted to TRA. It is the employee's tax, not the employer's. Corporate income tax is tax paid by the company itself on its profits after allowing permitted expenses. A company may pay PAYE on behalf of its employees AND pay corporate income tax on its profits — these are two separate obligations.
question_en: What is the difference between PAYE and corporate income tax?

question_sw: PAYE inalipwa na nani — mfanyakazi au mwajiri?
answer_sw: PAYE ni kodi ya mfanyakazi — ni wajibu wa mfanyakazi kisheria. Lakini mwajiri ndiye anayebeba jukumu la kuikata kutoka mshahara na kuiwasilisha TRA kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi. Ikiwa mwajiri hakukata PAYE, mwajiri ndiye anayeadhibiwa kisheria na TRA — si mfanyakazi. Hata hivyo, mfanyakazi bado anaweza kulazimishwa kulipa kodi yake binafsi ikiwa mwajiri hakufanya hivyo. Kwa vitendo: mwajiri anakata → anawasilisha TRA → mfanyakazi anapata mshahara wa mikono (baada ya makato).
answer_en: PAYE is the employee's tax — it is legally the employee's obligation. However, the employer bears the responsibility of withholding it from the salary and remitting it to TRA on behalf of the employee. If the employer did not withhold PAYE, the employer is legally penalised by TRA — not the employee. However, the employee may still be required to pay their own tax personally if the employer failed to do so. In practice: employer withholds → remits to TRA → employee receives take-home salary (after deductions).
question_en: Who pays PAYE — the employee or the employer?

question_sw: GN 605A kwa sekta binafsi na ongezeko la sekta ya umma la Shilingi 500,000 ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: Ni hatua mbili tofauti: GN 605A inashughulikia sekta BINAFSI (sekta 16, sekta ndogo 46) kuanzia Januari 2026, na kiwango cha wastani cha Shilingi 358,322. Ongezeko la Shilingi 500,000 ni la sekta ya UMMA tu, lililotangazwa na Rais Samia kuanzia Julai 2025. Waajiri wa sekta binafsi wanafuata GN 605A; serikali inafuata tangazo la Rais.
question_en: What is the difference between GN 605A for the private sector and the TZS 500,000 public sector raise?
answer_en: These are two separate actions: GN 605A covers the PRIVATE sector (16 sectors, 46 sub-sectors) from January 2026 with an average floor of TZS 358,322. The TZS 500,000 raise applies to the PUBLIC sector only, announced by President Samia from July 2025. Private employers follow GN 605A; government follows the Presidential announcement.

question_sw: Biashara inayofanya mauzo ya mara moja tu kwa mwaka (seasonal business) ina wajibu wa kodi wa kila mwezi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Biashara ya msimu (seasonal) bado ina wajibu wa kodi wa kila mwezi ikiwa ina wafanyakazi: PAYE, NSSF, SDL (ikiwa ≥10) zinawasilishwa kila mwezi. Hata hivyo, kwa miezi ya biashara isipo na shughuli, PAYE na SDL ni sifuri ikiwa hakuna mshahara uliolipwa. Tamko la kodi la mwaka linawasilishwa mwaka mzima hata kama biashara ilifanya kazi miezi 3 tu. Mfumo wa TRA hautambui 'biashara ya msimu' kama aina maalum — sheria za kawaida zinatumika.
question_en: A business that sells only once a year (seasonal business) — does it have monthly tax obligations in Tanzania?
answer_en: A seasonal business still has monthly tax obligations if it has employees: PAYE, NSSF, SDL (if ≥10) are submitted monthly. However, during months with no business activity, PAYE and SDL are zero if no wages were paid. An annual tax return is filed for the full year even if the business only operated for 3 months. TRA's system does not recognise 'seasonal business' as a special category — standard rules apply.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi kwa waajiri wawili analipa PAYE vipi?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi mwenye waajiri wawili au zaidi lazima ataarifu kila mwajiri kuhusu vyanzo vingine vya mapato. Mwajiri mkuu (primary employer) hutumia viwango vya kawaida; waajiri wengine wanatumia kiwango cha juu zaidi (top rate) au makubaliano maalum na TRA. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is PAYE calculated for an employee with two employers?
answer_en: An employee with two or more employers must notify each employer of the other income sources. The primary employer uses the normal tax bands; secondary employers apply the highest rate or a special TRA arrangement. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: CPA wangu alisema hakuhitaji kusajili VAT kwa sababu ana wateja wachache. Anasema ukweli?
answer_sw: Hapana — CPA wako ana kosa. Kama CPA aliyesajiliwa na NBAA Tanzania, anahitajika kusajili VAT BILA KUJALI idadi ya wateja au kiasi cha mapato. Kizingiti cha TZS 200M kinachukulia biashara za kawaida — si fani zilizodhibitiwa kama uhasibu wa kitaalamu. CPA asiyesajili VAT anaweza kukabiliwa na adhabu za kodi na kupoteza leseni yake ya kitaalamu.
question_en: My CPA told me they don't need to register for VAT because they have few clients. Is that true?
answer_en: No — your CPA is mistaken. As a CPA registered with NBAA Tanzania, they are required to register for VAT REGARDLESS of the number of clients or amount of income. The TZS 200M threshold is for ordinary businesses — not for regulated professions like professional accounting. A CPA who fails to register for VAT may face tax penalties and risk losing their professional licence.

question_sw: Nimesikia kwamba kuna mpango wa NSSF wa asilimia 15/5 — ni kweli?
answer_sw: Mpango wa kawaida wa NSSF ni asilimia 10 mwajiri + asilimia 10 mfanyakazi = asilimia 20. Kuna mipango ya hiari ya pensheni ya ziada (occupational pension schemes) ambapo mgawanyo unaweza kutofautiana, lakini hizi ni mipango ya ziada ya hiari — si mbadala wa NSSF ya lazima. Kiwango cha lazima cha msingi cha NSSF ni asilimia 10+10 = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Kwa mwongozo wa mipango ya ziada, wasiliana na NSSF au mshauri wa pensheni.
question_en: I heard there is an NSSF scheme of 15%/5% — is this true?
answer_en: The standard NSSF scheme is 10% employer + 10% employee = 20%. There are voluntary supplementary occupational pension schemes where the split may differ, but these are voluntary additional schemes — not a substitute for mandatory NSSF. The mandatory minimum NSSF rate is 10%+10% = 20% of gross wage. For guidance on supplementary schemes, contact NSSF or a pension consultant.

question_sw: PAYE inalipwa kwa mwezi mmoja ambao haukuwa na wafanyakazi — toa return?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiri aliyesajiliwa PAYE lazima atoe return ya sifuri (nil return) hata kwa miezi ambayo hakuna wafanyakazi au hakuna malipo. Kushindwa kutoa nil return kunasababisha faini. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Must an employer file a PAYE return for a month with no employees?
answer_en: Yes. A PAYE-registered employer must file a nil return even for months with no employees or no payments. Failure to file a nil return attracts a penalty. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Kiwango cha juu zaidi cha mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni TZS ngapi na ni kwa sekta gani?
output: Kiwango cha JUU KABISA (maximum) cha mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni karibu TZS 765,900 kwa mwezi — kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati (international mining and energy). Hii si wastani — ni kiwango cha juu kabisa katika orodha yote ya GN 605A. Kumbuka: wastani wa sekta zote ni TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi — ambayo ni tofauti kabisa na kiwango cha juu kabisa cha TZS 765,900. Thibitisha takwimu hizi na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

question_sw: Kampuni ya ujenzi inahitaji leseni gani kabla ya kuanza kuchukua mikataba ya ujenzi?
answer_sw: Kampuni ya ujenzi lazima iandikishwe na Bodi ya Usajili wa Wakandarasi (CRB — Contractors Registration Board) chini ya Wizara ya Ujenzi. CRB ina madarasa ya usajili (darasa A hadi G) kulingana na uwezo wa fedha na uzoefu wa kampuni. Mkataba wa ujenzi unaozidi kiwango cha darasa la kampuni hauwezi kukubaliwa kisheria. Pia inahitaji: usajili wa BRELA, leseni ya LGA, TIN, na wakati mwingine vibali vya mazingira. Usajili wa CRB unahuishwa kila mwaka.
answer_en: A construction company must register with the Contractors Registration Board (CRB) under the Ministry of Works. CRB has registration classes (Class A through G) based on the company's financial capacity and experience. A construction contract exceeding the company's class limit cannot be legally accepted. Also required: BRELA registration, LGA licence, TIN, and sometimes environmental permits. CRB registration is renewed annually.
question_en: What licence does a construction company need before taking on construction contracts?

instruction: Ninafanya biashara mpaka usiku wa manane — Z-report nipige saa ngapi hasa?
output: Z-report lazima ipigwe MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Wakati halisi: piga Z-report mwishoni mwa mauzo yako ya siku hiyo. Ukifanya biashara hadi saa 6 usiku, piga Z-report saa 6 usiku au mara baada ya mauzo ya mwisho. Usisubiri hadi usiku wa manane ikiwa umekwisha fanya mauzo yako ya mwisho mapema zaidi.

instruction: VAT ya Tanzania ni 18% au kuna viwango vingine?
output: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Kwa manunuzi ya kawaida ya biashara yako: 18%. Kwa mauzo yako ya nje (exports): 0% — unaweza kudai rejareja ya VAT uliyo nayo. Kwa malipo ya kidijitali ya B2C kuanzia Sep 2025: 16% — kanuni za utekelezaji zinasubiriwa.

question_sw: Biashara yangu Tanzania Bara ina wafanyakazi 9 wa kudumu na 3 wa mkataba. Je, wafanyakazi wa mkataba wanajumuishwa?
answer_sw: Jumla ya wafanyakazi wanaolipwa (9 wa kudumu + 3 wa mkataba = 12) unazidi kiwango cha chini cha 10. Kwa hivyo unalazimika kulipa SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — kwa asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi wote 12. Wafanyakazi wa mkataba wanaolipwa mishahara wanajumuishwa katika hesabu ya SDL.
question_en: My Mainland Tanzania business has 9 permanent employees and 3 contract workers. Are contract workers included?
answer_en: Total paid workforce (9 permanent + 3 contract = 12) exceeds the threshold of 10. Therefore you are required to pay SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — at 3.5% of the total payroll for all 12 employees. Contract workers who receive wages are included in the SDL calculation.

instruction: Mwajiri anampa mfanyakazi nyumba ya kuishi bure — thamani ya nyumba hiyo inaongezwa kwenye SDL base?
output: Hapana — thamani ya nyumba inayotolewa na mwajiri (benefit in kind) HAIONGEZWI kwenye SDL base. SDL inakokotolewa kwa malipo ya FEDHA TU. Nyumba ya kampuni ni faida isiyokuwa ya fedha (non-cash benefit) — haijumuishwi kwenye SDL base. SDL = 3.5% x jumla ya mishahara ya fedha ya wafanyakazi wote tu. Hata hivyo, thamani ya nyumba inaweza kuathiri PAYE ya mfanyakazi kama faida ya ziada — hii ni suala tofauti. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kulipa mchango wote wa NSSF 20% bila kukata sehemu ya mfanyakazi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiri anaweza kuchagua kulipa mchango wote wa asilimia 20 bila kukata sehemu ya mfanyakazi (asilimia 10) kutoka mshahara wake. Hii ni chaguo la mwajiri — si lazima lakini inaruhusiwa na Sheria ya NSSF. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: Can an employer pay the full 20% NSSF contribution without deducting the employee's share?
answer_en: Yes. An employer may choose to remit the full 20% contribution without deducting the employee's share (10%) from their wage. This is the employer's option — not mandatory but permitted under the NSSF Act. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Mgeni wetu wa duka anasema ana haki ya kufanya biashara kwa sababu amesimama Tanzania miaka mingi — hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Muda wa kukaa Tanzania hauzidishi haki ya kufanya biashara iliyozuiliwa. GN 487A inazuia watu WASIO RAIA wa Tanzania — bila kujali wamekuwa Tanzania kwa miaka mingapi. Hata mgeni aliyekuwa Tanzania miaka 20 na ana vibali vyote vya makazi bado hawezi kumiliki duka la rejareja, saluni, au biashara nyingine ya makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa. Njia pekee ya kupata haki hiyo ni kupata uraia wa Tanzania.
question_en: Our foreign shop owner says he has the right to do business because he has been in Tanzania for many years — is this true?
answer_en: No. Length of stay in Tanzania does not increase the right to operate a prohibited business. GN 487A restricts those who are NOT Tanzanian citizens — regardless of how many years they have been in Tanzania. Even a non-citizen who has been in Tanzania for 20 years with all valid residence permits still cannot own a retail shop, salon, or any of the other 15 prohibited business categories. The only way to gain that right is to obtain Tanzanian citizenship.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Je, GN 605A inashughulikia wafanyakazi wa kigeni wanaofanya kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. GN 605A inatumika kwa wafanyakazi wote wanaofanya kazi Tanzania, bila kujali uraia. Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania ana haki ya kiwango cha chini kilichowekwa kwa sekta yake.
question_en: Does GN 605A apply to foreign workers working in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. GN 605A applies to all workers employed in Tanzania regardless of nationality. A foreign worker employed in Tanzania is entitled to the minimum wage set for their sector.

instruction: Kiwango cha NSSF inayopelekwa kila mwezi kinakokotolewa vipi?
output: Kiasi cha NSSF inayopelekwa kwa NSSF kila mwezi ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara wa jumla wa kila mfanyakazi. Mwajiri ndiye anayewajibika kupeleka jumla yote — ikiwa ni pamoja na asilimia 10 ya mfanyakazi aliyokatwa kwenye mshahara na asilimia 10 ya mwajiri mwenyewe (mgawanyo wa kawaida). Kwa mgawanyo mwingine halali (15+5 au 20+0), jumla inayopelekwa bado ni asilimia 20. Mwajiri hupeleka malipo moja kwa moja kwa NSSF — si TRA. Thibitisha tarehe ya mwisho ya sasa kwenye nssf.or.tz.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Ndugu yangu mgeni ana duka Dodoma — hajui kama anakiuka sheria. Nisaidie vipi?
answer_sw: Msaidie ndugu yako kufanya hatua hizi haraka: (1) Angalia ikiwa biashara yake ipo katika moja ya makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa (rejareja, jumla, pesa za simu, ukarabati wa simu, saluni, na mengine). (2) Kama ipo kwenye orodha, msaidie kupata wakili wa biashara au wa uhamiaji Dodoma haraka — kabla ya operesheni ya Idara ya Uhamiaji. (3) Chaguo ni: simamisha biashara, au hamisha umiliki kwa Mtanzania kwa njia ya kisheria. Kutokuwa na habari za sheria hakumkinga dhidi ya adhabu — GN 487A haina msamaha wa kutojua.
question_en: My non-citizen sibling has a shop in Dodoma — they do not know if they are breaking the law. How can I help?
answer_en: Help your sibling take these steps urgently: (1) Check if their business is in one of the 15 prohibited categories (retail, wholesale, mobile money, phone repair, salon, and others). (2) If it is on the list, help them find a business or immigration lawyer in Dodoma quickly — before an Immigration Department enforcement exercise. (3) Options are: stop the business, or transfer ownership to a Tanzanian citizen through a legal process. Lack of knowledge of the law does not protect against penalties — GN 487A has no ignorance exemption.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu ana ugonjwa wa kisukari. Je, anatakiwa kufanya kazi?
answer_sw: Samahani, sijui kuhusu magonjwa na uwezo wa kufanya kazi — hii ni maswali ya kimatibabu na kisheria ambayo yanazidi upeo wangu. Kwa masuala ya haki za mfanyakazi mwenye ugonjwa, wasiliana na daktari, mshauri wa sheria za kazi, au Ofisi ya Kazi ya Tanzania. Ninaweza kukusaidia na maswali ya NSSF, SDL, PAYE — je, kuna swali hilo?
question_en: My employee has diabetes. Are they required to work?
answer_en: I am sorry, I do not handle medical and work capacity matters — these are medical and legal questions beyond my scope. For issues about the rights of an ill employee, contact a doctor, a labour law adviser, or the Tanzania Labour Office. I can help with NSSF, SDL, PAYE questions — is there one of those?

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi kinahitajika kwa mwanachama wa familia ya mtu mwenye kibali?
answer_sw: Mwanafamilia tegemezi (mke/mume, watoto) wa mtu mwenye kibali cha kazi anaweza kuomba kibali cha Darasa E (tegemezi). Kibali cha Darasa E kinaruhusu kukaa Tanzania lakini mara nyingi hakiidhinishi kufanya kazi. Ikiwa mwanafamilia anataka kufanya kazi, anahitaji kibali chake mwenyewe cha kazi cha darasa linalofaa.
question_en: Is a work permit required for a family member of a permit holder?
answer_en: A dependent family member (spouse, children) of a work permit holder can apply for a Class E (dependant) permit. A Class E permit allows residence in Tanzania but typically does not authorise employment. If the family member wishes to work, they need their own separate work permit of the appropriate class.

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inayomilikiwa na mgeni — inaweza kufanya biashara ya rejareja?
answer_sw: Hapana — umiliki wa kampuni si njia ya kukwepa GN 487A. Sheria inazuia mgeni kufanya biashara zilizoorodheshwa — hata kwa njia ya kampuni inayomilikiwa na mgeni. Ikiwa mgeni ndiye mmiliki na mwenye nguvu za uamuzi wa kampuni inayofanya rejareja, hii inachukuliwa ukiukaji wa GN 487A. Muundo wa kisheria (kampuni vs mtu binafsi) hauzuii utekelezaji wa sheria.
question_en: A Tanzania company owned by a non-citizen — can it conduct retail trade?
answer_en: No — company ownership is not a way to circumvent GN 487A. The law prohibits a non-citizen from conducting the listed businesses — including through a company owned by a non-citizen. If a non-citizen is the owner and decision-maker of a company conducting retail trade, this is treated as a GN 487A violation. Legal structure (company vs individual) does not prevent law enforcement.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Biashara yangu inafanya kazi Zanzibar na Tanzania Bara — ninajisajili vipi na ninalipa kodi wapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa upande wa Zanzibar. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia Tanzania Bara peke yake. Biashara inayofanya kazi katika maeneo yote mawili inahitaji usajili tofauti — TRA kwa Tanzania Bara na ZRB kwa Zanzibar. Mahitaji maalum ya hali hii yanahitaji ushauri maalum. Wasiliana na ZRB kupitia zrb.go.tz, TRA kupitia tra.go.tz, au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu.

question_sw: Mtu anasema SDL ni 4% ya mishahara — ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango cha SDL ni 3.5% — si 4%. Angalau hadi Sheria ya Fedha inayofuata kuibadilisha, mwajiri analipa asilimia tatu nukta tano (3.5%) ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi wake.
question_en: Someone says SDL is 4% of payroll — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The SDL rate is 3.5% — not 4%. At least until the next Finance Act changes it, the employer pays three point five percent (3.5%) of total employee payroll.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: BRELA ni nini na inafanya nini?
answer_sw: BRELA ni Business Registrations and Licensing Agency — shirika la serikali la Tanzania linalosimamia usajilishaji wa biashara, ikiwa ni pamoja na makampuni (companies), majina ya biashara, ushirikiano (partnerships), na haki za miliki ya akili (intellectual property). Ili biashara yako iwe halali kisheria Tanzania, lazima isajiliwe na BRELA au mamlaka nyingine inayohusika. Tovuti yao ni brela.go.tz.
question_en: What is BRELA and what does it do?
answer_en: BRELA is the Business Registrations and Licensing Agency — the Tanzanian government body that oversees business registration, including companies, business names, partnerships, and intellectual property rights. For your business to be legally recognised in Tanzania, it must be registered with BRELA or the relevant authority. Their website is brela.go.tz.
next_review_trigger: When BRELA Act or mandate is amended

instruction: OSHA ukaguzi unapatikana lini — kampuni inaweza kupanga tarehe yake mwenyewe?
output: OSHA inafanya ukaguzi wa aina mbili: (1) UKAGUZI WA KAWAIDA (routine inspection): unaopangwa na OSHA kulingana na ratiba yao — kampuni haifahamishwi mapema wakati mwingine (hii ni ukaguzi wa kweli); (2) UKAGUZI MAALUM (special inspection): unaofuatia malalamiko ya mfanyakazi, ajali iliyotokea, au ombi la kampuni. Kampuni inaweza KUOMBA OSHA waje kufanya ukaguzi wa usalama (self-requested audit) kujaribu mahali pake pa kazi — hii inaonyesha nia njema ya kuzingatia kanuni. Ukaguzi wa kawaida si wa kupanga na kampuni — OSHA wanakuja wakitaka. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz.

question_sw: Saa za ziada (overtime) hazipigwi kodi ya PAYE — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Malipo ya saa za ziada ni mapato ya ajira na YANAPIGWA KODI ya PAYE. Malipo ya overtime yanaongezwa kwenye mshahara wa mwezi na jumla nzima inakabiliwa na kanda za PAYE. Hakuna msamaha maalum wa PAYE kwa overtime.
question_en: Overtime payments are not subject to PAYE — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Overtime payments are employment income and ARE subject to PAYE. Overtime pay is added to the monthly salary and the total is subject to PAYE bands. There is no special PAYE exemption for overtime.

question_sw: Kama raia wa Tanzania, nikawasiliana na rafiki wa kigeni afanye biashara iliyopigwa marufuku kwa jina langu — je, nitaadhibiwa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, na adhabu ni kali. GN 487A inaadhibu pia raia wa Tanzania wanaomsaidia raia wa kigeni kukiuka marufuku. Adhabu kwa Mtanzania anayemsaidia raia wa kigeni: faini ya TZS milioni 5 au kifungo cha miezi 3 gerezani. Kutumia jina lako ili raia wa kigeni afanye biashara iliyopigwa marufuku kunachukuliwa kama 'kuwezesha' (facilitating) ukiukwaji. Thibitisha hali yako na wakili kabla ya kuchukua hatua yoyote.
question_en: As a Tanzanian citizen, if I allow a foreign friend to run a prohibited business in my name — will I be penalised?
answer_en: Yes, and the penalty is serious. GN 487A also penalises Tanzanian citizens who assist non-citizens to violate the prohibition. Penalty for a Tanzanian who facilitates a non-citizen: TZS 5 million fine or 3 months imprisonment. Using your name to allow a non-citizen to operate a prohibited business is considered 'facilitating' a violation. Confirm your situation with a lawyer before taking any action.

instruction: Niliuza hisa zangu katika kampuni ya Tanzania na kupata faida — capital gains tax inanikabili?
output: Faida inayotokana na uuzaji wa mali kama ardhi, hisa, au majengo inaweza kuwa taxable chini ya Income Tax Act Tanzania. Hesabu halisi inategemea thamani ya ununuzi (cost base), thamani ya uuzaji, na hali yako kama mkazi au asiye mkazi. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Kodi ya mapato ya mtaji (capital gains tax) kwa mauzo ya hisa inashughulikiwa chini ya Income Tax Act — inahitaji utaalamu maalum wa kodi ya mapato. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: NSSF kwa wafanyakazi wanaolipwa kwa siku (daily rated) inahesabiwaje?
answer_sw: NSSF kwa wafanyakazi wanaolipwa kwa siku inahesabiwaje kwa jumla ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla uliolipwa katika kipindi cha malipo (kawaida mwezi). Jumla mshahara = siku zilizofanya kazi × kiwango cha siku. NSSF = jumla ya mshahara × 20% (mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10%). Msingi ni mshahara mkubwa wa jumla — si kiwango cha siku peke yake. Tarehe: ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara.
question_en: How is NSSF calculated for daily-rated workers?
answer_en: NSSF for daily-rated workers is calculated on total gross wages paid in the payment period (usually a month). Total wages = days worked × daily rate. NSSF = total wages × 20% (employer 10% + employee 10%). The base is total gross wage — not the daily rate alone. Deadline: within one month after the salary month.

question_sw: Je, biashara ya mkulima mdogo wa Tanzania inahitaji TIN na kodi?
answer_sw: Mkulima mdogo anayeuza mazao yake kwa matumizi ya nyumbani au soko la karibu kwa kiwango kidogo anaweza kutolazimishwa TIN na kodi rasmi. Hata hivyo, mkulima ambaye ana biashara ya kilimo ya kibiashara — anauza kwa kampuni, sokoni, au nje ya nchi — analazimika kufuata sheria za kodi. Mstari si wazi kabisa. Kwa maswali ya mahususi, wasiliana na TRA au mshauri wa kodi wa kilimo.
question_en: Does a small-scale Tanzanian farmer need a TIN and pay taxes?
answer_en: A small farmer selling their crops for home use or a nearby market at a small scale may not be required to have a TIN and formal taxation. However, a farmer with a commercial farming business — selling to companies, at market, or for export — is required to comply with tax laws. The line is not entirely clear. For specific questions, contact TRA or an agricultural tax adviser.

question_sw: GN 605A ilianza kutumika Julai 2025 — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 605A ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 JANUARI 2026 — si Julai 2025. Julai 2025 ndiyo tarehe ambayo ongezeko la sekta ya umma (Shilingi 500,000) lilianza — hizi ni hatua mbili tofauti. GN 605A ni ya sekta binafsi na ilianza Januari 2026.
question_en: GN 605A took effect in July 2025 — is this correct?
answer_en: No. GN 605A took effect on 1 JANUARY 2026 — not July 2025. July 2025 was the date the public sector raise (TZS 500,000) took effect — these are two separate actions. GN 605A governs the private sector and started January 2026.

question_sw: Je, thamani ya msafara USD 2,000 hasa — STR inatumika au haitumiki?
answer_sw: Kizingiti ni 'haitazidi USD 2,000' — kwa hivyo bidhaa zenye thamani ya USD 2,000 hasa (si zaidi ya) zinastahili STR kama masharti mengine yanakidhiwa. Thamani ya USD 2,001 inatosha kuvuka kizingiti na kusababisha utaratibu wa kawaida.
question_en: If consignment value is exactly USD 2,000 — does STR apply or not?
answer_en: The threshold is 'does not exceed USD 2,000' — so goods valued at exactly USD 2,000 (not more) qualify for STR if other conditions are met. A value of USD 2,001 is enough to exceed the threshold and trigger the standard customs process.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: OSHA inahusiana tu na majeraha ya kimwili — magonjwa yanayosababishwa na kazi hayafunikwi?
answer_sw: Hapana. OSHA ya 2003 inashughulikia USALAMA NA AFYA zote mbili — ikiwa ni pamoja na magonjwa yanayosababishwa na kazi (occupational diseases) kama uziwi wa kelele, magonjwa ya mapafu kutokana na vumbi, na matatizo ya kemikali. Afya ya mfanyakazi kwa njia yote ni wajibu wa mwajiri.
question_en: OSHA only relates to physical injuries — work-caused diseases are not covered?
answer_en: No. OSHA 2003 covers BOTH safety and health — including occupational diseases such as noise-induced deafness, dust-related lung conditions, and chemical health issues. Employee health in all its forms is an employer obligation.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Je, SDL ni kodi mpya iliyoanzishwa na Finance Act 2025?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — imekuwepo kwa miaka mingi Tanzania. Kilichobadilika katika Finance Act 2025 ni kiwango: kilishuka kutoka asilimia 4 hadi asilimia 3.5, kuanzia tarehe 1 Julai 2025. Kodi yenyewe si mpya.
question_en: Is SDL a new levy introduced by Finance Act 2025?
answer_en: No. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — has existed in Tanzania for many years. What changed in Finance Act 2025 is the rate: it was reduced from 4% to 3.5%, effective 1 July 2025. The levy itself is not new.

question_sw: SDL inahesabiwaje — inatumika kwenye mshahara wa msingi peke yake au posho pia?
answer_sw: SDL inahesabiwaje kwa Tanzania inategemea tafsiri ya 'gross emoluments' ya mwajiri. Kwa ujumla, SDL ya 3.5% inahesabiwaje kwenye jumla ya fidia ya ajira inayolipwa kwa wafanyakazi, ikiwa ni pamoja na mshahara wa msingi, posho za nyumba, usafiri, chakula, na malipo mengine yanayohusiana na ajira. Hata hivyo, malipo ya gharama za biashara halisi yanayopigiwa risiti kawaida hayajumuishwi. Kwa tafsiri sahihi ya mwaka huu, wasiliana na TRA au mshauri wa kodi.
answer_en: SDL calculation in Tanzania depends on the interpretation of 'gross emoluments' by the employer. Generally, SDL at 3.5% is calculated on the total employment compensation paid to employees, including basic salary, housing allowances, transport, meals, and other employment-related payments. However, genuine business expense reimbursements supported by receipts are typically excluded. For precise interpretation for this year, contact TRA or a tax consultant.
question_en: How is SDL calculated — does it apply to basic salary only or allowances too?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA SDL circular

question_sw: Duka langu linauza Shilingi 250M kwa mwaka — lazima niandikishe VAT?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ukizidi Shilingi 200M kwa mwaka au Shilingi 100M kwa miezi 6, lazima uandikishe VAT na TRA. Duka lako la Shilingi 250M linazidi kizingiti cha Shilingi 200M kwa mwaka, kwa hivyo uandikishe sasa hivi. Ukichelewa, unaweza kupata adhabu.
question_en: My shop sells TZS 250M per year — must I register for VAT?
answer_en: Yes. If you exceed TZS 200M per year or TZS 100M in 6 months, you must register for VAT with TRA. Your shop at TZS 250M exceeds the TZS 200M annual threshold, so you should register now. Late registration can result in penalties.

instruction: Kama biashara yangu ipo sekta ya viwanda (industrial) — mshahara wa chini ni ngapi?
output: Kulingana na GN605A, kiwango kilichothibitishwa kwa sekta ya viwanda (industrial) ni TZS 200,000 kwa mwezi. Kiwango hiki kilianza Januari 2026. Ikiwa una wasiwasi kuhusu kama kazi fulani ipo katika sekta ya viwanda au sekta nyingine, thibitisha na GN605A kwenye tanzlii.org au Ofisi ya Kazi ili kuhakikisha unatumia kiwango sahihi cha sekta na subsekta.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Mwenzangu mgeni ana duka la kutengeneza simu tangu mwaka 2020 — je, bado anaweza kuendelea?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A (inayofanya kazi kuanzia 28 Julai 2025) hairuhusu istisna kwa biashara zilizokuwepo kabla ya amri. Ukarabati wa simu ni kati ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia. Mwenzako lazima asimamishe shughuli hiyo au ahamishie umiliki kwa raia wa Tanzania. Kuendelea kufanya biashara hii kama mgeni baada ya 28 Julai 2025 ni kuvunja sheria, na adhabu ni faini ya TZS milioni 10 au zaidi, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza. Anashauriwa kupata ushauri wa kisheria haraka iwezekanavyo.
question_en: My foreign colleague has had a phone repair shop since 2020 — can he continue?
answer_en: No. GN 487A (effective 28 July 2025) makes no exception for businesses that existed before the Order. Phone repair is among the 15 activities prohibited for non-citizens. Your colleague must cease that activity or transfer ownership to a Tanzanian citizen. Continuing this business as a non-citizen after 28 July 2025 is a violation, and penalties are a TZS 10 million or more fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. He is advised to seek legal advice as soon as possible.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Je, mwajiri analazimika kulipa NSSF ya sehemu ya mwajiri wakati mfanyakazi yuko likizoni?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — mchango wa mwajiri (employer contribution) wa NSSF ni wajibu wa mwajiri, si mfanyakazi. Wakati mfanyakazi yuko likizo yoyote inayolipwa (maternity, sick leave, annual leave), mwajiri anaendelea kulipa NSSF ya sehemu yake (10%) na kukata mchango wa mfanyakazi (10%) kutoka mshahara unaolipwa. Mwajiri hawezi kusimamisha mchango wake wa 10% kwa sababu mfanyakazi yuko likizoni.
question_en: Is the employer required to pay their NSSF portion while an employee is on leave?
answer_en: Yes — the employer's NSSF contribution is the employer's obligation, not the employee's. While an employee is on any paid leave (maternity, sick leave, annual leave), the employer continues to pay their share (10%) and deduct the employee's share (10%) from wages paid. The employer cannot suspend their 10% contribution because the employee is on leave.

instruction: Mwajiri wangu analipa NSSF kwa kiwango cha chini (underpaying). Ninajuaje?
output: Angalia pay slip yako — thibitisha asilimia 10 au mgawanyo uliokubaliwa unakokotolewa kutoka mshahara wako wa jumla halisi. Kisha thibitisha na rekodi zako za akaunti ya NSSF kwamba kiasi kilichokatwa kweli kweli kimepelekwa NSSF. Kama mwajiri analipa kiasi kidogo kuliko inavyopaswa, ripoti tofauti kwa NSSF (nssf.or.tz) au Ofisi ya Kazi. Underpayment wa NSSF ni ukiukwaji wa kisheria.

Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: Ninatumia mafundi wa nje (contractors/freelancers) wa mikataba mifupi — wanajumuishwa kwenye wafanyakazi wa SDL?
output: Hapana kwa kawaida — wakandarasi wa nje (independent contractors) wanaofanya kazi kwa mkataba wa huduma (service contract), si mkataba wa ajira (employment contract), kwa kawaida HAWAJUMUISHWI kwenye hesabu ya wafanyakazi wa SDL. SDL inalenga wafanyakazi wa ajira (employees). Hata hivyo, tofauti ya mfanyakazi na mkandarasi inaweza kuwa ngumu kisheria — hali halisi ya mahusiano ya kazi inategemea mambo mengi. Thibitisha hali yako maalum na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: WHT kwa malipo ya bima na malipo ya riba ni sawa — asilimia 5 kwa wote — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. WHT kwa malipo ya bima ni asilimia 5, lakini WHT kwa riba (interest) ni asilimia 10 — si asilimia 5. Kiwango cha asilimia 5 kwa riba si sahihi. Kiwango cha asilimia 5 kinatumika tu kwa bima na ada za huduma za wakazi.
question_en: WHT on insurance payments and interest payments is the same — 5% for both — is this correct?
answer_en: No. WHT on insurance payments is 5%, but WHT on interest is 10% — not 5%. A 5% rate on interest is incorrect. The 5% rate applies only to insurance and resident service fees.

question_sw: Je, biashara ya rejareja yoyote imekatazwa, au ni aina fulani tu?
answer_sw: GN 487A inakataza biashara ya jumla (wholesale) NA rejareja (retail) kwa ujumla kwa raia wa kigeni. Hii inajumuisha maduka ya bidhaa, supermarket ndogo, na uuzaji wa moja kwa moja kwa wateja wa Tanzania. Hakuna msamaha kwa aina ndogo ya rejareja au eneo maalum la biashara.
question_en: Is any retail business prohibited, or only specific types?
answer_en: GN 487A prohibits wholesale AND retail trade in general for non-citizens. This includes goods shops, small supermarkets, and direct sales to Tanzanian consumers. There is no exemption for small-scale retail or a specific business location.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: NSSF inahesabiwaje kwa wafanyakazi wanaopata overtime?
answer_sw: Mshahara wa overtime unajumuishwa kwenye msingi wa mshahara mkubwa wa jumla kwa NSSF. Yaani: NSSF = (mshahara wa msingi + overtime + malipo mengine yoyote yanayolipwa kawaida) × 20%. Msingi ni mshahara mkubwa wa jumla — si mshahara wa msingi peke yake. Kiwango: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10%. Tarehe ya mwisho: ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara.
question_en: How is NSSF calculated for employees who receive overtime?
answer_en: Overtime wages are included in the gross wage base for NSSF. That is: NSSF = (basic salary + overtime + any other regularly paid allowances) × 20%. The base is total gross wage — not basic salary alone. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10%. Deadline: within one month after the salary month.

question_sw: Mteja ana haki ya kudai risiti ya EFD Tanzania — je, biashara inaweza kukataa?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kila mteja ana haki ya kupewa risiti ya EFD kwa kila nunuzi wanaofanya. Biashara iliyolazimika kutumia EFD HAIWEZI kukataa kutoa risiti ya EFD. Kutotoa risiti ya EFD ni kosa la kisheria chini ya Sheria ya TRA na inaweza kusababisha faini au kufungwa kwa biashara. Wateja wanashauriwa kudai risiti za EFD na kuripoti biashara zisizozipatia.
question_en: Does a customer have the right to demand an EFD receipt in Tanzania — can a business refuse?
answer_en: No. Every customer has the right to receive an EFD receipt for every purchase they make. A business required to use an EFD CANNOT refuse to issue an EFD receipt. Not issuing an EFD receipt is a legal offence under TRA law and can result in fines or business closure. Customers are encouraged to demand EFD receipts and report businesses that do not provide them.

question_sw: Adhabu ya kulipa chini ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A ni nini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anayolipa chini ya mshahara wa chini anaweza kukabiliwa na malimbikizo ya malipo tofauti kwa mfanyakazi, faini chini ya Sheria ya Ajira na Mahusiano ya Kazini (ELRA), na mashitaka ya jinai. Inspekta wa Kazi ana mamlaka ya kukagua na kuagiza malipo ya nyuma.
question_en: What is the penalty for paying below the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: An employer paying below the minimum wage faces back-pay liability to the employee, fines under the Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA), and possible criminal prosecution. A Labour Officer can inspect and order back payment.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Jinsi ya kusajili biashara na WCF — hatua zipi?
answer_sw: Hatua za kusajili na WCF: (1) nenda ofisi ya WCF au tovuti ya WCF, (2) jaza fomu ya usajili wa mwajiri, (3) wasilisha orodha ya wafanyakazi wote, (4) lipa ada ya usajili (kama inahitajika), na (5) pata nambari ya usajili ya WCF. Baada ya usajili, lipa mchango wa kila mwezi kwa wakati.
question_en: How do you register a business with WCF — what are the steps?
answer_en: Steps to register with WCF: (1) visit a WCF office or WCF website, (2) complete the employer registration form, (3) submit a list of all employees, (4) pay the registration fee (if required), and (5) receive your WCF registration number. After registration, pay the monthly contribution on time.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Ndoa na Mtanzania inabadilisha uraia wa mgeni haraka?
answer_sw: Hapana — ndoa peke yake haibadilishi uraia wa Tanzania haraka. Mchakato wa kupata uraia wa Tanzania unahusisha: maombi rasmi kwa Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani, kipindi cha makazi ya lazima (miaka kadhaa), na idhini ya Rais wa Tanzania. Ndoa inaweza kusaidia mchakato wa kupata uraia lakini si njia ya moja kwa moja au ya haraka. Hadi uraia unapatikana rasmi, mwenza wa ndoa bado ana hadhi ya mgeni.
question_en: Does marriage to a Tanzanian quickly change a non-citizen's citizenship?
answer_en: No — marriage alone does not quickly change Tanzanian citizenship. The process of obtaining Tanzanian citizenship involves: a formal application to the Ministry of Home Affairs, a mandatory residency period (several years), and Presidential approval. Marriage may facilitate the citizenship process but is not a direct or quick path. Until citizenship is formally granted, the non-citizen spouse retains non-citizen status.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A or citizenship law changes

question_sw: PAYE inalipwa kwa mwezi mmoja ambao haukuwa na wafanyakazi — toa return?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiri aliyesajiliwa PAYE lazima atoe return ya sifuri (nil return) hata kwa miezi ambayo hakuna wafanyakazi au hakuna malipo. Kushindwa kutoa nil return kunasababisha faini. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Must an employer file a PAYE return for a month with no employees?
answer_en: Yes. A PAYE-registered employer must file a nil return even for months with no employees or no payments. Failure to file a nil return attracts a penalty. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu kwenye hati za mkopo (mortgage) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Hati za mkopo au rehani (mortgage) Tanzania zina ushuru wa stempu. Kiwango kinategemea Jedwali la Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu — kawaida ni kiasi kidogo cha kawaida au asilimia ya kiasi cha mkopo. Angalia TRA kwa jedwali la hali ya sasa kwani viwango vinaweza kutofautiana kulingana na aina ya mkopo (rehani ya ardhi, mkopo wa biashara, n.k.).
question_en: What is the stamp duty rate on mortgage documents in Tanzania?
answer_en: Mortgage or loan security documents in Tanzania carry stamp duty. The rate depends on the Stamp Duty Act schedule — typically a small fixed amount or a percentage of the loan amount. Check TRA for the current schedule as rates can vary by type of mortgage (land mortgage, business loan, etc.).

instruction: Nikiwa na biashara mpya, nianzie lini kuomba usajilishaji wa VAT?
output: Anza kufuatilia mauzo yako ya kila mwezi mara tu biashara inapoanza. Tazama kipindi kinachozunguka cha miezi 12 — mara tu mauzo yanafika au yanakaribia TZS 200M, omba usajilishaji haraka. Usisubiri mpaka umezidi kizingiti kwa muda mrefu — usajilishaji wa kuchelewa unakuletea faini. Wahasibu au mshauri wa kodi wanaweza kukusaidia kufuatilia mauzo na kujua wakati mzuri wa kuomba.
