instruction: Kampuni ya Kichina inayomilikiwa na Wachina lakini imesajiliwa Tanzania kama kampuni ya Tanzania — je, GN 487A inaitumia?
output: GN 487A inazingatia uraia wa wamiliki/wadhibiti halisi, si tu usajili wa kisheria. Kampuni iliyosajiliwa Tanzania lakini inayomilikiwa na raia wa kigeni (wamiliki wa hisa, wakurugenzi wanaodhibiti) inaweza bado kukiuka GN 487A kwa shughuli zilizo katika orodha ya 15. Hii inaitwa 'shell company' au kampuni ya kimwamba. Mahakama na Idara ya Uhamiaji wanaweza kuchunguza zaidi ya jina la kisheria. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya kujisajilisha kama jina la biashara (sole trader) na kuunda kampuni yenye ukomo (limited company) ni nini?
answer_sw: Tofauti kuu ni wajibu wa kisheria na ulinzi wa mali binafsi. Kama jina la biashara (sole trader): wewe na biashara ni mtu mmoja kisheria. Madeni ya biashara ni madeni yako binafsi — mali yako binafsi inaweza kuchukuliwa. Kama limited company: kampuni ni mtu wa kisheria tofauti nawe. Kwa kawaida mali yako binafsi inalindwa dhidi ya madeni ya kampuni. Limited company inahitaji uwasilishaji wa hesabu za kila mwaka na gharama zaidi za kusimamia, lakini inatoa ulinzi zaidi na heshima ya biashara. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kisheria uchaguzi wako.
question_en: What is the difference between registering as a sole trader (business name) and forming a limited liability company?
answer_en: The key difference is legal liability and personal asset protection. As a sole trader (business name): you and your business are the same legal person. Business debts are your personal debts — your personal assets can be seized. As a limited company: the company is a separate legal entity from you. Your personal assets are generally protected from the company's debts. A limited company requires annual financial reporting and higher management costs, but offers greater protection and business credibility. Confirm your choice with a legal adviser.

instruction: Mfanyakazi wangu aliumia kazini — OSHA, WCF, au NSSF ninaweza mdai nini?
output: Tofauti kati ya OSHA, WCF, na NSSF: OSHA = kuzuia ajali na usalama mahali pa kazi (prevention/regulation). WCF = kulipa fidia baada ya ajali ya kazi (compensation). NSSF = pensheni na usalama wa jamii wa muda mrefu (pension/social security). Ajali ya kazi — vitendo vinavyohitajika: (1) WCF: ripoti ajali ndani ya siku 7 za kazi kupitia portal.wcf.go.tz — WCF inalipa fidia. (2) OSHA: OSHA inaweza kufanya uchunguzi wa ajali. (3) NSSF: inahusika na pensheni/ulemavu wa muda mrefu, si ajali za muda mfupi. Fidia ya haraka kwa ajali: WCF.

instruction: Nilikuwa na kipande cha ardhi kwa miaka 10 na kuiuza kwa faida — kodi ya Tanzania ni nini?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mauzo ya ardhi na kodi inayohusiana (land disposal tax na capital gains) ni mada inayohusisha Income Tax Act, Sheria ya Ardhi, na taratibu za TRA ambazo ziko nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Tafadhali wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Taasisi ya serikali (government agency) inayolipa mishahara kwa wafanyakazi 50 — je, inalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Mashirika ya serikali kwa ujumla hayalazimiki kulipa SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — kama ilivyoelezwa na TRA. SDL inahusu hasa sekta binafsi. Hata hivyo, msamaha huu unatofautiana kwa aina ya taasisi. Mashirika ya serikali yanayofanya biashara kama kampuni za kibiashara yanaweza kutakiwa kulipa. Thibisha hali yako na TRA kwa maandishi.
question_en: A government agency paying salaries to 50 employees — does it pay SDL?
answer_en: Government institutions are generally not required to pay SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — as specified by TRA. SDL primarily concerns the private sector. However, this exemption varies by type of institution. Parastatal bodies that operate commercially may be required to pay. Confirm your status with TRA in writing.

question_sw: Kizingiti cha VAT cha miezi 6 ni TZS ngapi — ni sawa na kizingiti cha miezi 12?
answer_sw: Hapana — viwango ni tofauti. Kizingiti cha miezi 12: TZS 200,000,000 (milioni 200). Kizingiti cha miezi 6: TZS 100,000,000 (milioni 100) tu. Si kizingiti kimoja cha TZS 200M kinachotumika kwa njia zote mbili. Kizingiti cha miezi 6 ni nusu ya cha miezi 12. Kila kimoja kinafanya kazi kwa njia yake: ukizidi MOJA tu kati ya viwango hivi viwili, usajili wa VAT ni wa lazima mara moja.
question_en: What is the 6-month VAT threshold — is it the same as the 12-month threshold?
answer_en: No — the thresholds are different. 12-month threshold: TZS 200,000,000 (200 million). 6-month threshold: TZS 100,000,000 (100 million) only. It is not one threshold of TZS 200M applied in both ways. The 6-month threshold is half of the 12-month one. Each works independently: if you exceed EITHER ONE of these two thresholds, VAT registration is immediately mandatory.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing VAT registration thresholds

question_sw: Kampuni iliyofutwa kwenye rejesta ya BRELA bado ina madeni yake — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kufutwa kwenye rejesta ya BRELA hakuondoi madeni ya kampuni. Wakurugenzi wanaweza kubaki na wajibu wa kibinafsi kwa baadhi ya madeni kulingana na hali. Wadai wanaweza kuomba mahakamani kurejesha kampuni kwenye rejesta ili kulipa madeni. Kufutwa ni hatua ya usajili tu — si uamuzi wa kisheria wa madeni.
question_en: A company struck off the BRELA register still has its debts — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. Strike off from the BRELA register does not extinguish the company's debts. Directors may remain personally liable for some debts depending on circumstances. Creditors can apply to court to restore the company to the register to recover debts. Strike off is a registration step only — not a legal settlement of debts.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mwalimu mgeni anayefundisha shule ya kibinafsi Tanzania — ana tatizo la GN 487A?
answer_sw: Huduma za elimu (shule na vyuo) haziko kati ya makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa na GN 487A. Mwalimu mgeni anayefundisha shule ya kibinafsi hawezi kukiuka GN 487A kwa shughuli hiyo. Hata hivyo, lazima awe na: kibali cha kufanya kazi (work permit) kutoka Wizara ya Kazi, usajili kutoka Wizara ya Elimu (kwa shule), na ATCl (Aliens Travel Certificate, inahitajika kwa baadhi ya aina za wageni). Kama shule hiyo pia inaendesha duka la vitabu na vifaa vya shule (rejareja), sehemu hiyo inaweza kuathiriwa na GN 487A.
question_en: A foreign teacher running a private school in Tanzania — do they have a GN 487A issue?
answer_en: Education services (schools and colleges) are not among the 15 prohibited categories under GN 487A. A foreign teacher running a private school does not violate GN 487A through that activity. However, they must have: a work permit from the Ministry of Labour, registration from the Ministry of Education (for the school), and other relevant permits. If the school also operates a bookshop selling stationery (retail), that aspect may be affected by GN 487A.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Kampuni yangu haina cheti cha usafi wa kodi lakini inataka kushindania tender ya Serikali. Matokeo ni nini?
answer_sw: Zabuni (tender) yoyote ya Serikali inayowasilishwa bila cheti cha usafi wa kodi inayotakiwa itakataliwa moja kwa moja bila kufunguliwa. Mamlaka ya Ununuzi wa Umma Tanzania (PPRA) na taasisi zinazopokea zabuni zinahitaji cheti cha usafi wa kodi halisi kama hati ya lazima ya kushindania. Zaidi ya hayo, kama kampuni inashindwa zabuni nyingi kwa kukosa cheti cha usafi, ukaguzi wa kodi unaweza kufuata. Suluhisho: anza mchakato wa upataji wa cheti angalau wiki 2 kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya zabuni.
answer_en: Any Government tender submitted without the required tax clearance certificate will be rejected outright without being opened. Tanzania's Public Procurement Regulatory Authority (PPRA) and procuring entities require a valid tax clearance certificate as a mandatory document for tendering. Additionally, if a company repeatedly fails tenders due to missing clearance, a tax audit may follow. Solution: start the process of obtaining the certificate at least 2 weeks before the tender deadline.
question_en: My company has no tax clearance certificate but wants to compete for a Government tender. What is the consequence?
primary_source_name: TRA + PPRA — tax clearance for government tenders
next_review_trigger: PPA 2023 amendment or PPRA guideline change

question_sw: Ushauri wa bure wa kodi unapatikana wapi Tanzania kwa biashara ndogo?
answer_sw: Rasilimali za bure za kodi kwa biashara ndogo Tanzania ni: (1) Kituo cha Huduma za TRA (TRA Service Centre) — maofisa wa TRA wanaweza kutoa mwongozo wa msingi wa uzingatiaji bila malipo, (2) Tovuti ya TRA (tra.go.tz) ina miongozo na maswali ya kawaida, (3) Vituo vya Biashara na SME vya serikali kama SIDO Tanzania. Hata hivyo, kwa maswali magumu ya kodi, mshauri wa kodi aliyesajiliwa au mhasibu aliyeidhinishwa anashauriwa.
question_en: Where can free tax advice be found in Tanzania for small businesses?
answer_en: Free tax resources for small Tanzania businesses include: (1) TRA Service Centre — TRA officers can provide basic compliance guidance at no charge, (2) TRA website (tra.go.tz) has guides and FAQs, (3) Government SME centres like SIDO Tanzania. However, for complex tax questions, a registered tax adviser or certified accountant is recommended.

question_sw: Darasa B la kibali cha kazi ni kwa wawekezaji wa kigeni — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Darasa B ni kwa mfanyakazi aliyeAJIRIWA na kampuni Tanzania — si mwekezaji. Darasa linalohusu wawekezaji ni Darasa A. Darasa B linahitaji mwajiri (kampuni) kuwasilisha maombi kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi wake wa kigeni aliyeajiriwa. Kuchanganya Darasa A na Darasa B ni kosa la kawaida la ombi.
question_en: Class B work permit is for foreign investors — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Class B is for an employee HIRED by a Tanzania company — not an investor. The investor class is Class A. Class B requires the employer (company) to submit the application on behalf of their employed foreign worker. Confusing Class A and Class B is a common application error.

question_sw: Mwajiri mdogo mwenye wafanyakazi 5 analipa SDL?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — inalipwa tu na waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi kwenye Tanzania Bara. Mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi chini ya 10 hatalazimika kulipa SDL. Hata hivyo, jina sahihi la kodi hii ni Skills Development Levy, si kodi ya huduma ya utoaji wala disability leave.
question_en: Does a small employer with 5 employees pay SDL?
answer_en: No. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — is paid only by employers with 10 or more employees on Mainland Tanzania. An employer with fewer than 10 employees is not required to pay SDL. Regardless, the correct name of this levy is Skills Development Levy, not service delivery levy or disability leave.

question_sw: NSSF inaweza kutoa mkopo wa dharura kwa mwanachama aliyechangia kwa miaka 3 Tanzania?
answer_sw: NSSF Tanzania imetoa programu za mkopo kwa wanachama wake katika mfumo wake wa umiliki. Masharti yanaweza kujumuisha: kipindi cha chini cha michango (angalau miezi 36 au zaidi), kuwa bado mwanachama wa sasa, na mkopo unaotolewa kwa matumizi maalum (nyumba, elimu). Angalia NSSF moja kwa moja kwa programu za mikopo ya hali ya sasa kwani masharti yanaweza kubadilika.
question_en: Can NSSF provide an emergency loan to a member who has contributed for 3 years in Tanzania?
answer_en: NSSF Tanzania has offered loan programmes to its members under its own ownership framework. Conditions may include: minimum contribution period (at least 36 months or more), still being a current member, and loans provided for specific uses (housing, education). Check NSSF directly for current loan programme terms as conditions can change.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: OSHA na WCF ni shirika moja tu — ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. OSHA na WCF ni mashirika tofauti kabisa yanayofanya kazi tofauti. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inasimamia USALAMA kazini. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) inasimamia BIMA ya ajali za kazi. Waajiri wanalazimika kusajiliwa na ZOTE MBILI kwa namna tofauti.
question_en: OSHA and WCF are just one organisation — is this true?
answer_en: No. OSHA and WCF are completely separate organisations with different functions. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) oversees workplace SAFETY. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) administers workplace accident INSURANCE. Employers must register with BOTH separately.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Nikiwa na biashara yangu mwenyewe (self-employed), naweza kujisajili NSSF?
output: Ndiyo. Wajasiriamali wanaojitegemea (self-employed) wanaweza kujisajili NSSF kwa hiari. Hii inakupa mwenyewe ufikiaji wa mafao ya pensheni na ulinzi baadaye. Kwa taratibu za usajilishaji wa kujitegemea na viwango vya mchango, thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.or.tz) moja kwa moja. Usajilishaji huu si wa lazima kwa self-employed, lakini unapendekezwa kwa usalama wa baadaye.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Kampuni inalipa michango ya pension kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi kwenye mfuko ulioibuliwa na Serikali. Je, michango hiyo inatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Michango ya mwajiri kwenye mfuko wa pension ulioibuliwa (kama NSSF, PPF, GEPF) haijumuishwi kwenye mapato ya mfanyakazi yanayotozwa PAYE, mpaka kiasi kinachokubalika kisheria. Lakini michango ya ziada zaidi ya kikomo cha kisheria inaweza kutozwa. Michango ya mfanyakazi mwenyewe kwenye mifuko iliyoidhinishwa inaweza kudaiwa kama punguzo la kodi (allowable deduction) wakati wa mahesabu ya PAYE. Thibitisha kikomo halisi cha mwaka huu na TRA.
answer_en: Employer contributions to an approved pension fund (such as NSSF, PPF, GEPF) are not included in the employee's taxable employment income, up to the legally permitted limit. Contributions above the statutory ceiling may be taxable. Employee contributions to approved funds may be claimed as an allowable deduction when calculating PAYE. Verify the current year ceiling with TRA.
question_en: A company pays pension contributions on behalf of an employee to a government-approved fund. Are those contributions subject to PAYE?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — Income Tax Act Cap.332 pension provisions

question_sw: Kiwango cha ushuru wa forodha (import duty) kwa televisheni kutoka China ni ngapi?
answer_sw: Sina uhakika wa kiwango maalum cha ushuru wa forodha kwa televisheni. Viwango vya forodha vinategemea HS Code ya bidhaa na ratiba ya forodha ya Tanzania (EAC Common External Tariff). Thibitisha na TRA (Idara ya Forodha) au wakala wa usafirishaji (customs agent) aliyesajiliwa.
question_en: What is the import duty rate for a television set from China?
answer_en: I am not certain of the specific import duty rate for television sets. Duty rates depend on the HS Code of the goods and the Tanzania customs tariff schedule (EAC Common External Tariff). Verify with TRA (Customs Department) or a registered customs agent.

question_sw: Ombi la kibali cha makazi Tanzania linafanywa wapi mtandaoni?
answer_sw: Maombi ya vibali vya makazi (daraja A, B, C) yanafanywa mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa e-services wa Idara ya Uhamiaji kwenye tovuti immigration.go.tz. Mwombaji anatakiwa kuunda akaunti, kujaza fomu, na kupakia hati zinazohitajika. Thibitisha mahitaji ya sasa na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Where is a Tanzania residence permit application submitted online?
answer_en: Applications for residence permits (Class A, B, C) are submitted online through the Immigration Department's e-services system at immigration.go.tz. The applicant creates an account, completes the form, and uploads required documents. Confirm current requirements with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Ada ya mkurugenzi asiye wa wakati kamili inalipwa kodi ya zuio ya asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ada ya mkurugenzi asiye wa wakati kamili (non full-time director) inalipwa kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 15 kwa wakazi na asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What withholding tax rate applies to non-full-time director fees in Tanzania?
answer_en: Non-full-time director fees are subject to 15% withholding tax for residents and 15% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Ninauza nyumba — stamp duty inayolipwa inakokotolewa vipi Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Stamp duty kwa uhamishaji wa mali isiyohamika (nyumba, ardhi) inahusisha uthamini wa thamani ya soko na taratibu za Ofisi ya Ardhi ambazo ziko nje ya wigo wangu. Kwa ujumla, stamp duty kwa uhamishaji wa mali isiyohamika ni 1% ya thamani — lakini utaratibu wa uthamini rasmi na malipo ni mada inayohusisha Ofisi ya Ardhi na TRA. Wasiliana na TRA au mshauri wa ardhi aliyehitimu.

question_sw: Je, PAYE inategemea ni wapi kazi inafanywa au ni wapi mshahara unalipwa?
answer_sw: PAYE Tanzania inategemea MAHALI PA KAZI — si mahali pa malipo ya mshahara. Kama mtu anafanya kazi Tanzania, PAYE Tanzania inatumika hata kama mshahara unalipwa Hong Kong, London, au mahali pengine. Mahali pa malipo ya mshahara si kigezo cha msingi — mahali pa kazi ndio msingi. Kumbuka: mfanyakazi asiye mkazi (non-resident) — yaani anayefanya kazi Tanzania kwa chini ya siku 183 — analipa kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 15 ya mapato yake yote ya ajira (flat rate), si viwango vya uendelezaji (0%-30%). Mwajiri anapaswa kuamua hali ya makazi ya mfanyakazi mgeni kabla ya kuhesabu PAYE.
question_en: Does PAYE depend on where work is performed or where salary is paid?
answer_en: Tanzania PAYE depends on WHERE WORK IS PERFORMED — not where the salary is paid. If a person works in Tanzania, Tanzania PAYE applies even if salary is paid in Hong Kong, London, or elsewhere. The place of salary payment is not the primary criterion — the place of work is the basis. Note: a non-resident employee — one working in Tanzania for fewer than 183 days — pays a flat 15% withholding tax on all employment income, not the progressive 0%-30% bands. The employer must determine the foreign employee's residency status before calculating PAYE.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Kwa nini watu wengi wanasema bendi ya 2 ya PAYE ni 9% — kosa hili limetoka wapi?
answer_sw: Kosa la 9% limetoka kwenye bendi za zamani za PAYE za Tanzania ambazo zilitumika kabla ya marekebisho. Bendi hii ilibadilishwa kwa 8% kupitia Finance Act ya miaka iliyopita. Mifumo mingi ya mishahara ya zamani, vitabu vya kodi visivyosasishwa, na wataalam fulani bado wanatumia kiwango cha zamani. Wajibu wa mwajiri ni kuhakikisha anatumia bendi za hivi karibuni za TRA — tazama tovuti ya TRA au wasiliana nao moja kwa moja kwa uthibitisho.
question_en: Why do many people say PAYE band 2 is 9% — where did this error come from?
answer_en: The 9% error comes from Tanzania's old PAYE bands that were used before amendments. This band was changed to 8% through a Finance Act in prior years. Many old payroll systems, uncorrected tax books, and some professionals still use the old rate. An employer's obligation is to use TRA's current latest bands — check the TRA website or contact them directly for confirmation.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands

question_sw: Biashara yangu ina wafanyakazi 20 na jumla ya mishahara ni TZS 12,000,000 kwa mwezi. Niambie: SDL, NSSF ya mwajiri, na SDL vinajumlika vingapi?
answer_sw: Hesabu: SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) = TZS 12,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 420,000. NSSF ya mwajiri = TZS 12,000,000 × 10% = TZS 1,200,000. Jumla ya malipo ya mwajiri kwa TRA na NSSF = TZS 1,620,000. (SDL na PAYE kwenda TRA; NSSF kwenda NSSF.) SDL inalipwa siku ya 7 pamoja na PAYE.
question_en: My business has 20 employees with total payroll TZS 12,000,000 per month. Calculate: SDL, employer NSSF, and their combined total.
answer_en: Calculation: SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) = TZS 12,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 420,000. Employer NSSF = TZS 12,000,000 × 10% = TZS 1,200,000. Total employer obligations to TRA and NSSF = TZS 1,620,000. (SDL and PAYE go to TRA; NSSF goes to NSSF.) SDL is due on the 7th together with PAYE.

instruction: Kampuni mama yetu inatupandia gharama za pamoja (shared costs) za IT na masoko — TRA inatambua gharama hizi vipi?
output: Kanuni ya msingi ya transfer pricing Tanzania ni arm's length principle katika Income Tax Act Sehemu 33 — miamala kati ya kampuni zinazohusiana lazima ifanane na bei za soko. Kwa uchambuzi wa kesi yako: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Utambuzi wa gharama za pamoja za kimataifa kati ya kampuni zilizounganishwa ni suala la transfer pricing na kodi ya kimataifa inayohitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Ikiwa mfanyakazi ameumia kazini, mwajiri anamwarifu WCF ndani ya muda gani?
answer_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kumwarifu WCF kuhusu ajali ya kazi ndani ya siku saba (7) ZA KAZI baada ya ajali kutokea — kwa njia ya portal ya mtandao ya WCF (portal.wcf.go.tz). Kwa ajali kubwa au ya kifo, OSHA lazima iarifu ndani ya masaa 24. Kutokuripoti kwa wakati kunasababisha adhabu na inaweza kuathiri madai ya mfanyakazi.
question_en: If a worker is injured at work within what timeframe must the employer notify WCF?
answer_en: The employer must notify WCF of a workplace accident within 7 WORKING DAYS of it occurring — through the WCF online portal (portal.wcf.go.tz). For serious or fatal accidents OSHA must be notified within 24 hours. Failure to report on time results in penalties and may affect the worker's claim.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Je, OSHA inahusiana na Sheria ya Viwanda ya 1950?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Sheria ya OSHA ya 2003 ilichukua nafasi ya Sheria ya Viwanda ya 1950 (Factories Ordinance). Sheria ya 1950 ilikuwa inashughulikia viwanda tu, wakati OSHA 2003 inashughulikia mahali POTE pa kazi, ikiwa ni pamoja na ofisi, maduka, na mahali pa kazi mengine.
question_en: How does OSHA relate to the Factories Ordinance of 1950?
answer_en: OSHA 2003 replaced the Factories Ordinance of 1950. The 1950 ordinance covered only factories, while OSHA 2003 covers ALL workplaces including offices, shops, and other work settings.

instruction: TRA inatathmini thamani ya ardhi yangu kwa stamp duty — ninaweza kupinga tathmini hiyo?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Utaratibu wa kupinga tathmini ya stamp duty unashughulikiwa chini ya Stamp Duty Act na kanuni za TRA — inajumuisha kuwasilisha tathmini mbadala na utaratibu wa rufaa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, inawezekana kulipa NSSF zaidi ya viwango vya kawaida kama mfanyakazi anataka akiba zaidi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Sheria ya NSSF inaruhusu michango ya ziada (voluntary contributions) zaidi ya kiwango cha lazima cha 10%+10%. Mfanyakazi au mwajiri anaweza kuchangia kwa hiari ziada ya kiwango cha lazima. Michango ya ziada inaongeza faida za mwisho wa kazi. Kwa maelezo ya mpango wa michango ya ziada, wasiliana na ofisi ya NSSF. Kiwango cha lazima cha msingi ni: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla.
question_en: Is it possible to pay more NSSF than the standard rate if an employee wants more savings?
answer_en: Yes. The NSSF Act allows voluntary contributions above the mandatory 10%+10% rate. An employee or employer can voluntarily contribute above the mandatory minimum. Additional contributions increase end-of-service benefits. For details on the voluntary contribution scheme, contact the NSSF office. The mandatory minimum is: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage.

question_sw: Ada ya kibali cha makazi Class C Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Ada ya kibali cha makazi daraja C inaweza kutofautiana kulingana na muda na aina ya kazi. Ada zinatofautiana sana kulingana na aina ya kibali, uraia, na muda — angalia jedwali la sasa la ada kwenye immigration.go.tz
question_en: What is the fee for a Class C residence permit in Tanzania?
answer_en: The Class C residence permit fee varies depending on duration and type of employment. Fees vary widely by permit class, nationality and duration — check current schedule at immigration.go.tz

question_sw: EFD yangu imeharibika leo asubuhi. Je, ninafanya nini?
answer_sw: Ikiwa EFD imeharibika: (1) Taarifa TRA mara moja — ndani ya masaa 24 ya kugundua uharibika; (2) Tumia stakabadhi za mkono zilizochapishwa awali (pre-printed manual receipt book) kwa muda wa kusubiri EFD kurekebishwa; (3) Wasiliana na muuzaji wa EFD aliyeidhinishwa ili arekebishe au abadilishe EFD; (4) Rekodi muamala wote uliotokea kwa stakabadhi za mkono; (5) Baada ya EFD kurekebishwa, ingiza taarifa zilizokosekana inapobidi. Usiendelee kufanya biashara bila kurejesha risiti za kisheria.
question_en: My EFD broke down this morning. What do I do?
answer_en: If the EFD breaks down: (1) Notify TRA immediately — within 24 hours of discovering the fault; (2) Use pre-printed manual receipt books while waiting for the EFD to be repaired; (3) Contact the TRA-approved EFD supplier to repair or replace the EFD; (4) Record all transactions using manual receipts; (5) After EFD is repaired, enter any missing transaction data as required. Do not continue business without restoring legal receipt issuance.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi (part-time) ana haki ya mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa msingi wa pro-rata. Mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi ana haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A kuhesabiwa kwa idadi ya masaa aliyofanya kazi ikilinganishwa na masaa ya kawaida ya wiki ya kazi. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Does a part-time worker have the right to the minimum wage under GN 605A?
answer_en: Yes, on a pro-rata basis. A part-time worker is entitled to the GN 605A minimum wage calculated according to the hours worked compared to the normal working week. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Biashara yangu ilikuwa exempt VAT — sasa imekuwa taxable. Ninaweza kudai VAT ya vifaa vilivyonunuliwa awali?
answer_sw: Hali hii ya mabadiliko ya hali ya VAT (exempt kwenda taxable) ina kanuni maalum. Kwa ujumla, input VAT iliyolipwa kipindi cha exempt haiwezi kudaiwa kwa wakati wa mabadiliko. Hata hivyo, kwa vifaa na mali ambazo bado zinatumika, inawezekana kudai sehemu ya input VAT — lakini hii ni ngumu. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: My business was VAT-exempt — it is now taxable. Can I claim VAT on goods bought earlier?
answer_en: This situation of changing VAT status (exempt to taxable) has specific rules. Generally, input VAT paid during the exempt period cannot be claimed at the time of change. However, for capital assets and equipment still in use, it may be possible to claim a portion of input VAT — but this is complex. Verify with TRA or a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Je, bonus ya mwaka mzima (annual bonus) inatozwa NSSF?
answer_sw: Kinadharia ndiyo — malipo yote yanayolipwa kwa mfanyakazi kama sehemu ya mshahara (ikiwemo bonuses) yanaweza kujumuishwa kwenye msingi wa NSSF. Hata hivyo, utekelezaji wa vitendo unaweza kutofautiana kulingana na aina ya bonus (mara moja vs ya kawaida) na jinsi inavyoainishwa kisheria. Kwa mwongozo wa hali yako maalum ya bonus, wasiliana na NSSF. Kiwango cha lazima ni mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla.
question_en: Is an annual bonus subject to NSSF?
answer_en: In principle yes — all payments made to an employee as part of compensation (including bonuses) may be included in the NSSF base. However, practical application may vary depending on the type of bonus (one-off vs regular) and how it is legally classified. For guidance on your specific bonus situation, contact NSSF. The mandatory rate is employer 10% + employee 10% of gross wage.

question_sw: WCF inacheswa vipi kwa mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ghafi — inalipwa na mwajiri peke yake. Kwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 358,322: WCF = TZS 1,792 kwa mfanyakazi kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na WCF.
question_en: How is WCF calculated on the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) is 0.5% of total gross wages — paid by the employer only. On TZS 358,322 minimum wage: WCF = TZS 1,792 per employee per month. Confirm with WCF.

question_sw: BRELA ni nini na inashughulikia nini Tanzania?
answer_sw: BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) ni shirika la serikali linalosimamiwa na Wizara ya Viwanda na Biashara. Inashughulikia: usajili wa majina ya biashara, uanzishwaji wa kampuni, usajili wa kampuni za kigeni, uandishi wa hati muhimu za biashara, na utunzaji wa rejesta ya biashara Tanzania.
question_en: What is BRELA and what does it handle in Tanzania?
answer_en: BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) is a government agency under the Ministry of Industry and Trade. It handles: business name registration, company incorporation, foreign company registration, filing of key business documents, and maintenance of Tanzania's business registry.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: BRELA Act or fee schedule update

instruction: Bidhaa za chakula Tanzania — zinalipiwa VAT au zipo katika kundi la zero-rated au exempt?
output: Bidhaa nyingi za chakula msingi Tanzania zimewekwa katika kundi la zero-rated (0% VAT) au exempt — si kiwango cha kawaida cha 18%. Hata hivyo, si chakula chote ni zero-rated au exempt — bidhaa zilizosindikwa au za anasa zinaweza kulipiwa 18%. Kwa orodha kamili ya bidhaa zero-rated na exempt, thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi, kwani orodha inaweza kubadilika kila mwaka na Finance Act.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Kampuni inahitajika kuandaa mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura (emergency response plan) Tanzania — OSHA inashughulikia hili?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. OSHA Act Tanzania inataka mwajiri — hasa katika sekta zenye hatari kali kama viwanda, kemikali, ujenzi — kuandaa na kutekeleza mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura. Mpango huu lazima ujumuishe: taratibu za uokoaji wa haraka, nambari za dharura, mafunzo ya wafanyakazi wa kutoa huduma ya kwanza, na mazoezi ya mara kwa mara. OSHA inaweza kuuliza kuona mpango huu wakati wa ukaguzi.
question_en: Is a company required to prepare an emergency response plan in Tanzania — does OSHA handle this?
answer_en: Yes. The Tanzania OSHA Act requires employers — especially in high-hazard sectors like industrial, chemical, and construction — to prepare and implement an emergency response plan. This plan must include: rapid evacuation procedures, emergency numbers, first aid worker training, and regular drills. OSHA can ask to see this plan during an inspection.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Biashara yangu inafanywa mtandaoni tu — siuzi bidhaa za kimwili, ninauza huduma za kidijitali. Je, ninahitaji leseni yoyote?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara za mtandaoni (online businesses) Tanzania zinahitaji usajili wa kawaida wa biashara: usajili wa BRELA kama jina la biashara au kampuni, TIN kutoka TRA, na leseni ya LGA ikiwa una ofisi au anwani ya biashara. Pia, tangu Sheria ya Fedha 2022, huduma za kidijitali zinazotolewa nchini Tanzania zinatozwa Kodi ya Huduma za Kidijitali (Digital Service Tax — DST) ya asilimia 2 ya mapato ghafi. Ikiwa mapato yako yanazidi kizingiti cha VAT, lazima usajili VAT pia.
answer_en: Yes. Online businesses in Tanzania require standard business registration: BRELA registration as a business name or company, a TIN from TRA, and an LGA licence if you have an office or business address. Also, since the Finance Act 2022, digital services provided in Tanzania are subject to Digital Service Tax (DST) of 2% of gross revenue. If your income exceeds the VAT threshold, VAT registration is also required.
question_en: My business operates online only — I don't sell physical goods, just digital services. Do I need any licence?

question_sw: WCF inashughulikia magonjwa yanayotokana na kazi (occupational diseases) pia?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. WCF inashughulikia magonjwa yanayotokana na kazi — magonjwa yanayotokea au yanayoongezeka kwa sababu ya mazingira ya kazi. Mifano ni: uziwi wa kelele, magonjwa ya mapafu kutokana na vumbi, na matatizo yanayosababishwa na kemikali. Mfanyakazi mwenye ugonjwa wa kazi ana haki ya madai ya WCF.
question_en: Does WCF also cover occupational diseases?
answer_en: Yes. WCF covers occupational diseases — conditions that arise or worsen because of the work environment. Examples include: noise-induced deafness, dust-related lung diseases, and conditions caused by chemicals. An employee with an occupational disease is entitled to make a WCF claim.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inamilikiwa na kampuni mama ya nje. Sheria ya kuzuia uchepushwaji wa faida (thin capitalisation) inaathiri vipi mkopo kutoka kwa kampuni mama?
answer_sw: Sheria ya udhaifu wa mtaji (thin capitalisation) Tanzania inazuia ukato wa riba inayolipwa kwa mmiliki wa nje ikiwa deni la kampuni linazidi mara tatu ya mtaji wake (uwiano wa 3:1 wa deni kwa mtaji). Riba inayolipwa kwenye deni linalozidi kikomo hiki haiwezi kukatwa kama gharama ya biashara. Kanuni hii inalenga kuzuia kampuni za kimataifa kupeleka faida nje ya Tanzania kwa njia ya mikopo ya bandia yenye riba kubwa. Thibitisha muundo wako wa fedha na mshauri wa kodi.
answer_en: Tanzania's thin capitalisation rules limit the deductibility of interest paid to a foreign parent company if the company's debt exceeds three times its equity (3:1 debt-to-equity ratio). Interest on debt exceeding this limit cannot be deducted as a business expense. This rule is designed to prevent multinational companies from shifting profits out of Tanzania through artificial high-interest loans. Confirm your financing structure with a tax consultant.
question_en: A Tanzanian company is owned by a foreign parent. How does the thin capitalisation rule affect loans from the parent company?

question_sw: Nilizidi kizingiti cha VAT wiki hii — hatua ya KWANZA ninayopaswa kuchukua ni nini?
answer_sw: Hatua ya KWANZA ni KUWASILIANA NA TRA MARA MOJA na kuomba usajili wa VAT. Usiendelee kufanya biashara bila VAT baada ya kuzidi kizingiti — hii ni ukiukaji wa sheria ya kodi. USIFANYE: (1) usiwasilishe 'return ya mwisho' (final VAT return) — hii ni ya usimamizi wa VAT uliopo, si ya kuanza usajili mpya; (2) usisubiri mwezi mzima au mwaka — muda wa kuchelewa ni gharama ya adhabu. Nenda TRA leo.
question_en: I exceeded the VAT threshold this week — what is the FIRST step I should take?
answer_en: The FIRST step is to CONTACT TRA IMMEDIATELY and apply for VAT registration. Do not continue trading without VAT after exceeding the threshold — this is a tax law violation. DO NOT: (1) do not submit a 'final VAT return' — that is for winding up an existing VAT registration, not starting a new one; (2) do not wait a full month or year — delay time is penalty cost. Go to TRA today.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ina mgogoro na msambazaji kuhusu malipo. Je, ninaweza kufanya nini kisheria?
answer_sw: Migogoro ya kibiashara (commercial disputes) ni nje ya upeo wangu — ninashughulikia kodi na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara, si ushauri wa kisheria wa jumla. Kwa migogoro ya kibiashara, wasiliana na: mwanasheria wa biashara aliyesajiliwa Tanzania, Tanzania Institute of Arbitration (TIA), au Commercial Court of Tanzania (Mahakama ya Biashara). Je, kuna swali la kodi la biashara ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: My company has a payment dispute with a supplier. What can I do legally?
answer_en: Commercial disputes are outside my scope — I handle Tanzania Mainland taxes and business registration, not general legal advice. For business disputes, contact: a registered Tanzanian commercial lawyer, the Tanzania Institute of Arbitration (TIA), or the Commercial Court of Tanzania. Is there a business tax question I can help with?

instruction: Adhabu ya kuendelea kufanya kazi bila usajilishaji wa OSHA kwa miezi 3 itakuwa ngapi?
output: Adhabu ya msingi ni TZS 1,000,000 hadi TZS 5,000,000 — hii ni kwa kosa la awali. Kwa kosa linaloendelea (continuing offence), adhabu ya ziada ya TZS 100,000 kwa kila siku inayoendelea inaweza kutolewa. Kwa miezi 3 ya kukiuka (siku 90 za kazi), adhabu ya ziada inaweza kuwa hadi TZS 9,000,000 — juu ya adhabu ya msingi. Jumla inaweza kufikia zaidi ya TZS 14,000,000. Sajili na OSHA haraka (osha.go.tz).

instruction: Kampeni ya utekelezaji wa GN 487A ilikuwa ni ya mwezi mmoja tu — je, sheria imeisha?
output: Hapana — kampeni ya utekelezaji (11 Sep–8 Oct 2025) ilikuwa ni harakati maalum ya kwanza ya kukagua na kutekeleza GN 487A kwa nguvu — si mwisho wa sheria. GN 487A yenyewe ni sheria ya kudumu (permanent law) iliyoanzishwa tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Kampeni iliisha lakini utekelezaji wa kawaida wa sheria unaendelea kila wakati. Idara ya Uhamiaji, polisi, na mahakama zinaweza kushughulikia ukiukwaji wowote wa GN 487A wakati wowote — bila kuhitaji kampeni maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Je, kampuni ya hisa ya Tanzania inaweza kumilikiwa 100% na mgeni?
output: Ndiyo — sheria za uwekezaji Tanzania zinamlruhusu mgeni kumiliki hisa 100% katika kampuni nyingi za sekta. Hata hivyo, kuna vikwazo: (1) GN 487A inazuia shughuli katika orodha ya 15 — hata kama kampuni imesajiliwa Tanzania na kumilikiwa 100% na mgeni, kufanya shughuli hizo bado ni marufuku; (2) Sekta fulani (madini, ardhi, media) zina vikwazo vya umiliki wa kigeni; (3) Tanzania Investment Centre (TIC) inasimamia uwekezaji wa kigeni. Kwa sekta zilizoruhusiwa (viwanda, kilimo, utalii), umiliki 100% wa kigeni unawezekana. Thibitisha na TIC (tic.go.tz) na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: WCF inalipa mfanyakazi aliyeumia mahali pa kazi bila hata mwajiri kusajili WCF — je, WCF inalipa bila kujali?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ikiwa mwajiri HAIKUSAJILI WCF, mfanyakazi aliyeumia ana changamoto za kupata fidia ya moja kwa moja kupitia WCF. Hata hivyo, sheria ya Tanzania inaweza kumuruhusu mfanyakazi kudai fidia kutoka mwajiri moja kwa moja au kupitia mahakama. Mwajiri asiyesajili WCF bado ana wajibu wa kisheria wa kulipa fidia kwa mfanyakazi aliyeumia — na adhabu za ziada kwa kutosajili.
question_en: Does WCF pay an injured workplace worker even if the employer has not registered with WCF — does WCF pay regardless?
answer_en: No. If an employer has NOT registered with WCF, an injured worker faces challenges getting direct compensation through WCF. However, Tanzania law may still allow the worker to claim compensation directly from the employer or through court. An employer not registered with WCF still has a legal obligation to pay compensation to an injured worker — plus additional penalties for not registering.

question_sw: Malipo ya mkurugenzi (director's fee) yanastahili PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Malipo ya mkurugenzi wa kampuni yanastahili PAYE. Kama mkurugenzi si mfanyakazi wa wakati kamili, yanaweza kustahili kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) badala ya PAYE — kiwango ni asilimia 15 kwa wakazi na asilimia 20 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha aina ya mkurugenzi na TRA.
question_en: Are director's fees subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Director's fees are subject to PAYE. If the director is not a full-time employee, the fees may be subject to withholding tax instead of PAYE — the rate is 15% for residents and 20% for non-residents. Confirm the director's classification with TRA.

question_sw: Hati ya kukopa (loan agreement) kati ya kampuni mbili za Tanzania ina ushuru wa stempu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mikataba ya mkopo na dhamana Tanzania kwa kawaida iko kwenye orodha ya Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu. Ushuru huu unahesabiwa kwa kuzingatia kiasi cha mkopo au thamani ya dhamana. Kampuni zinazofanya makubaliano ya mkopo zinapaswa kuhakikisha ushuru wa stempu umelipwa ili mkopo uwe na nguvu kamili ya kisheria.
question_en: Does a loan agreement between two Tanzania companies attract stamp duty?
answer_en: Yes. Loan agreements and security documents in Tanzania are generally listed in the Stamp Duty Act schedule. The duty is calculated based on the loan amount or security value. Companies entering loan agreements should ensure stamp duty is paid so the loan has full legal enforceability.

instruction: Ninalipa mshauri wa kisheria (lawyer) kwa huduma za ushauri wa biashara — VAT withholding ni ngapi?
output: Huduma za ushauri wa kisheria (legal consultancy) ni HUDUMA — kwa hivyo VAT withholding ni 6%. Hii ni sawa kwa huduma zote za kitaaluma: wakili, mhasibu, mhandisi, mshauri wa biashara, daktari anayetoa huduma za kliniki, na kadhalika. Finance Act 2025 ilipanga: bidhaa → 3%; huduma → 6%, kuanzia 1 Julai 2025. Mnunuzi anayehitimu anakata 6% ya VAT ya bill na kutuma TRA. Muuzaji (wakili) anapokea bei pungufu ya 6% lakini anaweza kudai input VAT. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Kampuni inasajili OSHA na WCF — ni lazima pia kusajili NSSF na SDL?
output: Ndiyo — hizi ni usajili TOFAUTI na ni lazima ZOTE: OSHA: usajili wa mahali pa kazi kwa usalama — wa kila biashara; WCF: bima ya ajali za kazi — michango 0.5% ya mishahara — kwa kila mwajiri; NSSF: pensheni ya wafanyakazi — michango 20% (10%+10%) — kwa kila mwajiri; SDL: mafunzo ya taaluma — michango 3.5% — kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10+; PAYE na VAT (TRA): kodi nyingine. Kila moja ina usajili wake tofauti, tarehe zake, na fomu zake. Biashara kamili ya Tanzania inazingatia ZOTE kwa pamoja. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz, wcf.go.tz, nssf.or.tz, na tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya ETR, EFD, na VFD ni nini Tanzania?
answer_sw: ETR (Electronic Tax Register) ni kifaa cha zamani cha mauzo kinachotoa risiti za kawaida — mfumo wa zamani. EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) ni kifaa kipya cha mauzo chenye uhusiano wa moja kwa moja na seva ya TRA — kinatuma taarifa za kila muamala mara moja. VFD (Virtual Fiscal Device) ni programu ya kompyuta (software) inayofanya kazi ya EFD — inafaa kwa biashara zinazotumia mifumo ya ERP au mauzo ya mtandao. TRA inasimamia aina zote tatu.
question_en: What is the difference between ETR, EFD, and VFD in Tanzania?
answer_en: ETR (Electronic Tax Register) is the older cash register device issuing standard receipts — the old system. EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) is the newer device with a direct connection to TRA's server — it transmits data on every transaction in real time. VFD (Virtual Fiscal Device) is a software solution that performs the EFD function — suitable for businesses using ERP systems or online sales. TRA regulates all three types.

instruction: Kuna tarehe nyingi za mabadiliko ya sheria mwaka 2025-2026 Tanzania — unaweza kuzifafanua?
output:
Kuna tarehe tofauti tatu muhimu ambazo mara nyingi zinachanganywa:

1 JULAI 2025: Finance Act 2025 inaanza — mabadiliko ya VAT withholding (3% bidhaa / 6% huduma) na mabadiliko mengine ya kodi.
1 SEPTEMBA 2025: VAT mpya ya B2C e-payment (16%) inaanza chini ya Finance Act 2025.
13 OKTOBA 2025: GN 605A inatolewa rasmi (gazetted).
1 JANUARI 2026: GN 605A ya mishahara ya chini ya sekta binafsi inaanza kutumika. Amri ya 2022 inafutwa.

Kila tarehe inahusiana na suala tofauti kabisa. Usichanganye tarehe hizi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz), PKF Eastern Africa, au TanzLII.

instruction: Ninas wakati gani wa kuwasilisha transfer pricing documentation kwa TRA?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Nyaraka za transfer pricing (transfer pricing documentation) zinahitajika chini ya kanuni za Income Tax Act — muda na maudhui yanategemea ukubwa wa kampuni na kiasi cha miamala ya washirika. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Mwajiri mgeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania — analipa SDL?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiri yeyote anayeendesha biashara Tanzania na kulipa mishahara kwa wafanyakazi Tanzania analipa SDL kama ana wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Uraia wa mwajiri (mgeni au raia) hauthiri wajibu wa SDL.
question_en: A foreign employer operating in Tanzania — do they pay SDL?
answer_en: Yes. Any employer operating a business in Tanzania and paying salaries to Tanzania-based employees pays SDL if they have 10 or more employees. The citizenship of the employer (foreign or citizen) does not affect the SDL obligation.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Je, wauzaji wadogo wa soko lazima watumie EFD?
answer_sw: Wauzaji wadogo wa soko wasiosajiliwa kwa VAT hawahitajiwi kutumia EFD. Wajibu wa EFD unafuata usajili wa VAT — na usajili wa VAT ni lazima tu pale biashara inapofika kizingiti cha TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6. Wengi wa wauzaji wa soko wako chini ya kizingiti hiki na hawalazimiki kutumia EFD.
question_en: Are small market vendors required to use EFD?
answer_en: Small market vendors who are not VAT-registered are not required to use EFD. The EFD obligation follows VAT registration — and VAT registration is only mandatory when a business reaches the TZS 200M/year or TZS 100M/6-month threshold. Most market vendors are below this threshold and are not required to use EFD.

question_sw: TIN (Tax Identification Number) na leseni ya biashara — ni vitu sawa?
answer_sw: Hapana. TIN (Nambari ya Utambulisho wa Kodi) ni nambari ya TRA inayotambulisha mlipa kodi — inatumika kwa kodi zote. Leseni ya biashara ni hati inayoruhusiwa biashara kufanya shughuli fulani — inatoka kwa halmashauri au mamlaka husika. Biashara inahitaji ZOTE MBILI: TIN kwa TRA na leseni ya biashara kwa halmashauri.
question_en: TIN (Tax Identification Number) and a business licence — are they the same thing?
answer_en: No. A TIN (Tax Identification Number) is a TRA number that identifies a taxpayer — used for all taxes. A business licence is a document permitting a business to conduct specific activities — it comes from the local council or relevant authority. A business needs BOTH: a TIN for TRA and a business licence from the council.

question_sw: Usajili wa BRELA unalinda dhidi ya GN 487A — kweli au uongo?
answer_sw: Uongo. Usajili wa BRELA ni hitaji la msingi la kisheria kwa biashara yoyote, lakini haumruhusu mwenye hisa mgeni kufanya biashara yoyote iliyokatazwa. GN 487A inabaki kuzuia shughuli 15 bila kujali hali ya usajili wa BRELA. Hata ukisajili kampuni yako vizuri BRELA, bado huwezi kuendesha duka la rejareja kama mgeni.
question_en: Does BRELA registration protect against GN 487A — true or false?
answer_en: False. BRELA registration is a basic legal requirement for any business, but does not allow a foreign shareholder to conduct any prohibited activity. GN 487A still blocks the 15 activities regardless of BRELA registration status. Even if you register your company properly with BRELA, you still cannot run a retail shop as a non-citizen.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: Malipo ya NSSF yanaingia kwenye akaunti yangu ya NSSF mara moja?
output: Malipo ya mwajiri yanaingia kwenye akaunti yako ya NSSF baada ya kuthibitishwa — mara nyingi ndani ya siku chache hadi wiki moja baada ya mwajiri kulipa. Unaweza kuangalia akaunti yako na mizania ya mchango kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa NSSF (nssf.or.tz) au ofisi yoyote ya NSSF. Kama malipo hayaonekani kwa muda mrefu, wasiliana na NSSF moja kwa moja.

instruction: Machinga (street vending) — mgeni anaweza kufanya Tanzania?
output: GN 487A inakataza shughuli 15 kwa wasio raia Tanzania. Machinga/street vending ipo kwenye orodha ya marufuku ya GN 487A. Mgeni hawezi kufanya biashara ya machinga au uuzaji wa mtaani Tanzania Bara. Hii inajumuisha: uuzaji wa bidhaa za rejareja mitaani, soko la wazi, au maeneo ya umma. Utekelezaji wa GN 487A (Septemba–Oktoba 2025): Idara ya Uhamiaji ilifanya doria na kuwakamata wageni kadhaa waliokuwa wakifanya biashara zilizokuwa marufuku.

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kutumia EFD moja kwa biashara yangu ya jumla na biashara ya rejareja tofauti?
answer_sw: Hapana — EFD moja inasajiliwa kwa TIN moja na eneo moja la biashara. Biashara ya jumla (wholesale) na ya rejareja (retail) zinazofanya kazi kama biashara tofauti (TIN tofauti) zinahitaji EFD tofauti. Hata kama TIN ni moja, ikiwa mauzo yanafanyika maeneo tofauti (anwani tofauti), kila eneo linahitaji EFD yake. Wasiliana na TRA kwa hali yako maalum.
question_en: Can I use one EFD for my separate wholesale and retail businesses?
answer_en: No — one EFD is registered to one TIN and one business location. Wholesale and retail businesses operating as separate businesses (different TINs) need separate EFDs. Even with one TIN, if sales occur at different locations (different addresses), each location needs its own EFD. Contact TRA for your specific situation.

instruction: Kampuni yaliyofutwa BRELA inaweza kufanya nini kisheria?
output: Kampuni iliyofutwa orodha (deregistered) na BRELA haina uwezo wa kisheria: haiwezi kuingia mikataba mipya, haiwezi kufungua akaunti mpya ya benki, haiwezi kushiriki zabuni za serikali, na kawaida haiwezi kuanzisha kesi mpya mahakamani bila kurejesha usajili wake kwanza — urejesho unawezekana lakini ni ghali. Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Urejesho wa kampuni uliyofutwa unachukua muda na gharama zaidi ya kuwasilisha kwa wakati.

question_sw: Daktari anasema: 'Huduma za afya zimesamehewa VAT — kwa hivyo sijasajilishwa.' Je, hoja hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hoja hii ina nuance muhimu. Kweli fulani: huduma za afya za msingi (basic health services) zinaweza kuwa exempt au zero-rated kwa VAT. Lakini: hii haimaanishi daktari hauhitaji KUSAJILIWA VAT. Hata kama huduma zako ziko exempt, unastahili kusajiliwa kama fani iliyodhibitiwa. Pia, si huduma zote za madaktari ni exempt — huduma za kibinafsi za hali ya juu, huduma za urembo, na zingine zinaweza kuwa taxable.
question_en: A doctor says: 'Health services are VAT-exempt — so I have not registered.' Is this argument correct?
answer_en: This argument has an important nuance. Partly true: basic health services may be exempt or zero-rated for VAT. But: this does not mean a doctor does not need to BE REGISTERED for VAT. Even if your services are exempt, you are still required to register as a regulated profession. Also, not all doctors' services are exempt — high-end private services, cosmetic services, and others may be taxable.

instruction: Kwa nini Z-report lazima ipigwe mwishoni mwa siku na si kesho asubuhi?
output: Z-report lazima ipigwe MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Sababu ya kisheria: Z-report inafunga data ya mauzo ya siku hiyo kwenye EFD — ikichelewa, data ya siku hiyo inabaki 'wazi' kwenye EFD, ambayo ni ukiukaji wa kanuni za TIMS. TRA inaweza kuona vipindi vya Z-report vilivyokosekana au vilivyochelewa kupitia TIMS.

question_sw: Malipo ya mkurugenzi (director's fee) yanastahili PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Malipo ya mkurugenzi wa kampuni yanastahili PAYE. Kama mkurugenzi si mfanyakazi wa wakati kamili, yanaweza kustahili kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) badala ya PAYE — kiwango ni asilimia 15 kwa wakazi. Thibitisha aina ya mkurugenzi na TRA.
question_en: Are director's fees subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Director's fees are subject to PAYE. If the director is not a full-time employee, the fees may be subject to withholding tax instead of PAYE — the rate is 15% for residents. Confirm the director's classification with TRA.

question_sw: Mgeni anaweza kumiliki hisa za kampuni ya rejareja Tanzania?
answer_sw: Umiliki wa hisa peke yake si sawa na kuendesha biashara. Hata hivyo, GN 487A inazuia raia wa kigeni KUFANYA biashara za orodha ya 15. Ikiwa umiliki wa hisa unakupelekea udhibiti wa uendeshaji wa biashara ya rejareja, hii inaweza kukiuka roho ya GN 487A. Muundo wa kisheria unaofaa unahitajika — thibitisha na mwanasheria.
question_en: Can a non-citizen own shares in a Tanzanian retail company?
answer_en: Owning shares alone is not the same as operating a business. However, GN 487A prohibits non-citizens from ENGAGING IN businesses on the list of 15. If share ownership leads to operational control of a retail business, this may violate the spirit of GN 487A. Appropriate legal structuring is needed — verify with a lawyer.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Withholding tax kwa royalties ni asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango cha withholding tax kwa royalties kwa wasio wakazi ni asilimia 15 — si asilimia 10. Kiwango hiki kinatumika kwa wakazi na wasio wakazi sawa. Kiwango cha asilimia 10 si sahihi kwa royalties Tanzania.
question_en: Withholding tax on royalties is 10% for non-residents — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The withholding tax rate on royalties for non-residents is 15% — not 10%. This rate applies equally to residents and non-residents. A rate of 10% is incorrect for royalties in Tanzania.

question_sw: Kwa muda gani lazima nihifadhi rekodi za biashara kwa madhumuni ya ukaguzi wa TRA?
answer_sw: Chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato Tanzania, mlipa kodi lazima ahifadhi rekodi zake za uhasibu kwa angalau miaka 5 baada ya mwaka wa mapato unaoathirika. Hii inahusisha: vitabu vya uhasibu, risiti za mauzo na manunuzi, orodha za mishahara (payroll), return za kodi zilizotumwa, maelezo ya benki, mikataba, na nyaraka zote za kuhusiana na biashara. Kwa udanganyifu uliodhibitiwa, TRA inaweza kufungua ukaguzi kwa miaka ya nyuma zaidi ya 5. Hifadhi rekodi za kidijitali na karatasi zote kwa usalama — hasara ya rekodi wakati wa ukaguzi inaweza kusababisha tathmini kubwa.
answer_en: Under Tanzania's Income Tax Act, a taxpayer must keep their accounting records for at least 5 years after the relevant year of income. This includes: accounting books, sales and purchase receipts, payroll records, filed tax returns, bank statements, contracts, and all business-related documents. For confirmed fraud cases, TRA may open investigations beyond 5 years. Keep all digital and paper records securely — loss of records during an audit may result in a large assessment.
question_en: For how long must I keep business records for TRA audit purposes?
primary_source_name: TRA — record keeping requirements ITA Cap.332
next_review_trigger: ITA amendment on record keeping period

question_sw: SDL ni nini na nani analazimika kulipa?
answer_sw: SDL ni Skills Development Levy — ushuru wa maendeleo ya ujuzi. Ni mchango unaolipwa na mwajiri kwa TRA kila mwezi kwa ajili ya mfuko wa mafunzo ya ujuzi nchini Tanzania. SDL inalipwa na waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Waajiri wenye wafanyakazi chini ya 10 hawajumuishwi kwa kawaida. Thibitisha kama biashara yako inahitimu na TRA kwenye tra.go.tz.
question_en: What is SDL and who is required to pay it?
answer_en: SDL is the Skills Development Levy — a skills training tax. It is a monthly contribution paid by employers to TRA for Tanzania's workforce skills development fund. SDL is paid by employers with 10 or more employees. Employers with fewer than 10 employees are generally not included. Confirm whether your business qualifies with TRA at tra.go.tz.
primary_source_name: Tanzania Revenue Authority — Skills Development Levy

instruction: GN 487A ilianzishwa kwa sababu gani — historia yake ni nini?
output: GN 487A (iliyoanza 28 Julai 2025) ilianzishwa kama sehemu ya sera ya Tanzania ya kulinda fursa za kiuchumi kwa raia wake dhidi ya ushindani usiohaki wa wageni katika biashara ndogo ndogo. Msingi: wageni (hasa kutoka China na nchi za Asia) walikuwa wakichukua nafasi za biashara ndogo (saluni, maduka ya simu, rejareja) ambazo kihistoria zilikuwa kwa Watanzania. Serikali iliamua kupiga marufuku shughuli 15 kwa raia wa kigeni ili kuhakikisha Watanzania wana nafasi za kiuchumi. Hii ni sera ya Tanzania Kwanza (Tanzania First) kwa uchumi mdogo. Thibitisha na tangazo rasmi la Serikali na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Mtu anayepata kipato kutoka vyanzo viwili tofauti (mshahara + biashara ndogo) analipa PAYE kwenye mshahara tu na anasahau biashara ndogo — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mtu anayepata kipato kutoka vyanzo vingi — kama mshahara (PAYE inakatwa na mwajiri) na biashara ndogo — lazima ajiripoti mapato YOTE kwenye tamko la kodi la mwaka lake. PAYE iliyokatwa na mwajiri ni malipo ya awali ya kodi ya mwaka. Mapato yote ya mwaka yanajumlishwa na kodi ya mwaka inakokotolewa — ikiwa mapato ya biashara yanaongeza mzigo wa kodi, adalipa tofauti.
question_en: A person earning from two sources (salary + small business) pays PAYE only on their salary and ignores the small business — is this correct?
answer_en: No. A person earning from multiple sources — such as salary (PAYE deducted by employer) and small business — must declare ALL income on their annual tax return. PAYE deducted by the employer is an advance payment on annual tax. All annual income is totalled and annual tax calculated — if business income adds to the tax burden, the difference must be paid.

question_sw: Biashara yangu ya kuuza bidhaa mtandaoni inatumia Jumia au platform nyingine. Je, ninahitaji leseni tofauti ya kuuza mtandaoni?
answer_sw: Hapana leseni ya ziada maalum ya mauzo ya mtandaoni peke yake. Lakini biashara yako inahitaji: usajili wa BRELA (ikiwa bado hujafanya), TIN, na leseni ya LGA ikiwa una eneo la biashara. Kama mnunuzi ni biashara iliyosajiliwa na ununuzi unazidi TZS 500,000, wanalazimika kukata kodi ya kizuizi. Ikiwa mapato yako ya jumla yanazidi kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200,000,000/mwaka), lazima usajili VAT na kutoa risiti za EFD au VFD kwa malipo yote.
answer_en: No special separate licence specifically for online selling alone. But your business requires: BRELA registration (if not yet done), a TIN, and an LGA licence if you have a physical business location. If the buyer is a registered business and the purchase exceeds TZS 500,000, they are required to withhold tax. If your total income exceeds the VAT threshold (TZS 200,000,000/year), you must register for VAT and issue EFD/VFD receipts for all payments.
question_en: My business sells products online through Jumia or another platform. Do I need a special online selling licence?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA e-commerce circular

question_sw: Mchango wa WCF wa asilimia 0.5 unahesabiwa kwa mshahara wa msingi tu au mshahara wote?
answer_sw: Mchango wa WCF wa asilimia 0.5 unahesabiwa kwa MSHAHARA WOTE (gross emoluments) — si mshahara wa msingi tu. Mshahara wote unajumuisha mshahara wa msingi, posho, bonasi, na malipo mengine ya mwajiri. Hii ni sawa na msingi wa NSSF.
question_en: Is the 0.5% WCF contribution calculated on basic salary only or total wages?
answer_en: The 0.5% WCF contribution is calculated on TOTAL WAGES (gross emoluments) — not just basic salary. Total wages include basic salary, allowances, bonuses, and other employer payments. This is the same basis as NSSF.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya tarehe ya 20 (VAT return) na tarehe ya hati ya zuio la VAT?
answer_sw: Tarehe MBILI tofauti: (1) TAREHE YA 20 ya kila mwezi: hii ni mwisho wa kuwasilisha return ya VAT (VAT return) na kulipa VAT unayodaiwa. Inahusu biashara yoyote iliyosajiliwa VAT. (2) TAREHE YA KUTOA HATI YA ZUIO: hii ni siku ambayo VAT inastahili kulipwa — si mwishoni mwa mwezi. Inahusu manunuzi anayehitimu (qualifying buyer) anayezuia VAT. Kufanya kazi kama qualifying buyer na kutoa hati tarehe ya 20 ni kuchelewa — lazima itolewa mara tu wakati wa zuio.
question_en: What is the difference between the 20th (VAT return) and the VAT withholding certificate date?
answer_en: TWO different dates: (1) THE 20TH of each month: this is the deadline for submitting a VAT return and paying the VAT owed. It applies to any VAT-registered business. (2) VAT WITHHOLDING CERTIFICATE DATE: this is the day the VAT becomes payable — not at month end. It applies to a qualifying buyer who withholds VAT. Operating as a qualifying buyer and issuing certificates on the 20th is late — they must be issued immediately at the time of withholding.

question_sw: Je, TRA inaweza kuangalia historia ya risiti zangu zote za EFD?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRA ina upatikanaji wa moja kwa moja kwa seva ya TRA inayohifadhi taarifa za risiti zote za EFD ulizotoa. Kwa hivyo TRA inaweza kuangalia risiti zote za zamani, kuhesabu mauzo yako ya jumla, na kulinganisha na VAT returns ulizowahi kuwasilisha. Hii ndiyo nguvu kuu ya mfumo wa EFD — kuruhusu TRA kufanya ukaguzi wa kina bila ya lazima kuwepo ofisini kwako.
question_en: Can TRA view the history of all my EFD receipts?
answer_en: Yes. TRA has direct access to the TRA server that stores all your EFD receipt data. Therefore TRA can view all historical receipts, calculate your total sales, and compare with VAT returns you have submitted. This is the core strength of the EFD system — allowing TRA to conduct detailed audits without necessarily being physically present at your business.

question_sw: EFD machine inahitajika kwa kila tawi (branch) la biashara Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kila tawi au mahali pa biashara (point of sale) linalofanya mauzo lazima liwe na EFD lake mwenyewe iliyosajiliwa. Biashara yenye matawi mengi lazima iwe na EFD katika kila tawi. Unaweza kuwa na EFD nyingi zilizosajiliwa kwa TIN moja ya kampuni, lakini kila EFD lazima isajiliwe mahali pamoja na itumike mahali pale.
question_en: Is an EFD machine required for every branch of a business in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Every branch or point of sale that makes sales must have its own registered EFD. A business with multiple branches must have an EFD at each branch. You can have multiple EFDs registered under one company TIN, but each EFD must be registered at a specific location and used at that location.

instruction: Je, bidhaa na huduma vina kiwango sawa cha VAT withholding?
output: Hapana. Bidhaa na huduma vina viwango tofauti vya VAT withholding — kiwango cha bidhaa ni tofauti na kile cha huduma. Kwa hesabu sahihi ya kiasi kinachokatwa kwenye invoice yako, thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Usitegemee bidhaa na huduma kuwa sawa.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ilisajiliwa mwezi Machi — annual return yangu inaisha lini?
output: Hakuna tarehe maalum ya 30 Septemba kwa annual returns za BRELA — tarehe inategemea tarehe ya usajili wa kampuni yako. Annual return inapaswa kuwasilishwa kulingana na tarehe ya kumbukumbu ya usajili wa kampuni yako (anniversary date) — si lazima mwaka wa kifedha. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kwa tarehe yako halisi. Kwa kampuni iliyosajiliwa mwezi Machi, mwaka wako wa biashara utategemea tarehe ya cheti chako cha usajili. Ingia brela.go.tz au wasiliana na BRELA moja kwa moja kujua tarehe yako halisi ya kuwasilisha.

instruction: Ni faida gani za kodi za kuanzisha kampuni katika EPZ dhidi ya Tanzania Bara ya kawaida?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara kwa biashara za kawaida. Ulinganisho wa faida za kodi za EPZ dhidi ya Tanzania Bara ya kawaida inahitaji tathmini kamili ya hali yako — unahitaji utaalamu maalum wa sheria za uwekezaji. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au EPZA kupitia epza.go.tz.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi aliyepelekwa Tanzania kwa miezi 3 (secondment) — PAYE inatumika?
answer_sw: Kwa secondment ya miezi 3, PAYE Tanzania itatumika kwa mapato yote ya ajira Tanzania katika kipindi hicho. Mwajiri (Tanzania au nje) analazimika kukata PAYE ya mshahara wowote unaolipwa kwa kazi inayofanywa Tanzania. Kipindi kifupi cha kazi hakimtoi mfanyakazi kutoka PAYE.
question_en: An employee sent to Tanzania on a 3-month secondment — does PAYE apply?
answer_en: For a 3-month secondment, Tanzania PAYE applies to all employment income earned in Tanzania during that period. The employer (Tanzania or foreign) must deduct PAYE from any salary paid for work performed in Tanzania. A short work period does not exempt the employee from PAYE.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi kwa waajiri wawili analipa PAYE vipi?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi mwenye waajiri wawili au zaidi lazima ataarifu kila mwajiri kuhusu vyanzo vingine vya mapato. Mwajiri mkuu (primary employer) hutumia viwango vya kawaida; waajiri wengine wanatumia kiwango cha juu zaidi (top rate) au makubaliano maalum na TRA. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is PAYE calculated for an employee with two employers?
answer_en: An employee with two or more employers must notify each employer of the other income sources. The primary employer uses the normal tax bands; secondary employers apply the highest rate or a special TRA arrangement. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: GN 487A ilitoa muda wa mpito rasmi kwa wageni walio na biashara zilizotangulia?
answer_sw: GN 487A haikutoa muda mrefu wa mpito rasmi. Amri ilianza kutumika 28 Julai 2025 na ilikuwa ya lazima tangu tarehe hiyo. Zoezi la utekelezaji la Septemba–Oktoba 2025 lilikuwa kampeni maalum — si mwanzo wa uhalali wa amri. Ukiukaji wowote kuanzia 28 Julai 2025 ungeweza kusababisha adhabu.
question_en: Did GN 487A provide a formal transition period for non-citizens with pre-existing businesses?
answer_en: GN 487A did not provide a long formal transition period. The order took effect on 28 July 2025 and was mandatory from that date. The September–October 2025 enforcement exercise was a specific campaign — not the start of the order's legal validity. Any violation from 28 July 2025 onward could result in penalties.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Bendi ya juu kabisa ya PAYE (30%) inaanza lini — ni kwa mapato yote zaidi ya TZS milioni moja?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — kiwango cha 30% kinatumika kwenye sehemu ya mapato INAYOPITA TZS 1,000,000 kwa mwezi. Mapato ya TZS 0-1,000,000 yanapigwa kodi kwa bendi tofauti (0%, 8%, 20%, 25%). Sehemu inayozidi TZS 1,000,000 tu ndiyo inaathiriwa na 30%. Kwa hivyo mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 1,500,000 atalipa 30% kwenye TZS 500,000 tu (sehemu inayopita TZS 1M), si kwenye TZS 1.5M yote.
question_en: When does the highest PAYE band (30%) start — is it on all income above TZS one million?
answer_en: Yes — the 30% rate applies to the portion of income EXCEEDING TZS 1,000,000 per month. Income from TZS 0 to 1,000,000 is taxed at different bands (0%, 8%, 20%, 25%). Only the portion exceeding TZS 1,000,000 is affected by 30%. So an employee earning TZS 1,500,000 will pay 30% on TZS 500,000 only (the portion above TZS 1M), not on the full TZS 1.5M.

question_sw: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kuwasilisha P9 (taarifa ya mwaka ya PAYE) ni tarehe 31 Januari — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Tarehe ya mwisho ya kuwasilisha fomu ya P9 ni tarehe 31 MACHI — si 31 Januari. Tarehe hii inahusu kipindi cha kutoa taarifa ya PAYE kwa mwaka mzima. Adhabu ya kutokutoa fomu ya P9 kwa wakati ni Shilingi 200,000.
question_en: The deadline for submitting the P9 (annual PAYE return) is 31 January — is this true?
answer_en: No. The P9 submission deadline is 31 MARCH — not 31 January. This date applies to the annual PAYE reconciliation return. The penalty for late P9 submission is TZS 200,000.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or TRA deadline change

question_sw: Vifaa vya kinga binafsi (PPE) mfanyakazi anunue mwenyewe — je, mwajiri hana wajibu?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mwajiri analazimika kutoa PPE BILA MALIPO kwa wafanyakazi wanaofanya kazi hatari. Kuwaacha wafanyakazi wanunue PPE wenyewe ni ukiukwaji wa Sheria ya OSHA. Mwajiri ndiye mwenye wajibu mkubwa wa usalama mahali pa kazi.
question_en: Personal protective equipment (PPE) should be bought by the worker themselves — the employer has no obligation?
answer_en: No. The employer is required to provide PPE FREE OF CHARGE to workers in hazardous roles. Requiring workers to buy their own PPE is a violation of the OSHA Act. The employer bears primary responsibility for workplace safety.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina wafanyakazi 15 — lazima nilipe SDL na WCF au moja tu?
output: SDL = asilimia 3.5 → TRA → waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. WCF = asilimia 0.5 → Mamlaka ya WCF → WAAJIRI WOTE (hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi 1). Tofauti kubwa: WCF haina kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi — mwajiri yeyote analipa. Kwa wafanyakazi 15: SDL: NDIYO (umepita kizingiti cha 10) — 3.5% ya mishahara yote → TRA. WCF: NDIYO (inatumika kwa wafanyakazi wote) — 0.5% → Mamlaka ya WCF. Zote mbili zinahitajika — zinawasilishwa kwa mamlaka tofauti.

question_sw: EFD inahitajika kwa biashara ndogo — threshold ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Biashara zilizosajiliwa kwa VAT ni lazima zitumie EFD — bila kujali ukubwa wa biashara. Kizingiti cha usajili wa EFD kinafuata kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT: TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12 au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6. Ukisajiliwa kwa VAT, lazima utumie EFD au VFD. Biashara zisizosajiliwa kwa VAT hazilazimishwi na EFD — lakini TRA inaweza kubadilisha hii.
question_en: Is EFD required for small businesses — what is the threshold?
answer_en: Businesses registered for VAT must use EFD — regardless of business size. The EFD registration threshold follows the VAT registration threshold: TZS 200,000,000 in 12 months or TZS 100,000,000 in 6 months. Once registered for VAT, you must use an EFD or VFD. Non-VAT-registered businesses are not required to use EFD — but TRA may change this.

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kutekeleza GN 605A ndani ya muda gani?
answer_sw: Mwajiri alipaswa kutekeleza GN 605A kuanzia malipo ya kwanza ya mishahara ya Januari 2026. Utekelezaji haukuwa na kipindi cha mpito — ufanisi ulianza moja kwa moja tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: When must an employer implement GN 605A?
answer_en: Employers were required to implement GN 605A from the first payroll of January 2026. There was no transition period — the order took effect immediately on 1 January 2026. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: WHT kwa riba (interest) ni asilimia ngapi kwa wakazi na wasio wakazi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha withholding tax kwa riba ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na pia asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi. Kiwango hiki kinatumika kwa malipo ya riba yanayolipwa na benki, makampuni, au watu binafsi.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on interest for residents and non-residents?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on interest is 10% for residents and 10% for non-residents. This rate applies to interest payments made by banks, companies, or individuals.

question_sw: Nimetaka kubadilisha jina la biashara yangu iliyosajiliwa na BRELA. Nawezaje kufanya hivyo?
answer_sw: Kubadilisha jina la biashara lililosajiliwa na BRELA: (1) angalia kwanza kama jina jipya linapatikana kwenye mfumo wa BRELA ili kuhakikisha halipo tayari; (2) jaza fomu ya mabadiliko ya jina na wasilisha pamoja na nakala ya cheti cha usajili wa sasa na ada ya mabadiliko; (3) BRELA itatoa cheti kipya chenye jina jipya. Muhimu: baada ya kubadilisha jina lazima pia uarifu TRA ili kusasisha akaunti yako ya kodi na TIN certificate yako.
question_en: I want to change my business name registered with BRELA. How do I do this?
answer_en: To change a BRELA-registered business name: (1) first check the new name is available on the BRELA system to ensure it does not already exist; (2) complete the name-change application form and submit it with a copy of the current registration certificate and the amendment fee; (3) BRELA will issue a new certificate with the new name. Important: after changing the name you must also notify TRA to update your tax account and TIN certificate.
primary_source_name: BRELA - Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: BRELA fee or process changes announced by BRELA

instruction: Mfanyakazi wa nyumbani (mama/baba wa mtoto) — mwajiri wake analazimika kuwasilisha NSSF?
output: Ndiyo — wafanyakazi wa nyumbani (domestic workers) kama wasaidizi wa nyumba, walinzi, na mama za watoto wanafunikwa na NSSF Tanzania. Mwajiri (mmiliki wa nyumba) ana wajibu wa: (1) Kusajili mfanyakazi wa nyumbani kwa NSSF ndani ya siku 30 ya kuajiri; (2) Kutuma michango kila mwezi: 10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi wa mshahara. Kutokuwasilisha NSSF ya mfanyakazi wa nyumbani ni ukiukwaji wa sheria — hata kama mfanyakazi hajui haki zake. Faini ya kuchelewa ni 5%/mwezi. Thibitisha na nssf.or.tz.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya usajili wa biashara (BRELA) na leseni ya biashara (LGA) ni nini?
answer_sw: Hizi ni hatua mbili tofauti za kufuata sheria. Usajili wa BRELA unasajili JINA au MUUNDO wa biashara yako (kampuni au biashara ya mtu mmoja) kwenye rejista ya kitaifa — ni mara moja tu. Leseni ya biashara ya LGA inakupa RUHUSA ya kufanya shughuli za biashara katika eneo maalum la kijiografia la LGA — inarudiwa kila mwaka. Unahitaji zote mbili: BRELA kwa uhalali wa kisheria wa biashara yako, LGA kwa ruhusa ya eneo.
question_en: What is the difference between business registration (BRELA) and a business licence (LGA)?
answer_en: These are two separate compliance steps. BRELA registration registers the NAME or STRUCTURE of your business (company or sole proprietorship) in the national registry — done once. An LGA business licence gives you PERMISSION to conduct business activities in a specific geographic area of the LGA — renewed annually. You need both: BRELA for the legal existence of your business, LGA for area permission.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: Business registration or licensing framework update

instruction: Mfanyakazi wa nyumbani (domestic worker) amepata ajali kazini — WCF inamsaidia au NSSF?
output: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ndiyo inayolipa fidia kwa ajali za kazi — si NSSF. NSSF inahusika na: pensheni, mafao ya uzeeni, ulemavu wa muda mrefu, na kifo cha kawaida. WCF inahusika na: ajali za kazi (work injuries), magonjwa ya kazini (occupational diseases), na kifo kilichotokana na kazi. Kwa mfanyakazi wa nyumbani aliyepata ajali: mwajiri alipaswa kusajili mfanyakazi kwa WCF — akifanya hivyo, WCF italipa fidia. Kama mwajiri hakusajili — mwajiri anaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi kwa fidia. Mwajiri wa wafanyakazi wa nyumbani lazima alsajili WCF pia. Thibitisha na wcf.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, kizingiti cha miezi 6 cha TZS 100M kinatumika kwa miezi sita MAALUM (Jan-Jun) au kipindi chochote?
answer_sw: Kizingiti cha miezi 6 kinatumika kwa KIPINDI CHOCHOTE cha miezi 6 mfululizo — si kwa miezi sita maalum ya mwaka. Hii inamaanisha TRA inaangalia mauzo yako katika kipindi cha kuzunguka (rolling 6-month period). Mauzo ya miezi Januari-Juni, Februari-Julai, Machi-Agosti — yote yanachaguliwa. Ukizidi TZS 100M katika kipindi chochote cha miezi 6, usajili ni wa lazima.
question_en: Does the 6-month TZS 100M threshold apply to SPECIFIC months (Jan-Jun) or any 6-month period?
answer_en: The 6-month threshold applies to ANY consecutive 6-month period — not specific calendar months. This means TRA looks at your sales in a rolling 6-month period. Sales for January-June, February-July, March-August — all are considered. If you exceed TZS 100M in any 6-month period at all, registration is mandatory.

instruction: Mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara TZS 1,200,000 kwa mwezi — PAYE yake ni ngapi?
output:
Hesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 1,200,000/mwezi:
Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 = TZS 0
Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000
Bendi 3 (20%): TZS 240,000 × 20% = TZS 48,000
Bendi 4 (25%): TZS 240,000 × 25% = TZS 60,000
Bendi 5 (30%): TZS 200,000 × 30% = TZS 60,000
PAYE ya jumla: TZS 188,000/mwezi
TZS 200,000 ya ziada juu ya TZS 1,000,000 iko Bendi 5 (30%) = TZS 60,000.

question_sw: Je, mteja anaweza kuomba risiti ya EFD kwa muamala wowote?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mteja ana haki ya kupata risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala. Biashara yenye EFD inalazimika kutoa risiti bila kusita. Ikiwa mteja hakupewa risiti, ana haki ya kulalamika kwa TRA. TRA inakusudia wanunuzi kuwa 'wakaguzi wadogo' kwa kuomba risiti — hii inasaidia kupambana na ukwepaji wa kodi.
question_en: Can a customer request an EFD receipt for any transaction?
answer_en: Yes. A customer has the right to receive an EFD receipt for every transaction. A business with EFD is obligated to issue receipts without hesitation. If a customer is not given a receipt, they have the right to complain to TRA. TRA encourages buyers to be 'small inspectors' by requesting receipts — this helps combat tax evasion.

instruction: Nililipa ushuru wa 4% ya jumla ya mishahara — nilikusudia kulipa SDL na WCF pamoja kwa TRA. Hii ni sahihi?
output:
Hapana — hii si sahihi kabisa. SDL na WCF hazilipwi kwa mkupuo mmoja wa asilimia 4 kwa TRA. Zinalipwa TOFAUTI kwa mamlaka TOFAUTI:

SDL = 3.5% — inalipwa TRA.
WCF = 0.5% — inalipwa Mamlaka ya WCF (si TRA).

Kulipa 4% kwa TRA kunaweza kukuridhisha SDL lakini si WCF. Bado una deni la WCF (0.5%) kwa Mamlaka ya WCF. Lipa WCF kwa Mamlaka ya WCF moja kwa moja. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na Mamlaka ya WCF.

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kutunza rekodi gani za usalama wa mahali pa kazi?
answer_sw: Mwajiri lazima atunze: rejesta ya ajali na matukio, rekodi za mafunzo ya usalama, rekodi za uchunguzi wa afya wa wafanyakazi, matokeo ya ukaguzi wa usalama, na nakala za notisi za OSHA. Rekodi hizi zinaweza kukaguliwa na inspekta wa OSHA.
