question_en: What safety records must an employer keep at the workplace?
answer_en: An employer must maintain: an accident and incident register, safety training records, employee health surveillance records, safety inspection results, and copies of OSHA notices. These records can be inspected by an OSHA inspector.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Hati ya ukodishaji (tenancy agreement) ya nyumba ya kawaida ya kaya inahitaji ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Makubaliano ya ukodishaji wa nyumba ya makazi (residential tenancy) ya muda mfupi kwa kawaida yanaweza yasiwe kwenye orodha ya nyaraka zinazohitaji ushuru wa stempu au yawe na ushuru mdogo Tanzania. Hata hivyo, mikataba ya kukodisha ya muda mrefu ya mali za kibiashara kwa kawaida ina ushuru wa stempu. Angalia Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu au TRA kwa mwongozo wa hali yako.
question_en: Does a regular residential tenancy agreement require stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: Short-term residential tenancy agreements may not be listed in the stamp duty schedule or may attract minimal duty in Tanzania. However, long-term commercial property leases typically carry stamp duty. Check the Stamp Duty Act or TRA for guidance on your specific situation.

question_sw: Mgeni aliyekamatwa akifanya biashara ya rejareja — anaweza kukwepa faini kwa kulipa haraka?
answer_sw: Hapana — kulipa faini haraka haizuii adhabu nyingine. Adhabu za GN 487A zote tatu (faini ya angalau TZS 10M, kifungo hadi miezi 6, visa kufutwa) zinaamuliwa na korti. Kulipa faini si utaratibu wa makubaliano wa nje ya korti. Pia, kulipa faini hakuzuii kufutwa kwa visa — visa itafutwa hata kama faini imelipwa.
question_en: A non-citizen caught conducting retail trade — can they avoid the penalty by paying quickly?
answer_en: No — paying a fine quickly does not prevent the other penalties. All three GN 487A penalties (fine of at least TZS 10M, imprisonment up to 6 months, visa revocation) are decided by a court. Paying a fine is not an out-of-court settlement procedure. Also, paying the fine does not prevent visa revocation — the visa will be revoked even if the fine is paid.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Wakaguzi wa TRA wanaweza kuja biashara yangu lini?
answer_sw: TRA inspectors wana haki ya kutembelea biashara yoyote wakati wowote wa saa za kazi (business hours) — bila tangazo la mapema (without prior notice) kwa ukaguzi wa EFD na kodi. Wanaweza kuangalia EFD yako, kuomba Z-reports, na kukagua rekodi za akaunti. Kama unafanya biashara kwa kanuni, ukaguzi haupaswi kukuumiza. Uhifadhi bora wa rekodi na matumizi sahihi ya EFD ndiyo ulinzi bora.
question_en: When can TRA inspectors visit my business?
answer_en: TRA inspectors have the right to visit any business at any time during business hours — without prior notice — for EFD and tax inspections. They can inspect your EFD, request Z-reports, and review accounting records. If you operate by the rules, an inspection should not cause you problems. Good record keeping and proper EFD use is the best protection.

question_sw: Kama nina wafanyakazi wachini ya 10, bado nailazimika kulipa mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. GN 605A inatumika kwa waajiri wote bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Tofauti pekee ni SDL — SDL ya asilimia 3.5 inatakiwa tu kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Lakini mshahara wa chini ni lazima hata kama una mfanyakazi mmoja tu.
question_en: If I have fewer than 10 employees do I still need to pay the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: Yes. GN 605A applies to all employers regardless of staff count. The only difference is SDL — the 3.5% Skills Development Levy applies only to employers with 10 or more staff. But the minimum wage is mandatory even with just one employee.

question_sw: Niliuza ardhi yangu kwa TZS 80M — capital gains tax (kodi ya mapato ya mtaji) ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kodi ya mapato ya mtaji (capital gains tax) kwenye ardhi ni mada ngumu inayohitaji maarifa ya kina ya sheria ya mapato ya Tanzania — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Suala hili linahusisha: thamani ya ununuzi wa awali, muda wa umiliki, aina ya ardhi (title deed vs hati nyingine), na msamaha wa kisheria unaowezekana. Muona wakili au mhesabu wa kodi aliyehitimu.
question_en: I sold my land for TZS 80M — how much is the capital gains tax?
answer_en: Capital gains tax on land is a complex topic requiring detailed knowledge of Tanzanian income tax law — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. This matter involves: the original purchase value, ownership period, type of land documentation, and possible legal exemptions. Consult a qualified lawyer or tax accountant.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment on capital gains

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu unalipwa lini — kabla au baada ya kusaini mkataba?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania kwa kawaida unahitajika kulipwa KABLA ya hati kusajiliwa rasmi au kabla ya kutumika katika mahakama. Hati ambayo haijalipwa ushuru wa stempu inaweza kukosa nguvu ya kisheria au kukataliwi katika mahakama. Ni busara kulipa ushuru wa stempu mara baada ya kusainiwa hati ili hati iwe na nguvu ya kisheria kamili.
question_en: When is stamp duty paid — before or after signing a contract?
answer_en: Stamp duty in Tanzania is generally required to be paid BEFORE the instrument is formally registered or before it is used in court. An instrument that has not had stamp duty paid may lack legal force or be rejected in court. It is advisable to pay stamp duty promptly after signing so the instrument has full legal effect.

instruction: Kwa invoice ya TZS 1,000,000 ya bidhaa, serikali itakata kiasi gani cha VAT withholding?
output: Kiasi kinachofaa kukatwa kinategemea kiwango cha withholding kilichowekwa na TRA kwa bidhaa. Kwa hesabu sahihi, thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Kumbuka: VAT ya invoice ya TZS 1,000,000 kwa kiwango cha kawaida cha 18% ni TZS 180,000 — sehemu ya hiyo ndiyo inayokatwa kulingana na kiwango cha withholding. Kwa hesabu halisi, thibitisha na TRA kwa hesabu sahihi.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: PAYE inarudishwa TRA kwa njia gani?
answer_sw: PAYE inarudishwa kupitia mfumo wa IDRAS (TRA Taxpayer Portal) mtandaoni. Mwajiri anaingiza return ya mwezi na kisha kulipa kupitia GePG au benki iliyoidhinishwa. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is PAYE remitted to TRA?
answer_en: PAYE is remitted through the IDRAS (TRA Taxpayer Portal) online system. The employer files a monthly return and pays through GePG or an approved bank. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Kiwango cha VAT Zanzibar ni sawa na Tanzania Bara — asilimia 18?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa masuala ya Zanzibar. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia Tanzania Bara peke yake. Zanzibar ina mfumo wake wa kodi kupitia ZRB (Zanzibar Revenue Board) — viwango vya VAT Zanzibar vinaweza kutofautiana na Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na ZRB kupitia zrb.go.tz kwa habari sahihi. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz kwa masuala ya Tanzania Bara.

question_sw: Nini lengo la SDL — ni malipo ya likizo ya ugonjwa au mafunzo ya kazi?
answer_sw: Lengo la SDL ni kufadhili mafunzo ya ufundi na ujuzi wa kazi (vocational training) nchini Tanzania — si malipo ya likizo. SDL ilanzishwa ili kusaidia VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) na mifumo ya mafunzo ya kitaalamu. Mwajiri ndiye analipa, mfanyakazi hapunguziwa kitu.
question_en: What is the purpose of SDL — is it sick leave payments or job training?
answer_en: The purpose of SDL is to fund vocational and job skills training in Tanzania — not leave payments. SDL was established to support VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) and professional training systems. The employer pays it; nothing is deducted from the employee.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Mtu anayefanya kazi nje ya nchi lakini bado ana biashara Tanzania ana wajibu gani wa kodi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hali inategemea ukazi wa kodi (tax residency). Ikiwa mtu amekaa nje ya Tanzania zaidi ya siku 183 kwa mwaka wa fedha, huenda asizingatiwe mkazi wa kodi wa Tanzania kwa kipato chake cha kigeni. Hata hivyo, biashara yake Tanzania bado inalipa kodi ya Tanzania kwenye mapato yanayotokana Tanzania. Anapaswa kupata ushauri maalum kutoka mwanasheria wa kodi wa kimataifa kwa hali yake.
question_en: A person working abroad but still owning a business in Tanzania — what Tanzania tax obligations apply?
answer_en: The situation depends on tax residency. If a person has been outside Tanzania for more than 183 days in a tax year, they may not be considered a Tanzania tax resident for their foreign income. However, their Tanzania business still pays Tanzania tax on income arising in Tanzania. They should get specific advice from an international tax lawyer for their situation.

question_sw: TRA inazuia VAT gani kwa malipo ya bidhaa na kwa malipo ya huduma?
answer_sw: VAT withholding ya Tanzania (Finance Act 2025, kuanza Julai 2025): BIDHAA — asilimia 3 ya VAT inazuiwa; HUDUMA — asilimia 6 ya VAT inazuiwa. Tofauti: kiwango cha bidhaa (3%) ni nusu ya kiwango cha huduma (6%). Kumbuka: hizi si viwango vya VAT vyenyewe (ambayo ni 18%) — ni sehemu tu ya VAT inayozuiwa na qualifying buyer kabla ya kufikia msambazaji.
question_en: What VAT withholding rate does TRA apply to goods payments and services payments?
answer_en: Tanzania VAT withholding (Finance Act 2025, effective July 2025): GOODS — 3% VAT is withheld; SERVICES — 6% VAT is withheld. The difference: the goods rate (3%) is half the services rate (6%). Note: these are not the VAT rates themselves (which are 18%) — they are only the portion of VAT withheld by the qualifying buyer before it reaches the supplier.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing VAT withholding rates

instruction: Biashara yangu inaingiza mapato ya TZS 250M kwa mwaka lakini VAT register haikuwahi kufanywa — ninafanyaje?
output: Unapaswa kujisajili VAT haraka iwezekanavyo — usijaribu kuficha au kuahirisha zaidi. Hatua za kufuata: (1) Nenda TRA na uwasilishe ombi la usajili wa VAT — eleza hali yako ya biashara; (2) TRA itaamua tarehe ya usajili (inaweza kuwa nyuma — 'back-date') kuanzia ulipofika kizingiti; (3) Utahitajika kulipa VAT ya nyuma + faini + riba ya kuchelewa; (4) Anza kutoza VAT kwa wateja wote mara VRN itakapotolewa. Hali hii ya kujisajili marehemu ni nzuri kuliko kuendelea bila usajili — unoona ushirikiano na TRA. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi kwanza. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mtanzania alikubaliana na mgeni kutumia jina lake kusajili biashara huku mgeni ndiye anaendesha. Je, yule Mtanzania anakabiliwa na nini kisheria?
answer_sw: GN 487A ina adhabu maalum kwa Watanzania wanaosaidia wageni kukwepa marufuku hii. Adhabu kwa Mtanzania anayewezesha ni: faini ya TZS 5,000,000 au kifungo kisichozidi miezi 3 gerezani. Hii inatumika kama Mtanzania alitoa jina lake kusajili biashara, aliruhusu mgeni kutumia leseni yake, au alionyesha kuwa yeye ni mmiliki huku mgeni akiendesha biashara halisi. Idara ya Uhamiaji na TRA wanachunguza hali kama hizi na adhabu hizi zinatumika.
question_en: A Tanzanian citizen registered a business in his name while a foreigner actually runs it. What does the Tanzanian face legally?
answer_en: GN 487A has specific penalties for Tanzanian citizens who help non-citizens circumvent the prohibition. Penalty for a Tanzanian facilitator: a fine of TZS 5,000,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 months. This applies where the Tanzanian registered the business in their name, allowed a foreigner to use their licence, or presented themselves as the owner while the foreigner ran the actual business. The Immigration Department and TRA investigate such arrangements and these penalties are enforced.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A or penalty amounts changed by new order

question_sw: GN 487A inaathiri Watanzania wote? Au ni wageni wa nchi fulani tu?
answer_sw: GN 487A inawahusu WAGENI (raia wa kigeni) WOTE — bila kujali utaifa wao. Inazuia raia wa Kenya, China, India, Uropa, na nchi yoyote nyingine kufanya biashara zilizoorodheshwa. Watanzania wote (wa asili na wenye uraia) hawaathiriwi na vikwazo vya GN 487A kwa biashara. Hivyo, utaifa si kigezo — uraia wa Tanzania ndicho kigezo.
question_en: Does GN 487A affect all Tanzanians? Or only non-citizens from certain countries?
answer_en: GN 487A applies to ALL NON-CITIZENS (foreign nationals) — regardless of their nationality. It prohibits citizens of Kenya, China, India, Europe, and any other country from conducting the listed businesses. All Tanzanians (by birth or naturalisation) are unaffected by GN 487A business prohibitions. So nationality is not the criterion — Tanzanian citizenship is the criterion.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Kizingiti cha VAT Tanzania kimebadilika mwaka 2025?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT Tanzania Bara kilibaki bila mabadiliko mwaka 2025: TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12, au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6. Finance Act 2025 haikubadilisha kizingiti hiki. Kiwango cha VAT pia kilibaki asilimia 18 — kiwango kimoja cha kawaida.
question_en: Did the VAT threshold in Tanzania change in 2025?
answer_en: No. The VAT registration threshold on Mainland Tanzania remained unchanged in 2025: TZS 200,000,000 over 12 months, or TZS 100,000,000 over 6 months. Finance Act 2025 did not change this threshold. The VAT rate also remained 18% — the one standard rate.

question_sw: Utekelezaji wa GN 487A unafanywa na idara gani na kwa wakati gani?
answer_sw: GN 487A inatekelezwa na Idara ya Huduma za Uhamiaji. Utekelezaji mkubwa ulifanywa kati ya tarehe 11 Septemba na 8 Oktoba 2025 — mazoezi ya ukaguzi wa biashara katika maeneo ya biashara ya Tanzania. Maofisa wa uhamiaji walikuwa na mamlaka ya kukagua biashara, kuuliza hati, na kuchukua hatua dhidi ya wavunjaji.
question_en: Which department enforces GN 487A and during what period?
answer_en: GN 487A is enforced by the Immigration Services Department. A major enforcement exercise was conducted between 11 September and 8 October 2025 — a business inspection exercise at Tanzania's commercial areas. Immigration officers had authority to inspect businesses, demand documents, and take action against violators.

question_sw: Je, biashara ya mtandaoni ya Tanzania inayouza kwa wateja nje ya Tanzania inahitaji EFD?
answer_sw: Mauzo ya nje ya Tanzania (exports) kwa wateja wa nje ya nchi yanaweza kuwa zero-rated kwa VAT — yaani VAT ya asilimia 0. Hata hivyo, biashara bado inahitaji kuandika muamala huu kwenye mfumo wake wa VAT na EFD/VFD. Taarifa za muamala wa zero-rated bado zinapelekwa TRA kupitia VFD. Risiti/invoice inatolewa kwa mteja wa nje — kwa kiwango cha asilimia 0 — na inawasilishwa kwenye VAT return kama mauzo ya zero-rated.
question_en: Does a Tanzanian online business selling to customers outside Tanzania need EFD?
answer_en: Sales outside Tanzania (exports) to foreign customers may be zero-rated for VAT — meaning 0% VAT. However, the business still needs to record these transactions in its VAT and EFD/VFD system. Zero-rated transaction data is still transmitted to TRA through the VFD. A receipt/invoice is issued to the foreign customer — at 0% — and reported on the VAT return as zero-rated sales.

instruction: VAT return inawasilishwa online au ni lazima nifike ofisini TRA?
output: VAT return inaweza kuwasilishwa kupitia mifumo miwili: ONLINE (inashauriwa): Kupitia TRA portal ya IDRAS (Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System) — biashara zinazosajiliwa zina akaunti ya online; Faida: haraka, rekodi zinabaki, hakuna foleni; Malipo yanaweza pia kufanywa online kupitia benki zilizounganishwa. OFISINI: Kwa biashara ndogo au ambazo hazina ufikiaji wa mtandao — zinaweza kwenda ofisi ya TRA ya karibu; Hata hivyo, TRA inazidi kushukiza biashara zote kutumia mfumo wa online. Usajili wa IDRAS unafanywa mara tu unapopata TIN yako. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na IDRAS.

instruction: Mgeni aliyekamatwa anaweza kulipia 'kitu kidogo' polisi na kuendelea na biashara — hii inafanya kazi?
output: Hapana — hii ni rushwa ambayo pia ni kosa la jinai nchini Tanzania. GN 487A ni sheria ya kitaifa inayotekelezwa na mahakama — si faini ya kiutawala inayoweza kusamehewa na polisi mmoja. Mgeni anayekamatwa lazima afikishwe mahakamani kwa hukumu rasmi: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Kulipa rushwa kunaongeza hatari ya sheria. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Kampuni mpya inayoanza (intending trader) inaweza kusajili VAT bila kuwa na mapato bado?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mtu anayekusudia kufanya biashara (intending trader) anaweza kuomba usajili wa VAT 'wakati wowote' mradi atoe ushahidi wa kutosha kama vile mikataba, zabuni, mipango ya ujenzi, mipango ya biashara, au ufadhili wa benki. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Can a new start-up (intending trader) register for VAT with no revenue yet?
answer_en: Yes. An intending trader can apply for VAT registration 'at any time' provided they present sufficient evidence such as contracts, tenders, building plans, business plans, or bank financing. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni inanunua mashine mpya ya TZS 50,000,000. Je, inaweza kudai punguzo la mwaka wa kwanza (first year allowance) la 50%?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato Tanzania ina kifungu cha punguzo la uwekezaji (investment deduction) ambacho kinaruhusu kampuni kudai 50% ya gharama ya mali mpya ya kustahili katika mwaka wa kwanza wa ununuzi, badala ya uchakavu wa kawaida. Kwa mashine ya TZS 50,000,000: punguzo la mwaka wa kwanza = 50% × 50,000,000 = TZS 25,000,000 inayokatwa mwaka wa kwanza. Kiasi kilichobaki (TZS 25,000,000) kinaendelea kukatwa kwa kiwango cha uchakavu cha kawaida katika miaka inayofuata. Thibitisha kama mali yako inastahili chaguo hili na mshauri wa kodi.
answer_en: Yes. Tanzania's Income Tax Act has an investment deduction provision that allows a company to claim 50% of the cost of qualifying new assets in the first year of purchase, instead of the normal depreciation. For machinery costing TZS 50,000,000: first year allowance = 50% × 50,000,000 = TZS 25,000,000 deducted in year one. The remaining balance (TZS 25,000,000) continues to be depreciated at the normal rate in subsequent years. Confirm whether your asset qualifies for this option with a tax consultant.
question_en: A company buys new machinery for TZS 50,000,000. Can it claim a 50% first year allowance?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — investment deduction ITA Cap.332

question_sw: Mtu wa kigeni akilazimika kwenda nje ya Tanzania kwa muda mfupi — kibali chake kinaendelea kufanya kazi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kibali cha kazi cha Tanzania kinaendelea kutumika kwa ujumla hata ikiwa mhusika anaondoka Tanzania kwa muda mfupi (kama safari ya biashara au familia). Hata hivyo, visas vya kuingia tena (re-entry visas) vinaweza kuhitajika kulingana na uraia wa mhusika na masharti ya eneo lake. Angalia Idara ya Uhamiaji kwa masharti ya hali yako.
question_en: If a foreigner must leave Tanzania briefly — does their work permit remain valid?
answer_en: Yes, a Tanzania work permit generally continues to be valid even if the holder leaves Tanzania briefly (such as for a business trip or family visit). However, re-entry visas may be required depending on the holder's nationality and visa conditions. Check with the Immigration Department for requirements in your specific situation.

question_sw: EFD inatumika kwa mauzo ya bidhaa zilizo huru ya VAT (exempt) Tanzania — au EFD ni kwa mauzo ya VAT tu?
answer_sw: EFD inatumika kwa mauzo YOTE ya biashara iliyolazimika kutumia EFD — ikiwa ni pamoja na mauzo ya bidhaa zilizo huru ya VAT (exempt) na mauzo ya kiwango cha sifuri (zero-rated). Biashara lazima iingie muamala wote kwenye EFD na iuainishe ipasavyo (standard rate, zero-rated, exempt). Kuchagua tu mauzo ya VAT kwenye EFD na kuacha mauzo ya exempt ni kosa la uzingatiaji wa EFD.
question_en: Is an EFD used for exempt VAT sales in Tanzania — or is an EFD only for VAT sales?
answer_en: An EFD is used for ALL sales of a business required to use an EFD — including exempt VAT sales and zero-rated sales. The business must enter all transactions in the EFD and categorise them correctly (standard rate, zero-rated, exempt). Entering only VAT sales in the EFD and leaving out exempt sales is an EFD compliance error.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD categorisation or compliance update

question_sw: Mpango mbadala wa NSSF (15%/5%) unafanya kazi vipi?
answer_sw: Badala ya mgawanyo wa kawaida wa 10%/10%, mwajiri anaweza kulipa asilimia 15 na mfanyakazi asilimia 5. Jumla bado ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi. Mpango huu unaruhusiwa chini ya Sheria ya NSSF Kifungu cha 12. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How does the alternative NSSF arrangement (15%/5%) work?
answer_en: Instead of the standard 10%/10% split, the employer may pay 15% and the employee 5%. The total remains 20% of gross wage. This arrangement is permitted under the NSSF Act Section 12. Confirm with NSSF.

instruction: PAYE ya mfanyakazi wangu mwenye mshahara wa TZS 800,000 kwa mwezi ni kiasi gani?
output:
PAYE ya mshahara wa TZS 800,000 kwa mwezi inakokotolewa kwa kanda za PAYE kama ifuatavyo:

Kanda 1 (0%): TZS 0 hadi 270,000 — kodi = TZS 0
Kanda 2 (8%): TZS 270,001 hadi 520,000 — TZS 250,000 x 8% = TZS 20,000
Kanda 3 (20%): TZS 520,001 hadi 760,000 — TZS 240,000 x 20% = TZS 48,000
Kanda 4 (25%): TZS 760,001 hadi 800,000 — TZS 40,000 x 25% = TZS 10,000

Jumla ya PAYE = TZS 78,000 kwa mwezi.

PAYE hii inakatwa mshahara wa mfanyakazi na kuwasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: TRA inaweza kusamehe adhabu za kodi (penalty waiver)? Ninaomba vipi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRA ina nguvu ya kusamehe adhabu (penalty waiver) kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato chini ya masharti fulani. Vigezo vinavyozingatiwa: hali ya nguvu ya lazima iliyosababisha kuchelewa (maumivu, majanga ya asili), historia nzuri ya utii wa kodi, na nia njema ya kulipa. Hatua za kuomba: (1) Lipa kodi yote ya msingi na riba kwanza. (2) Wasilisha maombi rasmi ya maandishi kwa Kamishna wa TRA ukieleza sababu za kuchelewa na hati zinazothibitisha. (3) Subiri uamuzi. Samahani nyingi zinatolewa kwa walipa kodi wa mara ya kwanza wenye rekodi nzuri. Samahani haizuii riba — riba mara nyingi italipwa hata baada ya samahani ya adhabu.
answer_en: Yes. TRA has authority to waive penalties under the Income Tax Act under certain conditions. Factors considered: force majeure circumstances causing the delay (illness, natural disasters), good compliance history, and genuine intent to pay. Steps to apply: (1) First pay all principal tax owed and any interest. (2) File a formal written application to the TRA Commissioner General explaining the reasons for the delay with supporting documents. (3) Await the decision. Many waivers are granted to first-time offenders with good records. A waiver does not cover interest — interest typically remains payable even after a penalty waiver.
question_en: Can TRA waive tax penalties (penalty waiver)? How do I apply?

instruction: NSSF inanisaidia vipi wakati wa kustaafu?
output: NSSF inatoa mafao ya pensheni ukitimia umri wa miaka 60 (55 kwa sekta ya madini) na ukiwa na angalau miezi 180 ya mchango (miaka 15). Mafao yanajumuisha: pensheni ya kila mwezi, mafao ya ulemavu, mafao ya kufiwa. Kwa mafao kamili na jinsi ya kudai, thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.or.tz) — masharti yanaweza kuwa na masharti zaidi kulingana na muda wa uanachama.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Mabadiliko ya wakurugenzi wa kampuni yanapaswa kuripotiwa BRELA ndani ya muda gani?
answer_sw: Mabadiliko ya wakurugenzi (uteuzi mpya au kuacha) yanapaswa kuripotiwa BRELA ndani ya siku 14 baada ya mabadiliko. Kuchelewa kuwasilisha ni ukiukwaji wa kisheria. Mabadiliko yanawasilishwa kupitia fomu rasmi za BRELA pamoja na ada husika.
question_en: Within what timeframe must changes in company directors be reported to BRELA?
answer_en: Changes in directors (new appointment or resignation) must be reported to BRELA within 14 days of the change. Late filing is a legal breach. Changes are filed using official BRELA forms with the applicable fee.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Biashara ya courier au delivery ya vitu (si posta ya serikali) inayomilikiwa na mgeni — je, GN 487A inahusika?
output: Ndiyo — huduma za ujumbe na delivery ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A (tarehe 28 Julai 2025). Hii inajumuisha courier ya vitu, delivery ya chakula, vifurushi, na huduma za ujumbe. Mgeni anayemiliki au kuendesha huduma kama hizo anakabiliwa na: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Mashirika ya kidini na ya hisani (charitable) hayalazimishwi na mchakato wa pingamizi la kodi — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mashirika ya kidini na ya hisani yanayolazimishwa na kodi au yanayopokea tathmini ya kodi (hata ikiwa yanaamini wana msamaha) yalazimike kufuata mchakato ule ule wa pingamizi — yaani kuwasilisha ndani ya siku 30 na kulipa 1/3. Madai ya msamaha yanashughulikiwa kama sehemu ya maudhui ya pingamizi.
question_en: Religious and charitable organisations are not required to follow the tax objection process — is this true?
answer_en: No. Religious and charitable organisations that are assessed for tax (even if they believe they have an exemption) must follow the same objection process — filing within 30 days and paying 1/3. Exemption claims are addressed as part of the substance of the objection.

question_sw: Boss wangu analipa chini ya GN 605A — ninafanya nini?
answer_sw: Ukijua mshahara wako uko chini ya kiwango cha GN 605A, una haki ya kudai tofauti. Kwanza, zungumza na mwajiri wako kwa amani. Kama hajabadilisha hali, unaweza kwenda Ofisi ya Kazi ya karibu nawe (Labour Office) au Kamati ya Usuluhishi wa Migogoro ya Kazi (CMA) kudai malipo yako. Huna haja ya wakili.
question_en: My employer is paying below GN 605A — what do I do?
answer_en: If you know your salary is below the GN 605A rate, you have the right to claim the shortfall. First, speak with your employer peacefully. If they don't change, you can go to the nearest Labour Office or the Commission for Mediation and Arbitration (CMA) to claim your pay. You don't need a lawyer.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya WHT na PAYE ni nini?
answer_sw: WHT (Withholding Tax) inahusu MALIPO YANAYOTOKA KWA BIASHARA — kama gawio, riba, royalties, na ada za huduma. PAYE (Pay As You Earn) inahusu MISHAHARA YA WAFANYAKAZI. WHT inakataolewa na mlipaji kabla ya kutoa malipo. PAYE inakataolewa na mwajiri kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Zote mbili zinawasilishwa TRA.
question_en: What is the difference between WHT and PAYE?
answer_en: WHT (Withholding Tax) applies to BUSINESS PAYMENTS — such as dividends, interest, royalties, and service fees. PAYE (Pay As You Earn) applies to EMPLOYEE SALARIES. WHT is deducted by the payer before making the payment. PAYE is deducted by the employer from the employee's salary. Both are remitted to TRA.

question_sw: Je, kiwango cha VAT withholding kilikuwa tofauti kabla ya Finance Act 2025?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kabla ya Finance Act 2025, kiwango cha VAT withholding kilikuwa: asilimia 2 kwa bidhaa na asilimia 5 kwa huduma (kwa baadhi ya makampuni) au viwango tofauti. Finance Act 2025 ilipanga upya: asilimia 3 kwa bidhaa na asilimia 6 kwa huduma, kuanzia 1 Julai 2025. Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT kilibaki asilimia 18 — hakikubadilika.
question_en: Was the VAT withholding rate different before Finance Act 2025?
answer_en: Yes. Before Finance Act 2025, the VAT withholding rate was different. Finance Act 2025 standardised it at: 3% on goods and 6% on services, effective 1 July 2025. The standard VAT rate remained at 18% — it did not change.

question_sw: Je, kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT kinatumika kwa biashara za kidijitali?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kizingiti cha VAT Tanzania (TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6) kinatumika kwa biashara zote — za kidijitali NA za kimwili. Biashara ya mtandaoni inayofikia kizingiti hiki lazima isajiliwe kwa VAT kama kampuni yoyote nyingine.
question_en: Does the VAT registration threshold apply to digital businesses?
answer_en: Yes. Tanzania's VAT registration threshold (TZS 200M/year or TZS 100M/6 months) applies to all businesses — digital AND physical. An online business reaching this threshold must register for VAT like any other company.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: Kampuni ya NGO ya kigeni inafuata sheria sawa ya vibali vya kazi kama kampuni ya faida?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. NGO za kigeni zinahitaji vibali vya kazi kwa wafanyakazi wao wa kigeni kama kampuni za faida. Sheria ya Uhamiaji inatumika bila kujali aina ya shirika. NGO inayoshindwa kupata vibali vya kazi kwa wafanyakazi wake wa kigeni inakiuka sheria ya uhamiaji.
question_en: Does a foreign NGO follow the same work permit laws as a for-profit company?
answer_en: Yes. Foreign NGOs need work permits for their foreign workers just like for-profit companies. The Immigration Act applies regardless of the type of organisation. An NGO that fails to obtain work permits for its foreign workers is in violation of immigration law.

question_sw: Ninahitaji taarifa za hali ya hewa Tanzania kwa biashara yangu ya kilimo.
answer_sw: Taarifa za hali ya hewa (weather/climate data) ni nje ya upeo wangu — ninashughulikia kodi na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Kwa taarifa za hali ya hewa na misimu ya kilimo, wasiliana na: Tanzania Meteorological Authority (TMA) kwa meteo.go.tz, au Wizara ya Kilimo. Je, kuna swali la kodi ya kilimo au SDL ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: I need weather data for my agricultural business in Tanzania.
answer_en: Weather and climate data is outside my scope — I handle Tanzania Mainland taxes and business registration. For weather and farming season information, contact: Tanzania Meteorological Authority (TMA) at meteo.go.tz, or the Ministry of Agriculture. Is there an agricultural tax or SDL question I can help with?

question_sw: Je, biashara mpya inayonunua vifaa vya ofisi — inaweza kudai VAT refund?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, ikiwa biashara imesajiliwa VAT. Ununuzi wa vifaa vya ofisi (kompyuta, samani, vifaa vya ofisi) kutoka wasambazaji waliosajilistwaa VAT unazalisha input VAT. Kama input VAT inazidi output VAT (kawaida mwanzoni mwa biashara), biashara ina haki ya kudai refund au kubeba credit mbele.
question_en: A new business buying office equipment — can it claim a VAT refund?
answer_en: Yes, if the business is VAT-registered. Purchasing office equipment (computers, furniture, office supplies) from VAT-registered suppliers generates input VAT. If input VAT exceeds output VAT (common at the start of a business), the business is entitled to claim a refund or carry the credit forward.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

instruction: Ninaleta dawa za kilimo kutoka India — ushuru wa kuingiza ni asilimia ngapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ushuru wa dawa za kilimo (agricultural inputs import duty) unaweza kuwa na msamaha maalum au asilimia tofauti kulingana na aina — hii ni mada ya Customs and Excise nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT ya biashara, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Tafadhali wasiliana na TRA Customs and Excise kupitia tra.go.tz au mshauri wa forodha kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi (casual worker) analipa PAYE?
answer_sw: Inategemea: kama mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi anafanya kazi kwa zaidi ya siku 30 mfululizo au kuwa na mapato yanayozidi kiwango cha chini cha PAYE (TZS 270,000/mwezi), mwajiri anapaswa kukata PAYE. Thibitisha hali halisi na TRA.
question_en: Do casual workers pay PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: It depends: if a casual worker works for more than 30 consecutive days or has earnings exceeding the minimum PAYE threshold (TZS 270,000/month), the employer must deduct PAYE. Confirm the specific situation with TRA.

question_sw: Mtu anayeuza mkaa msituni — ana haja ya usajili wowote?
answer_sw: Uuzaji wa mkaa (charcoal) unasimamia na sheria ya misitu na sheria ya mazingira Tanzania. Kwa ujumla, unahitaji: kibali cha ukataji miti kutoka TFS (Tanzania Forest Service) au Halmashauri; na labda leseni ya biashara kutoka halmashauri kama unauza kibiashara. TIN inashauriwa kama una biashara ya kawaida. Thibitisha na Halmashauri yako.
question_en: A person selling charcoal from the forest — do they need any registration?
answer_en: Charcoal (mkaa) sales are regulated by Tanzania's forestry and environmental laws. Generally, you need: a timber cutting permit from TFS (Tanzania Forest Service) or the Council; and possibly a business licence from the council if selling commercially. A TIN is advisable if you have a regular business. Verify with your local council.

instruction: SDL inalipwa tarehe ngapi?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Mfano: SDL ya mwezi Januari inalipwa kabla ya tarehe 7 Februari. Kuchelewa kulipa SDL kunasababisha faini na riba ya TRA.

instruction: Biashara yangu ina wafanyakazi 10 — ninaacha mfanyakazi mmoja na sasa ni 9. Je, ninaendelea kulipa SDL mwezi huu?
output: Inategemea LINI ulimuacha mfanyakazi: KAMA aliachwa mwanzo wa mwezi (na mwezi wote umekuwa na wafanyakazi 9): hakuna SDL kwa mwezi huo. KAMA aliachwa katikati ya mwezi: wafanyakazi walipofika 10 siku fulani za mwezi — SDL inaweza bado kutumika kwa siku hizo au mwezi wote (kulingana na tafsiri ya TRA). Kwa ujumla, TRA inazingatia hali ya mwisho wa mwezi au idadi ya wastani. Kwa usalama, toa SDL kwa mwezi wa mwisho wa kuwa na wafanyakazi 10+ na acha mwezi unaofuata ukiwa na 9. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa tafsiri sahihi.

instruction: Bidhaa za kilimo zina VAT ngapi Tanzania — 5%?
output: Tanzania haina VAT ya 5%. Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Bidhaa nyingi za kilimo (mbolea, mbegu, zana za kilimo) zina VAT 0% (zero-rated) au zimesamehewa (exempt) — si 5%. Orodha kamili iko kwenye VAT Act na TRA.

question_sw: Mwalimu wa shule ya msingi ya binafsi (private primary school) — shule inalipa kodi gani?
answer_sw: Shule binafsi za msingi zinaweza kuwa na wajibu wa: (1) PAYE kwa walimu waliohiriwa; (2) NSSF, SDL (kama walimu ≥10), WCF; (3) Usajili wa biashara BRELA na leseni ya elimu kutoka Wizara ya Elimu; (4) VAT kama mauzo ya ada yanafikia kizingiti (ingawa elimu inaweza kuwa na msamaha — thibitisha). TIN ya shule inahitajika.
question_en: A teacher at a private primary school — what taxes does the school pay?
answer_en: Private primary schools may have: (1) PAYE for hired teachers; (2) NSSF, SDL (if ≥10 teachers), WCF; (3) BRELA business registration and education licence from Ministry of Education; (4) VAT if tuition fee revenue reaches the threshold (education may have an exemption — verify). The school's TIN is required.

question_sw: Mgeni alikamatwa kwa ukiukaji wa GN 487A mara ya pili — kuna adhabu maalum ya mara ya pili (recidivism)?
answer_sw: GN 487A kama inavyosomeka haitaji adhabu maalum ya 'mara ya pili' au mfumo wa recidivism. Kila ukiukaji unashughulikiwa kwa kanuni za kawaida za korti za Tanzania ambazo zinazingatia historia ya mshtakiwa wakati wa kutoa hukumu. Korti inaweza kutoa adhabu kubwa zaidi kwa mgeni mwenye historia ya ukiukaji — lakini hii ni uamuzi wa korti, si sharti la kisheria lililowekwa na GN 487A. Kwa ufafanuzi zaidi: wasiliana na mwanasheria wa kisheria cha Tanzania.
question_en: A non-citizen was caught violating GN 487A a second time — is there a special repeat offender (recidivism) penalty?
answer_en: GN 487A as written does not provide for a specific 'second offence' penalty or recidivism system. Each violation is handled under normal Tanzanian court procedures which consider the defendant's history when sentencing. A court may impose a larger penalty for a non-citizen with a violation history — but this is a court decision, not a legal requirement set by GN 487A itself. For more clarification: contact a Tanzanian legal practitioner.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A adding recidivism provisions

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kurekebisha makosa ya PAYE ya miezi iliyopita vipi?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kurekebisha makosa ya PAYE ya miezi iliyopita kwa: (1) kuwasilisha marekebisho ya P10 kwa TRA ikionyesha kiasi sahihi, (2) kulipa tofauti pamoja na adhabu na riba inayohusika, na (3) kurekebisha rekodi za wafanyakazi. Ni bora kuwasiliana na TRA mapema kama marekesiho yanahusisha kiasi kikubwa.
question_en: How can an employer correct past PAYE errors for previous months?
answer_en: An employer can correct past PAYE errors by: (1) submitting an amended P10 to TRA showing the correct amount, (2) paying the difference plus applicable penalties and interest, and (3) correcting employee records. It is advisable to contact TRA early if the correction involves a significant amount.

question_sw: Hati ya mauzo ya ardhi iliyosainiwa kabla ya sheria mpya ya ushuru wa stempu inalipa kiwango cha zamani au kipya?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida, kiwango cha ushuru wa stempu kinachohusika ni kile kilichokuwepo wakati hati ilisainiwa au wakati malipo yanafanywa — kulingana na utaratibu wa Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu. Sheria mpya inaweza kuwa na masharti ya mpito yanayoathiri hati za zamani ambazo bado hazijapigwa stempu. Angalia TRA kwa mwongozo wa hali za mpito za kisheria.
question_en: Does a land sale instrument signed before a new stamp duty law use the old or new rate?
answer_en: Generally, the applicable stamp duty rate is the one in force at the time the instrument was signed or when payment is made — depending on the Stamp Duty Act procedure. New legislation may have transitional provisions affecting old unstamped instruments. Check TRA for guidance on legal transitional situations.

question_sw: Ninafanya biashara ya exempt — 'kwa ujumla' naweza kudai input VAT au si?
answer_sw: Hapana — si 'kwa ujumla' bali KAMWE. Kanuni ya exempt haibadiliki: kama biashara yako ina asili ya exempt, huwezi kudai input VAT inayohusiana na biashara hiyo. Lugha ya hedging kama 'kwa ujumla' au 'inategemea hali' si sahihi kwa kanuni hii — ni kanuni ngumu (hard rule) ya sheria ya VAT Tanzania. Ikiwa una biashara zote mbili (exempt na taxable), unaweza kudai input VAT ya sehemu ya taxable tu — si ya sehemu ya exempt.
question_en: I run an exempt business — 'in general' can I claim input VAT or not?
answer_en: No — not 'in general' but NEVER. The exempt rule does not change: if your business is exempt in nature, you cannot claim input VAT related to that business. Hedging language like 'in general' or 'it depends on the situation' is not accurate for this rule — it is a hard rule in Tanzanian VAT law. If you have both (exempt and taxable) activities, you may claim input VAT for the taxable portion only — not for the exempt portion.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu unaweza kulipwa kwa Mpesa au Tigo Pesa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kwa sasa, malipo ya ushuru wa stempu Tanzania kwa kawaida yanafanywa kupitia mfumo wa TRA (PRN) kupitia benki zilizoidhinishwa au e-payment ya TRA. Malipo ya moja kwa moja kwa pesa ya simu (mobile money) kama M-Pesa kwa ushuru wa stempu yanaweza hayajakubaliwa rasmi kwenye mfumo wa TRA. Angalia TRA moja kwa moja au tovuti yake kwa njia za malipo zilizoidhinishwa za hali ya sasa.
question_en: Can stamp duty be paid via M-Pesa or Tigo Pesa in Tanzania?
answer_en: Currently, stamp duty payments in Tanzania are generally made through the TRA system (PRN) via authorised banks or TRA e-payment. Direct payment via mobile money (M-Pesa) for stamp duty may not yet be formally accepted in the TRA system. Check TRA directly or on its website for currently authorised payment methods.

instruction: Mimi ni Mariamu Juma — ninauza chakula kwa jina 'Mariamu Juma Foods'. Lazima BRELA?
output: Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. 'Mariamu Juma Foods' ni jina la biashara — hata kama linajumuisha jina lako, lazima lisajiliwe kwa BRELA kama biashara ya jina. Faida ya usajili: umiliki wa kisheria wa jina hilo.

question_sw: GN 605A ni nini Tanzania?
answer_sw: GN 605A ni Amri ya Mishahara ya Sekta ya Faragha (Wage Order) iliyotolewa chini ya ELRA. Inaweka kiwango cha chini cha mishahara (minimum wage) kwa sekta 16 na sekta ndogo 46 nchini Tanzania Bara. Ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: What is GN 605A in Tanzania?
answer_en: GN 605A is the Private Sector Wage Order issued under ELRA. It sets the minimum wage for 16 sectors and 46 sub-sectors in Tanzania Mainland. It came into effect on 1 January 2026. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Input VAT inaweza kudaiwa kwa ununuzi wa bidhaa na huduma zote?
answer_sw: Hapana. Si input VAT yote inaweza kudaiwa. Kwa ujumla, input VAT inayodaiwa lazima iwe kwa ununuzi wa biashara tu — si matumizi ya kibinafsi. Ununuzi wa gari la kibinafsi, chakula cha kibinafsi, au matumizi yasiyohusiana na biashara haustahili input VAT credit. TRA inaweza kukataa madai ya input VAT yasiyokuwa ya biashara.
question_en: Can input VAT be claimed on all purchases of goods and services?
answer_en: No. Not all input VAT can be claimed. Generally, claimable input VAT must relate to business purchases only — not personal use. Purchasing a personal car, personal food, or expenses unrelated to business do not qualify for input VAT credit. TRA can reject input VAT claims not related to business.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Rafiki yangu anasema SDL ni asilimia 4. Je, hiyo bado ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana tena. Kiwango cha SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — kilipunguzwa kutoka asilimia 4 hadi asilimia 3.5 na Finance Act 2025, kuanzia tarehe 1 Julai 2025. Ikiwa unatumia kiwango cha asilimia 4 baada ya tarehe hiyo, unalipa zaidi ya inavyotakiwa au hesabu yako ni makosa.
question_en: My friend says SDL is 4%. Is that still correct?
answer_en: Not anymore. The SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — rate was reduced from 4% to 3.5% by the Finance Act 2025, effective 1 July 2025. If you are using 4% after that date, you are overpaying or your calculation is wrong.

question_sw: Msambazaji wa EFD aliyeidhinishwa na TRA ana jukumu gani ikiwa EFD haitafanya kazi vizuri?
answer_sw: Msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa na TRA ana majukumu ya: (1) kutoa EFD iliyoidhinishwa na kusajiliwa vizuri kwenye mfumo wa TRA, (2) kutoa mafunzo ya kuitumia, (3) kutoa huduma ya ukarabati wa haraka pale EFD inapoharibika, (4) kushughulikia matatizo ya muunganisho wa data kwa TRA. Ikiwa msambazaji hakufanya kazi vizuri, biashara inaweza kulalamika kwa TRA. Hata hivyo, mwajiri/biashara bado ana wajibu wa kuhakikisha EFD inafanya kazi.
question_en: What responsibility does a TRA-approved EFD supplier have if the EFD doesn't work properly?
answer_en: A TRA-approved supplier has responsibilities to: (1) supply an EFD properly approved and registered on TRA's system, (2) provide usage training, (3) provide prompt repair service when the EFD breaks down, (4) handle data connectivity issues to TRA. If the supplier fails, the business can complain to TRA. However, the employer/business still has the obligation to ensure the EFD works.

question_sw: NSSF inashughulikia mfanyakazi aliyefukuzwa kazi Tanzania — ana haki ya pensheni yake?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi aliyefukuzwa kazi Tanzania HAPOTEZI michango yake ya NSSF iliyochangiwa. Akaunti yake ya NSSF inabaki na pesa zilizokwisha wasilishwa. Anaweza: (1) kuendelea kuchangia kwa mwajiri mpya ikiwa ataajiriwa tena, (2) kuomba manufaa yanayostahili kulingana na michango aliyochangia ikiwa amefikia masharti. Haki ya NSSF ni tofauti kabisa na haki ya fidia ya kufukuzwa — zote mbili zinaweza kudaiwa.
question_en: NSSF covers a dismissed worker in Tanzania — do they retain their pension rights?
answer_en: A worker dismissed in Tanzania does NOT lose NSSF contributions already paid. Their NSSF account remains with the money already submitted. They can: (1) continue contributing with a new employer if re-employed, (2) apply for eligible benefits based on contributions paid if they meet conditions. NSSF rights are completely separate from dismissal compensation rights — both can be claimed.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

instruction: Biashara yangu imebadilisha EFD (machine mpya) — ninahitaji kusajili upya kwa TRA?
output: Ndiyo — EFD mpya inahitaji kusajiliwa upya kwa TRA kabla ya kutumika kwa madhumuni ya kodi. TRA lazima ijue kwamba EFD ya zamani imebadilishwa na mpya imewekwa — ili rekodi za TIMS zielewe mabadiliko. Hatua za kufuata: (1) Arifu TRA kwamba EFD ya zamani imeachwa; (2) Wasilisha EFD mpya kwa TRA kwa usajili; (3) Pata nambari ya usajili ya EFD mpya kabla ya kutumika; (4) Hifadhi rekodi za EFD ya zamani — TRA inaweza kuzihitaji kwa ukaguzi. Kutumia EFD mpya bila kusajili kwa TRA ni kosa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na muuzaji wa EFD.

instruction: Mfanyakazi wangu anapata TZS 270,000 kwa mwezi — PAYE yake ni ngapi?
output:
Hesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 270,000/mwezi:
Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 = TZS 0
PAYE ya jumla: TZS 0/mwezi
TZS 270,000 ipo ndani ya Bendi 1 (0%) — hakuna PAYE inayodaiwa.

instruction: Mfanyakazi aliyeachishwa kazi ghafla — NSSF pensheni yake inafanywa nini?
output: Mfanyakazi aliyeachishwa kazi HAAPOTEZI michango yake ya NSSF iliyochangiwa. Michango inabaki kwenye akaunti yake ya NSSF hadi atakapokuwa na haki ya kupata: (1) PENSHENI ya uzeeni (baada ya umri wa miaka 60, au 55 kwa wachimbaji/mapema) na angalau miezi 180 ya michango; (2) MAFAO YA MAPEMA kama ni mlemavu wa kudumu; (3) MAFAO YA KIFO kwa familia yake. Hata kama alichangia miaka 5 tu — pesa hizo ziko salama NSSF. Akitaka kujua salio la akaunti yake, anaweza kuwasiliana na NSSF moja kwa moja. Thibitisha na nssf.or.tz.

question_sw: Je, Tanzania ina kodi maalum ya huduma za kidijitali?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Sheria ya Fedha ya 2025 ilianzisha mabadiliko yanayoathiri VAT kwenye miamala ya kielektroniki. Kiwango cha VAT cha 16% kinatumiwa kwa malipo ya B2C (biashara-kwa-wateja) ya kielektroniki kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025. Hii ni tofauti na kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT cha 18% kinachotumika kwa bidhaa na huduma za kawaida.
question_en: Does Tanzania have a special tax on digital services?
answer_en: Yes. The Finance Act 2025 introduced changes affecting VAT on electronic transactions. A 16% VAT rate applies to B2C (business-to-consumer) electronic payments from 1 September 2025. This differs from the standard 18% VAT rate that applies to regular goods and services.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: WCF ni tofauti na bima ya maisha (life insurance) — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, ni tofauti kabisa. WCF inashughulikia majeraha na magonjwa yanayotokana na KAZI — ni bima ya ajali za kazini inayodhibitiwa na serikali. Bima ya maisha ni mkataba wa kibinafsi kati ya mtu na kampuni ya bima unaohusisha kifo kutoka sababu yoyote. Waajiri wanalazimika WCF; bima ya maisha ni ya hiari.
question_en: WCF is different from life insurance — is this true?
answer_en: Yes, they are completely different. WCF covers WORK-RELATED injuries and diseases — it is government-regulated workplace accident insurance. Life insurance is a private contract between an individual and an insurer covering death from any cause. WCF is mandatory for employers; life insurance is voluntary.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kumfukuza mfanyakazi bila kumpa onyo kabla?
answer_sw: Masuala ya kufukuza kazi (dismissal) yanajumuisha Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA) na mchakato maalum — lakini hii ni ushauri wa kina wa kisheria unaohitaji mwanasheria wa kazi. Ninaweza kukuambia kwamba GN 605A inasimamia viwango vya chini vya mshahara, na kwamba NSSF na SDL lazima zisimame vizuri wakati wa kumaliza ajira. Kwa mchakato wa kufukuza, wasiliana na mwanasheria wa kazi au Ofisi ya Kazi.
question_en: Can I dismiss an employee without giving them a warning first?
answer_en: Dismissal matters involve the Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA) and a specific process — but this is detailed legal advice that requires a labour lawyer. I can tell you that GN 605A governs minimum wages, and that NSSF and SDL obligations must be properly settled at termination. For the dismissal process itself, contact a labour lawyer or the Labour Office.

question_sw: Mstahimilivu wa kodi ya PAYE (PAYE threshold) kwa mwaka mzima ni TZS ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha mwaka ambacho mfanyakazi anaanza kulipa PAYE halisi (baada ya punguzo la kibinafsi) ni kama ifuatavyo: Kwa mwaka wote, punguzo la kibinafsi la TZS 312,000 (yaani TZS 26,000 × 12) linakatwa kutoka kodi iliyohesabiwa. Mfanyakazi anayepata chini ya karibu TZS 7,140,000 kwa mwaka (≈ TZS 595,000 kwa mwezi × 12) mara nyingi halazimiki kulipa PAYE yoyote baada ya punguzo la kibinafsi. Kwa mapato zaidi ya hayo, PAYE itaanza kulipwa. Thibitisha kwa hesabu kamili kwa mwaka wako maalum.
answer_en: The annual income level at which an employee starts paying actual PAYE (after personal relief) is approximately as follows: For the full year, personal relief of TZS 312,000 (i.e. TZS 26,000 × 12) is deducted from calculated tax. An employee earning below approximately TZS 7,140,000 per year (≈ TZS 595,000 per month × 12) generally owes no PAYE after personal relief. For income above that level, PAYE starts to become payable. Confirm with a full calculation for your specific year.
question_en: What is the annual PAYE threshold in Tanzania — the salary level above which an employee starts paying PAYE?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — annual threshold ITA Cap.332 Finance Act 2025

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu wa hati ya uhamishaji wa hisa katika sekta ya madini Tanzania ni sawa na hati ya ardhi ya kawaida?
answer_sw: Uhamishaji wa hisa katika sekta ya madini Tanzania unaweza kuwa na masharti maalum ya ushuru chini ya Sheria ya Madini na mfumo wake wa ushuru. Viwango au exemptions zinaweza kutofautiana na uhamishaji wa ardhi wa kawaida. Ni muhimu kupata ushauri maalum wa mwanasheria wa madini na kodi kwa aina hii ya muamala.
question_en: Is stamp duty on a mining sector share transfer the same as a regular land transfer in Tanzania?
answer_en: Mining sector share transfers in Tanzania may have special tax provisions under the Mining Act and its fiscal regime. Rates or exemptions may differ from regular land transfers. It is important to obtain specialist advice from a mining and tax lawyer for this type of transaction.
next_review_trigger: Mining Act or Stamp Duty Act amendment

instruction: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni mwenye Class B permit anaweza kufanya kazi katika biashara ya rejareja inayomilikiwa na Mtanzania?
output: GN 487A inalenga WAMILIKI na WADHIBITI wa biashara — si wafanyakazi wa kawaida. Mgeni mwenye Class B Residence Permit (kwa ajira) anayefanya kazi kama mwajiriwa wa kawaida (si mmiliki) katika biashara inayomilikiwa na Mtanzania — GN 487A haihusiki moja kwa moja na hali yake kama mwajiriwa. Hata hivyo, Class B permit lazima iwe halisi na iidhinishe kazi katika sekta husika, na mwajiri Mtanzania lazima apate idhini ya kuajiri mgeni (immigration quota). Kama hana Class B permit halisi — ni ukiukwaji wa sheria nyingine ya uhamiaji (si GN 487A). Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na Wizara ya Kazi.

question_sw: Raia wa kigeni anaweza kufungua bureau de change Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ubadilishaji wa fedha za kigeni (forex bureau / bureau de change) ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania chini ya GN 487A (2025). Hata kama mtu wa nje ana leseni ya BoT (Benki Kuu ya Tanzania) ya ubadilishaji wa fedha, hawezi kuwa mmiliki au meneja wa bureau de change kama biashara yake binafsi chini ya GN 487A. Adhabu ni faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza.
question_en: Can a foreign national open a bureau de change in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Forex bureau (bureau de change) operations are one of the 15 business activities prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens under GN 487A (2025). Even if a foreigner has a BoT (Bank of Tanzania) licence for currency exchange, they cannot be the owner or operator of a bureau de change as their own business under GN 487A. Penalties are a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Daktari binafsi aliyefungua kliniki ndogo — anahitaji kusajili VAT kuanzia siku ya kwanza?
answer_sw: NDIYO — daktari aliyesajiliwa (registered medical practitioner) anahitaji kusajili VAT kama sehemu ya mahitaji ya kufanya mazoezi ya dawa Tanzania, bila kujali ukubwa wa kliniki au idadi ya wagonjwa. Hata kama kliniki ni ndogo na ana wagonjwa wachache — usajili wa VAT ni lazima. Fani za afya zinaonekana kama fani zilizoidhinishwa zinazohitaji usajili wa VAT mara moja.
question_en: A private doctor who has opened a small clinic — do they need to register for VAT from day one?
answer_en: YES — a registered medical practitioner needs to register for VAT as part of the requirements to practise medicine in Tanzania, regardless of the clinic size or number of patients. Even if the clinic is small and has few patients — VAT registration is mandatory. Medical professions are treated as regulated professions requiring immediate VAT registration.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni aliyesha-resign — mwajiri anahitaji kulipa PAYE ya mwisho lini?
answer_sw: PAYE ya mshahara wa mwisho (terminal benefits — mshahara wa mwisho, posho ya kuachana, likizo iliyobaki inayolipwa) inapaswa kukokotolewa, kukatwa, na kuwasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata baada ya malipo ya mwisho. Toa P9 kwa mfanyakazi baada ya malipo ya mwisho.
question_en: A foreign employee has resigned — when must the employer pay the final PAYE?
answer_en: PAYE on the final salary (terminal benefits — last salary, severance, unused leave paid out) must be calculated, deducted, and remitted to TRA by the 7th of the month following the final payment. Issue a P9 to the employee after the final payment.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Mauzo yangu bado hayajafika TZS 200 milioni kwa mwaka. Ninaweza kusajili VAT kwa hiari (voluntary VAT registration)?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — unaweza kusajili VAT kwa hiari hata kama mauzo yako hayajafika kizingiti cha lazima cha TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12 (au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6). Faida ya usajili wa hiari: unaweza kudai mkopo wa VAT (input VAT) kwa manunuzi ya biashara yako na hivyo kupunguza gharama. Hasara: utahitajika kuwasilisha return ya kila mwezi, kutoa risiti za EFD, na kulipa VAT kwa wakati. Fikiria kama faida ya mkopo wa VAT inazidi gharama ya utiifu (compliance).
question_en: My annual sales have not yet reached TZS 200 million. Can I register for VAT voluntarily?
answer_en: Yes — you can register for VAT voluntarily even if your turnover has not reached the mandatory threshold of TZS 200,000,000 per 12 months (or TZS 100,000,000 per 6 months). Benefit: you can claim input VAT credits on business purchases, reducing costs. Drawback: you must submit a monthly VAT return, issue EFD receipts, and pay VAT on time. Weigh whether the input VAT benefit outweighs the compliance burden.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing voluntary VAT registration rules

instruction: WCF inafunika magonjwa ya kazini — mfanyakazi anayepata ugonjwa kutokana na kazi anafanyaje?
output: Mfanyakazi aliyepata ugonjwa wa kazini (occupational disease) anachukua hatua hizi: (1) Pata utambuzi wa daktari unaothibitisha ugonjwa unatokana na kazi; (2) Mwajiri alazimike kutoa taarifa WCF ndani ya siku 7 za kazi baada ya utambuzi; (3) Daktari wa WCF anakagua na kuthibitisha kama ugonjwa unatokana na hali ya kazi; (4) Kama unathibitishwa — WCF inalipa fidia ya matibabu na/au fidia ya kipato ikiwa mfanyakazi hawezi kufanya kazi. Magonjwa yanayofunikwa ni pamoja na: ugonjwa wa mapafu kutokana na vumbi, poisoning ya kemikali, na magonjwa mengine yanayotambulika ya kazini. Thibitisha na wcf.go.tz.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kupunguza au kuzuia fidia ya WCF ikiwa mfanyakazi mwenyewe alisababisha ajali — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Inategemea hali. WCF Tanzania kwa kawaida inalipa fidia hata kama mfanyakazi alichangia katika ajali — isipokuwa ikiwa ajali ilitokana na tabia ya makusudi ya mfanyakazi au ukiukwaji mkubwa wa maagizo ya usalama. Hata hivyo, uzembe mdogo wa mfanyakazi kwa kawaida HAUKATII haki ya fidia. Sheria ya WCF inasema mfanyakazi analindwa hata kama ana makosa madogo.
question_en: Can an employer reduce or block WCF compensation if the worker themselves caused the accident — is this true?
answer_en: It depends on the situation. Tanzania's WCF generally pays compensation even if the worker contributed to the accident — except if the accident resulted from the worker's intentional conduct or serious violation of safety instructions. However, minor worker negligence generally does NOT disqualify a compensation claim. WCF law protects the worker even if they have minor fault.

question_sw: Mshahara wa chini unahusu tu wafanyakazi wa kudumu — wafanyakazi wa muda mfupi hawafunikwi?
answer_sw: Hapana, hii si kweli. GN 605A inafunika wafanyakazi wote — wa kudumu, wa muda mfupi, wa muda, na wa msimu. Kwa wafanyakazi wasio wa kudumu, kiwango kinahesabiwa kwa uwiano. Hakuna msamaha kwa aina yoyote ya mkataba wa ajira.
question_en: The minimum wage only covers permanent employees — temporary workers are not covered?
answer_en: No, this is false. GN 605A covers all workers — permanent, short-term, fixed-term, and seasonal. For non-permanent workers the rate is calculated proportionally. There is no exemption for any type of employment contract.

question_sw: Gawio linalolipwa kwa mwanahisa asiye mkazi (non-resident) lina kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 10 — sawa na mkazi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kodi ya zuio kwenye gawio kwa mwanahisa asiye mkazi (non-resident) ni asilimia 10 pia, lakini angalia mikataba ya DTA. Tanzania ina mikataba ya kuepuka kodi mara mbili na nchi kadhaa (kama Uswizi, Uingereza, India) ambayo inaweza kupunguza kiwango hadi asilimia 5 au zaidi. Kagua DTA inayohusika kwa kiwango halisi kinachotumika.
question_en: Dividends paid to a non-resident shareholder carry a 10% withholding tax — same as for a resident — is this correct?
answer_en: The base rate for withholding tax on dividends to a non-resident is also 10%, but check applicable DTA agreements. Tanzania has double tax treaties with several countries (such as Switzerland, UK, India) which may reduce the rate to 5% or more. Check the applicable DTA for the actual rate that applies.
next_review_trigger: DTA network change or Finance Act

question_sw: Cheti cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kinatoka lini?
answer_sw: Cheti cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kinatoka siku VAT inapokuwa stahili kulipwa (the day VAT becomes payable) — si tarehe 20 ya mwezi. Tarehe 20 ni ya kufungua return ya VAT, ambayo ni wajibu tofauti. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: When must a VAT withholding certificate be issued?
answer_en: A VAT withholding certificate must be issued on the day VAT becomes payable — not on the 20th of the month. The 20th is the VAT return filing deadline, which is a separate obligation. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Nilikuwa na mauzo ya TZS 90M kwa miezi 6 na TZS 185M kwa miezi 12. Je, ninahitaji kusajili VAT?
answer_sw: Hapana — bado haujafika kizingiti. Mauzo ya TZS 90M kwa miezi 6 ni chini ya kizingiti cha TZS 100M cha miezi 6. Mauzo ya TZS 185M kwa miezi 12 ni chini ya kizingiti cha TZS 200M cha miezi 12. Viwango vyote viwili havijazidiwa — kwa hivyo usajili wa VAT wa lazima haujafika. Hata hivyo, angalia kipindi kinachofuata — ukiwa karibu na viwango, zingatia usajili wa hiari au panga vizuri.
question_en: I had sales of TZS 90M over 6 months and TZS 185M over 12 months. Do I need to register for VAT?
answer_en: No — you have not yet reached either threshold. Sales of TZS 90M over 6 months are below the TZS 100M 6-month threshold. Sales of TZS 185M over 12 months are below the TZS 200M 12-month threshold. Neither threshold has been exceeded — so mandatory VAT registration has not been triggered. However, watch the next period — if you are close, consider voluntary registration or careful planning.

question_sw: WHT inalipwa TRA tarehe ngapi baada ya kukata?
answer_sw: WHT inalipwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata baada ya kukata. Kwa mfano, WHT iliyokatwa Januari inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 Februari. Cheti cha WHT (withholding tax certificate) hutolewa kwa mlipwaji ndani ya siku 30 za kukata.
question_en: By what date is WHT remitted to TRA after deduction?
answer_en: WHT is remitted to TRA by the 7th of the following month after deduction. For example, WHT deducted in January is paid by 7 February. A WHT certificate is issued to the payee within 30 days of deduction.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya kampuni ya binafsi (private limited) na kampuni ya umma (public limited) Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Kampuni ya BINAFSI: idadi ya wanahisa imepunguzwa (kawaida hadi 50), hisa haziwezi kuuzwa hadharani, na AGM inaweza kuwa rahisi zaidi. Kampuni ya UMMA: hisa zinaweza kuuzwa hadharani (ikiwa ni pamoja na kwenye DSE), idadi ya wanahisa isio na kikomo, na mahitaji ya uwazi na utawala wa shirika ni magumu zaidi.
question_en: What is the difference between a private limited company and a public limited company in Tanzania?
answer_en: PRIVATE company: restricted number of shareholders (usually up to 50), shares cannot be offered to the public, AGM can be less formal. PUBLIC company: shares can be offered to the public (including on DSE), unlimited shareholder numbers, and corporate governance and transparency requirements are stricter.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Ninaajiri intern (mwanafunzi wa mafunzo) bila mshahara — je, SDL inaathirika?
output: Intern asiyepewa mshahara (bila malipo ya fedha) HAINGII SDL base kwa sababu mbili: (1) SDL inakokotolewa kwa MALIPO YA FEDHA — intern bila mshahara hana malipo; (2) Hali ya intern inaweza pia kumaanisha si mwajiriwa wa kisheria bali mwanafunzi. Hata hivyo, intern mwenye mshahara hata mdogo (posho ya usafiri ya fedha, au malipo yoyote ya pesa) anaingia SDL base na kuhesabiwa katika idadi ya wafanyakazi kwa kizingiti cha 10. Kama intern hana malipo yoyote ya fedha — haathiri SDL wala PAYE. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na Wizara ya Kazi kwa hali ya kisheria ya intern.

question_sw: Je, kuna adhabu kali zaidi kwa mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A mara ya pili?
answer_sw: Sina uhakika wa masharti maalum ya marudio ya makosa (recidivism) ndani ya GN 487A. Amri inaeleza adhabu za msingi: TZS 10M na hadi miezi 6 gerezani. Kwa hali ya ukiukaji wa mara ya pili, thibitisha na mwanasheria au Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Are there enhanced penalties for a non-citizen violating GN 487A a second time?
answer_en: I am not certain of specific recidivism provisions within GN 487A. The order specifies basic penalties: TZS 10M and up to 6 months imprisonment. For the specific situation of a second violation, verify with a lawyer or the Immigration Services Department.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: Ningependa kuhama biashara yangu kutoka sole trader hadi kampuni limited. Nifanye nini?
output: Huwezi tu 'kubadilisha' sole trader hadi kampuni — lazima usajili kampuni mpya kwa BRELA na kisha uhamishe shughuli za biashara kwenda kampuni. Hatua: (1) sajili kampuni mpya kupitia ORS (ors.brela.go.tz); (2) fungua akaunti ya benki ya kampuni; (3) hamisha mikataba na wateja wa biashara; (4) update usajilishaji wa TRA na kodi; (5) sole trader ya zamani inaweza kubaki au kufungwa. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi na mwanasheria kwa uhamisho salama.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Kodi ya mapato ya kampuni inalipwa mwishoni mwa mwaka wa fedha tu — hakuna malipo ya kati ya mwaka — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kampuni za Tanzania zinalazimika kulipa kodi ya awali (provisional tax) kwa awamu NNE sawa katika mwaka wa fedha — mwishoni mwa miezi ya 3, 6, 9, na 12 kutoka mwanzo wa mwaka wa fedha. Malipo ya awali yanakokotolewa kwa asilimia 100 ya kodi ya mwaka uliopita au makadirio ya mwaka wa sasa.
question_en: Corporate income tax is only paid at the end of the financial year — no mid-year payments — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Tanzania companies are required to pay provisional tax in FOUR equal instalments during the financial year — at the end of months 3, 6, 9, and 12 from the start of the financial year. Provisional instalments are calculated at 100% of the previous year's tax or an estimate of the current year.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kulipa PAYE mara moja mwaka (lump sum) badala ya kila mwezi — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. PAYE lazima ilipwe kila mwezi ifikapo tarehe 7 — hakuna ruhusa ya kulipa mara moja kwa mwaka kama mwajiri. Mfumo wa PAYE umeundwa kulipa mwezi kwa mwezi. Kulimbikiza na kulipa mwaka mzima kwa mkupuo kunasababisha adhabu za ucheleweshaji wa kila mwezi ambao ulishindwa kulipa kwa wakati.
question_en: An employer can pay PAYE as an annual lump sum instead of monthly — is this true?
answer_en: No. PAYE must be paid monthly by the 7th — there is no employer permission to pay annually in a lump sum. The PAYE system is designed for monthly remittance. Accumulating and paying for the whole year in one go generates monthly late-payment penalties for every month that was not paid on time.

instruction: Certificate of Incorporation ni nini na inathibitisha nini?
output: Certificate of Incorporation ni hati rasmi inayotolewa na BRELA inayothibitisha kwamba kampuni imesajiliwa kisheria na kuanza kuwa chombo huru cha kisheria (legal entity). Hati hii ina: nambari ya usajilishaji wa kampuni, jina rasmi la kampuni, aina ya kampuni, na tarehe ya usajilishaji. Inahitajika kufungua akaunti ya benki, kuingia mikataba, na kwa matumizi mengi ya kisheria. Hifadhi salama.

question_sw: Je, hata daktari au mwanasheria analazimika kutumia EFD?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — mtaalamu yeyote aliyesajiliwa kwa VAT (daktari, mwanasheria, mhasibu, mbunifu) analazimika kutumia EFD au VFD. Sheria ya EFD haitekelezi tofauti kati ya biashara ya bidhaa na biashara ya huduma za kitaalamu. Ikiwa mauzo ya mtaalamu yanazidi kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6) na amejisajili kwa VAT, lazima atumie EFD/VFD.
question_en: Are even doctors or lawyers required to use EFD?
answer_en: Yes — any professional registered for VAT (doctor, lawyer, accountant, architect) must use EFD or VFD. EFD law does not make a distinction between goods businesses and professional service businesses. If a professional's sales exceed the VAT threshold (TZS 200M/year or TZS 100M/6 months) and they are registered for VAT, they must use EFD/VFD.

instruction: EFD yangu imeharibika usiku — ninaweza kuendelea na biashara bila EFD hadi asubuhi?
output: Kuharibu kwa EFD ni tatizo linalohitaji hatua haraka: (1) Wasiliana na TRA AU muuzaji wa EFD wako HARAKA IWEZEKANAVYO — TRA inasaidia kushughulikia EFD zilizovunjika; (2) Wakati EFD iko nje ya huduma, andika rekodi za mikono za muamala wote kwa makini — orodha ya kila mauzo; (3) Unapoweza, ingiza rekodi hizo kwenye EFD mpya au iliyotengenezwa; (4) Usiendelee na biashara bila rekodi yoyote — hii itaonekana kama ukwepaji wa kodi. TRA inatoa mwongozo maalum wa jinsi ya kushughulikia EFD zilizovunjika — wasiliana nao. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Tanzania ina VAT ya kawaida na VAT ndogo (reduced rate) kama nchi nyingine?
output: Hapana — Tanzania haina 'reduced rate' ya VAT. Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Tofauti na nchi kama Kenya (0%, 8%, 16%) au Uingereza (0%, 5%, 20%), Tanzania ina 18% (standard), 16% (B2C digital tu, Sep 2025), na 0% (zero-rated — mauzo ya nje/exports; exempt ni hali tofauti: haziruhusu kudai input VAT). Hakuna reduced rate ya kati (kama 5% au 8%).

instruction: Ninaingia mkataba wa ubia (partnership agreement) na mtu mwingine — stamp duty inatumika kwenye mkataba huu?
output: Mikataba ya ushirika (partnership agreements) inaweza kuwa na wajibu wa stamp duty chini ya Stamp Duty Act Tanzania kulingana na maudhui ya mkataba. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa kiwango halisi, jinsi ya kusajili hati, na utaratibu wa kulipa TRA. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: EFD yangu imetoa risiti nyingi za mazoezi (practice receipts) bila mauzo halisi — hii ni tatizo?
output: Ndiyo — risiti za mazoezi (test receipts) ambazo hazijaambatana na mauzo halisi zinaweza kuonekana kama rekodi zisizolingana na mauzo halisi. TRA inaweza kukagua orodha ya risiti zote na kuzilinganisha na malipo halisi yaliyopokelewa. Unashauriwa: (1) Epuka kutoa risiti za mazoezi baada ya EFD imesajiliwa rasmi; (2) Kama ulitoa risiti za mazoezi wakati wa kuanzisha, rekodi hizo na ueleze ipasavyo; (3) Wasiliana na TRA au muuzaji wa EFD kwa mwongozo wa jinsi ya kurejesha hali baada ya mazoezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Je, PAYE inaweza kuomba kurudishwa (refund)?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kama PAYE iliyokatwa ni zaidi ya kodi halisi, mfanyakazi anaweza kuomba kurudishwa kupitia TRA. Ombi hufanywa kupitia mfumo wa IDRAS baada ya kujaza taarifa ya mwaka (individual tax return) ikiwa ni lazima. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Can PAYE be refunded if overpaid?
answer_en: Yes. If PAYE deducted exceeds the actual tax liability, the employee can apply for a refund through TRA. The application is made via the IDRAS system after filing the annual return where required. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Tofauti kati ya VAT withholding na output VAT ya kawaida ni nini?
output: VAT ya kawaida (output VAT) unalipa mwenyewe TRA baada ya kukusanya kutoka kwa wateja wako. VAT withholding ni ambapo mnunuzi anayehitimu (kama serikali) anakata VAT moja kwa moja kutoka malipo yako kabla ya kukupa pesa na anapeleka TRA kwa niaba yako. Tofauti kuu: withholding inapunguza kiasi unachopokea, lakini certificate inakupa haki ya kudai pembejeo ya VAT hiyo.
