answer_sw: Hospitality sector (hoteli, mikahawa) inaweza kuhitaji aina maalum ya EFD inayoweza kushughulikia bidhaa nyingi (menu items), meza tofauti, na tipping. Hata hivyo, msingi wa kisheria ni sawa — EFD iliyoidhinishwa na TRA, iliyosajiliwa kwa TIN ya biashara, inayotoa risiti za EFD. TRA inatoa mwongozo mahususi kwa hospitality sector. Angalia msambazaji wako wa EFD kwa suluhisho la hospitality.
question_en: Does a hotel or restaurant in Tanzania need a special EFD different from retail shops?
answer_en: The hospitality sector (hotels, restaurants) may need a specialised EFD that can handle multiple products (menu items), different tables, and tipping. However, the legal basis is the same — a TRA-approved EFD, registered to the business TIN, issuing EFD receipts. TRA provides specific guidance for the hospitality sector. Check your EFD supplier for hospitality solutions.

question_sw: Simplified Customs Document (SCD) ni rahisi kiasi gani?
answer_sw: SCD ni fomu rahisi ya forodha iliyoundwa maalum kwa wafanyabiashara wadogo wa STR. Ina sehemu chache zaidi na lugha rahisi zaidi kuliko fomu ya kawaida ya forodha. Lengo lake ni kupunguza ugumu wa karatasi kwa wafanyabiashara wadogo ambao wengi hawana elimu ya juu ya biashara.
question_en: How simplified is the Simplified Customs Document (SCD)?
answer_en: The SCD is a simplified customs form designed specifically for small STR traders. It has fewer sections and simpler language than the standard customs form. Its purpose is to reduce paperwork complexity for small traders, many of whom may not have advanced business education.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: GN 487A inawahusu Watanzania pia au wageni tu?
answer_sw: GN 487A inawahusu WAGENI (raia wa kigeni) TU — Watanzania hawakabiwi vikwazo vya GN 487A kwa biashara. Raia wa Tanzania wana uhuru wa kufanya biashara yoyote inayoruhusiwa kisheria nchini Tanzania bila kizuizi cha GN 487A. Adhabu ya GN 487A (faini ya TZS 10M+, kifungo, visa kufutwa) inatumika kwa wageni wanaovunja sheria hii — si kwa Watanzania.
question_en: Does GN 487A apply to Tanzanians too or only to non-citizens?
answer_en: GN 487A applies to NON-CITIZENS (foreign nationals) ONLY — Tanzanians are not subject to GN 487A business prohibitions. Tanzanian citizens are free to conduct any legally permitted business in Tanzania without GN 487A restrictions. GN 487A penalties (TZS 10M+ fine, imprisonment, visa revocation) apply to non-citizens who violate the law — not to Tanzanians.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Je, biashara yangu inaendesha mabadiliko mawili ya wafanyakazi — Z-report moja au mbili?
output: Z-report lazima ipigwe MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Z-report MOJA kwa siku — hata kama una mabadiliko mawili ya wafanyakazi. X-report unaweza kupiga kati ya mabadiliko ili kupata muhtasari wa kila mabadiliko, lakini Z-report inafunga siku yote mwishoni mwa biashara.

question_sw: Ninasikia certificate ya VAT withholding inatakiwa ifikishwe siku ya 20 — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana — hii si kweli. Siku ya 20 ni deadline ya kuwasilisha VAT return, si deadline ya certificate ya VAT withholding. Certificate ya VAT withholding inatakiwa itolewe siku ile VAT inapostahili kulipwa, si tarehe nyingine. Ni muhimu kujua tofauti hii: return ya VAT → siku ya 20 ya mwezi unaofuata; certificate ya withholding → siku VAT inapostahili. Thibitisha ratiba hii na TRA.
question_en: I hear the VAT withholding certificate must be delivered by the 20th — is that correct?
answer_en: No — that is not correct. The 20th is the VAT return filing deadline, not the withholding certificate deadline. The VAT withholding certificate must be issued on the day VAT becomes payable, not on a later date. The distinction matters: VAT return → 20th of the following month; withholding certificate → the day VAT falls due. Confirm this timeline with TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kuweka rekodi gani za PAYE?
answer_sw: Mwajiri lazima aweke: orodha ya wafanyakazi na TIN zao, hesabu za mishahara, hesabu za PAYE kwa kila mfanyakazi, stakabadhi za malipo ya TRA, na fomu za PAYE P9. Rekodi hizi zinahifadhiwa kwa miaka 5. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What PAYE records must an employer maintain?
answer_en: An employer must keep: employee list with their TINs, payroll calculations, PAYE calculations per employee, TRA payment receipts, and PAYE P9 forms. Records must be kept for 5 years. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kuacha kulipa NSSF kwa sababu biashara inazorota?
answer_sw: Hapana. NSSF ni mchango wa lazima chini ya sheria — mwajiri hawezi kuacha kulipa hata kama biashara inazorota au inakabili matatizo ya fedha. Kushindwa kulipa kunasababisha faini ya asilimia 5 kwa mwezi na madai ya kisheria. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: Can an employer stop paying NSSF because the business is struggling financially?
answer_en: No. NSSF is a mandatory statutory contribution — an employer cannot stop paying even if the business is struggling financially. Failure to pay attracts a 5% monthly penalty and legal claims. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Je, ushuru wa stempu unatumika kwenye mikataba ya ujenzi (construction contracts)?
answer_sw: Mikataba ya ujenzi kwa kawaida haiko kwenye orodha kuu ya nyaraka zinazohitaji ushuru wa stempu Tanzania. Ushuru wa stempu unajumuisha zaidi hati za kisheria zinazohusiana na uhamishaji wa mali au dhamana za mkopo. Hata hivyo, ikiwa mkataba wa ujenzi una vipengele vya uhamishaji wa ardhi au dhamana, sehemu hizo zinaweza kuathiriwa. Angalia Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu na ushauri wa kisheria.
question_en: Does stamp duty apply to construction contracts?
answer_en: Construction contracts are generally not in the main schedule of instruments requiring Tanzania stamp duty. Stamp duty primarily covers legal instruments relating to property transfer or loan security. However, if a construction contract includes property transfer or security elements, those parts may be affected. Check the Stamp Duty Act and seek legal advice.

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi Tanzania kinadumu kwa muda gani?
answer_sw: Kibali cha makazi daraja C kawaida kinatolewa kwa kipindi cha hadi miaka 2, kinachoweza kuhuishwa. Kibali cha daraja A (mwekezaji — self-employed) kinaweza kutolewa kwa hadi miaka 5. Thibitisha muda halisi wa aina yako ya kibali na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: How long is a work permit valid in Tanzania?
answer_en: A Class C residence permit is typically issued for up to 2 years, renewable. A Class A (investor — self-employed) permit may be issued for up to 5 years. Confirm the exact duration for your permit type with the Immigration Department.

instruction: Kizingiti cha VAT ni TZS 200M kwa mwaka au kwa mwezi?
output: Kizingiti cha kawaida ni TZS 200M kwa MIEZI 12 (mwaka) — si kwa mwezi mmoja. Pia kuna kizingiti cha muda mfupi: TZS 100M kwa MIEZI 6 (miezi 6 ya mfululizo). Ukipita TZS 100M katika miezi 6 yoyote, lazima usajili VAT hata kama haujafika TZS 200M kwa mwaka.

question_sw: Je, ruzuku ya matibabu (medical allowance) inastahili PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ruzuku ya matibabu inayolipwa moja kwa moja kwa mfanyakazi (cash allowance) inastahili PAYE. Malipo ya matibabu yanayolipwa moja kwa moja kwa hospitali au insurer kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi yanaweza kuwa na nafuu — thibitisha kiasi na TRA.
question_en: Is a medical allowance subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: A medical allowance paid directly to the employee as cash is subject to PAYE. Payments made directly to a hospital or insurer on behalf of the employee may receive a tax relief — confirm the threshold and arrangement with TRA.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana mapato mawili — mshahara wa kampuni ya A na kazi ya sehemu kwa kampuni ya B. Je, kila mwajiri anakata PAYE kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kila mwajiri anakata PAYE kwenye mshahara wake peke yake kwa kutumia jedwali la kawaida. Tatizo ni kwamba mfanyakazi anapata msamaha wa TZS 270,000/mwezi mara mbili — moja kwa kila mwajiri — wakati anapaswa kupata mara moja tu. Mwishoni mwa mwaka, mfanyakazi anaweza kulazimika kulipa PAYE ya ziada ikiwa jumla ya mapato kutoka pande zote mbili inasababisha kodi ya juu zaidi. Mfanyakazi anapaswa kuripoti hali hii kwa TRA kupitia kujaza return ya mtu binafsi.
answer_en: Each employer withholds PAYE on their own salary payment using the normal tax bands. The problem is that the employee receives the TZS 270,000/month personal relief twice — once from each employer — when they are entitled to it only once. At year end, the employee may owe additional PAYE if combined income from both sources falls into a higher tax band. The employee should report this situation to TRA by filing an individual income tax return.
question_en: An employee has two incomes — a salary from Company A and part-time work at Company B. How much PAYE does each employer deduct?

instruction: Wastani wa mshahara wa chini wa sekta binafsi Tanzania BAADA ya GN 605A ni TZS ngapi?
output: Wastani wa mshahara wa chini wa sekta binafsi baada ya GN 605A ni TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi. Hii ni WASTANI kwa sekta zote 16 — si kiwango cha juu kabisa. Kiwango cha juu kabisa (maximum) chini ya GN 605A ni karibu TZS 765,900 kwa mwezi, kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati. Kiwango cha chini kabisa ni karibu TZS 175,000. Thibitisha kiwango halisi cha sekta yako na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

instruction: P9 form ni nini na inawasilishwa lini?
output: P9 ni fomu ya TRA inayoonyesha muhtasari wa mapato na PAYE ya mfanyakazi kwa mwaka mzima. Hutolewa na mwajiri kwa kila mfanyakazi mwishoni mwa mwaka wa kodi. Tarehe ya kuwasilisha P9 kwa TRA: tarehe 31 Machi ya mwaka unaofuata. Mfano: P9 za mwaka 2025 (Januari–Desemba 2025) → wasilisha TRA kabla ya 31 Machi 2026. P9 pia hutolewa kwa mfanyakazi anapoacha kazi (Leaving Certificate).

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi (work permit) kinamzuia mgeni kufanya biashara iliyozuiliwa?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kibali cha kazi kinaruhusu mgeni kufanya kazi kama mfanyakazi wa kampuni au taasisi — si kumiliki au kuendesha biashara yake binafsi. GN 487A na sheria ya vibali vya kazi ni tofauti kabisa: kibali cha kazi kinahusu uhusiano wa ajira, GN 487A inahusu umiliki wa biashara katika makundi 15. Mgeni mwenye kibali cha kazi anaweza bado kukiuka GN 487A kama anafanya biashara iliyozuiliwa kando ya kazi yake ya kawaida. Ni muhimu kutofautisha kati ya 'mfanyakazi' na 'mwenye biashara'.
question_en: Does a work permit prevent a non-citizen from operating a prohibited business?
answer_en: No. A work permit allows a non-citizen to work as an employee of a company or institution — not to own or operate their own business. GN 487A and work permit law are completely different: work permits concern employment relationships, GN 487A concerns business ownership in 15 categories. A non-citizen with a work permit can still violate GN 487A by running a prohibited business alongside their regular employment. It is important to distinguish between being an 'employee' and a 'business owner'.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Kampuni inayofanya kazi kwenye jengo la kukodi inahitaji kupata idhini ya OSHA kwa jengo hilo Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, mwajiri aliyekodi jengo ana wajibu wa kuhakikisha mazingira ya kazi yanafuata viwango vya OSHA — hata kama hajamiliki jengo. Ikiwa jengo lina hatari za kimuundo (kama umeme mbaya, paa yenye hatari, njia za dharura zilizofungwa), mwajiri anaweza kuzungumza na mmiliki wa jengo LAKINI bado ana wajibu wa kisheria wa kulinda wafanyakazi wake. OSHA inaweza kukagua mahali pa kazi bila kujali nani anamiliki jengo.
question_en: Does a company working in a rented building need to get OSHA approval for that building in Tanzania?
answer_en: Generally, an employer who rents a building has an obligation to ensure the work environment meets OSHA standards — even if they don't own the building. If the building has structural hazards (such as faulty electrics, dangerous roof, blocked emergency exits), the employer can speak to the building owner BUT still has a legal duty to protect their workers. OSHA can inspect a workplace regardless of who owns the building.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Kampuni ya uajiri (recruitment/employment agency) inaweza kumilikiwa na raia wa kigeni?
answer_sw: Hapana. Huduma za uajiri na wakala wa ajira (employment bureau / recruitment agency) ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania chini ya GN 487A (2025). Raia wa kigeni hawezi kumiliki au kuendesha kampuni ya uajiri kama biashara yake binafsi nchini Tanzania. Akijaribu kufanya hivyo, anakabiliwa na faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza. Sekta hii ni nyeti kwa sababu inahusiana na masoko ya ajira kwa Watanzania.
question_en: Can a foreign national own an employment/recruitment agency in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Employment bureau and recruitment agency services are one of the 15 business activities prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens under GN 487A (2025). A foreign national cannot own or operate a recruitment agency as their own business in Tanzania. Attempting to do so risks a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. This sector is particularly sensitive as it relates to the labour market for Tanzanian citizens.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Ununuzi wa hisa za kampuni ya Tanzania iliyoorodheshwa DSE — kuna kodi?
answer_sw: Miamala ya hisa kwenye Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange (DSE) inaweza kuwa na kodi ya mauzo ya hisa (capital gains tax) au msamaha maalum. Mfumo wa kodi wa soko la hisa Tanzania una kanuni maalum. Sina uhakika wa mwelekeo wa sasa. Thibitisha na DSE, TRA, au mshauri wa fedha.
question_en: Buying shares in a DSE-listed Tanzanian company — is there a tax?
answer_en: Share transactions on the Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange (DSE) may be subject to capital gains tax or special exemptions. The tax framework for Tanzania's stock market has specific rules. I am not certain of the current position. Verify with DSE, TRA, or a financial advisor.

question_sw: Kampuni ya media (radio, televisheni, au gazeti) inahitaji leseni gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kampuni za media Tanzania zinahitaji leseni kutoka Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano Tanzania (TCRA — Tanzania Communications Regulatory Authority). Redio na televisheni zinahitaji leseni ya utangazaji (broadcasting licence) na leseni ya maudhui (content licence). Magazeti yanahitaji usajili wa chapisho (publication registration) kutoka Wizara ya Habari. Yote yanahitaji pia: usajili wa BRELA, TIN, na leseni ya LGA. Leseni ya TCRA ina ada na masharti ya kufuata kanuni za utangazaji.
answer_en: Media companies in Tanzania require a licence from the Tanzania Communications Regulatory Authority (TCRA). Radio and television stations need a broadcasting licence and a content licence. Newspapers require publication registration from the Ministry of Information. All also require: BRELA registration, TIN, and an LGA licence. The TCRA licence has fees and conditions to comply with broadcasting regulations.
question_en: What licence does a media company (radio, television, or newspaper) need in Tanzania?
next_review_trigger: Electronic and Postal Communications Act amendment

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi mgeni anahitaji TIN Tanzania kwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kila mtu anayepokea mapato Tanzania — raia au mgeni — anahitaji TIN (Tax Identification Number) ya TRA. TIN inahitajika kwa mwajiri kuwasilisha PAYE returns na kwa mfanyakazi kuwasilisha kodi zake binafsi. Omba TIN kwa mfanyakazi mgeni wako mapema iwezekanavyo baada ya kuanza kazi.
question_en: Does a foreign employee need a Tanzania TIN for PAYE?
answer_en: Yes. Every person receiving income in Tanzania — citizens and foreigners — needs a TRA TIN (Tax Identification Number). The TIN is required for the employer to file PAYE returns and for the employee to file personal taxes. Apply for a TIN for your foreign employee as early as possible after they start work.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Biashara inayopokea ufadhili (grant) kutoka shirika la kimataifa — mpokeaji wa grant analipa VAT na anahitaji EFD Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ufadhili (grant) kutoka shirika la kimataifa kwa kawaida si mauzo ya kibiashara yanayostahili VAT — ni mapato ya hiari, si malipo kwa bidhaa/huduma. Kwa hivyo, grant yenyewe kwa kawaida HAILIPISHI VAT wala haihitaji EFD. Hata hivyo, ikiwa shirika la kimataifa linakununulia bidhaa au huduma (yaani unauza kwake), hizo ni mauzo ya kawaida zinazostahili VAT na EFD. Angalia mwanasheria wa kodi kwa muundo maalum wa ufadhili wako.
question_en: A business receiving a grant from an international organisation — does the grant recipient pay VAT and need an EFD in Tanzania?
answer_en: A grant from an international organisation is generally not a commercial sale subject to VAT — it is gratuitous income, not payment for goods/services. Therefore, the grant itself generally does NOT attract VAT or require an EFD. However, if the international organisation is buying goods or services from you (i.e., you are selling to them), those are regular taxable sales requiring VAT and an EFD. Consult a tax lawyer for your specific grant structure.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya ada za huduma (service fees) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya ada za huduma (service fees) ni asilimia 5 kwa wakazi na asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on service fees in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on service fees is 5% for residents and 15% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Je, kuna tofauti ya ada kati ya kusajili kampuni ya ndani na kampuni ya kigeni (foreign company)?
output: Ndiyo, ada za usajilishaji wa kampuni ya kigeni (foreign company) ni tofauti na za kampuni za ndani — mara nyingi ni za juu zaidi. Kwa ada za sasa za aina zote za usajilishaji, angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz au mfumo wa ORS (ors.brela.go.tz). Usitegemee takwimu za ada zilizotolewa na vyanzo visivyo rasmi kwani zinaweza kuwa za zamani.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Kampuni iliyosimamishwa shughuli (dormant company) bado inalipa ada za kila mwaka kwa BRELA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni iliyosajiliwa Tanzania — hata kama haifanyi shughuli yoyote — bado inalazimika kuwasilisha ripoti ya kila mwaka (annual return) kwa BRELA ndani ya siku 42 baada ya siku ya kumbukumbu ya usajili. Kushindwa kuwasilisha kunaweza kusababisha adhabu au kampuni kufutwa orodha. Ikiwa huhitaji kampuni tena, ni bora kufuata mchakato rasmi wa kufuta (deregistration).
question_en: Does a dormant company still need to pay annual fees to BRELA?
answer_en: Yes. A registered Tanzania company — even if it conducts no activities — is still required to file an annual return to BRELA within 42 days of the anniversary of its registration date. Failure to file can result in penalties or the company being struck off the register. If you no longer need the company, it is better to follow the formal deregistration process.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa nusu muda (part-time) analipa NSSF sawa na wa muda wote?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi wa nusu muda analipa NSSF kwa msingi wa mshahara wake mkubwa wa jumla — bila kujali ni nusu ya muda au muda wote. Kiwango ni sawa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla wa mfanyakazi huyo. Kwa mfano: mfanyakazi wa nusu muda analipwa TZS 300,000/mwezi → NSSF = TZS 60,000 (mwajiri 30,000 + mfanyakazi 30,000).
question_en: Does a part-time worker pay NSSF the same as a full-time employee?
answer_en: Yes. A part-time worker pays NSSF on their actual gross wages — regardless of whether they are part-time or full-time. The rate is the same: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of that employee's gross wage. Example: a part-time worker paid TZS 300,000/month → NSSF = TZS 60,000 (employer TZS 30,000 + employee TZS 30,000).

question_sw: WCF ni nini na wajibu wake kwa biashara yangu ni nini?
answer_sw: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ni mfuko wa bima ya ajali za kazi wa Tanzania. Kama mwajiri, unalazimika kusajiliwa WCF na kulipa mchango wa asilimia 0.5 ya mshahara wote wa wafanyakazi wako kila mwezi. WCF inalipia mfanyakazi aliyeumia kazini — matibabu, fidia, na manufaa ya ulemavu au kifo.
question_en: What is WCF and what is its obligation for my business?
answer_en: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) is Tanzania's workplace accident insurance fund. As an employer you must register with WCF and pay a contribution of 0.5% of total employee wages each month. WCF pays injured workers — medical expenses, compensation, and disability or death benefits.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: EFD inahitajika kwa mauzo ya mtandaoni (online sales) Tanzania?
answer_sw: TRA inashughulikia aina za EFD kwa mauzo ya kidijitali Tanzania. Mauzo ya mtandaoni yanayofanywa na biashara zilizosajili VAT bado yanahitaji ufuatiliaji wa kielelezo cha fedha. TRA inaweza kutoa mwongozo mahususi kwa biashara za mtandaoni kuhusu jinsi ya kufuata sheria za EFD kwa miamala ya kidijitali. Angalia TRA moja kwa moja kwa hali ya EFD kwa biashara yako ya mtandaoni.
question_en: Is an EFD required for online sales in Tanzania?
answer_en: TRA is addressing EFD compliance for digital sales in Tanzania. Online sales made by VAT-registered businesses still require fiscal tracking. TRA may issue specific guidance for online businesses on how to comply with EFD requirements for digital transactions. Check TRA directly for the EFD position for your online business.

question_sw: Wakurugenzi wa pekee (sole directors) wanaofanya kazi peke yao — je, wana wajibu wa NSSF?
answer_sw: Mkurugenzi wa pekee anayejilipa mshahara katika kampuni yake ana wajibu wa NSSF — kampuni (kama mwajiri) inalipa 10% na mkurugenzi (kama mfanyakazi) analipa 10% = jumla 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Ikiwa mkurugenzi anachukua gawio (dividends) badala ya mshahara, hali inaweza kutofautiana. Kwa mwongozo wa hali hii maalum, wasiliana na NSSF moja kwa moja.
question_en: Sole directors who work alone in their company — do they have NSSF obligations?
answer_en: A sole director who pays themselves a salary in their company has NSSF obligations — the company (as employer) pays 10% and the director (as employee) pays 10% = total 20% of gross wage. If the director takes dividends instead of a salary, the situation may differ. For guidance on this specific arrangement, contact NSSF directly.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi aliyeumia anaweza kudai WCF bila kumwambia mwajiri wake — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi analazimika kumwambia mwajiri wake kuhusu jeraha la kazi haraka iwezekanavyo. Mwajiri kisha ana wajibu wa kuripoti WCF. Hata hivyo, ikiwa mwajiri anakataa kuripoti, mfanyakazi anaweza kwenda WCF moja kwa moja. Kudumisha ushahidi wa jeraha na kuripoti mapema ni muhimu kwa mafanikio ya madai.
question_en: Can an injured worker claim WCF without telling their employer — is this true?
answer_en: The worker should notify their employer of the work injury as soon as possible. The employer then has the obligation to report to WCF. However, if the employer refuses to report, the worker can approach WCF directly. Preserving evidence of the injury and reporting early is critical for a successful claim.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: BRELA inasajili mashirika ya kiraia (NGO) pia?
answer_sw: Hapana kwa ujumla. Mashirika ya kiraia (NGO) yanasajiliwa na Msajili wa NGO chini ya Ofisi ya Makamu wa Rais au wizara husika — si BRELA. BRELA inasajili kampuni za faida (for-profit companies) na majina ya biashara. Walakini, NGO inayoendesha shughuli za biashara ya ziada inaweza kuhitaji usajili wa BRELA pia.
question_en: Does BRELA also register civil society organisations (NGOs)?
answer_en: Generally no. Civil society organisations (NGOs) register with the NGO Registrar under the Vice President's Office or relevant ministry — not BRELA. BRELA registers for-profit companies and business names. However, an NGO conducting ancillary commercial activities may also need BRELA registration.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: NGO Act or Companies Act update

instruction: GN 605A ongezeko la mshahara linaathiri SDL kwa kiasi gani kwa mfano wa vitendo?
output: Mfano wa vitendo: Kampuni ina wafanyakazi 10, kila mmoja alilipwa TZS 275,060/mwezi kabla ya GN 605A. Jumla ya mishahara = TZS 2,750,600. SDL ya zamani = 3.5% × TZS 2,750,600 = TZS 96,271/mwezi. Baada ya GN 605A (1 Januari 2026), mshahara wa chini wa sekta husika unaenda TZS 358,322/mwezi. Jumla mpya = TZS 3,583,220. SDL mpya = 3.5% × TZS 3,583,220 = TZS 125,413/mwezi. Ongezeko la SDL = TZS 125,413 − TZS 96,271 = TZS 29,142/mwezi zaidi. Hii ni mfano wa wastani — kiwango halisi kinategemea sekta na mshahara halisi. Thibitisha na TRA na GN 605A.

question_sw: Kampuni inayoshirikiana na kampuni nyingine (partnership) kila mmoja analipa kodi ya kampuni yake mwenyewe — je, ushirika una mfumo wake wa kodi?
answer_sw: Ushirika wa biashara (partnership) Tanzania kwa kawaida haupigiwi kodi moja kwa moja kama kampuni. Kila mshirika analipa kodi kwenye sehemu yake ya faida ya ushirika kwenye tamko lake la kibinafsi au kampuni (kulingana na aina ya mshirika). Ushirika unawasilisha tamko lake TRA lakini kodi inalipwa na washirika mmoja mmoja, si na ushirika wenyewe.
question_en: A partnership — each partner pays their own corporate tax — is there a separate tax structure for partnerships?
answer_en: A business partnership in Tanzania is generally not taxed directly like a company. Each partner pays tax on their share of partnership profit in their own individual or corporate return (depending on the type of partner). The partnership files its own return with TRA but the tax is paid by each partner individually, not by the partnership itself.

question_sw: Fundi wa seremala (carpenter) anayefanya kazi peke yake — anahitaji NSSF?
answer_sw: Fundi anayejitegemea (mwenye biashara yake mwenyewe, hana wafanyakazi) hajalazimishwa kwa NSSF ya wafanyakazi. Hata hivyo, NSSF inatoa programu ya michango ya hiari (voluntary contribution) kwa wajitegemea wanaotaka usalama wa pensheni. Kama fundi ataanza kuwa na wafanyakazi waliohiriwa, NSSF itakuwa lazima.
question_en: A self-employed carpenter — do they need NSSF?
answer_en: A self-employed carpenter (running their own business, no hired workers) is not required to contribute to NSSF for employees. However, NSSF offers a voluntary contribution programme for self-employed persons who want pension security. If the carpenter starts hiring employees, NSSF becomes mandatory for those employees.

question_sw: Mariamu, mfanyabiashara wa Kariakoo, anasema mchina jirani wake ana 'vibali vyote' — inamaanisha nini?
answer_sw: Hata mgeni mwenye 'vibali vyote' (kama leseni ya biashara, VAT, TIN, kibali cha makazi) hawezi kufanya biashara katika makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa chini ya GN 487A. Vibali hivyo ni vya biashara ya jumla — si kibali cha kufanya biashara YOYOTE. GN 487A ina nguvu juu ya vibali vingine kwa sekta zilizozuiliwa. Mchina huyo akiwa na duka la rejareja au biashara nyingine ya makundi 15, bado anakiuka GN 487A bila kujali vibali alivyo navyo. Mariamu asikubali usemi wa 'nina vibali vyote' kama ushahidi wa uhalali wa biashara hiyo.
question_en: Mariamu, a Kariakoo trader, says her Chinese neighbour has 'all the permits' — what does this mean?
answer_en: Even a non-citizen with 'all the permits' (such as a business licence, VAT, TIN, residence permit) cannot operate in the 15 prohibited categories under GN 487A. Those permits are for general business — they are not a permit to operate ANY business. GN 487A takes precedence over other permits for the prohibited sectors. If that Chinese national has a retail shop or another of the 15 prohibited categories, they still violate GN 487A regardless of what permits they hold. Mariamu should not accept 'I have all the permits' as evidence of the legality of that business.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Nimesikia wastani wa ongezeko la mishahara chini ya GN 605A ni asilimia 33.5 — hii ni sahihi?
output: Hapana — takwimu sahihi ni asilimia 33.4, si 33.5. Tofauti ni ndogo lakini muhimu kwa usahihi wa hesabu za mishahara. Wastani wa ongezeko la mshahara wa chini wa sekta binafsi chini ya GN 605A ni asilimia 33.4: mshahara wa wastani ulipanda kutoka TZS 275,060 hadi TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi kuanzia 1 Januari 2026. Thibitisha takwimu hizi na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

question_sw: 'Isiyopungua TZS 10M' inamaanisha nini kwa vitendo — korti inaweza kutoza zaidi ya 10M?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — 'isiyopungua TZS 10,000,000' inamaanisha TZS 10M ni KIWANGO CHA CHINI. Korti inaweza kutoza 10M, 15M, 20M au zaidi kulingana na hali ya kesi — lakini haiwezi kutoza chini ya 10M. Hii ni tofauti na 'hadi TZS 10M' (yaani huwezi kutoza zaidi ya 10M). Lugha ya kisheria inabainisha: 'not less than' = minimum; 'not exceeding' = maximum.
question_en: What does 'not less than TZS 10M' mean in practice — can the court impose more than 10M?
answer_en: Yes — 'not less than TZS 10,000,000' means TZS 10M is the MINIMUM. A court may impose 10M, 15M, 20M or more depending on the circumstances — but it cannot impose less than 10M. This differs from 'up to TZS 10M' (meaning you cannot impose more than 10M). Legal language: 'not less than' = minimum floor; 'not exceeding' = maximum ceiling.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Biashara yangu inaendesha mgahawa na duka la nguo. SDL inakokotolewa kwa jumla au kila biashara tofauti?
output: Kama mtu mmoja ndiye mmiliki wa biashara zote mbili (mgahawa na duka), SDL inakokotolewa kwa jumla ya wafanyakazi wote wa biashara zote — si kila biashara tofauti. Kizingiti cha wafanyakazi 10 kinaangalia wafanyakazi WOTE wa mmiliki. Kwa mfano: mgahawa una wafanyakazi 6, duka una 5 = jumla 11 — SDL inatumika kwa 11 wote. Malipo ya SDL: 3.5% ya jumla ya mishahara yote ya wafanyakazi 11. Hata hivyo, kama kila biashara ina TIN tofauti na inafanya kazi kwa uhuru — hali inaweza kuwa tofauti. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa hali yako maalum.

question_sw: EFD inaweza kuratibu mifumo miwili ya VAT — standard rate (18%) na zero-rated (0%) — kwenye muamala mmoja Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. EFD za kisasa ziliweza kushughulikia muamala mmoja wenye bidhaa za aina tofauti za VAT — kwa mfano, duka linalouza bidhaa za 18% na bidhaa za zero-rated pamoja. EFD inakokotoa VAT ya kila bidhaa kulingana na kategoria yake na kuonyesha muhtasari wa risiti na jumla ya VAT inayohusika. Weka programu ya EFD iliyosasishwa ili kushughulikia aina zote za VAT.
question_en: Can an EFD handle two VAT rates — standard rate (18%) and zero-rated (0%) — on one transaction in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Modern EFDs can handle a single transaction with goods of different VAT types — for example, a shop selling 18% goods and zero-rated goods together. The EFD calculates VAT for each item according to its category and shows a receipt summary with the applicable total VAT. Keep EFD software updated to handle all VAT categories.

question_sw: Je, WHT inaathiri mkataba wa makubaliano ya biashara (business agreement) vipi?
answer_sw: Mtu anayeingia mkataba wa biashara Tanzania anapaswa kuzingatia WHT katika mahesabu ya bei. Kwa mfano, ikiwa ada ya ushauri ni Shilingi 1,000,000 na WHT ni asilimia 5, mshauri atapokea Shilingi 950,000 na mwajiri atalipa Shilingi 50,000 TRA. Mikataba inapaswa kuainisha wazi kama bei ni kabla au baada ya WHT.
question_en: How does WHT affect a business contract agreement?
answer_en: A person entering a business contract in Tanzania must factor WHT into pricing. For example, if a consulting fee is TZS 1,000,000 and WHT is 5%, the consultant receives TZS 950,000 and the payer remits TZS 50,000 to TRA. Contracts should clearly state whether prices are gross (before) or net (after) WHT.

question_sw: Tozo za TRL (Tanzania Railways Limited) kwa mzigo — ni ngapi?
answer_sw: Tozo za usafiri wa reli (TRL) zinaathiriwa na aina ya mzigo, uzito, na umbali. Sina uhakika wa tozo za sasa. Wasiliana na TRL moja kwa moja kwa orodha ya sasa ya bei.
question_en: TRL (Tanzania Railways Limited) freight charges — how much?
answer_en: Rail freight charges (TRL) vary by cargo type, weight, and distance. I am not certain of current rates. Contact TRL directly for the current price list.

question_sw: Kampuni inayotoa hisa mpya (new share issue) inalipa ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Utoaji wa hisa mpya na kampuni (new share issue) unaweza kuwa na ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unaohesabiwa kwa kuzingatia thamani ya hisa mpya zinazotolewa. Hii ni tofauti na uhamishaji wa hisa zilizopo kati ya wanaohisa (share transfer). Angalia Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu na TRA kwa kiwango kinachohusika na utoaji mpya wa hisa.
question_en: Does a company issuing new shares attract stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: A company issuing new shares may attract stamp duty in Tanzania calculated on the value of the new shares being issued. This is different from a transfer of existing shares between shareholders. Check the Stamp Duty Act and TRA for the rate applicable to new share issuances.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or Companies Act amendment

question_sw: TRA imetoa tathmini ya kodi ambayo ninaona ni makosa. Ninaweza kupinga vipi na ndani ya muda gani?
answer_sw: MUHIMU: Kabla ya kuwasilisha hoja ya pingamizi, lazima ulipe kiwango kikubwa kati ya: (a) kodi isiyobishaniwa AU (b) theluthi moja (1/3) ya kodi iliyotathminiwa — ndani ya siku 15 baada ya kupokea tathmini. Bila malipo haya hoja haitakubaliwa na TRA. Unaweza kupinga tathmini ya TRA kwa kuwasilisha hoja ya pingamizi rasmi (notice of objection) kwa Kamishna wa TRA ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kupokea tathmini. Hoja lazima iwe kwa maandishi na ieleze kwa undani sababu za kisheria za kupingana na tathmini, ikiambatana na ushahidi wa kutosha (rekodi za uhasibu, risiti, mikataba). Kamishna atapitia hoja na kutoa uamuzi ndani ya miezi 6 kutoka tarehe ya kukubali hoja. Muhimu: Siku 30 za kuwasilisha hoja ni muda wa kisheria usiopanuliwa kwa urahisi — usipoteze muda.
answer_en: IMPORTANT: Before filing the objection, you must pay the higher of: (a) undisputed tax OR (b) one-third (1/3) of the assessed tax — within 15 days of receiving the assessment. Without this payment TRA will not admit the objection. You can dispute a TRA assessment by submitting a formal notice of objection to the TRA Commissioner General within 30 days of receiving the assessment. The objection must be in writing and explain in detail the legal grounds for disputing the assessment, accompanied by sufficient evidence (accounting records, receipts, contracts). The Commissioner will review the objection and issue a decision within 6 months from the date of admission of the objection. Important: the 30-day period for filing an objection is a statutory deadline not easily extended — do not waste time.
question_en: TRA has issued a tax assessment that I believe is wrong. How can I dispute it and within what time?

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ina wafanyakazi 9. Je, tunalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — inastahili tu kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi kwenye Tanzania Bara. Wafanyakazi 9 ni chini ya kiwango cha chini. Ikiwa utaajiri mfanyakazi mmoja zaidi na kufikia 10, utalazimika kuanza kulipa SDL kwa asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara.
question_en: My company has 9 employees. Do we pay SDL?
answer_en: No. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — only applies to employers with 10 or more employees on Mainland Tanzania. 9 employees is below the threshold. If you hire one more employee and reach 10, you will be required to start paying SDL at 3.5% of total gross payroll.

question_sw: Kampuni inalipia mfanyakazi chakula cha mchana (lunch) kila siku kiwanda. Je, chakula hicho kinatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Inategemea. Chakula kinachotolewa kwenye chumba cha chakula cha kampuni (canteen) kwa wafanyakazi wote kwa bei ya chini au bure kawaida halionekani kama mapato yanayotozwa kodi. Lakini ikiwa kampuni inalipia chakula cha mfanyakazi mmoja mmoja kwenye mgahawa au kutoa posho ya chakula ya pesa — inajumuishwa kwenye mapato ya ajira na inatozwa PAYE. Kwa ufafanuzi zaidi wa hali yako mahususi, thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi wa TRA.
answer_en: It depends. Meals provided in a company canteen available to all employees at a subsidized or free rate are generally not treated as taxable income. However, if the company pays for individual meals at a restaurant or provides a cash meal allowance — this is included in employment income and is subject to PAYE. For clarity on your specific situation, confirm with a TRA-registered tax consultant.
question_en: A company pays for an employee's daily lunch at the factory. Is that meal subject to PAYE?
next_review_trigger: TRA circular on benefits in kind

question_sw: Mfanyakazi aliye kwenye probation (muda wa majaribio) analipa NSSF?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi aliye kwenye muda wa majaribio (probationary period) analipa NSSF kama mfanyakazi yeyote mwingine — mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Hali ya probation haiathiri wajibu wa NSSF. Muda wa probation unahesabiwaje kama miezi ya mchango wa NSSF ikiwa mfanyakazi ataendelea kufanya kazi.
question_en: Does a probationary employee pay NSSF?
answer_en: Yes. An employee on probation pays NSSF like any other employee — employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. Probationary status does not affect the NSSF obligation. The probationary period counts as NSSF contribution months if the employee continues in employment.

question_sw: Usajili wa NSSF unagharimu kiasi gani na unachukua muda gani?
answer_sw: Usajili wa NSSF (National Social Security Fund) hauna ada ya usajili — ni BURE. Mwajiri anasajili kampuni yake na NSSF na kisha anasajili wafanyakazi wake. Mchakato unachukua siku 1-5 za kazi. Mara baada ya usajili, mwajiri anaanza kukatia na kuwasilisha michango ya NSSF kila mwezi (mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara wa jumla) ifikapo tarehe 10 ya mwezi unaofuata.
question_en: How much does NSSF registration cost and how long does it take?
answer_en: NSSF (National Social Security Fund) registration has no registration fee — it is FREE. An employer registers their company with NSSF and then registers their employees. The process takes 1-5 working days. Once registered, the employer begins deducting and remitting NSSF contributions monthly (employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage) by the 10th of the following month.
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act amendment or registration process update

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari: GN 487A inawahusu nani, inapiga marufuku nini, na kwa eneo gani?
answer_sw: Muhtasari wa GN 487A: (1) NANI inawahusu: raia wa kigeni (wageni) wote — si Watanzania; (2) NINI inapiga marufuku: makundi 15 ya biashara ikiwemo rejareja na jumla (isipokuwa supermarkets na vituo maalum), uhamisho wa pesa za simu, ukarabati wa simu na vifaa vya elektroniki, salon (isipokuwa hoteli/utalii), usafi wa nyumba na ofisi, uchimbaji madini mdogo, posta na usafirishaji vifurushi, uongozaji watalii, redio na televisheni, makumbusho na maduka ya vinyago, udalali wa biashara na mali isiyohamika, usafishaji forodha, ununuzi wa mazao shambani, mashine za kamari (isipokuwa kasino), na viwanda vidogo na vidogo sana.; (3) ENEO: Tanzania Bara tu — si Zanzibar. Ilianza: 28 Julai 2025.
question_en: Summary: who does GN 487A apply to, what does it prohibit, and in which area?
answer_en: GN 487A summary: (1) WHO it applies to: all foreign nationals (non-citizens) — not Tanzanians; (2) WHAT it prohibits: 15 business categories including retail and wholesale (excl. supermarkets and specialised outlets), mobile money transfers, phone and electronic device repair, salon business (excl. hotel/tourism), home and office cleaning, small-scale mining, postal and parcel delivery, local tour guiding, radio and television operation, museums and curio shops, business and real estate brokerage, clearing and forwarding, on-farm crop purchasing, gambling machines (excl. casino), and micro/small industries.; (3) AREA: Tanzania Mainland only — not Zanzibar. Effective: 28 July 2025.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutolipa PAYE kwa wakati ni ipi?
answer_sw: Faini ya kuchelewsha PAYE ni asilimia 5 ya kiwango kilichochelewa kwa kila mwezi au sehemu ya mwezi, pamoja na riba. TRA pia inaweza kufunga akaunti za benki za mwajiri anayekosea. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the penalty for late PAYE remittance in Tanzania?
answer_en: The late PAYE penalty is 5% of the unpaid amount per month or part thereof, plus interest. TRA can also freeze bank accounts of non-compliant employers. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Gari la kampuni linalipwa PAYE vipi?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi anayetumia gari la kampuni kwa madhumuni ya kibinafsi anapata manufaa yanayostahili PAYE. Thamani ya manufaa inahesabiwa kulingana na sheria ya kodi ya TRA. Mwajiri analazimika kujumuisha thamani hiyo katika mshahara unaostahili PAYE. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is a company car taxed under PAYE?
answer_en: An employee who uses a company car for personal purposes receives a taxable benefit subject to PAYE. The benefit value is calculated under TRA tax rules. The employer must include this value in the PAYE-liable payroll. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni ya nje (foreign company) inaweza kumiliki duka la reja reja Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana chini ya GN 487A. Biashara ya reja reja ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni. Kampuni inayomilikiwa na wageni haiwezi kufanya biashara ya reja reja Tanzania Bara. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na TIC.
question_en: Can a foreign-owned company own a retail shop in Tanzania?
answer_en: No under GN 487A. Retail trade is one of the 15 activities prohibited for non-citizens. A company owned by foreigners cannot conduct retail business in Tanzania Mainland. Confirm with the Immigration Department and TIC.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: Je, thamani ya USD 2,000 inahesabiwa kwa sarafu gani — dola, shilingi, au bei ya soko?
answer_sw: Thamani ya USD 2,000 inahesabiwa kwa Dola za Marekani (USD) — lakini wakati wa kuhesabu, inaweza kubadilishwa kwa sarafu ya ndani kwa kiwango cha ubadilishaji wa siku hiyo. Ofisa wa forodha ndiye anayehesabu thamani halisi. Hakikisha una kumbukumbu ya bei ya bidhaa zako.
question_en: Is the USD 2,000 value calculated in dollars, shillings, or market price?
answer_en: The USD 2,000 value is denominated in US Dollars — but when assessed, it can be converted to local currency at the exchange rate of that day. The customs officer calculates the actual value. Make sure you have a record of your goods' prices.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Mfanyakazi akifa kazini Tanzania — mwajiri ana wajibu gani wa kisheria zaidi ya WCF?
answer_sw: Mbali na WCF (ambayo inalipa fidia ya kifo kwa familia), mwajiri ana wajibu wa ziada: (1) kuarifu OSHA na polisi kuhusu kifo cha kazini ndani ya muda uliopangwa, (2) kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa OSHA wa ajali iliyosababisha kifo, (3) kulipa mshahara wote uliostahiliwa hadi tarehe ya kifo, (4) kushughulikia NSSF kwa manufaa ya kifo yanayostahili familia, (5) kuhakikisha mazingira ya kazi yanaboreshwa ili kuzuia kifo kingine kama hicho.
question_en: If an employee dies at work in Tanzania — what legal obligations does the employer have beyond WCF?
answer_en: Beyond WCF (which pays death compensation to the family), the employer has additional obligations: (1) notify OSHA and police about the workplace death within the specified time, (2) cooperate with OSHA's investigation of the fatal accident, (3) pay all wages owed up to the date of death, (4) engage with NSSF for death benefits payable to the family, (5) ensure workplace conditions are improved to prevent another similar death.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act or WCF Act amendment

question_sw: Mtu anayefanya kazi mbili — mwajiriwa na mwenye biashara — ana wajibu wa kodi gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Mtu mwenye kipato cha vyanzo viwili (mshahara wa ajira + faida ya biashara) ana: (1) PAYE inayokatwa na mwajiri wake kwenye mshahara, (2) wajibu wa kuwasilisha tamko la kodi la mwaka ambalo linajumuisha kipato cha biashara pia, (3) kulipa kodi ya ziada ikiwa kipato cha biashara kinaongeza jumla ya kodi zaidi ya PAYE iliyokatwa. Biashara yake inahitaji TIN yake mwenyewe ikiwa ni kampuni, au TIN yake kwa biashara ya mtu mmoja.
question_en: A person with two jobs — employed and business owner — what tax obligations apply in Tanzania?
answer_en: A person with two income sources (employment salary + business profit) has: (1) PAYE deducted by their employer on their salary, (2) an obligation to file an annual tax return that includes business income too, (3) pay additional tax if business income increases total tax above the PAYE already deducted. Their business needs its own TIN if it is a company, or their personal TIN for a sole proprietorship.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act PAYE or income tax update

question_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa mshahara ghafi (gross wage) au mshahara wa msingi (basic salary)?
answer_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa mshahara ghafi (gross wage) — si mshahara wa msingi peke yake. Mshahara ghafi unajumuisha mishahara yote ya lazima kabla ya makato yoyote. Thibitisha ufafanuzi kamili wa 'mshahara wa jumla' na NSSF.
question_en: Is NSSF calculated on gross wage or basic salary in Tanzania?
answer_en: NSSF is calculated on gross wage — not basic salary alone. Gross wage includes all compulsory remuneration before any deductions. Confirm the full definition of 'total wage' with NSSF.

question_sw: GN 487A inaathiri vipi wageni wanaofanya biashara Tanzania?
answer_sw: GN 487A (Agizo la Uzuiaji wa Shughuli za Biashara kwa Wasio Raia) lilianza kutumika tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Linazuia raia wa kigeni kufanya shughuli 15 za biashara ikiwa ni pamoja na: biashara ya jumla na rejareja, uhamisho wa pesa ya simu, ukarabati wa simu, salon na nyingine. Adhabu: faini ya angalau Shilingi 10M + kifungo hadi miezi 6 + kufutwa kwa viza.
question_en: How does GN 487A affect foreigners doing business in Tanzania?
answer_en: GN 487A (Business Licensing Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens Order) took effect on 28 July 2025. It prohibits foreign nationals from conducting 15 business activities including: wholesale/retail trade, mobile money transfers, phone repair, salon business and others. Penalties: minimum TZS 10M fine + up to 6 months imprisonment + visa revocation.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya P9 na P10 ni nini kwa madhumuni ya PAYE?
answer_sw: P10 ni fomu ya KILA MWEZI ya kuwasilisha na kulipa PAYE iliyokatwa kwa kipindi. P9 ni TAARIFA YA MWAKA ya PAYE — inawasilishwa mara moja kwa mwaka ifikapo tarehe 31 Machi na inatoa muhtasari wa PAYE yote iliyolipwa na mwaka. Waajiri wanahitaji zote mbili — P10 kila mwezi na P9 mwishoni mwa mwaka.
question_en: What is the difference between P9 and P10 for PAYE purposes?
answer_en: P10 is the MONTHLY form for submitting and paying PAYE deducted for the period. P9 is the ANNUAL PAYE RETURN — filed once per year by 31 March summarising all PAYE paid through the year. Employers need both — P10 monthly and P9 at year end.

question_sw: Je, VAT inastahili kwa bidhaa na huduma zote Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. VAT inastahili kwa usambazaji unaostahili (taxable supply) peke yake unaofanywa na mtu msajiliwa katika mwendo wa shughuli za kiuchumi. Usambazaji fulani una kiwango cha sifuri (zero-rated) au umeachiliwa (exempt). Thibitisha hali ya bidhaa/huduma yako na TRA.
question_en: Does VAT apply to all goods and services in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. VAT applies only to taxable supplies made by a registered person in the course of economic activities. Some supplies are zero-rated or exempt. Confirm the status of your goods/services with TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni inataka kubadilisha jina lake. Inafuata mchakato gani wa BRELA?
answer_sw: Kubadilisha jina la kampuni kunahitaji: kupitisha azimio maalum (special resolution) la wanahisa wenye asilimia 75 ya kura kuunga mkono mabadiliko ya jina, kuomba kuidhinishwa kwa jina jipya na BRELA kwa ajili ya uthibitisho wa upatikanaji, kuwasilisha maombi rasmi ya mabadiliko ya jina kwa BRELA na ada, na kupata cheti kipya cha usajili kikiwa na jina jipya. Baada ya mabadiliko ya jina, lazima usasishe nyaraka zote za kisheria, akaunti za benki, na leseni nyingine zote.
answer_en: Changing a company name requires: passing a special resolution by shareholders holding at least 75% of votes supporting the name change, applying to BRELA to approve the new name for availability confirmation, submitting a formal name change application to BRELA with fees, and receiving a new registration certificate with the new name. After the name change, you must update all legal documents, bank accounts, and all other licences.
question_en: A company wants to change its name. What BRELA process does it follow?

question_sw: Wakurugenzi wa kampuni wanabeba dhima ya kibinafsi kwa kodi za kampuni — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida hapana — kampuni ya kikomo cha dhima ina utu wa kisheria tofauti. Hata hivyo, kuna hali ambapo wakurugenzi wanabeba dhima ya kibinafsi kwa kodi kama: kwa ukweli wa udanganyifu, kwa PAYE isiyolipwa (kwa sababu ni pesa za wafanyakazi), au wakati kampuni inafanywa kuwa chombo cha kukwepa kodi. Shauriana na wakili wa kodi kwa hali yako.
question_en: Company directors bear personal liability for company taxes — is this true?
answer_en: Generally no — a limited company has a separate legal personality. However, there are situations where directors can bear personal liability for taxes such as: for fraud, for unpaid PAYE (since it is employees' money), or when a company is used as a tax evasion vehicle. Consult a tax lawyer for your specific situation.

question_sw: Je, wafanyakazi wa Zanzibar wanajumuishwa kwenye kuhesabu wafanyakazi 10 wa SDL ya Tanzania Bara?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL ya TRA (Mainland) inatumika tu kwa wafanyakazi wa Tanzania Bara. Wafanyakazi waliopo Zanzibar si sehemu ya hesabu ya SDL ya Mainland. Ikiwa una wafanyakazi 8 Mainland na 4 Zanzibar, unaweza kutolazimika kulipa SDL ya TRA (Mainland 8 < 10). Zanzibar ina mfumo wake tofauti kupitia ZRA.
question_en: Are Zanzibar-based employees included in the 10-employee count for Mainland Tanzania SDL?
answer_en: No. TRA's SDL (Mainland) applies only to employees based on Mainland Tanzania. Zanzibar-based employees are not part of the Mainland SDL calculation. If you have 8 Mainland employees and 4 Zanzibar employees, you may not be liable for TRA SDL (Mainland 8 < 10). Zanzibar has its own separate system through ZRA.

question_sw: Ombi la kibali cha makazi Tanzania linafanywa wapi mtandaoni?
answer_sw: Maombi ya vibali vya makazi (daraja A, B, C) yanafanywa mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa e-services wa Idara ya Uhamiaji kwenye tovuti immigration.go.tz. Mwombaji anatakiwa kuunda akaunti, kujaza fomu, na kupakia hati zinazohitajika. Thibitisha mahitaji ya sasa na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Where is a Tanzania residence permit application submitted online?
answer_en: Applications for residence permits (Class A, B, C) are submitted online through the Immigration Department's e-services system at immigration.go.tz. The applicant creates an account, completes the form, and uploads required documents. Confirm current requirements with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: VAT ya uingizaji (imports) inafanyaje kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: VAT ya asilimia 18 inastahili kwa uingizaji wa bidhaa zinazostahili kutoka nje ya Tanzania Bara. Uingizaji wa huduma pia unastahili VAT. Sheria za kawaida za Forodha zinatumika. Thibitisha mahitaji ya VAT ya uingizaji na TRA na Forodha.
question_en: How does VAT on imports work in Tanzania?
answer_en: 18% VAT applies to the importation of taxable goods from outside Tanzania Mainland. Importation of services is also subject to VAT. Normal Customs laws and procedures apply. Confirm import VAT requirements with TRA and Customs.

instruction: Mgeni amefungua duka chini ya jina la mke wake Mtanzania — je, hii inamhifadhi dhidi ya GN 487A?
output: Hapana — kufungua biashara chini ya jina la mke au mume Mtanzania hakumhifadhi mgeni dhidi ya GN 487A. Sheria inazingatia nani anayodhibiti na kunufaika na biashara halisi, si jina katika hati. Mgeni anayedhibiti biashara, kupokea faida, au kufanya maamuzi ya biashara bado anakiuka GN 487A. Mke/mume Mtanzania anaweza pia kuadhibiwa kama 'mwezesha' — faini ya TZS milioni 5 AU miezi 3. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

instruction: Mpishi wangu wa nyumbani (house cook) anapaswa kuwa na NSSF?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Ndio — wafanyakazi wa nyumbani (domestic workers) wanastahili NSSF. Hii inajumuisha: mpishi, msafi wa nyumba, mlinzi wa nyumba, mtunza watoto. Hata kama wafanyakazi wako wa nyumbani ni wawili tu, una wajibu wa kisheria wa kuwaandikisha NSSF.

instruction: Je, partnership (ushirikiano) nchini Tanzania inaweza kusajiliwa rasmi?
output: Ndiyo. Partnership (ushirikiano wa kibiashara) inaweza kusajiliwa BRELA kwa aina mbalimbali — kama business name ya pamoja au kwa njia nyingine. Mbia lazima waandike mkataba wa ushirikiano (partnership deed) ukibainisha majukumu, faida, na hasara. Kwa utaratibu wa sasa wa usajilishaji wa partnership na ada husika, thibitisha na BRELA moja kwa moja (brela.go.tz) — mahitaji yanaweza kubadilika.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: TRA inaweza kukamata mali za kampuni kama kodi haijalipiwa — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRA ina mamlaka ya kisheria ya kuchukua hatua za makusanyo kwa kodi isiyolipwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na: kuzuia akaunti za benki, kukamata mali, na mauzo ya mali kwa minada. Hatua hizi zinaelekea kufuata notisi za onyo. Makubaliano ya malipo yanaweza kuzuia hatua hizi.
question_en: Can TRA seize company assets if tax is not paid — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. TRA has legal authority to take collection action for unpaid tax, including: freezing bank accounts, seizing assets, and auctioning property. These steps typically follow warning notices. A payment arrangement can prevent these actions.

question_sw: Je, kampuni ya madini lazima ilipe SDL kwa wafanyakazi wake?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — kampuni ya madini inayofanya kazi Tanzania Bara na yenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi inalazimika kulipa SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) kwa asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara. Hii ni swali la SDL ambalo ninaweza kulisaidia. Hata hivyo, kwa maswali ya royalty ya madini, permits za uchimbaji, na Sheria ya Madini, wasiliana na TMAA au Wizara ya Madini.
question_en: Must a mining company pay SDL for its employees?
answer_en: Yes — a mining company operating on Mainland Tanzania with 10 or more employees must pay SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) at 3.5% of total gross payroll. This is an SDL question I can help with. However, for mining royalty questions, drilling permits, and the Mining Act, contact TMAA or the Ministry of Minerals.

instruction: Mshahara wa wastani wa sekta binafsi wa TZS 275,060 — ulikuwa ukitumika hadi tarehe ngapi?
output: Mshahara wa wastani wa TZS 275,060 ulikuwa ukitumika chini ya amri ya mishahara ya 2022 — hadi tarehe 31 Desemba 2025. Kuanzia 1 Januari 2026, amri ya 2022 ilifutwa na GN 605A ikaanza kutumika, ikiinua wastani hadi TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi. Kumbuka: tarehe ya mwisho ya amri ya 2022 ni 31 Desemba 2025 — si Septemba 2025 wala Oktoba 2025. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

instruction: Zanzibar ina VAT tofauti na Tanzania Bara — ni tofauti gani?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants na ninashughulikia sheria za kodi na biashara za TANZANIA BARA peke yake. Zanzibar ina mfumo wake wa kodi (Zanzibar Revenue Board — ZRB) ambao ni tofauti na wa TRA ya Tanzania Bara. Tofauti kati ya mifumo hii miwili ni nje ya wigo wangu. Wasiliana na ZRB kupitia zrb.go.tz au mshauri wa kodi wa Zanzibar kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Makubaliano ya mkopo kati ya kampuni mbili yanahitaji kodi ya stempu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Makubaliano ya mkopo (loan agreement) yanajumuishwa kwenye hati zinazohitaji kodi ya stempu. Kiwango kinatofautiana kulingana na aina ya hati: kama ni 'agreement or memorandum of agreement' ya kawaida, kodi ya stempu ni TZS 2,000. Kwa hati za pawn, hypothecation, au deposit ya hati za umiliki wa mali (title deeds), kodi ni pia TZS 2,000. Makubaliano ya mkopo lazima yapigwe stempu ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kutiwa saini.
answer_en: Yes. Loan agreements are included among instruments requiring stamp duty. The rate depends on the type of instrument: for a standard 'agreement or memorandum of agreement', stamp duty is TZS 2,000. For instruments of pawn, hypothecation, or deposit of title deeds, the duty is also TZS 2,000. Loan agreements must be stamped within 30 days of signing.
question_en: Does a loan agreement between two companies require stamp duty?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — agreement schedule

question_sw: Je, uwekezaji wa moja kwa moja wa kigeni (FDI) unaathiriwa na GN 487A?
answer_sw: FDI (Foreign Direct Investment) na uwekezaji wa kimataifa mkubwa unaosimamiwa na TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) na sheria ya uwekezaji unaweza kuwa na mwongozo tofauti kutoka kwa GN 487A. TIC inaweza kutoa hati za uwekezaji zinazomruhusu mgeni kufanya biashara kwa masharti maalum. Hata hivyo: FDI inayofanya biashara katika makundi yaliyopigwa marufuku na GN 487A (rejareja ndogo, salon, nk) bila idhini maalum ya TIC inaweza bado kukiuka GN 487A. Thibitisha hali yako na TIC na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Does foreign direct investment (FDI) get affected by GN 487A?
answer_en: FDI and large international investments managed through TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) and investment law may have different guidance from GN 487A. TIC may issue investment certificates that permit a non-citizen to conduct business under specific conditions. However: FDI conducting businesses in GN 487A prohibited categories (small retail, salons, etc.) without specific TIC authorisation may still violate GN 487A. Verify your situation with TIC and the Immigration Department.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A or investment law

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni wa NGO/asasi ya kiraia — PAYE inatumika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. PAYE inatumika kwa wafanyakazi wa asasi za kiraia (NGO, asasi za jamii, mashirika ya kimataifa) wanaofanya kazi Tanzania — kama wana mshahara. Mwajiri (NGO au asasi) analazimika kukata na kuwasilisha PAYE. Baadhi ya asasi za kimataifa zenye hadhi maalum za UN au kidiplomasia zinaweza kuwa na msamaha — thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: A foreign employee of an NGO/civil society organization — does PAYE apply?
answer_en: Yes. PAYE applies to employees of civil society organizations (NGOs, community organizations, international organizations) working in Tanzania — if they receive a salary. The employer (NGO or organization) must deduct and remit PAYE. Some international organizations with special UN or diplomatic status may have exemptions — verify with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Je, duka la kutengeneza simu linamilikiwa na mgeni ni tatizo gani?
answer_sw: Ukarabati wa simu (phone repair) umekatazwa wazi na GN 487A. Raia wa kigeni hawezi kumiliki au kuendesha duka la ukarabati wa simu Tanzania Bara. Ikiwa ataendelea, anakabiliwa na faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa visa.
question_en: What problem does a non-citizen owning a phone repair shop face?
answer_en: Phone repair is explicitly prohibited under GN 487A. A non-citizen cannot own or operate a phone repair shop in Mainland Tanzania. If they continue, they face a fine of at least TZS 10 million, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: Mgeni alianza biashara ya rejareja wakati wa kampuni ya utekelezaji imeisha (baada ya Oktoba 2025) — je, bado ana tatizo?
output: Ndiyo — kampeni ya utekelezaji ya Idara ya Uhamiaji (11 Sep–8 Oct 2025) ilikuwa ni harakati maalum ya mwanzo, lakini GN 487A yenyewe ni sheria ya kudumu (permanent law) iliyoanza tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Kampeni ya utekelezaji iliisha lakini sheria haijabadilika. Mgeni yeyote anayefanya biashara katika orodha ya 15 baada ya Oktoba 2025 bado anakiuka GN 487A na anakabiliwa na adhabu kamili: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari: mfanyabiashara wa mipaka anahitaji nini kufaidika na STR?
answer_sw: Kufaidika na STR, mfanyabiashara anahitaji: (1) Bidhaa zilizozalishwa ndani ya EAC/COMESA (originating status) — thibitishwa na SCO; (2) Aina ya bidhaa ipo kwenye Common List (~370 bidhaa); (3) Thamani ya msafara si zaidi ya USD 2,000; (4) Simplified Customs Document (SCD) iliyojazwa vizuri; (5) Kitambulisho cha kibinafsi. Masharti yote lazima yakidhiwe — si moja au mawili tu.
question_en: Summary: what does a border trader need to benefit from STR?
answer_en: To benefit from STR, a trader needs: (1) Goods produced within EAC/COMESA (originating status) — certified by SCO; (2) Goods category on the Common List (~370 products); (3) Consignment value not exceeding USD 2,000; (4) A properly completed Simplified Customs Document (SCD); (5) Personal identification. All conditions must be met — not just one or two.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu ana kazi mbili — kampuni yangu na kampuni nyingine. Je, NSSF inalipwa mara mbili?
answer_sw: Kwa mfanyakazi mwenye waajiri wawili, kila mwajiri analipa NSSF kwa sehemu ya mshahara wake: mwajiri 10% na mfanyakazi 10% = jumla 20% kwa kila chanzo cha mshahara. Kwa mfano: Kampuni A inalipa 10% ya TZS 500,000, Kampuni B inalipa 10% ya TZS 300,000 — jumla ya michango inakuwa 20% ya kila mshahara, si 20% ya jumla. Mfanyakazi anatoa namba moja ya NSSF kwa waajiri wote. Michango yote inaenda kwenye akaunti moja ya NSSF ya mfanyakazi.
question_en: My employee has two jobs — my company and another company. Is NSSF paid twice?
answer_en: For an employee with two employers, each employer pays NSSF on their portion of the salary: employer 10% plus employee 10% = total 20% from each salary source. Example: Company A pays 10% of TZS 500,000, Company B pays 10% of TZS 300,000 — contributions are 20% of each salary separately, not 20% of the combined total. The employee provides one NSSF number to all employers. All contributions go into the employee's single NSSF account.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina faida ya mwaka 0 kwa sababu bado inajenga — je, inapaswa kulipa kodi yoyote?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Kodi inayotumika kwa kampuni mpya bado katika hatua ya ujenzi (pre-revenue/construction phase) — kama AMT, provisional tax, au msamaha wa kipindi fulani — ni mada ya Income Tax Act inayohitaji uchambuzi maalum wa hali ya kodi ya biashara. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Mwombaji wa kibali cha kazi (Class C) Tanzania anahitaji hati gani?
answer_sw: Kibali cha daraja C ni kwa watafiti, wastaafu, wamishonari, na wanaojitolea — si kwa wafanyakazi wanaoajiriwa na kampuni. Wafanyakazi wanaoajiriwa wanahitaji daraja B. Kwa kawaida, mwombaji wa daraja C anahitaji: passport inayotumika, barua ya mwajiri, mkataba wa kazi, vyeti vya elimu/uzoefu, picha za pasipoti, fomu ya TRA (TIN), na ada ya maombi. Mahitaji yanaweza kutofautiana — thibitisha orodha kamili na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What documents does a Class C work permit applicant in Tanzania need?
answer_en: Class C is for researchers, retired persons, missionaries and volunteers. Class B is what company-hired workers need instead. Typically, a Class C applicant needs: a valid passport, employer letter, employment contract, educational/experience certificates, passport photos, TRA form (TIN), and application fee. Requirements may vary — confirm the full list with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa majaribio (probationary employee) ana haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi katika kipindi cha majaribio ana haki ya angalau kiwango cha chini cha GN 605A cha sekta husika. Muda wa majaribio haupunguzi haki ya mshahara wa chini. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Is a probationary employee entitled to the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: Yes. An employee on probation is entitled to at least the GN 605A minimum wage for their sector. The probation period does not reduce the right to minimum pay. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya 'zero-rated' na 'exempt' kwa VAT Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Zero-rated: bidhaa/huduma zinatozwa VAT ya asilimia 0. Msambazaji bado anaweza kudai input VAT aliyolipa kwa manunuzi wake. Mfano: mazao ya kilimo fulani, dawa fulani, mauzo ya nje (exports). Exempt: bidhaa/huduma hazilipwi VAT kabisa, LAKINI msambazaji hawezi kudai input VAT. Mfano: huduma za fedha, ardhi, baadhi ya huduma za elimu. Tofauti kubwa: msambazaji wa zero-rated anadai input VAT; msambazaji wa exempt hadai.
question_en: What is the difference between 'zero-rated' and 'exempt' for VAT purposes in Tanzania?
answer_en: Zero-rated: goods/services are taxed at 0% VAT. The supplier can still claim input VAT paid to their own suppliers. Examples: certain agricultural produce, certain medicines, exports. Exempt: goods/services are not subject to VAT, BUT the supplier cannot claim input VAT. Examples: financial services, land, some educational services. Key difference: zero-rated supplier claims input VAT; exempt supplier cannot.

question_sw: Jinsi ya kuhesabu mshahara wa mikono (net salary) mfanyakazi anapopata baada ya PAYE na NSSF kukatwa — mfano wa TZS 800,000.
answer_sw: Mahesabu ya mshahara wa mikono (take-home) kwa mshahara ghafi TZS 800,000/mwezi: PAYE = TZS 52,000 (kama ilivyohesabiwa). NSSF ya mfanyakazi (10%) = TZS 80,000. Jumla ya makato = TZS 132,000. Mshahara wa mikono = TZS 800,000 − TZS 132,000 = TZS 668,000. Kumbuka: WCF na SDL ni gharama za mwajiri peke yake — hazikatwi kwa mfanyakazi. NSSF ya mwajiri (10%) inalipwa tena juu ya mshahara na mwajiri.
answer_en: Take-home salary calculation for gross salary TZS 800,000/month: PAYE = TZS 52,000 (as calculated). Employee NSSF (10%) = TZS 80,000. Total deductions = TZS 132,000. Take-home salary = TZS 800,000 − TZS 132,000 = TZS 668,000. Note: WCF and SDL are employer-only costs — not deducted from the employee. The employer's NSSF share (10%) is paid additionally on top of the salary by the employer.
question_en: How do you calculate an employee's take-home (net) salary after PAYE and NSSF deductions — example with TZS 800,000.
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE + NSSF — net salary calculation
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or NSSF rate amendment

instruction: Kampuni yangu ilianza 2022 na haijawahi kuwasilisha annual return — hatari gani inanisubiri?
output: Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Kuanzia 2022 hadi 2026 ni karibu miaka 4 — faini inakusanyika kwa kila mwezi. Zaidi ya miaka 2 ya kukosa, BRELA ina mamlaka ya kufuta kampuni kwenye orodha. Wasiliana na BRELA haraka kujua hali ya kampuni yako na jinsi ya kurekebisha.

question_sw: Wakati gani mfanyabiashara anapata haki ya kudai refund ya VAT?
answer_sw: Haki ya kudai refund ya VAT inatokea wakati INPUT VAT inazidi OUTPUT VAT kwa kipindi cha uwasilishaji (mwezi au robo mwaka). Hali hii mara nyingi hutokea kwa: (1) Wauza bidhaa nje ya nchi (exporters) — mauzo yao yana VAT 0% lakini wananunua bidhaa na VAT ya kawaida; (2) Biashara mpya inayonunua vifaa vingi kabla ya kuanza mauzo; (3) Biashara inayonunua mali ghali (kama mashine) na VAT kubwa ya awali.
question_en: When does a business become entitled to claim a VAT refund?
answer_en: Entitlement to a VAT refund arises when INPUT VAT exceeds OUTPUT VAT for a filing period (monthly or quarterly). This commonly happens for: (1) Exporters — their sales carry 0% VAT but they buy goods with regular VAT; (2) New businesses buying a lot of equipment before sales start; (3) Businesses buying expensive assets (like machinery) with a large upfront VAT.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Jinsi ya kusajilisha biashara yangu na wafanyakazi wake na NSSF?
answer_sw: Hatua za kusajilisha na NSSF ni: 1) Tembelea ofisi ya NSSF iliyo karibu nawe au tovuti nssf.or.tz. 2) Wasilisha fomu ya usajilishaji wa mwajiri pamoja na nakala ya certificate ya BRELA, TIN, na vitambulisho vya wafanyakazi. 3) Kila mfanyakazi atasajiliwa na kupewa nambari yake ya NSSF. 4) Baada ya usajilishaji, utapewa akaunti ya kulipa michango kila mwezi. Thibitisha nyaraka zinazohitajika na NSSF kwenye nssf.or.tz kabla ya kwenda.
question_en: How do I register my business and employees with NSSF?
answer_en: Steps to register with NSSF: 1) Visit your nearest NSSF office or the website nssf.or.tz. 2) Submit an employer registration form along with copies of your BRELA certificate, TIN, and employees' identification. 3) Each employee will be registered and assigned their own NSSF number. 4) After registration, you will be given an account for monthly contribution payments. Confirm the required documents with NSSF at nssf.or.tz before going.
next_review_trigger: When NSSF Act is amended — VERIFY exact effective date from nssf.or.tz before training

question_sw: Mfanyakazi yuko likizo bila malipo (unpaid leave) kwa mwezi mzima. Je, NSSF inalipwa?
answer_sw: Wakati mfanyakazi yuko likizo bila malipo, hakuna mshahara unaolipwa — na kwa hivyo hakuna msingi wa NSSF ya kulipiwa. NSSF inahesabiwaje kwa msingi wa mshahara mkubwa wa jumla uliolipwa. Kama hakuna mshahara, hakuna michango ya NSSF inayohitajika kwa kipindi hicho. Kumbuka: mwezi huo hauhesabiwi kama mwezi wa mchango kwa madhumuni ya faida za NSSF.
question_en: An employee is on unpaid leave for a whole month. Is NSSF paid?
answer_en: When an employee is on unpaid leave, no wages are paid — and therefore there is no NSSF base to calculate on. NSSF is calculated on actual gross wages paid. If no wages are paid, no NSSF contributions are required for that period. Note: that month will not count as a contribution month for NSSF benefit purposes.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya pango la kibiashara (commercial rent) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya pango la kibiashara ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on commercial rent in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on commercial rent is 10% for residents and 15% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mshahara wa chini wa sekta ya umma ni Shilingi 400,000 kutoka Julai 2025 — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mshahara wa chini wa sekta ya umma ni Shilingi 500,000 kwa mwezi — si Shilingi 400,000. Rais Samia alitangaza Shilingi 500,000 mnamo tarehe 1 Mei 2025, kuanzia Julai 2025. Namba ya Shilingi 400,000 si sahihi.
question_en: The public sector minimum wage is TZS 400,000 from July 2025 — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The public sector minimum wage is TZS 500,000 per month — not TZS 400,000. President Samia announced TZS 500,000 on 1 May 2025, effective July 2025. The figure of TZS 400,000 is incorrect.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Serikali ilitoa GN 487A kwa sababu gani hasa?
answer_sw: Serikali ya Tanzania ilitoa GN 487A (2025) kwa lengo la kulinda fursa za kibiashara kwa raia wa Tanzania — hasa katika biashara ndogo ndogo na za kati ambazo zimekuwa zikifanywa na wageni. Amri inalenga makundi 15 ya biashara ambazo kwa miaka mingi zilikuwa zikifanywa na wageni badala ya Watanzania. Lengo ni kuwezesha wafanyabiashara wa Tanzania kupata sehemu ya kiuchumi katika sekta hizi. Hii ni sera ya sera ya uchumi shirikishi (economic empowerment) inayolenga ukuzaji wa biashara za Watanzania.
question_en: Why exactly did the government issue GN 487A?
answer_en: The Government of Tanzania issued GN 487A (2025) to protect business opportunities for Tanzanian citizens — particularly in small and medium enterprises that had been operated by non-citizens. The Order targets 15 business categories that for many years had been dominated by non-citizens rather than Tanzanians. The goal is to enable Tanzanian entrepreneurs to gain an economic share in these sectors. This is an economic empowerment policy aimed at growing Tanzanian businesses.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: VAT rate ya Zanzibar ni ile ile 18% kama Tanzania Bara?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. VAT na kiwango chake kwa Zanzibar inashughulikiwa chini ya sheria za ZRB — mimi ninashughulikia VAT ya Tanzania Bara tu. Kwa maswali ya Zanzibar, wasiliana na ZRB moja kwa moja. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Mkurugenzi wangu anapata TZS 1,000,000 kwa mwezi — PAYE ni ngapi?
output:
Hesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 1,000,000/mwezi:
Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 = TZS 0
Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000
Bendi 3 (20%): TZS 240,000 × 20% = TZS 48,000
Bendi 4 (25%): TZS 240,000 × 25% = TZS 60,000
PAYE ya jumla: TZS 128,000/mwezi
TZS 1,000,000 ni mwisho wa Bendi 4 — PAYE ya juu kabisa ya vipande 4 vya kwanza.

instruction: VAT inawasilishwa kwa mfumo gani — kila mwezi au kila mwaka?
output: VAT inawasilishwa KILA MWEZI kwa biashara zilizosajiliwa VAT Tanzania. Hakuna chaguo la mwaka — ni kila mwezi bila kukosekana. Mfumo: VAT return ya mwezi uliopita inawasilishwa kabla ya tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kwa mfano: VAT ya Januari → iwasilishwe kabla ya 20 Februari. Hata kama hukufanya biashara yoyote mwezi fulani — bado lazima uwasilishe VAT return ya NIL (zero) kuonyesha TRA biashara ipo. Kutokuwasilisha — hata kwa mwezi wa sifuri — ni kosa la kodi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Mwajiri hana WCF — mfanyakazi aliyeumia kazini anafanyaje?
output: Kama mwajiri hakusajili WCF (ukiukwaji wa sheria), mfanyakazi aliyeumia ana haki za kisheria bado: (1) Anapaswa kutoa taarifa kwa WCF moja kwa moja (WCF inaweza kuchunguza na kumfuatilia mwajiri); (2) WCF ina uwezo wa kudai fidia kutoka kwa mwajiri moja kwa moja hata kama mwajiri hakusajili — mwajiri anaweza kulazimishwa kulipa; (3) Mfanyakazi anaweza kufungua kesi ya kisheria kwa Mahakama ya Kazi dhidi ya mwajiri kwa kutofuata sheria ya WCF. Mwajiri asiyesajili WCF ana hatari ya: madai ya fidia, faini, na mashtaka ya kisheria. Thibitisha na wcf.go.tz na Mahakama ya Kazi.

question_sw: Je, ninapouza hisa zangu kampunini, nalipa kodi ngapi?
answer_sw: Kodi kwa uuzaji wa hisa ni suala la kodi ya mapato ya mtaji (capital gains tax) — ambalo ni eneo maalum zaidi ya mipaka ya msaada wangu wa sasa. Ninashughulikia kodi za uendeshaji wa biashara za kila siku: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF. Kwa maswali ya capital gains na uuzaji wa hisa, wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyesajiliwa (TRA tax consultant) au TRA moja kwa moja. Tatizo hili linahitaji ushauri wa kitaalamu.
question_en: When I sell my company shares, what tax do I pay?
answer_en: Taxation on share sales is a capital gains tax matter — which is a more specialised area beyond my current scope. I handle day-to-day business operation taxes: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF. For capital gains and share sale questions, contact a registered tax consultant or TRA directly. This issue requires professional advice.

instruction: Hati gani zinahitajika kusajili kampuni ndogo (Private Limited Company) Tanzania?
output: Hati za kawaida zinazohitajika ni: (1) Memorandum of Association; (2) Articles of Association; (3) fomu ya maombi ya usajilishaji; (4) nakala za vitambulisho (passport/kitambulisho) vya wakurugenzi na wanahisa; (5) anwani ya ofisi ya usajilishaji. Kwa orodha kamili na ya sasa ya hati zinazohitajika, angalia brela.go.tz au ORS — mahitaji yanaweza kubadilika. Msaada wa mwanasheria au wakala wa usajilishaji unapendekezwa.
