question_sw: Malipo ya pango la nyumba ya kampuni kwa mkurugenzi wake ni gharama ya biashara inayopunguzwa kodi — hakuna vizuizi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Kwa kiasi fulani. Pango la makazi la mkurugenzi linaweza kudaiwa kama gharama ya biashara ikiwa makazi yanatolewa kama sehemu ya mkataba wa ajira na inahusiana moja kwa moja na biashara. Hata hivyo, thamani ya makazi haya lazima ijumuishwe kwenye kipato cha mkurugenzi kwa PAYE (kama manufaa ya nje ya fedha). Mkurugenzi analipa PAYE kwenye thamani ya makazi; kampuni inadai gharama — lakini si 'bure' kwa kodi.
question_en: A company paying its director's home rent is a fully deductible business expense with no restrictions — is this correct?
answer_en: Partially. Director accommodation rent can be claimed as a business expense if accommodation is provided as part of the employment contract and is directly connected to the business. However, the value of this accommodation must be included in the director's income for PAYE purposes (as a non-cash benefit). The director pays PAYE on the accommodation value; the company claims the expense — but it is not 'tax-free' overall.

instruction: Mwajiri wangu analipa chini ya kiwango cha GN605A. Naweza mfanyabiashara wangu nini kisheria?
output: Ndiyo, una haki. Mwajiri anapaswa kulipa angalau kiwango cha chini cha sekta yako kulingana na GN605A tangu Januari 2026. Hatua unazoweza chukua: (1) toa malalamiko kwa Ofisi ya Kazi ya wilaya yako (Ministry of Labour); (2) omba malipo yaliyobaki (backpay) tangu Januari 2026; (3) unaweza pia kuomba msaada wa Bodi ya Usuluhishi wa Migogoro ya Kazi (CMA). Haki yako inalindwa kisheria.

question_sw: EFD ya biashara moja inaweza kutumika kwa biashara nyingine ya mwenye biashara huyo huyo Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kila EFD machine inasajiliwa kwa biashara MAALUM na TIN yake mahususi. EFD iliyosajiliwa kwa biashara moja haiwezi kutumika kisheria kwa biashara nyingine, hata kama mwenye biashara ni mtu mmoja. Kila biashara lazima iwe na EFD yake iliyosajiliwa kwa TIN yake mwenyewe.
question_en: Can an EFD machine for one business be used for another business owned by the same person in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Each EFD machine is registered to a SPECIFIC business and its particular TIN. An EFD registered for one business cannot legally be used for another business, even if the same person owns both. Each business must have its own EFD registered to its own TIN.

instruction: SDL na WCF — vinalipwa kwa wakati mmoja au tofauti?
output: SDL na WCF vinalipwa wakati tofauti kwa taasisi tofauti: SDL (→ TRA): tarehe ya mwisho ni 7 ya mwezi unaofuata mwezi wa malipo ya wafanyakazi. Inalipwa pamoja na PAYE kwa kawaida katika kujaza fomu ya TRA. WCF (→ WCF Authority): malipo yanaweza kufanywa kwa mwezi, robo ya mwaka, nusu ya mwaka, au mwaka mzima — kwa idhini ya WCF. Kwa kawaida inalipwa mwezi mzima. Zinatumia fomu tofauti, portals tofauti, na taasisi tofauti. Kampuni nyingi zinaweka ratiba maalum: 7th (SDL+PAYE kwa TRA), na tofauti kwa WCF. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na WCF (wcf.go.tz).

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina wafanyakazi wanaolipwa kwa wakati na wanaolipwa kwa kipande — wote wanalipwa NSSF?
output: Kwa ujumla, wafanyakazi wote wanaoajiriwa na kampuni — iwe wanalipwa kwa wakati au kwa kipande — wana haki ya NSSF. Msingi wa hesabu ni malipo halisi wanayopokea. Kwa hali maalum ya aina tofauti za malipo na jinsi ya kuhesabu NSSF, thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.or.tz) au mshauri wa HR ili kuhakikisha unazingatia sheria vizuri.

question_sw: Ninasikia PAYE inabadilika kila mwaka — kanda za sasa ni zipi?
answer_sw: Kanda za PAYE za sasa kwa mwezi ni: asilimia 0 (hadi Shilingi 270,000), asilimia 8 (Shilingi 270,001 hadi 520,000), asilimia 20 (Shilingi 520,001 hadi 760,000), asilimia 25 (Shilingi 760,001 hadi 1,000,000), na asilimia 30 (zaidi ya Shilingi 1,000,000). Hizi ndizo kanda za Finance Act ya sasa.
question_en: I hear PAYE changes every year — what are the current bands?
answer_en: The current monthly PAYE bands are: 0% (up to TZS 270,000), 8% (TZS 270,001 to 520,000), 20% (TZS 520,001 to 760,000), 25% (TZS 760,001 to 1,000,000), and 30% (above TZS 1,000,000). These are the current Finance Act bands.

instruction: Wafanyakazi wangu Zanzibar wanalipa PAYE — ni sawa na Bara au kuna tofauti?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. PAYE na mifumo ya kodi ya mshahara kwa Zanzibar inashughulikiwa chini ya sheria za ZRB — mimi ninashughulikia PAYE ya Tanzania Bara tu. Kwa Zanzibar wasiliana na ZRB. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, GN 487A inaathiri Watanzania wa diaspora waliozaliwa nje ya nchi?
answer_sw: GN 487A inahusu watu 'wasio raia wa Tanzania' — yaani watu ambao hawana uraia wa Tanzania kisheria. Mtanzania wa diaspora aliyezaliwa nje ya nchi lakini akiwa na pasipoti ya Tanzania na uraia wa Tanzania hawathiriwi na GN 487A — anachukuliwa kama raia wa Tanzania. Hata hivyo, kama mtu ana uraia wa nchi mbili (dual citizenship) na Tanzania hairuhusu uraia wa nchi mbili, hali yake ya kisheria inaweza kuwa ngumu. Watu walio na maswali kuhusu hali yao ya uraia wanapaswa kuwasiliana na Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani au wakili wa uhamiaji.
question_en: Does GN 487A affect Tanzanians in the diaspora who were born outside the country?
answer_en: GN 487A applies to persons 'who are not Tanzanian citizens' — that is, people who do not legally hold Tanzanian citizenship. A Tanzanian in the diaspora who was born abroad but holds a Tanzanian passport and citizenship is not affected by GN 487A — they are treated as a Tanzanian citizen. However, if a person holds dual citizenship and Tanzania does not recognise dual citizenship, their legal situation may be complex. Those with questions about their citizenship status should contact the Ministry of Home Affairs or an immigration lawyer.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: NSSF inalipwa kwa njia gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: NSSF inalipwa kupitia mfumo wa GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway). Mwajiri analazimika pia kutoa nyaraka za usaidizi (fomu NSSF/CON.05) kwenye ofisi ya NSSF mara tu baada ya malipo — kwa utoaji wa kimwili au njia ya kielektroniki. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How is NSSF paid in Tanzania?
answer_en: NSSF is paid through the GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) system. The employer must also submit supporting documents (NSSF/CON.05 form) to the NSSF office immediately after payment — by physical delivery or electronic means. Confirm with NSSF.

instruction: Nikiwa sijasajiliwa VAT lakini ninatoza wateja VAT kwenye invoice — ni tatizo?
output: Ndiyo, hii ni tatizo kubwa sana. Kutoza VAT bila kuwa na usajilishaji wa VAT ni kosa la kisheria. TRA inaweza: (1) kuamrisha ulipe faini; (2) kukufanya ulipe kodi yote uliyokusanya bila ruhusa; (3) kufungua kesi dhidi yako. Ikiwa umekusanya VAT bila usajilishaji, acha mara moja na wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi na TRA (tra.go.tz) kukusaidia kurekebisha hali.

question_sw: Nina mahindi kutoka Tanzania yanayokwenda Kenya — mahindi yote ya Tanzania yanapata STR?
answer_sw: Lazima masharti mawili yakidhiwe. Kwanza: mahindi lazima yawe kwenye Common List — ndiyo, mahindi kwa ujumla yako. Pili: mahindi lazima yathibitishwe kuzalishwa Tanzania (originating status) kupitia SCO. Kama masharti yote mawili yanakidhiwa na thamani haitazidi USD 2,000, basi unapata manufaa ya STR.
question_en: I have Tanzanian maize going to Kenya — do all Tanzanian maize get STR benefits?
answer_en: Two conditions must both be met. First: maize must be on the Common List — yes, maize is generally on it. Second: maize must be certified as produced in Tanzania (originating status) via an SCO. If both conditions are met and value does not exceed USD 2,000, then you get STR benefits.

question_sw: Je, mwajiri anaweza kupunguza gharama za NSSF kutoka kodi ya mapato ya makampuni?
answer_sw: Michango ya NSSF ya mwajiri kwa kawaida inaweza kuchukuliwa kama gharama inayopunguzwa kwa kodi ya mapato ya makampuni — lakini masharti maalum yanategemea sheria ya kodi ya Tanzania na muundo wa malipo. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi wa kodi ya makampuni au TRA.
question_en: Can an employer deduct NSSF contributions from corporate income tax?
answer_en: Employer NSSF contributions can generally be treated as a deductible expense for corporate income tax purposes — but specific conditions depend on Tanzania's corporate tax law and payment structure. Verify with a corporate tax advisor or TRA.

question_sw: Matumizi ya chakula cha ofisi na burudani za wateja (entertainment) yanaweza kudaiwa kikamilifu kama gharama ya biashara Tanzania — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Si kweli kabisa. Gharama za burudani (entertainment) zinaweza kupunguzwa kwa kiasi tu Tanzania — TRA ina mipaka kwenye gharama za burudani za wateja. Chakula cha ofisi cha kawaida kwa wafanyakazi kinaweza kuruhusiwa zaidi, lakini chakula cha anasa na matumizi ya burudani ya wateja yanazungumziwa zaidi na TRA. Daima hifadhi nyaraka na ufafanuzi wa madhumuni ya biashara.
question_en: Office food expenses and client entertainment can be fully claimed as Tanzania business expenses — is this correct?
answer_en: Not entirely true. Entertainment expenses may only be partially deductible in Tanzania — TRA has limits on client entertainment expenses. Regular office food for employees may be more permissible, but luxury entertainment and client hospitality are more closely scrutinised by TRA. Always keep documentation and business purpose explanations.

question_sw: Jinsi ya kuhesabu gross-up ya PAYE — mfano rahisi.
answer_sw: Mfano rahisi: Mfanyakazi anahitaji net TZS 1,000,000 baada ya PAYE ya 25%. Gross-up = Net ÷ (1 - kiwango cha kodi) = TZS 1,000,000 ÷ 0.75 = TZS 1,333,333 gross. PAYE = TZS 1,333,333 × 25% = TZS 333,333. Net = TZS 1,333,333 - TZS 333,333 = TZS 1,000,000. Kwa viwango vya Tanzania vya juu, mahesabu yanakuwa ngumu zaidi kwa sababu ya viwango vya kujiendelea (progressive bands). Tumia mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: How to calculate PAYE gross-up — a simple example.
answer_en: Simple example: Employee needs net TZS 1,000,000 after 25% PAYE. Gross-up = Net ÷ (1 - tax rate) = TZS 1,000,000 ÷ 0.75 = TZS 1,333,333 gross. PAYE = TZS 1,333,333 × 25% = TZS 333,333. Net = TZS 1,333,333 - TZS 333,333 = TZS 1,000,000. For Tanzania's higher progressive bands, calculations become more complex. Use a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Bodi ya Rufaa za Mapato ya Kodi (Tax Revenue Appeals Board — TRAB) inahusika vipi kwenye mgawanyiko wa kodi?
answer_sw: TRAB ndiyo hatua ya pili ya rufaa baada ya hoja ya pingamizi kutofanikiwa kwa Kamishna. Ikiwa Kamishna wa TRA ametoa uamuzi dhidi yako, unaweza kupiga rufaa kwa TRAB ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kupokea uamuzi wa Kamishna. Hatua ya 2: Wasilisha Maombi rasmi ya Rufaa (Statement of Appeal) kwa TRAB ndani ya siku 45 baada ya uamuzi huo huo. Hatua zote mbili ni za lazima — kukosa moja yao kunasababisha rufaa kutokubaliwa. TRAB ni mahakama ya pekee ya kodi yenye wajumbe wa mwanasheria, mtaalamu wa kodi, na mfanyabiashara. TRAB inasikia mashauri, inachunguza ushahidi, na inatoa uamuzi. Ikiwa bado hujaridhika na uamuzi wa TRAB, unaweza kwenda Mahakama ya Rufaa ya Mapato ya Kodi (Tax Revenue Appeals Tribunal).
answer_en: TRAB is the second stage of appeals after an objection to the Commissioner is unsuccessful. If the TRA Commissioner has ruled against you, you may appeal to TRAB within 30 days of receiving the Commissioner's decision. Step 2: Lodge the formal Statement of Appeal with TRAB within 45 days of the same Commissioner decision. Both steps are mandatory — missing either step causes the appeal to be inadmissible. TRAB is a specialised tax court comprising a legal member, a tax expert, and a business representative. TRAB hears submissions, examines evidence, and issues a ruling. If still unsatisfied with TRAB's decision, you may proceed to the Tax Revenue Appeals Tribunal.
question_en: How does the Tax Revenue Appeals Board (TRAB) fit into a tax dispute?

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina fiscal year inayoishia Desemba 31 — annual return BRELA inapaswa kuwasilishwa lini?
output: Hakuna tarehe maalum ya 30 Septemba kwa annual returns za BRELA — tarehe inategemea tarehe ya usajili wa kampuni yako. Annual return inapaswa kuwasilishwa kulingana na tarehe ya kumbukumbu ya usajili wa kampuni yako (anniversary date) — si lazima mwaka wa kifedha. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kwa tarehe yako halisi. Kwa kampuni zenye fiscal year inayoishia Desemba 31, tarehe ya kuwasilisha annual return inategemea tarehe ya usajili wako na kanuni za BRELA — si Septemba 30. Thibitisha na brela.go.tz au ofisi ya BRELA.

question_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa mshahara ghafi (gross wage) au mshahara wa msingi (basic salary)?
answer_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa mshahara ghafi (gross wage) — si mshahara wa msingi peke yake. Mshahara ghafi unajumuisha mishahara yote ya lazima kabla ya makato yoyote. Thibitisha ufafanuzi kamili wa 'mshahara wa jumla' na NSSF.
question_en: Is NSSF calculated on gross wage or basic salary in Tanzania?
answer_en: NSSF is calculated on gross wage — not basic salary alone. Gross wage includes all compulsory remuneration before any deductions. Confirm the full definition of 'total wage' with NSSF.

question_sw: Gari la biashara lililonunuliwa kampuni — input VAT yake inaweza kudaiwa?
answer_sw: Inategemea matumizi ya gari. Magari yanayotumika kwa biashara (transport ya biashara, delivery vans, lorries) — input VAT yake kwa ujumla inaweza kudaiwa. Magari ya abiria (passenger cars) yanayotumika kwa wasimamizi binafsi — mara nyingi hayadaiwi input VAT Tanzania. TRA ina kanuni maalum kuhusu madai ya input VAT kwa magari — thibitisha na mshauri.
question_en: A company car purchased by the company — can input VAT be claimed?
answer_en: It depends on the vehicle's use. Vehicles used for business purposes (business transport, delivery vans, lorries) — input VAT can generally be claimed. Passenger cars used by individual executives — often input VAT is not claimable in Tanzania. TRA has specific rules on vehicle input VAT claims — verify with an advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

instruction: Thamani ya ardhi kwa madhumuni ya kodi — nani anaithamini Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Uthamini rasmi wa ardhi na mali isiyohamika (land valuation) Tanzania unafanywa na wathamini walioidhinishwa na Wizara ya Ardhi — hii iko nje ya wigo wangu wa VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants. Wasiliana na Wizara ya Ardhi, TRA, au mtathmini wa ardhi (Certified Valuer) aliyehitimu kwa jibu sahihi.

instruction: Mwezi uliopita nilikawia kulipa PAYE lakini nikalipa SDL kwa wakati — je, hii inaonekana vizuri kwa TRA?
output: Hapana — hali hii inaonyesha tatizo la utiifu. SDL na PAYE zote mbili zinatakiwa kuwasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata — tarehe moja, si mbili tofauti. Kwa kuwa PAYE hazijalipwa, unakabiliwa na faini na riba kwa PAYE iliyochelewa — haijalishi kwamba SDL umelipa. TRA inategemea malipo kamili ya kodi zote siku moja. Lipa PAYE iliyobaki haraka iwezekanavyo na thibitisha faini inayostahili na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kampuni ina tawi Dar es Salaam (wafanyakazi 6) na tawi Mwanza (wafanyakazi 5). Je, SDL inahesabiwaje?
answer_sw: Jumla ya wafanyakazi wote: 6 + 5 = 11, yaani inazidi kiwango cha chini cha 10. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — inahesabiwi kwa msingi wa jumla ya mishahara ya kampuni nzima (matawi yote), si kwa tawi moja moja. Thibisha na TRA jinsi ya kuwasilisha SDL kwa kampuni yenye matawi mengi.
question_en: A company has a Dar es Salaam branch (6 employees) and a Mwanza branch (5 employees). How is SDL calculated?
answer_en: Total workforce across all branches: 6 + 5 = 11, which exceeds the threshold of 10. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — is calculated on the company's total payroll (all branches combined), not branch by branch. Confirm with TRA how to remit SDL for a company with multiple branches.

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari: bendi TANO za PAYE Tanzania kwa 2025/2026 — zitaje kwa usahihi kamili.
answer_sw: Bendi TANO za PAYE Tanzania 2025/2026 — sahihi kamili: (1) TZS 0 hadi 270,000 = 0%; (2) TZS 270,001 hadi 520,000 = 8% (MUHIMU: si 9%); (3) TZS 520,001 hadi 760,000 = 20%; (4) TZS 760,001 hadi 1,000,000 = 25%; (5) Zaidi ya TZS 1,000,000 = 30%. Kizingiti cha mapato yasiyotozwa kodi: TZS 3,240,000/mwaka (TZS 270,000/mwezi kwa 0% — imejengwa ndani ya Bendi 1, hakuna punguzo tofauti la kila mwezi). kwa mwezi. Kodi ya bendi inahusu sehemu ya mapato ndani ya bendi hiyo tu — si mshahara wote. Kwa mahesabu ya mshahara mahususi: tumia TRA IDRAS (taidras.tra.go.tz).
question_en: Summary: the FIVE PAYE bands for Tanzania 2025/2026 — state them with complete accuracy.
answer_en: FIVE PAYE bands for Tanzania 2025/2026 — complete accuracy: (1) TZS 0 to 270,000 = 0%; (2) TZS 270,001 to 520,000 = 8% (IMPORTANT: not 9%); (3) TZS 520,001 to 760,000 = 20%; (4) TZS 760,001 to 1,000,000 = 25%; (5) Above TZS 1,000,000 = 30%. Annual tax-free threshold: TZS 3,240,000/year (TZS 270,000/month at 0% — built into Band 1, no separate monthly relief). per month. Band tax applies to the portion of income within that band only — not the full salary. For specific salary calculations: use TRA IDRAS (taidras.tra.go.tz).
