question_sw: Je, withholding ya VAT kwa bidhaa ni asilimia 3 au asilimia 6?
answer_sw: Withholding ya VAT kwa bidhaa ni asilimia 3, na kwa huduma ni asilimia 6 — kuanzia 1 Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). VAT ya jumla inabaki asilimia 18. Manunuzi wanaopewa leseni ya kuzuia VAT wanazuia sehemu hii na kuipeleka TRA, na msambazaji analipwa kilichobaki. Kumbuka: kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT Tanzania ni asilimia 18 tu — si asilimia 3 wala 6.
question_en: Is VAT withholding on goods 3% or 6%?
answer_en: VAT withholding on goods is 3%, and on services is 6% — effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Total VAT remains 18%. Designated withholding agents withhold this portion and remit it to TRA, with the supplier receiving the balance. Note: the standard VAT rate in Tanzania is 18% only — not 3% or 6%.

question_sw: Hisa za kampuni ya Tanzania zinaweza kumilikiwa na watu wa kigeni — je, kuna vizuizi?
answer_sw: Kwa kampuni za kawaida za Tanzania, watu wa kigeni wanaweza kumiliki hisa. Hata hivyo, kuna vizuizi katika sekta fulani kama: utalii wa mitaa (local tour operators lazima wamiliki wengi Tanzania), udanganyifu wa ardhi, na shughuli zilizoorodheshwa chini ya GN 487A. Tanzania Investment Centre (TIC) inaweza kutoa mwongozo wa kwa uwekezaji wa kigeni.
question_en: Can shares in a Tanzania company be owned by foreigners — are there restrictions?
answer_en: For standard Tanzania companies foreigners can own shares. However there are restrictions in certain sectors such as: local tour operations (majority ownership must be Tanzanian), certain land activities, and activities listed under GN 487A. The Tanzania Investment Centre (TIC) can provide guidance on foreign investment.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Biashara ya kuuza programu za simu (mobile apps) Tanzania — VAT inatumika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Uuzaji wa programu za simu kwa wateja Tanzania unashughulikiwa kama huduma ya kidijitali na unabeba VAT inayofaa. Kama kampuni imesajiliwa VAT, lazima itoe risiti za EFD na ikusanye VAT. Kwa watoa kutoka nje ya nchi, masharti yanaweza kutofautiana — thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: A business selling mobile apps in Tanzania — does VAT apply?
answer_en: Yes. Selling mobile apps to Tanzanian customers is treated as a digital service and carries applicable VAT. If the company is VAT-registered, it must issue EFD receipts and collect VAT. For foreign-based providers, requirements may differ — verify with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

instruction: SDL base inajumuisha bonasi za mwisho wa mwaka — je, au haijumuishi?
output: Bonasi za mwisho wa mwaka (year-end bonuses) ambazo ZINATOLEWA KWA FEDHA (cash) zinaingia katika SDL base kwa mwezi zinalipwa. SDL inakusanywa kwa malipo ya fedha yote ya wafanyakazi — ikiwa ni pamoja na mshahara wa msingi, posho za fedha, na bonasi za fedha. Kwa hivyo: mwezi Desemba au Januari unapolipa bonasi ya TZS 500,000 kwa kila mfanyakazi wa 10+ — bonasi hiyo inaongeza SDL base ya mwezi huo. SDL inakuwa 3.5% ya jumla ya mishahara + bonasi kwa mwezi huo. Hiyo inaweza kuifanya SDL ya Desemba kuwa kubwa zaidi kuliko miezi mingine. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Kampuni ya Tanzania inanunua programu (software license) kutoka kampuni ya nje ya nchi — kuna withholding yoyote?
output: Malipo ya software license kwa kampuni ya kigeni yanaweza kuhusisha: (1) WHT (Withholding Tax) ya 15% kwa royalties — software licenses zinaweza kuchukuliwa royalties kisheria; (2) VAT withholding ya 6% kwa huduma — kama programu ni huduma ya kidijitali inayotolewa na mtu anayehitimu. Kwa kampuni ya Tanzania inayolipa kampuni ya kigeni: Ikiwa kampuni ya kigeni ina daftari la TRA — kawaida mfumo wa kawaida wa VAT unatumika. Ikiwa kampuni ya kigeni haina daftari la TRA — unaweza kulazimika kukaa na mfumo wa 'reverse charge' au withholding. Mada hii ni ngumu — thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na mshauri wa kodi wa kimataifa.

question_sw: Kampuni inayopitia muundo mpya (restructuring) ambapo ardhi inahamishwa kwa kampuni mpya — ushuru wa stempu unaepukika?
answer_sw: Uhamishaji wa ardhi ndani ya muundo wa kikundi (group restructuring) Tanzania kwa kawaida HAUKEPUKI ushuru wa stempu wa asilimia 1. Hata kama ni muundo wa ndani tu wa kikundi kimoja, uhamishaji wa hati za kisheria za ardhi bado una ushuru wa stempu Tanzania. Uchunguze kwa kina na mwanasheria wa kodi na mwanasheria wa mali kabla ya muundo wowote.
question_en: A company undergoing restructuring where land is transferred to a new company — can stamp duty be avoided?
answer_en: Land transfer within a group restructuring in Tanzania generally does NOT avoid the 1% stamp duty. Even if it is purely an internal group restructuring, the transfer of legal land instruments still attracts Tanzania stamp duty. Investigate thoroughly with a tax lawyer and property lawyer before any restructuring.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or company restructuring law update

question_sw: Mwajiri wa nje ya nchi anayetuma mfanyakazi Tanzania — analazimika kujisajili TRA kwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Hili ni swali ngumu la kisheria. Kama mwajiri wa nje hana uhalali wa kibiashara Tanzania (PE - Permanent Establishment), anaweza asihitajike kujisajili TRA. Hata hivyo, kama mwajiri ana uwepo Tanzania, usajili wa PAYE unaweza kutumika. Thibitisha hali yako maalum na TRA au mshauri wa kodi wa kimataifa.
question_en: A foreign employer sending employees to Tanzania — do they need to register with TRA for PAYE?
answer_en: This is a complex legal question. If the foreign employer has no Tanzanian business presence (PE - Permanent Establishment), they may not need to register with TRA. However, if the employer has a presence in Tanzania, PAYE registration may apply. Confirm your specific situation with TRA or an international tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: WHT haihitajiki kwa malipo ya chini ya Shilingi 500,000 — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Hakuna kizingiti cha chini cha kisheria cha kiasi cha malipo kinachomwondolea mwajiri wajibu wa WHT. Malipo yoyote yanayotoza WHT — iwe madogo au makubwa — yanatakiwa WHT. Kizingiti cha Shilingi 500,000 hakipo chini ya sheria ya WHT ya Tanzania.
question_en: WHT is not required for payments below TZS 500,000 — is this true?
answer_en: No. There is no statutory minimum payment threshold that exempts a payer from WHT. Any payment subject to WHT — large or small — requires WHT deduction. A threshold of TZS 500,000 does not exist under Tanzania's WHT law.

question_sw: Mshahara wa chini kwa sekta ya umma ni Shilingi ngapi?
answer_sw: Kwa sekta ya umma, Rais Samia alitangaza mshahara wa chini wa Shilingi 500,000 kwa mwezi kuanzia Julai 2025. Hii ni tofauti kabisa na GN 605A ambayo inashughulikia sekta binafsi.
question_en: What is the minimum wage for the public sector?
answer_en: For the public sector, President Samia announced a minimum wage of TZS 500,000 per month effective July 2025. This is separate from GN 605A which governs the private sector.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: SDL na PAYE zinawasilishwa TRA kwa wakati mmoja — au kuna tarehe tofauti mbili?
output: Zinawasilishwa KWA WAKATI MMOJA — si tarehe tofauti. SDL na PAYE zote mbili zinawasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Mfano: SDL na PAYE za Januari zinawasilishwa ifikapo 7 Februari. Hakuna siku tofauti kwa SDL na siku nyingine kwa PAYE — zinawasilishwa pamoja siku moja. Thibitisha tarehe hii na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz kwani inaweza kubadilika.

instruction: Ninanunua mitambo (machinery) kwa kampuni yangu — stamp duty inatumika kwenye mkataba wa ununuzi?
output: Mikataba ya ununuzi wa mitambo na bidhaa inaweza kuwa na wajibu wa stamp duty chini ya Stamp Duty Act Tanzania kulingana na aina ya hati na thamani yake. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa kiwango halisi na aina za mikataba inayostahili au kusamehewa stamp duty. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Mgeni ana investment permit ya TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) — je, amesamehewa GN 487A?
output: Investment permit ya TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) inamruhusu mgeni kuwekeza katika sekta maalum zilizoidhinishwa na TIC kama viwanda, kilimo, utalii, madini, na kadhalika. Hata hivyo, investment permit ya TIC haizungumziwi moja kwa moja kama msamaha wa GN 487A kwa shughuli zilizo katika orodha ya 15. Kwa biashara ya rejareja, saluni, ukarabati wa simu, na shughuli nyingine 15 — hata na investment permit ya TIC — mgeni anakabiliwa na vikwazo vya GN 487A. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na TIC (tic.go.tz) kwa hali yako maalum.

instruction: Ninataka kulinda nembo ya biashara yangu (logo) — ninapaswa kwenda wapi?
output: Ulinzi wa nembo (logo) unaweza kufanywa kwa njia mbili — inategemea aina ya ulinzi unaouhitaji: TRADEMARK (alama ya biashara) — BRELA: kama unataka kulinda nembo yako dhidi ya wengine kuitumia biashara, usajili wa trademark kwa BRELA ndiyo njia sahihi. Hii inakupa haki ya kipekee ya kutumia nembo hiyo kibiashara Tanzania. COPYRIGHT — COSOTA: kama nembo ni kazi ya kisanaa ya asili, inaweza kulindwa pia kwa copyright (bila usajili rasmi). Kwa biashara, trademark (BRELA) hutoa ulinzi bora na wa kisheria dhidi ya washindani. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

question_sw: Wafanyabiashara wa mpakani (cross-border traders) Tunduma wana mahitaji gani ya uzingatiaji Tanzania?
answer_sw: Mfanyabiashara wa mpakani Tunduma-Nakonde anahitaji kuzingatia: (1) TIN ya TRA kwa biashara yake Tanzania, (2) Hati za forodha (customs documentation) za TANZRA/TRA — ikiwa ni pamoja na invoice ya biashara, packing list, na hati ya asili ya bidhaa, (3) EAC STR (Simplified Trade Regime) inaweza kutumika ikiwa bidhaa ziko kwenye orodha ya kawaida na kiasi ni chini ya USD 2,000, (4) Leseni ya biashara ya LGA ya Tunduma. Angalia KRA/ZRA kwa biashara ya upande wa Kenya/Zambia.
question_en: What compliance requirements do cross-border traders at Tunduma have in Tanzania?
answer_en: A Tunduma-Nakonde cross-border trader needs to comply with: (1) TRA TIN for their Tanzania business, (2) customs documentation for TANZRA/TRA — including commercial invoice, packing list, and certificate of origin, (3) EAC STR (Simplified Trade Regime) may apply if goods are on the common list and amount is below USD 2,000, (4) Tunduma LGA business licence. Check KRA/ZRA for Kenya/Zambia side requirements.
next_review_trigger: EAC STR or customs procedure update

question_sw: SDL inahitajika kuanzia wafanyakazi wangapi — 5 au 10?
answer_sw: SDL inahitajika kuanzia wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi — si 5. Mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi 9 au chini yake hajalazimishwa kulipa SDL. Ukifika wafanyakazi 10, SDL inakuwa lazima tangu mwezi huo huo.
question_en: SDL is required from how many employees — 5 or 10?
answer_en: SDL is required from 10 or more employees — not 5. An employer with 9 or fewer employees is not required to pay SDL. Once you reach 10 employees, SDL becomes mandatory from that same month.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Ninaajiri watu 5 wa nusu muda. Je, NSSF inatumika kwao?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wafanyakazi 5 wa nusu muda wanaolipwa mishahara wanalazimika kulipwa NSSF. Kiwango: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla wa kila mfanyakazi. Hata hivyo, kama wote 5 ni wa nusu muda na hauna wafanyakazi wengine, huhitajiwi SDL kwa sababu una wafanyakazi chini ya 10 (SDL inahitaji wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi). NSSF inatumika bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi.
question_en: I employ 5 part-time workers. Does NSSF apply to them?
answer_en: Yes. 5 part-time workers who receive wages must have NSSF paid for them. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of each employee's gross wage. However, if all 5 are part-time and you have no other employees, you are not required to pay SDL because you have fewer than 10 employees (SDL requires 10 or more). NSSF applies regardless of the number of employees.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu inalipa mishahara ya jumla ya TZS 5,000,000 kwa mwezi kwa wafanyakazi 15. SDL ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara. Hesabu: TZS 5,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi. Hii inalipwa na mwajiri peke yake — haikatwi kutoka mshahara. Iwasilishwe TRA ifikapo siku ya 7 ya mwezi unaofuata, pamoja na PAYE.
question_en: My company pays total monthly wages of TZS 5,000,000 to 15 employees. How much is SDL?
answer_en: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — is 3.5% of total payroll. Calculation: TZS 5,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 175,000 per month. This is paid by the employer only — not deducted from salaries. Remit to TRA by the 7th of the following month, together with PAYE.

question_sw: Nina bidhaa zinazozalishwa Tanzania lakini hazipo kwenye Common List — ninaweza kutumia STR?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ingawa bidhaa zako zinazalishwa Tanzania (originating status ✓), kama hazipo kwenye Common List, hazistahili manufaa ya STR. Lazima masharti yote mawili yakidhiwe. Kwa bidhaa zisizopo kwenye Common List, utaratibu wa kawaida wa forodha na ushuru unaotumika.
question_en: I have goods produced in Tanzania but not on the Common List — can I use STR?
answer_en: No. Although your goods are produced in Tanzania (originating status ✓), if they are not on the Common List, they do not qualify for STR benefits. Both conditions must be met. For goods not on the Common List, the standard customs process and applicable duties apply.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

instruction: Biashara yangu ya hoteli — EFD inatumika kwa bili za vyumba tu au chakula pia?
output: EFD inatumika kwa KILA MUAMALA wa biashara — bili za vyumba, chakula, vinywaji, laundry, parking, na huduma zozote za ziada. Hakuna msamaha kwa aina fulani ya huduma ndani ya hoteli moja. Hoteli inahitaji kuhakikisha: (1) EFD inatoa risiti kwa kila bili ya chumba; (2) Migahawa na baa ndani ya hoteli zinatoa risiti za EFD kwa chakula na vinywaji; (3) Huduma za ziada (spa, gym, conference) zinatoa risiti pia. Bila shaka, hoteli zinatoa invoice kubwa kwa makampuni na watu binafsi — hizi lazima ziwe tax invoices za EFD. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mgeni ana mkoba wa pesa anayoikopesha watu kijijini kama mfumo wa SACCOS — GN 487A inamhusu?
answer_sw: Inaweza kuumhusu. Kama mgeni anafanya shughuli za ukopeshaji (micro-lending) kwa ujumla — hasa kama inafanana na huduma za kifedha rasmi — inaweza kuchukuliwa kama sehemu ya makundi yaliyozuiliwa au kuanguka chini ya sheria nyingine za fedha. Huduma za uhamisho wa pesa kwa simu zimezuiliwa wazi, lakini ukopeshaji wa pesa unaweza kuhitaji leseni ya BoT. Kama mkoba huo unafanya kazi kama SACCOS rasmi, mgeni anahitaji kushauriana na Wakala wa Usimamizi wa Vyama vya Ushirika (COASCO) na wakili wa kisheria ili kuelewa kikamilifu.
question_en: A non-citizen has a money lending system in the village similar to a SACCOS — does GN 487A affect them?
answer_en: It may affect them. If a non-citizen is conducting general money lending activities — especially if it resembles formal financial services — it may fall under the prohibited categories or other financial laws. Mobile money transfer services are explicitly prohibited, and money lending may require a BoT licence. If the lending operates as a formal SACCOS, the non-citizen needs to consult COASCO (Cooperative Societies) and a legal adviser to fully understand their obligations.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Wafanyakazi wa muda mfupi (casual workers) wanalipa NSSF Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wafanyakazi wanaolipwa mishahara, ikiwemo casual workers, wanastahili kulipa NSSF. Kiwango: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Msingi wa hesabu ni mshahara mkubwa wa jumla (gross wage) — si mshahara wa msingi (basic salary). Tarehe ya mwisho wa malipo: ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara.
question_en: Do casual workers pay NSSF in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Workers who receive wages, including casual workers, are eligible to contribute to NSSF. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. The calculation base is total gross wage — not basic salary. Payment deadline: within one month after the salary month.

question_sw: Kampuni inalijaza return ya kodi ya mapato kwenye mfumo gani wa TRA?
answer_sw: Kampuni inawasilisha return ya kodi ya mapato kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa TRA unaojulikana kama IDRAS (Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System) au mfumo wake wa kibinafsi wa TRA e-filing. Kampuni lazima iwe na TIN iliyosajiliwa na akaunti ya IDRAS. Baada ya kujaza return mtandaoni, malipo yanafanywa kupitia GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) — benki au simu za pesa zinazoungana na mfumo huu. Epuka kuwasilisha kwa karatasi kwa sababu TRA inasisitiza e-filing.
answer_en: A company submits its income tax return through TRA's online system known as IDRAS (Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System) or TRA's own e-filing platform. The company must have a registered TIN and an IDRAS account. After completing the online return, payment is made via GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) — banks or mobile money services connected to this system. Avoid paper filing as TRA emphasises e-filing.
question_en: Through which TRA system does a company file its income tax return?

question_sw: Kiwango cha WCF ni kiasi gani cha mishahara yangu?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya jumla (gross wages) ya wafanyakazi wote. Kwa mfano, kama jumla ya mishahara yako ya mwezi ni TZS milioni 10, WCF itakuwa TZS 50,000. WCF inalipwa na mwajiri — haikatwi kwa mfanyakazi. Thibitisha kiwango cha sasa na Mamlaka ya WCF.
question_en: What percentage of my payroll is WCF?
answer_en: The WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) rate is 0.5% of the total gross wages of all employees. For example, if your total monthly payroll is TZS 10 million, WCF will be TZS 50,000. WCF is paid by the employer — it is not deducted from the employee's salary. Confirm the current rate with the WCF Authority.

question_sw: Adhabu ya msaidizi ni laini sana — TZS 5M tu. Je, hii inamaanisha kuwa msaada wa wageni si kosa kubwa?
answer_sw: Ingawa adhabu ya msaidizi ni ndogo kuliko ya mgeni, bado ni kosa kubwa la kisheria. Faini ya hadi TZS 5M AU miezi 3 jela ni adhabu nzito. Aidha, kumbuka kwamba mashitaka yanaweza kuwa ya jinai (criminal) ambayo yataathiri historia ya msaidizi na kazi yake ya siku zijazo. Msaidizi anaweza pia kupoteza leseni yake ya biashara kama korti itaona inafaa.
question_en: The facilitator's penalty seems light — only TZS 5M. Does this mean helping non-citizens is not a serious offence?
answer_en: Although the facilitator's penalty is smaller than the non-citizen's, it remains a serious criminal offence. A fine of up to TZS 5M OR 3 months' imprisonment is a significant punishment. Moreover, the charges may be criminal in nature which will affect the facilitator's record and future employment. A facilitator may also lose their business licence if the court sees fit.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: BRELA na TRA ni mashirika sawa — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) na TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority) ni mashirika tofauti yanayofanya kazi tofauti. BRELA inasajili kampuni na biashara. TRA inakusanya kodi. Kusajili na BRELA hakutoi TIN — lazima usajili kwa TRA tofauti kupata TIN.
question_en: BRELA and TRA are the same organisation — is this true?
answer_en: No. BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) and TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority) are separate organisations with different functions. BRELA registers companies and businesses. TRA collects taxes. Registering with BRELA does not give you a TIN — you must register separately with TRA to obtain a TIN.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi kinahuishwa mara ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Vibali vya kazi Tanzania kwa kawaida vina muda wa miaka miwili na vinahuishwa kabla ya kumalizika. Mwajiri anapaswa kuomba uhuishaji angalau miezi 3 kabla ya tarehe ya kumalizika. Kushindwa kuhuisha kwa wakati kunaweza kusababisha mfanyakazi kuwa na hali ya haramu Tanzania.
question_en: How often is a work permit renewed in Tanzania?
answer_en: Tanzania work permits typically have a 2-year validity and are renewed before expiry. The employer should apply for renewal at least 3 months before the expiry date. Failure to renew on time can result in the worker becoming undocumented in Tanzania.

question_sw: Kampuni ya usafirishaji inayopeleka bidhaa Kenya — VAT yake ya mafuta ya gari inastahili refund?
answer_sw: Inategemea muundo wa biashara. Kama kampuni ya usafirishaji imesajiliwa VAT na inafanya huduma za zero-rated (usafirishaji wa nje ya nchi), input VAT ya mafuta (kama ilinunuliwa kutoka msambazaji aliyesajiliwa VAT na kupata risiti ya EFD) inaweza kudaiwa kama input VAT. Thibitisha muundo wako na mshauri wa kodi au TRA.
question_en: A transport company carrying goods to Kenya — does the VAT on its diesel qualify for refund?
answer_en: It depends on the business structure. If the transport company is VAT-registered and performs zero-rated services (international transport), input VAT on fuel (if purchased from a VAT-registered supplier with an EFD receipt) may be claimable as input VAT. Confirm your structure with a tax advisor or TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Ubia (joint venture) kati ya mgeni na Mtanzania — GN 487A inazuiwa?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ubia (joint venture au partnership) hauzui GN 487A. Raia wa kigeni ndani ya ubia bado hawezi kufanya kazi za biashara zilizo kwenye orodha ya 15 kwa niaba yake mwenyewe. Mtanzania ndiye anapaswa kuwa mmiliki mkuu na meneja wa shughuli zilizokatazwa. Muundo wa kisheria sahihi unahitajika.
question_en: A joint venture between a non-citizen and a Tanzanian — does this bypass GN 487A?
answer_en: No. A joint venture or partnership does not bypass GN 487A. The non-citizen within the partnership still cannot perform business activities on the list of 15 on their own behalf. The Tanzanian must be the primary owner and manager of the prohibited activities. Correct legal structuring is required.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutokuwasilisha taarifa ya kodi kwa TRA ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Adhabu ya kutowasilisha taarifa ya kodi (failure to file return) inategemea aina ya kodi. Kwa kawaida ni faini ya kiasi maalum au asilimia ya kodi inayodaiwa, kulingana na aina ya kodi na muda wa ucheleweshaji. Angalia Sheria ya Usimamizi wa Kodi au wasiliana na TRA kwa kiwango maalum cha aina yako ya kodi.
question_en: What is the penalty rate for not filing a tax return with TRA?
answer_en: The penalty for failure to file a tax return depends on the type of tax. It is generally a specified fixed amount or a percentage of the tax owed, depending on the tax type and duration of delay. Refer to the Tax Administration Act or contact TRA for the specific rate for your tax type.

instruction: Wateja wangu wanakataa risiti ya EFD. Je, lazima nitoe hata hivyo?
output: Ndiyo, lazima utoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala, hata kama mteja anakataa au haipendi. Wajibu wa kutoa risiti ni wa biashara — si wa mteja kukubali. Kama mteja atakataa, bado rekodi ya muamala lazima ibaki kwenye mfumo wa EFD. TRA haikusamehe kwa msingi wa mteja kukataa. Toa risiti na ieleze mteja umuhimu wake.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: SDL inafadhili nini hasa?
answer_sw: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — inafadhili mafunzo ya kitaaluma na ukuzaji wa ujuzi wa wafanyakazi nchini Tanzania, kupitia Vocational Education and Training Authority (VETA) na taasisi nyingine za mafunzo. Si kodi ya ustawi, si kodi ya huduma — ni kodi ya kukuza ujuzi hasa.
question_en: What exactly does SDL fund?
answer_en: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — funds vocational training and skills development for workers in Tanzania, through the Vocational Education and Training Authority (VETA) and other training institutions. It is not a welfare levy, not a services levy — it is specifically a skills development levy.

instruction: PAYE ya wafanyakazi wanaoajiriwa na kampuni ya EPZ Tanzania — kuna msamaha wowote?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara kwa biashara za kawaida. Matibabu ya PAYE kwa kampuni za EPZ inashughulikiwa na EPZA na TRA kwa pamoja — inahitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu, EPZA kupitia epza.go.tz, au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Hati ya mauzo iliyoandikwa vizuri bila kulipwa ushuru wa stempu bado ni hati halali ya kisheria Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana kwa ujumla. Hati inayohitaji ushuru wa stempu lakini haijalipwa inaweza kukosa nguvu ya kisheria au kukataliwi na mahakama. Hata kama hati imeandikwa vizuri — ina pande zote mbili, masharti wazi, na sahihi za kisheria — kukosa ushuru wa stempu kunaweza kuifanya hati hiyo isitekelezwe kisheria. Lipa ushuru wa stempu mara baada ya kusaini.
question_en: A well-written sale instrument without stamp duty paid is still a legally valid document in Tanzania?
answer_en: Generally no. An instrument requiring stamp duty but unpaid may lack legal force or be rejected by courts. Even if the instrument is well-written — has both parties, clear terms, and legal signatures — missing stamp duty can make the instrument unenforceable in law. Pay stamp duty promptly after signing.

instruction: Nitakayopata kama ninachelewesha annual return ya BRELA kwa mwaka mmoja ni nini?
output: Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Thibitisha ada halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz). Kabla ya hapo, wakati wowote — wasilisha sasa kuliko kuendelea kuchelewesha.

question_sw: PAYE haihusiani na SDL na NSSF — kila moja inalipwa kwa shirika tofauti kabisa — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kabisa. PAYE, SDL, na NSSF zote tatu zinahusiana na payroll ya mfanyakazi na zinashughulikia kwa wakati mmoja. PAYE inalipwa TRA, SDL inalipwa TRA, na NSSF inalipwa NSSF. Ingawa shirika la kupokea linatofautiana, mwajiri huzihesabu na kuzilipa zote kama sehemu ya mzunguko mmoja wa mishahara.
question_en: PAYE has nothing to do with SDL and NSSF — each is paid to an entirely different agency — is this true?
answer_en: Not entirely. PAYE, SDL, and NSSF are all linked to the employee payroll and handled simultaneously. PAYE goes to TRA, SDL goes to TRA, and NSSF goes to NSSF. While the receiving agency differs, the employer calculates and pays all of them as part of one payroll cycle.

question_sw: Biashara yangu inafanya mauzo ya VAT (taxable) na mauzo yasiyobeba VAT (exempt) — jinsi ya kudai input VAT?
answer_sw: Kama biashara inafanya mauzo ya aina mbili — yenye VAT (taxable) na yasio na VAT (exempt) — input VAT inagawanywa (apportioned). Gawanya input VAT kulingana na uwiano wa mauzo ya taxable kwa mauzo yote. Sehemu ya input VAT inayohusiana na mauzo ya taxable inaweza kudaiwa; sehemu inayohusiana na exempt haiwezi. Utaratibu huu unaitwa 'partial exemption' au 'apportionment'.
question_en: My business makes both VAT-taxable sales and VAT-exempt sales — how do I claim input VAT?
answer_en: When a business makes two types of sales — taxable (with VAT) and exempt (no VAT) — input VAT must be apportioned. Divide input VAT in proportion to taxable sales over total sales. The portion of input VAT relating to taxable sales can be claimed; the portion relating to exempt sales cannot. This process is called 'partial exemption' or 'apportionment'.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Je, SDL inahusiana na kodi ya usalama wa chakula au kilimo?
answer_sw: Hapana hata kidogo. SDL ni Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi — na inahusiana na ukuzaji wa ujuzi wa wafanyakazi, si kilimo wala usalama wa chakula. Inatolewa na TRA, inalipwa na waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, kwa kiwango cha asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara.
question_en: Is SDL related to food security or agricultural levies?
answer_en: Not at all. SDL is the Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi — and it concerns workforce skills development, not agriculture or food security. It is administered by TRA, paid by employers with 10 or more employees, at 3.5% of gross payroll.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana hisa za kampuni anayofanyia kazi. Anapopata hisa au dividendi — anatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Hisa zinazotolewa kama sehemu ya fidia ya ajira (employee share scheme) zinatozwa PAYE kwa thamani ya soko wakati wa kupewa. Dividendi zinazolipwa kwa hisa hizo baadaye zinatozwa kodi ya kizuizi ya 5% (kwa wakazi wa Tanzania) — si PAYE. Kwa mipango tata ya hisa au options, thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi — muda na thamani ya utozaji unaweza kutofautiana. Rekodi sahihi za thamani ya hisa ni muhimu.
answer_en: Shares granted as part of employment compensation (employee share scheme) are subject to PAYE at market value at the time of grant. Dividends paid on those shares subsequently are subject to 5% withholding tax (for Tanzania residents) — not PAYE. For complex share schemes or options, confirm with a tax consultant — the timing and value of taxation can vary. Accurate records of share values are essential.
question_en: An employee holds shares in the company they work for. When they receive shares or dividends — are they subject to PAYE?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — share schemes and dividends

question_sw: Faini ya kuchelewa kulipa NSSF Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Faini ya kuchelewa kulipa NSSF ni asilimia 5 ya kiwango kilichochelewa kwa kila mwezi au sehemu ya mwezi baada ya tarehe ya malipo. Faini inakusanywa kama deni kutoka kwa mwajiri. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: What is the penalty for late NSSF contribution payment in Tanzania?
answer_en: The late NSSF contribution penalty is 5% of the unpaid amount for each month or part of a month after the due date. The penalty is recovered as a debt from the employer. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Kampuni ya Kiingereza yenye ofisi ndogo Tanzania (branch) inalipa kodi ya kampuni Tanzania tu kwa faida inayotokana Tanzania — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa ujumla. Tawi (branch) la kampuni ya kigeni Tanzania linalipishwa kodi ya kampuni kwa faida inayohusishwa na shughuli za tawi hilo Tanzania. Kiwango cha kodi ya tawi (branch profits tax) ni asilimia 30. Faida inayobaki baada ya kodi ya kampuni na kuhamishwa nje ya nchi inaweza pia kuwa na kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 10.
question_en: A British company with a small branch in Tanzania pays Tanzania corporate tax only on profits arising in Tanzania — is this correct?
answer_en: Yes, generally. A foreign company branch in Tanzania is taxed on profits attributable to the branch's Tanzania activities. The branch profits tax rate is 30%. Profits remaining after corporate tax and repatriated abroad may also attract a 10% withholding tax.

question_sw: Ninaweza kuangalia kama jina la biashara ninalotaka liko tayari kabla ya kusajilisha?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. BRELA inakuruhusu kutafuta (search) jina la biashara kabla ya kusajilisha ili kuthibitisha kuwa halijachukuliwa tayari. Unaweza kufanya utafutaji huu kwenye tovuti ya BRELA (brela.go.tz) au kwa kutembelea ofisi yao. Baada ya kuthibitisha jina linapatikana, unaweza kuwasilisha ombi la kuhifadhi (reservation) jina hilo kabla ya kukamilisha usajilishaji. Jibu la utafutaji si dhamana — thibitisha na BRELA moja kwa moja.
question_en: Can I check if the business name I want is already taken before registering?
answer_en: Yes. BRELA allows you to search for a business name before registering to confirm it has not already been taken. You can do this search on BRELA's website (brela.go.tz) or by visiting their office. After confirming the name is available, you can apply to reserve it before completing registration. A search result is not a guarantee — confirm directly with BRELA.
next_review_trigger: When BRELA updates name search procedures

instruction: Je, SDL na mshahara wa chini wa GN605A vinaunganika vipi?
output: Vina uhusiano wa moja kwa moja: mshahara wa chini wa GN605A unabainisha malipo ya chini kabisa kwa wafanyakazi — SDL (Skills Development Levy) ya 3.5% inakokotolewa kutoka jumla ya malipo hayo halisi. Kwa mfano, kama mwajiri analipa mshahara wa TZS 175,000 (kiwango cha kilimo) kwa mfanyakazi, SDL ni 3.5% ya TZS 175,000. Viwango vya GN605A vikiongezeka, msingi wa SDL nao unaongezeka. SDL inatumika kwa wajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Je, elimu Tanzania inalipwa VAT?
answer_sw: Huduma za elimu rasmi (shule, vyuo) nyingi Tanzania zimesamehewa VAT (VAT exempt). Hii inamaanisha hazilipwi VAT, lakini taasisi ya elimu haiwezi kudai input VAT kwenye gharama zake. Mafunzo ya biashara ya biashara (commercial training) yanaweza kutozwa VAT ya asilimia 18. Angalia hali ya kila aina ya huduma ya elimu na TRA. Hakuna kiwango cha VAT cha asilimia 5 kwa elimu.
question_en: Are educational services subject to VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: Most formal educational services (schools, colleges) in Tanzania are VAT exempt. This means they are not subject to VAT, but the institution cannot claim input VAT on its costs. Commercial training services may be subject to standard 18% VAT. Check the status of each type of educational service with TRA. There is no 5% VAT rate for education.

question_sw: Duka la mtandaoni la Tanzania linauza bidhaa — EFD inahitajika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Duka la mtandaoni (e-commerce store) la Tanzania linalouza bidhaa kwa wateja Tanzania linahitaji EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) kama kampuni inastahili VAT. Kila mauzo lazima itoe risiti ya EFD. Biashara za mtandaoni hazipewi msamaha wa EFD kwa sababu ya kuwa za kidijitali.
question_en: A Tanzanian online shop selling goods — is EFD required?
answer_en: Yes. A Tanzanian e-commerce store selling goods to Tanzanian customers requires an EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) if the company is VAT-registered. Every sale must issue an EFD receipt. Online businesses are not exempt from EFD just because they are digital.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: EFD machine ya Tanzania inahitaji mtandao wa intaneti kufanya kazi?
answer_sw: EFD machines nyingi za Tanzania zinaweza kufanya kazi bila mtandao kwa muda mfupi na zinahifadhi data za muamala kwenye mashine. Lakini zinahitaji muunganisho wa mtandao (internet/SIM card) mara kwa mara ili: (1) kupeleka data ya muamala kwenye seva ya TRA, (2) kupata masasisho ya mfumo. EFD isiyopeleka data kwa TRA kwa muda mrefu inaweza kukiuka sheria — angalia mwongozo wa msambazaji wako kuhusu mahitaji ya muunganisho.
question_en: Does a Tanzania EFD machine need an internet connection to work?
answer_en: Most Tanzania EFD machines can operate offline briefly and store transaction data on the machine. But they need periodic internet/SIM connection to: (1) transmit transaction data to TRA's server, (2) receive system updates. An EFD that does not transmit data to TRA for a long period may be in violation — check your supplier's guidance on connectivity requirements.

question_sw: Niambie jinsi ya kulipa ushuru wa uagizaji wa bidhaa kutoka China kupitia EAC.
answer_sw: Mchakato wa ushuru wa uagizaji kutoka China unahusisha forodha ya TRA na kanuni za EAC — hii ni eneo maalum zaidi ya VAT na kodi za ndani ninazoshughulikia. Kwa mchakato wa uagizaji na forodha, wasiliana na: TRA Customs na Excise (tra.go.tz), Freight forwarder wa Tanzania, Tanzania Bureau of Standards (TBS) kwa vipimo. Je, kuna swali la kodi ya ndani kama VAT au SDL ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: Tell me how to pay import duty on goods from China through EAC.
answer_en: The import duty process from China involves TRA customs and EAC rules — this is a more specialised area beyond the VAT and domestic taxes I handle. For import/customs processes, contact: TRA Customs and Excise (tra.go.tz), a Tanzanian freight forwarder, Tanzania Bureau of Standards (TBS) for standards. Is there a domestic tax question like VAT or SDL I can help with?

question_sw: Ninatoa huduma za ushauri wa mtandaoni kwa wateja wa Tanzania. Je, VFD inahitajika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — ikiwa mauzo yako ya huduma za ushauri wa mtandaoni yanazidi kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6) na umesajiliwa kwa VAT, unahitaji VFD. VFD itazalisha risiti ya kidijitali kwa kila muamala wa huduma, itapeleka taarifa kwa seva ya TRA, na itakusaidia kutunza rekodi za VAT sahihi. Kiwango cha VAT kwenye huduma za ushauri ni asilimia 18.
question_en: I provide online consultancy services to Tanzanian clients. Is VFD required?
answer_en: Yes — if your online consultancy sales exceed the VAT threshold (TZS 200M/year or TZS 100M/6 months) and you are VAT-registered, you need a VFD. The VFD will generate a digital receipt for each service transaction, transmit data to TRA's server, and help you maintain accurate VAT records. The VAT rate on consultancy services is 18%.

question_sw: Mtu alisema umeme unalipwa VAT ya asilimia 10 Tanzania. Je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli. Tanzania haina kiwango cha VAT cha asilimia 10. Kiwango cha VAT Tanzania Bara ni asilimia 18 peke yake — kiwango cha kawaida. Huduma za umeme zinaweza kuwa zero-rated au exempt kulingana na hali, lakini asilimia 10 haipo kabisa katika mfumo wa VAT wa Tanzania.
question_en: Someone said electricity in Tanzania is charged VAT at 10%. Is this true?
answer_en: Not true. Tanzania does not have a 10% VAT rate. The VAT rate on Mainland Tanzania is 18% only — the standard rate. Electricity services may be zero-rated or exempt depending on the circumstances, but 10% simply does not exist in Tanzania's VAT system.

question_sw: Ni nani anayeweza kuripoti mgeni anayefanya biashara haramu chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Mtu yeyote anaweza kuripoti — raia, mshindani wa biashara, au afisa yeyote wa serikali. Idara kuu za utekelezaji ni: Idara ya Uhamiaji, TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority), na polisi. Unaweza kuwasiliana na Idara ya Uhamiaji kupitia simu yao ya dharura au ofisi ya karibu nawe. Kumbuka: GN 487A yenyewe haitaji utaratibu wa kuripoti, usiri, au ulinzi wa mripoti — thibitisha utaratibu wa kuripoti na ulinzi wowote moja kwa moja na Idara ya Uhamiaji kabla ya kuripoti.
question_en: Who can report a non-citizen conducting an illegal business under GN 487A?
answer_en: Anyone can report — a citizen, a business competitor, or any government official. The main enforcement departments are: the Immigration Department, TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority), and the police. You can contact the Immigration Department through their emergency line or nearest office. Anyone can report — a citizen, business competitor, or government official. The main enforcement departments are: Immigration Department, TRA, and the police. Contact the nearest Immigration Department office. Note: GN 487A itself does not specify reporting procedures, confidentiality provisions, or whistleblower protections — verify reporting procedures and any protections directly with the Immigration Department before reporting.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa sekta ya ulinzi (watchman/security) ana kiwango gani cha mshahara?
answer_sw: Sekta ya ulinzi na usalama ina kiwango chake katika GN 605A. Kwa kawaida ni kiwango cha wastani — zaidi ya kiwango cha jumla lakini chini ya sekta kama madini. Angalia jedwali la GN 605A kwa kiwango sahihi cha sekta ya ulinzi.
question_en: What minimum wage applies to a security watchman?
answer_en: The security and guarding sector has its own rate in GN 605A — typically a mid-tier rate, above the general floor but below sectors like mining. Check the GN 605A schedule for the exact security sector rate.

question_sw: Sijui GN 487A inaathiri sekta yangu — nifanye nini?
answer_sw: Hatua bora ni: (1) Angalia orodha kamili ya makundi 15 ya shughuli zilizozuiliwa katika GN 487A kwenye TanzLII.org, (2) Linganisha sekta yako na orodha hiyo, (3) Kama sekta yako ipo kwenye orodha na wewe ni mgeni, wasiliana na wakili wa biashara au uhamiaji haraka, (4) Kama huna uhakika, pata ushauri wa kisheria kabla ya kuendelea na biashara. Usijaribu kujiamua mwenyewe bila ushauri wa kisheria — adhabu za GN 487A ni kali na zinafanya kazi mara moja. Biashara zinazoathiriwa zinapendekezwa kutathmini muundo wao wa umiliki na mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: I am not sure if GN 487A affects my sector — what should I do?
answer_en: The best steps are: (1) Check the complete list of 15 prohibited activity categories in GN 487A at TanzLII.org, (2) Compare your sector against that list, (3) If your sector is on the list and you are a non-citizen, contact a business or immigration lawyer urgently, (4) If unsure, get legal advice before continuing to operate. Do not try to self-assess without legal advice — GN 487A penalties are severe and take immediate effect. Affected businesses are advised to review their ownership structure with a legal adviser.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya ripoti ya ajali ya OSHA na WCF ni ipi?
answer_sw: Mifumo miwili tofauti: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) — mwajiri anaripoti ajali kupitia portal.wcf.go.tz ndani ya siku 7 za kazi baada ya ajali. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) — OSHA inafanya ukaguzi wa mahali pa kazi; kikosi cha ukaguzi kinaweza kutoa notisi ya uboreshaji au ya kuzuia. Mwajiri analazimika kuwasilisha kwa OSHA pia maelezo ya ajali kubwa. Mifumo hii ni ya ziada — tekeleza yote mawili. Thibitisha na WCF na OSHA.
question_en: What is the difference between OSHA and WCF accident reporting in Tanzania?
answer_en: Two separate systems: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) — employer reports the accident via portal.wcf.go.tz within 7 working days after the accident. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) — OSHA conducts workplace inspections; an inspector may issue an improvement notice or a prohibition notice. Employers must also report major accidents to OSHA separately. These systems are complementary — comply with both. Confirm with WCF and OSHA.
primary_source_name: OSHA - Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act amendment or new WCF regulations

instruction: SDL na WCF — tofauti kuu ni nini?
output: SDL na WCF zinafanana kwa kuwa zote ni malipo ya mwajiri — lakini ni tofauti kabisa: SDL (Skills Development Levy): kiwango 3.5% ya mishahara ya fedha; inalipwa TRA; inaenda mfuko wa mafunzo ya taaluma Tanzania; inatumika kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi; tarehe ya mwisho 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund): kiwango 0.5% ya mishahara ya fedha; inalipwa WCF Authority (wcf.go.tz); inaenda mfuko wa bima ya ajali za kazi; inatumika kwa WAAJIRI WOTE (hata chini ya 10) — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi; tarehe ya mwisho inafanana na SDL. Vyote viwili ni malipo ya mwajiri tu — si kukatwa kwa mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA na wcf.go.tz.

instruction: Ninachimba almasi kidogo kidogo kama mchimbaji mdogo (artisanal miner) — royalty yangu ni ngapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Royalty ya madini kwa wachimbaji wadogo (artisanal and small-scale miners) inashughulikiwa chini ya Mining Act na kanuni maalum za TMAA — kiwango kinatofautiana na cha wachimbaji wakubwa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Bendi ya tatu ya PAYE (TZS 520,001-760,000) ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Bendi ya tatu ya PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia 20. Mfumo wa bendi zote tano: Bendi 1 (0-270K): 0%; Bendi 2 (270K-520K): 8%; Bendi 3 (520K-760K): 20%; Bendi 4 (760K-1M): 25%; Bendi 5 (zaidi ya 1M): 30%. Ongezeko kutoka bendi 2 hadi bendi 3 ni kubwa — kutoka 8% hadi 20%. Hii inamaanisha mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 521,000 analipa 8% kwa sehemu ya bendi 2 NA 20% kwa TZS 1,000 ya bendi 3.
question_en: What is the rate of the third PAYE band (TZS 520,001-760,000)?
answer_en: The third PAYE band in Tanzania is 20%. All five band rates: Band 1 (0-270K): 0%; Band 2 (270K-520K): 8%; Band 3 (520K-760K): 20%; Band 4 (760K-1M): 25%; Band 5 (above 1M): 30%. The jump from band 2 to band 3 is large — from 8% to 20%. This means an employee earning TZS 521,000 pays 8% on the band 2 portion AND 20% on TZS 1,000 in band 3.

question_sw: Nini kinatokea kama kibali cha kazi kimeisha muda kabla ya kuhuishwa?
answer_sw: Ikiwa kibali cha kazi kimeisha muda bila kuhuishwa, mfanyakazi anawa na hali ya haramu kisheria Tanzania. Lazima waende Idara ya Uhamiaji haraka ili kurekebisha hali. Kuchelewa kunaweza kusababisha faini, na mwajiri pia ana wajibu wa kuhakikisha vibali vya wafanyakazi wake ni halali daima.
question_en: What happens if a work permit expires before renewal?
answer_en: If a work permit expires without renewal the worker is in an unlawful status in Tanzania. They must go to the Immigration Department promptly to regularise. Delay can result in fines, and the employer also has a responsibility to ensure their workers' permits are always valid.

question_sw: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kulipa PAYE TRA ni ipi?
answer_sw: PAYE lazima ilipwe TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kwa mfano, PAYE ya Januari inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 Februari. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the PAYE remittance deadline in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE must be remitted to TRA by the 7th of the following month. For example, January PAYE is due by 7 February. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: SDL — kama mfanyakazi ana mshahara wa TZS 100,000 tu (chini ya mshahara wa chini) — bado anahusika katika SDL base?
output: Ndiyo — kwa madhumuni ya SDL, mfanyakazi yeyote anayelipwa pesa za fedha (hata chini ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A) anahusika katika SDL base. SDL base ni JUMLA ya mishahara ya fedha ya wafanyakazi wote — si tu wale wanaolipwa zaidi ya mshahara wa chini. Hata hivyo, unapaswa kuhakikisha wafanyakazi wote wanalipwa angalau mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A (kuanzia 1 Januari 2026) — vinginevyo unakiuka Sheria ya Kazi, hata kama SDL imekusanywa. Thibitisha na TRA kwa SDL na wizara ya Kazi kwa mshahara wa chini.

instruction: Biashara yangu imefanyiwa ukaguzi wa EFD — wakaguzi wameona rekodi hazifanani na mauzo halisi. Adhabu ni nini?
output: Tofauti kati ya rekodi za EFD na mauzo halisi inachukuliwa kama ukwepaji wa kodi (tax evasion). Adhabu zinaweza kujumuisha: (1) Malipo ya kodi yote iliyokosekana (back taxes) + riba ya kuchelewa; (2) Faini ya hadi 100% ya kodi iliyokosekana kwa makosa ya makusudi; (3) Faini ya 5% ya kodi kwa kila mwezi wa kuchelewa (PAYE late penalty); (4) Uwezekano wa kufungwa kwa biashara; (5) Mashtaka ya jinai kwa ukwepaji mkubwa wa kodi. Kama una tatizo la rekodi zako, wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi haraka kabla ya ukaguzi kuendelea. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Je, SDL inaweza kulipwa kama sehemu ya mshahara wa mfanyakazi bila ya kumjulisha?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL ni ushuru wa mwajiri unaolipwa TRA — si sehemu ya mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Kuiingiza kwenye mshahara wa mfanyakazi bila idhini ni kosa la kisheria. Mfanyakazi ana haki ya kupata mshahara wake kamili na mwajiri analipa SDL kando.
question_en: Can SDL be paid as part of an employee's salary without informing them?
answer_en: No. SDL is an employer levy paid to TRA — it is not part of the employee's salary. Including it in the employee's payroll without consent is a legal error. The employee is entitled to their full salary and the employer pays SDL separately.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: OSHA Tanzania inasimamia usalama wa mahali pa kazi tu — si afya ya wafanyakazi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Jina kamili ni Mamlaka ya Usalama na Afya Mahali pa Kazi (Occupational Safety and HEALTH Authority). OSHA inasimamia ZOTE MBILI: usalama wa mazingira ya kazi (vifaa salama, miundo ya jengo, hatari za mashine) NA afya ya wafanyakazi (ugonjwa wa kazini, kemikali hatari, kelele, joto). Dhana kwamba OSHA ni ya 'usalama tu' ni kosa la kawaida.
question_en: OSHA Tanzania only supervises workplace safety — not worker health — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The full name is Occupational Safety and HEALTH Authority. OSHA supervises BOTH: workplace environment safety (safe equipment, building structure, machine hazards) AND worker health (occupational disease, hazardous chemicals, noise, heat). The notion that OSHA is 'only about safety' is a common error.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

instruction: Je, kuna tarehe moja inayotumika kwa kampuni zote za BRELA kwa annual returns?
output: Hapana. Hakuna tarehe maalum ya 30 Septemba kwa annual returns za BRELA — tarehe inategemea tarehe ya usajili wa kampuni yako. Annual return inapaswa kuwasilishwa kulingana na tarehe ya kumbukumbu ya usajili wa kampuni yako (anniversary date) — si lazima mwaka wa kifedha. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kwa tarehe yako halisi. Kila kampuni ina tarehe yake binafsi kulingana na tarehe yake ya usajili na mwaka wa biashara. Mfumo wa BRELA online unakuonyesha tarehe yako maalum ukiingia kwa TIN yako au nambari ya usajili.

question_sw: Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA ana muda gani kuamua pingamizi langu?
answer_sw: Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA ana miezi 6 kuamua pingamizi. Kama hatajibu ndani ya miezi 6, pingamizi linachukuliwa kama limekataliwa kisheria na mlipaji kodi anaweza kukata rufaa kwa Bodi ya Rufaa ya Mapato ya Kodi (TRAB) — hata bila uamuzi rasmi.
question_en: How long does the TRA Commissioner General have to decide my objection?
answer_en: The TRA Commissioner General has 6 months to decide an objection. If they fail to respond within 6 months the objection is deemed rejected by law and the taxpayer can appeal to the Tax Revenue Appeals Board (TRAB) — even without a formal determination.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni ambaye amesajiliwa NSSF, analipa PAYE, na ana TIN — ana hali nzuri?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — mfanyakazi mwenye TIN, PAYE inayokatwa kwa usahihi, na NSSF inayochangiwa — ana hali nzuri ya kodi Tanzania. Hii ni muundo sahihi wa kufuata. Mwajiri pia anahitaji SDL (kama wafanyakazi ≥10) na WCF (0.5%) zilizolipwa. Hifadhi kumbukumbu zote za P9 na malipo kwa ajili ya ukaguzi wowote wa TRA.
question_en: A foreign employee registered with NSSF, paying PAYE, with a TIN — are they in good standing?
answer_en: Yes — an employee with a TIN, correctly deducted PAYE, and NSSF contributions — is in good Tanzania tax standing. This is the correct compliance structure. The employer also needs SDL (if ≥10 employees) and WCF (0.5%) paid. Keep all P9 records and payment receipts for any TRA audit.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Wafanyakazi 10 wanaolipwa jumla TZS 3,600,000 kwa mwezi. SDL ya mwezi ni TZS ngapi?
answer_sw: SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi): TZS 3,600,000 × 3.5% = TZS 126,000 kwa mwezi. Kampuni yako inastahili kulipa SDL kwa sababu una wafanyakazi 10 hasa — yaani unafika kiwango cha chini (10 au zaidi). Inalipwa na mwajiri, mwisho siku ya 7 ya mwezi unaofuata.
question_en: 10 employees are paid a total of TZS 3,600,000 per month. What is the monthly SDL?
answer_en: SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi): TZS 3,600,000 × 3.5% = TZS 126,000 per month. Your company qualifies to pay SDL because you have exactly 10 employees — the minimum threshold (10 or more). Paid by the employer, due by the 7th of the following month.

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inaweza kufanya biashara kwa jina tofauti na jina lililosaili BRELA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni inaweza kufanya biashara kwa jina la biashara (trading name) tofauti na jina lake rasmi la kampuni iliyosajiliwa BRELA, ikiwa jina la biashara pia limesajiliwa. Kwa mfano, kampuni iliyosajiliwa kama 'ABC Holdings Limited' inaweza kufanya biashara kama 'QuickShop'. Jina la biashara lazima lisajiliwe BRELA pia.
question_en: Can a Tanzania company trade under a different name from the one registered with BRELA?
answer_en: Yes. A company can trade under a different trading name from its formal BRELA-registered company name, provided the trading name is also registered. For example, a company registered as 'ABC Holdings Limited' can trade as 'QuickShop'. The trading name must also be registered with BRELA.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Kiwango cha mchango wa NSSF kinachopelekwa TRA au NSSF kwa kila mfanyakazi ni ngapi?
output: Mchango wa NSSF unaopelekwa si TRA — unaenda moja kwa moja kwa NSSF. Kiasi kinachopelekwa kwa kila mfanyakazi ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara wa jumla — mwajiri anachangia asilimia 10 na mfanyakazi anachangia asilimia 10 (mgawanyo wa kawaida). Mwajiri ndiye anayepeleka jumla yote NSSF — ikiwa ni pamoja na sehemu ya mfanyakazi aliyokatwa kwenye mshahara.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: Niliomba usajilishaji wa VAT miezi 3 iliyopita — sijapata jibu. Nifanye nini?
output: Fuatilia ombi lako na Kamishna wa TRA (tra.go.tz). Ikiwa umekuwa ukisubiri zaidi ya muda uliowekwa na TRA, ufuatilie rasmi kwa maandishi ukitaja tarehe ya maombi na nambari ya kumbukumbu. Unaweza pia kuwasiliana na ofisi ya TRA karibu nawe. Usisimame biashara — endelea kuhifadhi rekodi za mauzo vizuri hadi upate jibu.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: EFD inaweza kutoa risiti kwa lugha ya Kiingereza au lazima iwe Kiswahili?
output: Risiti za EFD zinaweza kuwa kwa Kiingereza au Kiswahili — thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kuhusu mahitaji ya lugha kwa risiti za EFD, kwani mwongozo rasmi wa TRA utathibitisha kama Kiswahili au Kiingereza zinakubalika. Muhimu zaidi ni: risiti iwe na taarifa zote zinazohitajika (jina la biashara, TIN, TRA registration number, tarehe, kiasi, aina ya bidhaa/huduma, na TRA verification code). Biashara nyingi za Tanzania zinatoa risiti kwa Kiingereza kwa sababu EFD nyingi zina programu ya Kiingereza. Wateja wanaohitaji risiti kwa Kiswahili wanaweza kuomba — lakini sheria hailazimishi lugha maalum. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa miongozo ya hali ya sasa ya lugha inayokubalika kwa risiti za EFD.

question_sw: Jumla ya mishahara ya kampuni ni TZS 25,000,000 kwa mwezi. SDL ni TZS ngapi? Na ikiwa tungepoteza wafanyakazi 2 na kubaki na 9, SDL itabadilika vipi?
answer_sw: Sasa hivi (25 wafanyakazi, TZS 25,000,000): SDL = TZS 25,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 875,000. Ikiwa utabaki na wafanyakazi 9 (chini ya 10): haulazimiki tena kulipa SDL — kiwango cha chini ni wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. SDL itakuwa sifuri. Hata hivyo, thibisha na TRA kwamba idadi ya wafanyakazi imepungua kabla ya kusimamisha malipo.
question_en: Total company payroll is TZS 25,000,000 per month. What is the SDL? And if we lose 2 employees and are left with 9, how does SDL change?
answer_en: Currently (25 employees, TZS 25,000,000): SDL = TZS 25,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 875,000. If you are left with 9 employees (below 10): you are no longer required to pay SDL — the threshold is 10 or more employees. SDL becomes zero. However, confirm with TRA that your employee count has decreased before stopping payments.

question_sw: Je, bendi za PAYE zinabadilika kila mwaka au zinakaa sawa?
answer_sw: Bendi za PAYE zinaweza kubadilika kila mwaka kupitia Finance Act inayotangazwa kila Julai. Mwaka 2025/2026, bendi ni: Bendi 1 (0-270K): 0%; Bendi 2 (270K-520K): 8%; Bendi 3 (520K-760K): 20%; Bendi 4 (760K-1M): 25%; Bendi 5 (zaidi ya 1M): 30%. Kizingiti cha mapato yasiyotozwa kodi: TZS 3,240,000/mwaka (TZS 270,000/mwezi kwa 0% — imejengwa ndani ya Bendi 1, hakuna punguzo tofauti la kila mwezi)./mwezi. Angalia Finance Act mpya kila Julai au wasiliana na TRA kuthibitisha bendi za sasa. Usitegemee viwango vya zamani bila kuthibitisha.
question_en: Do PAYE bands change every year or do they remain the same?
answer_en: PAYE bands may change annually through the Finance Act published each July. For 2025/2026, the bands are: Band 1 (0-270K): 0%; Band 2 (270K-520K): 8%; Band 3 (520K-760K): 20%; Band 4 (760K-1M): 25%; Band 5 (above 1M): 30%. Annual tax-free threshold: TZS 3,240,000/year (TZS 270,000/month at 0% — built into Band 1, no separate monthly relief)./month. Check the new Finance Act every July or contact TRA to confirm current bands. Do not rely on old rates without verifying.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands — review every July

question_sw: Je, risiti ya karatasi ya kawaida (hand-written) inakubaliwa badala ya EFD?
answer_sw: Hapana — biashara iliyosajiliwa kwa VAT na EFD haiwezi kutoa risiti ya mkono (hand-written) au risiti ya kawaida kama mbadala wa EFD. Risiti ya EFD ndiyo pekee inayokubaliwa kisheria. Hata hivyo, kama EFD imeharibika, TRA inaruhusu kutumia stakabadhi zilizochapishwa awali (pre-printed manual receipt book) kwa muda mfupi — na lazima urejeshe EFD haraka iwezekanavyo na utaarifiShe TRA.
question_en: Is a regular hand-written receipt acceptable instead of EFD?
answer_en: No — a business registered for VAT with EFD cannot issue a hand-written or regular receipt as a substitute for EFD. An EFD receipt is the only legally accepted document. However, if the EFD breaks down, TRA allows the use of pre-printed manual receipt books temporarily — and you must restore the EFD as quickly as possible and notify TRA.

question_sw: Biashara yangu inaendesha huduma za ushauri. Je, kizingiti cha VAT ni sawa kwa huduma na bidhaa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT kinatumika kwa bidhaa NA huduma: TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12, au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6 — bila kujali aina ya biashara. Huduma za ushauri zinazopita kizingiti hiki lazima zisajiliwe kwa VAT. Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT ni asilimia 18. Hakuna kiwango maalum cha chini kwa huduma.
question_en: My business provides consultancy services. Is the VAT threshold the same for services as for goods?
answer_en: Yes. The VAT registration threshold applies to both goods AND services: TZS 200,000,000 in 12 months, or TZS 100,000,000 in 6 months — regardless of business type. Consultancy services that exceed this threshold must register for VAT. The standard VAT rate is 18%. There is no special lower rate for services.

question_sw: Biashara inaweza kudai VAT ya pembejeo (input VAT) bila risiti ya EFD ya muuzaji Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, TRA inashikilia kwamba kudai input VAT kunahitaji risiti halisi ya EFD au ankara ya VAT iliyotolewa na muuzaji aliyesajili VAT. Bila risiti ya EFD au ankara halisi ya VAT, madai ya input VAT yanaweza kukataliwa na TRA wakati wa ukaguzi. Hifadhi risiti zote za EFD na ankara za VAT kutoka kwa wasambazaji wako kwa angalau miaka 5.
question_en: Can a business claim input VAT without an EFD receipt from the supplier in Tanzania?
answer_en: Generally, TRA requires that claiming input VAT be supported by a genuine EFD receipt or a VAT invoice issued by a VAT-registered supplier. Without an EFD receipt or genuine VAT invoice, input VAT claims can be rejected by TRA during audit. Keep all EFD receipts and VAT invoices from your suppliers for at least 5 years.
next_review_trigger: TRA input VAT or EFD evidence update

question_sw: Je, ikiwa wafanyakazi wa TRA wananikatalia bila sababu — ninafanya nini?
answer_sw: Kama unaamini madai yako ya VAT refund yamekataliwa bila sababu ya kisheria, una haki za kisheria. Pata maelezo ya maandishi ya sababu ya kukataliwa. Thibitisha na sheria ya VAT Tanzania. Piga rufaa kwa Kamishna wa TRA. Kama bado hujaridhika, fika TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) au mahakama. Weka kumbukumbu za mawasiliano yote.
question_en: If TRA staff are rejecting my claim without reason — what do I do?
answer_en: If you believe your VAT refund claim was rejected without legal basis, you have legal rights. Get the rejection reason in writing. Verify against Tanzania VAT law. Appeal to the TRA Commissioner. If still unsatisfied, go to TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) or courts. Keep records of all communications.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari: viwango vya VAT Tanzania ni vipi?
answer_sw: Viwango VYA LAZIMA (mandatory) vya usajili wa VAT Tanzania: (1) TZS 200,000,000 katika KIPINDI CHOCHOTE cha miezi 12 mfululizo; AU (2) TZS 100,000,000 katika KIPINDI CHOCHOTE cha miezi 6 mfululizo. Moja tu ya viwango hivi kuzidiwa kunafanya usajili kuwa wa lazima mara moja. Fani zilizodhibitiwa (wakili, CPA, nk) lazima zisajilishwe mara moja bila kujali mauzo. Pia: unaweza kusajili VAT kwa hiari hata kama hujafika viwango hivi.
question_en: Summary: what are Tanzania's VAT registration thresholds?
answer_en: MANDATORY VAT registration thresholds in Tanzania: (1) TZS 200,000,000 in ANY consecutive 12-month period; OR (2) TZS 100,000,000 in ANY consecutive 6-month period. Exceeding either one of these thresholds alone makes registration immediately mandatory. Regulated professions (lawyers, CPAs, etc.) must register immediately regardless of sales. Also: you may voluntarily register for VAT even if you have not reached these thresholds.

instruction: Ninaununua huduma za IT (programming) kutoka kampuni nyingine — kiwango cha VAT withholding ni ngapi?
output: Huduma za IT kama programming, usanidi wa mifumo, na ushauri wa teknolojia ni HUDUMA — kwa hivyo VAT withholding ni 6% (si 3%). Kanuni ya msingi: BIDHAA → 3%; HUDUMA → 6%. Hii ni sawa kwa huduma zote kama ushauri, uhasibu, ujenzi wa programu, na kadhalika. Finance Act 2025 ilianzisha mfumo huu wa 3%/6% kuanzia 1 Julai 2025. Mnunuzi anayehitimu (qualifying buyer) anakata 6% ya VAT kutoka bei ya huduma na kutuma TRA. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Mgeni anafanya biashara ndogo chini ya GN 487A lakini analipa kodi zote — je, kulipa kodi kunamlinda?
output: Hapana — kulipa kodi (VAT, PAYE, SDL) hakumpa mgeni haki ya kufanya biashara iliyokatazwa chini ya GN 487A. GN 487A ni sheria ya biashara (business prohibition) inayozuia aina ya shughuli — si sheria ya kodi. Mgeni anayelipa kodi zote bado anakiuka GN 487A kama anafanya shughuli mojawapo ya 15 katika orodha. Kulipa kodi na kufuata GN 487A ni wajibu WA PAMOJA, si wa kuchagua moja kwa moja. Adhabu ya GN 487A: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu anakataa kuchangia NSSF — ninafanya nini?
answer_sw: Mchango wa NSSF ni wa lazima kisheria kwa wafanyakazi wote. Mfanyakazi hawezi kukataa mchango wa NSSF — ni wajibu wa kisheria wa mwajiri KUKATA mchango wa mfanyakazi (asilimia 10) na KUONGEZA mchango wa mwajiri (asilimia 10) na kumpelekea NSSF. Mfanyakazi kukubali au la si sharti.
question_en: My employee refuses to contribute to NSSF — what do I do?
answer_en: NSSF contributions are legally mandatory for all employees. An employee cannot refuse NSSF contributions — it is the employer's legal obligation to DEDUCT the employee's contribution (10%) and ADD the employer's contribution (10%) and remit to NSSF. The employee's agreement is not a condition.

question_sw: Dereva wa bodaboda — ana wajibu gani wa kodi na leseni?
answer_sw: Dereva wa bodaboda kwa kawaida anahitaji: (1) Leseni ya udereva (driving licence) ya kategoria husika; (2) Leseni ya gari (vehicle registration na bima); (3) Leseni ya biashara kutoka halmashauri kama ana duka au kituo; (4) TIN na BRELA kama biashara imekua. PAYE haitumiki kwa mwenye biashara yake mwenyewe. VAT kwa kawaida haifiki. Angalia kanuni za halmashauri yako.
question_en: A motorcycle taxi (bodaboda) rider — what tax and licence obligations do they have?
answer_en: A bodaboda rider typically needs: (1) An appropriate driving licence; (2) Vehicle registration and insurance; (3) A business licence from the local council if they have a base or station; (4) TIN and BRELA registration if the business has grown. PAYE does not apply to self-employed operators. VAT typically does not apply. Check your local council's rules.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya miaka mitatu imekuwa na mapato ya TZS 150M kwa mwaka kwa miaka miwili — je, lazima nisajili VAT?
output: Ndiyo — kizingiti cha mwaka ni TZS 200M. Mapato ya TZS 150M kwa mwaka ni CHINI ya kizingiti cha TZS 200M/mwaka — kwa hivyo kwa msingi wa kizingiti cha mwaka, bado haujafika. Hata hivyo, angalia pia kizingiti cha miezi 6 (rolling): kama mapato yako yoyote ya miezi yoyote 6 mfululizo yanazidi TZS 100M — lazima usajili. Kama biashara yako inapokelewa kwa usawa (TZS 150M ÷ 12 miezi = TZS 12.5M/mwezi × 6 = TZS 75M) — chini ya TZS 100M kwa miezi 6. Kwa hivyo ukiweza kuthibitisha mapato ya chini ya TZS 100M katika kipindi chochote cha miezi 6 mfululizo, bado hujalazimika. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mgeni anayemiliki majengo na kukodisha maduka — anakiuka GN 487A?
answer_sw: Kukodisha mali (real estate rental) kwa ujumla si miongoni mwa biashara 15 zilizopigwa marufuku moja kwa moja na GN 487A. Hata hivyo, mipaka inaweza kuwa na utata — kama mgeni anamiliki na kuendesha jengo kama mkahawa au duka la rejareja mwenyewe ndiye muendesha, inaweza kuzingatiwa ukiukaji. Kuhusu kukodisha maduka kwa Watanzania wengine kuendesha — hii kwa kawaida ipo nje ya marufuku ya GN 487A. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: A non-citizen who owns buildings and rents out shops — do they violate GN 487A?
answer_en: Renting out property (real estate rental) is not directly among the 15 business categories explicitly prohibited by GN 487A. However, the boundaries may be complex — if a non-citizen owns and personally operates a building as a food outlet or retail shop, it could be considered a violation. Renting shops to other Tanzanians to operate — this is generally outside GN 487A's prohibition. Verify with the Immigration Department.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: NSSF inakataa kulipa pensheni ikiwa mfanyakazi amestaafu mapema kwa hiari — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kabisa. Mfanyakazi anayestaafu mapema kwa hiari (voluntary early retirement) anaweza bado kudai manufaa ya NSSF, lakini kiasi kitategemea: miezi ya michango aliyochangia (lazima angalau 60 kwa manufaa yaliyopunguzwa), umri wake, na aina ya manufaa anayodai. Anastaafu kabla ya miaka 60 anaweza kupata manufaa yaliyopunguzwa au kulazimishwa kusubiri hadi umri wa kawaida wa pensheni. Wasiliana na NSSF moja kwa moja kwa hali yako.
question_en: NSSF refuses to pay pension if a worker retired early voluntarily — is this true?
answer_en: Not entirely true. A worker who voluntarily takes early retirement can still claim NSSF benefits, but the amount will depend on: months of contributions paid (must be at least 60 for reduced benefits), their age, and the type of benefit claimed. Retiring before age 60 may result in reduced benefits or being required to wait until normal pension age. Contact NSSF directly for your situation.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: VAT withholding ni nini na kiwango chake ni kiasi gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: VAT withholding ni mfumo ambapo mnunuzi (mwenye leseni ya kuzuia VAT) anamzuia msambazaji sehemu ya VAT na kuipeleka TRA moja kwa moja. Kiwango: asilimia 3 kwa bidhaa na asilimia 6 kwa huduma, kuanzia 1 Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). VAT ya kawaida ni asilimia 18 — withholding ni sehemu tu inayozuiwa, si kiwango kipya cha VAT.
question_en: What is VAT withholding and what is its rate in Tanzania?
answer_en: VAT withholding is a system where the buyer (designated withholding agent) withholds a portion of VAT from the supplier and remits it directly to TRA. Rate: 3% on goods and 6% on services, effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Standard VAT remains 18% — withholding is a portion withheld, not a new VAT rate.

question_sw: GN 487A na GN 605A — ni amri zinazohusiana au tofauti kabisa?
answer_sw: Ni amri mbili tofauti kabisa. GN 487A (28 Julai 2025): inazuia raia wa kigeni kufanya aina fulani za biashara. GN 605A (1 Januari 2026): inaweka mshahara wa chini kwa sekta mbalimbali — inaathiri waajiri WOTE, wakiwemo raia na wageni. Hazihusiani moja kwa moja.
question_en: GN 487A and GN 605A — are they related orders or completely different?
answer_en: They are two completely different orders. GN 487A (28 July 2025): prohibits non-citizens from engaging in certain business activities. GN 605A (1 January 2026): sets minimum wages across various sectors — affecting ALL employers, both citizens and non-citizens. They have no direct connection.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: Biashara yangu ilifungwa siku moja bila mauzo yoyote — bado ninahitaji kupiga Z-report?
output: Z-report lazima ipigwe MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Hata ukiwa na mauzo ya sufuri (zero), piga Z-report. Kutoipiga kunaweza kuonekana kwa TRA kwenye TIMS kama siku iliyokosekana. Z-report ya sufuri (TZS 0 mauzo) ni halali na inakumbatia rekodi za siku hiyo bila shida.

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi mgeni aliye Tanzania kwa mwezi mmoja tu analipa PAYE?
answer_sw: Inategemea muundo wa ajira. Mfanyakazi aliyehiriwa na mwajiri wa Tanzania na kupata mshahara kutoka Tanzania analipa PAYE kwa kipindi chochote cha kufanya kazi Tanzania. Kwa ziara za muda mfupi za kibiashara (si kazi ya kawaida), PAYE inaweza isitumike. Thibitisha hali maalum na TRA au mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: Does a foreign employee in Tanzania for just one month pay PAYE?
answer_en: It depends on the employment structure. An employee hired by a Tanzanian employer receiving salary from Tanzania pays PAYE for any period of working in Tanzania. For brief business visits (not regular work), PAYE may not apply. Confirm the specific situation with TRA or a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa bidhaa ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa usambazaji wa bidhaa na wakala wa zuio (qualifying buyer) ni asilimia 3, kulingana na Kifungu cha 5(5) cha Sheria ya VAT. Hii ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the VAT withholding rate on goods in Tanzania?
answer_en: The VAT withholding obligation on supply of goods by the Withholding Agent under Section 5(5) of the VAT Act is 3%, effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Mzabuni wangu ameandika invoice yenye VAT 5% — nailipe au nikatae?
output: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Invoice yenye VAT 5% ina kosa — mzabuni ametumia kiwango kisichopo Tanzania. Hatua: (1) Arifu mzabuni kwamba Tanzania haina 5% VAT. (2) Omba invoice mpya yenye 18% (iwapo bidhaa/huduma inastahili VAT standard). (3) Usidai input VAT ya 5% kwenye return yako — TRA haitaikubali.

question_sw: Malipo ya mwisho ya kazi (gratuity/terminal benefits) yanastahili PAYE?
answer_sw: Malipo ya mwisho wa kazi kama vile malipo ya likizo yasiyotumika, mafao ya kujitenga (gratuity), na malipo ya fidia yanaweza kustahili PAYE kulingana na sheria ya kodi. Sehemu fulani inaweza kuwa huru — thibitisha hesabu halisi na TRA kabla ya kulipa.
question_en: Are terminal benefits and gratuity subject to PAYE?
answer_en: Terminal payments such as unused leave pay-out, gratuity, and severance may be subject to PAYE depending on the tax rules. Certain portions may be exempt — confirm the exact calculation with TRA before payment.

instruction: TIN ya kampuni yangu — ninaitoa BRELA au TRA?
output: TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) inatoka TRA — si BRELA. BRELA inakupa nambari ya usajilishaji wa kampuni (Certificate of Incorporation). Baada ya kupata certificate ya BRELA, unapeleka TRA kupata TIN ya kampuni. Hatua ni tofauti: BRELA kwanza (usajilishaji wa kampuni), kisha TRA (usajilishaji wa kodi). Biashara zote lazima ziwe na TIN kutoka TRA kabla ya kufanya biashara.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inaweza kufanya biashara nje ya Tanzania bila leseni nyingine?
answer_sw: Kwa biashara nyingi, usajili wa Tanzania (BRELA + TRA) unaruhusu kufanya biashara kimataifa kwa mikataba ya kawaida ya nje. Hata hivyo, kufungua tawi nje ya Tanzania kunahitaji usajili katika nchi hiyo. Biashara fulani za udhibiti (fedha, bima) zinahitaji vibali maalum kwa shughuli za kimataifa.
question_en: Can a Tanzania company do business outside Tanzania without additional licences?
answer_en: For most businesses, Tanzania registration (BRELA + TRA) permits international trade through normal export contracts. However, opening a branch outside Tanzania requires registration in that country. Certain regulated businesses (finance, insurance) require special permits for international operations.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Mbia wa serikali anakata VAT yangu. Niandikaje kwenye VAT return yangu?
output: Kwenye VAT return yako, ripoti VAT iliyokatwa kama pembejeo (input VAT credit). Tumia certificate ya withholding iliyotolewa na serikali (mnunuzi anayehitimu) kama ushahidi. Hakikisha certificate ina TIN yako, maelezo ya bidhaa, kiwango kilichotumika, na kiasi kilichokatwa. Ikiwa certificate haipo, omba kabla ya kuwasilisha return ifikapo tarehe 20.
