question_sw: Mke wangu ni raia wa Ethiopia, anataka kufungua saluni Dar es Salaam — je, anaweza?
answer_sw: Hapana. Chini ya GN 487A (2025), huduma za saluni, kinyozi, na urembo ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania. Mke wako hawezi kumiliki wala kuendesha saluni kama biashara yake binafsi. Adhabu ni faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza yake. Unaweza fikiria chaguo la ubia ambapo raia wa Tanzania ndiye mmiliki rasmi, lakini hata hivyo mhusika anapaswa kupata ushauri wa kisheria kwanza ili kuhakikisha muundo wa ubia ni halali.
question_en: My wife is an Ethiopian citizen and wants to open a salon in Dar es Salaam — can she?
answer_en: No. Under GN 487A (2025), salon, barbershop, and beauty services are one of the 15 business activities prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens. Your wife cannot own or operate a salon as her own business. Penalties are a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. You may consider a partnership arrangement where a Tanzanian citizen is the registered owner, but even then she should seek legal advice first to ensure the partnership structure is lawful.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: OSHA inafanya ukaguzi wa muda gani — na kama itakuta tatizo, inafanya nini?
output: Ukaguzi wa OSHA unaweza kuchukua saa chache hadi siku kadhaa kulingana na ukubwa wa biashara. Wakaguzi wa OSHA wanakagua: mazingira ya kazi, vifaa vya usalama, usafi, hewa, taa, nishati ya umeme, kemikali hatari, na kama safety officer yupo (kwa biashara 50+). KAMA TATIZO LINAPATIKANA: (1) Notisi ya marekebisho (improvement notice) — inaweza kutoa muda wa kurekebisha; (2) Kama tatizo ni hatari ya papo hapo — wanaweza kusimamisha kazi mara moja; (3) Kutopata tatizo baada ya notisi → faini, mashtaka ya kisheria; (4) Wakurugenzi wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi kwa matatizo makubwa ya usalama. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz.

question_sw: Mwajiri anatoa taarifa ya kila mwaka ya PAYE TRA lini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anatoa Taarifa ya Mwaka ya PAYE (Annual PAYE Statement) ifikapo tarehe 31 Machi ya mwaka unaofuata. Taarifa hiyo inaonyesha jumla ya mapato na kodi iliyokatwa kwa kila mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: When does an employer submit the annual PAYE reconciliation to TRA?
answer_en: An employer must submit the Annual PAYE Statement (reconciliation) by 31 March of the following year. It shows total income and tax withheld per employee. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni mwenye hisa za kampuni (share options) — thamani yao inalazimika PAYE?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, manufaa ya hisa za kampuni (share options, restricted stock) zinazotolewa kwa wafanyakazi zinachukuliwa kama mapato ya ajira pale zinapoibuliwa au kupatikana — na zinabeba PAYE. Hata hivyo, matibabu maalum ya kodi ya stock options Tanzania ni ngumu na yanategemea muundo wa mpango wa hisa. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: A foreign employee with company share options — is their value subject to PAYE?
answer_en: Generally, company share benefits (share options, restricted stock) given to employees are treated as employment income when exercised or vested — and they carry PAYE. However, the specific tax treatment of stock options in Tanzania is complex and depends on the share plan structure. Verify with a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: GN 605A ilianza tarehe ngapi?
answer_sw: GN 605A ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Ilisainiwa mnamo Oktoba 2025. Amri ya zamani ya mshahara wa mwaka 2022 ilifutwa rasmi kuanzia tarehe hiyo hiyo. Thibitisha na TanzLII.
question_en: When did GN 605A come into effect?
answer_en: GN 605A came into effect on 1 January 2026. It was gazetted in October 2025. The 2022 wage order was formally revoked from the same date. Confirm with TanzLII.

question_sw: Mgeni alikuwa na duka tangu 2020 — biashara yake ya zamani inalindwa dhidi ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A ya 2025 inatumika kwa biashara zote — za zamani NA mpya. Hakuna msamaha kwa biashara zilizoanzishwa kabla ya tarehe ya kuanza (28 Julai 2025). Mgeni aliyekuwa na duka la rejareja kabla ya tarehe hiyo bado lazima atii GN 487A — ama ahamishie kwa raia wa Tanzania au akabiliane na adhabu.
question_en: A non-citizen had a shop since 2020 — is their existing business protected from GN 487A?
answer_en: No. GN 487A of 2025 applies to all businesses — existing AND new. There is no exemption for businesses established before the effective date (28 July 2025). A non-citizen who had a retail shop before that date must still comply with GN 487A — either transfer it to a Tanzanian citizen or face penalties.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: Nina wafanyakazi 8 — SDL inahusika nami?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kwa wafanyakazi 8, bado uko chini ya kizingiti cha 10 — SDL haihitajiki. Lakini ukiongeza hadi wafanyakazi 10, SDL inahitajika mara moja kwa mwezi huo. Fuatilia idadi ya wafanyakazi wako kila wakati.

question_sw: VAT inalipwa kwa muda gani na msajiliwa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Msajiliwa wa VAT analipa VAT kupitia return ya VAT ya kila mwezi. Return na malipo yanatolewa ifikapo tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata mwezi wa biashara. Thibitisha tarehe na TRA.
question_en: When does a VAT registrant file and pay VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: A VAT registrant pays VAT through a monthly VAT return. The return and payment are due by the 20th of the month following the trading month. Confirm the deadline with TRA.

question_sw: TIC Certificate ya uwekezaji inalinda dhidi ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: TIC Certificate inatoa haki na vivutio kwa wawekezaji — lakini haifuti GN 487A. Ikiwa biashara ya TIC inaingia kwenye mojawapo ya shughuli 15 za GN 487A, lazima izingatie kanuni zote mbili. TIC na GN 487A ni mifumo miwili tofauti inayofanya kazi pamoja. Thibitisha na TIC na mwanasheria.
question_en: Does a TIC Investment Certificate protect against GN 487A?
answer_en: A TIC Certificate provides rights and incentives for investors — but it does not override GN 487A. If a TIC business engages in one of the 15 GN 487A activities, it must comply with both sets of rules. TIC and GN 487A are two separate systems that operate in parallel. Verify with TIC and a lawyer.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Kampuni ya kimataifa ya IT (teknolojia ya habari) inaweza kumilikiwa na mgeni Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa ujumla inaweza. Huduma za teknolojia ya habari (IT), ubunifu wa programu (software development), na huduma za kielektroniki haziko kati ya makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa wazi na GN 487A. Kampuni ya IT inayomilikiwa na mgeni inaweza kufanya kazi Tanzania mradi inazingatia sheria nyingine za biashara, kama usajili wa BRELA, ulipaji wa kodi, na vibali sahihi vya kazi kwa wafanyakazi. Hata hivyo, kama kampuni hiyo pia inaendesha duka la rejareja la bidhaa za IT (kuuza vifaa moja kwa moja kwa wateja), sehemu hiyo ya biashara inaweza kuathiriwa na GN 487A.
question_en: Can an international IT (information technology) company be owned by a non-citizen in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes, generally it can. Information technology services, software development, and electronic services are not among the 15 explicitly prohibited categories under GN 487A. A non-citizen-owned IT company can operate in Tanzania provided it complies with other business laws, such as BRELA registration, tax payment, and valid work permits for employees. However, if that company also operates a retail shop selling IT goods (selling hardware directly to customers), that aspect of the business may be affected by GN 487A.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi wa kilimo ana kiwango tofauti cha mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Sekta ya kilimo ina viwango vyake maalum chini ya GN 605A ambavyo ni tofauti na viwango vya sekta nyingine. Angalia jedwali maalum la GN 605A kwa viwango vya kilimo kwa mazao tofauti — kama chai, kahawa, mkonge, na maua.
question_en: Does the agriculture sector have a different minimum wage floor?
answer_en: Yes. The agriculture sector has its own specific rates under GN 605A which differ from other sectors. Check the GN 605A schedule for agriculture rates by crop type — tea, coffee, sisal, flowers, etc.

question_sw: Vibali 15 vya shughuli vilivyopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A ni vipi?
answer_sw: GN 487A (iliyoanza Julai 2025) inapiga marufuku wageni kufanya: biashara ya jumla/reja reja, uhamishaji wa pesa za simu, ukarabati wa simu, saluni na ususi, na shughuli 11 nyingine zilizoorodheshwa kwenye amri. Biashara ya usambazaji mdogo inajumuishwa. Thibitisha orodha kamili na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What are the 15 business activities prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A?
answer_en: GN 487A (effective July 2025) prohibits non-citizens from conducting: wholesale/retail trade, mobile money transfers, phone repair, salon and hairdressing business, and 11 other activities listed in the order. Small distribution business is included. Confirm the full list with the Immigration Department.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: Hati ya uhamishaji wa hisa za kampuni (share transfer) ina ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Uhamishaji wa hisa za kampuni Tanzania una ushuru wa stempu. Ushuru huu unahesabiwa kwa asilimia ya thamani ya hisa zinazohamishwa. Kampuni na washirika wanapaswa kuhakikisha hati za uhamishaji wa hisa zimesajiliwa ipasavyo na ushuru wa stempu umelipwa ili uhamishaji uwe na nguvu ya kisheria.
question_en: Does a company share transfer instrument attract stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Transfer of company shares in Tanzania attracts stamp duty. This is calculated at a percentage of the value of shares being transferred. Companies and shareholders should ensure share transfer instruments are properly stamped and registered so the transfer has full legal effect.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or Companies Act amendment

question_sw: Mkurugenzi mgeni wa kampuni ya Tanzania (non-full time director) — PAYE au WHT?
answer_sw: Mkurugenzi asiye na wakati wote (non-full-time director) anayepokea ada ya mkurugenzi (director fees) — WHT ya 15% inatumika (si PAYE). Hii inatumika kwa wakurugenzi wa ndani NA wa nje ya nchi. Mkurugenzi mwenye wakati wote (full-time) anayepokea mshahara — PAYE inatumika. Angalia muundo wa malipo.
question_en: A foreign company director in Tanzania (non-full time director) — PAYE or WHT?
answer_en: A non-full-time director receiving director fees — 15% WHT applies (not PAYE). This applies to both resident and non-resident directors. A full-time director receiving a salary — PAYE applies. Check the payment structure.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

instruction: Nilinunua hisa za kampuni mwaka 2020 kwa TZS 5M, sasa ninaziuza kwa TZS 20M — kodi ni ngapi?
output: Faida inayotokana na uuzaji wa hisa (TZS 15M katika mfano huu) inaweza kuwa taxable chini ya Income Tax Act Tanzania. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa kiwango cha kodi halisi, msamaha wowote unaotumika, na tarehe ya kuwasilisha kwa TRA. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: QR code kwenye risiti ya EFD — wateja wangu wanaweza kuitumia vipi?
output: QR code kwenye kila risiti ya EFD inaweza kuscanwa na mteja yeyote kwa simu yake. Inampeleka kwenye portal ya TRA ambayo inathibitisha kwamba risiti hiyo ni halisi — si bandia. Faida kwa wateja: wanaweza kuthibitisha kwamba unalipa kodi na kutoa risiti halisi. Faida kwako kama mfanyabiashara: hujui risiti za bandia zikiwa zimetumika kwa jina lako.

question_sw: Adhabu gani inatumika ikiwa mwajiri halipi PAYE kwa wakati ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi?
answer_sw: Ikiwa PAYE haijalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata, adhabu ya 2.5% ya kiwango kisicholipwa inatumika kwa kila mwezi wa ucheleweshaji au sehemu ya mwezi. Zaidi ya hayo, riba ya kisheria inayowekwa na TRA (thibitisha kiwango cha sasa na TRA) inaongezwa kwenye kiasi kisicholipwa. Adhabu hizi zinaendelea kukusanyika hadi PAYE yote ilipwe. TRA pia ina mamlaka ya kuchukua hatua za kisheria dhidi ya mwajiri asiyetii.
answer_en: If PAYE is not paid by the 7th of the following month, a 2.5% penalty on the unpaid amount applies for each month or part of a month of delay. Additionally, statutory interest at the rate set by TRA (confirm current rate with TRA) is charged on the unpaid balance. These penalties continue to accumulate until the full PAYE is paid. TRA also has authority to take legal enforcement action against a non-compliant employer.
question_en: What penalty applies if an employer does not pay PAYE on time by the 7th of the month?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to penalty rates

question_sw: Ninaweza kukataa ombi la mteja kuzuia VAT kwenye invoice yangu?
answer_sw: Inategemea hali ya mteja wako. Kama mteja ni 'qualifying buyer' (serikali, taasisi ya serikali, au wakala aliyeteuliwa na TRA) — hana chaguo: wana wajibu wa kisheria wa kuzuia VAT. Huwezi kuwakatalia kisheria kuzuia VAT wanapostahili kufanya hivyo. Kama mteja ni kampuni ya kawaida isiyokuwa 'qualifying buyer' — hawana haki ya kuzuia VAT na unaomba kwamba walipe VAT kamili.
question_en: Can I refuse a client's request to withhold VAT on my invoice?
answer_en: It depends on your client's status. If the client is a 'qualifying buyer' (government, government institution, or TRA-designated agent) — there is no choice: they have a legal obligation to withhold VAT. You cannot legally prevent them from withholding VAT when they are required to do so. If the client is an ordinary company that is not a 'qualifying buyer' — they have no right to withhold VAT and you should ask them to pay VAT in full.

question_sw: Nilikuwa na wafanyakazi 10 tangu miaka mitatu. SDL ninaidaiwa kutoka lini?
answer_sw: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — inadaiwa kutoka tarehe ulipofika wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Ikiwa umekuwa na wafanyakazi 10+ kwa miaka mitatu na hujawahi kulipa SDL, kuna uwezekano wa madai ya malimbikizo, faini, na riba. Wasiliana na TRA mara moja ili kutathmini hali yako na kupanga mpango wa kulipa madeni yaliyosalia.
question_en: I have had 10 employees for three years. From when am I liable for SDL?
answer_en: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — is owed from the date you reached 10 or more employees. If you have had 10+ employees for three years and have never paid SDL, there may be outstanding assessments, penalties, and interest. Contact TRA immediately to assess your situation and arrange a payment plan for any arrears.

question_sw: Kiwango cha WHT kwa riba ya benki ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: WHT kwa riba ya benki inayolipwa kwa mkazi ni asilimia 10. Kwa wasio wakazi, kiwango ni pia asilimia 10. Benki inayolipa riba kwenye akaunti ya akiba inalazimika kukata WHT ya asilimia 10 na kuipeleka TRA kabla ya kulipa riba kwa mwenyekiti wa akaunti.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on bank interest?
answer_en: WHT on bank interest paid to a resident is 10%. For non-residents the rate is also 10%. A bank paying interest on a savings account must deduct 10% WHT and remit it to TRA before paying interest to the account holder.

question_sw: Baada ya kuzidi kizingiti cha VAT, ninaweza kuendelea kufanya biashara wakati wa kusubiri TRA kunisajili?
answer_sw: Unaweza kuendelea na biashara LAKINI lazima uanze kutunza kumbukumbu za mauzo yako vizuri kuanzia siku uliyozidi kizingiti. Kwa vitendo: huwezi kukusanya VAT rasmi kutoka kwa wateja mpaka usajili ukamilike — lakini unastahili kufanya hivyo baada ya usajili. TRA inaweza kukuambia ulipe VAT ya kipindi chote tangu ulipozidi kizingiti hata kabla ya usajili rasmi. Inashauriwa: funga mauzo mapya mpya baada ya kusajilishwa.
question_en: After exceeding the VAT threshold, can I continue trading while waiting for TRA to register me?
answer_en: You may continue trading BUT you must start keeping careful sales records from the day you exceeded the threshold. Practically: you cannot formally collect VAT from customers until registration is complete — but you should do so after registration. TRA may ask you to pay VAT for the entire period since you exceeded the threshold even before formal registration. Advisable: apply proper VAT from the date of registration.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni aliyekuwa Tanzania na sasa amerudi nyumbani — TRA inaweza kumpigia kodi baadaye?
answer_sw: Kama PAYE ilipwa vizuri wakati wa kufanya kazi Tanzania, hawezi kupigiwa kodi tena kwa mapato yale. Hata hivyo, kama kuna PAYE iliyokosekana au ukiukaji wa kodi, TRA inaweza kutaka kulipa hata baada ya kuondoka. Hii inaweza kuathiri visa ya kurudi Tanzania au mali zinazobaki Tanzania. Thibitisha usafi wa kodi kabla ya kuondoka.
question_en: A foreign employee who was in Tanzania and has now returned home — can TRA still tax them later?
answer_en: If PAYE was correctly paid during the period of work in Tanzania, they cannot be taxed again on that income. However, if there is unpaid PAYE or a tax violation, TRA may seek payment even after departure. This may affect future Tanzania visas or assets remaining in Tanzania. Verify clean tax status before departing.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Kiwango cha PAYE Kenya ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Sijui kuhusu PAYE Kenya — ninashughulikia maswali ya Tanzania Bara tu. Kwa taarifa za PAYE Kenya, wasiliana na KRA (kra.go.ke) au mshauri wa kodi wa Kenya. Je, unataka kujua kuhusu PAYE Tanzania? Bendi ya kwanza ya PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia 0 hadi TZS 270,000 kwa mwezi.
question_en: What is the PAYE rate in Kenya?
answer_en: I do not cover Kenya PAYE — I handle Tanzania Mainland questions only. For Kenya PAYE information, contact KRA (kra.go.ke) or a Kenyan tax adviser. Would you like to know about Tanzania PAYE? The first Tanzania PAYE band is 0% up to TZS 270,000 per month.

instruction: Mkandarasi (contractor) anayefanya kazi kwangu kwa miezi 2 — anahesabiwa katika kizingiti cha SDL?
output: Mkandarasi (independent contractor au freelancer) KAMA si mwajiriwa wa kawaida — anafanya kazi yake mwenyewe, ana wateja wengine, na hakuna mkataba wa ajira — kwa kawaida hawahesabiwi katika idadi ya wafanyakazi kwa SDL. SDL inalenga WAFANYAKAZI wa ajira ya kawaida (employees) — si wakandarasi huru. Hata hivyo, tofauti kati ya mwajiriwa na mkandarasi inaweza kuwa ngumu kisheria — TRA inaweza kuchunguza kama mtu anafanya kazi kwa mhusika mmoja tu kwa muda mrefu (kama mwajiriwa wa kweli). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na mshauri wa kazi.

instruction: Mgeni anayemiliki duka la saluni NA ukarabati wa simu — makosa mawili au moja chini ya GN 487A?
output: Shughuli mbili tofauti zinazopigwa marufuku zinaweza kuchukuliwa kama makosa mawili tofauti — saluni ni kosa moja, ukarabati wa simu ni kosa lingine. Hata hivyo GN 487A haisemi wazi kama shughuli mbili zinazokatazwa zinachukua kama kosa moja au mawili — hii ni tafsiri ya kisheria. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji. Korti itaona uzito wa jumla wa ukiukwaji. Kwa kila kosa, adhabu inaweza kuwa: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6. kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Adhabu ya jumla inaweza kuwa kubwa zaidi kwa makosa mengi. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Chama cha ushirika (cooperative society) kinalipa kodi gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Vyama vya ushirika vina mfumo maalum wa ushirika na kodi. Viwango vya kodi ya mapato na msamaha maalum unaotumika kwa SACCOS na ushirika wa kilimo unategemea muundo na mapato ya kila chama. Sina uhakika wa viwango vya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au Msajili wa Vyama vya Ushirika.
question_en: What taxes does a cooperative society pay in Tanzania?
answer_en: Cooperative societies have a special legal and tax framework. Income tax rates and special exemptions applicable to SACCOs and agricultural cooperatives depend on each society's structure and income. I am not certain of current rules. Verify with TRA or the Registrar of Cooperatives.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ina matawi matatu Dar es Salaam. Je, kila tawi linahitaji EFD yake?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kila tawi la biashara linahitaji EFD iliyosajiliwa yake — moja kwa moja na TRA na inayoonyesha jina la tawi na anwani yake. Huwezi kutumia EFD moja kwa matawi matatu. Kila tawi linatoa risiti zake tofauti na kupeleka taarifa zake tofauti kwa seva ya TRA. VAT returns zinaweza kuwasilishwa kwa pamoja (consolidated) ikiwa TRA inaruhusu, lakini EFD za kimwili lazima ziwe tofauti kwa kila tawi.
question_en: My company has three branches in Dar es Salaam. Does each branch need its own EFD?
answer_en: Yes. Each business branch requires its own registered EFD — individually registered with TRA showing the branch name and address. You cannot use one EFD for three branches. Each branch issues its own receipts and transmits its own data to TRA's server. VAT returns may be submitted consolidated if TRA permits, but physical EFDs must be separate for each branch.

instruction: Jirani yangu ananikopa pesa lakini hayarudishi — naweza fanya nini?
output: Sina uhakika ni mshauri bora kwa tatizo hili la kisheria la kibinafsi — hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya biashara na kodi. Kwa madai ya fedha kati ya watu binafsi, chaguzi lako ni: (1) wasiliana na Mahakama ya Mwanzo ya wilaya yako kwa madai madogo; (2) omba msaada wa mwanasheria wa madai ya kiraia. Kwa masuala ya biashara na kodi, mimi naweza kusaidia — lakini madai ya kibinafsi si eneo langu.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Kampuni mpya inaweza kuanza kufanya biashara kabla ya kupata Cheti cha Uanzishwaji — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kampuni haiwezi kufanya biashara kisheria kabla ya kupata Cheti cha Uanzishwaji (Certificate of Incorporation) kutoka BRELA. Mikataba iliyoingiwa kabla ya uanzishwaji inaweza kuwa batili au kuwabeba wakurugenzi kibinafsi. Subiri cheti kabla ya kuanza shughuli yoyote ya biashara.
question_en: Can a new company start trading before receiving its Certificate of Incorporation — is this true?
answer_en: No. A company cannot legally trade before receiving its Certificate of Incorporation from BRELA. Contracts entered before incorporation may be void or hold directors personally liable. Wait for the certificate before commencing any business activity.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: GN 487A ni tofauti na GN 605A — zinasemaje?
answer_sw: Ndio, hizi ni amri tofauti kabisa. GN 487A (Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025, inayofanya kazi kuanzia 28 Julai 2025) inazuia wageni kufanya biashara katika makundi 15 maalum. GN 605A (Wage Order 2025, iliyosajiliwa 13 Oktoba 2025, inayofanya kazi kuanzia 1 Januari 2026) inabainisha mishahara ya chini ya sekta mbalimbali kwa wafanyakazi wote Tanzania. GN 487A inahusu UMILIKI wa biashara; GN 605A inahusu MISHAHARA ya wafanyakazi. Kampuni inaweza kufuata GN 605A (kulipa mishahara sahihi) na bado kukiuka GN 487A (kama mmiliki ni mgeni katika sekta zilizozuiliwa).
question_en: GN 487A and GN 605A are different — what does each say?
answer_en: Yes, these are completely different Orders. GN 487A (Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, effective 28 July 2025) prohibits non-citizens from operating businesses in 15 specific categories. GN 605A (Wage Order 2025, gazetted 13 October 2025, effective 1 January 2026) sets minimum wages across various sectors for all workers in Tanzania. GN 487A concerns business OWNERSHIP; GN 605A concerns worker WAGES. A company can comply with GN 605A (paying correct wages) and still violate GN 487A (if the owner is a non-citizen in a prohibited sector).
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Mteja alinipa malipo ya M-Pesa usiku — je, ninatoa risiti kesho asubuhi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Risiti ya EFD inapaswa kutolewa wakati wa muamala au mara baada ya kupokea malipo — si kesho. Kuchelewesha kutoa risiti kwa sababu malipo yalipokelewa usiku ni ukiukaji wa kanuni za EFD. EFD za kisasa zinaweza kutoa risiti usiku. Ikiwa EFD haikuweza kutumika usiku, tumia stakabadhi ya mkono ya dharura na uandike risiti ya EFD asubuhi ukiiingiza muamala wa usiku.
question_en: A customer sent me M-Pesa payment at night — can I issue the receipt the next morning?
answer_en: No. An EFD receipt should be issued at the time of the transaction or immediately upon receiving payment — not the following day. Delaying receipt issuance because payment was received at night is a violation of EFD rules. Modern EFDs can issue receipts at night. If the EFD was unavailable at night, use an emergency manual receipt and issue the EFD receipt in the morning, entering the night-time transaction.

question_sw: Kamati ya usalama inahitajika kwa biashara zenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kamati ya usalama inahitajika kwa biashara zenye wafanyakazi 20 au zaidi — si 10. Kiwango cha 10 ni kwa USAJILI wa OSHA. Kiwango tofauti cha wafanyakazi 20 kinatumika kwa UUNDWAJI WA KAMATI ya usalama.
question_en: A safety committee is required for businesses with 10 or more employees — is this true?
answer_en: No. A safety committee is required for businesses with 20 or more employees — not 10. The threshold of 10 is for OSHA REGISTRATION. The separate threshold of 20 applies to establishing a SAFETY COMMITTEE.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Je, Tanzania ina viwango vitatu vya VAT: asilimia 0, asilimia 5, na asilimia 18?
answer_sw: Hapana. Tanzania ina viwango viwili tu vya VAT: asilimia 18 (kiwango cha kawaida) na asilimia 0 (zero-rated). Kuna pia bidhaa na huduma zilizo exempt (zimesamehewa) ambazo hazilipwi VAT kabisa. Hakuna kiwango cha asilimia 5 katika mfumo wa VAT wa Tanzania Bara.
question_en: Does Tanzania have three VAT rates: 0%, 5%, and 18%?
answer_en: No. Tanzania has only two VAT rates: 18% (standard rate) and 0% (zero-rated). There are also exempt supplies which are not subject to VAT at all. There is no 5% VAT rate in Tanzania Mainland's VAT system.

instruction: Withholding agents wote wanakata kiwango sawa, au kila mmoja ana kiwango chake?
output: Kiwango cha withholding ni kimoja kwa aina moja ya muamala — bidhaa vina kiwango kimoja na huduma vina kiwango kingine. Withholding agents wote wanaoteuliwa na TRA wanatakiwa kutumia viwango vilivyowekwa — hawana uhuru wa kuweka kiwango chao wenyewe. Kwa hesabu halisi ya kiwango kinachotumika kwenye biashara yako, thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: NSSF haijalipiwa kwa miezi mitatu — adhabu ni nini?
output: Adhabu ya kutolipa NSSF kwa wakati ni asilimia 5 kwa kila mwezi wa uchelewaji wa malipo. Adhabu hukusanyika kila mwezi — uchelewaji wa miezi mitatu unaweza kuwa na adhabu ya asilimia 15 ya kiasi kilichokosekana. Zaidi ya hayo, NSSF inaweza kufungua kesi dhidi ya mwajiri. Lipa malipo yote pamoja na adhabu haraka iwezekanavyo na wasiliana na NSSF kupanga mpango wa ulipaji kama haiwezekani kulipa mara moja.

question_sw: Kampuni ya kigeni inayosajiliwa Tanzania lazima iwe na anwani rasmi Tanzania — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni ya kigeni inayosajiliwa Tanzania lazima iwe na anwani rasmi ya Tanzania (registered address). Hii inaweza kuwa ofisi halisi au anwani ya wakala (registered agent). Anwani hii inatumika kwa mawasiliano ya BRELA na TRA.
question_en: A foreign company registering in Tanzania must have a formal Tanzania address — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. A foreign company registering in Tanzania must have a formal Tanzanian registered address. This can be an actual office or a registered agent's address. This address is used for BRELA and TRA correspondence.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Mgeni wa Uingereza anafanya kazi Tanzania kwa kampuni kubwa ya kimataifa — je, GN 487A inamhusu?
output: GN 487A inazuia raia wa kigeni kufanya biashara WENYEWE katika orodha ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku. Kama mgeni anafanya kazi kwa kampuni kama mwajiriwa wa kawaida (si mmiliki wala mbia), na shughuli ya kampuni si mojawapo ya 15 zilizokatazwa, GN 487A haihusiki moja kwa moja. Lakini kama mgeni ni mmiliki au mbia wa biashara katika orodha ya 15 — ndipo GN 487A inatumika. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Gari la biashara linaweza kukatwa kama gharama kwa kodi ya mapato? Kiwango cha uchakavu ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Magari yanayotumiwa kwa biashara yanaweza kukatwa kwa njia ya uchakavu (depreciation) kwenye kodi ya mapato ya kampuni. Kiwango cha uchakavu kwa magari (motor vehicles) chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato Tanzania ni asilimia 25 kwa mwaka kwa njia ya msingi unaopungua (reducing balance method). Kwa mfano, gari linalogharimu TZS 30,000,000: mwaka 1 = 25% × 30,000,000 = TZS 7,500,000 inakatwa. Mwaka 2 = 25% × 22,500,000 = TZS 5,625,000 inakatwa, na kadhalika. Sehemu ya matumizi ya kibinafsi (personal use) haiwezi kukatwa.
answer_en: Yes. Vehicles used for business can be deducted through depreciation (capital allowances) for corporation tax. The depreciation rate for motor vehicles under Tanzania's Income Tax Act is 25% per year using the reducing balance method. For example, a vehicle costing TZS 30,000,000: Year 1 = 25% × 30,000,000 = TZS 7,500,000 deducted. Year 2 = 25% × 22,500,000 = TZS 5,625,000 deducted, and so on. Any personal use portion cannot be deducted.
question_en: Can a business vehicle be deducted as an expense for income tax? What is the depreciation rate?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — motor vehicle depreciation ITA Cap.332
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to depreciation rates

instruction: Wakurugenzi wa kampuni wanalipa PAYE kama wafanyakazi wa kawaida?
output: Ndio — wakurugenzi wanaolipwa mshahara au posho (director fees) wanalipa PAYE. Wakurugenzi wa ndani (executive directors) wanaofanya kazi: PAYE kwa vipande vya kawaida. Wakurugenzi wasio wa kazi (non-executive, posho za mkutano tu): Mkazi → PAYE kwa vipande vya kawaida. Asiye mkazi → withholding tax 15% (si PAYE ya vipande). Vipande vya PAYE (kwa mwezi): Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 0 – 270,000 Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 270,001 – 520,000 Bendi 3 (20%): TZS 520,001 – 760,000 Bendi 4 (25%): TZS 760,001 – 1,000,000 Bendi 5 (30%): TZS 1,000,001 na zaidi.

question_sw: Mtanzania anayenusuru mgeni kukiuka GN 487A atapata adhabu gani?
answer_sw: Mtanzania anayenusuru raia wa kigeni kufanya biashara iliyokatazwa anakabiliwa na faini ya TZS 5,000,000 AU kifungo cha miezi 3 gerezani. Hizi si adhabu za mgeni mwenyewe (TZS 10M na miezi 6) — ni adhabu maalum kwa wanaowezesha ukiukaji.
question_en: What penalty does a Tanzanian face for facilitating a GN 487A violation?
answer_en: A Tanzanian who facilitates a non-citizen in conducting a prohibited business faces a fine of TZS 5,000,000 OR 3 months imprisonment. These are not the same as the penalties for the non-citizen themselves (TZS 10M and 6 months) — they are specific penalties for facilitators.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: Wafanyakazi wangu wa EPZ wanalipa PAYE kama wafanyakazi wa kawaida Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Wajibu wa PAYE kwa wafanyakazi wa kampuni za EPZ unashughulikiwa chini ya EPZ Act na mkataba wa EPZA na TRA — masharti yanaweza kuwa na tofauti muhimu na mfumo wa kawaida. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: EFD inafanya kazi bila umeme — kama umeme unakatika ninafanyaje?
output: EFD nyingi (hasa za kisasa) zina betri ya akiba au UPS inayoruhusu kufanya kazi kwa muda bila umeme. Hatua za kufuata wakati umeme unakatika: (1) Tumia betri ya EFD kama ipo — endelea kutoa risiti; (2) Kama EFD haifanyi kazi kabisa — andika rekodi za mikono ya kila muamala; (3) Unapopata umeme — ingiza rekodi za mikono kwenye EFD na unda risiti zilizokosekana (TRA ina mchakato wa 'recovery' transactions); (4) Toa habari TRA kama upotevu wa muda mrefu wa umeme ulikuzuia. Usiendelee na biashara bila rekodi yoyote. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na muuzaji wa EFD wako.

question_sw: Je, SDL ya 5% ipo kwenye sheria ya Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango cha SDL ni 3.5% — hakuna SDL ya 5% katika sheria ya Tanzania. Ikiwa mtu au mfumo unakuambia SDL ni 5%, hiyo ni kosa. Thibitisha na TRA au angalia Sheria ya Fedha ya hivi karibuni.
question_en: Is there a 5% SDL in Tanzanian law?
answer_en: No. The SDL rate is 3.5% — there is no 5% SDL in Tanzanian law. If anyone or any system tells you SDL is 5%, that is an error. Verify with TRA or check the latest Finance Act.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Biashara ndogo yenye wafanyakazi 5 Tanzania inahitaji kulipa mchango wa SDL?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL (Skills Development Levy) inatumika kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 AU ZAIDI kwenye Mainland Tanzania. Biashara yenye wafanyakazi 5 tu HAIHITAJIKI kulipa SDL. Ikiwa biashara itakua na kufikia wafanyakazi 10, basi itaanza kulipa SDL ya asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara kila mwezi.
question_en: Does a small business with 5 employees in Tanzania need to pay SDL?
answer_en: No. SDL (Skills Development Levy) applies to employers with 10 OR MORE employees on Mainland Tanzania. A business with only 5 employees is NOT required to pay SDL. Once the business grows to reach 10 employees, it then starts paying SDL at 3.5% of total gross payroll monthly.

question_sw: Mauzo ya VAT ya sifuri (zero-rated) yanaonekana vipi kwenye EFD Tanzania?
answer_sw: Mauzo yanayostahili kiwango cha sifuri cha VAT (zero-rated) yanaingizwa kwenye EFD kwa kiwango cha 0% — si msamaha. Tofauti kati ya zero-rated na exempt: mauzo ya zero-rated yanaonyeshwa kwenye tamko la VAT na yanakuruhusu kudai VAT ya pembejeo (input VAT) unayolipa. Mauzo ya exempt hayaonyeshwi kwa madhumuni ya VAT na hayakuruhusu kudai input VAT. EFD lazima iwe na programu inayoweza kutofautisha kati ya zero-rated, exempt, na standard-rated.
question_en: How do zero-rated VAT sales appear on an EFD in Tanzania?
answer_en: Sales qualifying for zero-rated VAT are entered in the EFD at 0% rate — not as exempt. The difference between zero-rated and exempt: zero-rated sales appear on the VAT return and allow you to reclaim input VAT you paid. Exempt sales are not shown for VAT purposes and don't allow input VAT reclaim. The EFD must have software that can distinguish between zero-rated, exempt, and standard-rated.

question_sw: Msaada wa kibinafsi (personal relief) wa PAYE ni Shilingi 400,000 kwa mwaka — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Msaada wa kibinafsi wa PAYE kwa mkazi wa Tanzania ni Shilingi 270,000 kwa mwaka — si Shilingi 400,000. Hii inamaanisha mwaka wa mapato ya kwanza kabla ya kutolipwa PAYE ni Shilingi 3,240,000 kwa mwaka (Shilingi 270,000 × 12). Kiwango cha Shilingi 400,000 si sahihi.
question_en: The personal PAYE relief is TZS 400,000 per year — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The personal PAYE relief for a Tanzania resident is TZS 270,000 per year — not TZS 400,000. This means the first TZS 3,240,000 annual income (TZS 270,000 × 12) is tax-free. The figure of TZS 400,000 is incorrect.

instruction: Sekta ya benki za biashara — mshahara wa chini kwa GN605A ni ngapi?
output: Kulingana na GN605A, viwango vilivyothibitishwa kwa sekta ya benki za biashara (commercial banks) ni TZS 733,000 kwa mwezi. Kiwango hiki kilianza Januari 2026. Ikiwa una wafanyakazi wa benki, hakikisha mshahara wao wa chini hauteremki chini ya kiwango hiki. Kwa subsekta maalum za benki, thibitisha kwenye GN605A yenyewe.

question_sw: Nimekuwa nikifanya biashara ya ukarabati wa simu kama mgeni kwa miaka 3 — GN 487A inanihusu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, inakuhusu. GN 487A haikutoa kipindi cha mpito kwa biashara zilizokuwepo. Tangu 28 Julai 2025 unahitajika kutii sheria mara moja — haijalishi ulikuwa ukifanya biashara kwa muda gani. Idara ya Uhamiaji ilifanya zoezi la ukaguzi kati ya 11 Septemba na 8 Oktoba 2025. Adhabu: faini ya chini ya TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa visa. Wasiliana na wakili wa uhamiaji haraka.
question_en: I have been running a phone repair business as a foreigner for 3 years — does GN 487A apply to me?
answer_en: Yes, it applies to you. GN 487A provided no grace period for pre-existing businesses. From 28 July 2025 you were required to comply immediately regardless of how long you had been operating. The Immigration Services Department ran a compliance exercise from 11 September to 8 October 2025. Penalties: minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, visa revocation. Contact an immigration lawyer urgently.

instruction: Sekta yangu ya kilimo (crop/animal) — mshahara wa chini ni ngapi kulingana na GN605A?
output: Kulingana na GN605A, viwango vilivyothibitishwa kwa sekta ya kilimo (kilimo cha mazao/wanyama) ni TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi — hii ni kiwango cha msingi cha sekta hii. Kiwango hiki kilianza kutumika Januari 2026. Viwango vya sekta ndogo (subsekta) maalum vinaweza kutofautiana — thibitisha viwango vya subsekta yako mahususi kwenye GN605A au kwa Ofisi ya Kazi.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi aliyeumia kazini Tanzania anapata kiasi gani cha fidia kutoka WCF?
answer_sw: Kiasi cha fidia ya WCF Tanzania kinategemea: aina ya jeraha au ulemavu, asilimia ya ulemavu iliyoamuliwa na daktari wa WCF, na mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Fidia kwa ulemavu wa kudumu wa asilimia 100 ni miaka fulani ya mshahara (kiwango kilichowekwa na Workers Compensation Act). Fidia ya kifo cha mfanyakazi inajumuisha malipo ya mkupuo na malipo ya mwenzi/watoto. Angalia WCF kwa jedwali la fidia la hali ya sasa.
question_en: How much compensation does an injured Tanzanian worker receive from WCF?
answer_en: The amount of WCF compensation in Tanzania depends on: the type of injury or disability, the percentage of disability assessed by a WCF-appointed doctor, and the worker's wage. Compensation for 100% permanent disability is a set number of years of wages (amount prescribed by the Workers Compensation Act). Death compensation includes a lump sum payment and spouse/children payments. Check WCF for the current compensation schedule.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu inajaribu kuorodhesha wafanyakazi kama wakandarasi kuepuka PAYE. Hatari gani?
answer_sw: Kutoa hali ya ukandarasi kwa mfanyakazi halisi (misclassification) ni ukwepaji wa kodi kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato Tanzania. TRA ina mamlaka ya: kutoa tathmini ya PAYE ya nyuma kwa miaka yote ya ukandarasi wa uongo, kuongeza adhabu ya 100% ya PAYE iliyokosekana, kutoza riba ya 16% kwa mwaka kwa kila mwezi uliopita, na kufungua mashtaka ya jinai dhidi ya watendaji wa kampuni. Kanuni ya kutumia ni: kama ukweli wa hali unaonyesha ajira, ni ajira — jina la mkataba halibadilishi hali ya kisheria.
answer_en: Labelling a genuine employee as a contractor (misclassification) is tax evasion under Tanzania's Income Tax Act. TRA has authority to: issue a back assessment of PAYE for all years of false contractor status, add a 100% penalty on the missing PAYE, charge 16% per annum interest for every month that has passed, and open criminal proceedings against company officers. The test to apply is: if the facts of the situation show employment, it is employment — the name of the contract does not change the legal status.
question_en: My company is trying to classify employees as contractors to avoid PAYE. What is the risk?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — misclassification risk and penalties

instruction: Mgeni mwenye duka la rejareja na mke wake ni Mtanzania — ndoa hiyo inamlinda dhidi ya GN 487A?
output: Hapana — ndoa na raia wa Tanzania HAIBADILISHI hadhi ya uraia wala haki za biashara chini ya GN 487A. GN 487A inazuia raia wa kigeni kufanya biashara katika orodha ya 15 — bila kujali hali ya ndoa. Hata kama mwenzi ni Mtanzania, mgeni bado anakabiliwa na marufuku. Njia pekee halali: biashara isajiliwe na kumilikiwa KIKAMILIFU na mwenzi Mtanzania, mgeni asidhibiti, asimame, wala asipate faida kutoka biashara hiyo. Hata hilo linaweza kuonekana kama 'uwezesha' na kuchunguzwa. Adhabu: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: TRA inaweza kukagua biashara yangu bila notisi ya awali — je, hii inaruhusiwa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRA ina mamlaka ya kukagua biashara bila notisi ya awali katika hali fulani. Hata hivyo, kwa ukaguzi wa kawaida wa hesabu (audit), TRA mara nyingi hutoa notisi na ratiba. Wakaguzi wa TRA wana haki ya kuangalia rekodi za kodi, akaunti za benki, na hati za biashara.
question_en: Can TRA audit my business without prior notice — is this permitted?
answer_en: Yes. TRA has authority to audit a business without prior notice in certain circumstances. However, for a routine accounts audit, TRA usually provides notice and a schedule. TRA auditors have the right to examine tax records, bank accounts, and business documents.

question_sw: Thamani ya ardhi yangu inakadiriwa vipi kwa ajili ya stamp duty Tanzania?
answer_sw: Mbinu ya kukadiri thamani ya ardhi kwa ajili ya stamp duty inahitaji ujuzi wa kitaalamu wa tathmini ya mali — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Ninajua kwamba stamp duty inahesabiwa kwenye thamani ya soko ya mali lakini njia ya kufikia thamani hiyo (tathmini rasmi, njia ya soko, tathmini ya serikali) inahitaji mtaalam wa mali isiyohamishika (registered valuer) au mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: How is the value of my land assessed for stamp duty purposes in Tanzania?
answer_en: The methodology for valuing land for stamp duty requires specialist property valuation expertise — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. I know that stamp duty is calculated on the market value of property but the way to arrive at that value (formal valuation, market approach, government assessment) requires a registered property valuer or legal adviser.

question_sw: GN 605A inahusu wafanyakazi wa sekta ya kilimo?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Sekta ya kilimo imejumuishwa katika GN 605A. Kiwango halisi cha mshahara wa chini kwa kilimo kinatofautiana na sekta nyingine — thibitisha kiwango cha sasa kwa sekta ya kilimo na MLYWF.
question_en: Does GN 605A apply to workers in the agricultural sector?
answer_en: Yes. The agricultural sector is included in GN 605A. The exact minimum wage for agriculture differs from other sectors — confirm the current agricultural sector rate with MLYWF.

question_sw: Je, refund ya VAT inaathiri faida ya kodi ya mapato (corporate tax)?
answer_sw: VAT refund si mapato ya biashara — haipunguzi wala kuongeza kodi ya mapato. VAT ni kodi tofauti na kodi ya mapato ya makampuni. Hata hivyo, utunzaji wa kumbukumbu za VAT na kodi ya mapato ya makampuni unaunganika — makosa ya VAT yanaweza kusababisha ukaguzi wa kodi ya mapato pia.
question_en: Does a VAT refund affect corporate income tax?
answer_en: A VAT refund is not business income — it does not reduce or increase corporate tax. VAT is a separate tax from corporate income tax. However, VAT and corporate tax record-keeping are interconnected — VAT errors can also trigger a corporate tax audit.

question_sw: Posho ya chakula (meal allowance) haikodiwi PAYE ikiwa inatolewa kila siku — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kwa ujumla. Posho ya chakula inayolipwa kwa pesa moja kwa moja kwa mfanyakazi kwa kawaida inajumuishwa kama mapato yanayotoza PAYE. Chakula kinachotolewa mahali pa kazi moja kwa moja (kama canteen au mlo wa bure) kinaweza kuwa na matibabu tofauti. Mazingira ya kila kampuni yanaweza kutofautiana — tathmini na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: A daily meal allowance paid in cash is not subject to PAYE — is this true?
answer_en: Not as a general rule. A meal allowance paid as cash directly to the employee is generally included as PAYE-taxable income. Meals provided in-kind at the workplace (such as a canteen or free meal) may have different treatment. Each company's specific circumstances may vary — assess with a tax adviser.

instruction: Biashara ya mitumba (second-hand clothes) — inafaa kwa mgeni?
output: GN 487A inakataza shughuli 15 kwa wasio raia Tanzania. Biashara ya mitumba (second-hand clothing/goods) ipo kwenye orodha ya marufuku ya GN 487A. Mgeni hawezi kuendesha biashara hii Tanzania Bara. Biashara ya mitumba ni sekta iliyohifadhiwa kwa raia wa Tanzania. Adhabu kwa mgeni: faini ya TZS 10M au zaidi + kifungo cha miezi 6 + kufutwa kwa visa. Adhabu kwa Mtanzania anayemsaidia: faini TZS 5M au kifungo miezi 3.

question_sw: Je, SDL ni bima au ushuru?
answer_sw: SDL ni ushuru (levy/tax) — si bima. Tofauti na NSSF (ambayo ni bima ya pensheni) au WCF (bima ya ajali), SDL ni malipo ya serikali yanayokwenda TRA na VETA. Haitoi fidia ya moja kwa moja kwa mfanyakazi yeyote.
question_en: Is SDL insurance or a tax?
answer_en: SDL is a levy/tax — not insurance. Unlike NSSF (which is pension insurance) or WCF (workplace accident insurance), SDL is a government payment that goes to TRA and VETA. It does not provide direct compensation to any individual employee.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: SDL inalipwa lini kwa mwezi — tarehe 7 au 20?
answer_sw: SDL inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata — si tarehe 20. Tarehe ya 20 ni ya VAT return. SDL na PAYE zinalipwa kabla ya tarehe 7, na VAT kabla ya tarehe 20. Zisije zikachanganywa.
question_en: When is SDL paid each month — by the 7th or the 20th?
answer_en: SDL is paid by the 7th of the following month — not the 20th. The 20th is the VAT return deadline. SDL and PAYE are paid before the 7th, and VAT before the 20th. Do not confuse them.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Z-report ya EFD ni nini na inahitajika kila siku?
answer_sw: Z-report (au Z-reading) ni taarifa ya mwisho wa siku inayotolewa na EFD baada ya shughuli za biashara kuisha. Inaonyesha: jumla ya mauzo ya siku, jumla ya VAT iliyokusanywa, na namba ya risiti za kwanza na za mwisho za siku. Z-report lazima itolewe kila siku ya biashara na kupelekwa kwenye seva ya TRA. Kutotoa Z-report ni ukiukaji wa kanuni za EFD.
question_en: What is a Z-report on EFD and is it required daily?
answer_en: A Z-report (or Z-reading) is the end-of-day report generated by the EFD after business activity closes. It shows: total daily sales, total VAT collected, and the first and last receipt numbers of the day. A Z-report must be generated every business day and transmitted to TRA's server. Failure to generate a Z-report is a violation of EFD regulations.

instruction: TRA inaweza kuniuliza kuhakikisha miamala yangu na kampuni mama ni ya 'arm's length' — hii inamaanisha nini kwa vitendo?
output: Kanuni ya msingi ya transfer pricing Tanzania ni arm's length principle katika Income Tax Act Sehemu 33 — miamala kati ya kampuni zinazohusiana lazima ifanane na bei za soko. Kwa uchambuzi wa kesi yako: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Kanuni ya arm's length katika transfer pricing inahitaji tathmini ya miamala na kulinganisha na bei za soko — hii ni mada ya kodi ya kimataifa inayohitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Malipo gani yanastahili PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: PAYE inakata: mshahara wa msingi, ujira wa ziada (overtime), posho (allowances — nyumba, usafiri, chakula), bonasi, motisha, na thamani ya manufaa kama vile gari la kampuni au nyumba ya kampuni. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What payments are subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE applies to: basic salary, overtime pay, allowances (housing, transport, meals), bonuses, incentives, and the value of benefits such as company car or company housing. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu alianguka na kuumia dukani — WCF inasaidiaje?
answer_sw: Taarisha WCF kuhusu ajali hii ndani ya siku saba (7) za kazi. WCF italipa: gharama za hospitali na dawa, na posho ya mfanyakazi wakati wa kupumzika kutokana na majeraha. Pia taarisha OSHA kama majeraha ni makubwa — ndani ya masaa 24. Hifadhi nyaraka zote za hospitali kama ushahidi.
question_en: My employee fell and was injured in the shop — how does WCF help?
answer_en: Report the accident to WCF within 7 working days. WCF will pay: hospital and medicine costs, and an allowance for the employee during recovery. Also notify OSHA if the injuries are serious — within 24 hours. Keep all hospital documents as evidence.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: WCF inashughulikia matukio ya dharura tu — kama maumivu ya kawaida, mfanyakazi hana haki — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kwa ujumla. WCF inashughulikia majeraha na magonjwa yanayotokana na KAZI — sio matukio ya dharura tu. Maumivu ya kawaida yanayotokana na kazi (kama maumivu ya mgongo kutokana na kuketi muda mrefu, au maumivu ya mkono kutokana na kujirudiarudia) yanaweza kustahili madai ya WCF.
question_en: WCF only covers emergency incidents — for normal aches, the employee has no rights — is this true?
answer_en: Not as a general rule. WCF covers injuries and WORK-CAUSED conditions — not just emergency incidents. Common work-related pains (such as back pain from prolonged sitting, or hand strain from repetitive movements) can qualify for WCF claims.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Je, VAT withholding inatumika kwa wote Tanzania au kwa makampuni maalum tu?
answer_sw: VAT withholding inatumika kwa makampuni maalum tu — wale waliopewa leseni ya 'designated withholding agent' na TRA. Si makampuni yote. Kawaida ni taasisi za serikali na makampuni makubwa ya sekta binafsi yaliyochaguliwa na TRA. Kama hujapewa leseni hiyo, huhitajiwi kuzuia VAT. Kiwango cha VAT kwako bado ni asilimia 18 ya kawaida.
question_en: Does VAT withholding apply to everyone in Tanzania or only specific companies?
answer_en: VAT withholding applies only to specific companies — those designated as 'withholding agents' by TRA. Not all companies. Typically these are government institutions and selected large private sector companies chosen by TRA. If you have not been designated as a withholding agent, you are not required to withhold VAT. Your VAT rate remains the standard 18%.

instruction: Malipo ya NSSF yanawasilishwa TRA au NSSF moja kwa moja?
output: Malipo ya NSSF yanawasilishwa moja kwa moja kwa NSSF — si TRA. NSSF ina mfumo wake wa ukusanyaji. Mwajiri anaweza kulipa kupitia benki au mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa NSSF (nssf.or.tz). Tofauti na PAYE na SDL ambazo zinakwenda TRA, NSSF inakwenda shirika lake la mfuko wa pensheni. Hakikisha unapeleka malipo kwenye akaunti sahihi ya NSSF.

Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: Ninataka kuuza jengo langu la biashara Tanzania — capital gains tax inahesabiwaje?
output: Faida inayotokana na uuzaji wa mali kama ardhi, hisa, au majengo inaweza kuwa taxable chini ya Income Tax Act Tanzania. Hesabu halisi inategemea thamani ya ununuzi (cost base), thamani ya uuzaji, na hali yako kama mkazi au asiye mkazi. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Uhesabuji wa capital gains tax kwa mali za biashara unashughulikiwa chini ya Income Tax Act na unahitaji tathmini maalum ya thamani ya mali na gharama za msingi. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Mtu wa nje anafanya biashara ya kutengeneza nguo na kuziuza — je, ni tatizo?
answer_sw: Inategemea. Uzalishaji wa viwanda (manufacturing) — kama kushona na kutengeneza nguo — si moja ya sekta 15 zilizozuiliwa wazi na GN 487A. Hata hivyo, KUUZA nguo moja kwa moja kwa wateja (retail) au kwa wachuuzi (wholesale) ni tatizo kwa sababu biashara ya jumla na rejareja imezuiliwa. Mgeni anayeshona nguo na kuziuza moja kwa moja katika duka lake anaweza kukiuka GN 487A upande wa uuzaji. Anashauriwa kupata ushauri wa kisheria ili kuelewa vizuri muundo sahihi wa biashara yake.
question_en: A non-citizen runs a clothes manufacturing and selling business — is this a problem?
answer_en: It depends. Industrial manufacturing — such as sewing and making clothes — is not one of the 15 explicitly prohibited sectors under GN 487A. However, SELLING clothes directly to customers (retail) or to traders (wholesale) is a problem because wholesale and retail trade is prohibited. A non-citizen who makes clothes and sells them directly from their own shop may violate GN 487A on the selling side. They are advised to get legal advice to understand the correct business structure.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Ninalipa bima ya biashara kila mwaka — je, kuna ushuru wa insurance premium levy Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ushuru wa bima (insurance premium levy) Tanzania — viwango, malipo, na taasisi inayopokea — ni mada tofauti nje ya wigo wangu wa VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants. Wasiliana na Mamlaka ya Usimamizi wa Bima (TIRA) kupitia tira.go.tz au mshauri wa bima aliyehitimu kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Biashara inayofanya rejareja ya dawa (pharmacy) Tanzania inahitaji aina maalum ya EFD?
answer_sw: Maduka ya dawa (pharmacy) Tanzania yanayofanya mauzo ya dawa lazima yatumie EFD kama biashara nyingine zilizolazimishwa. Bidhaa za dawa fulani zinaweza kuwa huru ya VAT (exempt) au za kiwango cha sifuri — EFD lazima iwe na programu inayoweza kuuainisha kwa usahihi. Pia, pharmacy inaweza kuhitaji leseni maalum ya TMDA mbali na EFD ya TRA. Angalia TRA na TMDA kwa mahitaji yote yanayohusika.
question_en: Does a pharmaceutical retail business (pharmacy) in Tanzania need a special type of EFD?
answer_en: Pharmacies in Tanzania making medicine sales must use an EFD like other mandatory businesses. Certain pharmaceutical products may be VAT-exempt or zero-rated — the EFD must have software that can correctly categorise them. Also, a pharmacy may need a specific TMDA licence separate from TRA's EFD. Check TRA and TMDA for all applicable requirements.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD pharmacy or TMDA sector update

question_sw: Mgeni aliyefukuzwa (deported) kabla ya kulipa faini yake — je, faini hiyo inaendelea kuwepo?
answer_sw: GN 487A haishughulikii hali hii moja kwa moja. Kwa kanuni za jumla za jinai Tanzania, uamuzi wa korti unabaki halali hata baada ya mtu kufukuzwa. Kwa vitendo, utekelezaji wa faini dhidi ya mtu aliyefukuzwa ni mgumu na unaweza kuhitaji ushirikiano wa kisheria wa kimataifa. Hukumu na amri ya visa kufutwa zinabaki kwenye rekodi. Kwa ushauri mahususi wasiliana na wakili wa Tanzania au Idara ya Uhamiaji. — hii ni tatizo la kawaida la kisheria kimataifa. Tanzania inaweza kujaribu kutekeleza uamuzi wa korti kupitia njia za kisheria za kimataifa, lakini hii ni ngumu vitendo. Kufukuzwa huzuia utekelezaji wa muda mfupi lakini uamuzi wa korti unabaki halali.
question_en: A non-citizen was deported before paying their fine — does the fine still exist?
answer_en: GN 487A does not address this scenario directly. Under general Tanzanian criminal procedure, a court order remains legally valid regardless of deportation. In practice, enforcement of a fine against a deported person is difficult and may require international legal cooperation. The conviction and visa revocation order remain on record. For specific advice consult a Tanzanian lawyer or the Immigration Department. — this is a common international legal challenge. Tanzania may attempt to enforce the court order through international legal channels, but this is difficult in practice. Deportation prevents short-term enforcement but the court order remains legally valid.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mnunuzi wa nyumba Tanzania anahitaji kulipa ushuru wa stempu na VAT kwenye ununuzi huo — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: VAT na ushuru wa stempu ni makodi tofauti na yanaweza yakatumika wakati mmoja kwenye ununuzi wa mali. VAT kwa kawaida inatumika ikiwa muuzaji ni msajiliwa wa VAT na mauzo yanastahili VAT (kwa mfano, mali mpya kutoka msanidi aliyesajiliwa). Ushuru wa stempu wa asilimia 1 unatumika kwenye uhamishaji wenyewe wa hati. Ni muhimu kuelewa kila moja kando na mwanasheria au mtaalamu wa mali.
question_en: A Tanzania home buyer needs to pay both stamp duty and VAT on the purchase — is this true?
answer_en: VAT and stamp duty are separate taxes and both can apply simultaneously to a property purchase. VAT generally applies if the seller is VAT-registered and the sale is taxable (for example, new property from a registered developer). The 1% stamp duty applies to the transfer instrument itself. It is important to understand each separately with a lawyer or property specialist.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or VAT/stamp duty update

question_sw: Posho ya nyumba inayolipwa kwa mfanyakazi mgeni — ni mapato yanayolazimika PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Posho ya nyumba (housing allowance) inachukuliwa kama sehemu ya mapato ya ajira na inabeba PAYE. Hii inatumika kwa wafanyakazi wote — raia na wageni. Posho ya nyumba inajumlishwa pamoja na mshahara wa msingi kwa madhumuni ya kuhesabu PAYE.
question_en: Housing allowance paid to a foreign employee — is it subject to PAYE?
answer_en: Yes. Housing allowance is treated as employment income and is subject to PAYE. This applies to all employees — citizens and foreigners. Housing allowance is added to basic salary for the purpose of calculating PAYE.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi mgeni anayeondoka Tanzania atapata pensheni yake ya NSSF?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, mchangiaji wa NSSF ana haki ya manufaa baada ya kufikia miaka ya kustaafu na masharti ya muda wa michango. Hata hivyo, wageni wanaohama wanaweza kuwa na matatizo ya kupata manufaa kama hawakufikia miaka ya kustaafu Tanzania. Thibitisha hali yako maalum na NSSF kuhusu uhamisho wa manufaa au payout ya awali.
question_en: A foreign employee leaving Tanzania — will they receive their NSSF pension?
answer_en: Generally, an NSSF contributor has benefit rights after reaching retirement age and meeting contribution period requirements. However, departing foreigners may face challenges in accessing benefits if they have not reached retirement age in Tanzania. Confirm your specific situation with NSSF about benefit transfer or early payout options.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu hulipwa na nani — mnunuzi au muuzaji?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida Tanzania, ushuru wa stempu kwenye uhamishaji wa ardhi hulipwa na MNUNUZI (mpokeaji wa hati). Hata hivyo, pande zote mbili zinaweza kukubaliana juu ya mgawanyo wa gharama hii katika mkataba wa mauzo. TRA inatazamia kwamba ushuru umelipwa kabla ya hati kusajiliwa au kutumika kisheria.
question_en: Who pays stamp duty — the buyer or the seller?
answer_en: Generally in Tanzania, stamp duty on land transfer is paid by the BUYER (the recipient of the instrument). However, both parties can agree on how to share this cost in the sale agreement. TRA expects the duty to be paid before the instrument is registered or used legally.

instruction: Kiwango cha juu zaidi cha mshahara wa chini Tanzania kwa sekta gani na ni ngapi?
output: Kulingana na GN605A, kiwango cha juu zaidi kilichothibitishwa ni kwa sekta ya nishati (energy) ya makampuni ya kimataifa — TZS 765,900 kwa mwezi. Kiwango hiki kilianza Januari 2026 baada ya GN605A kubatilisha amri ya 2022 iliyokuwa na viwango vya chini zaidi.

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari — kanuni ngumu tatu za VAT ambazo kila mfanyabiashara lazima azijue.
answer_sw: Kanuni tatu ngumu (hard rules) za VAT Tanzania: (1) EXEMPT = HAKUNA input VAT — ukitoa huduma/bidhaa za exempt, huwezi kudai input VAT inayohusiana nazo, bila ubaguzi; (2) USAJILI WA LAZIMA MARA MOJA — ukizidi kizingiti cha TZS 200M/miezi 12 au TZS 100M/miezi 6, wasiliana na TRA leo — usichelewesha; (3) BIASHARA ISIYOSAJILIWA HAIKUSANYI VAT — ni kinyume cha sheria kuweka VAT kwenye invoice kama hujasajiliwa.
question_en: Summary — three hard VAT rules every business person must know.
answer_en: Three hard rules of Tanzanian VAT: (1) EXEMPT = NO input VAT — if you supply exempt services/goods, you cannot claim related input VAT, no exceptions; (2) MANDATORY IMMEDIATE REGISTRATION — if you exceed TZS 200M/12 months or TZS 100M/6 months threshold, contact TRA today — do not delay; (3) UNREGISTERED BUSINESS DOES NOT CHARGE VAT — it is against the law to put VAT on invoices if you are not registered.

instruction: Certificate ya VAT withholding ni nini na kwa nini inahitajika?
output: Cheti cha VAT withholding ni hati rasmi inayotolewa na mnunuzi anayehitimu kwa msambazaji, inayothibitisha kiasi cha VAT kilichokatwa. Msambazaji anahitaji certificate hii kama ushahidi wa pembejeo ya VAT (input VAT credit) ambayo anaweza kudai kwenye VAT return yake. Bila certificate, msambazaji hawezi kuthibitisha VAT iliyokatwa kwake.

instruction: Mkanda wa biashara kwenye mtandao (online store) unaomilikiwa na mgeni — GN 487A inasema nini?
output: Online store ya rejareja inayomilikiwa na mgeni Tanzania inakabiliwa na GN 487A kwa sababu: (1) Biashara ya rejareja (orodha ya 1) imezuiwa kwa wageni — nje ya mtandao au mtandaoni; (2) GN 487A inazingatia MMILIKI wa biashara, si eneo la biashara au njia ya kuuza. Online store inayofikia wateja wa Tanzania na inayomilikiwa na mgeni anayeishi Tanzania inaweza kukiuka GN 487A — lakini hii ni tafsiri ya kisheria kwani GN 487A haisemi wazi kuhusu biashara za mtandaoni. Kama mmiliki yuko nje ya Tanzania kabisa na hafikii Tanzania moja kwa moja — hali inaweza kuwa ngumu kisheria. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara.

instruction: Biashara imesajiliwa kwa jina la mwanachama wa kwanza wa SACCOS — mgeni anayenufaika ni tatizo la GN 487A?
output: Ndiyo — GN 487A inazingatia MNUFAIKA (beneficiary) wa kweli wa biashara, si tu jina katika hati za kisheria. Kama mgeni anatonufaika na biashara, kupokea faida, au kudhibiti maamuzi — hata kama biashara imesajiliwa chini ya jina la mwanachama wa SACCOS au mtu mwingine — hii inaweza kuonekana kama ukiukwaji. Idara ya Uhamiaji na mahakama wanaweza kuchunguza 'beneficial ownership' — nani anafaidika kweli kweli. Hii inaitwa ukiukwaji wa 'substantive' bila kujali 'formal structure'. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Provisional tax inalipwa kwa awamu 3 kwa mwaka — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kodi ya awali (provisional tax) inalipwa kwa awamu 4 kwa mwaka — si 3. Awamu zinapaswa kulipwa: tarehe 31 Machi, 30 Juni, 30 Septemba, na 31 Desemba. Kampuni inayolipa kwa awamu 3 itakuwa na makosa ya malipo na inaweza kuadhibiwa.
question_en: Provisional tax is paid in 3 instalments per year — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Provisional tax (advance income tax) is paid in 4 instalments per year — not 3. Instalments are due: 31 March, 30 June, 30 September, and 31 December. A company paying in only 3 instalments will have an underpayment error and may be penalised.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to provisional tax

question_sw: Kwa nini ni muhimu kushughulikia PAYE ya mfanyakazi mgeni vizuri tangu mwanzo?
answer_sw: Kushughulikia PAYE ya mfanyakazi mgeni vizuri kunamlinda mwajiri kutoka: adhabu za 2.5%/mwezi, ukaguzi wa TRA, madai ya nyuma ya PAYE, na tatizo za kisheria. Pia kunamlinda mfanyakazi mgeni kutoka deni la kodi la kibinafsi. Makosa yanayogunduliwa baadaye (hasa baada ya mfanyakazi kuondoka) ni ngumu na gharama zaidi kutatua.
question_en: Why is it important to handle a foreign employee's PAYE correctly from the start?
answer_en: Handling a foreign employee's PAYE correctly from the start protects the employer from: 2.5%/month penalties, TRA audits, backdated PAYE claims, and legal problems. It also protects the foreign employee from personal tax liabilities. Errors discovered later (especially after the employee has left) are harder and more expensive to resolve.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Mfanyakazi kutoka Kenya anafanya kazi Dar es Salaam — wajibu wa NSSF ni wa Tanzania au Kenya?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi kutoka Kenya anayefanya kazi Tanzania Bara analipa NSSF ya Tanzania — si NSSF ya Kenya. Wajibu unafuata mahali pa kazi (lex loci laboris). Mwajiri wa Tanzania analipa 10% ya mshahara na kukata 10% kutoka kwa mfanyakazi, kisha kuwasilisha NSSF Tanzania. Hata hivyo, kama mfanyakazi amepewa kwa muda mfupi, kanuni za EAC Portability of Social Security zinaweza kutumika — wasiliana na NSSF.
question_en: An employee from Kenya works in Dar es Salaam — is the NSSF obligation Tanzania's or Kenya's?
answer_en: An employee from Kenya working on Mainland Tanzania pays Tanzania NSSF — not Kenya's. The obligation follows the place of work (lex loci laboris). The Tanzanian employer pays 10% of the wage and deducts 10% from the employee, then remits to Tanzania NSSF. However, if the employee is on a short-term secondment, EAC Portability of Social Security rules may apply — contact NSSF.

instruction: Wakala wa mali isiyohamika (real estate agent) anayepata commission — anapaswa kusajili VAT?
output: Wakala wa mali isiyohamika anayepokea commission kwa huduma za udalali (brokerage services) anakabiliwa na: (1) Kama mapato ya commission yanazidi TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6 → lazima asajili VAT na atoe tax invoice; (2) Kama ni mwanachama wa taaluma inayolazimishwa (kama Valuers Registration Board) → anaweza kulazimika kusajili VAT hata bila kufika kizingiti. Commission yenyewe si mali isiyohamika — ni huduma ya udalali inayopaswa kulipwa VAT (18%) kama amefika kizingiti. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na Valuers Registration Board Tanzania.

instruction: SDL inalipwa kwa taasisi gani — NSSF, TRA, au mwingine?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inalipwa kwa TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority) — si NSSF wala taasisi nyingine. Hii ndiyo chanzo cha mkanganyiko mkubwa: SDL → TRA; NSSF → NSSF (Mfuko wa Pensheni); WCF → WCF Authority (Mfuko wa Fidia za Wafanyakazi). Kila moja ni taasisi tofauti, malipo tofauti, na taratibu tofauti za kuwasilisha. SDL inalipwa kupitia mfumo wa TRA (kama PAYE) — kwa kawaida katika fomu moja ya pamoja ya malipo ya kodi. Tarehe ya mwisho ya SDL ni 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutotoa risiti ya EFD ni nini?
answer_sw: Kutotoa risiti ya EFD kwa muamala wa mauzo ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya VAT Tanzania. TRA ina mamlaka ya kutoza faini, kusimamisha leseni ya biashara, au kuchukua hatua nyingine za kisheria dhidi ya biashara inayokiuka sheria hii. Ukaguzi wa TRA (tax audit) unaweza kutokea wakati wowote, na muamala wowote usiokuwa na risiti ya EFD unaweza kutafsiriwa kama kukimbia kodi. Thibitisha kiasi halisi cha faini na TRA kwani kinaweza kubadilika baada ya Finance Act ya kila mwaka.
question_en: What is the penalty for not issuing an EFD receipt?
answer_en: Failing to issue an EFD fiscal receipt for a sales transaction is a violation of Tanzania's VAT law. TRA has the authority to impose fines, suspend business licences, or take other legal action against a non-compliant business. TRA inspections can happen at any time, and any transaction without an EFD receipt may be treated as tax evasion. Confirm the specific penalty amounts with TRA as they may change.
next_review_trigger: After Finance Act July 2026 for updated penalty amounts

question_sw: Mashirika mapya ya biashara hayana ukaguzi wa TRA kwa miaka 3 ya kwanza — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Hakuna kanuni ya kisheria inayompa biashara mpya ruhusa ya miaka 3 bila ukaguzi wa TRA. TRA inaweza kukagua biashara yoyote — mpya au ya zamani — wakati wowote inapoona inafaa. Biashara mpya zinapaswa kuhifadhi rekodi sahihi tangu siku ya kwanza.
question_en: New businesses are free from TRA audits for the first 3 years — is this true?
answer_en: No. There is no legal provision giving new businesses a 3-year audit exemption from TRA. TRA can audit any business — new or established — at any time it considers appropriate. New businesses must maintain accurate records from day one.

instruction: Usajili wa VAT — ninafanya wapi na inahitaji nini?
output: Usajili wa VAT unafanywa kupitia TRA: (1) Nenda tra.go.tz au ofisi ya TRA iliyo karibu. (2) Hati zinazohitajika: TIN yako, cheti cha usajili wa BRELA, akaunti ya benki ya biashara, hati ya utambulisho wa mmiliki/wakurugenzi. (3) Baada ya usajili: TRA inakupa nambari ya VAT (VAT registration number). (4) Nunua na usajili EFD. (5) Anza kutoa invoice za VAT kwa wateja wako na kuwasilisha VAT return kila mwezi tarehe 20.

question_sw: Biashara ndogo Tanzania inapaswa kutenganisha akaunti ya biashara na akaunti ya mwenye biashara — serikali inaweza kukagua akaunti yake binafsi?
answer_sw: TRA inaweza kuomba mahakama ruhusa ya kukagua akaunti za benki za mshukiwa wa ukwepaji wa kodi — ikiwa ni pamoja na akaunti za kibinafsi zikionekana kuwa biashara inafanya shughuli kupitia akaunti binafsi. Hii ni sababu nzuri zaidi ya kuhifadhi biashara na fedha za kibinafsi tofauti. Akaunti tofauti za benki zinazuia uchunguzi usiohitajika na zinahifadhi faragha ya kibinafsi.
question_en: Should a small Tanzania business separate the business account from the owner's personal account — can the government audit the personal account?
answer_en: TRA can seek court authorisation to examine bank accounts of a tax evasion suspect — including personal accounts if the business appears to be operating through personal accounts. This is another strong reason to keep business and personal funds separate. Separate bank accounts prevent unnecessary scrutiny and protect personal privacy.
next_review_trigger: Tax Administration Act audit power update

question_sw: Kampuni ya usafirishaji wa baharini (shipping company) inalipa kodi gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Makampuni ya usafirishaji wa baharini yana mfumo maalum wa kodi wa kimataifa. Tanzania ina maeneo ya ushirikiano na vyama vya usafirishaji wa baharini. Sina uhakika wa mfumo wa kodi wa sasa kwa shipping companies Tanzania. Thibitisha na TRA au mwanasheria wa usafirishaji wa baharini.
question_en: What taxes does a maritime shipping company pay in Tanzania?
answer_en: Maritime shipping companies have a specialized international tax framework. Tanzania has cooperation arrangements with maritime shipping associations. I am not certain of the current tax framework for shipping companies in Tanzania. Verify with TRA or a maritime lawyer.

instruction: Mgeni ana biashara ya upigaji picha LAKINI wafanyakazi wake wote ni Watanzania — adhabu ya GN 487A bado inatumika?
output: Ndiyo — GN 487A inazingatia mmiliki/mdhibiti wa biashara, si muundo wa wafanyakazi. Kama mgeni ndiye mmiliki, mdhibiti, au anayenufaika na biashara ya upigaji picha — sheria inatumika bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi Watanzania waliohusika. Hata biashara inayoajiri Watanzania 20 inakiuka GN 487A kama mmiliki mkuu ni mgeni. Adhabu: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Mwajiri wangu hakusajili NSSF tangu nilipoingia kazi — nina haki ya kudai chochote?
output: Ndiyo. Una haki ya kudai mchango wako wote wa NSSF uliokosekana. Hatua: (1) ripoti kwa NSSF (nssf.or.tz) ukitoa ushahidi wa miaka ya kazi (karatasi za mshahara, barua ya ajira, n.k.); (2) NSSF itachunguza na kuamrisha mwajiri wako kulipa mchango wote pamoja na adhabu; (3) unaweza pia wasiliana na Ofisi ya Kazi. Haki yako ya uanachama wa NSSF inalindwa kisheria — usikae kimya.

question_sw: Je, raia wa kigeni anaweza kufanya biashara ya uhamisho wa pesa za simu (mobile money)?
answer_sw: Hapana. Uhamisho wa pesa za simu (mobile money transfers) ni mojawapo ya makundi 15 yaliyopigwa marufuku kwa raia wa kigeni chini ya GN 487A, kuanzia 28 Julai 2025. Biashara ya wakala wa mobile money (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa na kadhalika) inahifadhiwa kwa raia wa Tanzania tu. Raia wa kigeni anayeendelea na biashara hii anakabiliwa na faini ya chini ya TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa visa. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji au wakili.
question_en: Can a non-citizen operate a mobile money transfer business in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Mobile money transfers is one of the 15 categories prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A from 28 July 2025. Mobile money agent businesses (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa, etc.) are reserved for Tanzanian citizens only. A non-citizen continuing this business faces a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. Confirm with the Immigration Services Department or a lawyer.

question_sw: Je, STR inatumika kwa bidhaa za mazao ya bahari (samaki, pweza)?
answer_sw: Bidhaa za mazao ya bahari zinaweza kuwa kwenye Common List, lakini hali inategemea aina maalum ya bidhaa. Samaki safi na bidhaa za bahari zinazozalishwa ndani ya EAC kwa ujumla zinaweza kustahili — lakini thibitisha na ofisi ya forodha kama aina yako mahususi ipo kwenye Common List ya sasa.
question_en: Does STR apply to marine products (fish, octopus)?
answer_en: Marine products may be on the Common List, but eligibility depends on the specific type. Fresh fish and marine products produced within EAC can generally qualify — but verify with the customs office whether your specific type is on the current Common List.

instruction: Mfanyakazi wangu ni mgeni (non-resident) — PAYE yake inahesabiwaje?
output: Mfanyakazi asiye mkazi Tanzania (non-resident employee) analipa PAYE tofauti: Kiwango: asilimia 15 ya jumla ya mshahara — kiwango kimoja tu (flat rate). Si vipande (progressive bands) kama wakazi. Mfano: mshahara wa TZS 1,000,000 → PAYE = TZS 150,000 (15%). Mgeni wa kazi: hakuna msamaha wa Bendi 1 (TZS 270,000 ya kwanza haitasamehewa). Vipande vya PAYE (kwa mwezi): Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 0 – 270,000 Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 270,001 – 520,000 Bendi 3 (20%): TZS 520,001 – 760,000 Bendi 4 (25%): TZS 760,001 – 1,000,000 Bendi 5 (30%): TZS 1,000,001 na zaidi.

question_sw: Mnunuzi wa biashara (buyer of a going concern) anachukua madeni ya kodi ya muuzaji Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ikiwa mnunuzi ananunua BIASHARA (going concern) au hisa za kampuni — anaweza kuchukua madeni ya kodi ya zamani ya muuzaji ikiwa muamala umefanywa vibaya. Mnunuzi LAZIMA: (1) omba uthibitisho wa TRA wa kukosekana kwa madeni ya kodi kabla ya kununua, (2) fanya ukaguzi wa kina (due diligence) wa uzingatiaji wa kodi, (3) pangia mkataba wa mauzo unaomba mnunuzi awe na dhamana dhidi ya madeni ya kodi ya kabla ya mauzo. Kutofanya hivyo kunaweza kukufanya ulipie madeni ya kodi ya mmiliki wa zamani.
question_en: Does a buyer of a business (going concern) take on the seller's tax debts in Tanzania?
answer_en: If a buyer purchases a BUSINESS (going concern) or company shares — they may inherit the seller's historical tax debts if the transaction is done poorly. The buyer MUST: (1) request a TRA tax clearance certificate showing no outstanding debts before buying, (2) conduct thorough tax compliance due diligence, (3) structure the sale contract to indemnify the buyer against pre-sale tax debts. Failing to do so can result in paying the previous owner's tax debts.

instruction: Sijui kama mbia wangu ni withholding agent. Nifanye nini?
output: Angalia: je, mbia wako ni wizara ya serikali, benki, kampuni ya simu, au taasisi ya umma? Hawa mara nyingi ni wanunuzi wanaohitimu kama withholding agents. Kama huna uhakika, uliza TRA moja kwa moja au angalia tra.go.tz. Kujua hili ni muhimu kwa sababu itaathiri jinsi unavyoandaa VAT return yako.
