Tanzania's VAT registration threshold is TZS 200 million in any 12-month period, or TZS 100 million in any 6-month period (TRA.go.tz). Your TZS 250 million turnover exceeds this threshold, so you must register for VAT promptly. Note: Lawyers, accountants, engineers, and architects must register for VAT regardless of their turnover. Contact TRA directly to begin the process.

question_sw: Je, kumwambia mgeni 'tumia jina langu kwenye biashara' ni msaada wa kisheria?
answer_sw: Hapana — hii ni mfano wa kawaida wa 'kuwezesha' (facilitating) kwa maana ya GN 487A. Kuruhusu mgeni kutumia jina lako kusajili biashara au kuendesha biashara inayofanywa kweli na mgeni kunakufanya 'msaidizi' chini ya GN 487A. Adhabu yako kama msaidizi: hadi TZS 5,000,000 AU kifungo hadi miezi 3. Mbinu hii ya 'dawa ya siri' ni maarufu lakini ni kosa la kisheria.
question_en: Is telling a non-citizen 'use my name for the business' legal assistance?
answer_en: No — this is a classic example of 'facilitating' within the meaning of GN 487A. Allowing a non-citizen to use your name to register a business or run a business actually operated by a non-citizen makes you a 'facilitator' under GN 487A. Your penalty as a facilitator: up to TZS 5,000,000 OR imprisonment up to 3 months. This 'secret medicine' method is popular but is a criminal offence.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Biashara ya mkoba mdogo ya Kariakoo — ikiwa inafanya mauzo ya TZS 30M kwa mwaka tu — je, inahitaji EFD?
answer_sw: Biashara yenye mauzo ya TZS 30M kwa mwaka iko chini ya kizingiti cha VAT cha TZS 200M. Kwa hivyo, HAIHITAJIKI kusajili VAT. Ikiwa haijasajili VAT na TRA haijaitambua kwa amri maalum ya EFD, biashara hiyo HAIHITAJIKI kuwa na EFD. Hata hivyo, ikiwa sekta yake imo kwenye orodha ya TRA ya sekta zinazolazimika kutumia EFD bila kujali mauzo, basi EFD inahitajika. Angalia TRA na sekta yako.
question_en: A small bag seller in Kariakoo making only TZS 30M sales per year — do they need an EFD?
answer_en: A business with TZS 30M annual sales is below the VAT threshold of TZS 200M. Therefore, it is NOT required to register for VAT. If not VAT-registered and TRA has not designated it with a specific EFD directive, that business is NOT required to have an EFD. However, if its sector is on TRA's list of sectors required to use EFD regardless of sales, then an EFD is required. Check TRA and your sector.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD threshold and sector mandate update

question_sw: Je, PAYE inatumika kwa mfanyakazi anayepata mshahara wa chini wa Shilingi 358,322?
answer_sw: Kwa mshahara wa Shilingi 358,322 kwa mwezi, PAYE inaweza kulipwa au la kulingana na mwaka — kwa sababu kiwango cha kwanza cha PAYE cha asilimia sifuri kinaendelea hadi Shilingi 270,000. Sehemu inayozidi Shilingi 270,000 inalipwa kwa kiwango cha asilimia 8. Hesabu: (358,322 - 270,000) × 8% = Shilingi 7,066 za PAYE kwa mwezi.
question_en: Does PAYE apply to an employee earning the TZS 358,322 minimum wage?
answer_en: At TZS 358,322 per month some PAYE is due — the zero-rate band ends at TZS 270,000. The amount above TZS 270,000 is taxed at 8%. Calculation: (358,322 - 270,000) × 8% = TZS 7,066 PAYE per month.

instruction: Wafanyakazi wa mkataba wa muda mfupi (casual workers) wanahesabiwaje kwa SDL?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Wafanyakazi wa muda mfupi wanaopewa mishahara: mishahara yao inajumuishwa katika hesabu ya SDL kama wengine. Kama wafanyakazi wako wote (wa kudumu + wa muda mfupi) wanafikia 10+, SDL inahitajika. Thibitisha ufafanuzi wa 'mfanyakazi' na TRA kwa hali yako maalum.

question_sw: Kodi ya forodha (customs duty) kwa kuagiza simu 100 kutoka China ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Viwango vya ushuru wa forodha (customs duty) kwa bidhaa maalum vinasimamiwa na Tanzania Revenue Authority — Idara ya Forodha na Kenya/EAC tariff schedules — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Viwango vinatofautiana kulingana na HS code ya bidhaa, nchi ya asili, na makubaliano ya kikanda (EAC). Wasiliana na TRA — Idara ya Forodha au mwingizi wa forodha (clearing agent) aliyehitimu.
question_en: How much customs duty applies to importing 100 mobile phones from China?
answer_en: Customs duty rates for specific goods are governed by Tanzania Revenue Authority — Customs Department and EAC tariff schedules — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Rates vary depending on the HS code of the goods, country of origin, and regional agreements (EAC). Contact TRA — Customs Department or a licensed clearing agent.
next_review_trigger: EAC or national customs tariff changes

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya kiwango cha usajili wa OSHA (wafanyakazi 10) na kiwango cha kamati ya usalama (wafanyakazi 20) ni nini?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha 10 ni kwa USAJILI rasmi wa biashara yako na OSHA — kupata cheti cha OSHA. Kiwango cha 20 ni kwa KUUNDA KAMATI ya usalama ndani ya biashara. Kwa hivyo biashara yenye wafanyakazi 10-19 inasajiliwa na OSHA lakini haihitaji kamati ya usalama. Biashara yenye wafanyakazi 20+ inahitaji vyote viwili.
question_en: What is the difference between the OSHA registration threshold (10 employees) and the safety committee threshold (20 employees)?
answer_en: The threshold of 10 is for formal OSHA REGISTRATION of your business — obtaining an OSHA certificate. The threshold of 20 is for ESTABLISHING A SAFETY COMMITTEE inside the business. So a business with 10-19 employees registers with OSHA but doesn't need a safety committee. A business with 20+ needs both.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Kampuni ya uwekezaji wa nje iliyopo kwenye SEZ (Special Economic Zone) — je, inalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Kampuni zilizo ndani ya Special Economic Zone (SEZ) — kama vile EPZ — zinaweza kupata msamaha wa SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) kama sehemu ya vivutio vya uwekezaji. Msamaha wa SEZ unathibitishwa na EPZA (Export Processing Zones Authority). Omba barua ya uthibitisho wa msamaha kutoka EPZA na nakala ya uthibitisho kutoka TRA kabla ya kusimama kulipa SDL.
question_en: A foreign-invested company in a Special Economic Zone (SEZ) — does it pay SDL?
answer_en: Companies within a Special Economic Zone (SEZ) — such as EPZ — may be exempt from SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) as part of the investment incentives package. SEZ exemptions are confirmed by EPZA (Export Processing Zones Authority). Obtain a written exemption letter from EPZA and a copy of TRA confirmation before stopping SDL payments.

question_sw: Biashara iliyosajili VAT lazima iwasilishe tamko la VAT hata kama haikufanya mauzo mwezi huo Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara iliyosajili VAT Tanzania lazima iwasilishe tamko la VAT kwa TRA kila mwezi bila kujali kama ilifanya mauzo au la. Tamko la sifuri (nil return) linawasilishwa ikiwa hakuna mauzo. Tarehe ya mwisho ni tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kushindwa kuwasilisha nil return kunasababisha adhabu kama vile kutokufanya mauzo hakumaanishi tamko halikuhitajika.
question_en: Must a VAT-registered business file a VAT return even if it made no sales that month in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. A VAT-registered business in Tanzania must file a VAT return with TRA every month regardless of whether it made sales or not. A nil return is filed if there were no sales. The deadline is the 20th of the following month. Failing to file a nil return attracts penalties just as if sales had been made but not reported.
next_review_trigger: Tax Administration Act VAT filing update

question_sw: Mgeni anayefanya biashara ya jumla (wholesale) anasema sheria inazuia rejareja tu — si jumla. Ana haki?
answer_sw: Hapana — ana kosa kubwa. GN 487A inapiga marufuku BIASHARA ZA JUMLA NA REJAREJA zote mbili. Orodha ya biashara 15 zilizopigwa marufuku inajumuisha wazi biashara ya jumla na biashara ya rejareja kama makundi tofauti. Mgeni anayeendesha jumla anakiuka GN 487A kama vile mwenye duka la rejareja. Jibu hili 'jumla tu inaruhusiwa' ni hatari na si kweli.
question_en: A non-citizen wholesale trader says the law only prohibits retail, not wholesale. Are they correct?
answer_en: No — they have a serious misunderstanding. GN 487A prohibits BOTH wholesale AND retail trade. The list of 15 prohibited categories explicitly includes wholesale trade and retail trade as separate categories. A non-citizen running wholesale is violating GN 487A just as much as a retail shop owner. The claim 'only retail is prohibited' is dangerous and incorrect.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Leseni ya halmashauri (LGA) iliyotolewa 2024 inalinda mgeni dhidi ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. Leseni za halmashauri zinahusu kufuata kanuni za biashara za eneo — si uraia wa mmiliki. GN 487A ni amri ya kitaifa inayozidi leseni za halmashauri. Hata leseni kamili ya 2024 hailindi mgeni dhidi ya GN 487A baada ya 28 Julai 2025.
question_en: Does an LGA business licence issued in 2024 protect a non-citizen from GN 487A?
answer_en: No. LGA licences address local business compliance — not the owner's citizenship. GN 487A is a national order that supersedes LGA licences. Even a complete 2024 licence does not protect a non-citizen from GN 487A after 28 July 2025.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Mimi ni CPA (Certified Public Accountant) aliyesajiliwa. Je, lazima nisajili VAT hata kama sina wateja wengi?
answer_sw: NDIYO — kama CPA aliyesajiliwa chini ya sheria ya Tanzania, lazima usajili VAT BILA KUJALI kiasi cha mauzo yako. Kanuni hii inazuia fani zilizoidhinishwa (regulated professions) kama vile wahasibu walioidhinishwa, mawakili, wahandisi, madaktari, na wasanifu majengo. Kizingiti cha kawaida cha TZS 200M kwa miezi 12 kinatumika kwa biashara za kawaida — si kwa fani zilizoorodheshwa.
question_en: I am a registered CPA (Certified Public Accountant). Must I register for VAT even if I have few clients?
answer_en: YES — as a registered CPA under Tanzanian law, you must register for VAT REGARDLESS of the amount of your fees. This rule covers regulated professions such as certified accountants, lawyers, engineers, doctors, and architects. The standard threshold of TZS 200M per 12 months applies to ordinary businesses — not to the listed regulated professions.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing VAT registration rules for professionals

question_sw: WCF 0.5% ya mishahara inalipwa kwa pamoja na michango ya NSSF — mwajiri analipa kila mmoja kwa nguzo tofauti — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, mwajiri analipa NSSF na WCF kwa njia tofauti na mifumo tofauti: NSSF inalipwa kwa NSSF moja kwa moja kupitia mfumo wa NSSF au benki iliyoidhinishwa, tarehe 10 ya kila mwezi. WCF inalipwa kwa WCF moja kwa moja kupitia mfumo wa WCF (portal.wcf.go.tz). Kila chombo cha serikali kina kumbukumbu yake na tarehe zake za malipo. Hakuna malipo ya pamoja ya NSSF+WCF kwenye dirisha moja.
question_en: The WCF 0.5% of payroll is paid together with NSSF contributions — the employer pays each to a different account — is this correct?
answer_en: Yes, an employer pays NSSF and WCF through different channels and systems: NSSF is paid directly to NSSF through the NSSF system or an approved bank, by the 10th of each month. WCF is paid directly to WCF through the WCF system (portal.wcf.go.tz). Each government body has its own records and payment dates. There is no combined NSSF+WCF payment at one window.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania
next_review_trigger: NSSF or WCF payment system update

instruction: Nilinunua Bitcoin mwaka 2023 na kuuza mwaka 2025 kwa faida — lazima nilipe kodi Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Kodi ya mapato kwa faida ya cryptocurrency ni mada tofauti ambayo bado inaboreshwa kisheria Tanzania. BoT (Bank of Tanzania) na TRA ndiyo mamlaka zinazohusika. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz, na BoT kupitia bot.go.tz.

question_sw: Biashara inayotumia EFD haitahitaji kuwasilisha tamko la VAT kwa TRA kwa sababu EFD inapeleka data moja kwa moja — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. EFD inashiriki data ya mauzo na TRA kwa wakati halisi, lakini hii HAIONDOI wajibu wa biashara wa kuwasilisha tamko la VAT rasmi kila mwezi. Tamko la VAT bado linahitajika kuwasilishwa ndani ya tarehe 20 ya kila mwezi. EFD data ni rasilimali ya TRA ya ukaguzi — si mbadala wa tamko rasmi la VAT lililothibitishwa na biashara.
question_en: A business using an EFD will not need to file a VAT return with TRA because the EFD sends data directly — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The EFD shares sales data with TRA in real time, but this does NOT eliminate the business's obligation to file a formal VAT return monthly. A VAT return must still be filed by the 20th of each month. EFD data is TRA's audit resource — it is not a substitute for a formal VAT return confirmed by the business.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD and VAT return dual obligation update

question_sw: Mwezi mmoja nilifikia wafanyakazi 11, mwezi uliofuata nilikuwa na 8 kwa sababu ya kuacha kazi. Je, nililazimika kulipa SDL mwezi mzima wa kwanza?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwezi ulipokuwa na wafanyakazi 11 ulilazimika kulipa SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — kwa sababu ulifika kiwango cha chini cha 10. Mwezi uliofuata ulipokuwa na wafanyakazi 8 huhitajiwi tena kulipa SDL. SDL inatathminiwa kila mwezi kulingana na idadi halisi ya wafanyakazi wa mwezi husika.
question_en: One month I had 11 employees, the next I was down to 8 due to resignations. Was I required to pay SDL for the whole first month?
answer_en: Yes. The month you had 11 employees you were required to pay SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — because you met the threshold of 10 or more. The following month with 8 employees you are no longer required to pay SDL. SDL is assessed each month based on the actual employee count for that month.

question_sw: Mwajiri asiye na OSHA lakini ana WCF — anafuata sheria Tanzania?
answer_sw: Mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi 10+ analazimika kusajili OSHA NA WCF. Kusajili WCF tu bila OSHA (kwa mwajiri anayestahili OSHA) ni uzingatiaji wa sehemu tu — si kamili. OSHA na WCF zinafanya kazi tofauti: WCF inashughulikia bima ya fidia baada ya ajali; OSHA inashughulikia kuzuia ajali na usalama wa kila siku. Kusajili WCF PEKE YAKE hakumaanishi kwamba mwajiri amefuata sheria ya OSHA.
question_en: An employer with WCF but without OSHA — are they compliant in Tanzania?
answer_en: An employer with 10+ employees is required to register with BOTH OSHA AND WCF. Registering with WCF only without OSHA (for an employer who qualifies for OSHA) is only partial compliance — not full. OSHA and WCF do different things: WCF handles accident compensation insurance after an injury; OSHA handles accident prevention and daily safety. Having WCF ALONE does not mean an employer has complied with OSHA law.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Je, SDL inahusu likizo yoyote — likizo ya ulemavu, ugonjwa, au uzazi?
answer_sw: Hapana kabisa. SDL haihusu aina yoyote ya likizo — wala ulemavu, wala ugonjwa, wala uzazi. Skills Development Levy inahusiana na ushuru tu, si haki za likizo. Haki za likizo (ugonjwa, uzazi, ulemavu) zinasimamia na ELRA (Employment and Labour Relations Act) — si SDL.
question_en: Does SDL relate to any type of leave — disability leave, sick leave, or maternity leave?
answer_en: Absolutely not. SDL has nothing to do with any type of leave — disability, sick, or maternity. Skills Development Levy is purely a tax levy, not an employment leave entitlement. Leave rights are governed by ELRA (Employment and Labour Relations Act) — not SDL.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Kodi ya Huduma za Kidijitali (Digital Service Tax — DST) ni nini na inatumika kwa biashara gani?
answer_sw: DST ni kodi ya asilimia 2 kwenye mapato ghafi ya huduma za kidijitali zinazotolewa Tanzania (iliyoanzishwa Finance Act 2022). Inatumika kwa: kampuni za nje zinazotoa huduma za kidijitali kwa wateja Tanzania (kama vile streaming, programu za mtandaoni, matangazo ya kidijitali), na makampuni ya ndani ya Tanzania yanayotoa huduma hizo hizo. DST inafanya kazi tofauti na VAT — DST inalipwa kwenye mapato ghafi, si thamani iliyoongezwa. Biashara zinazostahili lazima zisajiliwe kwa DST na TRA na wasilishe return za DST. Thibitisha kama huduma zako zinaathiriwa.
answer_en: DST is a 2% tax on gross revenue from digital services provided in Tanzania (introduced Finance Act 2022). It applies to: foreign companies providing digital services to Tanzanian customers (e.g. streaming, online software, digital advertising), and domestic Tanzanian companies providing the same services. DST works differently from VAT — DST is charged on gross revenue, not value added. Qualifying businesses must register for DST with TRA and file DST returns. Confirm whether your services are affected.
question_en: What is the Digital Service Tax (DST) and which businesses does it apply to?
primary_source_name: TRA — Digital Service Tax Finance Act 2022

instruction: Adhabu ya raia wa Tanzania aliyeruhusu mgeni kutumia jina lake kufungua duka — ni nini hasa?
output: Raia wa Tanzania anayewezesha mgeni kufanya biashara iliyokatazwa chini ya GN 487A anakabiliwa na: faini ya TZS milioni 5 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 3 — si zote mbili pamoja. Hii ni adhabu tofauti kabisa na ile ya mgeni (ambaye anaadhibiwa zaidi: TZS milioni 10 AU miezi 6, PAMOJA NA kufutwa kwa visa). Raia wa Tanzania hawezi kufutwa visa kwa sababu ana uraia — lakini adhabu ya jinai bado inatumika. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Ununuzi wa mafuta ya dizeli kwa matumizi ya biashara — input VAT inaweza kudaiwa?
answer_sw: Kwa biashara zilizoposajiliwa VAT zinazotumia mafuta kwa biashara (kwa magari ya biashara, mashine) — input VAT ya mafuta inaweza kudaiwa. Hata hivyo, kama mafuta yanatumika kwa gari la kibinafsi la msimamizi, input VAT haiwezi kudaiwa. Thibitisha matumizi ya mafuta na uhifadhi kumbukumbu nzuri.
question_en: Purchases of diesel fuel for business use — can input VAT be claimed?
answer_en: For VAT-registered businesses using fuel for business purposes (business vehicles, machinery) — input VAT on fuel can be claimed. However, if fuel is used for a personal executive vehicle, input VAT cannot be claimed. Verify fuel usage and maintain good records.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Watumishi wa serikali hawajumuishwi na PAYE — wanalipwa mshahara kamili bila makato — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Watumishi wa serikali wanajumuishwa na PAYE kama wafanyakazi wengine. PAYE inakatwa kutoka mshahara wa watumishi wa serikali na kuwasilishwa TRA kwa njia ya Hazina kwa kawaida. Hakuna msamaha wa PAYE kwa ajira ya serikali.
question_en: Government employees are exempt from PAYE — they receive their full salary without deductions?
answer_en: No. Government employees are subject to PAYE like other employees. PAYE is deducted from government employees' salaries and remitted to TRA through Treasury. There is no PAYE exemption for government employment.

question_sw: Deadline ya kuwasilisha VAT return nchini Tanzania ni lini?
answer_sw: VAT return inatakiwa iwasilishwe TRA ifikapo siku ya 20 ya mwezi unaofuata baada ya kipindi cha ripoti. Kwa mfano, VAT return ya Januari iwasilishwe ifikapo 20 Februari. Ucheleweshaji unaweza kusababisha faini na riba. Thibitisha ratiba hii na TRA kwani inaweza kubadilika baada ya Finance Act.
question_en: What is the deadline for filing a VAT return in Tanzania?
answer_en: VAT returns must be submitted to TRA by the 20th of the month following the reporting period. For example, the January VAT return must be filed by 20 February. Late filing can result in penalties and interest charges. Confirm this schedule with TRA as it may change after each Finance Act.

instruction: Korti imemua mgeni asiye na uhia wa kulipa faini ya TZS milioni 10 — inaweza kubadilisha adhabu?
output: Korti ina uamuzi wa kuchagua kati ya faini AU kifungo chini ya GN 487A — si zote mbili. Kama mgeni hana uwezo wa kulipa, korti inaweza kuchagua kifungo badala yake (hadi miezi 6). Kiwango cha chini cha faini (TZS milioni 10) hakiwezi kupunguzwa na korti. Hata hivyo, chaguo lolote kati ya faini au kifungo, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Kampuni inanunua mashine ya TZS 50,000,000. Gharama ya mashine hiyo inakatwa kwa mwaka mmoja au inagawanywa miaka mingi?
answer_sw: Gharama ya mashine haiwezi kukatwa yote kwa mwaka mmoja. Inagawanywa kwa njia ya uchakavu (depreciation) kulingana na kiwango kilichoandikwa na TRA kulingana na darasa la mali. Kwa mfano, mashine za viwandani mara nyingi zinaangukia darasa la 37.5% kwa njia ya kufuta kwa msingi unaopungua (reducing balance method). Kiwango sahihi kinategemea aina ya mali. TRA inachapisha jedwali la madarasa ya mali na viwango vyake.
answer_en: The cost of machinery cannot be deducted entirely in one year. It is spread over multiple years through depreciation at rates prescribed by TRA according to the asset class. For example, industrial machinery typically falls in the 37.5% class under the reducing balance method. The exact rate depends on the asset type. TRA publishes a schedule of asset classes and their rates.
question_en: A company purchases machinery for TZS 50,000,000. Is the cost of the machinery deducted in one year or spread over many years?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to depreciation rates

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi kinaathiriwa na mabadiliko ya jina au muundo wa kampuni?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ikiwa kampuni inabadilisha jina au muundo wake (kwa mfano, uundaji upya au ununuzi na kampuni nyingine), vibali vya kazi vilivyopo vinaweza kuhitaji kusasishwa au kubadilishwa ili kuonyesha mabadiliko hayo. Mwajiri anapaswa kuwasiliana na Idara ya Uhamiaji mara tu mabadiliko ya muundo wa kampuni yanapotokea.
question_en: Is a work permit affected by a change of company name or structure?
answer_en: Yes. If a company changes its name or structure (for example, through a restructuring or acquisition), existing work permits may need to be updated or reissued to reflect the changes. The employer should contact the Immigration Department as soon as any corporate structural changes occur.

question_sw: Ajali za kazini zinaripotiwa ndani ya siku 7 — je, muda huu ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana kwa ajali kubwa. Ajali kubwa au za kifo lazima ziripotiwe kwa OSHA ndani ya masaa 24 — si siku 7. Kwa WCF (Workers Compensation Fund), muda wa kuripoti ni siku saba (7) za kazi. Muda wa masaa 24 unahusu OSHA peke yake na unatumika kwa ajali za haraka.
question_en: Workplace accidents are reported within 7 days — is this timeframe correct?
answer_en: No, not for serious accidents. Serious or fatal accidents must be reported to OSHA within 24 HOURS — not 7 days. For WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) the reporting period is 7 working days. The 24-hour window applies to OSHA specifically for urgent accidents.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: SDL na WCF — tofauti yao kuu nini na zinalipwa wapi?
answer_sw: SDL (Skills Development Levy, 3.5%): ushuru wa mafunzo ya ujuzi — inalipwa TRA na mwajiri, kwa wafanyakazi ≥10. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund, 0.5%): bima ya ajali za kazi — inalipwa WCF (taasisi tofauti), kwa wafanyakazi wote (kizingiti kinategemea sekta). Walipwa: TRA vs WCF. Lengo: mafunzo vs bima ya ajali. Viwango: 3.5% vs 0.5%.
question_en: SDL and WCF — what is their key difference and where are they paid?
answer_en: SDL (Skills Development Levy, 3.5%): a skills training levy — paid to TRA by the employer, for ≥10 employees. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund, 0.5%): workplace accident insurance — paid to WCF (a separate institution), for all employees (threshold depends on sector). Recipients: TRA vs WCF. Purpose: training vs accident insurance. Rates: 3.5% vs 0.5%.

question_sw: Je, GN 487A inazuia wageni kufanya kilimo Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kilimo kwa ujumla hakiko kati ya makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa wazi na GN 487A. Mgeni anaweza kufanya kilimo Tanzania — lakini kuna vizuizi vingine vya kisheria kama umiliki wa ardhi (sheria ya Tanzania inazuia wageni kumiliki ardhi moja kwa moja, wanaweza kukodisha tu) na makubaliano ya uwekezaji wa kilimo yanayohitaji idhini ya serikali. Hata hivyo, kama kilimo hicho kinajumuisha KUUZA mazao moja kwa moja kwa wateja kwa njia ya rejareja au jumla, sehemu hiyo ya biashara inaweza kukiuka GN 487A.
question_en: Does GN 487A prohibit non-citizens from farming in Tanzania?
answer_en: Farming in general is not among the 15 categories explicitly prohibited by GN 487A. A non-citizen can engage in farming in Tanzania — but there are other legal restrictions such as land ownership (Tanzania law restricts non-citizens from directly owning land; they can only lease) and agricultural investment agreements requiring government approval. However, if that farming involves SELLING produce directly to customers through retail or wholesale channels, that aspect of the business may violate GN 487A.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Bima ya afya (health insurance) inaathiriwa na insurance premium levy kama bima ya gari?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Aina za bima zinazoshughulikiwa na insurance premium levy Tanzania inashughulikiwa na TIRA na inahitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TIRA kupitia tira.go.tz.

instruction: Duka la rejareja (biashara ya jumla na rejareja) linamilikiwa na mgeni — ni ukiukwaji wa GN 487A?
output: Ndiyo — biashara ya rejareja (jumla na rejareja) ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A, iliyoanza tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Hii inajumuisha maduka ya bidhaa za jumla, maduka ya rejareja, na maduka yanayofanya biashara ya aina zote mbili. Mgeni anayemiliki au kudhibiti duka kama hilo anakabiliwa na: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Vatimbia yangu imeandika VAT 5% kwenye EFD — ninapaswa kubadilisha vipi?
output: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. EFD yenye kiwango cha 5% imeprogramiwa vibaya. Hatua: (1) Wasiliana na msambazaji wako wa EFD haraka. (2) Omba EFD irekebishwe kuonyesha 18% (au 0% kwa bidhaa zilizosamehewa). (3) EFD lazima iwe na viwango sahihi — risiti zenye 5% zinaweza kuleta matatizo na TRA.

question_sw: Originating status inamaanisha bidhaa yote ya malighafi kutoka EAC au inatosha kuzalishwa EAC?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, 'originating status' inamaanisha bidhaa zimepitia mchakato wa kutosha wa uzalishaji ndani ya nchi wanachama — si lazima malighafi yote kutoka EAC. Kwa bidhaa za kilimo zinazopandwa na kuvunwa ndani ya nchi wanachama, hii ni rahisi kuthibitisha. Kwa bidhaa zilizosindikwa, kanuni za asili (rules of origin) za EAC zinatoa mwongozo zaidi.
question_en: Does originating status mean all raw materials from EAC or is it enough to be produced in EAC?
answer_en: Generally, 'originating status' means goods have undergone sufficient processing within member states — not necessarily that all raw materials are from EAC. For agricultural goods grown and harvested within member states, this is straightforward to demonstrate. For processed goods, EAC rules of origin provide further guidance.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

instruction: Mgeni anafanya kazi ya delivery/ujumbe kwa kampuni ya kibiashara kama mwajiriwa — je, ni ukiukwaji wa GN 487A?
output: Inategemea: kama mgeni ni MWAJIRIWA tu (si mmiliki wala mbia) wa kampuni halali iliyosajiliwa, na kazi yake ni sehemu ya ajira ya kawaida — GN 487A huathiri zaidi wamiliki na wabia wa biashara. Lakini kama mgeni anaendesha biashara yake ya delivery wenyewe (self-employed), na hiyo ni mojawapo ya shughuli 10 (huduma za ujumbe na delivery) katika orodha ya 15 — ndipo GN 487A inatumika. Tofauti muhimu: mmiliki/mbia vs mwajiriwa. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Jirani yangu mgeni ana biashara ndogo ya kuchoma nyama — GN 487A inamhusu?
answer_sw: Inategemea jinsi biashara inavyoainishwa. Kuchoma na kuuza nyama kunaweza kuainishwa kama biashara ya rejareja ya chakula, ambayo ni moja ya sekta zilizozuiliwa. Kama jirani yako mgeni anafanya biashara hii kama mmiliki wake binafsi, labda anakiuka GN 487A. Hata hivyo, kama anafanya kazi kama mfanyakazi wa kampuni ya chakula inayomilikiwa na Mtanzania, hiyo si tatizo la GN 487A. Hali yake inategemea muundo halisi wa biashara. Ni bora ampeleke apate ushauri wa kisheria ili ajue kwa uhakika.
question_en: My foreign neighbour has a small nyama choma (grilled meat) stall — does GN 487A apply?
answer_en: It depends on how the business is classified. Grilling and selling meat may be classified as retail food business, which is one of the prohibited sectors. If your foreign neighbour operates this as their own individual business, they may be violating GN 487A. However, if they work as an employee of a Tanzanian-owned food company, that is not a GN 487A issue. Their situation depends on the actual business structure. It is best for them to get legal advice to know for certain.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anamaliza kazi baada ya miaka 10. Kampuni inalipa TZS 5,000,000 kama mafao ya mwisho. Je, PAYE inatolewa kwenye malipo hayo?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato, malipo ya mwisho wa kazi kama vile mafao, gratuity na bonasi ya kustaafu yanajumuishwa kwenye mapato yanayotozwa kodi. Mwajiri lazima ahesabu PAYE kwenye malipo hayo na kuiwasilisha TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kiwango cha kodi kinatumika kulingana na jedwali la kawaida la PAYE — mapato ya mwezi huo yote pamoja. Unaweza kujua zaidi kwenye tra.go.tz.
answer_en: Yes. Under the Income Tax Act, employment termination benefits including gratuity, severance pay, and retirement bonuses are included in taxable employment income. The employer must calculate PAYE on these payments and remit to TRA by the 7th of the following month. The normal PAYE tax bands apply — total income for that month is taxed. See tra.go.tz for details.
question_en: An employee completes 10 years of service. The company pays TZS 5,000,000 as terminal benefits. Is PAYE deducted from this payment?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — Income Tax Act Cap.332

instruction: EFD yangu ilifunga (hung) usiku bila kupiga Z-report — hatua gani?
output: Z-report lazima ipigwe MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Hatua: (1) Washa tena EFD asubuhi ya mapema. (2) Piga Z-report haraka iwezekanavyo kabla ya mauzo mapya. (3) Kama EFD hifunguki, wasiliana na msambazaji wako wa EFD mara moja. (4) Andika rekodi ya mkono (manual record) kwa mauzo yoyote hadi EFD irudi kufanya kazi.

instruction: EFD machine yangu iliharibika. Niendelee kuuza bila kutoa risiti wakati inakarabatiwa?
output: Hapana. Kuendelea kufanya miamala bila kutoa risiti ya EFD ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya EFD. Hatua sahihi ni: (1) Ripoti uharibiku kwa msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa na TRA mara moja; (2) Omba ruhusa ya sementara kwa TRA (tra.go.tz) kuendelea na biashara wakati wa ukarabati; (3) Hifadhi rekodi za mauzo yote kwa mkono wakati huo; (4) Malipo ya kodi lazima yafanyike kama kawaida. Kuendelea bila ruhusa ni kosa la kisheria.

question_sw: Mauzo ya bidhaa kwenye mitandao ya kijamii (Facebook, Instagram) hayalipishi kodi Tanzania kwa sababu ni biashara ya mtandaoni tu — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mauzo ya bidhaa au huduma kupitia mitandao ya kijamii bado yana kodi ya Tanzania ikiwa biashara ipo Tanzania au bidhaa/huduma zinauzwa kwa wateja wa Tanzania. Kodi ya mapato ya biashara, VAT (ikiwa mauzo yanazidi kizingiti), na EFD (kama unaomba) zinatumika bila kujali iwapo mauzo yanafanywa mtandaoni au mwili kwa mwili.
question_en: Sales via social media (Facebook, Instagram) are not taxed in Tanzania because it is online business only — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Sales of goods or services via social media are still subject to Tanzania tax if the business is based in Tanzania or the goods/services are sold to Tanzania customers. Business income tax, VAT (if sales exceed the threshold), and EFD (if applicable) apply regardless of whether sales are made online or in person.

instruction: Rafiki yangu alisema sole trader asiohitaji BRELA ni huyo anayetumia jina lake — ukweli ni upi?
output: Rafiki yako alikosea. Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. Ukweli: sheria haifanyi ubaguzi wowote kulingana na jina unalotumia. Kila mfanyabiashara Tanzania Bara anahitaji usajili wa BRELA.

question_sw: Mgeni anaweza kuanza kufanya kazi Tanzania kabla ya kupata kibali?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mgeni lazima apate kibali cha makazi cha daraja B (Class B) kabla ya kuanza kufanya kazi. Kufanya kazi kabla ya kibali ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya uhamiaji na unaweza kusababisha kufukuzwa nchini. Mwajiri pia anachukuliwa na jukumu. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Can a non-citizen start working in Tanzania before receiving their permit?
answer_en: No. A non-citizen must obtain a Class B residence permit before starting work. Working before a permit is an immigration law violation and can result in deportation. The employer also bears liability. Confirm with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: SDL ya kampuni yenye mishahara ya TZS 5,000,000 kwa mwezi ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: SDL = 3.5% × TZS 5,000,000 = TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi. Mwajiri analipa TZS 175,000 kwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kiwango cha 3.5% kinatumiwa kwa jumla ya mishahara yote (gross payroll).
question_en: SDL for a company with TZS 5,000,000 monthly payroll is how much?
answer_en: SDL = 3.5% × TZS 5,000,000 = TZS 175,000 per month. The employer pays TZS 175,000 to TRA by the 7th of the following month. The 3.5% rate is applied to total gross payroll.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Biashara ya rejareja iliyofanywa na mgeni kwa miaka mitatu. Adhabu itahesabiwa kwa miaka mitatu?
answer_sw: Hapana — adhabu ya GN 487A inategemea USHAHIDI wa muda wa ukiukaji uliobainishwa mahakamani, si muda wote ambao biashara ilifanya kazi. Korti inazingatia ushahidi uliowasilishwa. Hata hivyo, muda mrefu wa ukiukaji unaweza kuathiri ukali wa adhabu ndani ya mipaka ya sheria — korti inaweza kutoza faini kubwa zaidi kuliko kiwango cha chini cha 10M.
question_en: Retail business conducted by a non-citizen for three years. Will the penalty be calculated for three years?
answer_en: No — the GN 487A penalty depends on the EVIDENCE of the violation period established in court, not the entire period the business operated. The court considers the evidence presented. However, a long period of violation may influence the severity of the penalty within the legal limits — a court may impose a higher fine than the 10M minimum.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Ninahamisha hisa zangu kwa mtu mwingine katika kampuni ya Tanzania — stamp duty inatumika?
output: Stamp duty inatumika kwa uhamisho wa mali Tanzania. Viwango na taratibu halisi vinategemea aina ya mali na thamani yake inayotathminiwa na mthamini aliyesajiliwa. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Stamp duty kwa uhamisho wa hisa inashughulikiwa chini ya Sheria ya Stamp Duty na inahitaji tathmini maalum ya thamani ya hisa. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari: mfanyabiashara wa Tanzania anapaswa kujua nini kuhusu kodi za huduma za kidijitali?
answer_sw: Mambo makuu: (1) VAT ya kawaida ni 18% — bado inatumika kwa bidhaa/huduma nyingi; (2) VAT ya 16% kwa B2C e-payments kuanzia 1 Sep 2025; (3) Withholding tax 6% kwa huduma (ikiwa ni pamoja na kidijitali) kuanzia 1 Jul 2025; (4) EFD inahitajika kwa mauzo ya mtandaoni pia; (5) Watoa huduma wa nje wanaweza kuwa na wajibu wa VAT Tanzania. Thibitisha maelezo ya utekelezaji na TRA kwa sababu kanuni fulani bado zinaandaliwa.
question_en: Summary: what does a Tanzanian business need to know about digital services taxes?
answer_en: Key points: (1) Standard VAT is 18% — still applies to most goods/services; (2) 16% VAT on B2C e-payments from 1 Sep 2025; (3) 6% withholding tax on services (including digital) from 1 Jul 2025; (4) EFD is required for online sales too; (5) Foreign service providers may have Tanzania VAT obligations. Verify implementation details with TRA as some rules are still being finalized.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: Hati ya dhamana ya mkopo wa benki (bank loan security) Tanzania ina ushuru wa stempu — mnunuzi analipa wakati wa kusaini au baadaye?
answer_sw: Dhamana ya mkopo wa benki Tanzania (kama rehani ya ardhi, charge) ina ushuru wa stempu ambao unapaswa kulipwa KABLA ya kusajili dhamana hiyo au kabla ya kutumika kisheria. Kawaida, ushuru unalipwa WAKATI AU KABLA ya kusaini au kusajili. Benki nyingi zinasimamia mchakato huu na mteja (mkopaji) mara nyingi anabeba gharama hii.
question_en: Does a bank loan security instrument in Tanzania carry stamp duty — does the buyer pay at signing or later?
answer_en: A bank loan security in Tanzania (such as a land mortgage or charge) carries stamp duty that must be paid BEFORE registering the security or before it can be used legally. Generally, duty is paid AT OR BEFORE signing or registration. Banks usually manage this process and the client (borrower) typically bears the cost.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or banking regulation update

instruction: GN605A ilianza lini na ilifutwa amri gani?
output: GN605A ilitangazwa rasmi kwenye Gazeti la Serikali tarehe 13 Oktoba 2025. Ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Ilifuta kabisa Amri ya Mshahara wa Chini ya Sekta Binafsi ya mwaka 2022 — amri hiyo ya 2022 haina nguvu yoyote ya kisheria tangu tarehe 31 Desemba 2025. Viwango vyote vya mshahara wa sekta binafsi tangu Januari 2026 lazima vitokane na GN605A.
